The Science Version is a unique science ship, which means it can survey systems, but also comes equipped with impressive firepower. As with all science vessels, they cannot join fleets and require a scientist to lead them.
MIlitary Flagships are very powerful, but regular warships, come with special modifiers that make them deadly in combat. 

Be careful though, using these ships comes with a risk, should your flagship be destroyed you must wait until the next class version is available... no do-overs here! 

In order to build the next version of the Enterprise, make sure the tech is available and the class exists in the ship designer, and you no longer have the older version active in your fleet (except the NX-01, this ship does not count as part of the 1701 family ... you can keep it!).
STH_qpedia.10.g.response: Buildable from Utopia Planitia Megastructure these ships represent some of the more famous ships in Star Trek lore, they are formidable ships and add a bit of extra Trek flavour to the game! Some even come with unique missions... watch out for those badlands USS Voyager!
STH_qpedia.10.name: The Humans
STH_qpedia.100.c.response: The Borg fleets in battle will slowly adapt to the weapons they face reducing the damage enemy weapons inflict upon them until finally when fully adapted taking no damage from them at all. When Borg fleets are not in battle this adaptation level drops slowly. The enemies of the Borg can use special anti-Borg edicts such as Anti-Borg Frequency Remodulators or Anti-Borg Tactical Innovations to either slow down this adaption or reduce the time Borg stay adapted against their weapons. On the other hand the Borg also have a tradition tree called Adaptability that gives them bonuses to various aspects of adaptation.
STH_qpedia.100.d.response: To unlock the Colony harvest espionage operation you need to first adopt the Harvesting tradition tree which then makes it possible to harvest colonies from 1 pop to 15 pops. And once you have done the Hyper-Compression Patter buffers tradition the limit rises to colonies from 1 to 30 pops. However you cannot harvest anyone's homeworld or Undine colonies. Also no war or truce is allowed with the target empire when trying to harvest.
STH_qpedia.100.desc: Perfection. So close yet still so very very far for you. Take it from someone who knows. Now with what knowledge would you wish to improve yourself today?
STH_qpedia.100.e.response: Transwarp conduits allow ships to move between two built conduit entries (Transwarp conduit megastructures) at a very rapid rate. Initially these conduits are only available for Borg fleets to enter, but fighting against the Borg may yield the technology for other empires to also take advantage of them. The Transwarp Aparture Hub functions like regular Stellaris Quantum Catapult megastructure moving your fleet close to the set destination within the catapults range. To use the Aparture you need to have a fleet in the same system as it and then choose the Catapult-fleet option from the fleet UI.
STH_qpedia.100.e: Transwarp conduit and Transwarp Aperture Hub.
STH_qpedia.100.name: The Borg Collective
STH_qpedia.11.a: What or Where is Starbase One?
STH_qpedia.11.b: What can I do with the Council?
STH_qpedia.11.desc: As of our 3.6 update, you can summon the UFP council to Starbase one for a meeting to discuss key events and help manage the Federation and its member worlds. Some worlds will appreciate the support, while others might become frustrated with the micro-management. To open this mechanic simply click on the UFP emblem next to Starbase one or contact them via the contacts tab.
STH_qpedia.11.name: Starbase One
STH_qpedia.1111.a.response: Arguing with the Q, well, well... that's a risky decision, whole fleets have been known to vanish in a.... snap.
STH_qpedia.1111.name: Locked out system [From.GetName].
STH_qpedia.1112.desc:
Dev Note: As part of our 4.0 release, we have examined several performance improvements and decided that we need to modify how the decision techs operate. These techs, once researched, enable you to select from multiple specialisations. 

In the 4.0 update, these will now be checked every 3 months, which will cause a small delay between the research being completed and the decision being made. 

If you would like to force the event to run earlier, then run STH_custom.51 from the console.
STH_qpedia.1112.name: Decision Techs
STH_qpedia.12.desc:
You may have noticed that an extra pop-up appeared after you formed the Federation, well that formed the council, as well as giving you lots of planets, leaders, and cool new ships.

If you look over Neptune in the Sol system or one of your gas giants if you are not playing as Earth you will see a new megastructure that resembles Starbase One, as seen in Discovery and Strange New Worlds... click on it, just like you would click on another countries ships to talk to them.
STH_qpedia.12.name: Starbase One
STH_qpedia.13.a.response: This gives you the most options and allows you to directly update your member's home systems. From here you can fund a starbase upgrade (if you have the tech), you can transfer some of your ships to them or seek there advice on winning a war.
STH_qpedia.13.b.response: You can select which era of Federation Flag you wish to represent the UFP.
STH_qpedia.13.desc: Now that the Council has assembled you have a number of options to manage your members and run the Federation as you wish.
STH_qpedia.13.name: The Federation Council
STH_qpedia.2.desc:
The Q Continuum is bursting with knowledge and has introduced a new means of helping players play the many unique features of ST:New Horizons. 

The Q-pedia contains the collective knowledge of the Q with handy questions on how certain mechanics work and is worth a peak if you get stuck! 

If you need to open the help section, contact Q from the Contacts tab and there via Adv Diplomacy which now not only allows you to change the starting conditions but also find these helpful articles.
STH_qpedia.2.name: Q-pedia
STH_qpedia.200.a.response: To escape fluidic space you need to either complete the events in 'Masters of Fluidic Space' event chain and wait for the Borg to show up or make use of the edict 'Unleash the Vanguard' which comes available after 20 years.
STH_qpedia.200.a: How do I get out of fluidic space?
STH_qpedia.200.b.response: Building a Holding Pen on each Fluidic realm planet will allow non fluidic species to be placed on those planets without getting purged.
STH_qpedia.200.b: How can I avoid purging none fluidic pops?
STH_qpedia.200.c.response: In order to become the crisis as Undine you need to have the Nemesis DLC on and attack the main galaxy during the event 'The Purge' as the Undine Infesters.
STH_qpedia.200.c: How to become the crisis as Undine?
STH_qpedia.200.desc: Oh the Undine with their famous motto, 'the weak shall perish.' Such hostile creatures to visitors in their space. But if you are going to keep up with that attitude there might be some useful things for you to know.
STH_qpedia.200.name: The Undine
STH_qpedia.300.a.response:
As you may have noticed the Dominion has 3 different types of basic pops. The Founders also known as shape-shifters are the rulers of the Dominion. Considered as gods by the Vorta and Jem'Hadar the Founders mainly handle the most prestigious jobs in the Dominion. 

The Vorta act as commanders, administrators, scientists and diplomats for the Founders, utterly loyal to their will.

The military arm of the Dominion is run by the Jem'Hadar, a genetically engineered race who are birthed and genetically modified to be perfect soldiers. Their loyalty is guaranteed by a drug called ketracel-white, which is their sole source of food and nourishment.
STH_qpedia.300.a: The Founder, Vorta and Jem'Hadar pops.
STH_qpedia.300.b.response:
Ketracel-White is a special resource that provides sustenance to your Jem'Hadar pops. It is also a way the Dominion rulers, the Founders, ensure the loyalty of the fierce Jem'Hadar warriors. 

Ketracel-White can be produced in two ways. Either find a planet that you can build a Ketracel-White Refinery on or once you have researched the technology build a Synthetic Ketracel-White Refinery on a planet. Alternatively you can also look to buy some Ketracel-White from the Market.
STH_qpedia.300.c.response:
A Dominion Member World is a special type of vassal for the Dominion. This vassal type will offer you some of its resources as well as a unique vassal specialization tree that offers new benefits after each level on the tree is reached. You can view this tree and the vassal in-general from Contacts and there Agreements. It can even help you defend the Dominion. 

But can I get more of these vassals, I hear you asking? Sure just select Expand the Dominion war goal when you declare war to your neighbour.
STH_qpedia.300.c: What is a Dominion Member World?
STH_qpedia.300.desc: Ah the Dominion, a bunch of shape-shifters who can do cute little form tricks while playing as gods for those species that cannot. How cute. What do you want to know about them?
STH_qpedia.300.name: The Dominion
STH_qpedia.50.desc: Well glory to you and to your tiny house and all that other Klingon nonsense. What do you wish to know more about?
STH_qpedia.50.name: The Klingon Empire
STH_qpedia.70.b.response: Not every empire has the audacity to impose its ideals on other empires, pacifists in particular (and this included the Federation) like to think they are above such things. But I want to... I hear you shout, well you can all you need is the Righteous minds tradition in the Force of Will Then, ensure you have changed your war policy to include ideological wars and you can go on your merry way pushing your views on anyone who will listen and now those that don't.
STH_qpedia.70.b: Why can't I impose my ideology?
STH_qpedia.70.desc: War... what is it good for? Well as it turns out, it's good for rather a lot. Whether you want to take some territory, defend yourself, or those many human words you have just don't seem as much fun as firing a torpedo at a helpless hull. Here you can find enough bits of info on war to make Sun Tzu want to write a second book.
STH_qpedia.70.name: War! What is it good for?
STH_qpedia.71.a.response: With enough influence you can claim another empires systems and declare war to win ownership of said system.
STH_qpedia.71.b.response: Can be declared by all normal countries with unrestricted wars or ideological wars policy. Forces an empire that you have tried to subjugate diplomatically to become your subject. When playing as the Dominion victory forces them to become Dominion Member states.
STH_qpedia.71.c.response: Forces your ideology onto another empire, can be used by all normal countries with has unrestricted wars or ideological wars policy and not gestalt consciousness. Cannot be declared on an empire with the same ideology as you... for obvious reasons.
STH_qpedia.71.d.response: May only be used by a barbaric society or one with the barbaric despoilers civic.
STH_qpedia.71.desc: This section of the Q-pedia list the requirement for each Casus Belli in STNH.
STH_qpedia.71.e.response: The Borg can declare their intent to assimilate their neighbours, victory forces the loser to submit to the Borg, who will eventually assimilate their culture and make them adapt to service the Collective. The AI Borg will operate a sleep cycle and will often ignore empires that are less technologically advance than themselves.
STH_qpedia.71.f.response: Any neighbour of the Borg or allied empire who neighbours the Borg may declare a defensive war on the Collective. Also you can declare war on the Borg if they have used their colony scoop against you... those devious cyborgs.
STH_qpedia.71.g.response: You can declare war on any target that is at war with any of your allies, countries you are guaranteeing or associate empires.
STH_qpedia.71.name: How do Casus Belli Work?
STH_qpedia.90.desc: Ah the Romulans, always scheming and plotting something in secrecy aren't you? Well as it turns out I know all of your petty little secrets, so just ask away.
STH_qpedia.90.name: The Romulan Star Empire
STH_redemption.10.desc: Ambassador K'Ehleyr from the Federation has confirmed that the Federation is sending one of their warriors to meet with us to discuss the Rite of Succession, and whilst they proclaim they will not directly interfere they will hear our ask.
STH_redemption.10.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.11.desc: Our failure to attend our own conference has no doubt led to confusion within our own ranks and frustration within the decks of the Starfleet vessel that was waiting to rendezvous with us.
STH_redemption.11.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.12.desc: The Klingons have never been known as a patient people and our failure to attend the agreed meeting has nothing to improve relations and will have harmed our efforts to build a peaceful quadrant.
STH_redemption.12.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.13.desc: It appears the Klingons have failed to attend the arranged meeting with the Federation Flagship, a baffling and cowardly act from the Klingons, however one can never fathom the actions of such a foolish species. It does however. put an end to our schemes in this area.
STH_redemption.13.name: Klingons Fail to Attend
STH_redemption.14.desc: The Federation has demonstrated a lack of honour by failing to attend the agreed meeting, perhaps we have miss-judged them.
STH_redemption.14.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.15.desc: The Klingons have never been known as a patient people and our failure to attend the agreed meeting has nothing to improve relations and will have harmed our efforts to build a peaceful quadrant.
STH_redemption.15.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.16.desc: It appears the Federation have failed to attend the arranged meeting with the Klingon Flagship, a rather baffling and cowardly act from Starfleet, which puts an end to our schemes in this area.
STH_redemption.16.name: Federation fail to Attend
STH_redemption.17.a: Let the Rite of Succession begin.
STH_redemption.17.desc: Commander [klingon_redemption_1_leader.GetName] has successfully delivered Chancellor [klingon_leader.GetName] to their meeting with the Federation Flagship, now begins a hazardous situation for the Klingon Empire as a new ruler must be selected to guide them Empire through this new era.
STH_redemption.17.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.18.a: You had better be correct Sela.
STH_redemption.18.desc: As I predicted Praetor the Klingon Empire has run to his Federation betters to seek help with aiding in the selection of a new Chancellor, now is our chance to not only place a puppet on the throne of the Empire but destroy their relationship with Starfleet and plunge them into chaos.
STH_redemption.18.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.19.a: Let the Rite of Succession begin.
STH_redemption.19.desc: Captain [federation_redemption_1_leader.GetName] and the [federation_redemption_1_ship.GetName] have arrived at the coordinates, as a Klingon Battlecruiser the IKS Vor'cha, pride of the Klingon fleet decloaks in front of them carrying the Klingon Chancellor eager to meet and discuss the situation ahead.
STH_redemption.19.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.2.b: We have no time for this.
STH_redemption.2.desc: Greetings Praetor, I bring you a grave warning from the Tal Shiar.. we have been working with one of your up-and-coming Imperial Commanders who is requesting an audience with the council to discuss a matter which could impact the very security of the Empire.
STH_redemption.2.name: Message from the Tal Shiar
STH_redemption.20.a.response: Bloodwine has long been my weakness and I would assume I am now paying the price for this love. How else would Veridium Six make its way into my bloodstream? How very Romulan of someone...
STH_redemption.20.b.response: I need a neutral party who I can trust, and I trust very few people within the Empire now.
STH_redemption.20.c.response: Gowron, son of M'Rel, is ambitious, greedy, and has long-eyed power, but he respect our alliance and has no desire for war. There is honour in the house of Gowron.
STH_redemption.20.d.response: Duras comes from a ancient and noble House, he carries the loyalty of many of the elite families. He would do anything to claim power and would see the empire go to war to achieve those personal goals.
STH_redemption.20.desc:
Greetings [federation_redemption_1_leader.GetName] you bring great honor to yourself in joining us here today and I offer you my thanks. 

The great Klingon Empire stands on a D'k tahg edge... my time remaining is limited, forces cough have been working against me from the shadows and I cannot let these agents rule the Empire when I am gone. 

There are two leading candidates to replace me, both have strong support... cough Gowron commands the loyalty of those who wish to see the status quo remain, whilst Duras has the support of the ambitious forces within the Empire cough I know you cannot directly interfere, but you can help me put the right person in the Chancellor's seat, help me find out who has killed me.
STH_redemption.20.e: We must think on this decision.
STH_redemption.20.name: The Klingon Succession Crisis
STH_redemption.21.a.response: Of course, how else would so much Veridium Six make its way into my bloodwine? It is clear someone has there own desires for the throne of the Empire and need me out of the way.
STH_redemption.21.a: We suspect foul play, do you?
STH_redemption.21.b.response: I need a neutral party who I can trust, and I trust very few people within the Empire now.
STH_redemption.21.b: Why did you reach out to us?
STH_redemption.21.desc:
Greetings [Root.GetRulerName] from the United Federation of Planets, I am [ufp_leader.GetName] and I am here to answer the call for assistance from the Klingon High Council. 

As requested my Chief Medical Officer has looked at your medical report and can confirm that the Veridium Six poisoning will soon take your life, our understanding is that two rival leaders stand ready to challenge for the leadership of the Empire. Gowron offers a stable option, whilst Duras desires power above all else. One of these is likely to have taken their desire to lead the empire to treacherous levels, we will attempt to judge who the culprit is.
STH_redemption.21.name: The Klingon Succession Crisis
STH_redemption.22.a.response: An explosive response should do the trick.
STH_redemption.22.desc: Praetor, Command Sela reporting in, our spies from the House of Duras have confirmed that the meeting between the Starfleet Captain and the Klingon Chancellor has taken place, we have the perfect opportunity to sabotage this meeting and sow confusion and tension within both parties, laying the way for our puppets in the House of Duras to take control of the Empire.
STH_redemption.22.name: The Klingon Succession Crisis
STH_redemption.24.desc:
As the meeting comes to an end, the deafening sound of an explosion rings out across the meeting room. Security Officers from Starfleet and KDF dive to protect their leaders and sirens bellow while the emergency lights flicker hopelessly. 

It is clear that some force does not want this meeting to have taken place.
STH_redemption.24.name: Explosion Rocks the Chamber!
STH_redemption.25.a.response: I believe that Duras has been working with the Romulan Star Empire for many months now, tell me this does not smell like a Romulan plot to you?
STH_redemption.25.a: Off the record... what do you think?
STH_redemption.25.desc:
Captain, this is K'Ehleyr the Federation Ambassador to the Klingon Empire, the Federation Council has tasked me with aiding you in this investigation into this attack given my knowledge of the current state of Klingon affairs.

I need not warn you that the Empire stands on the edge of a civil war that could drag in powers from across the quadrant, I have my suspicions on who is responsible here, but we cannot act without evidence and a wrong move could easily turn the average Klingon warrior against us.
STH_redemption.25.name: Investigate the Bombing
STH_redemption.26.a.response: With little evidence to back this up, all I can suggest is that this attack feels unlikely to have been carried out without the help of a third party, but I could not say who.
STH_redemption.26.desc:
Unfortunately, we must report back with bad news, despite a thorough investigation of the bomb site we have been unable to find any more evidence to suggest who was behind the attack. 

I cannot offer any additional information for you at this point.
STH_redemption.26.name: No Evidence Found
STH_redemption.27.a.response: The evidence is quite clear, it seems Duras was complicit in planting this bomb, with help from the Romulans. Further, we now have a link between these parties and the attack on the Klingon colony at Khitomer.
STH_redemption.27.desc:
Our investigation has been completed and we have made a startling discovery, it appears the substance used in the bomb carries a unique signature which has been known to have been used by Romulan agents and appears to have been carried in the meeting by a member of the Duras household guard. 

What makes this even more interesting is that we were able to go through our records and find similar readings also present at the site of the Khitomer Massacre. 

This implies a connection between Duras, the Romulans and the events at Khitomer all those years ago.
STH_redemption.27.name: Evidence Found
STH_redemption.28.a.response: This evidence could turn the average Klingon against Duras and reveal him as the traitor to the Empire that he is!
STH_redemption.28.a: What does this mean for Duras?
STH_redemption.28.b.response: This could turn the tide and end the threat from House Duras, as well as remove the wrongful suspicions that have plagued the House of Mogh for years.
STH_redemption.28.b: The Council must see this evidence!
STH_redemption.28.desc_01:
I have spoken with Worf, son of Mogh, a ...close associate of mine, his family was killed at Khitomer, and Mogh his father has long taken the blame for the failings the Empire suffered on that fateful day. 

This new evidence not only links Duras to those events but strongly suggests that his bid for leadership of the Empire is backed by the Romulans. This could prove a great threat to the Federation, as no doubt the Romulans would have more plans that are not in the best interests of the UFP. 

Worf and I must work together to present this evidence, Worf can confront Duras whilst I gather the evidence and bring it to the Council and Starfleet.
STH_redemption.28.desc_02:
This new evidence not only links Duras to the events at Khitomer but strongly suggests that his bid for leadership of the Empire is backed by the Romulans. This could prove a great threat to the Federation, as no doubt the Romulans would have more plans that are not in the best interests of the UFP. 

This evidence could completely derail Duras' bid to take over the leadership of the Empire as no self-respecting warrior would stand alongside this traitor.
STH_redemption.28.name: Evidence against Duras
STH_redemption.29.d: Ambassador K'Ehleyr dies in the arms of Worf.
STH_redemption.29.desc_01:
As Ambassador K'Ehleyr downloads the evidence and prepares to take it to her superiors, the door to her quarters opens, and a tall and dangerous figure enters the room, Duras armed with a vicious-looking d'k tahg blade. He advances on the Ambassador, with a cruel smile, uttering the words 'this evidence can go no further'. 

The two warriors trade blows, but Duras is stronger and more experienced, in the end K'Ehleyr lies mortally wounded and Duras has his prize.
STH_redemption.29.desc_02:
As Ambassador K'Ehleyr downloads the evidence and prepares to take it to her superiors, the door to her quarters opens, and a tall and dangerous figure enters the room, Duras armed with a vicious-looking d'k tahg blade. He advances on the Ambassador, with a cruel smile, uttering the words 'this evidence can go no further'. 

The two warriors trade blows, but although Duras is stronger and more experienced, K'Ehleyr has something truly powerful to fight for and is able to hold her ground forcing Duras to use tactics unworthy of a Klingon warror... but it gets the job done. 

K'Ehleyr lays crippled on the floor and Duras, evidence in hand makes a hasty retreat.
STH_redemption.29.desc_03:
As Ambassador K'Ehleyr downloads the evidence and prepares to take it to her superiors, the door to her quarters opens, and a tall and dangerous figure enters the room, Duras armed with a vicious-looking d'k tahg blade. He advances on the Ambassador, with a cruel smile, uttering the words 'this evidence can go no further'. 

The two warriors trade blows, the fight is fierce, two warriors with everything to lose fighting with all their might. 

When it is clear that Duras cannot win he changes tact and manages to target the evidence with a well aimed shot from his Disrupter, the explosion from the console knocking the Ambassador to thr ground, whilst Duras makes his escape.
STH_redemption.29.name: Duras finds K'Ehleyr alone
STH_redemption.3.b: We will have no part in this plan.
STH_redemption.3.desc:
Greetings Praetor [Root.GetLeaderName], my name is Commander Sela and I have been working on fostering a relationship with the leadership of one of the Great Houses within the Klingon Empire my source has revealed that the relationship between the Klingon Empire and the Federation is continuing to grow at an alarming pace since they signed the treaty at Khitomer. 

My contact within the House of Duras is ready to make a bid for the leadership of the Empire, but they will need our support and a little help ensuring the current leader of the High Council meets an 'unfortunate' end...
STH_redemption.3.name: A meeting with Sela
STH_redemption.30.a.response: Since you will never be able to prove it, you may as well know that my father betrayed the Empire and you need me to prove that your father was not a traitor!
STH_redemption.30.b.response: She was collateral damage and in my way, just like you and your Federation!
STH_redemption.30.b: Why did K'Ehleyr have to die?
STH_redemption.30.c: Today is a Good Day to Die Duras.
STH_redemption.30.desc: Duras! I am here to claim the Right of Vengeance for your actions here today, you will die at my hands here today and pay for your crimes against K'Ehleyr and for the sins of your father against the House of Mogh.
STH_redemption.30.name: Right of Vengance
STH_redemption.31.desc: The two Klingons are locked in fierce combat, one fighting for vengeance and fueled by the rage of the injustices caused by the other. As the sounds of battle echos around, one man emerges triumphant, Worf, while Duras lies dead at his feet.
STH_redemption.31.name: Worf Emerges Victorious
STH_redemption.32.desc: The two Klingons engage in combat, with both warriors fighting for their lives, Duras moves quickly to his right feigning an attack and drawing Worf into a lunge enabling Duras to capitalise and stab Worf in the back ending the battle with Duras standing victorious.
STH_redemption.32.name: Duras Emerges Victorious
STH_redemption.33.a.response: The House of Duras is powerful and has many backers, and most will not accept that they have colluded with the Romulans. Duras' disgrace is his own and his bid for the Chancellorship ends today, but his family remains strong and powerful.
STH_redemption.33.b.response: The House of Mogh will formally accept the Dishonour upon it for the sake of the Empire.
STH_redemption.33.desc:
Worf, you stand before the High Council, whilst you were in your rights as Klingon to enact the Right of Vengence, with it lies any chance of clearing your family name. If we may speak off the record... your father knew too well that challenging Duras at this time would lead to open revolt within the Empire. The House of Duras is too strong right now to challenge and the death of their leader at the hands of a member of Starfleet only strengthens the backing they have. 

For the good of the Empire we need you to bear this disgrace a while longer whilst the future of the Empire is solidified.
STH_redemption.33.name: Discommendation
STH_redemption.34.desc:
As the meeting comes to an end, the deafening sound of an explosion rings out across the meeting room. Security Officers from Starfleet and KDF dive to protect their leaders and sirens bellow while the emergency lights flicker hopelessly. 

It is clear that some force does not want this meeting to have taken place.
STH_redemption.34.name: Bomb Explodes
STH_redemption.35.a: This is all going to plan.
STH_redemption.35.desc: As planned by Sela and her team, an explosion has rocked the conference being held by the Klingons and Federation the resulting chaos has hampered the succession process, and built support for our puppets in the House of Duras.
STH_redemption.35.name: Bomb Explodes at UFP-Klingon Conference
STH_redemption.36.desc: Our plans to plant Duras as head of the Klingon Empire have suffered a serious blow, as it appears the fool was killed in single combat against a Starfleet officer. Only in Klingon society could an act of such barbarism be tolerated, we will need to re-assess and adapt our plans without the fool Duras.
STH_redemption.36.name: Duras Dead
STH_redemption.37.desc:
Despite the bombing, the Klingons are insisting on a decision, the Rite of Succession must be completed and a recommendation must be put forward. 

What has been made clear is that no matter the victor today this matter is far from settled and both sides will not take the decision lightly. We cannot directly influence the internal matters of the Empire, but we can make a judgment on who has been trying to kill the Chancellor.
STH_redemption.37.name: Time to Decide
STH_redemption.38.desc: The time has come to make a judgment on the next Chancellor of the Klingon Empire. Our investigations have shown that Duras, working with the Romulans, attempted to sabotage the meeting and kill his rivals in a very un-Klingon display. However, it is clear that Duras has the backing of a large number of the 'old-guard' and his family name carries a lot of weight within the noble families. Whereas Gowron offers stability, a clear career politician he lacks the big family name and military history, but he is in no rush to take the Empire to war. The Chancellor wants to know who is working against the Empire, which answer should we give?
STH_redemption.38.name: Time to Decide
STH_redemption.39.a: Gowron should be the new leader.
STH_redemption.39.b: Duras should be the new leader.
STH_redemption.39.desc_01: The Arbiter has made their decision and believes that Gowron son of M'Rel played no part in the poisoning and later attempted assassination of the Chancellor. After studying the evidence they are in no doubt that Duras, conspiring with other forces is the traitor!
STH_redemption.39.desc_02:
The Arbiter has made their decision and believes that Duras of the House of Duras is the innocent party, and despite the rumors played no part in the attempted assassination of the Chancellor's life. 

Instead the ambitious Gowron took it upon himself to open up a route to the Chancellorship.
STH_redemption.39.name: The Arbiter Has Spoken
STH_redemption.4.desc:
Qapla' it is with great concern I must report that my health continues to deteriorate, the greatest doctors within the Empire feel my passage to Sto-vo-kor rapidly approaches. 

I speak now grave words for I fear that treachery runs deep within the Empire and I will be reaching out to our allies in the Federation to play a part in the Arbiter of Succession ritual for I can no longer trust the warriors within these halls.
STH_redemption.4.name: High Council Meeting
STH_redemption.40.desc: The Klingon's have reached a decision and Gowron will be the new leader of the Klingon Empire on the death of their current Chancellor.
STH_redemption.40.name: Gowron the Heir to the Empire
STH_redemption.41.desc: The Klingon's have reached a decision and Duras will be the new leader of the Klingon Empire on the death of their current Chancellor.
STH_redemption.41.name: Duras Heir to the Empire
STH_redemption.42.desc:
Our Federation liaison has contacted our security teams, they regret to inform us that Duras entered into single combat with the son of Mogh and was slain as an act of Vengence for killing the Federation Ambassador. 

It is amusing that the Federation is so concerned about this act, they forget we are Klingons and the right of vengence and combat is in our blood.. We shall await the son of Mogh presenting himself to us for judgment.
STH_redemption.42.name: Duras killed in Combat
STH_redemption.45.desc_01: Word has reached the Federation Council from the Klingon Empire, Chancellor K'mpec has passed on to Sto-Vo-Kor. We have passed on our condolences and will mourn the passing of a leader who held he peace treaty in high regard, as we move on to more uncertain times.
STH_redemption.45.desc_02: Our warriors cry out to let the dead know a new warrior travels the barge to the Great Halls of Sto-Vo-Kor. [Root.GetRulerName] As one regime ends and new one begins.
STH_redemption.45.name: The Chancellor is Dead...
STH_redemption.46.desc: Our spies in the Klingon Empire have confirmed that their Chancellor has finally succumbed to the poison that our agents have been pumping into the fool's Bloodwine. The next phase of our plan comes into effect.
STH_redemption.46.name: Klingon Chancellor Dies
STH_redemption.47.desc: It is time to confirm the position of Chancellor [Root.GetRulerName] in front of the Klingon High Council and our allies. We should send out invites and begin a new era in the Empires grand history.
STH_redemption.47.name: The New Chancellor
STH_redemption.48.desc:
Qapla' to our allies! I invite you to travel to Qo'noS to celebrate in my ascension to my rightful position as ruler of the Klingon Empire, no thanks to the help that you provided. 

I look forward to showing your representative a true Klingon welcome!
STH_redemption.48.name: Message from the Klingon Empire
STH_redemption.5.a.response: Chancellor [klingon_leader.GetName] requires our help to oversee the Rite of Succession, a process which selects the next Chancellor of the Empire, a role which I am told he feels he can trust no one within the Empire.
STH_redemption.5.a: What role does the Arbiter play?
STH_redemption.5.desc: Greetings I am K'Ehleyr, Federation Ambassador to the Klingon Empire, I've been approached by my counterpart from the Empire to ask for our attendance at an important meeting, it appears the Chancellor of the Empire is in dire health and has asked for one of our finest to act as the Arbiter of Succession in the upcoming ceremony. This act will go a long way in cementing our relationship with the Empire and ensuring that the best possible outcome is reached for future Federation-Klingon relations.
STH_redemption.5.name: Inbound Message from the Klingon Ambassador
STH_redemption.50.desc_01: As Gowron dons the ceremonial robe of the High Chancellor, his forces make their move to arrest members of the House of Duras who had not previously fled Qo'noS a fleet of rebel sympathisers decloak and begin to open fire in an attempt to cover the escape of Duras' forces.
STH_redemption.50.desc_02: As Duras dons the ceremonial robe of the High Chancellor, his forces make their move to arrest members of Gowrons team who had not previously fled Qo'noS a fleet of rebel sympathisers decloak and begin to open fire in an attempt to cover the escape of Gowron and his commanders.
STH_redemption.50.name: Rebel Attack
STH_redemption.52.desc: The Rebel fleet has been destroyed, but not before allowing the rebel leaders to escape the planet's surface. Could this be the first skirmish in a Klingon Civil War?
STH_redemption.52.name: Rebel Fleet Destroyed
STH_redemption.53.desc_01: Greetings Praetor our chance to fuel the Rebel faction of House Duras has arrived, with all eyes within the Klingon Empire now turning towards the inevitable civil war that our agents have fueled now is the time to provide them with weapons and resources that will forever place them in our debt, so that once they come to power we will have ourselves a new ally eager to turn on the Federation, paving the way for Romulus to come and take her rightful place as rulers of the Alpha-Beta Quadrants.
STH_redemption.53.desc_02: Greetings Praetor our chance to fuel the Rebel faction of House of Gowron has arrived, with all eyes within the Klingon Empire now turning towards the inevitable civil war that our agents have fueled now is the time to provide them with weapons and resources that will forever place them in our debt, this means that whatever side wins the upcoming civil war, they will owe the Romulan Star Empire a debt that can only be paid with the blood of our enemies.
STH_redemption.53.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.54.desc:
It is now unfortunately clear that the situation within the Klingon Empire is only heading one way... towards a civil war between the Houses of Duras and Gowron. However, whilst this remains quite clear, what is concerning is how the rebel faction is managing to build up a rapid supply of ships, weapons and resources well beyond their means. 

The influence of another major empire working behind the scenes is now all but confirmed.
STH_redemption.54.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.56.desc: Exposing the House of Duras has started a chain of events that has set in motion a Klingon Civil War, far earlier than anyone could have expected and has forced the hand of the Romulans, pulling them into the war. Now we shall see which faction is strong enough to lead the Empire as a true Klingon!
STH_redemption.56.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.57.desc:
As many predicted, forcing the House of Duras' hand has resulted in the Klingon Empire descending into a potentially brutal civil war. 

We shall soon see which House is strongest and who will lead the Empire.
STH_redemption.57.name: Klingon Empire Decends into Civil War
STH_redemption.58.desc: It appears the fools within the House of Duras, having been humiliated in front ot their allies have taken the foolish move to begin the planned Klingon Civil war far too early, in their desperation they appear to have named our involvement and dragged us into their war!
STH_redemption.58.name: Klingon Empire Decends into Civil War
STH_redemption.6.desc:
Having worked with the Klingons and gained their respect, I am willing to speak with the Empire regarding the Rite of Succession. It would be remiss of me if I did not flag my concern about involving ourselves in the internal affairs of the Klingon Empire and we will have to inform them that whilst we can observe the event our role must remain neutral. 

Remaining on good terms with the Empire will be a key outcome of this meeting and ensuring stability along our borders.
STH_redemption.6.name: Rite of Succession
STH_redemption.60.desc:
Our military council grows ever more concerned that our enemy is managing to build up its forces at an alarming rate, they must be getting help from an outside power, most likely those Romulan cowards, who would never dare confront us directly! 

With all our forces searching for the rebels we must once again turn to the humans to help.
STH_redemption.60.name: Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.61.a: Agree to set up a Tachyon Grid.
STH_redemption.61.desc: Qapla' [Root.GetRulerName] the cowardly Romulans are clearly attempting to bolster the fighting power of our rebel factions, over the past weeks weapons, ships and resources have found their way into the Rebel's hands. We seek the aid of our friends to stop this from happening.
STH_redemption.61.name: Incoming Message
STH_redemption.62.desc: The Federation has responded to our ask and agreed to set up a Tachyon Dection Grid along our border, whilst it would have been better for them to have provided ships and torpedos, this action should remove the Romulan threat.
STH_redemption.62.name: Federation agrees to help
STH_redemption.63.desc: The Federation has sent their regrets that they cannot involve themselves in 'internal Klingon matters' and they will not be offering to help us. We must deal with this situation on our own.
STH_redemption.63.name: Federation refuses to help
STH_redemption.64.desc:
The fleet continued to scan the border for any sign of ships attempting to cross the border, suddenly one of the ships broke formation and fired a volley of low-yield torpedoes into a seemingly empty section of space. 

All of a sudden a shimmer and energy spike is seen on viewers, this can only be a cloak fleet attempting to break the border blockade!
STH_redemption.64.name: Cloak Ship Detected
STH_redemption.65.desc: The fleet continues to scan the border for any sign of ships attempting to cross the border to aid the Klingon rebels. Several hours pass with no sign of any ships attempting to breach the blockade. It appears our attempt to stop the Romulans crossing the border has either failed or the Romulans have thought better of it.
STH_redemption.65.name: No sign of any ships
STH_redemption.66.desc: The Federation's attempts to prevent our ships from delivering resources to the Klingon Rebels has failed to prevent us from crossing the borders, once again displaying the superiority of Romulan technology and leadership.
STH_redemption.66.name: Fleet Breaches the Blockade
STH_redemption.67.desc: The Starfleet ships are locking weapons onto our cloak fleets, they must have detected us with that Tachyon Grid. Continuing to press on could result on them firing on us whilst our shields are down!
STH_redemption.67.name: Fleet Detected!
STH_redemption.68.a.response: All I know is that Tasha Yar was my mother, and died whilst trying to take me from my home.
STH_redemption.68.a: How could Yar be your mother?
STH_redemption.68.b.response: Everything in me that was human died that day with my mother. All that's left is Romulan. Never doubt that.
STH_redemption.68.c: We will not be backing down.
STH_redemption.68.desc: No, Captain. I am Commander Sela. The woman you knew as Tasha Yar was my mother. Deploying an invasion fleet along our border is a clear act of aggression.
STH_redemption.68.name: ... Tasha?
STH_redemption.69.desc: There has been no answer to our attempts to hail the cloaked fleet and subsequent scans have failed to reveal any further sign of the cloaked ships. It appears they were in no mood for confrontation and have retreated.
STH_redemption.69.name: Cloaked Fleet Retreats
STH_redemption.7.desc: Our sources within the Klingon High Council have made us aware that the Federation has been approached to assist the Empire in replacing the leader we have poisoned. Commander Sela assures us that this unexpected twist will be 'handled' by her team.
STH_redemption.7.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.70.desc: Our faith in Starfleet has been rewarded! The Federation fleet has reported in that they have successfully deterred a suspected Romulan fleet from crossing into our space to aid our foes.
STH_redemption.70.name: Federation Repel Romulans
STH_redemption.71.a: We need no lecture from you [redemption_event_tachyon_leader.GetName].
STH_redemption.71.desc: Sela, we are in no position to offer you a fight today, nor do we wish to engage in a conflict with the Romulan Star Empire on this occasion. We urge you to reconsider your interfering in this internal matter for the Klingons as it will only lead to war.
STH_redemption.71.name: Starfleet Backs Down
STH_redemption.72.desc: It appears that the Starfleet blockade was in no mood for a fight against the Romulans and has backed down allowing them to cross into Klingon territory.
STH_redemption.72.name: Starfleet Backs Down
STH_redemption.73.desc:
Be advised Romulan Commander, we are not looking to start a war here today, nor are we massing on the border looking for conflict, but we cannot allow interference in a matter for the Klingon Empire. 

Knowing the Klingons as we do, I suspect any public knowledge of your involvement will cause an adverse effect on the faction you are looking to support.
STH_redemption.73.name: Incoming Message
STH_redemption.74.a: The fleet has done its job.
STH_redemption.74.desc: You may have the victory today Starfleet, but rest assured we will not forget how you have interfered within our matters here today. Until we meet again... Sela out.
STH_redemption.74.name: Romulans Backs Down
STH_redemption.75.desc: It appears a fleet of Starfleet ships were involved in an altercation along the border when a fleet or Romulan warbirds attempted to cross into our territory to deliver aid to the rebel factions. It seems the Starfleet captain involve was able to 'convince' the Romulans to head home with their tails between their legs.
STH_redemption.75.name: Starfleet Exposes a Romulan theat
STH_redemption.8.a: You have made fools of us Sela.
STH_redemption.8.desc: Our spies within the Klingon Empire have advised us that the Empire attempted to seek the help of Starfleet, who rejected their request for help. Whilst this action will no doubt damage the relationship between both sides it does not aid our attempts to gain influence within the High Council
STH_redemption.8.name: Redemption
STH_redemption.80.desc_01:
Reports are coming in from our listening posts monitoring activity within the Klingon Empire, it appears that as predicted and feared the tensions between the Klingon Houses have resulted in a full-scale Civil War. 

No doubt the outcome will have far reaching effects on the state of the quadrant.
STH_redemption.80.desc_02:
It appears the time has finally arrived, our sensor posts have picked up the opening volleys in an attack by the Rebel Houses. 

It appears this frustrating waiting is now finally over and the real battles can begin, now we fight like real Klingons!
STH_redemption.80.name: The Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.81.desc:
Our cloaked vessels watching the events unfolding in Klingon space have picked up the opening shots in the start of the Klingon Civil War. 

Now we wait to see if our rebel-backed faction wins. throwing their relationship with the humans into disarray!
STH_redemption.81.name: The Klingon Civil War
STH_redemption.9.desc:
We have been advise by the Federation Ambassador that they will be sending no Captain to support our request to aid with the Rite of Succession. 

It seems our trust in the Federation was miss-placed and they have no honour after all.
STH_redemption.9.name: Rite of Succession
STH_relic_hunters.110.a: For the might of the Empire!
STH_relic_hunters.110.desc:
We have finished curating the [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName] for maximum viability. We recovered what relics we could from the extraneous exhibits. Our Curators have decided on this exhibit description based on the species' appearance, culture, and former civilization:

[STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesMuseumDescription]
STH_relic_hunters.110.title: Curation Complete
STH_relic_hunters.111.a: Place them in the Primitive Written Works exhibit.
STH_relic_hunters.111.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an artifact! It appears to be a set of scrolls discussing the formation of governments.
STH_relic_hunters.111.title: We have recovered the colAndor Scrolls!
STH_relic_hunters.112.a: Place them in the Primitive Written Works exhibit.
STH_relic_hunters.112.desc: After combing through the relics of the recent [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop.GetSpeciesName] acquisitions on [STH_relic_hunters_curating_pop_planet.GetName], we have recovered an artifact! It appears to be a set of metaphors and aphorisms around the acquisition of material wealth.

STH_relic_hunters.201.a: Rule 34. War is good for business.
STH_relic_hunters.201.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on supplying the necessary £ crews to power the warships of the [From.GetName]. With trained crews, our vessels operate more efficiently in space and the demand for weaponry and transport grows. This is entirely exemplified within one rule.
STH_relic_hunters.201.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.202.a: Rule 18. A Ferengi without profit is no Ferengi at all.
STH_relic_hunters.202.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on supplying the necessary £ latinum to ensure the [From.GetName] has enough working capital to operate with. With enough capital all our needs can be accomplished. This is entirely exemplified within one rule.
STH_relic_hunters.202.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.203.a: Rule 23. Nothing is more important than your health - except for your money.
STH_relic_hunters.203.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring the health of the population is maintained within the [From.GetName]. With enough healthy workers, profit is assured.
STH_relic_hunters.203.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.204.a: Rule 214. Never begin a business negotiation on an empty stomach.
STH_relic_hunters.204.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring a well fed population amongst the [From.GetName]. With enough £ food distributed amongst the workers, profit is assured.
STH_relic_hunters.204.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.205.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring that we can expand our influence throughout the galaxy. With enough £ influence our businesses can grow.
STH_relic_hunters.205.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.206.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit. One principle says that we should focus on ensuring that we can expand our research and development throughout the [From.GetName]. With enough research our businesses can maintain their edge.
STH_relic_hunters.206.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.207.a: Rule 217. You can't free a fish from water...
STH_relic_hunters.207.desc: Our study of the Ferengi Rules of Acquisition has finally borne fruit.One principle says that we should focus on ensuring that we have enough basic resources throughout the [From.GetName] to deal with thirst. With enough water our worlds can ensure the population never wants for something that is so common at home.
STH_relic_hunters.207.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relic_hunters.2200.a: Return the Orb to the vault.
STH_relic_hunters.2200.desc_deaf: The Orb has been brought forth for a series of scientific experiments, but our researchers are still unable to explain what it is made of or what it does.They have, however, gathered valuable data which will be useful in a variety of scientific pursuits.
STH_relic_hunters.2200.desc_sensitive: The Orb has been brought forth for [Root.GetRulerName]'s examination. After an intense series of visions, filled with disjointed images and cryptic statements by people from [Root.GetRulerName]'s life, [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] emerges from the Orb experience with a greater sense of clarity.
STH_relic_hunters.2200.title: Orb Examination
STH_relic_hunters.301.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked a massive resurgence in our engineering divisions research reads similar to Kiri-Kin-Tha's teachings that 'Nothing unreal exists', a logical expression of how mathematics takes place abstractly. If you attempt to model something in reality with maths and logic then sometimes one can end up drawing absurd conclusions about reality itself.

By stating outright 'Nothing unreal exists' and accepting this as part of our philosophy, it serves as a reminder that as soon as we start thinking abstractly we lose relevance. It is not so much an axiom as a warning to unnecessary abstraction.
STH_relic_hunters.301.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.302.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked a massive resurgence in our sociologists research reads similar to the teachings in the Kol-Ut-Shan, or more commonly known as IDIC - Infinite Diversity in Infinite Combinations. If you attempt to close off any part of diversity simply because you do not like it, you close off infinite possible combinations.

By embracing the Kol-Ut-Shan which symbolises the vast variables and elements in the galaxy that create truth and beauty, it serves as a reminder that we should not close ourselves off to any path just because it is different, and instead we should embrace the differences between us.
STH_relic_hunters.302.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.303.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked a large following within our populace reiterates part of what we already teach - 'The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few, or the one', one of the cornerstones of our philosophy.

By embracing this teaching we can ensure all who come to serve within the Vulcan Expeditionary Group or the Science Academy are serving the entirety of Vulcan. This should boost recruitment substantially.
STH_relic_hunters.303.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.304.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such section that has recently sparked been discovered appears to be an early version of T'Plana-Hath's statement that 'Logic is the cement of our civilisation with which we ascend from chaos using reason as our guide'.

By understanding these teachings we can understand how the Vulcans ancestors and history have progressed to create the future we live in now. The logical extension of these teachings is that whilst logic may not solve all our problems, as long as it remains a foundation upon which we may build our society and research we may deepen our understanding of the universe.
STH_relic_hunters.304.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.305.desc:
The writings carved into the Kir'Shara are one of the highest examples of Vulcan philosophy.

One such heavily damaged section that has recently been restored by a student has sparked a discussion stating that Logic is not the be all and end all of the Vulcan philosophy. It states that pure logic will make Vulcan's weak and helpless, something that their rituals and traditional Kahs-wan seeks to prevent.

The discovery of this section has caused members of society from all branches to return many luxuries to society and live out a more simple life.
STH_relic_hunters.305.name: Teachings of Surak
STH_relic_hunters.500.desc: The writings of 'The Never-Ending Sacrifice' are considered by many scholars to be the epitome of Cardassian literature and of the repetitive epic. The novel covers seven generations of the same family as they overcome the trials facing the Cardassian state as they live selfless lives working for the betterment of the State.
STH_relic_hunters.500.name: Literature Review
STH_relic_hunters.501.desc: The writings of 'Enigma Tales' by Shoggoth are considered by many scholars to be a fine example of mystery within the repetitive epic. The novel covers numerous suspects, all being found guilty of similar crimes, but the mystery lies in the discovery of who exactly was guilty of what.
STH_relic_hunters.501.name: Literature Review
STH_relic_hunters.502.desc: The wartime epic 'Meditations of a Crimson Shadow' by Eleta Preloc is considered to be a prime example of the collective state overcoming vast and vicious Empires across the galaxy, each more vicious and unruly than the last. The novel covers invasions of nearby Empires such as the United Federation of Planets and Klingons, and features propaganda in how it portrays how each seeks the destruction of the Cardassian Union.
STH_relic_hunters.502.name: Literature Review
STH_relic_hunters.600.desc_hasbroker: We have contracted a skilled and reliable broker, the [STH_relic_hunters_broker_country.GetName], to host the auction. They are only charging a modest commission fee. Which Relic shall we auction?
STH_relic_hunters.600.desc_nobroker: We are known as skilled and reliable brokers, so hosting our our own auction is no issue. Which Relic shall we auction?
STH_relic_hunters.600.r_meditations_on_a: Meditations On A Crimson Shadow - Min Bid:
STH_relic_hunters.600.r_sacred_chalice_o: Sacred Chalice of Rixx - Min Bid:
STH_relic_hunters.600.title: Auctioning A Relic
STH_relic_hunters.6000.desc_hasbroker: No bidder met the minumum bid for the relic, and so it has returned to our vaults. The [STH_relic_hunters_broker_country.GetName] are somewhat miffed that the relic did not attract as much attention as they expected.
STH_relic_hunters.6000.desc_nobroker: No bidder met the minumum bid for the relic, and so it has returned to our vaults.
STH_relic_hunters.6000.title: Auction Failed!
STH_relic_hunters.6000.unfortunate_recov: At least we recovered most of our expenses on this venture.
STH_relic_hunters.700.desc: If we want to plunder the wealth of the Galaxy, we must first select a target.
STH_relic_hunters.700.title: Select an Empire
STH_relic_hunters.7000.desc: The [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] has hired a team of relic hunters to steal our cultural treasures! Fortunatly, our brave [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetInternalSecurityName] forces were able to stop them!
STH_relic_hunters.7000.title: Attemted theft stopped!
STH_relic_hunters.7001.a: We must find out who did this!
STH_relic_hunters.7001.desc: A routine inspection of our vaults has discovered that one of our cultural relics has been stolen! Forensic examiners have turned up nothing!
STH_relic_hunters.7001.title: One of our cultural treasures was stolen!
STH_relic_hunters.7002.desc: The [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] has hired a team of relic hunters to steal our cultural treasures! Our [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetInternalSecurityName] forces were unable to stop them!
STH_relic_hunters.7002.title: One of our cultural treasures was stolen!
STH_relic_hunters.7003.desc: Our intelligence agency has uncovered that the [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] was the one who hired a team of relic hunters to steal our cultural treasures!
STH_relic_hunters.7003.title: We have discovered the thieves!
STH_relic_hunters.701.aquisitionsspecial: Ferengi are excellent negotiators and businessmen. Any bribes they attempt will almost always succeed. They are greedy, however, and may find ways of keeping some of the loot. They are also cowards, and will not do well in combat situations.(Specialist £ Infiltrators)
STH_relic_hunters.701.covertspecialists_: Breen are mysterious fighters and covert agents. They are more resillient than other infiltration groups. (Specialist £ Infiltrators)
STH_relic_hunters.701.desc: Now that we have decided to take the cultural riches of the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], we must find persons of an adventurous and amoral nature that are willing to take the job. We have made contact with several groups, each with their own specialties:
STH_relic_hunters.701.inflitrators_desc: Infiltrators are good at stealthy incursions and have a ship that is outfitted for discrete insertions. They are more likely to remain undetected and determine genuine relics from fakes. They are not as good at brute force assaults and are unlikely to retrive heavily guarded relics.
STH_relic_hunters.701.informationspecial: Yridians are excellent spies and information brokers. They are more likely to find secret information or caches. They expect to be paid well, however, and may find ways of keeping some of the loot if they feel underpaid. (Specialist £ Infiltrators)
STH_relic_hunters.701.mercenaries_desc: Mercenaries are good at brute force assaults and have a ship that is outfitted for quick skirmishes. They are likely to breach the vault and recover loot, but may not be careful in what they take. They are not as good at infiltration and are likely to rat us out if they are paid more than what we pay them for the job.
STH_relic_hunters.701.piratespecialists_: Nausicaans are brutal pirates and raiders. They will win most skirmishes and situations requiring brute force. They are not very subtle or imaginative, however, and our involvement is more likely to be discovered. (Specialist £ Mercenaries)
STH_relic_hunters.701.raiderspecialists_: Members of the Orion Syndicate are ruthless smugglers and assassins. The team will have the support of any local Syndicate branches in any operations. However, the Syndicate will not tolerate any actions against itself or its allies. (Specialist £ Mercenaries)
STH_relic_hunters.701.title: Select a group of specialists
STH_relic_hunters.701.warriorspecialists: Klingons are honorable warriors and fighters. They will win most melee engagements and situations requiring brute force. They are not very subtle, however, and our involvement is more likely to be discovered. (Specialist £ Mercenaries)
STH_relic_hunters.701.wildcardspecialist: Humans are very diverse and resourceful. Their talents are widely varied: one group may be excellent fighters and scrappers, others may be good at stealth and deception. The specific talents of this particular group are unknown, other than that they usually get the job done. (Specialists with randomized stats, usually better than average)
STH_relic_hunters.702.desc: Now that we have selected a group of specialists to take the cultural riches of the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], we must decide how much we want to pay them for the job, as well as how much backing (both financial and material) we wish to give them:
STH_relic_hunters.702.major_desc: Half now, half upon job completion.
STH_relic_hunters.702.minimal_desc: They should be glad for the job! Wretched scum!
STH_relic_hunters.702.moderate_desc: Give them a modest sum upon job completion.
STH_relic_hunters.702.ship_desc: A ship refitted with our latest weapons technologies and stealth devices will massively enhance their chances.
STH_relic_hunters.702.title: Select an Amount of Support

[Root.GetTeamDescription] [Root.GetTeamShip] [Root.GetTeamSupplies]
With the team assembled, hacking tools primed, documents forged, supplies procured, and ship ready, the team sets course for the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName] to hopefully make a big score (and make their client happy as well!)

As the [STH_relic_hunters_hiring_country.GetName] has open borders with the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], the team only needs to flag their ship appropriately.

[Root.GetTeamDescription] [Root.GetTeamShip] [Root.GetTeamSupplies]
Having arrived near the borders of the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], the team must now decide upon their insertion method to get past the border patrols:

The Team Lead has decided that the best course of action is to just cross the border, trying to avoid patrols and neutralizing any that they encounter.

[Root.GetTeamDescription] [Root.GetTeamShip] [Root.GetTeamSupplies]
Having arrived near the borders of the [STH_relic_hunters_mark_country.GetName], the team must now decide upon their insertion method to get past the border patrols:

The Team Lead has decided that the best course of action is to bribe a border control officer at a nearby station, utilizing an underworld contact. This will allow them to slip through the sensor grid and not appear on any logs.

[Root.GetTeamDescription] [Root.GetTeamShip] [Root.GetTeamSupplies]

[Root.GetTeamDescription] [Root.GetTeamShip] [Root.GetTeamSupplies]

[Root.GetTeamDescription] [Root.GetTeamShip] [Root.GetTeamSupplies]

They were released on the condition that they not return.

STH_relics_flavour.1000.desc:
The unique metaphasic radiation within the belt surrounding the planet of Ba'ku offers dramatic life extension and wound regeneration possibilities.

A metaphasic collector has been designed to launch an injector assembly that will start a thermolytic reaction within the radiation, enabling the particles to be harvested, though with a small chance of rendering the planet uninhabitable.
STH_relics_flavour.1000.name: Metaphasic Particles Collector
STH_relics_flavour.1001.desc: Using the modified injector on the high concentrations of metaphasic radiation within the rings of Ba'ku has provided a large amount of metaphasic particles that can be used to advance medical science and extend life spans across the [Root.GetName].
STH_relics_flavour.1001.name: Thermolytic Reaction
STH_relics_flavour.101.a: Rule 34. War is good for business.
STH_relics_flavour.101.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have formed the basis for our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principle along the Great Material River should focus on supplying the necessary £ crews to power the warships of the [From.GetName]. With trained crews, our vessels operate more efficiently in space and the demand for weaponry and transport grows. This is entirely exemplified within one rule.
STH_relics_flavour.101.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.102.a: Rule 18. A Ferengi without profit is no Ferengi at all.
STH_relics_flavour.102.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have formed the basis for our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principle along the Great Material River should focus on supplying the necessary £ latinum to ensure the [From.GetName] has enough working capital to operate with. With enough capital all our needs can be accomplished. This is entirely exemplified within one rule.
STH_relics_flavour.102.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.103.a: Rule 23. Nothing is more important than your health - except for your money.
STH_relics_flavour.103.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have formed the basis for our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principles should focus on ensuring the health of the population is maintained within the [From.GetName]. With enough healthy workers, profit is assured. The Great Material River will provide for us.
STH_relics_flavour.103.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.104.a: Rule 214. Never begin a business negotiation on an empty stomach.
STH_relics_flavour.104.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have formed the basis for our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principles should focus on ensuring a well fed population amongst the [From.GetName]. With enough £ food distributed amongst the workers, profit is assured. The Great Material River will provide for us.
STH_relics_flavour.104.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.105.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have guided our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principles should focus on ensuring that we can expand our influence throughout the galaxy. With enough £ influence our businesses can grow. The Great Material River will provide for us.
STH_relics_flavour.105.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.106.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have formed the basis for our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principles should focus on ensuring that we can expand our research and development throughout the [From.GetName]. With enough research our businesses can maintain their edge. The Great Material River will provide for us.
STH_relics_flavour.106.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.107.a: Rule 217. You can't free a fish from water...
STH_relics_flavour.107.desc: Our study of the ancient Rules of Acquisitions that have formed the basis for our civilisation for centuries has finally bore fruit. Our guiding principles should focus on ensuring that we have enough basic resources throughout the [From.GetName] to deal with thirst. With enough water our worlds can ensure the population never wants for something that is so common at home. The Great Material River will provide for us.
STH_relics_flavour.107.name: Reading Rules of Acquisition
STH_relics_flavour.1300.b: Purchase it, then break it down to find out how it works!
STH_relics_flavour.1300.c: A private auction could net us a hefty profit here.
STH_relics_flavour.1300.d: We have better uses for latinum.
STH_relics_flavour.1300.desc:
A humanoid trader has approached one of the trading outposts of the [Root.GetName] and offered us an artifact that can supposedly bend time for set period. Quite where the artifact came from or how it works is a mystery.

What should we do?
STH_relics_flavour.1300.name: Passing Trader
STH_relics_flavour.1301.a: Dissassemble it. Perhaps we can learn something.
STH_relics_flavour.1301.b: The perfect tool for a bank heist!
STH_relics_flavour.1301.desc:
The power to bend time, albeit within a limit window, offers us the unique ability to achieve goals that would otherwise be impossible.

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s advisors have provided numerous options for the wielder of the device where a time loop could be extremely effective.
STH_relics_flavour.1301.f: Time crystals must be nurtured, not exploited.
STH_relics_flavour.1301.name: Time Crystal Device
STH_relics_flavour.1302.desc: After the stresses of it's recent usage, the time crystal device appears to have fractured, splintering its energy across multiple times. The device has been rendered useless.
STH_relics_flavour.1302.name: Time Crystal Device Destroyed
STH_relics_flavour.1303.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing our agent to bypass all the security measures of a privately held offworld bank.

By defeating the magnetic locks and memorising and reciting the ten thousand digit code, the entire vault defences were bypassed enabling the transport of all goods contained within, some of which are priceless works from hundreds of civilisations.

The treasure has arrived upon [Root.Capital.GetName] and stands ready for [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s perusal.
STH_relics_flavour.1303.name: Time Crystal Device Heist
STH_relics_flavour.1304.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing our agent to bypass all but the most stringent security measures of a privately held offworld bank.

By defeating the magnetic locks and visual scanners, the outer vault defences were bypassed enabling the transport of some of the latinum within.

The loot has arrived upon [Root.Capital.GetName] and stands ready for [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s perusal.
STH_relics_flavour.1304.name: Time Crystal Device Heist
STH_relics_flavour.1305.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing our agent to bypass all but the most stringent security measures of a privately held offworld bank.

By defeating the magnetic locks and visual scanners, the outer vault defences were bypassed enabling the transport of some of the latinum within, however the alarm was raised before all of the loot could be transported.

The agent received a wound, and damaged the time crystal device, which is undergoing examination to determine if the blast has caused irreparable damage.
STH_relics_flavour.1305.name: Time Crystal Device Heist
STH_relics_flavour.1306.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to repeatedly question and challenge all of those in the inner circle of the government, determining lies and mistruths.

By determining whom is working for whom, and who can actively be trusted, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has initiated a purge of all disloyal members of the government.

Loyalists within the ranks will now ensure stability is high amongst the populace for the next few years.
STH_relics_flavour.1306.name: Time Crystal Interrogations
STH_relics_flavour.1307.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to repeatedly question and challenge all of those in the inner circle of the government, determining lies and mistruths.

By determining whom is working for whom, and who can actively be trusted, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has initiated a purge of some disloyal members of the government.

Loyalists within the ranks will now ensure stability is high amongst the populace for the next few years.
STH_relics_flavour.1307.name: Time Crystal Interrogations
STH_relics_flavour.1308.desc:
The time crystal device has proved valuable, allowing [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to repeatedly question and challenge some of those in the inner circle of the government, in an effort to determine lies and mistruths.

Unfortunately the device was damaged in an accident, and undiscovered disloyalty within the security detail assigned to purge the traitors has allowed many to escape into the underground.

These traitors will actively work against the [Root.GetName] for the next few years.
STH_relics_flavour.1308.name: Time Crystal Interrogations
STH_relics_flavour.1309.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to challenge all those opposed to their rule and defeat them in single combat.

By fighting opponents repeatedly until their weaknesses were discovered, the [Root.GetRulerTitle] has prevailed.

Loyalists within the government will now ensure stability is high amongst the populace for the next few years.
STH_relics_flavour.1309.name: Time Crystal Combat
STH_relics_flavour.1310.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to challenge some of those opposed to their rule and defeat them in single combat.

By fighting opponents repeatedly until their weaknesses were discovered, or avoiding fights with those that the [Root.GetRulerTitle] could not defeat, [Root.GetRulerName] has mostly prevailed.

Loyalists within the government will now ensure stability is high amongst the populace for the next few years.
STH_relics_flavour.1310.name: Time Crystal Combat
STH_relics_flavour.1311.desc:
The time crystal device initially proved valuable, allowing [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] to challenge some of those opposed to their rule and defeat them in single combat - until disaster struck.

An unfortunate duel where the time crystal device was struck by an opponent's weapon led to the device being rendered temporarily dysfunctional and leading to an opening within [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]'s defences, resulting in their death.
STH_relics_flavour.1311.name: Time Crystal Combat
STH_relics_flavour.1312.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing scientists within the [Root.GetName] to undertake dangerous and otherwise lethal experiments with no regard for safety measures.

By repeatedly testing volatile processes, scientists have made substantial breakthroughs within particular fields.

The results should be available for perusal shortly.
STH_relics_flavour.1312.name: Time Crystal Experiments
STH_relics_flavour.1313.desc:
The time crystal device has proved invaluable, allowing scientists within the [Root.GetName] to undertake dangerous and otherwise lethal experiments with no regard for safety measures.

By repeatedly testing volatile processes, scientists have made moderate breakthroughs within particular fields.

The results should be available for perusal shortly.
STH_relics_flavour.1313.name: Time Crystal Experiments
STH_relics_flavour.1314.desc:
The time crystal device has proved valuable, allowing scientists within the [Root.GetName] to undertake dangerous and otherwise lethal experiments with no regard for safety measures.

By repeatedly testing volatile processes, scientists have made small breakthroughs within particular fields, however one experiment did damage the time crystal slightly causing the experiments to come to an early end.

The results should be available for perusal shortly, whilst the crystal goes in for repairs.
STH_relics_flavour.1314.name: Time Crystal Experiments
STH_relics_flavour.1315.desc:
Time crystals are a rare mineral native to only a few places within the galaxy, and are often heavily guarded. The power to manipulate time is a weapon unlike any other, and these crystals should be nurtured upon our planets rather than exploited.

After planting the time crystal device within an ancient cavern upon one of our worlds, it has begun to sprout - forming smaller but still viable time crystals out of nearby rock.
STH_relics_flavour.1315.name: Time Crystal Nurture
STH_relics_flavour.1400.a: Supplement our ground forces with this drone.
STH_relics_flavour.1400.b: Purchase the entire stock and station them across our worlds.
STH_relics_flavour.1400.c: Patrol our territory and defend it against enemies.
STH_relics_flavour.1400.desc:
Reactivating the Echo Papa drone causes it to hover menacingly, and thrum with power. A signal is detected emanating from the device, and a holographic salesman suddenly appears as a projection from the drone.

From listening to the holo projection, it seems this drone is quite limited in power but can be used temporarily in either a ground or space role. Alternatively, we could purchase the remaining stock of these drones and station them across our worlds, improving the effectiveness of defensive armies.
STH_relics_flavour.1400.name: Echo Papa Drones
STH_relics_flavour.1500.a: Scour the archive data, we can learn much.
STH_relics_flavour.1500.b: Offer subsidies for a festival in remembrance.
STH_relics_flavour.1500.c: Find a weapon we can use.
STH_relics_flavour.1500.desc:
This mask serves as a reminder of when the D'Arsay Archive attempted to reactivate and restore the ancient D'Arsay civilisation thought lost millenia ago.

What can the archive do for us now?
STH_relics_flavour.1500.name: D'Arsay Archive
STH_relics_flavour.1601.a: Seize it in the name of the Nagus!
STH_relics_flavour.1601.c: Attempt to seize these swindlers - and their goods!
STH_relics_flavour.1601.d: We are not interested in this artifact.
STH_relics_flavour.1601.desc:
Aliens portraying themselves to be a team of archaeologists say they have uncovered a mysterious artifact of unrivaled power from the future.

Called the 'Tox Uthat', they have quantum dated it to some point centuries from now, and they believe it is a quantum phase inhibitor that can cause all fusion within a star to cease, effectively ending that star's life.

They are offering it for sale for a substantial sum.
STH_relics_flavour.1601.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1602.desc: Against all odds, our security services have failed to apprehend the archaeologists and their artifact known as the Tox Uthat. It seems they had help from two Vorgons. By now there is no doubt that it has been sold to another empire.
STH_relics_flavour.1602.name: Tox Uthat
STH_relics_flavour.1603.a: Destroy the Tox Uthat in a transporter stream.
STH_relics_flavour.1603.b: Pretend to destroy the Tox Uthat.
STH_relics_flavour.1603.c: Bargain to sell the Tox Uthat to them.
