sth_start.1001.e.tooltip: Begin the game with the current set up, any options not selected will automatically be switched off.
sth_start.1001.ethics.tooltip: Our testing has shown pop ethics and pop factions cause additional load on the mod; they can be managed here via this menu.
sth_start.1001.ethics: Manage STNH Ethics and Pop Factions.
sth_start.1001.f.tooltip: All Starfleet Military Ships will be given a realistic NCC registry number based as close as we can to canon.
sth_start.1001.g.tooltip: Revert to sequential Starfleet NCC registration, with the exception of certain hero ships.
sth_start.1001.k.tooltip: An event will run every 5 years once you are 60 years into the game, which may randomly promote a minor empire to a major empire.
sth_start.1001.k: Increased Minor to Major Promotions - ON.
sth_start.1001.l.tooltip: Minor Empires will only experience a very small chance of being promoted to a major or medium empire, as it has always been.
sth_start.1001.l: Increased Minor to Major Promotions OFF.
sth_start.1001.n.tooltip: Dev Note: Beta Code: Unemployed pops are forcible shuffled to planets with no unemployment and an additional modifier is added to planets with over 9 pops to artificially curb population growth.
sth_start.1001.name: The Q Continuum
sth_start.1001.navalpen.tooltip: Adds an additional harsh penalty to ship upkeep if the country goes over the Navy Cap.
sth_start.1001.nsurvey1.tooltip: Return survey speeds to Vanilla levels.
sth_start.1001.o.tooltip: Applies the pop performance modifier to human players and AI.
sth_start.1001.o: Performance Modifier for AI & Player - OFF.
sth_start.1001.p.tooltip: Switch off the performance modifier for human players so that it only applies to AI empires.
sth_start.1001.p: Performance Modifier for AI & Player - ON.
sth_start.1001.q.tooltip: Switch off the performance modifier and allow planets to develop naturally.
sth_start.1001.qpedia.tooltip: Access the mod Q-tips and specifically created guide articles to help you navigate the STNH experience. Dev Note: These guides are a continued WIP, for more information join us in our Discord server or check our FAQs. Are we missing something, feel free to have a go at writing it and send it to us.
sth_start.1001.qpedia: Access the knowledge of the Q.
sth_start.1001.r.tooltip: Return ship travelling speed to their normal level.
sth_start.1001.sb1.tooltip: Enabling Sandbox Mode will prevent the vast majority of story-based events from firing, this includes Crisis events. Species Mechanics and crucial events such as UFP formation will still occur with the same chance as normal.
sth_start.1001.sb2.tooltip: Disabling Sandbox Mode will allow all story events to fire as normal. Events are still subject to the usual RNG odds.
sth_start.1001.storm1.tooltip: Storms will spawn if you have the Cosmic Storms DLC, but be aware they do carry a small performance decrease.
sth_start.1001.storm2.tooltip: Prevents storms from triggering regardless of whether you have them active.
sth_start.1001.survey1.tooltip: Slowdown expansion of the galaxy by significantly increasing survey time. Dev Note: This mode is still under beta testing, so play with caution.
sth_start.1001.tng.tooltip: This option will allow you to unlock specific technologies not part of the TNG era setup or pick technologies choices that are not enabled by default.
sth_start.1001.trp1.tooltip: Dev Note: Beta Code: Trade Routes are a potential source of mid-late game lag, this mode sets starbase trade collection to 0 and boosts capital collection to max to prevent the complex route calculations, especially on bigger maps, switch off to revert back to Vanilla trade route gameplay.
sth_start.1001.trp1: STNH Trade Route Performance Mode - ON.
sth_start.1001.trp2.tooltip: Trade Route and Starbase Collection methods are set to Vanilla Starbase.
sth_start.1001.trp2: STNH Trade Route Performance Mode - OFF.
sth_start.1001.u.tooltip: Lower all ship travelling speed by 50%.
sth_start.1001.war1.tooltip: This mode creates more war scenarios resulting in countries that dislike you being more inclined to declare war on you, even if you think your fleet power makes you safe.
sth_start.1002.a: Rest In Peace, Lieutenant Uhura. Channels Closed.
sth_start.1002.desc:
Just like us, we're sure many of you were inspired and fell in love with the characters that appeared on our screens whilst watching Star Trek, all of whom were brought to life brilliant by their actors. Here at PDG we were saddened to hear of the passing of Nichelle Nichols, a hero and inspiration to so many and a legend to us all. She joins the cast of other legends who have sadly left us. 

Gone but never forgotten.
sth_start.1002.name: A tribute to Nichelle Nichols
sth_start.1005.a.tooltip:
This option creates all available minor races depending on whether their homeworld spawned as part of the map size option you selected.

Warning! This option is intensive and will take some time to complete as it creates all the minor empires.
sth_start.1005.b.tooltip: The combination of minor/warp-capable races will be selected from those available at random.
sth_start.1005.c.tooltip: Automatically selects the empires appropriate to the quadrant map size you have selected.
sth_start.1005.c: Create Quadrant Specific minors and Warp-Capables.
sth_start.1005.d.tooltip: Manually decide which minor empires to add to your game.
sth_start.1005.desc:
The galaxy is full of tiny empires, doing their tiny empire things, all of which are far beneath the Q, but the more empires the more we get to meddle... what fun! 

From this screen you can define how many Star Trek minors and Warp Capable species you would like to have in this playthrough. 

The empires available depend on the map you have selected and remember if you try to create all minors at once, it will take time to process, if your setup can't handle it, load them one at a time. 

Now don't forget the powers of the Q are almighty and once an empire has been created it cannot be undone! Now go enjoy!
sth_start.1005.desc_01:
You are almost there! You now need to set the tech level of the Minor Races... 

Dev Note: Adding the TNG era technologies is a resource-intensive activity and can take between 2-5mins to complete, during which time the game may freeze, let it complete and it will.
sth_start.1005.e.tooltip: Moves onto the next screen. Warning: Once selected you cannot come back and add more empires.
sth_start.1005.mult.tooltip: Creates a random selection of minors, which is less taxing on the multiplayer setup. It should only be selected by one player.
sth_start.1005.name: Galaxy Creation - Minor Empires
sth_start.1005.tng.tooltip:
This option will add all the applicable TNG era Minor Empires and convert them to the TNG era. 

Dev Note: This is an intensive action and could take up to 5 minutes to complete, at this point, it may appear to have hung... allow the process to complete and the next screen will appear.
sth_start.1006.a.response: All appropriate Alpha Quadrant powers added to the map.
sth_start.1006.a.tooltip: Add all appropriate Alpha Quadrant Major Powers.
sth_start.1006.b.response: All appropriate Beta Quadrant powers added to the map.
sth_start.1006.b.tooltip: Add all appropriate Beta Quadrant Major Powers.
sth_start.1006.c.response: All appropriate Gamma Quadrant powers added to the map.
sth_start.1006.c.tooltip: Add all appropriate Gamma Quadrant Major Powers.
sth_start.1006.d.response: All appropriate Delta Quadrant powers added to the map.
sth_start.1006.d.tooltip: Add all appropriate Delta Quadrant Major Powers.
sth_start.1006.desc:
The galaxy is run by the powerful, but thankfully there is always a bigger fish and the Q are the sharks!!... Now where was I? 

From this screen you can define how many Star Trek main species you would like to have in this playthrough. 

The empires available depend on the map you have selected and remember if you try to create all majors at once, it will take time to process, if your setup can't handle it, add them by Quadrants. 

Now don't forget the powers of the Q are almighty and once an empire has been created it cannot be undone! Now go enjoy!
sth_start.1006.desc_01:
Ahh, can you smell the winds of change in the air? It's the dawn of the 2300, but It's been a long road, getting from there to here... well actually it's been a few clicks of the galactic map! 

Now I suppose you will want your good pal Q to snap his fingers and transition from 2150 to 2300? Well, it's not quite that simple, I have selected the major empires for you to play as... but remember I am mending the rules of time and space here, so please wait and be patient while the magic happens! 

Dev Note: Adding the TNG era technologies is a resource intensive activity and can take between 2-5mins to complete, during which time the game may freeze, allow the process to complete and it will.
sth_start.1006.desc_02:
Ahh the Mirror Universe is so alike, yet so different. A playground for a little chaos! Now I imagine you are going to want your benevolent Q just to snap his mighty fingers and make it 2300 already? Hah Humans are so predictable! 

The course of history is so fragile and all it takes are a few small changes to set the galaxy off on a different track... I can't wait to see what will happen next Mon ami. 

Dev Note: Adding the TNG era technologies is a resource intensive activity and can take between 2-5mins to complete, during which time the game may freeze, allow the process to complete and it will.
sth_start.1006.h: Manually add major Empires and Factions.
sth_start.1006.mult.tooltip: Select this option if you are playing multiplayer and the host or another player is selecting the player conditions and you don't want to duplicate them.
sth_start.1006.name: Galaxy Creation - Major Empires
sth_start.1006.tng.tooltip: This option will convert all the applicable TNG era Major Empires to the TNG era. Dev Note: This is an intensive action and could take up to 10 minutes to complete, during which time the game may freeze, allow the process to complete and the next screen will appear.
sth_start.102.a: Ensure the formation of the UFP.
sth_start.102.desc:
For players who enjoy a more canon version of the STNH game, which includes the United Federation of Planets with all four member worlds having formed the Federation in the early 2160s then this mode can be switched on. 

As long as each of the four member worlds are played by the AI and they all exist by the time the Babel conference is due to take place then this mode will assist in the formation of the Federation. If any of the Founding member states are played by the player then the game will continue without interfering. 

This mode is entirely optional and if left off the formation of the Federation will progress, or not, without force.
sth_start.102.name: The United Federation of Planets
sth_start.110.desc: We recognise that many of our players enjoy to emulate a canon version of the Star Trek universe and to have their technologies become available at the 'right' time. For those fans who want this type of experience we have a game modifier that artifically slows progress to match the era. Should you wish to remove the modifier (non-ironman games only) then run event sth_start.110 to bring this screen back up.
sth_start.110.name: The Great Technology Race (beta)
sth_start.1200.desc:
Disabling Pop Factions and Ethics has been shown to provide a boost to game performance, but at the cost of pops having ethics other than their countries and forming factions. 

Currently, this mode is set to: 

Ethics & Factions ON.
sth_start.1200.desc_01:
Disabling Pop Factions and Ethics has been shown to provide a boost to game performance, but at the cost of pops having ethics other than their countries and forming factions. 

Currently, this mode is set to: 

Ethics & Factions ON for human players.
sth_start.1200.desc_02:
Disabling Pop Factions and Ethics has been shown to provide a boost to game performance, but at the cost of pops having ethics other than their countries and forming factions. 

Currently, this mode is set to: 

Ethics & Factions OFF for all.
sth_start.1200.name: Pop Ethics & Faction Options
sth_start.13.desc:
Important Alert!: 

There has been a rare error in the map set up when this game was loaded, and this may have caused a corrupted map. We strongly recommend that you return to the main menu and start a new game using the same settings.
sth_start.13.name: State Of The Galaxy
sth_start.16.a.tooltip: Game may still be playable, but some bugs could occur. Your start location is unoptimised and random.
sth_start.16.desc:
You have selected a race that is not placed in the Delta Quadrant map. This is not supported and may lead to buggy situations. 

If you wish to know which races are located in the Delta Quadrant, either choose the Borg or one of the other green empires on the selection screen, or open the in-game ST:NH Wiki by pressing the '?' icon at the bottom of the UI. 

If you would prefer to continue to play as this race, we strongly advise you to start a new game either using the main galaxy maps or full quadrant maps. 

Alternatively you may proceed at your own risk.

sth_start.23.name: Warning! Race unsupported on this map!
sth_start.5.b.tooltip: Game may still be playable, but some bugs could occur. Your start location is unoptimised and random.

You have selected a race that is not placed in the Alpha/Beta quadrant map. This is not supported and may lead to buggy situations.

If you wish to know which races are located in the Alpha and Beta Quadrants, either choose one of the blue or red empires from the empire selection screen or open the in-game ST:NH Wiki by pressing the '?' icon at the bottom of the UI.

sth_start.50.a.tooltip: This is the default galaxy, containing every single major species and the minor species you have previously selected. Minor races are randomised on game start and will not expand. This is considered the Default STNH experience.
sth_start.50.a: (Recommended) Default Play with all selected Empires.
sth_start.50.b.tooltip: This form of the galaxy contains ~25% of the regular empires, chosen by the developers and the minor empires previously selected. This is the most optimal in terms of performance.
sth_start.50.c.tooltip: This form of the galaxy contains ~50% of the regular empires, chosen by the developers and the minor empires selected in the previous screens.
sth_start.50.d.tooltip: This form of the galaxy contains ~75% of the regular empires, chosen by the developers and the minor empires selected in the previous screens.
sth_start.50.desc: The multiverse and timeline is constantly in flux. Please select your choice for the amount of Empires on the main map before gameplay begins in earnest. This will allow you to tune your experience and performance further.

sth_start.77.desc:
Start a playthrough with a number or all of the minor and primitive races set to use static population growth. These countries will not add to the late game population density of the galaxy unless they progress to a full power or are absorbed into another larger empire, such as the UFP or Dominion. It is theorised that pop size contributes to late game lag.

Dev Note: Use at own risk and does not guarentee improved performance whilst in trial mode.
sth_start.77.f.tooltip: This experience is recommended for the full experience, with no empires downgraded to static. Run at own risk.
sth_start.77.name: Start Conditions
sth_start.999.desc:
Welcome to the Autumn content update for STNH! We have made a number of changes to New Horizons based on player feedback and experience that we would like to share with you all. We hope you enjoy! 

The Flagship system has been overhauled, you can now build either the military flagship or the science flagship, each have unique bonuses, but you are limited to one per class of ship. 

The Federation and Terran empires now have access to new fleetyard facility that is available as a megastructure which allows you to build Flagships and certain legendary ships. 

Flagships are now only buildable via the Fleetyard. 

The early game Demon's mission has been re-written to pose a whole new challenge and play style for Terra Prime. 

Many changes made to the Dominion in line with player feedback, including the desire to increase the number of Dominion Members. 

The new Challenge Mode is now available on Grand Admiral difficulty and provides an artificially challenging experience for those who want a tough game! 

New event expansions - experience our recreation of Star Trek Picard, Nemesis, First Contact and a few more! 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_01:
Welcome to the Scorpio Expansion STNH! We have been hard at work producing our largest patch yet. We hope you enjoy! 

The mysterious and dangerous Species 8472, the Undine, are now a playable species with a unique play style. Pick the Undine and conquer the galaxy. 

A new crisis is available involving the Undine and the mysteries of Fluidic Space. 

Support Craft are available to build to help defend starbases. 

Leaders now have the option to retire and pick a new career as a legend, teacher or continue serving you! 

More quality of life improvements made to the Dominion based on feedback from the community. 

The new Challenge Mode is now available on Grand Admiral difficulty and provides an artificially challenging experience for those who want a tough game! 

The Borg Adaptation Mechanic has been updated to version 3.0, fear the Borg! 

We have integrated the Espionage system into the Mod, there are 3 empire tiers meaning that not all empires have access to the features, but those that do should be feared. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_02:
Welcome to the late Summer Scorpio Expansion update for STNH! We have been looking at a number of the issues that you have raised and implemented a number of fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy! 

We recognise much of the feedback on Species 8472 and have worked hard to fix many of the common issues and continue to expand on their play style. 

The mysterious Barzan Wormhole is available to purchase, if you own the Barzan sector and speak with them whilst they are still warm primitives. 

We've made a number of quality of life changes to the Klingon Houses, including making it easier to tell how they view you. Their opinion level of the Empire now reflects their loyalty 

You can now artifically hold back technology research to keep things in time with the in game date! 

More refit vessels have been added for those who prefer the classic look 

The new Challenge Mode is now available for the Mirror Universe 

We've continued our efforts to optimise the code to provide a better performance late game 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_03:
Welcome to the 3.1.2 Scorpio Expansion compat update for STNH! We hope you enjoy! 

Our existing traditions have now been made compatible with the new system introduced in 3.1. We will continue to adapt them to to take full advantage of the new mechanic in future patches. 

New tier 2 traditions have been introduced which unlock as you progress through the original ones. We will be adding more traditions in future patches 

One of the most asked for new mechanics is the troop deployment during combat. Now ships with marine components will try and board vessels 

Troop Carriers now have unique bombardment settings! 

New ship classes for the Klingons, Romulans and Federation 

Some love for Lower Decks Season 2 added 

We've continued our efforts to optimise the code to provide a better performance late game 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_04:
Welcome to our Traditions 2.0.1 update for the Scorpio Expansion of STNH! In this update we have overhauled the Traditions to fix a number of issues and make them more fun to work through. We hope you enjoy! 

We have separated out our existing traditions to make them their own unique branches. 

New tier 2 traditions have been introduced which unlock as you progress through the original ones. We will be adding more traditions in future patches 

Unlock unique mechanics, ships and stations as you complete the various race specific traditions trees! 

Feedback from the boarding mechanic has been taken onboard and implemented, thanks to all who fed back 

The geniuses are in the house, a new rare trait creates some real clever clogs! 

We've continued our efforts to optimise the code to provide a better performance late game 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_05:
Welcome to our 3.2 Compat Patch for the Scorpio Expansion of STNH! This update contains a number of fixes and changes to support the 3.2 Herbert Release from PDX. We hope you enjoy! 

We have heard how seriously you guys take canon/non canon ships, our latest tradition named after the series of the same name lets you decide whether you want to include a number of bonus non-canon ships. 

Community content! We have kicked off our very own community contribution scheme... the collective and this patch includes content written by fine folk! 

Minor empire ship sets, we're continuing our quest to flesh out the minor races ship sets to expand the Trek experience. 

Aquatics Pack - for those of you who have this species pack you can play as the 'turtly awesome' Chelarians and adds the warp capable Selkies 

Further performance increases by optimising old events 

Plus much more detailed in our Patch Notes. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod, brought to you by PDG.
sth_start.999.desc_06:
Seasons greetings and welcome to our final patch of the year! The dev team have been hard at work preparing one final update for 2021 and a number of fixes and changes that have been requested. We hope you enjoy! 

We've been hard at work withour community team "the Collective" to rework and improve all of the maps we offer. 

We have given some of the minor races some STNH love with some new portraits and added everyone fave pacifists the Mizarians to the map! 

A lot of work has gone into balancing the starting conditions across the majority of races, and this will continue into 2022. 

The Undine special weapons previously locked behind DLC now has a workaround so that everyone can enjoy. 

As we move towards 3.3 our focus will be on the AI and how it balances its economy, and we look forward to teasing more 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's mod and have a fantastic New Year. 

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_07:
Greetings and Happy New Year from us all at PDG! A new year and a new patch including number of fixes and changes that align with Libra 3.3! 

A huge amount of work has gone into the AI and how it builds, with buildings and districts overhauled and where we can brought inline with the Vanilla AI changes. 

Maps have been further updated and we're working with a group of lore experts to make some exciting changes! 

A new major endgame crisis has been introduced, no spoilers... you will just have to discover it. 

Optional canon war scenarios have been introduced for those who love to role play certain events. 

Experience the Wrath of Khan in one of two unique ways. 

We are continuing to introduce as many of the exciting Vanilla changes in a controlled manner as possible, the future is interesting. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_08:
Greetings from us all at PDG! Thank you for your patience whilst we have been hard at work on our 3.4 release! The teams have been hard at work on a number of behind-the-scenes changes securing the future of STNH and improving performance! 

With the help of PDX we have been working on the triggers we use to bring more optimised performance across the mod. 

For fans of a more violent play style we have added the Confederacy of Earth set within the prime universe map. 

The Borg Adaption mechanism has been upgraded and improved based on feedback from players. 

The list of leaders for the Mirror Universe has been refreshed and updated. 

Lots of love has been given to ST:SNW with a few new additions from the show added to the game. 

The Klingon Great Houses have been re-worked behind the scenes to take maximum effect of the new mechanics. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_09:
Greetings from us all at PDG! A wave of excitement rushes through the Q Continuum, it's patch time once again. Our 3.5 base compatibility release contains a number of fixes carried over from 3.4 as well as some exciting performance improvements. 

Using the new script profiler we have anaylsed and improved a number of scripts and triggers to speed up gameplay, this will be part of a continued effort on our part. 

Game balance has been a heavy focus this time as pretty much all empires have been reviewed and updated. 

We have reviewed and made some much needed improvements to how wars are conducted to avoid some of those endless wars that no one wants to see. 

The new lore map has had yet more planets added and many of the random made up systems replaced with real life stars. 

The UFP now has a separate contact for the Federation Council and many of the mechanics that sat in the yearly event have been split between this council & the science stations. 

A great number of fixes and feedback have been included. 

 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_10:
Greetings from us all at PDG! As we reach the conclusion of a long run of exciting new Trek on our TVs, what better to do than play some STNH and our 3.5.3 Patch... 

We have continued to review the new performance profiling tools and have further optimized and replaced older inefficient code to improve performance. 

More empires have undergone balance review and improvements. 

We have added the Tomed Incident as a pivotal moment in Federation/Romulan history. 

The new lore map now has a Mirror Universe version, something that you have been calling out for. 

A great number of fixes and feedback have been included. 

 Our focus has already started looking at our next major patch and looking at more exciting changes for 3.6 We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_11:
Hello from us all at PDG! This month we bring you a patch that has us very excited due to some of the very cool new features in 3.7 and the FC DLC... 

This DLC comes with cloaking! We have worked hard to adapt the new cloaking mechanics for all those who decide to buy the new DLC. 

For players without the DLC we have made some improvements to the original cloaking set up to make it feel more unique. 

You said, we did! We have looked at balancing Starbase battles, with scaling bonuses and a reduction in weapon range, with the aim to create powerful Starbases, that allow you to engage them fairly. 

Buzz Buzz Crackle Crackle... we now have Breen Voice Overs. 

The new Q-pedia has been added, just talk to Q for lots of hints and tips for playing STNH. 

As always we have included new events, ships and fixes along with everything you need to enjoy 3.7. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_12:
Hello from us all at PDG! We'd like to introduce you to our 3.8 patch and the Paragons DLC... 

One of the biggest changes in this patch is the introduction of the new star option, you can now customize how many minor empires are part of your playthrough. 

We have revamped the hero system and leader mechanics into a 3 tiered system in line with the changes from Paragons. 

To honor the return of the Enterprise-D in Picard, we have a new major story mission, play along with our take on Generations. 

Our team have been working behind the scenes to make a number of performance improvements. 

The new Q-pedia has been expanded with more questions answered, just talk to Q for lots of hints and tips for playing STNH. 

As always we have included new events, ships and fixes along with everything you need to enjoy 3.8. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

 All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_13:
Hello from us all at PDG! Hope you all enjoyed the summer, to kick off Autumn (here at least) we have our 3.9 patch... 

We have been working with the MP community to make a number of important changes that should improve the multiplayer experience. 

We have made a number of changes and fixes to the random maps, making them more random and mappy than ever before. 

The Borg have received some love to their councilors, with new ones added and improvements to their traits. 

Our team have been working behind the scenes to make a number of performance improvements. 

As always we have included a few new events, ships, and fixes along with everything you need to enjoy 3.9. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_14:
Seasons Greetings from us all at PDG! We are really excited to bring you our Next Generation and 3.10 patch... 

Welcome to the Next Generation, play STNH starting from 2300. 

New Maps and events that propel you into the Lost Era of Trek. 

Leader portraits have been massively overhauled to look absolutely brilliant. 

Our team has been working behind the scenes to make a number of performance improvements. 

We have exciting new story arcs re-written to make use of the new situation arcs. 

We've reviewed our hero leaders to make them compatible with the changes made to enjoy 3.10. We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_15:
Hello from us all at PDG! We are excited to bring you the 3.11 patch... 

We have included our 3.11.1 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

We've listened to feedback and included the starting options to remove crisis and story events. 

Leader age reviews have taken place, hopefully catching any leaders spawning too young!. 

New events to play out the Bajoran occupation. 

Late game performance improvements. 

We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_16:
Hello from us all at PDG! We are excited to bring you our latest expansion... A Mirror Shattered 

We have included our 3.11.3 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

This patch contains a brand new set of maps for the Mirror Universe starting from the 2300s. 

Experience a new story set in the MU 

Now play as the Terran Resistance, Coalition of Hope and The Alliance. 

All new ships and leader portraits added to expand the experience. 

Combat science ships have been expanded for each empire!. 

We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_17:
Hello from us all at PDG! Thank you for bearing with us as we work on our update for 3.14. 

We have included our 3.14.15 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

We've added in a number of new relics and specimens for the Trek museums. 

Our expeditions are slowly being updated to use the new situation mechanism. 

Taking advantage of the capture mechanics to use by Borg and Boarding Parties. 

Many fixes and other changes listed in the patch notes. 

We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_18:
Hello from us all at PDG! It has finally arrived, our 4.0.* release has made it out of the hangar bay! This update has changed so many elements behind the scenes & we wanted to make sure we were happy and stable before releasing, but a big thank you to all the Devs & Beta testers who have made this possible. 

We have included our 4.0 base compat changes, with further updates reviewing the new features. 

The pop system has been re-written to take advance of the vanilla improvements. 

Planet starts and balances have been re-worked. 

Coming soon, Undine Ships using the new DLC and the Citadel mechanic. 

Many fixes and other changes listed in the patch notes. 

As always we will need your help to report balance and bugs as we work through this major change to STNH, We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.desc_19:
Hello from us all at PDG! The 1st major patch of our 10th Anniversary year, ready to support the 4.3 release. 

We have included our 4.3 base compat changes, including significant changes to ship and fleet sizes. 

The economy changes from the base game have been worked into the mod 

Significant performance improvements have been included to give our best performance yet. 

Long running events and mechanics have been re-written and tightened up to reduce errors and improve performance. 

Many fixes and other changes listed in the patch notes. 

As always we will need your help to report balance and bugs as we work through this major change to STNH, We hope you enjoy this ST New Horizon's experience.

All the best from the PDG Team.
sth_start.999.name: What's new in ST Horizons

sthera.1.a.tooltip: Captain Carter-Lin transfers from the Starfleet Design Bureau and awaits assignment.
sthera.1.desc:
Buried deep in the bowels of Earth Spacedock a quiet revolution in Starship design has taken place. For nearly five years Captain Carter-Lin of the Starship Design Bureau has led a team of experts in the fields of warp theory and metallurgy, all striving to provide Starfleet with a new generation of vessels fit to take Starfleet's message of peaceful exploration across the quadrant. 

Smooth white duranium alloys, bright gold picofibre deflector dishes and spiral vortex bussard collector domes offer substantial advantages over preceding technology.
sthera.1.desc_evil:
Buried deep in the bowels of [Root.Capital.GetName] Spacedock a quiet revolution in starship design has taken place. For nearly five years Captain Carter-Lin of the Starship Design Bureau has led a team of experts in the fields of warp theory and metallurgy, all striving to provide Starfleet with a new generation of vessels fit to demonstrate Starfleet's strength across the quadrant. 

Smooth white duranium alloys, bright gold picofibre deflector dishes and spiral vortex bussard collector domes offer substantial advantages over preceding technology.
sthera.1.name: A Bold New Era
sthera.10.desc:
Kutaya and Valda's raptors had performed admirably for many years, however untold stories of guile, conquest and battle from thousands of deep space raid reports and border skirmishes have found their way back to the restructured Ministry of War. 

These reports - coupled with improvements from the latest offensive technology - have resulted in a wave of new raptor designs fit to face the galaxy, for the glory of Romulus.
sthera.10.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
sthera.11.a: Captain Taldor takes command of the PWB Koderex.
sthera.11.desc:
The galaxy remains a dangerous place, and while Romulan captains continue to outguile their enemies the Empire must not become complacent. 

A new wave of warbird design has emerged from the Ministry of War, to account for the new challenges that have emerged and new weapons wielded by the other great powers. 

The experimental warbird Koderex, captained under Taldor, exemplifies the qualities of this new era - overwhelming power and force of presence.
sthera.11.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
sthera.12.desc: A new era of technological superiority awaits for our people, who proudly fight for the glory of the empire.
sthera.12.name: The Raptor's Wings, Made Anew
sthera.13.desc: Working tirelessly on [Root.Capital.GetName]'s orbital spacedock, a quiet revolution in warship design has taken place. For nearly five years the scientist [newOfficer.GetName] of the Naval Design Academy has led a team of experts in the fields of warp theory and metallurgy, all striving to provide [Root.Capital.GetName] with a new generation of vessels fit to defend the [Root.GetName]'s interests across the quadrant.
sthera.13.name: A New Era
sthera.14.desc:
Teraquads of data from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space exploration reports and border skirmishes have been poured over by experts at the Naval Design Academy on [Root.Capital.GetName]. 

This data - coupled with optimisations from the latest propulsion and defensive technology - has resulted in a wave of new designs fit to face the galaxy and promote the [Root.GetName]'s interests. 

The unarmed test platform for these new designs - the warship [newShip.GetName] - is now released for refit, alongside her commanding officer Captain [newOfficer.GetName].
sthera.14.name: A New Era
sthera.15.desc:
Advances in material sciences coupled with the maturation of the [Root.GetName]'s defensive technologies has resulted in a new generation of warship designs. 

The unarmed test platform for these new designs - the cruiser [newShip.GetName] - is now released for refit, alongside her commanding officer Captain [newOfficer.GetName].
sthera.15.name: A New Era
sthera.16.name: A New Era
sthera.17.desc:
Perfection is elusive, but it is our purpose. Through the assimilation of new species and the acquisition of more and more data, we are able to reshape both ourself and our vessels. 

Geometry will always be at the heart of our... aesthetic, but the techniques we employ to fulfil it continue to evolve.
sthera.17.name: The Geometry of Change
sthera.18.desc:

sthera.2.a: Captain Esteban takes command of the USS Grissom.
sthera.2.desc:
Captain Carter-Lin's starships performed admirably for many years, however teraquads of data from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space exploration reports and border skirmishes have since flowed through to the analysts at the Starship Design Bureau. 

This data - coupled with optimisations from the latest propulsion and defensive technology - has resulted in a wave of new Starship designs fit to face the galaxy and promote Starfleet's message of peace. 

The test platform for these new designs - the science vessel USS Grissom - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain Jonathan Esteban.
sthera.2.desc_evil:
Captain Carter-Lin's starships performed admirably for many years, however teraquads of data from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space exploitation reports and border skirmishes have since flowed through to the analysts at the Starship Design Bureau. 

This data - coupled with optimisations from the latest propulsion and defensive technology - has resulted in a wave of new Starship designs fit to face the galaxy and promote Starfleet's interests. 

The test platform for these new designs - the science vessel USS Grissom - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain Jonathan Esteban.

Perfection is elusive, but it is our purpose. Through the assimilation of new species and the acquisition of more and more data, we are able to reshape both ourself and our vessels. 

Geometry will always be at the heart of our... aesthetic, but the techniques we employ to fulfil it continue to evolve.
sthera.20.name: The Geometry of Change
sthera.3.a: Captain [buranCaptain.GetName] takes command of the USS Buran.
sthera.3.desc:
Advances in material sciences coupled with the maturation of Starfleet's exploration mission has resulted in a new generation of Starship designs. Sharp lines have been replaced with graceful curves while space for families and civilian activities has grown substantially. 

While the [Root.GetName] has not left it's defensive technologies behind, the presence of a [Root.GetName] Starship is considered a blessing to the majority of its neighbours. 

The test platform for these new designs - the patrol frigate USS Buran - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain [buranCaptain.GetName].
sthera.3.desc_evil:
Advances in material sciences coupled with the maturation of Starfleet's exploitation mission have resulted in a new generation of Starship designs. Sharp lines have been replaced with subtle curves while space available for weapons and plunder has grown substantially. 

The [Root.GetName] has not left its defensive technologies behind; the presence of a [Root.GetName] Starship is considered a fearsome sight to the majority of its neighbours. 

The test platform for these new designs - the patrol frigate USS Buran - is now released for standard duties, alongside her commanding officer Captain [buranCaptain.GetName].
sthera.3.name: A Bold New Era
sthera.4.name: A Bold New Era
sthera.5.a.tooltip: The Shipwright - legacy assured - awaits assignment.
sthera.5.desc:
It has been five years since the robed figure entered the Council chamber, clutching a datapad and demanding to speak with [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], refusing to give any name but 'Shipwright'. 

The Shipwright promised to deliver warships of greater power than the Empire has ever known... and now that promise has been delivered. A new generation of ship stands ready to be built, for the glory of the empire.
sthera.5.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.6.desc:
The Shipwright's warships performed admirably for many years, however untold stories of conquest from millions of cubic lightyears of deep space raid reports and border skirmishes have found their way back to the Imperial Engineering Guild. 

These reports - coupled with improvements from the latest offensive technology - have resulted in a wave of new warship designs fit to face the galaxy, for the glory of the empire.
sthera.6.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.7.a: General Krex takes command of the IKS Vorcha.
sthera.7.desc:
The galaxy remains a dangerous place, and while Klingon captains continue to prove their skill in battle to enemies of the Empire, the Empire must not become complacent. 

A new breed of warship design has come forth from shipwrights pledged to the House of [Root.GetRulerName], powerful ships built to bring glory to the empire. 

The experimental battleship Vorcha, captained by General Krex, exemplifies the qualities of this new era - overwhelming power and force of presence.
sthera.7.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.8.desc: A new era of technological superiority awaits for our people, who proudly fight for the glory of the empire.
sthera.8.name: Jaq Chu' Bov
sthera.9.a.tooltip: Commission in hand, Kutaya awaits assignment.
sthera.9.b.tooltip: Commission in hand, Valda awaits assignment.
sthera.9.desc:
Five years the Oversight Committee had waited for the Ministry of War to complete its task. Five years since [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] addressed all Romulus and announced the fifty-seventh Generational Decree - [Root.GetRulerName]'s legacy appended to nearly 2,000 years of Romulan history. A decree to strengthen the Imperial Fleet, to ensure dominance over Vulcan and its new allies. 

Five years of infighting and stalled progress in the Ministry of War. 

Seeing for himself the lack of progress, alien material sciences expert Kutaya - the son of the Flaxian ambassador and a rare non-Romulan favourite of the Imperial Court - instead worked in parallel and in secret with a junior engineer in the Ministry of War, Valda. 

Appearing before the Oversight Committee the pair presented their work. A new generation of warbirds using the latest shields, warp drives and weapons, capable of showing the galaxy at last the true strength of the Romulan Star Empire. 

The Minister of War was furious to see her own work put to shame and stormed from the chamber, a Reman Praetorian guard following with dagger in hand...

stone_of_gol_chain_desc:
An ancient device called the 'Stone of Gol' was conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening.

Until recently it was believed to have been destroyed by the Vulcan gods but in reality, the weapon became disassembled in the Time of Awakening and its three pieces have been scattered over large distances of space.
story.301.desc.borg:
Reports of deep-space drone vessels unattached to the [Root.GetName] in certain systems have been investigated. These drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones seem to lack any comms protocols - at least any decipherable by the [Root.GetName] - and react with hostility to [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships entering the system. 

Their presence in the [From.From.GetName] system is an inconvenience.
story.305.a.tooltip: Gives access to the Droning Optimizations Edict.
story.305.b.tooltip: Adds a list of mineral-rich planetoids to the Situation Log.
story.305.desc.borg:
The ancient mining drones are indeed primitive, but highly specialised. Mining Network Controller subroutines on [Root.Capital.GetName] indicate efficiencies could be improved by adopting several of their extraction techniques buried in the drone's memory cores; however, this could risk damaging the location data of a number of high-value mining targets nearby. 

Additionally, analysis has indicated that the drones are not completely passive. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. There is no indication of what these signals may be targeting.
story.310.desc.borg:
The ancient mining drones were destroyed in a heated battle with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] vessels. Their energy cores are by far the sturdiest component used in their construction, and some were recovered by the Collective. The technology behind these cells is surprisingly advanced and resistant to assimilation, but initial tests show we are quite capable of converting their output to Energy. 

As the final energy cell bled out, our own drones handling the tests noticed a dip in background radiation. It would appear that the ancient mining drones are not silent, but they have been sporadically broadcasting on unusual frequencies since we first encountered them, possibly ever since they were first deployed. It is unlikely that there is anyone left to receive these transmissions.

The drones could prove to be a potent but limited source of energy, should we be able to find and disable them efficiently enough.
story.330.desc.borg: The [Root.GetName] has encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

sword_of_kahless_1.name: Hur'q Investigation
sword_of_kahless_2.desc: Dense jungle hides an abandoned medical facility that may help us locate the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_2.name: Jungle Investigation
sword_of_kahless_3.desc: An ancient ocean research station is our next point of call on the quest for the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_3.name: Ocean Investigation
sword_of_kahless_4.desc: We've located one of the last Hur'q colonies in this part of the galaxy. This may be our last option to locate the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_4.name: Desert Investigation
sword_of_kahless_5.desc: Evidence suggests that the Hur'q hid a treasure trove of stolen artefacts here. Is the Sword among them?
sword_of_kahless_5.name: The Vault
sword_of_kahless_chain_desc: The crone Le'tor has found a datapad that may hold clues to the location of the Sword of Kahless, lost centuries ago as the Hur'q were driven from our world.
temp_probe_chain_desc: We discovered a log buoy protected by temporal shields. Unfortunately, we found out after deactivating the shields that the data was too damaged. Maybe we can adjust the scanners to find any more buoys.
terra_prime_chain_desc: The recent string of anti-alien attacks throughout Human space poses a significant threat to our relationships with alien powers. But perhaps it all leads to a much bigger threat to our political system and the way of life.

theFederation.1.desc:
Our interstellar alliance has caught the public imagination. No longer is Earth an isolated backwater on the galactic stage, but a central component in a powerful block of shared values and interests. 

This coalition of planets protects us, but there are many who wish for further integration to better secure ourselves against hostile neighbours. Many influential politicians on coalition worlds have signaled a desire to start this process, all that is needed is for one leader to step forth and make the proposal...

[federationLeader.GetRulerTitle] [federationLeader.GetRulerName] of the [federationLeader.GetName] has formally called on all members of our coalition to take the next step toward integration, through the formation of a true multiplanetary federal state. The 'United Federation of Planets'.

theFederation.1003.desc:
The delegates have all assembled in the grand chamber on [federationLeader.Capital.GetName]. Billions of people from each of the coalition homeworlds watch from their homes or on enormous public displays. 

Federation day! 

[federationLeader.GetRulerTitle] [federationLeader.GetRulerName] steps forward, allied counterparts in tow. Dozens of lights from the audience flash and the roar of the crowd subsides until the entire hall is blanketed in silence. The leaders gather around a large book on the central podium and in turn mark their names. 

'Today is an historic day.', [federationLeader.GetRulerTitle] [federationLeader.GetRulerName] says to the gathered masses.
'Today is the day our many races are joined together in peace, and in the spirit of exploration and progress. Today marks the birth of a federation; THE United Federation of Planets!'

And with that the applause thundered.
