It is a true testament to the strength and wisdom of the Bajoran people.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_banea_desc:
Research Facility

The Banean Engineering Institute is now an interstellar monument to technical excellence. Its faculty includes the greatest Banean minds, and its students pioneer advancements in fields previously thought impossible, such as advanced sensor jamming and warp field theory.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_betazed_desc:
Research Facility

The University of Betazed is the premier institution of its kind in the quadrant. Its faculty includes the greatest Betazoid scholars, and its advanced programs attract students from many allied species. It is a beacon of intellectual curiosity, compassionate understanding, and deep respect for history and culture.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_cardassia_desc:
Research Facility

This is less a university and more of an arm of the Cardassian state. Its graduates are the elite of Cardassian society, and its faculty are the architects of the Union's ideology. The institution is the ultimate tool for both fostering intellectualism and ensuring absolute loyalty.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_denobulan_desc:
Research Facility

The Denobulan Science Academy is a wonder of the galaxy, its reputation and influence unmatched. Its alumni are considered the greatest scientific minds in their fields, and its research has led to countless breakthroughs in medicine, technology, and pure science.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_desc:
Research Facility

Students from nearby worlds attend this facility, with academic leaders in every branch, teaching seminars every day. A higher level of education amongst our citizens will improve our ability to make new discoveries and advance our scientific understanding.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_earth_desc:
Research Facility

The University of Cambridge is now a monumental institution, its reputation for academic excellence unmatched throughout humanity. Its alumni are considered the greatest scientific minds in their fields, and its research has led to countless breakthroughs that benefit all species.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_orion_desc:
Research Facility

This is a monument to the Orion mind and its uncompromising ambition. The Institute's research on cosmology and spacetime anomalies is a closely guarded asset, and its curriculum produces the elite, results-oriented professionals who are indispensable to Orion commerce and clandestine operations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_rom_desc:
Research Facility

This is a monument to the Romulan mind and its uncompromising ambition. The Academy's research is a closely guarded asset, and its curriculum produces the elite, results-oriented professionals who are indispensable to the continued power of the Star Empire and the Tal Shiar.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_vulcan_desc:
Research Facility

This is less a building and more of a galactic scientific monument. The Academy's influence is woven into the very fabric of scientific progress, and its graduates are at the forefront of every major discovery. It is the definitive voice of scientific authority in the quadrant.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_secret_1_cardassian_desc:
Government Facility

The Obsidian Order is the primary intelligence agency of the Cardassian Union. Almost all Cardassians live in fear of the Obsidian Order, whose constant surveillance had led to the sudden eliminations of numerous 'traitors'. It is said that The Order is so efficient, a Cardassian citizen couldn't sit down to a meal without each dish being duly noted and recorded by the Order, down to its preparation and the exact measurement of each ingredient. 'Everyone has reason to fear the Order.'

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_confederacy_desc:
Government Facility

The Confederacy Intelligence agency or CIA are responsible for the internal security of the Confederation with the jurisdiction to employ any means to accomplish the task.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_dominion_desc:
Government Facility

The Dominion Security Division are responsible for maintaining the security and protection of the Dominion and to ensure the Founders are never without the knowledge to keep the Dominion above its enemies.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_generic_desc:
Government Facility

It takes exceptional people to do what we do - To share glorious news of our greatness with our beloved citizens. Our reporters, newsreaders, editors and publicists ensure our citizens are given the correct information about our activities, rather than any dissident propaganda.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_romulan_desc:
Government Facility

The Tal Shiar is the elite intelligence agency of the Romulan Star Empire. It is a highly-respected and feared force in the Alpha and Beta Quadrants. Its purpose is guarding the security of the Empire, both from the Romulans' interstellar enemies - as well as from traitors within the Romulan population itself. The covert, often invisible presence of the Tal Shiar keeps the general populace in a constant state of paranoia. Dissent and dissatisfaction with the status quo is met with severe punishment and dissidents are often known to 'disappear'.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_starfleet_desc:
Government Facility

Starfleet Intelligence is a law enforcement and intelligence agency within Starfleet responsible for state security and citizen safety.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_terran_desc:
Government Facility

Imperial Intelligence, also referred to as Starfleet Intelligence or Imperial Security, is a law-enforcement and intelligence agency of the Terran Empire that is charged with matters of state security and ensuring the loyalty of citizens to the Empire. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_cardassian_desc:
Government Facility

With a renovated headquarters, the Obsidian Order has expanded its reach far beyond the Cardassian Union. Its agents now operate in a new capacity, monitoring and manipulating events in neighboring systems. Advanced data analysis engines allow the Order to predict and neutralize threats to Cardassian interests before they even materialize. The new HQ serves not only as a centre of intelligence but as the nerve centre for pre-emptive operations, ensuring the Order's grip on both domestic and interstellar affairs.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_generic_desc:
Government Facility

The Ministry of Psionic Enlightenment is the state's central organ for securing the loyalty of its populace. Within its halls, a specialized group of individuals work to identify and cultivate psionic talent, ensuring all abilities serve the greater good of the empire. Though their methods are rarely seen, their influence is undeniable, and their work ensures the collective will of the people remains in perfect harmony with the state.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_romulan_desc:
Government Facility

With this renovated facility, the Tal Shiar has perfected its network of spies and informants. State-of-the-art surveillance and interrogation facilities ensure that no secret, no matter how deeply buried, remains hidden from the Empire's gaze. The new headquarters is more than a building; it is a symbol of the Tal Shiar's total authority, a constant reminder that its unseen agents are everywhere, watching and listening for the slightest hint of disloyalty.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_starfleet_desc:
Government Facility

Starfleet Intelligence now represents a new generation of information management. This facility is dedicated to the proactive protection of Federation space and its ideals. It houses a state-of-the-art data analysis hub, where intelligence gathered from countless sources is meticulously cross-referenced to anticipate threats. Rather than merely reacting to crises, the Advanced HQ works to identify and neutralise them at their earliest stages, ensuring the continued safety and prosperity of all Federation citizens.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_terran_desc:
Government Facility

Time takes a toll on everything, being in the shadows doesnt exclude that from happening. While renovated it was also enhanced on several aspects, which i cant tell, otherwise it wouldnt be a secret.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_cardassian_desc:
Government Facility

This headquarters has been upgraded to house the Order's most effective and ruthless 'eliminators.' With a sprawling network of informants, state-of-the-art surveillance technologies, and a direct line to every major military asset, the Order is now able to act with total impunity. From this location, every move of every citizen, every military order, and every political machination is known and recorded. This new facility ensures no whisper of dissent or treason goes unpunished.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_romulan_desc:
Government Facility

This facility represents the pinnacle of Romulan intelligence. It is a fortress of both information and lethality, where advanced cognitive analysis and psi-scanners are used to predict the strategic moves of rivals and identify traitors before they can act. The 'Enhanced' HQ is less about gathering secrets and more about controlling the flow of information on a galactic scale, ensuring the Tal Shiar always holds the crucial advantage. Dissent is not merely punished here; it is erased from existence.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_terran_desc:
Government Facility

Further enhanced and bigger, its so big you can not see. Realy, its hiding in plain sight and no one knows about it. Maybe we should remove the 'Intelligence HQ' sign at the entrance.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_s31_starfleet_desc:
Government Facility

On the outside this building looks like any other on the planet, but within the secretive Section 31 coordinate their efforts to protect the citizens of Earth and its allies from within this building.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_agony_1_desc:
Government Facility

Built for interrogations of slaves, these chambers are large scale agony booths - capable of stimulating the pain centre of virtually any humanoid with a synaptic scan calibrating it for each species. The booth's sensors continually shifts the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_bazaar_desc:
Criminal Syndicate

Highly illegal on some worlds, the lucrative slave bazaar is large auctioneering area which allows the procurement of individuals who have been sold into indentured slavery.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_slave_camp_1_desc:
Government Facility

The buying and selling of slaves for usage for labour, research or pleasure has been a staple of business for centuries. With the introduction of new species and new markets, demand has spiked, allowing this facility to operate on a planetary wide scale. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_processing_1_desc:
Government Facility

In order to ensure effective and efficient slave labour, we need to keep track of our slaves. As with any commodity, maintenance and stock control is essential, so also with this commodity. These centres will improve the output of our slave labour force.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_smuggling_rings_desc:
Criminal Syndicate

Laws, taxes and tariffs can be avoided by the more wily merchants who traverse the stars. If there is a demand for a product, the smugglers can fill it.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_spawning_pool_1_desc:
Population Assembly

Grown in thick viscous goo filled with all the nutrients a growing body could need, the spawning pools are where many clones are born.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_2_desc:
Population Assembly

Tubes filled with the growing clones are kept here, suspended in a thick viscous gloop that contains all the nutrients and minerals a growing clone needs. Attached biomonitors can be closely monitored to ensure optimum growth.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_3_desc:
Population Assembly

The process of growing clones within vast rows of tubes has been automated somewhat, with the automatic release of nutrients, growth hormones or poison dependent on the central monitoring stations situated within the complex. 

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_4_desc:
Population Assembly

This vast cloning facility has rows upon rows of specimens growing within large cylindrical tubes filled with a whitish grey gloop. The process is fully automated with monitoring software responsible for the growth, birthing and recycling of subjects.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Population Assembly.
building_starport_1_desc:
Manufacturing Building

Not much more than a clearing and some basic facilities for civilian freighters and trading ships, the basic trading centre is meant to make way to a range of specialised commercial buildings.

Trading Centres allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_2_desc:
Manufacturing Building

A nexus for intra-system and interstellar civilian freighters, starports are a major hub of commerce. Most financial institutions and commodity exchanges keep at least a nominal presence in this giant facility, if not their main planetary headquarters.

Starports allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_3_desc:
Manufacturing Building

An enormous trading hub for interstellar civilian freighters and traders. Most interstellar financial institutions and commodity exchanges have a large presence here, if not their main planetary headquarters.

Commercial Hubs allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported good. The imported goods on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_4_desc:
Manufacturing Building

The headquarters of many interstellar commerce organisations, this starport is an immense trading port designed as a hub to service nearby worlds.

Commercial Nexus allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_stone_of_memory_desc:
Resource Building

Recordings of memories from deep within the rock are stored here, etched deep within the stonework.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_supercomputer_1_desc:
Research Facility

The sophisticated master computer on the planet Bynaus is with which virtually all Bynar are interconnected. It is an integral part of Bynar society, influencing their language and even their thought patterns.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_tholian_hub_1_desc:
Unity Building

The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. Being in proximity to a lattice node brings a sense of calm and unity to the population.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_2_desc:
Unity Building

The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. Being in proximity to where numerous lattice nodes converge brings a sense of calm and unity to the population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_3_desc:
Unity Building

The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. The confluence of large sections of the lattice here exude massive amounts of calm and unity across the surface of the world.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_4_desc:
Unity Building

The central nexus of the lattice, where all points meet in a large hub, is a powerful area where Tholians meet to experience the calm and unity that the lattice brings.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_time_crystal_mine_1_desc:
Resource Building

Time crystals are a very rare mineral in a non-equilibrium matter state. Time crystals can be identified by their orthogonal indices. Careful mining techniques are able to harvest this mineral, which is used in rare temporal experiments.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_tosk_refuge_desc:
Unity Building

A vast contained ecosystem where Tosk can roam free to create an ideal hunting grounds for the Oschean Hunters.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_training_centre_1_desc:
Military Facility

Whilst headquarters can often produce the best and the brightest, more members of the populace can be trained to traverse the stars, though it may take more resources.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_training_centre_2_desc:
Military Facility

Whilst headquarters can often produce the best and the brightest, gaining real experience with live fire exercises and actual ships is an important part of ensuring crews are experienced.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_transport_hub_1_desc:
Government Facility

A small complex designed to facilitate civilian transportation between worlds, with all immigration processes and medical clearances required. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_transport_hub_2_desc:
Government Facility

This interstellar port is a centralised arrival and departure point for migrants to and from other worlds, greatly speeding up the process of passing through customs and starting a new life.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_transport_hub_3_desc:
Government Facility

A large complex designed to facilitate the rapid immigration of species to the world with dedicated environmental chambers and nutritional supplements for species with unique requirements.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_trellium_mine_1_desc:
Resource Building

Whilst some forms of Trellium can be produced synthetically, the most useful forms are found in natural ore. Deep core mining allows the Trellium to be extracted from the ground and processed into a useable form.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_tribute_humanity_desc:
Unity Building

A site that is dedicated to spreading the message and glory of Humanity, so that none forget 'a Human Galaxy is a safe Galaxy'.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_underground_chemists_desc:
Criminal Syndicate

The more dangerous stims and illicit substances across the galaxy are too short lived to travel across the stars, and require networks of local laboratories where they can be produced.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_underground_clubs_desc:
Criminal Syndicate

Large underground clubs are a breeding ground for excitement, miscreants and customers of more illicit goods.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_underground_market_1_desc:
Government Facility

An underground market is a clandestine market for transactions that have some aspect of illegality. Crime is rife here.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_undine_academy_1_desc:
Military Facility

The construction of a local garrison that grows from the local biomass and gathers to defend a small section of territory.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_academy_2_desc:
Military Facility

Improvements to the garrison allow for a more permanent defensive force to infest in this system at the Division Headquarters, which is able to respond to any assaults rapidly across the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_academy_3_desc:
Military Facility

The headquarters of our orbital armies is a fortified command and control stronghold, filled with numerous divisions of defensive troops capable of coordinating the defences across the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_academy_4_desc:
Military Facility

A massive hardened and purpose built set of structures with large tunnel complexes under the surface allow for entire armies of units to be stationed in this fortress, able to defend against massed assaults by invading armies.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_arena_desc:
Amenity Building

The Undine do not socialise like normal species, but the Hive Arena allows them to test their psychic powers and encourage others from their species to watch and enjoy the entertainment.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_undine_capital_1_desc:
Capitol Building

Small local hive where the Undine can convene in their natural environment. The local Psi Master can coordinate the actions of the hive and allow the site to develop.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_2_desc:
Capitol Building

This Hive allows the coordination of the Undine population though a series of nodes that connect internally within the planet itself. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_3_desc:
Capitol Building

As we establish further control over the world, we are announcing to the rest of the galaxy that this planet is under the control of the biomass.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_4_desc:
Capitol Building

This world has now almost completely succumb to the biomass of Fluidic Space. The planet is more like a single organism than a planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_5_desc:
Capitol Building

The entire planet brims with the psychic energy of the Undine, with everything moving and acting as one. All life acting to further the supremacy of the fluidic realm.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_engineering_1_desc:
Research Facility

The Engineering Advancement Hive brings together the greatest minds in Undine society to telepathically work through ideas and make advancements.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_physics_1_desc:
Research Facility

The Physics commune brings together the greatest minds in Undine society to telepathically work through ideas and make advancements.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_1_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

Order is maintained within the hive via the local order depots, errant individuals are identified and removed from the group.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_2_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

Balancing the cohesion of the multiple minds takes careful coordination to ensure errant individuals to do corrupt the wider group.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_3_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

These segments allow for errant minds that are behaving against the good of the species to be captured and repaired before further damage to the group union can be done.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_4_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

The cohesion of the group is important, and large Hive Order complexes are designed to ensure cohesion, and rectify any errant Undine.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_1_desc:
Research Facility

The Undine Research Pool allows the Undine to gather and telepathically process and stores information relevant to current events, before communing with other hives.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_2_desc:
Research Facility

The Undine Research Archive processes and stores information uploaded from the minds of the Undine scientists and stores it for long term usage and archival.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_3_desc:
Research Facility

The Planetary Research Pool serves as a neural database of an entire world. It coordinates the work of Undine Research Archives and smooth information distribution to the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_4_desc:
Research Facility

The Interdimensional Research Archive coordinates the work of individual Planetary Research Pool and projects this information into the mines of Undine hives across dimensions.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_society_1_desc:
Research Facility

Undine biology is as close to perfection as possible, yet their genetists still work to advance their perfection by studying all branches in the field of biology.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_temple_desc:
Unity Building

Discovered on the planet, the ruins of an ancient Undine temple holding many secrets.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_undine_toiler_outpost_desc:
Undine Special Building

The Undine Toilers scower the fluidic realm to bring in resources to strenghten the hive. Their Outposts allow them to collect their harvested supplies and coordinate their efforts.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Undine Special Building.
building_university_capital_2_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is capable of handling the gathering of the best minds on the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_university_capital_3_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is also capable of handling the massive computations of the researchers.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_university_capital_4_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is also capable of handling massive amounts of data going in and out of the capital.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_university_capital_5_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is capable of handling anything the scientific mind can throw at it. 

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_verteron_array_desc:
Resource Building

The highly advanced and specialised Verteron Array can be used to divert comets from their solar orbit and force them to crash on Mars polar ice caps.

The Verteron Array may only be built on Mars. It will allow a special decision for the terraforming process for Mars.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_virtual_combat_arena_tsunkatse_:
Cultural Building

Updating blood sports to utilise advances in technology enables the creation of challenges of varying skill levels, offering entertainment and prestige. Broadcasting the fights worldwide using the latest technologies also has benefits.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Cultural Building.

Cultural Building

Rather than teaching new hunters with the dangerous and time consuming nature of seeking out worthy prey, holographic representations can satiate the hunters needs and teach valuable lessons.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Cultural Building.
building_war_factory_desc:
Resource Building

An extremely sophisticated military drone production facility capable of rapidly analysing strategic information and accordingly altering both the hardware and firmware of its drones. Thankfully inert, this facility is currently being rigorously studied by our scientists to glean insights into autonomous construction techniques and adaptive A.I. algorithms.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_weather_control_facility_desc:
Amenity Building

A weather control system is used to alter a planet's natural weather patterns and local system through a weather control grid that which acts much like a system-wide environmental system.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_wilderness_capital_2_desc:
Capitol Building

The Hunter's Cabin is the centralised location on a hunting planet where most hunting parties arrange their expeditions, as well as present their trophies and claim their rewards.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_xeno_zoo_1_desc:
Cultural Building

A facility containing biomes different to our own can be constructed to exhibit and study alien, non-sentient life for the enjoyment and benefit of our citizens.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_xeno_zoo_denobulan_desc:
Academic Facility

A large centre for Xenological studies created by the Denobulans in order to study alien life and understand their unique familial and cultural differences.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Academic Facility.
c_chapel_background: Christine Chapel was a Human Starfleet officer who lived during the 23rd century. She served in the medical department having transferred from the Stanford Morehouse Epigenetic Project.
cannot_colonise_dmz_zone: Cannot colonise planets in a DMZ
cannot_colonise_neutral_zone: Cannot colonise planets in a Neutral Zone
cannot_colonise_warp_prim: Cannot colonise planets in a Warp Capable System
cardassian_trophy_activate: Celebrate Earth's Victory over Cardassia with decreased ship upkeep costs and shipyard build speed.
casus_belli_cb_ally_defence_acquire_hint: When our allies are in trouble we come to their defence!
casus_belli_cb_border_conflict_attacker_: It is time to expand our borders and resolve the conflict on our borders!
casus_belli_cb_border_conflict_defence_a: It is time to defend our borders and resolve the conflict on our borders!
casus_belli_cb_borg_assimilation_acquire: Neighbouring the target empire will grant Assimilation Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_cleanse_border_worlds_acq: [From.GetName] is forced to abandon contested border territories, abandoning colonies and dismantling starbases.
casus_belli_cb_demilitarisation_acquire_: Declaring the target our Rival will grant Demilitarisation Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_dominion_acquire_hint: The Empire is a valid candidate to join the Dominion by choice or force.
casus_belli_cb_end_crisis_threat_acquire: End the threat that is facing the entire galaxy.
casus_belli_cb_fallen_empire_acquire_hin: The galactic threat must be ended!
casus_belli_cb_honour_revenge_acquire_hi: This dishonourable foe has wronged us granting the Honour demands revenge Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_leadership_change_event_a: It is time for regime change for this empire either by choice or by force!
casus_belli_cb_liberation_acquire_hint: This empire is oppressing another civilisation!
casus_belli_cb_occupation_acquire_hint: Event driven: World is selected as an occupation target to grant the Occupy World Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_occupation_subject_acquir: Event driven: World strives for freedom from forced occupations grants the Freedom from Occupation Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_pirate_raid_revenget_acqu: We've been raided and now it is our turn to hit them.
casus_belli_cb_quadrant_defender: This empire is defending the Quadrant from invasion!
casus_belli_cb_quadrant_invasion: This empire stands in our way in obtaining countrol over the Quadrant!
casus_belli_cb_revenge_acquire_hint: This fool has done us a great wrong granting the Revenge Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_rightfully_ours: We claim this empire as rightly ours
casus_belli_cb_rightfully_ours_acquire_h: Through our force of will we have claimed dominion over this lesser empire!
casus_belli_cb_trade_embargo_acquire_hin: Declaring the target our Rival will grant Trade Embargo Casus Belli.
casus_belli_cb_undine_purge_acquire_hint: Neighbouring the target empire will grant Purge Casus Belli.
chakotay_backstory: Chakotay was a 24th century Human male of Native American descent who served as a Starfleet officer before joining the Maquis.
chakotay_catch_phrase: My people taught me a man does not own land.
changeling_detection_1_desc: Minimal security checks on our populace.
changeling_detection_2_desc: Moderate security checks on our populace, balancing disrupting on lives with internal security.
changeling_detection_3_desc: Maximum security checks on our populace, offering the most protection but also disrupting lives.
charge_default_behavior_desc: The ship will charge directly at the enemy, closing down to range of 15 units and will try to deal as much damage as possible.
charge_desc: This ship charges into battle to fight at close range.
chris_pike_background: Born in Mojave on Earth, Christopher Pike is considered to be the most decorated Starfleet Captain in the history of the service.
chris_pike_catch_phrase: Be Brave, Be Bold, Be Courageous
chroniton_desc:
Fires highly charged Chroniton beams at a planet that not only destroys a planet but wipes it from history. Total removal from the timeline is the goal.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Massive damage to Buildings
- Heavy damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Can reduce planets to lifeless worlds
citizenship_deassimilation_tooltip: Members of this species are being actively de-assimilated from the Borg Collective.
citizenship_deassimilation_tooltip_delay: Freedom is the right of all sentient species, free from the clutches of the Borg.
citizenship_full_machine_tooltip: All owned Pops of this species are an equal part in our Great Society.
citizenship_full_machine_tooltip_delayed: Either through complete obedience, cybernetic implants or a positronic matrix, this species is an integral part of a larger whole.
civic_a_close_eye_desc: This society keeps a close eye on all comings and goings within its territory and doesn't like to share.
civic_a_quiet_life_desc: This society is quite content with their peaceful existance in their small corner of the galaxy.
civic_a_shared_burden_desc: This society has evolved around the art of sharing stories and experiences, learning from them and passing them on to others.
civic_acamarian_1_desc: While many outside the Acamarian Sovereignty will no doubt consider internal strife to be something best avoided in a healthy society, the Acamarians have turned it into a source of power. Any Sovereign that manages to navigate the intricate and hostile inner politics of Acamar is more than a match to anything the galaxy might throw at it.
civic_advanced_start_empire_desc: This empire has an advanced start.
civic_antede_1_desc: Our oceanic reclusivity is perfect, we are the masters of our own seas. We are happy here amongst the abundant waters, where we can feed and frolic to our own contentment.
civic_aristocratic_elite_betazed_desc: It has been centuries since any part of Betazed has been ruled by a feudal system, but the great families of the ancient houses still wield considerable power and influence. The numerous scions of the various houses enjoy a robust education, which results in a highly refined and sophisticated society - if somewhat elitist.
civic_aristocratic_elite_desc: This society has an entrenched nobility that occupies the upper echelons of society.
civic_assimilators_desc:
'In their collective state, the Borg are utterly without mercy; driven by one will alone: the will to conquer. They are beyond redemption, beyond reason.'
- Jean-Luc Picard
civic_attention_detail_desc: No detail, no matter how minute, ever escapes the notice of this species. With perfect, long-lasting memories and complete control of their bodies and internal environment, it is not surprising that the ancient people of this empire sought a way to bring this level of accuracy and fidelity to their language as well. The result, after centuries of diligent work, is a constructed language capable of delivering any message, no matter how complex. Nowadays, this entire society is based around this language, even though the tongue itself is so complex no outsider has ever managed to master more than a percent of its syntax rules and vocabulary.
civic_awakened_giant_2_desc: The giant is awake and ready to make their claim on the Galaxy, as other watch in nervous anticipation.
civic_awakened_giant_desc: The giant is awake and ready to make their claim on the Galaxy, as other watch in nervous anticipation.
civic_awakened_giant_effect: The giant is awake, with impressive bonuses and modifiers fitting of this Awakened Fallen Empire.
civic_bandits_desc: Criminal elements have infiltrated almost every part of society, from the government to law-keeping. A complex system of treaties and bribes keep organised crime well regulated and the economy vibrant. The result, however, can be volatile and hard to control.
civic_bandits_hirogen_desc: The independent Hirogen hunting tribes are fiercely competitive yet all still adhere to a central code. While even the most rogue elements in Hirogen society will think twice before turning on its brethren, the result can be volatile and hard to control.
civic_bandits_smugglers_desc: Beyond the law, smugglers often trade contraband and otherwise illegal goods across the galaxy.
civic_bandits_suliban_desc: The Cabal and other shadowy organisations infiltrated almost every part of Suliban society, from the government to law-keeping. A complex system of treaties and bribes keep organised crime well regulated and the economy vibrant. Hired privateers and mercenaries are constantly on the lookout for new technologies and genetic modifications that can benefit the Cabal's elite. The result, however, can be volatile and hard to control - even with help from the future.
civic_bandits_yrid_desc: Concerned with their own interests yet spanning traders and nomads across the galaxy, Yridians are a veritable source of information concerning enemy affairs - if you can pay their price.
civic_barbaric_society_desc: This society holds itself outside of the accepted norm. If you are strong enough you deserve to keep what you own, if you are not then you deserve defeat.
civic_bio_infesters_desc: The genetic power of the biomass is all the matters, this society recognises its dominance and looks to spread that so that it consumes all.
civic_black_right_side_desc: The Cheronite entire society is split between two phenotypes. While genetically identical, the government is entirely in control of one phenotype, with the other subjugated and made into cheap, and readily available, manual labor.
civic_born_of_order_desc: Few agencies, of any government and in any field, could hope to compete with the sheer brutal magnitude of the Tal Shiar. While rival intelligence agencies in the galaxy could sometimes hope to match the Tal Shiar, none had the absolute respect, and fear, of the population like the Romulan Tal Shiar.
civic_bounty_hunters_desc: This society has evolved around the life of the Bounty Hunter, tracking and hunting individuals on behalf of the highest bidder.
civic_carpe_diem_desc: For years now Krenim scientists have attempted to meddle with temporal mechanics, but in doing so has given rise to the idea that the future is malleable and that they should make the most of the present time and give little thought to the future.
civic_circle_of_elders_desc: The many Circles that make up Voth society are ruled over by the Elders, those Voth whom have steadily risen to a venerable age with a wealth of experience to impart upon the younger generations.
civic_connoisseur_desc: From music to brandy, Saurian culture is often appealing to other races.
civic_convergent_evolution_desc: The highly competitive ecosystem of this species home planet brought about the convergent evolution of multiple intelligent species.
civic_cooperative_desc: The Cooperative is truly free, and each former drone has a voice. This fledgling civilisation has quickly earned a reputation as a free haven. The tired, the poor, the huddled masses yearning to breathe free - all are welcome here, regardless of their original species, before they were turned.
civic_corporate_dominion_stnh_desc: This society is dominated by a megacorporation that has completely supplanted the role of the state.
civic_cult_personality_desc: In the Cooperative a drone has no god, no religion, no creed. Even the Queen does not command. But a drone does have a goal - to seek perfection. This perfection is embodied by our fearless leader. In our new society, there is but one religion - to venerate Him and what He is above all else.
civic_cyber_dreamer_desc: For decades, the utopia of Unimatrix Zero has only existed in the mind of a precious few. Now they have made the dream true. This calm and pacific society has little use for strangers who do not understand their way of life. More than anything, they would prefer to be left alone and prosper.
civic_cyclic_arguments_desc: Since birth, every citizen of Tellar has been brought up in the art of argumentation. Tellarite education is heavily biased toward studies in philosophy, logic, citizenship, rhetoric and law. This results in a society where many turn toward civil service.
civic_distant_origins_desc: The 'Distant Origin' theory which tells that the Voth evolved on the other side of the galaxy is one that contradicts the doctrine of the powerful Voth elders. Doctrine states that the Voth were the first intelligent beings to evolve in the quadrant.
civic_drug_addicts_desc: This society has become dependent on pharmaceuticals in order to function. Their entire economy and way of life revolves around securing their next intake of their drug.
civic_drug_dealers_desc: This society is led by individuals who make their living from the supply of narcotics and ensure that they thrive from the misery and payments of those under the power of their drugs.
civic_duality_desc: Outsiders often mistake a Bynar pairs for twins, but in fact each pair is far closer than mere blood siblings and they are completely inseparable. Pairs are able to communicate between themselves and the Central Computer at incredibly fast speeds, to the point pairs often rely on each other for basic functions and calculations. This duality is an integral part of Bynar society, and the result is a highly efficient, effective civilisation.
civic_enigmatic_isolationists_desc: Whilst life within the Assembly exists with no lies or deceit, a wall of isolation exists creating an aura of mystery and illusion to all that look in.
civic_exalted_priesthood_desc: To guard against heresy, this society is ruled by a religious council consisting of the wisest and most pious members of the clergy.
civic_extreme_pacifism_desc: Surrending has become an artform, knowing when to give in and seek approval from your new overlords.
civic_former_drones_desc: This society is populated by individuals who were once part of an oppressive cybernetic collective consciousness.
civic_frontier_spirit_desc: This society is populated by individuals who trace their history back through a series of bold individuals striking out on their own to get away from powers which sought to influence them.
civic_great_balance_pred: Predator species in the Great Balance
civic_great_balance_pred_desc: This society has evolved around the Great Balance where predator and prey live in a single ecosystem, being the dominant species comes with many perks.
civic_great_balance_prey: Prey species in the Great Balance
civic_great_balance_prey_desc: This society has evolved around the Great Balance where predator and prey live in a single ecosystem, being the prey means a life of challenge.
civic_great_house_desc: A Great House is led by the household 'Epetai' and has a great deal of autonomy.
civic_great_houses_desc: Hailing back to the times of Kahless, the family lines of the Great Houses are the bulwark on which the Klingon Empire stands.
civic_habitat_empire_desc: This empire has chosen to leave terra firma and live amongst the stars in habitats.
civic_high_command_desc: High Command is responsible for overseeing Vulcan military and civilian organisations, as well as Vulcan's space fleet, diplomatic missions, and scientific research.
civic_iconian_technology_desc: The Iconians mastered technology before many of the species of the galaxy had even evolved on their homeworlds.
civic_imperial_guard_desc: Andorian men and women have served in the mighty Imperial Guard for centuries, hailing back to a time Andoria had an Emperor that required a guard. Now, it is one of the most highly trained and respected forces in the galaxy. Special honours are reserved for those that fall in battle. Compatriots may bring back a token of the fallen to return to the Wall of Heroes on Andoria where they may be remembered forever.
civic_interstellar_guard_desc: Following the formation of the Interstellar Union, the Imperial Guard has been repurposed into the multispecies Interstellar Guard. One of the most highly trained and respected forces in the galaxy, the best and brightest long to serve aboard a Union starship.
civic_khanate_1_desc: Radical eugenics treatments result in an augmented being that is far stronger and more intelligent than most beings of the same race. Selective breeding allows for weak and diseased genomes to be purge from the genetic pool.
civic_khanate_2_desc: Selecting only the most perfect individuals to be brought to fruition results in no weakness entering the bloodline of this species, ensuring strong leaders and a healthy populace. Constantly searching for new ways to increase the strength of their genome allows for radical treatments to take place.
civic_kir_shara_desc: The Kir'Shara is an ancient Vulcan artifact containing the writings of Surak, the founder of modern Vulcan philosophy.
civic_korgano_desc: When Korgano is in ascendence, the God-Emperor relocates to the Palace of the Moon. It is a beautiful construction of terraces, courtyards and waterfalls, cascading down from the top of the valley hills and down to the fertile river. For the D'Arsay people, the age of Korgano is a time of growth, prosperity and luxury, where sacrifice is forbidden and the nobility host monthly feasts for their local community.
civic_krios_1_desc: The ancient Kriosian Empire was ruled over by two brothers, Krios and Valt, until love for an empathic metamorph named Garuth drove them apart, causing Krios to kidnap Garuth and take her to Krios Prime. This sparked a huge war, causing the Kriosian Empire to split into two - now the worlds of Krios and Valt.
civic_lethargic_democracy_desc: The First Federation society is old, stratified and ancient almost to the point of immutability. It has never properly recovered from the crippling battles it had with the Second Orion Empire and the Hur'Q, as well as the devastating Go Lin Catastrophe.
civic_maquis_1_desc: A rebellion does not become a new nation easily, or overnight. It has taken years of underground work, shady connections of a somewhat cavalier attitude to rules and regulations to get things done. Till this day, many leaders of the new nations have deep connections in various criminal enterprises as well as a brutal attitude that get things done quickly.
civic_maquis_2_desc: Defying their original sovereign nations and their new overlords, these people rose up as fierce protectors of their liberties and what they perceive as 'their' land. They will fight for it with their last breath.
civic_masaka_desc: The age of Masaka sees the God-Emperor moving their residence to the Fortress of the Sun. A forbidding edifice overlooking the valley of the capital, it signifies how Masaka herself stands a distant vigil over her people. The D'Arsay fear and love their goddess in equal measure, knowing that her ascent indicates that soon, many of their loved ones will be called to war.
civic_master_strategy_desc: The pursuit of excellence drives everything in Zakdorn society and gives them a well-earned reputation as master strategist. Whatever this reputation will be put in the test in the coming years remains to be seen.
civic_master_time_desc: Over the past few dozen years, the Imperium has diverted huge funds to finance the ever-growing Temporal Defense Agency. The Krenim have developed and refined the study of temporal theory to an art form, manipulating the timelines with ease that seems almost instinctive.
civic_matriarchy_desc: Skrreean society is a matriarchy, in which females hold a dominant role over males as males are considered too emotional to be good leaders.
civic_medical_society_desc: For years now, the entire Vidiian culture has one goal - the eradication of the phage. The best minds of generation after generation have struggled with the problem, but that has not stopped the Sodality from trying further. There is no other empire in the galaxy that has so many medical practitioners, nor one where they can enjoy so much influence and access to resources.
civic_megacorp_bandits_yrid_desc: Concerned with their own interests yet spanning traders and nomads across the galaxy, Yridians are a veritable source of information concerning enemy affairs - if you can pay their price.
civic_megacorp_ethical_trading_desc: The Karemma are renown for their ethical trading practices, and regard cheating and gambling to be taboo. Many species trust the Karemma implicitly not to rip them off.
civic_megacorp_rules_acquisition_desc: The Rules of Acquisition are a numbered series of aphorisms, guidelines, and principles that provide the foundation of business philosophy in Ferengi culture.
civic_megacorp_slave_bazaars_desc: The Orion slave markets are a place where you can buy and sell anything you may want or need, and is often described as the seedy underbelly at the heart of the crime rate on many worlds. There's always people at the market, and there's always a market for people.
civic_megacorp_tsunkatse_franchising_des: Tsunkatse! The highest quality full body contact sport in the Galaxy! Pay per fight, and bet directly through your holoscreens.
civic_museums_2_desc: The great floating museums of Hur'Q used to carry a horde of ancient artifacts, each telling a timeless tale of the Hur'Q conquests. The Curators have disbanded most of the fleet, but they are still carry the knowledge of creating museums of exquisite beauty and insight.
civic_museums_desc: For millennia, the Hur'Q have studied and sampled almost every primitive culture across the galaxy. Their deep and innate understanding of xenoanthropology, and insight into governorship and interspecies dynamics, will no doubt prove highly useful for them as well.
civic_nomadic_desc: Whether through cataclysm or choice, this species has cast aside the shackles of the gravity well of their homeworld to travel the stars.
civic_non_megacorp_rules_acquisition_des: The Rules of Acquisition are a numbered series of aphorisms, guidelines, and principles that provide the foundation of business philosophy in Ferengi culture.
civic_obsidian_order_desc: The Obsidian Order, the most efficient and ruthless espionage agency in the quadrant, is a hidden yet key part of the Cardassian Union government.
civic_opportunistic_traders_desc: Seeking out profit where they can, these traders find opportunity where others see only order.
civic_perfect_memory_desc: Tholian society, while mysterious and strange to outsiders, is entirely transparent within with no lies, and deceit. The Assembly as a whole is also incredibly efficient with zero tolerance to mistakes and tardiness.
civic_philomaths_desc: Philomaths are lovers of study and learning, seeking out knowledge wherever they can find it.
civic_post_apocalyptic_kobliad_desc: This society is biologically dependant on the rare substance deuridium to stabilise their cell structure. As a result they constantly face the threat of extinction.
civic_post_apocalyptic_talos_desc: The remnants of the Talosian people live underground, last survivors of a nuclear war.
civic_post_apocalyptic_teplan_desc: A once prosperous society brought to its knees for showing an act of defiance.
civic_post_scarcity_desc: World War III and the ecological collapse of the 21st century have taught humanity a bitter lesson - the wanton pursuit for power is a dangerous thing. Now that all citizens enjoy easy access to all basic amenities, material wealth has little interest to the general population. We can finally focus on greater goals.
civic_predatory_nature_desc: This society is naturally predatory, this pushes their leaders to strive to be the best to survive and causes other species to shy away in fear.
civic_prime_directive_desc: Also known as Starfleet General Order 1, this directive is a guiding principle of Starfleet, prohibiting its members from interfering with the internal and natural development of alien civilizations.
civic_prophet_1_desc: The Prophets have guided Bajoran society for millennia, in time of strife and peace, and faith has kept the Bajoran people unified throughout all hardship. Their Prophets prophecies are carefully interpreted by the Vedek assembly, a council consisting of the wisest and most pious members of the clergy.
civic_prophet_2_desc: Bajorans have an ancient, deeply spiritual and advanced society of farmers, philosophers and painters. Everyone was born into a specific caste of D'jarras based on their family, and the only option to change was to be adopted into a different extended family. The D'jarra were not marked a person's goal in life but their position in the social hierarchy, from the low Imutta D'jarra that dealt with death rites and up to the Ih'valla, the painters and artists. While this led to a highly organised society, it had a hard time raising and maintaining a significant army.
civic_psionic_projection_desc: Capable of projecting great psionic imagery over vast distances, these people live in an imaginary world.
civic_reclaim_the_glory_desc: This society has returned to reclaim the Empire that belonged to them and crush anyone who opposes them.
civic_relentless_conquest_desc: 'Any exotic species deemed a threat to the Imperial Supremacy will be extinguished without prejudice.' - Terran General Order 4
civic_ritualized_greed_desc: 285 rules, 47 commentaries, 900 major and minor judgments and 10,000 considered opinions - the Rules of Acquisition, their interpretation and execution, permeates every facet of Ferengi society for over 10,000 years. What started as nothing more than a marketing ploy by the Grand Nagus Gint has given birth to one of the most highly competitive societies in the galaxy and let the Ferengi buy themselves a way away from their Swamp of a planet and into a seat in galactic affairs.
civic_river_1_desc: United, the Dominion can never be broken, but even when alone, every single Changeling carries within itself a millennia of knowledge, and all the trapping, connection, arrogance, confidence and abilities of a god.
civic_river_2_desc: The perfect unity of the Great Link is at the very heart of the Dominion.
civic_scavengers_desc: This society will do whatever it can to scavenge and acquire technology and avoid doing the work themselves.
civic_slaver_superior_desc: The Breen are harsh masters, and some may call them cruel. Nevertheless, they are efficient slavers capable of working their slaves to the limit.
civic_sleeping_giant_desc: A hidden power waiting and watching to return in power to the galaxy and make their mark, for good or bad.
civic_sleeping_giant_effect: A sleeping powerhouse, with impressive production bonuses, but content to wait and sleep for now.
civic_sona_1_desc: Exiled from their home planet and it's life extending rings after a failed coup, the Son'a have become narcissistic and materialistic in their quest for revenge.
civic_sona_2_desc: Travelling from world to world, taking what it is they want, the Son'a are a materialistic and narcissistic people.
civic_spirit_exploration_desc: There is an urge in all of us, to explore and to discover, the thrust of curiosity that leads us to try to go where no one has gone before. Now at long last new technologies allow us to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilisations.
civic_static_empire_desc: This empire is not looking to expand its territory at this point nor is it looking to engage on the galactic stage.
civic_stubborn_pride_desc: The great Voice Wars have changed Tellar irrevocably. A species that has valued precision now values diversity above all else. Nowhere is this more reflected than in the Tellarite love of a good argument and the sharing of their opinion. Those unfamiliar with their culture and customs may simply think them rude, but in truth they are superb politicians.
civic_stuck_in_the_past_desc: This society has a special fixation on the past and has developed its culture around archaic ways.
civic_superior_democracy_desc: The Qomar civilisation is old and wise and has little time for those it considers beneath them. As such their role within the galaxy is limited.
civic_superior_trade_desc: Every facet of the citizens interaction with each other within this civilisation is devoted to trade or transactions, with each member seeking to constantly get a better deal and a foot above the competition.
civic_syncretic_evolution_desc: A second species forms an integral part of this society. They are big, strong and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.
civic_talarian_1_desc: Games, tests, and competitions are an important part of the Talarian culture and children regularly engage in contests and challenges. Sharing victory is an important part of the games. When a Talarian reaches the age of fourteen, he undergoes ceremony of initiation, and after that has the freedom to make his own choices in life.
civic_technocracy_desc: To maximize efficiency, this society is governed according to the principles of science and rationality. Scientists and researchers are the governing force being this body.
civic_technological_revolution_desc: Abandoning the governments of the past, this society embraces the principles of science and rationality. Scientists and researchers are the governing force being this body.
civic_telepath_hunters_desc: The Devore Imperium has a brutal police state is carefully regulated and controlled, and doesn't just employ some of the finest custom officials in the quadrants, but dedicated bounty hunters that are tasked to find and capture any rogue telepath found in the state. Unregulated communication is strictly forbidden.
civic_the_great_herd_desc: This society has evolved around the herd mentality, where the wellbeing of the group comes first and the thought of being alone is un-heard of.
civic_the_herd_desc: Even the hardiest of the Kelpien, trained soldiers who dare leave their home planet and serve on soulless beasts of metal, find space combat almost impossibly hard to stomach. Their keen senses and ability to work instinctively as a group allow them to survive when others would not.
civic_the_order_desc: Dedicated to restoring the former glory of this empire, nothing will stand in their way in any timeline.
civic_the_strongest_survives_desc: The ancient rule of evolution is a primary pillar of the Terran society. In order to endure, one must exercise constant vigilance, always ready to fight for his life - vulnerability is weakness, and weakness means death. Only the very best can be allowed to shape the Empire's future.
civic_the_weak_will_perish_desc: The Undine believe in the absolute strength of their genetics and the power of the Fluidic Realm. Everything else is weak & the weak deserve to perish.
civic_tooltip_aristocratic_elite_betazed: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional Chalice Holder job.
civic_tooltip_aristocratic_elite_effects: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional Ruler job.
civic_tooltip_assimilators_effects:
Enables this empire to assimilate a wide variety of targets, forcibly adding them to the collective whole:

Pops: Add £ Unity and £ £ £ Research
Planets: +100% Assimilated Habitability
Ships: Convert to £ Designs or Resources
Leaders: Bonuses vs. £ Empire of Origin
Armies: Convert into allied £ Armies
civic_tooltip_barbaric_society_effects:
Cannot form Migration Treaties
Cannot form (but can join) Federations other than Martial Alliances or Hegemonies
Has the 'Despoliation' casus belli on all other empires
Unlocks the Raiding bombardment stance, which in turn allows us to abduct pops from besieged planets and resettle them to our own worlds.
Decreased Opinion for most other empires.
civic_tooltip_born_of_order_effects: Increases Stability by 5 and Administrative Capacity by 10
civic_tooltip_carpe_diem_effects: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional Temporal Researcher job.
civic_tooltip_circle_of_elders_effects: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional Elder job.
civic_tooltip_convergent_evolution_effec: Start the game with a mixed population of separate species, capable of quickly colonising a wide range of eco-systems.
civic_tooltip_cyclic_arguments_effects: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional Demagogue job.
civic_tooltip_exalted_priesthood_effects: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional Ruler job.
civic_tooltip_former_drones_effects: Whilst no longer part of the Collective, the cybernetic implants still remain.
civic_tooltip_khanate_1_effects: The Khanate receives a very large single-time bonus of £ Unity point for every technology in the £ Genetic line that they research.
civic_tooltip_korgano_effects:
The Waxing Cycle is a key mechanic for the D'Arsay Restored Hegemony. Every 10 years , the god and goddess Masaka  and Korgano alternate and ascend to domination. When under the rule of Korgano, the empire gains the following bonuses:

£ is increased by +20%.
£ Influence is increased by +1. 
Pop $MOD_POP_GROWTH_SPEED$ increased by +25%.
civic_tooltip_masaka_effects:
The Waxing Cycle is a key mechanic for the D'Arsay Restored Hegemony. Every 10 years , the god and goddess Masaka  and Korgano alternate and ascend to domination. When under the rule of Masaka, the empire gains the following bonuses:

Ship Fire Rate is increased by +33%.
Army Damage is increased by +33%.
$MOD_SPACEPORT_SHIP_BUILD_COST_MULT$ is reduced by -15%.
civic_tooltip_master_time_effects: Starts the game with the £ Temporal Mechanic technology. The Krenim have a drastically increased chance to obtain temporal technologies, as well as an immunity from the negative effect of most temporal wake mechanics. Finally, Krenim receive a very large single-time bonus of £ Unity point for every additional temporal technology they investigate.
civic_tooltip_medical_society_effects: All £ Capital Buildings now add an additional High Surgeon job.
civic_tooltip_museums_2_effects: You start the game with the £ Xeno-Archeology technology, granting you the knowledge on how to build £ Museums. Museums, that are placed on relics, produce 5 extra points of £ Unity. Your home planet starts with one relic deposit and an established museum.
civic_tooltip_nomadic_effects: Starts the game with the knowledge on how to construct large space structures. Can not build colony ships or settle on planets.
civic_tooltip_post_apocalyptic_talos_eff: This species starts with the powerful trait Talos Survivor, giving them increased survivability on irradiated planets and prolonging their leaders' life.
civic_tooltip_prophet_2_effects: Produce £ 0.5 unity when placed on agricultural, entertainment and cultural facilities such as farms, museums and monuments.
civic_tooltip_sona_1_effects: Starts the game with the £ Frontier Hospital technology. The Son'a have highly effecient £ Hospitals that grant extra £ Unity, cost less £ Energy and improve £ Pop Growth rate.
civic_tooltip_spirit_exploration_effects: Exploration speed with science vessels is increased by +10%, whilst those unemployed £ pops living under Utopian Abundance Living Standards have increased research and £ unity production due to their thirst for knowledge.
civic_tooltip_superior_trade: Every 20 Trade Value provides 1 £ Supplies and 1 £ Unity as well as the regular 1 £ Latinum.
civic_tooltip_syncretic_evolution_effect: Start the game with a small population of a subservient species, capable of undertaking simple tasks.
civic_tooltip_technocracy_effects: All Students will now produce 1 extra £ Unity as well as +10% research points.
civic_tooltip_virtuoso_effects: Starts the game with the £ Holodeck technology that includes holographic equipped terrestrial buildings like £ Holographic Centre, £ The Colosseum and £ Tsunkatse Primus.
civic_tooltip_warrior_culture_effects: Start the game with Army Damage increased by +20% and Army Upkeep reduced by -20%.
civic_tooltip_warrior_kahless_effects: Reduces the Naval Capacity Cost of all Klingon Military Ships by -10%.
civic_tooltip_xeno_vultures_effects: Start the game with Immigration Pull increased by +75%
civic_unrelenting_struggle_desc: For over 2,000 years, every citizen of the Vidiian Sodality has but two goals - survivals, and the eradication of the Phage. This level of sheer single-minded dedication has paid off in great advances in medical and biological science - but alas, none that has yet managed to cure the Phage itself.
civic_valt_1_desc: The ancient Kriosian Empire was ruled over by two brothers, Krios and Valt, until love for an empathic metamorph named Garuth drove them apart, causing Krios to kidnap Garuth and take her to Krios Prime. This sparked a huge war, causing the Kriosian Empire to split into two - now the worlds of Krios and Valt.
civic_virtuoso_desc: The Yaderans possess a rare artistic talent and an instinctive understanding of the subtle intricacies of matter and energy. Their expertise in holographic technology is unparalleled in the galaxy.
civic_warp_capable_desc: This society has achieved warp flight, but is focused on life on its own homeworld, with little interest in expanding out amongst the stars.
civic_warrior_kahless_desc: 'Kahless left us, all of us, a powerful legacy. A way of thinking and acting that makes us Klingon.' - Emperor Kahless (Clone)
civic_way_of_the_gun_desc: The Way of the Gun is an old western term meaning that the person with the gun makes the law.
civic_xeno_vultures_desc: This society adds to their population by reanimating the deceased corpses of other species, altering their DNA to transform them into one of their own.
clone_army_desc: Vat-grown clones that reach adulthood in a matter of months. With a natural lifespan of less than a decade, their lack of personal initiative is deemed an acceptable trade-off for their total obedience to officers.
colony_harvest_2_desc: Harvest the planet's population and resources to create a new Borg vessel, the larger the colony the bigger ship that can be constructed from the ruins of the colony.
colony_ship_rushed_desc: Allows the construction of Private Colony Ships funded by unknown actors from the private sector. As a result the colonists may have ethics differing from the majority.
colony_trait_armed_contingency_desc: Armed defence units are carried onboard this colony ship, ready to defend their settled world.
colony_trait_hardy_pioneers_desc: Hardy Pioneers onboard this colony ship are ready to clear the way for colonists of hostile terrain blockers.
colony_trait_orbital_infrastructure_desc: This colony ship carries a small prefabricated starbase, ready for deployment in orbit around a newly colonised world.
colony_trait_prefabricated_structures_de: This colony ship carries cargo pods containing a prefabricated mine, power plant and farming equipment for rapid construction upon a settled world.
colony_trait_religious_mission_desc: This colony ship carries many missionaries, ready to spread the word of our culture to new worlds.
colony_trait_research_team_desc: This colony ship carries large amounts of researchers and scientific equipment, ready to construct laboratories upon interesting locations on a newly colonised world.
colony_trait_stasis_pods_desc: This colony ship carries many stasis pods, granting an extra unit of population on any world that it settles.
consumer_goods_desc: Supplies (£) is an advanced resource that represents the various infrastructure, luxuries and goods necessary to give military and £ Pops a good life and to perform intellectual £ Jobs such as Research.
consumer_goods_desc_cybernetic_imperativ: Nanites are microscopic robotic devices and a form of nanotechnology, and are small enough to enter living cells.
consumer_goods_desc_machine_intelligence: A chromodynamic power module derives its power from tripolymer plasma, and is used in the construction of artificial lifeforms.
consumer_goods_desc_psionic_consensus: The very foundation of Fluidic Space is made of Biomass and it controls all around it.
conversion_not_available_tooltip: We can only convert a single world at a time, and must have built an Infestation Chamber and Harvesting Centre.
council_agenda_agenda_adaption_protocol_: Hostile species detected, the collective must adapt to ensure its continued engagement of hostile lifeforms.
council_agenda_agenda_advance_the_fleet_: Invest heavily in Industry research to bolster the chance and speed of ship technology.
council_agenda_agenda_assimilation_drive: The collective must grow, species who oppose must be assimilated and made to service us.
council_agenda_agenda_focus_borg_assimil: Assimilation Target has been engaged, initial protocol to analyse their defenses and adapt our weapons to counter their shields.
council_agenda_agenda_oppose_the_androme: Studying these formidable threats will enable us to prepare our forces in anticipation of a potential confrontation.
council_agenda_agenda_oppose_the_borg_de: Studying these imposing threats will allow us to adapt our forces before a confrontation can arise.
council_agenda_agenda_oppose_the_undine_: Studying these imposing threats will allow us to adapt our forces before a confrontation can arise.
council_agenda_agenda_purge_the_weak_des: The weak must perish at the hands of our superior biology.
council_agenda_agenda_unlock_spy_slot_de: We should expand our government to support an additional councilor role for our intelligence agency.
council_agenda_agenda_unlock_spy_slot_na: Add a Slot for Intel Division
council_agenda_focus_borg_assimilation_e: Adapt our weapons to be more efficient against our targets defenses.
councilor_bajoran_kai_desc: The $TITLE$ is the religious leader of the Bajorans, elected from among and by the Vedek Assembly to a life term. Leader must have the Kai trait.
councilor_borg_defense_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the defense and assimilation directives across the Collective.
councilor_borg_done_desc: The $TITLE$ coordinates the drone activity within the hive mind.
councilor_borg_scientist_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the research directives across the Collective.
councilor_borg_unity: Primary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One
councilor_borg_unity_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the unity and disseminates the queens will throughout the collective.
councilor_borg_unity_female: Primary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One
councilor_chief_ambassador_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for working with the ambassadorial service to promote trust from other empires. Requires leader with the Ambassador Trait.
councilor_chief_medical_2_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the health and wellbeing of the population. Requires a leader with Consultant or CMO trait.
councilor_chief_medical_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the health and wellbeing of the population. Requires a leader with Consultant or CMO trait.
councilor_cloner_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for cloning operations.
councilor_ferengi_fca_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible with overseeing business practices and the enforcement of Ferengi Trade By-Laws.
councilor_high_priest_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the religious well-being of this empire. Must be a believer with a spiritualist ethic.
councilor_hirogen_hunter_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for hunts across Hirogen space, all new rules start and end with the Master of the Hunt.
councilor_klingon_brigadier_desc: A brigadier is a high ranking official who can handle the position of military advisor to the Chancellor, and can speak on behalf of the High Command.
councilor_master_genesist_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the advancement of Eugenics.
councilor_obsidian_order_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees all actions of the Obsidian Order. Requires the Obsidian Order trait
councilor_orion_syndicate_desc: The $TITLE$ is a position that doesn't officially exist, unofficially they coordinate syndicate activities within the Empire. The leader must have one of the Syndicate tags or be Corrupt.
councilor_ruler_borg_desc: I am the beginning, the end, the one who is many. I am the Borg.
councilor_ruler_dominion_desc: The drop becomes the ocean... The ocean becomes a drop.
councilor_ruler_klingon_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the Klingon Empire and the Great and Noble Klingon Houses.
councilor_starfleet_desc: Senior Member of Starfleet responsible for the operation of Starfleet. Requires Starfleet Admiral or Military Governor.
councilor_starfleet_s31_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees is the work of Section 31.
councilor_starfleet_security_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees all security actions involved in the protection of Starfleet. Requires a leader with either the section 31 or security agents/officer trait.
councilor_tal_shiar_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees all Tal Shiar Operations on behalf of the Empire. Requires the Tal Shiar or Zhat Vash trait.
councilor_temporal_scientist_desc: The individual holding $TITLE$ role is responsible for the advancement of Temporal studies within the Empire.
councilor_war_desc: The $TITLE$ is in charge of military administration and all matters of war.
counter_espionage_1_desc: Minimal security checks on our populace.
counter_espionage_2_desc: Moderate security checks on our populace, balancing disrupting lives with internal security.
counter_espionage_3_desc: Maximum security checks on our populace, offering the most protection but also disrupting lives.
cpt_freeman_background: Captain Carol Freeman was a female Human Starfleet officer who lived during the 2380s, and served as the commanding officer of the USS Cerritos, which specialized in second contact missions.
cpt_freeman_catch_phrase: Our ship might not be the biggest, and we might do the missions nobody else wants, but we are still Starfleet.
crisobj_crisobj_assimilate_planet_desc: Bring a new planet into the collective and one step closer to perfection.
crisobj_perform_upsetting_operations_des: Spreading fluidic space to make the galaxy more pure.
crisobj_spread_fluidic_space_desc: We must purge the galaxy of the impurities and spread our domain into this dimension.
crossbreeding_allowed_desc: No restrictions imposed by the government on breeding rights.
crossbreeding_not_allowed_desc: Different species may not breed with each other, preventing the creation of half-species.
crystal_caverns_desc:
This asteroid is home to extensive and uniquely beautiful crystalline structures. Conveniently a Ferengi has set up an inn and tourist shop at the entrence.
Holoimagers not allowed.
curator_government_desc: An ancient scholarly order dedicated towards the preservation of knowledge and technology.
d_acamar_molnar_desc: One of the largest cities on Acamar, Molnar city is known for its many villages and is home to the Lornak clan.
d_admonition_site_desc: A site known only to those who swear loyalty to the mysterious Zhat Vash, its mere presence is enough to ward most from approaching.
d_altamid_ancient_mining_equipment_desc: This mining facility appears ancient, yet highly efficient. Numerous drone bays and unique adaptation pods beyond common understanding are here, allowing for extremely high mineral production.
d_andoria_eastern_archipelago_desc: Dormant volcanoes dot this archipelago, a remnant of a more seismically active time.
d_andoria_harbortown_desc: Harbortown is the oldest continuously settled city on Andor and the third most populous. The city is situated on the island of Cheshras, between the Moss and Frost rivers. Harbortown began as a collection of small fishing villages in the largest natural harbor on the satellite, eventually merging to form the modern city.
d_andoria_laikan_desc: Laikan, the capital city of Andoria, is located on the Zhevra continent in the more temperate latitudes of Andor. Temperatures during the summer months average a few degrees above zero.
d_andoria_lortan_desc: Lor'Tan is the largest city on the planet Andoria and serves as the center for the Andorian cultural, economic, and political life.
d_andoria_northern_wastes_desc: The hidden, underground Aenar compound has been located. Its discovery reunited the Aenar with the rest of the Andorian people.
d_andoria_unexplored_wastes_desc: The vast desolate northern wastes are inhospitable, even to the hardiest Andorians.
d_andoria_vezhdar_plain_desc: The Vezhdar Plain is a large, featureless geographical area on Andor.
