ring_world_ruined_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_DELA: The ruined shell of a massive ring like structure, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
ring_world_ruined_DESC: The ruined shell of a massive ring like structure, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
rios_background: Rios was born in Chile on Earth. His mother taught at Starfleet Academy. When he was about eight years old, Rios snuck into a flight simulator there and scored higher than any cadet in history.
rios_catch_phrase: No. I'm from Chile. I just… I work in outer space.
robotic_army_desc: Robotic armies that can act autonomously to defeat enemies.
rok_tahk_backstory: More than just the Monster that many thought she was, Rok has a brilliant scientific mind and a fiercely loyal friend and member of the Protostar's crew.
rolaren_background: A survivor of the Cardassian occupation of Bajor, Ro had a tumultuous career within Starfleet.
romulan_vassal_1_desc: The Star Empire provides added security and stability for its vassals.
romulan_vassal_1_muster_desc: As a reward for the continued protection of the Star Empire and the synergies of the two fleets both sides gain larger fleet capacity and additional crew.
romulan_vassal_2_desc: The added security and stability provided by the Star Empire increases as the relationship deepens.
romulan_vassal_2_muster_desc: The synergies of the ever closening relationship between the parties manifests in further increased naval capacity and additional crew.
romulan_vassal_2_ship_build_desc: With the added support of its vassal the Star Empire is able to sustain more starbases.
romulan_vassal_2_tax_desc: As the Star Empire provides so many benefits for its vassals a small contribution of resources is expected in return.
romulan_vassal_3_desc: Thanks to the great contributions of the Star Empire the security and stability is reaching new highs.
romulan_vassal_3_muster_desc: The crew and fleet support functions of the Star Empire and its vassal have achieved seamless co-operation allowing the naval capacity and crew reserves of both to grow.
romulan_vassal_3_ship_build_desc: With the added support of its vassal the Star Empire is able to sustain even more starbases.
romulan_vassal_3_tax_desc: With all the benefits working with the Star Empire provides, surely a small added resource contribution isn't too high a price.
romulan_zhat_vash.tooltip: Embracing the Zhat Vash will open up specific story lines and gameplay features unique to this faction. A new edict will be available that, when activated, will empower the Zhat Vash to act against the rise of synthetic life. As a result of the edict, the Romulan Star Empire will be severely restricted in its use of AI technology.
romulan_zhat_vash_reject.tooltip: Rejecting the Zhat Vash will limit the Zhat Vash-related side missions and flavour from this playthrough. Major storylines may still occur but will be limited.
rules_of_acquisition_activate: Seek guidance within the Rules of Acquisition.
sarek_background: The son of Skon, Sarek was born in 2165 on Vulcan and became a renowned Federation Ambassador and diplomat.
saru_background: Born on Kaminar under the Watchful Eye, Saru was the first Kelpien to have voluntarily left his homeworld, and the first of his species to enter Starfleet service.
saurian_trophy_activate: Celebrate Earth's Victory with extra unity and influence income.
sc_blue_star_cluster_desc: A stellar cluster, stellar group, or star cluster was a group of stars held together by gravity. The cluster of stars is ripe for exploring with an expedition.
sc_collapsar_desc: M-Type Deep Space Anomalies refer to a highly intensive Quasar-like electromagnetic phenomenon. Typical Quasars that send bursts of X-ray matter. In this case, the radiation is so intensive that it causes ionization of the stellar dust of entire astronomical regions - a phenomena called the Murasaki Effect.
sc_d_desc: These are evolved stars of low luminosity, usually referred to as white dwarfs. They are compact stars with large masses at incredibly small sizes, which gives rise to very high density.
sc_deep_space_desc: The vast interstellar distance between quadrants and gaps within the great arms of the Milky Way Galaxy, where distance is measured in light years.
sc_fluidic_desc: Fluidic space is an extra-dimensional realm that is filled with an organic liquid medium rather than the open space of the Milky Way galaxy's dimension. Only accessible from the regular universe via quantum singularities.
sc_green_star_cluster_desc: A stellar cluster, stellar group, or star cluster was a group of stars held together by gravity. The cluster of stars is ripe for exploring with an expedition.
sc_open_space_desc: Sometimes space is vast and open and filled with nothing.
sc_p_green_desc: Interstellar Dust Clouds, or nebulae, are a rather common astronomical object. They often form from the the shells of red giants and supergiants, as well as stellar nurseries and supernovas, and consist of dust, hydrogen, helium and other ionized gases. A nebula is a considered a rather fast-moving phenomenon according to astronomical standards, lasting only up to a few million years. However, some of them can stretch across hundreds of light years.
sc_p_purple_desc: P-Type Deep Space Anomalies are a region of space that can contain dangerous space matter, such as Metreon gas pockets, as well as the remains of supernovae, false vacuum fluctuations and metaphasic radiation. Travelling through such regions can cause severe damage to numerous ship systems, and is highly advised to avoid it at all costs.
sc_p_red_desc: B-Type Deep Space Anomalies a wide category of space regions that are considered highly volatile, often for yet unexplained reasons. They contain intense plasma storms and gravitational anomalies and are a significant hazard to navigation. However, these regions still contain areas of relative stability and are often large enough to house a few stars and planets.
sc_protostar_desc: Stellar nurseries, often found in the heart of dense star clusters, are highly condensed pockets of interstellar matter that are in the process of forming into new protostars. Those are stars at the final stage of their formation, just before the ignition of the thermonuclear reactions in the nucleus. After the ignition, the outward pressure from the released energy finds an equilibrium with the inward pressure from the gravitational pull of the newly formed star's mass. The protostar then officially becomes a main-sequence star.
sc_purple_star_cluster_desc: A stellar cluster, stellar group, or star cluster was a group of stars held together by gravity. The cluster of stars is ripe for exploring with an expedition.
sc_red_star_cluster_desc: A stellar cluster, stellar group, or star cluster was a group of stars held together by gravity. The cluster of stars is ripe for exploring with an expedition.
sc_space_anomaly_desc: This area of space contains a dangerous anomaly that is best avoided.
sc_void_desc: An area of space absent of any matter, and in which a number of other starships have been trapped going back hundreds of thousands of years.
science_starbase_cooldown: You must wait for a set amount of time before building a new station.
scotty_background: Captain Montgomery Scott, often referred to as 'Scotty' by his shipmates, was a male Human Starfleet officer who many considered the finest engineer of his generation.
scotty_catch_phrase: I can't change the laws of physics!
sela_background: The half-Human, half-Romulan commander in the Imperial Navy was an extremely important figure in the Empire's covert attempts to destabilize both the Federation and the Klingon Empire.
selective_desc:
We only target identified military sites, taking care to avoid needless civilian casualties.
- Moderate damage to Armies
- Light damage to Buildings
- Light damage to Pops
- Will NOT bombard undefended planets
- Will NOT kill the last 10 Pops
seven_backstory: As a young girl Annika Hanson was captured and assimilated by the Borg, following her liberation she has become a strong-willed and brilliant individual.
sh_defiant_desc: The crew of the tough but small USS Defiant.
sh_under_assimilation_1_desc: Borg drones detected onboard this ship and are attempting to assimilate this vessel
short_range_desc: This ship is set up to fight in close combat scenarios.
shran_background: Thy'lek Shran was an Andorian commander in the Imperial Guard in the 2150s. Despite a rocky start with humanity, he became one of its greatest supporters and allies.
shran_catch_phrase: And tell Archer, we're not even anymore. He owes me!
singing_doctor_activate: Sing us a song, hologram. Sing us a song tonight.
situation_bajoran_occupation_complete_to: The situation on Bajor has reached a point where the status quo can no longer remain in place.
situation_bajoran_occupation_desc_bajora: Our home has been occupied by the Cardassian's, marking the start of a brutal occupation by the Cardassian Military, which fundamentally changed the way of life for every Bajoran. Our bid for freedom will either result in a Bajor that stands on its own or becomes a new footnote in this history of the Cardassian Empire.
situation_bajoran_occupation_desc_cardas: The world of Bajor can provide the Union with everything it needs to thrive and our commitment to helping the backwater Bajoran primitives only further demonstrates the generosity of the Cardassian people.
situation_bajoran_occupation_monthly_cha: The situation on Bajor continues to evolve.
situation_borg_assimilation_desc: The assimilation of other species into our collective, as a result we are bringing them closer to perfection.
situation_borg_assimilation_monthly_chan: This Situation will continue to bring other species closer to the perfection of the Borg.
situation_borg_assimilation_outcome: The process of Assimilation will continue uninterrupted as long as there are pops who need adding to the collective.
situation_borg_deassimilation_desc: Active Borg Drones have been detected, a taskforce has been set up to deal with the situation by eliminating or freeing the drones from the Collective.
situation_borg_deassimilation_monthly_ch: This Situation will continue to remove the Borg presence.
situation_borg_deassimilation_outcome_to: All Assimilated pops within our empire will be handled.
situation_cardassian_federation_border_d: The Federations expansion into our border territory region has gone on for far too long. They poach worlds that should belong to the Cardassian people and their colonists flaunt our borders. This situation is heading for war.
situation_cu_ufp_bad: Our decreasing relations with our enemy is escalating the situation.
situation_cu_ufp_calm_tt: The diplomats are attempting to defuse the situation.
situation_cu_ufp_diplomatic: Our diplomatic stance is helping to diffuse the ongoing tension.
situation_cu_ufp_envoy_bad: Our envoys attempts to escalate the situation bring us closer to war.
situation_cu_ufp_envoy_good: Our envoys attempts to improve the situation is helping.
situation_cu_ufp_escalate_tt: The situation is being artificially escalated.
situation_cu_ufp_expansion: Our need to expand is raising tensions along the border.
situation_cu_ufp_friendly: Our improving relations with our enemy is diffusing the situation.
situation_cu_ufp_hostile: Our hostile stance is escalating the ongoing tension.
situation_cu_ufp_neutral: Our neutral relations with our enemy is diffusing the situation.
situation_cu_ufp_obsidian_tt: The Obsidian Order are manipulating the situation.
situation_cu_ufp_ongoing_event_tt: An ongoing situation could determine the outcome of this conflict.
situation_cu_ufp_peace_tooltip: A peaceful outcome is now possible!
situation_disease_desc: Our medical division has reported an outbreak of [This.GetPlagueName] on [Target.GetName] putting the lives and security of the colonists at risk.
situation_disease_monthly_change_tooltip: This Situation will improve or deteriorate towards completion at a rate based on our selected Approach, and various other factors.
situation_dominion_peace_tooltip: A peaceful co-existence washes over the Alpha and Gamma Quadrants.
situation_dominion_war_1_desc: The discovery of the Bajoran Wormhole linking the Alpha and Gamma Quadrants opens up untold potentials, adventures and ... risks.
situation_dominion_war_active: Promote Travel to the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_active_desc: The regular traffic through the wormhole appears to be gathering attention.
situation_dominion_war_active_tooltip: Actively an loudly promote travel via the Wormhole to experience a whole new quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_ban: Limit Travel to the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_ban_desc: With limited traffic going through the Wormhole, fewer eyes are upon us.
situation_dominion_war_ban_tooltip: Limit civilian traffic and operations through the wormhole, less likely to provoke, but may not make your population too happy.
situation_dominion_war_colony: The presence of a colony in the Gamma Quadrant is causing fricton.
situation_dominion_war_ds9: The location of the large military station, DS9, so close to the wormhole has not gone unnoticed.
situation_dominion_war_envoy_bad: Our envoys are working hard to harm relations with the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_envoy_good: Our envoys are working hard to build relations with the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_expansion: Our expansionist policies are driving civilian traffic through to explore the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_monthly_change_to: The situation in the Gamma Quadrant advances.
situation_dominion_war_open_desc: Open travel to the Gamma Quadrant is drawing the attention of some major players.
situation_dominion_war_open_tooltip: Do not interfere with traffic flowing between the Alpha and Gamma Quadrants.
situation_dominion_war_relations_bad: Bad relations within the Gamma Quadrant are damaging the situation.
situation_dominion_war_relations_good: Good relations within the Gamma Quadrant are building bridges.
situation_dominion_war_stage_1: Peaceful exploration of the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_stage_1_effects: The excitement of discovering a new route to the Gamma Quadrant is filling the quadrant with a sense of excitement.
situation_dominion_war_stage_2: Our presence in the Gamma Quadrant has been noted.
situation_dominion_war_stage_2_effects: We are starting to draw the attention of the native species of the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_dominion_war_stage_3_effects: It seems clear hostile factions are starting to act against us.
situation_dominion_war_stage_4_effects: The situation within the Gamma Quadrant is buildng.
situation_dominion_war_stage_5_effects: It seems clear that this path of action will lead to war.
situation_dominion_war_tooltip: An uncertain fate awaits the two Quadrants.
situation_expedition_1_complete_tooltip: The expedition is complete and the fleet returns back to the capital system.
situation_expedition_1_desc: A new 3-year mission awaits the Captain and Crew of this fine ship, engaging on a continuing mission of exploration into the unknown.
situation_expedition_1_fail_tooltip: The expedition ends in failure and the ship and crew return home.

situation_expedition_approach_recall_too: Bring the expedition to an early end and recall the ship and crew back to your homeworld.
situation_expedition_gamma_1_desc: Travel beyond the Wormhole into the far reaches of the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_expedition_gamma_2_desc: Travel beyond the Wormhole into the far reaches of the Gamma Quadrant.
situation_expedition_gamma_3_desc: Travel beyond the Wormhole into the far reaches of the Gamma Quadrant.

situation_expedition_lembatta_approach_m: The Expedition will progress with a focus on Military applications.
situation_expedition_lembatta_approach_n: The Expedition will progress with no particular bias.

situation_expedition_lembatta_complete_t: The Expedition to the Cluster has been completed and full access to the Star Cluster is granted.

situation_expedition_lembatta_progress_s: Number of Ships on the Expedition Mult.
situation_expedition_star_cluster_lembat: The Lembatta Cluster offers a new frontier to explore amongst the Red Giant Stars.
situation_federation_cardassian_border_a: Send our diplomatic teams to talk in a bid for peace.
Send our diplomatic teams to talk in a bid to force a war.
We shall see how the situation pans out without additional input from our diplomats.
Engage our secret service in a bid to sabotage our rivals preparation, but speed up the road to war.
situation_federation_cardassian_border_d: Tensions along our border with the Cardassian Union continue to escalate, with the Unions opinion of us now at an all-time low, many within the Federation Council fear for the safety of our civilians living along the border.
situation_federation_cardassian_border_s: Despite the tense situation, it looks like a peaceful scenario will be reached.
The situation along the border is calming down.
Tensions along the border have reached the point where a situation has developed.
The situation along the border is become severe.
War could break out at any moment.
situation_federation_membership_2_desc: The ISU is a supranational interstellar union of multiple planetary constituent political entities under a single central government, and joining such an organisation is a monumental undertaking for any potential Member state, the process is long, but the potential rewards are often seen as worth it.
situation_federation_membership_desc: The United Federation of Planets is a supranational interstellar union of multiple planetary constituent political entities under a single central government, and joining such an organisation is a monumental undertaking for any potential Member state, the process is long, but worth it.
situation_federation_membership_monthly_: The Target moves closer to becoming a Member of the UFP.
situation_ketracel_deficit_desc: Our Ketracel White supply is critically low $situation_deficit_desc_base$.
situation_ketracel_deficit_monthly_chang:
The larger our shortage in Ketracel White, the faster this Situation will escalate in severity.
Having a positive monthly resource balance will rapidly reduce this Situation's severity.
situation_prodigy_approach_home_tooltip: They resolve to set a course for Starfleet, but the Diviner is hot on their trails. Their journey takes them on a wild adventure where they encounter strange new life and civilizations, learn about Starfleet's ideals, and hope to find a better future for themselves on the far side of the galaxy.
situation_prodigy_complete_tooltip: The USS Protostar and her crew reach Federation space.
situation_prodigy_desc: A motley crew of young foreigners who must figure out how to work together while navigating a greater galaxy, in search for a better future.
situation_prodigy_fail_tooltip: Protostar and her crew are lost forever.
situation_prodigy_monthly_change_tooltip: Journey that much closer to home.
situation_redemption_1_approach_normal_t: Continue the Klingon Civil War Story Arc.
situation_redemption_1_complete_tooltip: The Rite of Succession comes to a conclusion, what will be the state of the Empire?
situation_redemption_1_desc_01: The Klingon Empire stands on the cusp of a Civil War, the previous Chancellor has died, but before they passed hints of an unknown danger within the Empire was revealed. Our two Empires must navigate these troubled times and avoid a civil war that could threaten all.
situation_redemption_1_desc_02: Our great Empire stands on the precipice of a Civil War, our Chancellor lies dead, and whilst the Kos'Karii circle, the fate of the Empire lies between the two leading contenders... Gowron and Duras.
situation_redemption_1_fail_tooltip: The Klingon Civil War has been resolved.
situation_redemption_1_stage_1_tooltips: The Chancellor explains the current Situation.
situation_redemption_1_stage_2_tooltips: The challenge from Duras and Gowron.
situation_redemption_1_stage_3_tooltips: The situation advances towards a conclusion.
situation_redemption_1_stage_4_tooltips: The situation advances towards a conclusion.
situation_redemption_1_stage_5_tooltips: The situation advances towards a conclusion.
situation_romulan_supernova_desc: The Romulan primary star is showing unusual behaviour with our scientists believing the star is about to go Supernova! We must act now to protect our Empire.
situation_romulan_supernova_evac_tt: Accept that our Star's life is coming to an end and attempt to get as many people away from Romulus as possible.
situation_romulan_supernova_monthly_chan: The situation with the Romulan Star progresses.
situation_romulan_supernova_none_tt: No special action will be taken.
situation_romulan_supernova_science_tt: Invest time and efforts into looking into scientific ways to delay the destabilisation of the star, rather than evacuating or preparing our population.
situation_romulan_supernova_tooltip: The Romulan Supernova event comes to it's dramatic conclusion.
situation_star_cluster_approach_five_yea: Begin the event chain which allow for a new Multi-Year mission to this cluster.
situation_terra_prime_reunification_desc: The Battle between Mars and Earth have concluded, leaving the painstaking job of bringing the supporters of Terra Prime back into the fold.
situation_voyager: The journey of the lost Voyager
situation_voyager_approach_home_tooltip: Hide your Tuvix, brace for Borg, mind the threshold and head for home, for there is coffee in those nebulas!
situation_voyager_complete_tooltip: Voyager and her crew return home safely.
situation_voyager_desc: Lost 70,000 light years from home with a return journey of 75 years, the USS Voyager is presumed lost with all hands. However on the far side of the galaxy their adventure is just beginning.
situation_voyager_fail_tooltip: Voyager and her crew are lost forever.
situation_voyager_monthly_change_tooltip: Get a little bit closer to home.
situation_warpcapable_federation_members: The United Federation of Planets is a supranational interstellar union of multiple planetary constituent political entities under a single central government, and joining such an organisation is a monumental undertaking for any potential Member state, the process is long, but worth it.
The Target moves closer to becoming a Member of the UFP.
situation_warpcapable_generic_membership: The Target moves closer to becoming a Member of our alliance.
skirmisher_desc: The Ship is equipped to handle mid-range skirmish assaults.
skirmisher_mid_range_default_behavior_de: The ship will stay at median weapon range and circle the enemy, preferring to focus on causing damage to heavy ships.
slave_army_desc: Slave soldiers who serve their masters on the battlefield. Most are conscripted by force, but many slaves volunteer in a desperate attempt to increase their food rations or escape from grueling labor.
slavery_reman_tooltip: Remans make excellent physical workers mining dilithium, minerals and alloys and are great soldiers in our Armies.
slavery_reman_tooltip_delayed: Remans are distasteful aspect of our society, but they serve a purpose to help the Empire grow strong, placing them undergrown digging in the dirt produces great results or better yet fodder for our armies.
sm_alloy_refinery_desc: This facility gathers raw resources present within the system and converts them to their purified form for distribution within the empire.
sm_anchorage_desc: Starfaring vessels require a substantial investment to create, but also an ever increasing investment to maintain. Large logistical locations where fuel, life support and maintenance supplies can be provided to nearby ships are a vital part of sustaining a large space fleet.
sm_art_college_desc: Storage and preservation of items important to our cultural heritage has a high priority, and an orbital museum designed for this purpose is the ideal focal point.
sm_black_hole_observatory_desc: A specialised observatory designed to analyse and record the unique astronomical characteristics of a black hole.
sm_black_hole_observatory_fed_desc: The rare opportunities to study a Black Hole have been few and far between, up until now. Named after Stephen Hawking, the man who tried to understand every single concept of the universe and the one who discovered the so called Hawking radiation, the creation of an observatory around a station orbiting a black hole will allow for unique physics research opportunities to take place.
sm_borg_command_center_desc: Powered by the station's energy core, the system vinculum provides a substantial amount of command and control to nearby vessels.
sm_borg_matter_converter_desc: Large amounts of energy can be used to synthesise raw materials.
sm_borg_reactor_desc: Massive fission reactors provide power to the Collective.
sm_command_center_desc: The main command hub for this system allows for the command and control over all vessels in the vicinity, which drastically improves the weapon performance of all friendly ships in range
sm_communications_jammer_desc: Large ECM jammers can spread havoc and confusion across local space, making targeting more difficult for enemy vessels.
sm_communications_jammer_gorn_desc: Large ECM jammers can spread havoc and confusion across local space, making perfect targets for Gorn ambush fighters.
sm_crew_quarters_desc: Crew quarters aboard this station allow for the rest and recreation for the crew of docked starships. This reduces the maintenance of docked vessels.
sm_curator_think_tank_desc: This orbital institution houses the absolute best our interstellar society has to offer. Here the greatest minds gather to bolster our research and development capabilities with new ideas.
sm_deep_space_black_site_desc: This station, situated far from home, is the foundation of our hold on this part of space. It will take the dedicated work of our staff to maximise that impact. Building a colonial bureau will ensure the success of that effort.
sm_defense_grid_desc: Linking the control and targeting systems of all our platforms into a grid allows for drastic improvements to performance.
sm_detection_array_1_desc: A gravitic sensor net is a type of sensor grid employed by border outposts to detect cloaked ships.
sm_detection_array_2_desc: A tachyon detection grid is a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked vessels. The grid uses active tachyon beams transmitted between different points to pinpoint a cloaked ship.
sm_detection_array_borg_desc: A tachyon detection grid is a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked vessels. The grid uses active tachyon beams transmitted between different points to pinpoint a cloaked ship.
sm_detection_array_module_desc: High-powered scanning devices capable of picking up faint traces of cloaked ships. Can be augmented with additional technology to improve performance.
sm_detection_array_undine_desc: Uses advanced waves to scan space to detect for ships using cloaking devices.
sm_disruption_field_desc: These devices can leech energy from nearby enemy vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.
sm_facility_armor_plating_desc: Charged armour plates provide a substantial boost to the armour of the starbase.
sm_facility_buoys_desc: Navigational buoys mark out the safest route for civilian freighters, as well as act as a sensor net, which helps traffic to avoid potential hazards and pirate ambush points.
sm_facility_contractors_desc: Capable of handling their own affairs, private contractors are often hired for security by freighters.
sm_facility_drydock_desc: Large docking facilities where shipwide repairs can be undertaken in a breathable environment.
sm_facility_holosuite_desc: Large holosuites offer entertainment for large amounts of visitors to the orbital station.
sm_facility_hospital_desc: These infirmaries provide the basic medical needs of a space station. They will ease the rigours of life in space and provide emergency treatment to any member of the crew who requires it.
sm_facility_hotel_desc: A large orbital facility designed to cater for the requirements of the most discerning galactic citizens.
sm_facility_hull_integrity_II_desc: Improved power output from a more refined generator and power system for the structural integrity provides a significant improvement to the hull integrity at the cost of additional power.
sm_facility_hull_integrity_desc: The creation of a separate generator and power system for the structural integrity field allows for a massive increase in the structural integrity of the starbase.
sm_facility_market_desc: Not bound by a gravity well, this marketplace is free of many duties and taxes. Many traders pass through this market offering discounts on their goods.
sm_facility_mine_1_desc: Nuclear detonation devices are laid out throughout nearby space providing a hazard for enemy vessels.
sm_facility_mine_2_desc: Equipped with replication units able to create copies of themselves, the self replicating mine field provides a healthy deterrent to enemy vessels.
sm_facility_prison_desc: By designating an area of this station an interstellar penal colony, we can increase the stability of the system by ridding it of the miscreants, at the expense of those unfortunate enough to be housed here.
sm_facility_resturant_desc: The culinary delights on offer at this deluxe restaurant are renowned throughout the galaxy, attracting migrants from other worlds.
sm_facility_shield_II_desc: Engineers have successfully improved the power output on the Starbases shields, nearly doubling their effectiveness during combat situations.
sm_facility_shield_desc: The energy requirements for shielding a large structure are far beyond a normal starship. The size of a station central shield generator means that it is fixed in place, but at the same time provides a vastly stronger shield than can be found on any starship.
sm_facility_tractor_desc: Large mounted tractor beams can lock on and target enemy vessels, slowing them down and making them easier targets.
sm_facility_traffic_control_desc: Powerful navigational arrays allow for accurate and controlled navigation at sublight speeds across a star system.
sm_facility_training_holosuite_desc: We can use expansive holographic technology to create multiple challengers of all kinds, skill levels, and dangers even without risking living beings.
sm_facility_weaver_desc: Carefully laid out web-producing drones can create a vast solar system wide web to slow down approaching vessels.
sm_federal_yards_desc: The Federal Shipyards are one of the finest construction sites in the Federation, designed for creating experimental vessels which perform beyond the regular specification of Starfleet.
sm_fleet_academy_desc: With the advent of advanced pedagogic systems and theories, a new generation of naval students are born. A higher level of education amongst our fleet cadets will improve the overall experience of our fleets.
sm_fransisco_yards_desc: San Francisco Shipyards is Earth's finest construction site, designed for creating experimental vessels which perform beyond the regular specification of Starfleet.
sm_ftl_inhibitor_desc: While the starbase is still operational, its warp inhibitor prevents enemy ships from leaving the system unless retreating to the system they warped in from.
sm_great_plume_observatory_desc: The unique opportunity to capture and study the neutron blast emitting from a star allows for unique research experiments to be undertaken.
sm_gun_battery_desc: Large arrays of defensive cannons stand ready to defend this location against any threat.
sm_hangar_bay_car_desc: Cardassian hangar bays provide a launch platform for fighter craft in this system.
sm_hangar_bay_desc: Hangar bays contain the munitions, fuel and maintenance systems for fighters in this system.
sm_hangar_bay_dom_desc: Dominion launch bays provide a launch platform for fighter craft in this system.
sm_hangar_bay_fed_desc: Federation Shuttle Bays provide a launch platform for shuttle and fighter craft in this system.
sm_hangar_bay_kdf_desc: Klingon Raider launch bays provide the munitions and fuel for fighter craft in this system.
sm_hangar_bay_rom_desc: Romulan hangar bays provide a launch platform for fighter craft in this system.
sm_hydroponics_bay_brunali_desc: These hydroponic bays allow us to grow food on our stations and thereby shedding our reliance on imported food from terrestrial sources. Plants are grown without soil by using mineral nutrient solutions in a water solvent.
sm_hydroponics_bay_desc: These hydroponic bays allow us to grow food on our stations and thereby shedding our reliance on imported food from terrestrial sources. Plants are grown without soil by using mineral nutrient solutions in a water solvent.
sm_imperial_yards_desc: The most advanced, powerful and fearsome warships capable of surpassing even the highest expectations of the Imperial Starfleet Command are assembled at the Imperial Shipyards.
sm_infestation_spawner_desc: A specialy adapted module that produces the genetic code used to create the infesters with the power to transform worlds.
sm_kessok_solar_battery_desc: By utilising specialised batteries our Kessok Solar Panel Networks are now 25% more effecient.
sm_kessok_solar_panel_network_desc: A superior network of solar panels crafted from years of experience.
sm_listening_post_desc: A listening post is a facility for monitoring communications and territory between spacefaring civilizations.
sm_missile_battery_desc: Volleys of torpedos stand ready to be fired at any threats near this location.
sm_module_armor_desc: Heavy armour plating is outfitted to the hull of the starbase, providing a large increase to structural integrity.
sm_module_shield_borg_desc: The energy requirements for sheathing a large structure are far beyond simple vessels. The size of the generator means that it is fixed in place, but at the same time provides a vastly stronger adaptive field than can be found on any Borg vessel.
sm_module_shield_undine_desc: The Bio power plants have been discovered to produce excess energy, which can be redirected to the exterior of the hull creating a field which protects the starbase.
sm_naval_logistics_office_desc: Maintaining a large fleet requires logistics. Stores of goods, distributed throughout the realm, are indispensable to the function of a sovereign navy.
sm_nebula_refinery_desc: The facilities to gather and refine the particle matter and gases from a surrounding nebula can be installed on the station, enabling mineral production.
sm_offworld_trading_company_desc:
The promenade is the trading heart of this installation. It houses our businesses, food vendors, cultural hotspots and entertainment venues. A well maintained promenade ensures the pace of life for everyone living or visiting here is both dynamic and productive.

The Promenade is an upgrade to the Trade Depot. It adds 8 £ Trade Value by default and another 4 £ Trade Value if there are at least 3 Trade Depots.
sm_ore_processing_desc: Utilising slave labour to process ore and raw materials present in the system to produce refined minerals and resources that can be distributed.
sm_ore_refinery_desc: The processing of dilithium can be achieved in orbit in order to make the pollution on the planet negligible.
sm_primitive_observatory_desc: A large orbital Xeno-Anthropologic centre, designed to study alien life and understand the various familial and xenological differences of primitive alien cultures.
sm_recruitment_office_starfleet_desc: Ad Astra Per Aspera! Starfleet recruitment teams looks to bring in the best and brightest from across the galaxy to join Starfleet.
sm_resource_silo_desc: Large arrays of energy banks and mineral silos, designed to contain large amounts of energy and minerals in a cold, zero gravity environment.
sm_shipyard_desc: Shipyards are the construction backbone of our nation. They are zero gravity bays where vessels' keels are laid down.
sm_shipyard_undine_desc: Specially developed growing units capable of growing new vessels to join the Vanguard.
sm_shipyard_utopia_desc: The Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards is an important Starfleet starship construction and design facility named after the Utopia Planitia area on Mars in the Sol system.
sm_solar_panel_network_desc: A network of solar panelling is laid throughout the hull of this starbase, generating massive amounts of external £ energy.
sm_support_craft_desc: A dedicated facility to house a small assortment of support craft and fighters to defend the Starbase.
sm_target_uplink_computer_desc: A large central computer core controls this station's weapons and targeting, substantially increasing the range of its firepower.
sm_temporal_yards_desc: This shipyard is specially equipped with highly specialised facilities that allow the handling of the Chroniton waves that make up a temporal core. Thus allowing for the construction of a timeship.
sm_titan_yards_desc: Certain unique ship classes are especially large and outstrip the construction facilities found in even the largest of starbases. This facility includes specialized tools, various tractor beams and fabricators, that allow for the construction of such ships well outside of the main hull of the starbase.
sm_trading_hub2_desc: Docking platforms and freight cranes allow for civilian freighters to trade here, providing much needed wealth to the system.
sm_trading_hub_desc: Docking platforms and freight cranes allow for civilian freighters to trade here, providing much needed wealth to the system.
sm_warp_fluctuator_desc: Neutralising warp fields within local space requires massive amounts of power and a specialised facility on board the station. Disruptions to warp bubbles enable enemy fleets to be pulled from warp within range of the station, allowing local defence forces time to engage their opponents before they can escape.
sniper_desc: This ship is set up to fight at long-range.
soval_background: Soval was the Vulcan ambassador to Earth from the 2120s to the 2150s before becoming a key member of the fledgling United Federation of Planets.
space_building_arcology_1_desc:
Housing Project

A Habitation Dome is a structure that encloses a large urban area under a single roof. The dome is airtight and pressurised, creating a habitat that can be controlled for air temperature, composition and quality, typically due to an external atmosphere that is inimical to habitation for one or more reasons. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Project.
space_building_arcology_2_desc:
Housing Project

An Expanded Habitation Dome is a structure that encloses a large urban area in an airtight and pressurised environment. Expanded habitats' advanced bio-regulation technologies can effectively control air temperature, composition and quality, typically due to an external atmosphere that is inimical to habitation for one or more reasons. Its sophisticated facilities provide comfortable living standards for its inhabitants.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Project.
space_building_arcology_3_desc:
Housing Project

A Habitation Domes Complex is a structure that encloses an entire metropolis in an airtight and pressurised environment. Its sophisticated bio-regulation technologies can effectively control air temperature, composition and quality, typically due to an external atmosphere that is inimical to habitation for one or more reasons. It's highly-advanced facilities provide luxurious living standards for its inhabitants.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Housing Project.
space_building_basic_mine_desc:
Mining Network

A zero gravity bay for the mining and processing of minerals. The basic facilities involve small mining drones capable of bringing asteroids and other foreign bodies inside the bay to be broken down into minerals.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Mining Network.
space_building_generator_water_1_desc:
Manufacturing Building

Drawing ice water from deep under the planet's surface via large pumps provides a large source of ice water to the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_1_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

The hydroponics dome allows us to grow food on our stations, thereby shedding our reliance on imported food from terrestrial sources. Here, plants are grown without soil by using mineral nutrient solutions in a water solvent.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_2_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

By enhancing our hydroponics bays and improving the nutrient solutions in which the plants are grown, we can dramatically improve the crop yield.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_3_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

By enhancing our hydroponics bays with high-yielding vegetation, we can support a greater population number on our stations and thus expand our society.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_4_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

By enhancing our hydroponics bays with genetically enhanced vegetation suitable for a zero-gravity environment, we can support a greater population number on our stations and thus expand our society.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_military_camp_1_voth_desc:
Military Facility

Voth crew and soldiers are trained in this large military barracks complex onboard the City Ship.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
space_building_mining_network_1_desc:
Mining Network

Large advanced drones equipped with drill equipment can scan and separate mineral and ore rich asteroids into easily accessible resources, allowing for the refinement of raw materials into useable goods. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Mining Network.
space_building_mining_network_2_desc:
Mining Network

Large complexes allowing for the automated construction of boreholes via drones, deep into the core of mineral rich bodies, drawing rich ores to the surface for easy refinement.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Mining Network.
space_building_mining_network_3_desc:
Mining Network

Powerful particle impellers draw the rich ore and mineral material directly from under the surface, allowing it to be seperated and refined easily.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Mining Network.
space_building_ministry_production_1_des:
Manufacturing Building

The long term planning of large scale industrial production in deep space is achieved via the Production Centre.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
space_building_nursery_1_desc:
Population Assembly

A maturation chamber where the young and feeble amongst the species we encounter can be installed with implants that adapt the creatures perfectly to the hive mind.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_nursery_2_desc:
Population Assembly

Improvements to the nutrient mixtures and environmental controls in the Borg maturation chambers allow for the accelerated growth of adolescent drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_nursery_3_desc:
Population Assembly

Improvements to the maturation chambers allow for the accelerated growth of drones, via nutritional supplements fed intravenously to drones from infant ages through to adolescence and maturity.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_nursery_4_desc:
Population Assembly

The rapid growth of the new drones requires the creation of nurseries where new drones can be produced en masse. It is outfitted with ideal conditions that can ensure optimal growth for the new drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_planetary_shield_1_desc:
Military Facility

This system of armories and reinforced choke points connected by a network of self-powered turbolifts, allows for rapid redeployment of troops and advanced guerilla tactics.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
space_building_planetary_shield_1_voth_d:
Military Facility

A massive deflector array that projects a field around the hull of the Voth City Ship as it travels through space.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
space_building_planetary_shield_2_desc:
Military Facility

Large deflector arrays project a field across the surface of the station, providing structural integrity reinforcement and allowing force fields to cut off advances.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
space_building_planetary_shield_3_desc:
Military Facility

Automated turrets and automatic security forcefields are installed throughout the station, providing the defenders with a significant security advantage.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
space_building_queen_1_desc:
Unity Building

A central node which allows for the unified commands of the Collective to be processed and transmitted through it.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
space_building_queen_2_desc:
Unity Building

Numerous uplink nodes can meet in a network junction, where drones from all across an area can utilise shared network to ensure unified harmonisation across an area.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
space_building_queen_3_desc:
Unity Building

Controlling the vast amounts of drone voices within a structure, the system conflux offers a source of unified strength to all who are in proximity to it.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
space_building_queen_4_desc:
Unity Building

The central hub, directly linked to the central harmonisation processor, where all drones can experience the full extent of a collective mind is a great source of unified strength.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
space_building_temporal_1_desc:
Research Facility

A centre for communications that allows messages to be passed through time, allowing our scientists to gain glimpses of the future which aids in their research.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
space_building_undine_1_desc:
Unity Building

Amidst the vastness of space, a hive node stands as a testament to the power of collective thought. Within this epicenter, our individual thoughts harmonise, amplifying our strength and guiding our collective actions with unwavering precision.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
space_building_undine_2_desc:
Unity Building

A hive junction serves as a beacon of unity and purpose for our collective. Here, the hive mind's harmony resonates with amplified intensity, guiding our actions with renewed clarity. Our shared vision, crystallised through this junction, directs our strength towards a common goal, forging an unbreakable bond that echoes through the stars.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
space_building_undine_3_desc:
Unity Building

Representing the pinnacle of our unified power, a hive conflux is a cosmic symphony of minds. Within this grand structure, the collective consciousness soars, unleashing our full potential. It serves as a testament to the strength that arises from unity and the limitless possibilities that our hive-minded synergy unlocks.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
space_building_undine_4_desc:
Unity Building

A hive hub stands as the majestic grand nexus, where the very essence of our collective identity resonates with unwavering intensity. It is within this epicentre that our limitless strength and synergy converge, expanding the boundaries of what a unified force can achieve.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
spaceport_level_2_desc: Our starbases can now be upgraded to support 2 modules and with further research, finally allows for the construction of destroyers.
spaceport_level_3_desc: Our starbases can now be upgraded to support 3 modules and with further research, finally allows for the construction of cruisers.
spaceport_level_4_desc: Our starbases can now be upgraded to support 4 modules and with further research, finally allows for the construction of battlecruisers.
spaceport_level_5_desc: Our starbases can now be upgraded to support 5 modules and with further research, finally allows for the construction of battleships.
spaceport_level_6_desc: Our starbases can now be upgraded to support 6 modules and with further research, finally allows for the construction of sophisticated heavy escorts and assault cruisers.
spock_background: Born in ShiKahr, Vulcan Spock became one of the most distinguished and respected figures in the history of the United Federation of Planets.
spock_catch_phrase: The needs of the many, outweigh the needs of the few.
spy_orb_4_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_DELAYED: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
spy_orb_4_DESC: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
spy_orb_4_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
spy_orb_ruined_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_DELAYED: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
spy_orb_ruined_DESC: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
spy_orb_ruined_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
sr_boronite_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

An Omega molecule is a highly unstable molecule believed to be the most powerful substance known to exist. The molecule could be synthesized with sufficient amounts of boronite ore.

Omega Molecules can be produced by the Borg in Omega Facilities.
sr_brizeen_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Brizeen Nitrate is an extremely potent fertilizer that is used all over the galaxy. Just fifty tons of the material is enough to fertilize an entire continent.

This deposit can be collected from rare ground deposits, manufactured by intensive Soil Enrichment Centres, or imported via Starport.

Brizeen Nitrate is used to construct and support ground farms and agricultural districts.

All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_cordrazine_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Cordrazine is a powerful stimulant used to revive patients in an emergency. Overdoses cause hallucinations, madness and death.

This deposit must be produced from medicinal ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Cordrazine is used to construct and maintain advanced hospital structures. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_crew_cybernetic_imperative_desc: Drones operate vessels and their systems.
sr_crew_desc:
Trained crew are equipped to operate starships and their systems.

£ Trained Officers can be trained in Academies and Naval Headquarters.
sr_crew_desc_cybernetic_imperative:
Drones operate vessels and their systems efficiently.

£ Drones can be created in certain buildings.
sr_crew_desc_psionic_consensus:
Bioforms operate vessels and their systems efficiently.

£ Bioforms can be created in certain buildings.
sr_crew_psionic_consensus_desc: Undine Bioforms operate vessels and their systems.
sr_deuterium_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Deuterium is often used as fuel in matter-antimatter reactions aboard starships.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, manufactured by Neutron Enrichers, or imported via Starport.

Deuterium is used to construct and maintain industrial and commercial districts. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_dilithium_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Dilithium is the currency on which every modern space fleet runs. It is a vital resource for most warp civilisations as it controls the matter-antimatter reactors.

£ Dilithium can be mined from £ Dilithium deposits or found in orbital deposits, or manufactured synthetically.

Dilithium is used to construct and maintain warp engines on military and civilian ships.
sr_duranium_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Duranium plates are an extremely strong metallic substance that is used in alloys for hull construction of starships.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, purified in Duranium forges from alloy or imported via Starport.

Duranium is used to upgrade advanced starbases as well as construct starbase defensive platforms and large megastructures. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of the civilian economy.
sr_holographic_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Allows for the construction of Holographic resources on a planet.
sr_kemocite_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Kemocite is a multiphasic isotope of a radiolytic compound. It has many useful capabilities but in its purest form it can be used to create very potent torpedo weapons.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_ketracel_white_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Ketracel White, or simply White, is an addictive narcotic chemical compound containing an isogenic enzyme. One of its active ingredients is yridium bicantizine. Jem'Hadar soldiers of the Dominion are genetically engineered to lack the enzyme that White provides, meaning they require frequent doses of the drug to survive.
sr_latinum_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Latinum is a silver translucent liquid, used as a currency on many worlds. Since it can't be replicated and is extremely rare, it is considered very valuable.

1 £ Latinum is produced from every 20 £ trade value.
sr_luxuries_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Whilst consumer goods meet the requirements of a vast portion of the populace, luxuries are available only to a select few, whether it is down to quality, opulence or simply scarcity.

This deposit must be produced from rare ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Luxuries are required to construct and maintain education and administrative districts. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_magnesite_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Magnesite is a form of magnesium carbonate that is able to interfere with sensor and transporter functions. It can also be used for ship hull construction.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_new_horizons_desc:
Resource Category: Impossible

Dev Note: Will never appear in game, used as a dummy resource.
sr_pergium_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Pergium is an energy source that is used by over a thousand worlds all over the galaxy. It can produce a large amount of energy compared to other fuels and thus is mostly used in large scale terrestial reactors.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, found in rare £ Pergium ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Pergium is used in the construction of exotic reactor utilities on military ships, or the creation of clean and efficient terrestrial power sources.
sr_tallonian_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Tallonian crystals are a very rare type gemstone that, after processing, can be used as a focusing crystal inside the energy matrix of most energy weapons. Due to their volatile weaponised nature, trading the crystals is often banned by lesser species.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_time_crystal_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

A time crystal is a rare mineral with a non-equilibrium matter state, inherently unstable with an unpredictable decay rate. Exploiting the crystals is required for certain temporal technologies.

This deposit must be found in very rare ground deposits.

Time Crystals are required to construct exotic temporal weapons, components and armies.
sr_topaline_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Initial uses for the rare mineral Topaline consisted of usage in life support systems, but further studies of the mineral found that it has unique properties that improve the strength of a ship's shields.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_trellium_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Trellium-D is mostly used inside the Delphic Expanse to protect against dangerous anomalies. It should be noted, that Trellium-D has a strong influence on Vulcans, for which it acts like a drug when nearby and completely destroys their mental control.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, found in rare £ Trellium ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Trellium-D is used in the construction of exotic armor components.
sr_water_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Frozen into a solid state, water-ice is often found on arctic worlds.

This deposit must be mined from rare deposits on the surface of a world, from orbital deposits on icy planets, manufactured by Industrial Water Extractors or imported via Starport.

Water is used to construct and maintain hydroponic farms and city districts. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
stamets_background: Commander Paul Stamets was a male Human astromycologist and Starfleet officer who was pivotal in the invention of the SPORE drive.
starfleet_army_desc: Specially trained marines ready to be deployed to bolster any ground assault with a clinical tactical strike.
starfleet_history_museum_desc:
Amenity Building

A Starfleet facility that included a museum as part of the archives, it contains a quantum archive that contained a number of personal effects of active, deceased and retired Starfleet officers as well as galactic wonders collected across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
starting_ftl_hyperdrive_desc: Warp drive allows ships to bend space around them. Interstellar travel is fast but limited to existing paths along the hyperlane network.
statecraft_desc: The art of building a successful society.
sth_ambassador_class_desc: A tribute to the refitted Ambassador-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_ancient_romulan_colony_ship_blacklig: One of the eighteen ships that left Vulcan in the Sundering, the Blacklight was thought destroyed when 198 Eridani collapsed into a blackhole as the fleet journeyed to Romulus.
sth_ancient_romulan_colony_ship_bloodwin: One of the eighteen ships that left Vulcan in the Sundering, the Bloodwing was thought destroyed when 198 Eridani collapsed into a blackhole as the fleet journeyed to Romulus.
sth_ancient_romulan_colony_ship_forge_de: One of the eighteen ships that left Vulcan in the Sundering, the Forge was thought destroyed when 198 Eridani collapsed into a blackhole as the fleet journeyed to Romulus.
sth_ancient_romulan_colony_ship_lance_de: One of the eighteen ships that left Vulcan in the Sundering, the Lance was thought destroyed when 198 Eridani collapsed into a blackhole as the fleet journeyed to Romulus.
sth_ancient_romulan_colony_ship_pennon_d: One of the eighteen ships that left Vulcan in the Sundering, the Pennon was thought destroyed when 198 Eridani collapsed into a blackhole as the fleet journeyed to Romulus.
sth_ancient_romulan_colony_ship_starcatc: One of the eighteen ships that left Vulcan in the Sundering, the Starcatcher was thought destroyed when 198 Eridani collapsed into a blackhole as the fleet journeyed to Romulus.
sth_baku_collector_object_desc: Deployed by the Son'a to collect metaphasic radiation at the cost of all life on the planet below.
sth_botany_bay_desc: A DY-100-class sleeper ship built on Earth in the late 20th century.
sth_cali_class_desc: Loved by the lower decks a true workhorse of the fleet.
sth_caretaker_desc: The mysterious device that allowed trans-quadrant transportation.
sth_closure_gateway_0_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_: The Project must be deployed close to an active Gateway.
sth_closure_gateway_0_DESC: Closing down these gateways that allow our enemies access deep into our territory is vital for the defense of our borders.
sth_closure_gateway_0_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETA: Closing gateways into our territory will prevent our foes from attacking us.
sth_constellation_class_desc: A tribute to the Constellation Class and those that served on this ship. To bring light into the darkness!
sth_constitution_a_class_desc: A tribute to the refitted Constitution-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_constitution_class_desc: A tribute to the Constitution-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_cop_federation_desc: Members of this federation have grouped together, recognising that together they are stronger.
sth_crossfield_class_desc: A tribute to the Crossfield Class and those that served on this ship. All things can can be understood once they are discovered.
sth_defiant_class_desc: Fortune favours the bold and this class embodies that message.
sth_denorios_belt_orb_site_desc: Signs of a Bajoran Orb have been detected here.
sth_denorios_belt_wormhole_desc: Neutrino disturbances have been detected in this region of the Denorios Belt.
sth_excelsior_class_desc: A tribute to the grand experiment of Starfleet and those who served on this ship.
sth_fluidic_rift_desc: This appears to be a quantum singularity leading to a region of dense, fluid-like space.
sth_galaxy_class_desc: A tribute to the great Galaxy-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_gomtuu_desc: A massive, dark-colored starship shaped like a sunflower seed shell
sth_hyper_relay_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_DELAYE: The space traffic control centre is automatically built when upgrading to Starbase III or in systems that have a Level II base.
sth_hyper_relay_DESC: The planetary system space traffic control centre manages warp traffic into and out of the system providing faster and more efficient travel between aligned worlds.
sth_hyper_relay_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: The planetary system space traffic control centre manages warp traffic into and out of the system providing faster and more efficient travel between aligned worlds.
sth_intrepid_class_desc: A tribute to the Intrepid Class that voyaged further than any of its peers.
sth_liberation_wars_desc: We fight to liberate those who cannot fight for themselves.
sth_luna_class_desc: A tribute to the Luna-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_micro_wormhole_desc: Unstable wormholes occur relatively frequently, temporarily connecting locations in space hundreds of light years apart. The majority of these have apertures of just a few metres.
sth_miranda_class_desc: A tribute to the Miranda Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_museum_in_orbit_desc: The site of an decommissioned ship converted into an orbital museum for tourists and lovers off historical vessels.
sth_nx01_class_desc: A tribute to the Columbia-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_nx_class_desc: A tribute to the NX-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_rescue_transport_desc: The rescue transport is designed to weather emergency situations in order to rescue those in need.
sth_shang_class_desc: A tribute to the Shangri-La Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_site_landing_flag_category_desc: Scientists have discovered the potential site of our first landing on this world. A team has been sent to investigate and uncover the site of our ancestors greatest triumphs.
sth_sovereign_class_desc: A tribute to the regal Sovereign-Class and those that served on this ship.
sth_the_borg_artifact_desc: The Artifact is an abandoned Borg cube, also known as the Borg Reclamation Site. Scientists work there as guests of the Borg Artifact Research Institute.
sth_trait_pop_alpha_2_desc: The Alpha Jem'Hadar are an Alpha Quadrant variant of the Jem'Hadar. They believe themselves to be superior to the 'original' species.
sth_xcv247_desc: The UESP Manhire XCV-247 has been pulled from the nearby event horizon.
sth_xindi_probe_debris_desc: Investigating the wreckage of the hostile alien probe may reveal who ordered the attack and why.
stone_of_gol_clues: Clues found to the location of the parts of the Stone of Gol
stoneofgol_bombard_desc:
We order our fleet to deploy the ancient Stone of Gol, devastating armed forces on the planet while keeping some of the civilian populace and infrastructure intact.
- Massive damage to Armies
- No damage to Buildings
- Heavy damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
strategic_coordination_center_ruined_CON: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
strategic_coordination_center_ruined_DES: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
strategic_coordination_center_ruined_MEG: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
subclass_admiral_engineer_desc: Being at the forefront of the engineering profession, is there no issue this engineer cannot fix.
subclass_admiral_hero_desc: This officer represents everything it means to wear the uniform.
subclass_admiral_spy_desc: A master of working in the shadows and uncovering any secrets.
subclass_borg_admiral_primary_desc: Primary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_admiral_secondary_desc: Secondary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_admiral_tertiary_desc: Tertiary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_governor_primary_desc: Primary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_governor_secondary_desc: Secondary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_governor_tertiary_desc: Tertiary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_scientist_primary_desc: Primary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_scientist_secondary_desc: Secondary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_borg_scientist_tertiary_desc: Tertiary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One.
subclass_governor_ambassador_desc: A master diplomat representing the best of their empire.
subclass_governor_spy_desc: A master of working in the shadows and uncovering any secrets.
subclass_scientist_engineer_desc: Being at the forefront of the engineering profession, is there no issue this engineer cannot fix.
subclass_scientist_medical_desc: At the forefront of the medical profession, saving lives and helping patients.
subject_can_be_integrated_sth_desc: The Overlord can integrate the Subject into their empire.
subject_can_not_do_diplomacy_ufp: Has a seat on the UFP Council
subject_can_not_do_diplomacy_ufp_desc: The Federation Council handles external diplomacy, and the Subject has a voting seat on it.
subject_cannot_expand_agency_desc: The Agency is merely an arm of the empire and will not expand.
subject_holdings_limit_dom_desc: The Dominion are permitted access to their member world resources.
subject_holdings_limit_garid_desc: The Praetor may put 3 Holdings in Imperial protectorate territory.
subject_holdings_limit_klingon_desc: The Empire may put 3 Holdings in a Great House's territory.
subject_holdings_limit_ufp_desc: The Federation may put 3 Holdings in a Member World's territory.
subject_is_dominion_desc: Whether its fear or loyalty to the Founders, Dominion subjects are a formidable force.
sword_kahless_activate: Wield the Sword of Kahless and summon a great host of warriors.
sword_of_kahless_clues: Clues found to the Sword's location.
tal_shiar_espionage_1_desc: Minimal funding for the Tal Shiar.
tal_shiar_espionage_2_desc: Moderate funding for the Tal Shiar.
tal_shiar_espionage_3_desc: Max funding for the Tal Shiar.
tal_shiar_espionage_zhatvash_desc: The agency within the Romulan Empire, that even the Tal Shiar agents fear.
tasha_yar_backstory: Born on the Turkana IV colony in 2337, Tasha fought her way through adversity to escape and join Starfleet.
tech_automated_exploration_desc: Order the Science ship to automatically explore the galaxy.
tech_cloak_combat_effect: Crews are trained to use the cloaking device to ambush foes, resulting in a brief period of increased damage, fire rate & evasion whilst our opposition tries to understand what has hit it.
tech_cloak_defensive_effect: Training for our crews to take full advantage of our ability to cloak our ships, allowing them to move faster whilst cloaked.
tech_gene_tailoring_modifier_undine_desc: Unlocks the power to modify the genetic power of the Undine and the ability to modify their genome.
tempagency: Send the additional data to the Temporal Defense Authority
temporal_defense_agency_1_desc:
Research Facility

Temporal Defense Authority is dedicated to investigating time travel and other temporal events.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
temporal_probe_poi_1_desc: Chroniton signatures indicate a log buoy
temporal_probe_poi_2_desc: Chroniton signatures indicate a log buoy
temporal_probe_poi_3_desc: Chroniton signatures indicate a log buoy
temporal_probe_poi_4_desc: Chroniton signatures indicate a log buoy
temporal_probe_poi_5_desc: Chroniton signatures indicate a log buoy
terra_prime_reunification_complete_toolt: Earth and Mars are united once again.
terra_prime_reunification_fail_tooltip: The attempts to bring the two empires together has failed.
terra_prime_too_strong: Terra Prime will not accept that.
terraforming_not_available: Verteron Array is currently under maintenance. It will be available in due course.
terransword_activate: Wield the Sword of the Empire.
think_tank_ruined_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_DELA: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
think_tank_ruined_DESC: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
think_tank_ruined_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
tom_paris_backstory: The son of a prominent Starfleet admiral, he was dishonorably discharged from Starfleet and later joined the Maquis before being captured and serving time. Was redeemed in the eyes of Starfleet through his actions serving on the USS Voyager.
too_many_batteries_in_system: £ Only three Orbital Batteries can be constructed per system.
torres_backstory: Torres was a former Starfleet Academy dropout-turned-Maquis, who, after being stranded in the Delta Quadrant in 2371, served for seven years as the chief engineer aboard the Federation starship USS Voyager.
total_wars_desc:
There will be no peace, no negotiation, and no mercy. Military power is the only determinant of our borders.

Gain access to war goals that allow conquest of systems and planets without prior claims or occupation.

Conflict of this type always applies to both sides of a war!
tpol_background: Born 2088 on Vulcan, T'Pol became the first non-human officer to serve in United Earth's Starfleet, her brilliant scientific mind aiding the crew of the NX-01 on many occassions.
tpol_catch_phrase: My experience with Humans is limited, but I've come to learn that they are quite resourceful.
tpring_background: Born on Vulcan to a noble house served as an administrator and treatment specialist at the Vulcan rehabilitation colony before becoming a Matriarch at the Temple of Kolinahr.
tr_adaptability_1_delayed: As the Collective expands, there are more and more situations where drones must operate far away from the nearest transwarp communication hub. We must adapt and improve our autonomous algorithms to allow drones to function independently, if needed.
tr_adaptability_2_delayed: Our Collective mind is only as strong as the weakest link. Improving the defenses around the Collective ensures that our quest for perfection will not be disrupted.
tr_adaptability_3_delayed: The chaotic era where organic empires dictated the course of galactic history is over. The Collective will now take its rightful place, guiding the lesser species towards Omega.
tr_adaptability_3_desc: The £ Unity bonus from the assimilation of enemy populations and planets into the Collective is increased.
tr_adaptability_4_delayed: Land that is not being worked contributes nothing to the Collective. Drones must be relocated in an efficient manner to those planets where they are needed most.
tr_adaptability_5_delayed: The assimilation of numerous species has indicated that there is a non-zero probability of an assault on our unicomplexes at an undefined point in time. By rerouting resources to security subroutines and improving internal response procedures we can ensure that the Collective is well prepared for any assault.
tr_adaptability_borg_1_delayed: Backup processing nodes ensure that viable adaptation strategies are never erroneously discarded, significantly increasing combat efficiency.
tr_adaptability_borg_2_delayed: Predictive data analysis integrated within existing adaptive algorithms will increase the applicability of derived solutions, preventing a wider range of threats.
tr_adaptability_borg_3_delayed: Improvements to data acquisition and analysis greatly increases the rate at which we adapt to enemy weapons configurations.
tr_adaptability_borg_4_delayed: Specialised force field emitters are required for 87.6% of all countermeasures against species native to Fluidic Space.
tr_adaptability_borg_5_delayed: Defeat is irrelevant. Upon destruction of any of our units the plexus sends out collected information for analysis at the central processing node.
tr_adaptability_borg_5_desc: 25% chance to gain +100 Ruler XP when a Borg ship is destroyed. 33% chance that a Borg Cube or Tactical Cube will spawn a Borg Sphere on destruction.
tr_adaptability_undine_4_delayed: As our infestation takes hold of a planet our ability to purge all that stands in our way only increases in strength.
tr_adaptability_undine_5_delayed: As our strength grows, so does our ability to produce worker units best suited to toiling long hours in any condition for the good of all Undine.
tr_adaptability_undine_5_desc:
Unlocks: Job Undine Gatherer

Undine Gatherers scour Fluidic space for resources for the whole.
tr_assimilation_1_delayed: The chaotic era where organic empires dictated the course of galactic history is over. The Collective will now take its rightful place, guiding the lesser species towards Omega.
tr_assimilation_2_delayed: With countless billions of perspectives waiting to be directed at a given quandry, there is no field of study the Collective cannot eventually master.
tr_assimilation_3_delayed: Rapid-deployment nanotube talons significantly increase the rate and volume of nanoprobes delivered to assimilation targets, greatly reducing resistance against tactical drone operations.
tr_assimilation_4_delayed: Against highly resistant species, the battle capability of tactical drones must be elevated at least one standard deviation above previous baseline. Additional combat instruments added to servo-armatures will achieve this goal.
tr_assimilation_5_delayed: All tactical drones will be adapted to use spectrum-cycling ocular implants supported by precision targeting lasers. Identification and apprehension of priority assimilation targets will increase by a significant margin.
tr_assimilation_finish_desc:
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
Drone Boarding Chance: +25%
tr_automation_2_delayed: Advances in fabrication processes have yielded a +5% decrease in the time it takes to construct buildings on planets within the empire, as well as +5% increase in population assembly and +75% additional alloy production from Factory Workers.
tr_automation_3_delayed: Our scientists have discovered new algorithms to find the best research to study.
tr_automation_3_desc: Unlocks advanced technology that makes research automation possible.
tr_automation_4_delayed: Multiple efficiencies are made to the operation of Starbase. Including decreasing upkeep by -5% and increasing module and building build speed by +10% as well as increases the Starbase upgrade speed by 5%.
tr_automation_5_delayed: Advances in AI have enabled our ships to increase how long they can last and their ability to recover by connecting to all parts of the ship. This way, the energy distribution increased a lot, and the ability to build emergency forcefields in case of a hull break also increased. This raised its survivability significantly.
tr_automation_5_desc: Unlocks the technology to build a new automation component on the engineering module slots on your ships.
tr_cardassian_2_1_delayed: Our armies fight to demonstrate the might of Cardassian and to annex those deemed to be best suited to serving Cardassia.
tr_cardassian_2_2_delayed: The rights of the Cardassian people take precedence over all else and our rivals see this and fear it, our confiscation protocols ensure that it is always Cardassia first.
tr_cardassian_2_3_delayed: Life under the whip of a Cardassian guard is harsh, we Cardassians have learnt long ago how to get the most from our labor force.
tr_cardassian_2_4_delayed: The natural order of things puts the Cardassian at the top, with the directive of the Obsidian Order to guide our citizen on the correct path.
tr_cardassian_2_5_delayed: The defence of Cardassian sovereign systems will always be a priority and the new orbital defence structures will protect us from any threat and the ability to build these faster will keep our Union safer.
tr_cardassian_2_5_desc: Orbital defence stations are built a 3rd faster than before.
tr_cardassian_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases happiness across the Cardassian Union.
tr_connectivity_borg_1_delayed: Utilizing the cortical nodes of thousands of drones, it is possible for the Collective to simultaneously design and construct planetary-scale facilities in parallel, maximizing process efficiency.
tr_connectivity_borg_2_delayed: Assimilated advancements in graviton manipulation technology will enable us to further expand the Unicomplex superstructure, in order to house several billion additional drones.
tr_connectivity_borg_3_delayed: Drone shortages at critical facilities will impede territorial and technological development. Drones must be relocated in an efficient manner to those locations as quickly as possible.
tr_connectivity_borg_4_delayed: Once equipped with sufficient interlink redundancies, it is possible to establish a network of supercomplexes, distributing the production and processing capabilities of the Unicomplex across multiple unimatrices.
tr_connectivity_borg_5_delayed: Extension of territorial reach beyond the range of the Unicomplex increases the risk of mass incursions by resisting species. Recommend assimilation of existing technological platforms as auxiliary Unicomplex expansions.
tr_connectivity_borg_5_desc: Enables the construction of Subcomplexes on ruined ancient megastructures, galactic forum stations, and incomplete scientific arrays.
tr_cunning_1_delayed: Abandoning logic allows for our true emotions to take hold. Those who are our friends will remain so, but those who are our enemies will feel the full might of the Romulan Star Empire.
