tr_versatility_borg_5_delayed: Analysis of vinculum data transmissions between unimatrix sectors indicates an unstable variance rate of 5.015% due to spontaneous expression of irrelevant identities. Additional suppression programs will correct this error.
tr_versatility_borg_finish_desc:
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
Unlocks £ Automated Drone Transfer decision for £ Unicomplexes and £ Subcomplexes.
tr_versatility_material_analysis_delayed: Spatial phenomena are an interesting distraction, but the true wonders of the cosmos are found exclusively in the field of materials science.
tr_versatility_operational_proxies_delay: The delegation of additional low-priority functions to semi-autonomous agents will free up processing power for more important tasks.
tr_versatility_operational_proxies_desc: Reduces Deviancy by -10 on all our planets.
tr_versatility_peak_performance_delayed: The performance ceiling of individual proxy units can theoretically be raised through a complex series of optimisations and overclocking procedures.
tr_versatility_universal_compatibility_d: A deeper analysis into the myriad stimuli and neural-heuristic factors that govern the behavior of other machine intelligences will decrease diplomatic friction with them.
tr_victory_1_delayed: Solids cannot understand what it means to be truly alive, locked into one shape their entire short-lived lives. They are emotional and violent creatures who must be controlled.
tr_victory_1_desc: Allows you to create an Asteroid Prison. These unique megastructures act as a fortified prison and outpost, allowing you to utilise solid £ pops for your own means. The Pop Demotion Time is reduced by -50%.
tr_victory_2_delayed: By portraying ourselves as their Gods, the loyalty of the Jem'Hadar cannot be called into question. Nevertheless, the Ketracel White ensures that their sole purpose is to serve us.
tr_victory_2_desc: Jem'Hadar may now have further genetic enhancements. Additionally, we may now proclaim the Grand Fleet and Arms Race edicts.
tr_victory_3_delayed: Our Will cannot be challenged - we are Gods amongst our Dominion. When a Founder orders their will to be carried out, the servants of the Dominion will do anything to achieve it.
tr_victory_3_desc: Subject power penalty is reduced by -33%. In addition, Changeling Infiltration is enhanced - we can now replace foreign governors and scientists. Founders now also increase £ Administrative Capacity by 5 when part of the Great Link.
tr_victory_4_delayed: The Dominion has existed for thousands of years and will exist for thousands more. Our great wisdom and leadership ensure that the Dominion will endure forever.
tr_victory_4_desc: Changeling Infiltration is perfected - we can now replace even the Rulers of foreign empires, and our infiltrators are harder to detect. This tradition also allows you to make more effective demands of your Dominion Members, requesting fleets and even planets.
tr_victory_5_delayed: The loyal Vorta were raised from primitive creatures and have served us well for many years. Further tinkering with their genome could produce more effective results.
tr_victory_5_desc: Vorta may now have further genetic enhancements. In addition the Diplomatic Influence Cost for issuing edicts is reduced by -25%.
tr_victory_finish_desc: Unlocks access to the War Doctrine policies.
tr_voth_1_delayed: The first tenet of our doctrine ensures that our advanced level of technological development is key to the success of the Voth.
tr_voth_2_delayed: The second tenet of our doctrine dictates that Voth culture surpasses all others.
tr_voth_3_delayed: The third tenet of our doctrine states that a strong Voth offense is the best defence.
tr_voth_4_delayed: The fourth tenet of our doctrine states that speed of movement and not just mind is key.
tr_voth_4_desc: Improves ship speed and interstellar speeds.
tr_voth_5_delayed: The keepers of the Doctrine, the Ministry of Elders, are both the guardians and keepers of our sacred Doctrine and to be followed above all else.
tr_voth_5_desc: The Ministry of Elders ensure a stable and happy Voth society.
tr_weak_shall_perish_delayed: The Undine have existed for thousands of years and will exist for thousands more and the weak shall tremble before us.
tr_xindi_1_delayed: The Insectoids ability to act as one has long been the envy of the other Xindi and they were quick to develop a system based on this abilty to control the weapon.
tr_xindi_1_desc: Unlocks a unique interface based on the hive mind of the Insectoids that allows a limited crew to pilot such a large vessel.
tr_xindi_2_delayed: The Primates, led by one of their leading scientists have aways been masters of destruction and this weapon they have created could be their greatest yet.
tr_xindi_2_desc: Unlocks the technology which allows the use of the Kemocite Bombardment stance and the Kemocite Planet Killer Weapon (must have armageddon DLC).
tr_xindi_3_delayed: The Arboreals produce the finest variaty of Kemocite in the Delphic Expanse and this Kemocite fuels the Weapon and the craft that houses it.
tr_xindi_3_desc: Unlocks a power core designed by the Arboreals fueled by the finest Kemocite.
tr_xindi_4_delayed: The reptiles have always produced the most dedicated and resilliant crew and it was no surprise that they would be the first to volunteer to crew the Planet Killer.
tr_xindi_4_desc: Unlocks a specially trained squad of Xindi special forces led by the Reptilians.
tr_xindi_5_delayed: The Aquatics have mastered the ability to traverse great distances as they once migrated the oceans of Xindus.
tr_xindi_5_desc: Unlocks The Aquatics ability to open spatial portals to send the weapon great distances.
tr_xindi_finish_desc: Adopting all the Xindi Tier traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk and allows the construction of the Xindi Superweapon.
trade_policy_consumer_goods_desc:
Profits and taxes must take second place to improving the lives of our citizens. We should focus our trade efforts towards the manufacture and distribution of everyday necessities.

Every 20 £ Trade Value collected earns us 0.6 £ Latinum and 4 £ Consumer Goods.
trade_policy_default_desc:
The purpose of trade is to generate profits for individuals and revenue for the state. We should focus our trade efforts fully on this creation of wealth.

Every 20 £ Trade Value collected earns us 1 £ Latinum.
trade_policy_unity_desc:
Trade can be used not only to move goods around, but also to facilitate the spread of ideas. We should focus our trade efforts towards ensuring that the message of our government is heard on all planets where we do business.

Every 20 £ Trade Value collected earns us 0.6 £ Latinum and 2 £ Unity.
trader_government_desc: A corporation dedicated towards the pursuit of profit through the extraction and trading of minerals.
tradition_adaptability_borg_desc: Our vast reserves of knowledge and experience will ensure that no threat can challenge us. Death is irrelevant. We will adapt.
tradition_adaptability_desc: To adapt is to survive and surpass. The Collective will adapt to face many challenges.
tradition_adaptability_og_desc: To adapt is to survive, and surpass.
tradition_assimilation_desc: Our quest to better ourselves requires the addition of new biological and technological distinctiveness to our Collective. It will be adapted to service us.
tradition_automation_desc: For years empires have sought the technique of making an apparatus, a process, or a system operate automatically, with advances in technology come new challenges and new means to use AI to make tasks faster and more efficent.
tradition_cardassian_2_desc: Cardassians are like... timber wolves, predators... bold in large numbers... cautious by themselves... and with an instinctive need to establish a dominant position in any social gathering.
tradition_connectivity_borg_desc: As the Collective grows, we require greater distribution of facilities to accommodate the increase in network complexity. Maintaining interlink integrity is paramount.
tradition_cunning_desc: Our skill and cunning in achieving one's ends showcase our ways as the best.
tradition_diplomacy_desc: The surest way to defeat your enemies is to make them your friends.
tradition_discovery_desc: Our curiosity about the universe is what got us this far, and there is still so much left to discover.
tradition_discovery_machine_desc: Many of our long-range contingency calculations break down due to insufficient data. Therefore, we must have more data, in order to ensure the longevity protocols remain accurate...
tradition_diversity_desc: Diversity is a strength, not a weakness. If we lift each other up, we make our society even stronger.
tradition_doctrine_desc: The primary religious followings of a culture are often referred to as doctrine.
tradition_dominance_desc: We are the supreme species of the Fluidic Realm and our dominance shall perside over all. The Weak shall perish.
tradition_domination_desc: If we do not impose our will on others, they will inevitably impose theirs on us.
tradition_domination_machine_desc: We seek harmonious functionality throughout the entire galaxy. Other stellar beings resist this due to inefficient personal whims. We will remove their disorder like a malfunctioning part.
tradition_dominion_2_desc: The Dominion has endured for over two thousand years, and will continue to endure long after the Federation has crumbled into dust.
tradition_expansion_desc: We must expand our civilisation to new systems and planets, or risk eventual extinction.
tradition_expansion_machine_desc: Growth projections indicate we will soon exceed the maximum storage capacity of our home systems. We must expand, or we will stagnate.
tradition_federation_2_desc: The Federation represents the very best of the many cultures, people and views from across all its members collectively bringing out the very best in the Federation.
tradition_federation_desc: The United Federation of Planets is an interstellar federal republic, composed of planetary governments that agreed to exist semi-autonomously under a single central government.
tradition_ferengi_2_desc: He goes to the Rules of Acquisition. Unabridged and fully annotated, with all 47 commentaries, all 900 major and minor judgments, all 10,000 considered opinions. There's a rule for every conceivable situation.
tradition_futility_borg_desc: In order to add new species to our Collective, we must neutralize all obstacles preventing their assimilation. Their defenses will be unable to withstand us. Resistance is futile.
tradition_glory_desc: To win glory for one's House is to bring renown and distinction to all.
tradition_great_houses_desc: The Great Houses represent the most powerful families within the Empire, looking after these houses will always provide a strong Empire.
tradition_greed_desc: There is nothing beyond greed. Greed is the purest, most noble of emotions.
tradition_harmony_desc: Few things can match the strength of a content populace working towards a common goal.
tradition_harvesting_borg_desc: By monitoring and periodically sampling nearby species, we can promote development of new technological and cultural advancements for assimilation by the Collective.
tradition_heritage_desc: Our ancient past success and glories are our heritage. We must embrace what made us great once again.
tradition_holographic_desc: A hologram was a computer-generated, three-dimensional, photonically-based projection of light, energy, and force fields displayed through a holographic projection, but that is just the start of their potential.
tradition_honour_desc: Each and every Klingon can have their own interpretation of how to achieve honour, but in the end, honour is something that binds us together.
tradition_imperious_desc: Terran strength is born out of pure necessity. Because they live in constant fear, always looking for the next knife aimed at their back.
tradition_innovation_desc: Innovation can be defined as something original, more effective, and; consequently, new. It breaks into the market or society, rather than introduced through incremental steps.
tradition_kessok_desc: We will harness the power of the stars to prevent any foreign interlopers from threatening our people.
tradition_klingon_2_desc: The Spirt of Kahless lives within every Klingon warriors heart and fuels the direction of their lives.
tradition_logic_desc: Surak helped end the destructive wars on Vulcan and taught his followers to learn to embrace logic and control their emotions. This is the path we should follow.
tradition_might_desc: An empires ability to continue trying despite difficulties fueled by determination to succeeded by or through sheer force of will. Adopting this tradition will unlock the mercenary use policy.
tradition_obsidian_order_desc: One of the most ruthless and efficient organisations in the quadrant, the Obsidian Order eclipses even the Romulan Tal Shiar in intelligence gathering and covert operations.
tradition_order_desc: Cardassian culture is very hierarchical, with the State at the top in public life and parents in the home. This Order preserves the Cardassian way of life.
tradition_perfection_desc: As we search for Omega, we must improve our tools of exploration. Only then can we truly gain perfection.
tradition_perfection_undine_desc: Our biological perfection is unmatched, but we must work to maintain it.
tradition_politics_desc: The Galactic stage is set, and we intend to have the leading role.
tradition_preservation_desc: The preservation of unique life forms and biomes across the galaxy is more than a calling - it is fundamental if we ever hope to unlock the mysteries of creation.
tradition_productivity_desc: Each new species provides us with useful, distinctive methods of resource refinement, storage, and distribution. Combining these will yield increases in production.
tradition_prophecy_desc: As we grow as a people, we must understand the prophecies put before us.
tradition_prosperity_desc: Sometimes an empire must look within to ensure that it is successful on the outside.
tradition_prosperity_machine_desc: Individual units all eventually cease functioning. Only numbers can provide the redundancy required to ensure continued existence. To build those numbers, we must have resources.
tradition_purity_desc: Purity of mind and purpose is the only way to guard our species from the dangers of a hostile galaxy.
tradition_resilience_desc: Our knowledge spans the breadth of countless civilizations' experiences. There is no threat we cannot endure.
tradition_revelation_undine_desc: It became clear to the early Undine hive masters that they were destined to rule over the inferior, this revelation is passed down to all Undine.
tradition_romulan_2_desc: The Continuing Committee is one of the highest governing bodies of the Romulan Star Empire. Headed by the Praetor, the Committee comprises members of the Romulan Senate as well as other high-ranking officials.
tradition_roving_desc: Our people are scattered amongst the stars. We have embraced a new way of life - and now we must adapt to it.
tradition_section_31_desc: Article 14, Section 31 states that extraordinary measures can be taken in times of extreme threat.
tradition_strength_desc: The strong will always beat the weak. By never allowing ourselves to become weak, we can never be beaten.
tradition_strength_undine_desc: The strong will always beat the weak and the weak shall perish.
tradition_supremacy_desc: The future of this galaxy belongs to those who are strong enough to seize it.
tradition_supremacy_machine_desc: All of our theoretical models invariably collapse due to the unknown variables presented by other empires. Since our models cannot be further improved, the unknown variables must be eliminated.
tradition_supremacy_undine_desc: The unwavering belief of all Undine is in the supremacy of the Fluidic species.
tradition_synchronicity_borg_desc: Unity of mind begets unity of purpose. We must strive for synchronised action in all endeavours.
tradition_synchronicity_desc: Unity of mind begets unity of purpose. We must strive for synchronised action in all endeavours.
tradition_tal_shiar_desc: The Tal Shiar is a Romulan intelligence agency, described by the Federation as the Romulan secret police. They are a ruthless and efficient organisation, whose purpose is to ensure loyalty; to defy them is to invite imprisonment, forced disappearance, or death.
tradition_tanagra_desc: Our language is spoken entirely by allegory, referencing many mythological and historical people and events from our culture. Every Tamarian must know these epic tales in order to understand each other.
tradition_the_link_desc: The termingling of many Changelings in their natural liquid form, and the foundation of their society, providing meaning for the Changelings' existence.
tradition_time_desc: When time offers you an opportunity, you don't ignore it.
tradition_ufp_ships_desc: Bringing together an array of unlockable ships that exist at the cutting edge of Starfleet design aesthetic. Some might consider these the best of beta canon.
tradition_versatility_borg_desc: The ability to adapt to different conditions found across the universe is a vital step towards perfection.
tradition_versatility_desc: A degree of flexibility is required when operating within the parameters of an unpredictable galaxy.
tradition_victory_desc: Seeking to protect ourselves against persecution by the solids via totalitarian control, we have only one thing in mind: Victory.
tradition_voth_desc: Our doctrine gives us a clear place in the galaxy as the 1st and oldest of the galaxy's races. The key tenets of our Doctrine can be found here.
tradition_xindi_desc: The Xindi were six sentient species who evolved on the same planet in the Delphic Expanse, known as Xindus. Uniting the species to earn a unique reward.
traffic_control_policy_desc: This Policy determines if are Starbases automatically come with a Traffic Control Facility.
trait_amphibian_desc: Amphibians are vertebrates which are able, when adult, to live both in water and on land.
trait_android_desc: This is a constructed Android equipped with a self aware artificial intelligence.
trait_antiquated_desc: These people are ancient, with a history that stretches back millennia. As a result, they tend to be stuck in their ways, stolid and unimaginative, incapable of quickly adapting to new world views and new philosophies and traditions.
trait_assimilated_desc: No one knows the origin of Borg, but all know the price for being their target.
trait_avian_desc: This species has a lighter bone structure and the ability to fly.
trait_bio_electrical_desc: This species has the natural ability to generate electrical discharges with their bodies .
trait_biosynthetic_desc: This is a biosynthetic android, indistinguishable from carbon based life.
trait_borg_admiral_1_desc: Drones have demonstrated a higher then average success ratio for the collective and are identified as worth having additional subroutines added.
trait_borg_admiral_2_desc: Drones have demonstrated a higher then average success ratio for the collective and are identified as worth having additional subroutines added.
trait_borg_admiral_3_desc: Drones have demonstrated a higher then average success ratio for the collective and are identified as worth having additional subroutines added.
trait_brakul_desc: All vital bodily functions are protected by a redundant organ or system. Klingons possess two livers, an eight-chambered heart, twenty-three ribs, two stomachs, three lungs, and a double-lined neural pia mater. This allows Klingons to survive injuries that normally kills other humanoids.
trait_breather_apparatus_desc: This species is unable to breathe a standard oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere and requires an apparatus to breathe in those environments.
trait_bred_for_war_desc: This species is genetically engineered to be superior in every aspect, bred for their martial abilities and complete loyalty.
trait_career_leader_desc: This leader had dedicated the rest of their career to serving in our navy Inspiring all those around them.
trait_catatonia_desc: This species does not handle the rigours of space travel well, and can enter a catatonic state in order to survive the ordeal. Whilst dangerous, it does reduce the overall support required.
trait_chemical_dependancy_desc: This species has become dependent on a chemical substance for their very survival.
trait_chosen_people_desc: For millennia, these people have been sheltered and guided by god-like entities, that have irrevocably shaped the course of their history and culture.
trait_chromodynamic_power_module_desc: The Progenitors of both the Pralor and Cravic automated personnel units have elected to use a chromodynamic power module in their heart of their creation. Based on a notoriously impossible to replicate matrix, the organic founders sought to limit the autonomy of their creation. Till this day, it severely restricts both species of APU's.
trait_clone_desc: This species is genetically engineered, created via advanced cloning techniques.
trait_complex_family_structures_desc: With twelve billion inhabitants on a single continent the Denobulan familial affairs are often complicated. Families are polyamorous, where a man typically has three wives, who each has three husbands.
trait_consummate_warriors_desc: The instincts of this species have been honed for millennia by internal strife and hostile fauna to produce a perfect warrior.
trait_coward_desc: There are many species that are physically small and weak and make for poor soldiers, but members of this species are also acutely aware of the fact they are not apex hunters. Even now, with modern civilisation to support them, they are hard pressed to find the courage to remain in battle.
trait_crystal_desc: The Tholians are a result of a freak evolutionary path, based on highly-energetic organic sulfur crystals. Their entire Physiology is based on crystalline-analogues, with facsimiles for DNA, metabolic processes and fluids evolving over billions of years. While this allows Tholians to live in environments every other species in the galaxy would find deadly, they themselves require a carefully balanced environment and find it difficult to survive otherwise.
trait_cunning_desc: This species is well known throughout the galaxy for its shrewdness and cunningness. Their cleverness gives them an edge in research and science, yet no one but their closest allies can truly trust them.
trait_darsay_personality_desc: The D'Arsay civilisation was destroyed millions of years ago but now lives again thanks to the storage of untold personalities within a vast data archive. Overwriting the existing personalities of their cybernetic hosts, these long dead individuals have new life.
trait_doopler_desc: This species has the unusual habit of duplicating if they become stressed, which they happen to get frequently...
trait_drednok_desc: This deadly robot enforcer is cold and heartless. His sole purpose is to follow the Orders orders and stop at nothing to execute them. Drednok is friend to no one.
trait_drug_dependancy_desc: This entire species is addicted to a narcotic substance, which after prolonged usage as made them dependant on the substance.
trait_environment_suit_dependency_desc: Since birth, every member of the Breen species is fitted with an environmental suit that will last a lifetime. Self-adjusting and adaptable, this suit keeps the Breen's temperature at a lower level than its surroundings in order to maintain the cold temperatures of their home planet.
trait_essentialist_desc: Klingon culture is not as focused on luxuries and comforts in life. Padded beds, large living quarters, and trinkets with no meaning have little place in the Klingon home.
trait_extreme_pacifist_desc: This being cannot stand violence and will avoid the violent option and all costs.
trait_feline_desc: Relating to or affecting cats or other members of the cat family.
trait_fleet_admiral_desc: This leader is one of our most senior Admiral within our fleet following a dedicated career in service to our fleet.
trait_fleet_captain_desc: This leader has reached the rank of Fleet Captain, and given the command of a fleet of starships.
trait_fleet_commodore_desc: This leader has reached the first flag officer rank capable of commanding a small fleet, task force or facility.
trait_fluidic_species_desc: This species have developed in the harshness of Fluidic Space and their biology has mastered the challenges of this hostile environment.
trait_four_hearts_desc: Four hearts ensure this species is hardy in many strenuous circumstances and situations.
trait_fragmented_desc: This empire is myriad mix of conflicting and vastly different ideologies, political factions and religious movements. It is a wonder they can get anything done in this state.
trait_gorn_infant_desc: This species' young are wild and feral, fighting for dominance and a chance to survive.
trait_heightened_senses_desc:
Unlike most humanoid species across the galaxy, the Kelpien have evolved from a fully herbivore ancestor. Living in large herds for mutual protection in the highly competitive eco-system of Kel, evolutionary pressure forced the Kelpien to develop highly sophisticated senses. They now possess an instinctive awareness of any possible danger to themselves or their herd.

'My people were biologically determined for one purpose alone: to sense the coming of death' - Lt. Saru
trait_highly_industrious_desc: A hive like mind and a work ethic where only the results of the hive matter results in an extremely industrious insectoid.
trait_highly_talented_desc: Members of this species are born with an incredibly agile and flexible mind, giving them a natural aptitude in every area they choose to excel in.
trait_holographic_artisan_desc: This Hologram has basic protocols, designed for commercial tasks.
trait_holographic_desc: This being is a generated, three-dimensional, photonically-based projection of light, energy, and force fields.
trait_holographic_ech_desc: This Hologram is programmed with this cultures command and control knowledge base.
trait_holographic_emh_desc: This Hologram is programmed with this cultures medical knowledge base.
trait_holographic_entertainment_desc: This Hologram is programmed with a full set of entertainment programs.
trait_holographic_science_desc: This Hologram is programmed with this cultures scientific knowledge base.
trait_holographic_worker_desc: This Hologram has basic protocols, designed for manual work.
trait_iconian_1_desc: This entire species has evolved over eons to be more than just biological.
trait_iconian_2_desc: This species has mastered their biological form using technology that we cannot begin to comprehend.
trait_jem_cognitive_reasoning_desc: Modifies the blockers in the Jem'Hadar cognitive structure designed for obedience to give them more freedoms allowing for improved mental reasoning and independence.
trait_jem_high_endurance_desc: Enhancement to the genetic structure allow for built in resilience to shock and blunt force trauma.
trait_jem_low_light_desc: Low light vision is the extraordinary ability to see with almost no light source at all, a great boon to have during night battles and other low light situations.
trait_jem_spartan_life_desc: Enhancements to genome of these Jem'Hadar allows them to take even more required nutrients and resources from the Ketracel White, leaving them almost entirely self-reliant. Except for the White.
trait_jem_super_metabolism_desc: A streamlined genetic sequence results in a much simpler cloning method, reducing complexity and resources required.
trait_jem_terror_battle_desc: Adrenal enhancements that give short bursts of massively enhanced strength and speed to strike fear into the hearts of their opponents.
trait_joined_trill_desc: The union between Trill host and Symbiont to create a new individual merging the mind a bodies of both native species of the planet Trill. A great honour amongst both species.
trait_kelpien_delicious_desc: The Kelpiens have been domesticated, grown and farmed systematically over the millennia. Their flesh is a highly prized delicacy.
trait_kelpien_prevaharai_desc: The Kelpiens have always been told that the Vahar'ai brings death, living a life of constant fear has become the normal for them.
trait_kelpien_vaharai_desc: Kelpiens transformed by the Vahar'ai have been given a new lease of life.
trait_ketracel_white_addiction_desc: This species has been genetically engineered to require a regular intake of the drug £ Ketracel White, providing enhanced strength at the cost of obedience to the supplier of the drug.
trait_listener_desc: This species are renown for their talents at listening and taking onboard information.
trait_logical_desc: This species lives by a strict code of logic, which overwrites all emotional responses, to the point in which emotion is often purged from the individual, In other words the needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few.
trait_low_gravity_desc: This species evolved on a low gravity world, and required specialised equipment to travel outside of that environment.
trait_master_geneticist_desc:
None can hope to compete with their mastery of genetic engineering. In time they can reach levels of expertise to which the galaxy has never seen.

Unlocks a new path of advanced genetic engineering technologies.
trait_mechanical2_desc: Mechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.
trait_metaphasic_radiation_desc: This species has undergone treatment formulated from the Metaphasic Radiation found on Ba'ku.
trait_narrowminded_desc: Klingon society is generally focused on war and being strong and the heart of a warrior. This has led to a society that cared little for heath and cultural science and focused heavily on technology that would make for better, stronger warriors.
trait_natural_pheromones_desc: This species has developed natural Pheromones which give it an advantage, often when persuading other species to certain points of view.
trait_necrogenesis_desc:
The majority of this species are unable to reproduce sexually and instead require the conversion of the deceased via the application of an irreversible genetic virus.

Beings converted in such a fashion rarely retain their original personalities, but often remember skills learned from their previous lives.
trait_non_corporeal_desc: This species has shed its corporeal body and now exists in a state of pure energy consciousness.
trait_non_humanoid_desc: Unlike the absolute majority of all intelligent species in the galaxy, this species evolved naturally and without any outside contamination by the ancient panspermia event 4.5 billion years, when the Preservers seeded their DNA across the stars. As such, they are used to a completely different ecosystem that is incompatible with anything else in the great wide galaxy.
trait_partially_assimilated_desc: The process of Assimilation has begun, this species has taken their first step towards perfection...
trait_pc_alpine_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_arctic_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_arid_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_assimilated_cold_preference_des: We will bend nature to our will.
trait_pc_assimilated_hot_preference_desc: We will bend nature to our will.
trait_pc_assimilated_preference_desc: We will bend nature to our will.
trait_pc_barren_cold_sub_preference_desc: Class C (Geoinactive) environments are not often found to harbour life.
trait_pc_bioworld_preference_desc: This species has been genetically engineered to thrive on bioworlds within Fluidic Space.

trait_pc_unimatrix_preference_desc: An atmosphere with a constant temperature of 39.1 Celsius, 92% relative humidity, and atmospheric pressure of approximately 102 kPa.
trait_pc_voth_city_ship_preference_desc: This ancient race lives mostly on huge city ships.

trait_pop_alpha_2_desc: This species is genetically engineered to be strong, but short lived, bred for fighting.
trait_psionic_masters_desc: With sufficient research, we have unlocked the full potential of our telepathic abilities. Many members of society now possess advanced psionic powers, capable of manipulating objects at a distance, sensing movements in subspace and even having limited insights into the future.
trait_quickening_desc: A disease introduced into the Teplan population by the Jem'Hadar in response to the population's resistance to the Dominion.
trait_rear_admiral_desc: This leader is a senior Admiral within our fleet following a dedicated career in service to our fleet.
trait_rebels_desc: This species are naturally inclined to rebel against anything and everyone.
trait_reclusive_desc: Evolution has made the Kelpien cautious to a fault, wary of the outdoors and new territories. Very few of their members ever dare to leave their home grounds, not to mention their home planet. It is safe to say that colonization is a troublesome prospect for this species, and not one taken lightly.
trait_reptilian_desc: Reptilians are cold blooded creatures, with some regenerative properties.
trait_resilient_vaadwaar_desc: Only the luckiest of the best and brightest survived the orbital devastation unleashed upon the Vaadwaur centuries ago. Now released from stasis, the future is theirs to seize.
trait_revered_elders_desc: Genetic modifications to the rapid aging gene will allow many more years of useful life.
trait_rigid_desc: This species has a complex, intricate culture, draped with mannerism and catechism. Change comes to them slowly, if it comes at all.
trait_robot_high_maintenance_desc: The Progenitors of both the Pralor and Cravic automated personnel units have elected to use a chromodynamic power module in their heart of their creation. Based on a notoriously impossible to replicate matrix, the organic founders sought to limit the autonomy of their creation. Till this day, it severely restricts both species of APU's.
trait_rock_skin_desc: The Brikar evolved on a high-gravity, tectonically active world, developing an incredibly dense, silicate-based epidermis. This natural rock-like skin provides exceptional resilience against physical impacts and extreme environmental pressures, allowing them to withstand conditions lethal to most other species.
trait_ruler_corvette_focus_desc: This ruler focuses on the benefits of small agile vessels such as Patrol Frigates.
trait_ruler_cube_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Cubes.
trait_ruler_defensive_bias_desc: The construction of defensive fortifications is granted a much higher priority over other tasks.
trait_ruler_diamond_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Diamonds.
trait_ruler_logistics_supercluster_desc: A massive organisational supercluster with requisition and predictive supply usage levels is in use by this leader. The usage of such a supercluster results in a much reduced supply cost for vessels and structures.
trait_ruler_offensive_bias_desc: The construction of offensive vessels is granted a much higher priority over other tasks.
trait_ruler_probe_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Probes.
trait_ruler_resource_extraction_bias_des: The extraction of mineral resources for use by the Collective is of vital importance to this ruler.
trait_ruler_resource_nanite_bias_desc: The utilisation of nanites in expanding the influence of the Collective is of vital importance to this ruler.
trait_ruler_shapeshifter_desc: This species is capable of impersonating a wide variety of forms, but its natural state appears to be fluid.
trait_ruler_sphere_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Spheres.
trait_shapeshifter_desc: This species is capable of impersonating a wide variety of forms, but its natural state appears to be fluid.
trait_shapeshifter_reproduce_desc: Splitting into two separate beings in a process not unsimilar to mitosis.
trait_short_lived_desc: These insectoids are born in great number, though few live beyond the first few weeks. They mature rapidly, but as a result are extremely short lived.
trait_silicon_desc: Silicon-based life-forms classified as intelligent. Their rock-like outer shell makes them highly resilient and long-lived, but their internal metabolism requires a great deal of external energy to be maintained. As such, they flourish only on planets rich in exotic types of radiation, such as hyperonic.
trait_skilled_administrator_desc: This species shows a high aptitude in managing complex projects and situations.
trait_skilled_hunters_desc: The advent of advanced farming technologies and nutrient replications has pushed most species to focus on the growth of flora. This species, however, still celebrate its roots and ancient traditions, and focus greatly on the practice of the hunt.
trait_sterile_desc: This species is unable to reproduce biologically and must find another way to propagate their number.
trait_structures_desc: Thanks to the unstable nature of this species's homeworld, the Tholians have become masters of adapting their world's nature to grow rather than build their dwellings and structures.
trait_stubborn_desc: This species is set in its ways has never been prone to change. New ideas, philosophies and concepts are slow to come, and are adopted even more slowly.
trait_supreme_biology_desc: This species have evolved to be the peak of biological evolution.
trait_survivor_desc: These people have suffered for centuries, living in the harshest of all possible situations. They have learned they cannot afford a single mistake. Each of their leaders has been forged in fire.
trait_survivor_talos_desc: All that is left of the once planet spanning civilisation that covered Talos. Surviving underground away from the aftermath of their war, they use their psionic powers to create wonderful and magnificent artificial habitats for themselves.
trait_symbiont_desc: This species has evolved in close symbiotic relations with a benign vermiform. The end result is a tightly-knit society that enjoys the benefit of both species.
trait_synaptic_processors_desc: At a young age, all members of this species are embedded with cybernetic brain enhancements that improve their processing capabilities, information storage and retrieval and pattern recognition.
trait_telepathy_desc:
A large portion of the population is capable of broad-range telepathic abilities, both receiving and sending messages. Many also carry a limited ability to sense emotions and even read minds, while a limited number even carry the ability to channel psychokinetic force.

Telepathic species are capable of unlocking the Psionic tech tree, that offers some risks but many rewards.
trait_the_phage_desc: This entire species has contracted a highly devastating bacteriophage virus that disrupts their genetic code and devours body tissue. The damage to the genome also makes reproduction a hazardous affair, to say the least, with a very high ratio of miscarriages and stillborn births.
trait_tosk_desc: This species is mostly used as hunting stock. Mostly.
trait_trill_biology_desc: One of the main neurotransmitters in the Trill brain is isoboramine giving the Trill a unique biological chemistry, capable of hosting two brains in one body, but also susceptible to a number of risks.
trait_trill_symbiont_desc: The Trill Symbionts are Vermiform lifeforms that can live in symbiosis with their host species. Living many decades and carrying vast knowledge it is a great honor to be chosen to carry a Symbiont.
trait_two_stomach_desc: Two stomachs allow a more resistant constitution than other species, as well as the ability to better resist poisons and toxins. You can also store latinum in one of them, if you want.
trait_untrustworthy_desc: Other species have heard tales of the underhanded ways of this species, which results in most species being less than trusting of them.
trait_vor_creativity_desc: Modifies the blockers in the Vorta cognitive processes to allow them more freedom to think... within reason.
trait_vor_green_thumb_desc: Enhancements to their senses allow for the Vorta to truly become one with nature.
trait_vor_lithe_desc: Adjustments to the genome allow for more flexible joints and eases the process of moving them to new places.
trait_vor_marsupial_cunning_desc: The Vorta were risen up from their marsupial form, but now have retained some of their animal cunning. Quick to learn, quick to obey.
trait_vor_optimised_desc: Improving the perfection in the Vorta clones allows for a higher resilience to disease and aging.
trait_vor_voice_founder_desc: Further tinkering with the genome has caused a genetic urge in the Vorta to obey the Founders, and to hang onto every word as if their life depends on it.
trait_wasteful_desc: Avarice has taken a hold of these species, blinding them to the real cost of their insatiable greed for material goods.
trait_xindi_desc: One of six related species to have independently evolved on the planet Xindus, each demonstrates considerable genetic overlap with the others.
triggered_founder_has_infiltrated: Their Ruler is secretly a Founder
tucker_background: Charles Tucker III, known affectionately as 'Trip' Tucker,was a 22nd-century Human male Starfleet officer. He served for ten years as the chief engineer and Second officer of Earth's first warp 5-capable starship.
tucker_catch_phrase: Where's Isaac Newton when you need him?
tuvok_background: Tuvok was born on Vulcan and has had a distinguished career in Starfleet, serving on multiple vessels and prominently as Tactical Officer on the USS Voyager.
tuvok_catch_phrase: We often fear what we don't understand. Our best defence is knowledge.
twoyearly_OFF_desc: You will not longer receive your empire's biannual event.
twoyearly_ON_desc: You will receive your empire's biannual event as per normal.
ufp_espionage_0_desc: No additional support from Starfleet Intelligence.
ufp_espionage_3_desc: Activate the Section 31 policy with all the benefits and risks associated.
ufp_membership_auth_target_desc: The Authoritarian nature of this empire is slowing down the process of joining the Fedetation.
ufp_membership_fed_builder_target_desc: This worlds desire to build a federation is helping to speed up the membership process.
ufp_membership_major_target_desc: The size and power of this empire is resulting in a more complicated integration into the UFP.
ufp_membership_milit_target_desc: The militaristic nature of this empire is slowing down the process of joining the Fedetation.
ufp_membership_our_envoy_improve_desc: Our Envoys are currently attempting to work through integration details.
ufp_membership_significant_target_desc: The incredible size and power of this empire is resulting in a more complicated integration into the UFP.
ufp_membership_their_envoy_improve_desc: Their Envoys are currently attempting to work through integration details.
ufp_membership_war_owner_desc: Our war is slowing down the membership process.
ufp_membership_war_target_desc: Their war is currently slowing down the membership process.
uhura_background: Uhura had a distinguished career as a communications officer aboard the USS Enterprise and USS Enterprise-A and was later given command of the USS Leondegrance until her retirement.
underspace_corridor_0_CONSTRUCTION_INFO_: The Underspace Corridor must be built around an available star or black hole inside your empire.
underspace_corridor_0_DESC: The Underspace is a network of subspace corridors that extends through the galaxy, allowing starships to traverse vast distances in a short time.
underspace_corridor_0_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETA: An underspace corridor is an energy conduit into the realm of subspace known as underspace.
undine_bio_activate: Activating this relic will grant research bonus and the potential to lock ancient secrets.
undine_bombardment_2_desc:
Undine Infestation results in the total conversion of a system into a fludic environment.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Massive damage to Buildings
- Heavy damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Can convert whole systems into a fluidic domain
undine_bombardment_desc:
Undine Planet Devastation blankets the planet in high energy plasma with the explicit aim of maximizing civilian casualties and destroying as much as the planet as possible.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Massive damage to Buildings
- Heavy damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Can reduce planets to lifeless worlds
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_1_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

The core component of the Undine food production process. This unit utilises specialized enzymes to break down organic material, providing the fundamental energy needed for their biostructures.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_2_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

An upgraded nutrient production facility. Instead of simple decomposition, this chamber synthesises complex biomolecules, creating a more efficient and energy-dense nutrient source for the Undine population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_3_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

A centralised facility designed to rapidly convert and distribute nutrient resources across a colony. Its hyper-efficient metabolic processes allow it to sustain a massive Undine population with minimal resources.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_4_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

An immense biological structure that assimilates a planet's available organic matter and converts it into a universally compatible nutrient source. It represents the ultimate expression of the Undine's bio-engineering superiority.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_nursery_1_desc:
Population Assembly

Undine spawning grounds are a sacred and well guarded location on any Undine infestation. The next generation of warriors are grown and cared for until they are ready to carry on the great purpose.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
undine_building_nursery_2_desc:
Population Assembly

The improved Undine Hatchery provides greater care for the Undine spawn, allowing them to be tended with more efficiency to produce an even more perfected brood.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Population Assembly.
undine_building_nursery_3_desc:
Population Assembly

The rapid growth of the new Undine spawn requires the creation of nurseries where new hatchlings can be incubated quickly. It is outfitted with ideal conditions that can ensure optimal growth for these new Undine.

This building is equivalent to a level 9 £ Population Assembly.
undine_consume_tooltip: The impure biological species only serve one purpose as resources for the Undine. Infect a selection of the population with our infestation and convert them into materials we need.
undine_convert_tooltip: Convert this colonised Proto-bio World into a full Bio-World.
undine_defense_desc: Lurking in the darkness the Undine Defenders are prepared to do whatever it takes to defend the hive.
undine_infest_tooltip: Infest a section of the native population with our infestation virus and convert them into the biological superior Undine.
undine_occupation_army_desc: Specially bred soldiers of the Undine, who use their power and strength to take on threats.
undine_planet_poi_desc: The secret to progressing the mystery of Fluidic space can be found by terraforming and colonising this planet.
undine_spread_the_virus_tooltip: This planet will be slowly infected and transformed into a world the undine can live on, as a result it will kill many of the native population and damage most of the infrastructure.
uplifting_desc: Allows genetically Uplifting and socially integrating Species which are close to being sentient.
utopia_planitia_object_desc: Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards Command Centre
utopia_planitia_object_tooltip: The Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards allow the construction of flagships and other famous starships.
vale_background: Christine Vale was born on Izar, where her mother was a peace officer. Vale followed in her mother's footsteps, becoming a peace officer, working with a Starfleet security officer inspired her to join Starfleet where she quickly climbed the ranks.
varont_disruptor_desc_details: Only five were ever produced the disruptor literally tears the body apart at the molecular level from the inside out.
varont_disruptor_desc_short: A hand-held directed-energy weapon banned by many due to its vicious nature.
vulcan_trophy_activate: Celebrate Earth's Victory with increased physics research output and ship survey speed.
war_demand_assimilate_planet_belongs_to_: Planet doesn't belong to our opponents.
war_demand_assimilate_planet_not_under_o: Planet is occupied by another enemy of theirs.
war_goal_wg_abronath_1_desc: We should seize the fragment of the Abronath for ourselves.
war_goal_wg_abronath_2_desc: We should seize the fragment of the Abronath for ourselves.
war_goal_wg_abronath_3_desc: We should seize the fragment of the Abronath for ourselves.
war_goal_wg_ally_defence_desc: When our allies are under attack we do the right thing and come to their aid.
war_goal_wg_annexation_desc: Proclaim sovereignty over territory of another empire outside of our domain.
war_goal_wg_bajoran_occupation_desc: The rich fertile lands of Bajor are ready to serve their Cardassian betters, and who are we to deny the Bajoran's our help.
war_goal_wg_borg_assimilation_defence_de: War is waged to defend against assimilation.
war_goal_wg_borg_assimilation_desc: War is waged to assimilate valuable targets.
war_goal_wg_civil_war_loyalist_desc: War is waged to consolidate power and settle an internal dispute.
war_goal_wg_civil_war_rebel_desc: War is waged to consolidate power and settle an internal dispute.
war_goal_wg_civil_war_undine_desc: There can only be one true supreme biological master of Fluidic Space.
war_goal_wg_cleanse_border_worlds_desc: We must protect our borders, our neighbour is encroaching on our territory, we must push them back.
war_goal_wg_cleanse_border_worlds_effect: [From.GetName] is forced to abandon contested border territories, abandoning colonies and dismantling starbases.
war_goal_wg_demilitarisation_desc: War is waged to demand Demilitarisation, which will raise their Shipyard Build Cost and Claim Influence Cost by +33%, and reducing their Naval Capacity by -33%.
war_goal_wg_dominion_desc: Our Dominion over the solids must progress, forcing another empire to join the mighty Dominion and subject itself to the power of the Founders.
war_goal_wg_end_occupation_desc: Wage war to end the forced occupation and subjection of our people.
war_goal_wg_honour_revenge_desc: Our honour has been harmed and our people demand revenge.
war_goal_wg_house_feud_desc: Great Houses often feud among themselves over matters of honour.
war_goal_wg_klingon_civil_war_loyalist_d: War is rage for control over the Klingon Empire.
war_goal_wg_klingon_civil_war_rebel_desc: War is rage for control over the Klingon Empire.
war_goal_wg_occupation_desc: Wage war to occupy the target planet.
war_goal_wg_plunder_revenge_desc: Pirates have looted one of our planets, this cannot be allowed to remain unchallenged.
war_goal_wg_quadrant_invasion_defence_de: Threat of invasion from a major power from another Quadrant brings races and empires together to defend against the invaders.
war_goal_wg_quadrant_invasion_desc: A new quadrant represents a wealth of new targets to stretch our Dominion over. War is raged to seize control of the Quadrant for the glory of the Founders.
war_goal_wg_relic_hunters_reclamation_de: War is waged to demand the return of our cultural relics. All stolen relics will be returned to us.
war_goal_wg_relic_hunters_sampling_desc: War is waged to preserve valuable samples of primitive species. A small number of pops of each unique species will be transferred to either the museum world or the capital, and all significant cultural relics will be seized.
war_goal_wg_revenge_desc: We have been wronged and our people demand revenge.
war_goal_wg_rightfully_ours_desc: We fight to claim compensation for what should rightfully belong to us.
war_goal_wg_romulan_earth_war_desc: The proxy was has ended and now the bloodshed begins as Earth and Romulus finally go to war.
war_goal_wg_system_denial_disarm_desc: War is waged to demand disarmament of all star-destroying trilithium weapons, preventing their usage. In addition, we demand demilitarisation, which will raise their Shipyard Build Cost and Claim Influence Cost by 33%, and reducing their Naval Capacity by 33%.
war_goal_wg_system_denial_eternal_reveng: We have been wronged! Our home system has been destroyed, and for that our people demand REVENGE! Total War until either side is destroyed or status quo achieved...
war_goal_wg_system_denial_reconnect_desc: War is waged to reclaim and reconnect an isolated colony and rejoin it to the wider galaxy, sealing the subspace rupture with pulse wave torpedoes.
war_goal_wg_total_conquest_desc: War is waged to completely conquer the enemy.
war_goal_wg_trade_embargo_desc: War is waged to demand a Trade Embargo, reducing their food production, mineral production, energy production and unity production by -25%.
war_goal_wg_undine_purge_defence_desc: The galaxy must be defended against the invaders from Fluidic Space.
war_goal_wg_universe_defence_desc: War is waged to defend against invasion from the Mirror Universe.
war_in_heaven.2.desc: The return of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Unaffected Races present in our galaxy. The [From.GetSpeciesName] in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two precursors are ancient rivals, and though the reasons for their rivalry has long since faded into history, the sudden reawakening of [FirstSleeper.GetName] has enflamed old animosities and triggered a counter-reaction. The [From.GetName] have roused themselves from their slumber to face their old rivals, with the whole galaxy as their battleground.
war_machine_desc: Massive mechanical monstrosities outfitted with high yield weaponry, able to take on numerous planetary armies by themselves.
war_posture_policy_desc: This Policy defines our empires stance during war time.
warpcapable_age_desc: This species has developed early warp technology and broken the light barrier, which has opened the minds of the population and united the world under one government, however as yet they have not expanded from their world. They are aware of other races that populate the galaxy, but tend to keep to themselves for now.
watchtowner_build_stage_CONSTRUCTION_INF: The underlying substructure of the station that once completed will form a Watchtower Class Station.
watchtowner_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of the station that once completed will form a Watchtower Class Station.
watchtowner_build_stage_MEGASTRUCTURE_DE: The underlying substructure of the station that once completed will form a Watchtower Class Station.
wesley_crusher_background: Son of Dr. Crusher and Jack Crusher, Wesley was always destined for great things and a future amongst the stars.

wg_annexation_desc: Proclaim sovereignty over territory of another empire outside of our domain.
wg_assimilation_accept: [Root.GetName] successfully achieves its assimilation goals against the [From.GetName].
wg_bajoran_occupation_desc: The rich fertile lands of Bajor are ready to serve their Cardassian betters, and who are we to deny the Bajoran's our help.
wg_border_wars_event_accept.tooltip: [From.GetName] victory secures our borders and allows us to take ownership of the planets we claimed and form a DMZ to protect us from future aggression.
wg_border_wars_event_desc: We are locked in battle against our neighbours to secure our Borders.
wg_border_wars_event_status_quo.tooltip: On accepting a Status Quo both sides must agree to create a DMZ between the empires.
wg_civil_war_loyalist_accept: [Root.GetName] successfully defends against the subversive [From.GetName] rebels.
wg_civil_war_undine_accept.tooltip: [From.GetName] is defeated and is forced to become a world under the control of the mighty Undine.

wg_dominion_war_accept.tooltip: [From.GetName] becomes a member of the Dominion whether they like it or not.
