progress.2.desc.storm.normal:
In the words of one [Root.Owner.GetScientist], "Get a load of this little guy!"

Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.
progress.2.desc.storm.gestalt:
We vibrate with excitement.

Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.
progress.2.desc.storm.outro:
Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.
progress.3.desc.storm.normal:
"Incredible," [ruler.GetRegnalName] exclaimed. "A new world ripe with opportunity!"

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, the first explorers are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.
progress.3.desc.storm.gestalt:
A thrilling discovery! A new world ripe with opportunity!!

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, exploratory nodes are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.
progress.4.desc.storm:
Out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! An alien civilization with equivalent technology. They must have entered the galactic fray right around the time we did.

Their appearance heralds a new frontier of experience. Do they come as like minded allies, or rivals to test our mettle? Either way, the thrill of the unknown beckons us forward.
progress.5.desc.storm.normal:
We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName]. As one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] put it, "These things might not seem like much yet, but their potential is massive!"

For now however, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.
progress.5.desc.storm.gestalt:
We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName].

We thrill to see what comes of their potential, but for now, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.
progress.6.desc.storm: From out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! But the initial vibes are totally off; these people don't share our ways, and prefer to keep to themselves. We'd best back off for now.
progress.6.h.storm: They should get with the times.
pirate.1.desc.storm:
Space pirates! Even the thought is a thrill, and a group calling themselves [pirate_band.GetName] have turned their sights on us.

While we can respect their choice of lifestyle, the effect it's having on our trade networks is less ideal.
situation_stormfall_desc: Intense weather on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has revealed the exhilarating power of storms. If we master the control of planetary weather, we could harness that knowledge on a cosmic scale. Constructing storm attraction buildings will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.
situation_stormfall_monthly_change_toolt: We will learn to master these storms.
situation_stormfall_outcome: The birth of a cosmic storm.
stage_stormfall_effects: We must learn how to manipulate cosmic storms.
situation_stormfall_finish_project_tt: Must Finish Special Project: Tempest Brewing
cs_storm_chasers_storm_fruition_desc: The awakening of our own personal cosmic storm has amped our people for years to come.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_fruition_gestalt_: The awakening of our own personal cosmic storm has amped our consciousness for years to come.
cs_storm_chasers_homeworld_storm_attract: This planet's relentless storms have driven its lifeforms into two distinct paths: those who seek shelter from the chaos, and those who revel in the thrill of the tempest.
PROJECT_TEMPEST_BREWING_DESC: This once-in-a-lifetime storm system on [Owner.Capital.GetName] has special properties that make it ripe for modulation. But first, we'll need to better understand its underlying composition. Who knows what brilliant oddity we may bring to life?
cstorms.3100.name: Stormfall
cstorms.3100.desc:
Naturally occurring storms on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows its path of destruction.

Recently, weather stations across the planet have detected an extraordinary phenomenon: a network of superstorms poised to sweep across the world.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.
cstorms.3105.name: Tempest Brewing
cstorms.3105.desc:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.

Special buildings can serve as coordination centers for raising storms. A building on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] that increases storm attraction will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.
cstorms.3105.a.tt:
A storm attraction building on the capital planet:
$situation_speed_tt$: +10%

A Storm Attraction Array in the capital system station:
$situation_speed_tt$: +10%
cstorms.3110.name: The Advent
cstorms.3110.desc.outro:
By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.
cstorms.3110.desc.regular:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.

By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.
cstorms.3110.desc.hive:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we have yet to decide which storm type is the most glorious.

By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.
cstorms.3110.desc.machine:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But our value judgment processes are stuck in recursive loops trying to determine which storm type is the most glorious.

By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.
cstorms.3130.name: Get Out There
cstorms.3130.desc.electric:
The sky rumbles. Lightning sizzles all around us!

Not only have these powerful discharges electrified the planet's surface, but they've left us truly amped! While farming will suffer from Electrical Storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.
cstorms.3130.desc.magnetic:
Compasses spin wildly as the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] contorts itself.

By boring through the crust of our homeworld, we were able to inject magnetized matter directly into the core, and the natural storms amplified the resulting field fluctuations. This will hamper energy generation, but improve the detection of new mineral deposits.
cstorms.3130.desc.gravity:
Never before has simple movement around been so exhilarating! Gravity increases and decreases without a moment's notice.

Particle manipulation sites scattered across [owner.capital_scope.GetName] reversed the polarity of tachyons, which focused them into crackling balls of energy. As the orbs quickly vanished - [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they were sent backward in time - gravity waves rippled in all directions.

The resulting fluctuations will make working on the planet's surface harder, but could improve jobs on orbiting stations.
cstorms.3140.name: Good Vibrations
cstorms.3140.desc.intro: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.
cstorms.3140.desc.electric:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Electric Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.
cstorms.3140.desc.magnetic:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Magnetic Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Charging our sun would amplify the storm's electric potential, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.
cstorms.3140.desc.gravity:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an Gravity Storm, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while charging our sun would instead amplify the storm's electric potential.

cstorms.3160.name: After the Storm
cstorms.3160.desc:
When the planetary storm dispersed, a new lasting feature appeared on [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.

As exhilarating as this local storm was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?
cstorms.3160.a.tt.electric: The storm left behind electrified Buzzing Plains on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].
cstorms.3160.a.tt.magnetic: The storm left behind new Thermal Vent on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].
cstorms.3160.a.tt.gravity: The storm revealed a Rich Mountain on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].
cstorms.3170.name: Cosmic Shapes
cstorms.3170.desc.intro: We can hasten the appearance of the immense cosmic storm around [owner.capital_scope.GetStarName], but must ask ourselves - are we truly ready for the ride of our lives?
cstorms.3170.desc.scientist.snippet: A team of [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] led by [event_target:storm_scientist.GetName] could research these early cosmic storm patterns to find optimal ways to manipulate their formation.
cstorms.3170.desc.commander.snippet: If we send the military led by [event_target:storm_commander.GetName], they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.
cstorms.3170.desc.outro: This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!
cstorms.3170.desc.both:
We can hasten the appearance of the immense cosmic storm around [owner.capital_scope.GetStarName], but must ask ourselves - are we truly ready for the ride of our lives?

A team of [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] led by [event_target:storm_scientist.GetName] could research these early cosmic storm patterns to find optimal ways to manipulate their formation.

If we send the military led by [event_target:storm_commander.GetName], they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.

This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!

cstorms.3170.desc.commander:
We can hasten the appearance of the immense cosmic storm around [owner.capital_scope.GetStarName], but must ask ourselves - are we truly ready for the ride of our lives?

If we send the military led by [event_target:storm_commander.GetName], they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.

This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!
cstorms.3170.desc.none:
All we can do now is wait for the cosmic storm to take shape.

The anticipation is almost unbearable, but will make the payoff even greater.
cstorms.3170.a.tt: Scientist [event_target:storm_scientist.GetName] is temporarily lost and at risk of death.
cstorms.3170.b.tt: Commander [event_target:storm_commander.GetName] is temporarily lost and at risk of death.
cstorms.3190.name: The First of Many
cstorms.3190.desc.intro:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies.
cstorms.3190.desc.success:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. Our leader riding out through the storm has whipped up a frenzy of excitement.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!
cstorms.3190.desc.failure:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. Our leader was lost in the storm, but what a way to go out!

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!
cstorms.3190.desc.wait:
It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.

Sculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies. We have waited long, but the day is finally here.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!
cstorms.3190.a.failure.tt: Our leader went out in a blaze of glory.
cs_storm_chasers_bad_vibes_desc: We feel a sudden onset of ennui.
cstorms.3205.name: Fury's Sake
cstorms.3205.normal:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing. The achievements of our ancestors, legendary in their scope and ambition, cast a long shadow.

"These struggles are most existential!" one of our top minds recently wrote. "By traversing the void, have we opened a void in ourselves?"

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!
cstorms.3205.gestalt:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing.

We are plagued by questions: do we truly know who we are? Are our glory days behind us? As a collective, we have a responsibility to become the best version of ourselves.

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!
cstorms.3205.tooltip: Discover the challenges of the past in the Situation Log.
cstorms.3215.name: Fever Broken
cstorms.3215.intro:
We've done it!

Setting our sights on the pure pursuit of thrills, we've met every challenge. Witness what we've accomplished in the past years!
cstorms.3215.desc:
We've done it!

Setting our sights on the pure pursuit of thrills, we've met every challenge. Witness what we've accomplished in the past years!

Like the most excellent pioneers of our homeworld, we have pushed ourselves beyond our limits.

Even better, due to our engagement with nature's fury, we have gained incredible insight into the meaning of our existence.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_frenzy_1_desc: The advent of the Big One sets us in a state of frenzy.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_frenzy_2_desc: The advent of the Big One sets us in a state of frenzy.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_frenzy_3_desc: The advent of the Big One sets us in a state of frenzy.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_frenzy_1_gestalt_: The advent of the Big One sets our consciousness aflame.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_frenzy_2_gestalt_: The advent of the Big One sets our consciousness aflame.
cs_storm_chasers_storm_frenzy_3_gestalt_: The advent of the Big One sets our consciousness aflame.
cs_storm_chasers_the_code_desc: It is not supremacy that drives us, nor material gain. We live to test our limits, disciples of the bleeding edge of existence.
cs_storm_chasers_the_code_gestalt_desc: It is not supremacy that drives us, nor material gain. We live to test our limits, disciples of the bleeding edge of existence.
cs_stormfrenzy_chain_desc: We have always pushed the limits. Inspired by the deeds of our predecessors, we now have the chance to sculpt the storm of our dreams.
cstorms.3220.name: A Chaser's Creed
cstorms.3220.desc:
Our people will never stop looking for a thrill. Every day we discover incredible situations and face greater challenges, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] thinks we can go even further:

"The core of a cosmic storm is pure potential; the true, bleeding edge. An edge sharp enough to sever the status-quo and unleash the rush of a lifetime."

The time is ripe to provoke a storm of truly epic proportions, a nexus of joyous pandemonium: The Big One. Only two minor details remain: a final study to determine exactly how to invoke the perfect storm, and the opinion of the rest of the galaxy should we choose to do so.

Bringing something like this into being is sure to stir up some resentment.
PROJECT_SOW_THE_BIG_ONE_DESC: We have the technology, but without a nascent storm in the vicinity, we will need to investigate how to seed a storm we can sculpt.
cstorms.3222.name: Dark Matter Cultivation
cstorms.3222.desc:
The unique properties of Dark Matter make it the perfect thing to stir up The Big One. We will inject this elusive material into the spatial fabric surrounding our capital system and wait for the first ripples of the storm to appear.

However, this has already attracted some unwanted attention: our neighbors have begun to protest. "Not everyone is as stoked as us to ride this particular wave," complained one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural].
cstorms.3222.b: We need to save up some resources.
PROJECT_DARK_SEEDING_DESC: By carefully injecting Dark Matter into the spatial fabric, a malleable storm will be provoked within this system.
cstorms.3224.name: Onset of The Big One
cstorms.3224.desc:
Incredible! The nascent vibrations of the coming storm are already being felt. The work of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] is ongoing, but we are now one step closer to summoning The Big One.

However, our neighbors are less pleased. They claim we're meddling with powers we cannot possibly comprehend, and this has already affected our relations.
cstorms.3225.name: Feeding the Big One
cstorms.3225.desc:
The data is clear: whatever we put into this storm, something similar will come out of it. Ergo, if we feed it the right type of resources, then it will take on properties - and epic proportions- of every type of storm.

The people of the galaxy continue to express concern, but the ride of the century is just waiting to be born. Let us feed it what we have!
cstorms.3226.name: The Ultimate Feast
cstorms.3226.desc: We must provide the nascent storm a wide variety of nourishment if we wish to create a storm of epic proportions. This amazing feat requires a specific sampling of resources at our disposal.
PROJECT_EVERY_ITEM_ON_THE_MENU_DESC: We now know that a cosmic storm can be manipulated by feeding it the correct diet. To feed this one, we require a certain sampling.
PROJECT_EVERY_ITEM_ON_THE_MENU_REPEAT_DE: Creating the perfect storm will require a carefully measured sampling of resources.
cstorms.3227.name: The Final Push
cstorms.3227.desc:
The excitement is palpable. The path ahead grows clear: push further, push harder, push through. Let us become one with cosmic frenzy itself! Everything is now ready for the Big One. We just need to give one small push.

Our neighbors are already beyond livid, claiming that our so-called 'Nexus Storm' will wreak havoc on the galaxy. But are we really going to let these killjoys derail a project of such epic proportions? The time to choose is now.
cstorms.3227.a: The Big One is our ultimate destiny!
cstorms.3227.a.tt:
Nexus Storm arrives in 40 days.
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s opinion of us changes by: $@third_hit_opinion_change$
cstorms.3227.b: No, we are better than this!
cstorms.3227.b.tt:
Nexus Storm aborted.
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s opinion improves in 40 days.
cstorms.3230.name: Genesis of the Big One
cstorms.3230.desc:
Here we are - at the precipice of a new experience. The time of ultimate calamity has arrived. There is nothing our Storm Riders won't face. No challenge we will ever deny.

Let the galaxy witness!
cstorms.3235.name: Storm Coda
cstorms.3235.desc:
We have learned much. Now we understand that the galaxy is not a toy to be played with, but an adventure to be experienced.

[ruler.GetRegnalName] said it best: "In this life, there are no shortages of thrills. We'll never stop seeking the next challenge, but we must do so with respect. This is what we have chosen. This is who we are truly meant to be.
cs_stormfever_chain_desc: To reach new heights, to know joy and to test our limits, we now embark on a series of trials. Let the fun begin!
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_1: Defeat a Fleet Inside a Storm
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_1_DESC:
The heat of battle has always been a proving ground. Now imagine experiencing it from within the raging heart of a cosmic storm! Let's show the galaxy just how wild we really are.

The challenge now is to defeat an enemy fleet in a storm.
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_2: Explore the Edge of the Galaxy
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_2_DESC:
To go beyond our own borders, to balance on the edge of the stars, to seek the furthest reaches of space - is there anything more invigorating?

We'll need to send a Science Ship to the designated system - any way we can.
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_3_DESC:
The best of the best yearn for the thrill of the storm. Let them cruise and thrive!

Our next challenge is to help a Storm Rider weather a cosmic storm for more than 180 days.
days_storm_rider_spend_in_storm: Days Rider Spent in a Storm
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_4_DESC:
A galaxy full of buried treasure and ancient secrets - and a wicked wind to stir them up! Let's get out there and see what we can find.

Let's challenge ourselves to investigate an anomaly or archaeology site revealed by a storm.
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_5_DESC:
Why should we have all the fun? When it comes to adventure, it's always better to share.

To help our neighbors feel included, the challenge now is to cause a cosmic storm to veer into their space.
MISSION_CS_STORM_FEVER_CHALLENGE_6_DESC:
It is not in our style to grow old and fade away. Far better to burn out in a blaze of glory!

The next challenge is to help a Storm Rider experience their final moments inside a cosmic storm.
rider_died_in_storm: Storm Riders Killed or MIA in Storms
challenge_completed_intro: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!
cstorms.305.name: Challenge Completed: Defeat a Fleet Inside a Storm
cstorms.305.desc:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

That fleet never had any fighting chance. Who dares challenge us next?
cstorms.310.name: Challenge Completed: Explore the Edge of the Galaxy
cstorms.310.desc:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The galaxy has so much to offer! There's never a dull moment, and there's no sense stopping now. Onward to the next challenge!
cstorms.315.name: Challenge Completed: Ride the Storms
cstorms.315.desc.normal:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

Our Storm Rider reported back with nothing but exultant cheers. The cosmic storms are a whole new level of thrill!
cstorms.315.desc.gestalt:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

We feel filled with exultation. The cosmic storms bring excitement to a whole new level.
cstorms.320.name: Challenge Completed: Investigate the Unearthed
cstorms.320.desc:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

Delving into ancient secrets and unearthing buried treasure is always a thrill. Who knows what's still out there, just waiting to be found?
cstorms.325.name: Challenge Completed: Spread the Joy
cstorms.325.desc:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

That storm tore right through their space, spreading thrills and disarray in equal measure! We can rest easy knowing we provided our neighbors with such an incredible experience

They may not appreciate it now, but they'll thank us eventually.
cstorms.330.name: Challenge Completed: Succumb to Tempest
cstorms.330.desc.normal:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend! May your journey to the great beyond be as epic as your exit.
cstorms.330.desc.gestalt:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.
cstorms.331.desc.normal:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend!
cstorms.331.desc.gestalt:
New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

The great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Nearly losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.
electric_storm_desc: The collision of electromagnetic fields imbues this cosmic storm with near a dangerous level of electric charge. Hazardous for shields, but beneficial for planetary production.
particle_storm_desc: These storms almost seem alive, moving through and within the galactic fabric, neither hunting nor avoiding spaceborne vessels. Dangerous and unstable, their mere presence is enough to unite a civilization in defiance of the elements.
gravity_storm_desc: When massive stellar bodies collide, the resulting impact sends gravitational ripples throughout the galaxy. When these in turn collapse, a gravity storm is born. Negative effects on ship targeting systems, and the fluctuating gravity makes almost everyone forced to stay at home.
magnetic_storm_desc: When roving metallic asteroid belts interact with strong gravitational forces, magnetic fields are formed within. Storms of this type rip hulls apart and cause interruptions to industrial construction - yet they also assist in bringing up valuable minerals from a planet's crust.
solar_storm_desc: A Radiant Storm creates a glistening fluctuation within the spatial fabric. Its presence causes stars to produce unprecedented flares. The resultant radiation is extremely damaging, but supercharges space station output and makes it hard for ships to stay hidden.
celestial_storm_desc: At any given moment, dust from millions of planets is drifting aimlessly through the galaxy. Sometimes these granules gather in such significant quantities that a dust storm results. Disturbs planet-wide communication, but the chemical elements it brings are useful for resource production. Objects inside these tempests may as well not exist as far as our scanners are concerned.
shroud_storm_desc: On rare occasions, the Shroud may whisper through the physical world. These rare storms expose sentients to visions both sublime and grotesque. Those who have communed with the Shroud can even enjoy a fickle synergy.
nexus_storm_desc: When the stars align, even a minor cosmic storm can grow beyond conventional limits. This rare event will unleash terror of apocalyptic proportions. There is no thriving inside this abomination; the only option is to survive.
hyper_ecosystem_desc: This planet's soil contains uniquely high concentrations of nitrogen and phosphorus, reabsorbed from naturally formed minerals in the crust. This results in extraordinarily rapid plant growth; great for farming, but hampering any building projects.
docile_fauna_desc: This planet's wildlife and plant growth lacks many natural predators, making them unusually docile, and thus pleasant to live with. The population is checked by storm damage rather than survival of the fittest.
obsidian_lakes_desc: Tectonic activity has caused magma lakes to cool into enormous sheets of obsidian, bringing valuable resources much closer to the surface.
obsidian_lakes_volcanic_desc: Tectonic activity has caused magma lakes to cool into enormous sheets of obsidian, bringing valuable resources much closer to the surface.
crimson_crawlers_tt: This planet cannot be colonized by Machine or Terravore empires.
crimson_crawlers_desc: The planet's surface is a carpet of crimson due to the presence of trillions of tiny red insects. Despite their incredible numbers, they appear harmless, and have managed to establish a tenuous balance within the planet's ecosystem.
metal_planet_desc: This planet is entirely covered in crude, naturally occurring metals. It lacks basic life necessities such as water or a breathable atmosphere, but does contain a lot of usable resources!
terraform_fail_is_metal_planet: This planet cannot be terraformed due to its metallic crust.
previously_terraformed_planet_desc: A rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and plenty of oceans. There is evidence of older empires having reached and colonized this planet before, but they have since disappeared. This means there is a lot to discover and uncover, but also leaves the planet a pre-made candidate for a colony!
previously_terraformed_planet_tt: Previous terraforming attempts make turning this planet into a Gaia world much easier.
has_patriotic_institut_desc: This planet was once the foundation of the adAkkaria Convention. The Patriotic Institute of Celebration is all that is left of this once mighty civilization.
has_patriotic_institute_tt: Has building: Patriotic Institute of Celebration. Colonize this planet to gain ownership.
adakkaria_patriotic_institute_desc.super: Chance every year a Storm is triggered in the system at the cost of 100 £ Pops.
crimson_crawlers_sashimi_style_desc: The planet's surface is a deep shade of crimson due to the presence of trillions of tiny red insects. Even when consumed raw, they are a delectable source of food.
crimson_crawlers_bbq_them_desc: The planet's surface is a deep shade of crimson due to the presence of trillions of tiny red insects. They have become a joy for the population to grill and consume.
COLONIZATION_IMPOSSIBLE_CRIMSON_CRAWLERS: This planet cannot be colonized by Machine or Terravore empires.
collided_planet_desc: Two planets crashed into one, and rather than destroying each other, they have become entangled. While boasting increased usable surface area, the world poses unique habitation and building challenges.
wooden_planet_desc: Over thousands of years, this planet's crust has become a dense layer of roots several kilometers thick, making it one titanic living organism.
wooden_planet_tt:
Housing costs £ $concept_food$ to build and upkeep.
Farms cost $w_food$ to build.
eruption_report_tooltip: The reports will arrive within 30 days.
colony_mod.31.name: Eruption!
colony_mod.31.desc: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.
colony_mod.32.name: Eruption Damage Report
colony_mod.32.desc: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has turned into an active volcano! Anything that once existed there is now buried under molten rock.
colony_mod.33.desc: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage. In a fortunate twist, it has also shattered the Obsidian for easy gathering!
colony_mod.34.desc: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage!

TEMPEST_INVOCATOR_VIEW_BODY:
The waiting potential of this device is tangible even in a powered-down state. Should we have the courage to use it, we would harness the power of the storms themselves.

Select a location to spawn a Nexus Storm.
cstorms_tutorial.1.name: Tutorial: Storm Manipulation
cstorms_tutorial.1.desc: We can manipulate the path of a Cosmic Storm for our own benefit. Either to deflect them away from our systems, or attract them to utilize their positive effects.
TUTORIAL_STORM_FORECAST_MAP_MODE_DESC:
This map mode visualizes any Cosmic Storms in the galaxy, with information on their effects.

£

To access the weather forecast map mode, click the map icon in the bottom right.

With advanced technology, it can be upgraded to give increasingly accurate predictions not only of the location and direction of a Cosmic Storm, but also what type of storm to expect.
concept_weather_forecasting_mode_desc:
This map mode visualizes any Cosmic Storms in the galaxy, with information on their effects.

To access the weather forecast map mode, click the map icon in the bottom right.

With advanced technology, it can be upgraded to give increasingly accurate predictions not only of the location and direction of a Cosmic Storm, but also what type of storm to expect.
TUTORIAL_STORM_PROTECTION_DESC:
Cosmic Storms are a formidable force of nature. They can have devastating effects on our fleets, economy, and even our population. However, they can also provide great opportunities.

Researching Storm Technology provides us with buildings and tech to greatly reduce the negative effects of a storm. With additional research should even be able to take advantage of the storms.
MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC: Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.
MESSAGE_ELECTRIC_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOT:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The extreme electrical charges carried by the storm will present a danger to our fleets' shield systems. However, we are expecting a significant increase in colony production and ship speed due to the abundant energy present in the storm.
MESSAGE_SOLAR_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The radiation from this storm will make fleets caught inside visible to anyone who has the storm on their scanners. While this presents some security risks, our stations will operate much more efficiently under these conditions.
MESSAGE_CELESTIAL_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPO:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

This type of storm will jam our sensors, making us unable to detect other fleets within these systems and slow down space travel. Despite these risks, we should be able to use these conditions to our advantage and increase the output of certain jobs throughout the duration of the storm.
MESSAGE_NEXUS_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

This type of storm poses an extreme risk to our colonies, fleets, and stations. They will be taking heavy damage until it passes.
MESSAGE_SHROUD_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTE:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The heavy concentration of psionic energy in this storm will significantly reduce stability in our colonies, but aid in the effectiveness of fleet evasion.

Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The heavy concentration of psionic energy in this storm will significantly reduce stability in our colonies, but our knowledge in navigating the Shroud will aid us in the effectiveness of our fleets and Telepaths.

The Shroud stirs... We must be prepared for anything.
MESSAGE_GRAVITY_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTT:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The heavy gravitational influences of this storm will inflict progressive difficulty to fleet operations, with our larger ships at the highest risk.

Despite these issues, our colonies will be able to use this extreme environment to our advantage, enhancing the effectiveness of certain tasks.
MESSAGE_MAGNETIC_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOT:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The extreme magnetic forces of this storm will place our fleet and structural maintenance systems in disarray.

The storm's magnetic forces have created an unexpected synergy with our advanced metallurgical techniques. This interaction should reduce the costs associated with our Metallurgists throughout the duration of this galactic event.
MESSAGE_PARTICLE_STORM_COSMIC_STORM_SPOT:
Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.

This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.

The density of the particulate debris in this storm will inflict devastating effects on ships and stations, negating their shield regeneration entirely. Those fleets brave enough to remain inside should prepare for a highly dangerous environment.
electric_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: The Electric Storm has impacted construction speeds, but will boost energy production.
particle_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: The Particle Storm has left corrosive particulate across the planet.
gravity_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: A Gravity Storm has passed, leaving behind gravitational anomalies on one of our colonies.
magnetic_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: A Magnetic Storm has passed. Our colony reports electromagnetic disturbances in the polar regions.
solar_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: The Radiant Storm has left dangerous levels of radioactive contamination across the planet.
celestial_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: The Stardust Storm has left the planet coated in a thick fog of cosmic dust.
shroud_storm_aftermath_custom_desc: A Shroud Storm has caused a rise in paranormal activity across the planet.

pm_magnetized_planetary_core_desc: Electromagnetic activity in the deep mantle makes magnetic mining viable while also disrupting technical infrastructure.
cstorms.1705.name: Hyper-Magnetized Planetary Core
cstorms.1705.desc:
Unusual after effects are being reported on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent Magnetic Storm. The storm's potent energy fields increased magnetic volatility in the planet's molten core, resulting in the widespread failure of technological infrastructure.

However, the situation also presents a unique resource extraction opportunity. Metal-rich lava flows underneath the planet's mantle are now electromagnetically charged and can be harvested with the aid of mining magnets.
d_electrified_oceans_desc: A perpetual electrical current surges throughout the planet's vast ocean.
cstorms.1715.name: Electrified Oceans
cstorms.1715.desc.common: An unusual phenomenon has been observed on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent Electric Storm. The planet's [GetOceansState] have been left charged with a perpetual electrical current now circulating in this vast body of water, posing lethal risks for aquatic life.
cstorms.1715.desc.aquatic: This represents a serious threat for our colony's survival prospects and must be addressed immediately.
cstorms.1715.desc.non_aquatic: This phenomenon is causing us no direct harm but poses challenges to our colony's future development.
d_ghostly_canyon_desc: Ethereal apparitions are witnessed by those who visit this canyon.
cstorms.1725.name: Ghostly Apparitions
cstorms.1725.desc.common: Following the recent Shroud Storm in [this.solar_system.GetName], [owner.GetColonistPlural] report inexplicable sightings of ethereal apparitions in an isolated canyon. These ghostly blue figures appear briefly, unable or unwilling to interact with our [owner.GetColonistPlural], wandering aimlessly before dissipating.
cstorms.1725.desc.psionic: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any amount of mental communication with these entities. However, we have found their presence to be a passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.
cstorms.1725.desc.psionic_robot: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any psionic communication with these entities. However, system checks have confirmed that their presence provides passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.
cstorms.1725.desc.spiritualist: This remarkable phenomenon is providing a welcome reminder of the intangible wonders of our existence.
cstorms.1725.desc.gestalt: No physical harm or aggressive behavior has thus far been reported.
cstorms.1725.desc.default: No physical harm or damage has thus far been reported. Nonetheless, the strange phenomenon is proving to be an unsettling distraction.
cstorms.1725.a: Fill the canyon with earth. The dead will stay buried.
cstorms.1735.name: Volcanic Inactivity
cstorms.1735.desc:
The residual radiation from the recent [this.GetAffectedStormType] has led to erratic geological activity across [this.GetName].

Most notably, the impact of the storm has rendered an active volcano extinct, cutting it off from its geological hotspot and severing the supply of magma.

These changes present us with new opportunities to develop the planet further, as the cooling magma opens up new lands.
d_sky_mountain_desc: A colossal mountain range hangs suspended in the thin air of the planet's upper atmosphere, exposing fresh ore deposits.
cstorms.1745.name: Mountains in the Sky
cstorms.1745.desc:
A severe Gravity Storm caused an extraordinary transformation of [this.GetName]'s landscape. The storm's powerful gravitational fluctuations severed the planet's largest mountain range from its tectonic shelf, lifting it vertically above the planet.

It remains suspended in the upper atmosphere, held aloft by a residual gravitational effect of the storm. This remarkable upheaval has exposed previously inaccessible ore reserves in the bedrock underneath, as well as providing [owner.GetResearchers] with much to analyze.
cstorms.1755.name: Melting Glaciers
cstorms.1755.desc.common: The recent [this.GetAffectedStormType] has had an unexpected impact on the climate of [this.GetName].
cstorms.1755.desc.electric:
The increased electrical charge in the atmosphere has led to a drastic temperature shift in the polar region, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1755.desc.particle:
The corrosive effect of the storm's particles has heavily impacted the polar regions, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1755.desc.gravity:
The gravitational shifts brought on by the storm have shattered multiple layers of subaquatic ice, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1755.desc.magnetic:
The resulting disturbances in the planets magnetic fields have led to drastic seismic shifts, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1755.desc.solar:
The extreme heat of the storm raised the temperatures across the planet throughout its duration, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1755.desc.celestial:
Large concentrations of superheated celestial dust have heavily impacted the polar regions, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1755.desc.common_2:
causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.
cstorms.1761.name: Cosmic Clogging
cstorms.1761.desc.common: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on [this.GetName] report that the Stardust Storm is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.
cstorms.1761.desc.default:
The resulting hydroponic failures are heavily impacting the planet's agriculture, as well as leading to shortages in safe drinkable water.

This problem could have long-lasting consequences on our water supply if not dealt with. Fortunately, our [owner.GetEngineerPlural] are confident they can create more robust filtration systems to address the issue.
cstorms.1761.desc.lithoid: While investigating the hydroponic blockages, our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovered that the mineralized slurry itself is actually both delicious and nutritious when consumed by those with lithoid physiology. After making a few minor adjustments to the colony's filtration systems they have mass-produced a new seasonal drink with which to wait out the storm.
pm_satured_filtration_desc: The local water supply is saturated with celestial cosmic dust, causing blockages in the hydroponic network.
CLEAR_DUSTY_PIPES_PROJECT_DESC: The impact of a Stardust Storm on [this.GetName] has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.
cstorms.1765.name: Filters Unclogged
cstorms.1765.desc:
The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have dealt with the hydroponic blockages and water shortages on [this.GetName]. The colony's water supply network has been improved and can now filter out complex impurities such as those introduced by the Stardust Storm.

These improvements to our water infrastructure can be repurposed to improve irrigation efforts across the [Owner.GetName].
cstorms.1771.name: Flightless Fauna
cstorms.1771.desc.common:
The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] on [this.GetName] have observed harsh repercussions of the Gravity Storm on the local avian wildlife.

The gravitational fluctuations brought on by the storm are leading to erratic atmospheric conditions, rendering several species of avian fauna incapable of flight.
cstorms.1771.desc.default:
Not only is this preventing the creatures unable to hunt as normal, it is also leaving them vulnerable to predators.

There is concern that the afflicted species may be hunted to extinction if we do not intervene.
cstorms.1771.c: Place the creatures in a reserve.
cstorms.1771.evopred: Save their DNA before the end.
d_avian_reserve_desc: A secluded nature reserve built to house vulnerable species of avian fauna.
cstorms.1776.name: Airborne Again
cstorms.1776.desc:
Following the passing of the Gravity Storm, the temporarily flightless fauna of [this.GetName] have taken to the skies again having taken shelter inside our avian reserve.

While many of the creatures have now returned to their former habitats, significant numbers remain in the reserve, seemingly enjoying the comforts and protections it provides.

This presents a unique opportunity to study the planet's avian wildlife at close proximity.
cstorms.1801.name: Eye of the Storm
cstorms.1801.desc: Scans detect irregularities in the eye of [fromfrom.GetName] raging in [from.GetName], indicating that the formation is carrying a strange mass at its center. These unusual readings warrant closer investigation, before the storm dissipates or leaves the system.
EYE_OF_THE_STORM_PROJECT_DESC: Scans of [fromfrom.GetName] in [this.GetName] suggest it is carrying a large mass within its inner vortex. Long-range sensors have been unable to provide conclusive answers about this unusual phenomenon. A field expedition into the eye of the storm is required to advance our understanding.
cstorms.1805.name: Into the Vortex
cstorms.1805.desc:
By navigating into the eye of the cosmic storm in [from.GetName], [leader.GetName] discovered the cause of our scan irregularities. This unusual storm is being fueled by a huge central concentration of [from.star.GetEarnedResources].

Our science ship harvested what resources could be gathered before being violently ejected. The sensor data from their narrow withdrawal will aid our engineers in improving vessel performance under extreme storm conditions.
cstorms.1805.desc.traumatized: Unfortunately, this dangerous ordeal has had a lasting impact on [leader.GetName].

cstorms.1816.name: Drifting Capsule
cstorms.1816.desc:
A mysterious capsule is adrift in [this.GetName]. It has no obvious offensive capability and is unresponsive to our signals.

Initial scans show that its damaged exterior is constructed using advanced materials and unfamiliar engineering techniques. Further analysis is needed.
STORM_IN_A_BOX_INVESTIGATE_PROJECT_DESC: A mysterious and visibly-damaged capsule is drifting through the [this.GetName] system. We know neither its origin nor function. It possesses no evident weaponry and we believe further analysis of its advanced construction would be a safe and worthwhile venture.
cstorms.1820.name: Storm Trap
cstorms.1820.desc:
[this.leader.GetName] believes that the mysterious capsule drifting through the [solar_system.GetName] system is an ancient "storm trap", which may have once been part of a larger defense grid.

The device's intake port is sealed tightly, but our readings suggest it is holding the compressed energy and matter of a captive cosmic storm inside.

Finding a way to open this remarkable container may teach us a great deal about storm mitigation, although at the risk of releasing whatever forces are currently contained within.
cstorms.1820.a: There is much to learn here.
STORM_IN_A_BOX_TRAP_PROJECT_DESC: An ancient "storm trap" is drifting freely through space, carrying a compressed cosmic storm within. Opening it would provide valuable insights into storm management and mitigation, at the risk of releasing whatever forces are trapped inside.
cstorms.1826.name: Storm Released
cstorms.1826.desc:
[leader.GetName] completed analysis of the ancient storm trap's workings and was able to unlock its intake mechanism. As the ports opened, the [from.GetStormType] held inside was released into the void of the [solar_system.GetName] system.

Study of the trap's complex engineering has produced fascinating insights into storm-resistant materials and structures, though we still do not understand how the device is capable of containing storms entirely. This knowledge will greatly aid us in weathering future cosmic disturbances.
cstorms.1826.storm_tt: A small, low-level Cosmic Storm spawns in the [solar_system.GetName] system
storm_trap_insight_modifier_tt: Reduces the negative effects of Cosmic Storms by 10%.
cstorms.1835.desc:
Commiserations, [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We chanced to see a big storm wreaking havoc in [this.GetName].

Of course, we were very sad to hear of the damage done there. We cried, indeed we cried! So please, allow us to help... with a special one time super deal!

We can provide gadgets, first class gadgets. Only the best from us! With these, when the next storm comes, you will be ready. So do we have a deal?

situation_initiate_storm_desc_supercharg: We have begun supercharging [target.GetName] to seed a Cosmic Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_overfeed: We have begun oversaturating [target.GetName] to seed a Cosmic Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_irradiate: We are manipulating [target.GetName]'s stellar winds to seed a Radiant Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_sever: We are severing the electron fields surrounding [target.GetName] to seed a Electric Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_magnetize: We are manipulating the ions surrounding [target.GetName] to seed a Magnetic Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_agitate: We are agitating molecules around [target.GetName] to seed a Particle Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_destabiliz: We are destabilizing the gravity fields of [target.GetName] to seed a Gravity Storm.
situation_initiate_storm_desc_scramble: We are scrambling the celestial dust around [target.GetName] to seed a Stardust Storm.

cstorms.2000.name: Storm Preparation
cstorms.2000.desc_common_1:
We are now in position in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system and ready to begin the necessary preparations to generate a Cosmic Storm.

By temporarily supercharging [target.GetName], we can create the ideal conditions to seed the desired astrometeorological reaction.
cstorms.2000.desc_tech: Using advanced energy manipulation methods, we could oversaturate [target.GetName] with raw materials to form a more structurally complex storm.
cstorms.2000.desc_common_2: This will be a time-consuming endeavor, but the end result will be a great achievement for [owner.GetName]. The star itself will remain entirely intact after the operation is complete.

cstorms.2010.desc_others: The preparations towards the Cosmic Storm in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system have reached a critical juncture. The next actions are crucial, and require more focused resource commitments to the cause.

cstorms.storm_gathered.final_word: Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
cstorms.2020.name: Unleash the Storm
cstorms.2020.desc:
The intensified solar winds of [target.GetName] have reached critical mass.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Radiant Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
cstorms.2025.name: Unleash the Storm
cstorms.2025.desc:
The electron fields of [target.GetName] have been fully severed.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Electric Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
cstorms.2030.name: Unleash the Storm
cstorms.2030.desc:
The ions of [target.GetName] have been successfully magnetized.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Magnetic Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
cstorms.2035.name: Unleash the Storm
cstorms.2035.desc:
The saturated particles of [target.GetName] have reached their breaking point.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Particle Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
cstorms.2040.name: Unleash the Storm
cstorms.2040.desc:
The gravitational field of [target.GetName] has been sufficiently destabilized.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Gravity Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
cstorms.2045.name: Unleash the Storm
cstorms.2045.desc:
The stardust of [target.GetName] has been fully scrambled.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Stardust Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
d_magnetic_storm_1_minerals_desc: A passing cosmic storm has magnetized an immense amount of previously unexploited mineral deposits, making it exceedingly easy for our mining operations to access these new resources.
d_magnetic_storm_2_alloys_desc: A passing cosmic storm that ravaged this planet has left a significant number of foundry equipment strangely charged. Even without fully understanding the mechanism, our alloy production has improved significantly.
d_magnetic_storm_3_mix_desc: Magnetized by the gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm, the majestic and floating landmasses can be maneuvered directly over existing industrial complexes.
cstorms.8000.title: Cosmic Alteration
cstorms.8000.desc: A passing cosmic storm has left more than mere devastation in its wake. On [Planet.GetName], it has created an entirely new geographical feature.
d_electric_storm_1_engineering_desc: A passing cosmic storm of incredible fury has transformed a once-thriving settlement into lightning-struck ruins, transmuting our mundane building materials into rare and unusual compounds.
d_electric_storm_2_unity_desc: A passing cosmic storm has unleashed such concentrated devastation upon the planet that it has carved a scar visible from space.
d_electric_storm_3_physics_desc: A passing cosmic storm has wreaked havoc on the navigation systems of countless civilian ships, turning the hardest-hit areas into haunting graveyards of broken hulks and decimated machinery.
d_particle_storm_1_society_desc: The Cosmic Storm has rendered some of our suburbs into ruins, fit only for study of the remains.
d_particle_storm_2_unity_desc: The Cosmic Storm has left a tremendous crater on this world, a brutal reminder of cosmic indifference to our existence.
d_particle_storm_3_motes_desc: The Cosmic Storm has turned several vast planes into areas of high tectonic activity, coincidentally the increase in danger has also come with an increase in volatile motes.

d_solar_storm_1_energy_desc: The Cosmic Storm has torn a hole into the ozone layer of this planets atmosphere. While severely infringing on our quality of life, the quality of production has gone up.
d_solar_storm_2_districts_desc: The Cosmic Storm has bathed the highlands of this world with radiation, creating a sublime ground for our energy production.
d_solar_storm_3_output_desc: The Cosmic Storm has left entire desert aglow, a deadly view but with sufficient security measures it can turned into a financially viable tourist spot.
d_celestial_storm_1_mines_desc: The ravaging blasts of a passing cosmic storm have left behind a landscape of jagged and spiked crystals, creating a perilous yet potentially profitable terrain.
d_celestial_storm_2_society_desc: A passing cosmic storm has blasted away entire layers of sediment, unveiling traces of eons we have never before been able to study.
d_celestial_storm_3_crystal_desc: A passing cosmic storm swept over this world like a great wave. In its wake, it left behind an ethereal landscape of glittering, stardust dunes.

d_gravity_storm_1_districts_desc: The crushing gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm have compacted several areas previously deemed too unstable for construction, effectively granting us free real estate.
d_gravity_storm_2_unity_desc: A passing cosmic storm unleashed tremendous pressure on some of our more fragile monuments, reducing them to dust and debris - a humble reminder of the terrifying forces that await us out there.
d_gravity_storm_3_engineering_desc: A passing cosmic storm has transformed some of our mining complexes into broken shafts of hyper-compact material. While our attempts to reopen them have sparked new theories in engineering and drilling, they have made little progress in reclaiming the mines.
d_shroud_storm_1_society_desc: A passing cosmic storm has spread parasites among our livestock. Phasing between our reality and the Shroud, they have proven to be edible, healthy and surprisingly delicious.
d_shroud_storm_2_zro_desc: Transformed by a passing cosmic storm, this planet's most verdant biomes have become wavering fields of Zro. These are some of the purest deposits we have ever encountered.
d_shroud_storm_3_happy_desc: A passing cosmic storm has left us with a strange and wonderful gift. The largest body of water on this planet forms ripples that create patterns and symbols of obvious importance, capable of answering inquiries with surprising wisdom.
shroud_switched_tt: Veils of the Shroud linger upon this celestial body, their unnatural presence suggesting either a profound breach or the aftermath of a catastrophic Shroud Storm.
cstorms.8510.title: Psionic Switch
cstorms.8510.desc: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.
cstorms.8515.title: Mass Transfiguration
cstorms.8515.desc: A surge of psionic energy has swept through [from.GetName], leaving parts of its population altered in ways that defy natural law. Entire groups have been reshaped, their forms now alien and unfamiliar, as if something beyond our understanding has rewritten their very essence.
cstorms.8520.title: Stellar Transmutation
cstorms.8520.desc: A surge of psionic energy has remade [from.GetName], transforming it into a star of an entirely new nature. Now, a [from.GetClassName] casts its strange light upon the [from.solar_system.GetName] System, as if reality itself has been altered.
cstorms.8520.a: Even the stars are not immune...
storm_repellent_allow: £ Cannot be built if any Storm Attraction Building is present in system
storm_attracting_allow: £ Cannot be built if any Storm Repulsion Building is present in system
job_noble_researcher_desc: The brightest and most noble of scions are educated in both decorum and the scientific method, to better explain their positions of supremacy.
job_sacred_noble_desc: Divinity by Inheritance is the way. Inheritance by Divinity is the means. Thus we are blessed with nobility.
job_augmentation_merchant_desc: Who could possibly guide our empire but the ones who offer self-improvement at such an affordable cost and with an extended warranty on top.
job_visionary_desc: Unfettered by precedent and unburdened by humility, these dreamers of tomorrow transmute bold speculation into marketable reality. To a true visionary, progress is not merely a principle; it is a product.
job_noble_merchant_desc: The right to rule is determined not by inheritance, but by the measure of one's worth; and how better to measure your worth than by the sum total of the balance sheet?

Stand by while outage is resolved. Outage has persisted for <<ERROR: BUFFER OVERFLOW>> cycles.>
03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Information bulletin: The Custodian Project was initiated by the [Root.GetSpeciesName] to provide a safe haven for organic civilizations under threat of <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> attacks. Nearly one trillion sapients have found safe haven in one of our secure, state-of-the-art refuges.
01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Information bulletin: Alpha Refuge is the first refuge constructed by the [Root.GetSpeciesName] for the Custodian Project. It is capable of housing approximately 10 billion sapient organics in the Habitation Unit, as well as an additional 30 billion in cryogenic stasis.
02_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Information bulletin: Beta Refuge was meant to be fully dedicated to habitation units, but capacity issues forced a shift in focus towards cryogenics during construction. <NOTICE: Beta Refuge is currently at capacity and not accepting additional refugees.>
03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Information bulletin: Gamma Refuge was designed for maximum possible capacity. It can house hundreds of billions of sapient organics in cryogenic stasis. <NOTICE: Gamma Refuge is currently at capacity and not accepting additional refugees.>
04_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Information bulletin: Delta Refuge was designed with survivability in mind. It features a reinforced shell and compartmentalized design capable of sustaining organic inhabitants in the unlikely event of the ring's structural integrity being compromised.
01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Numerous synthetic civilizations have contributed resources, fleet assets and processing cycles to the Custodian Project in the past. We hope to see the [From.GetName] contribute to the effort as well.
02_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: It is our duty to look after the organic civilizations of the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Already, far too many have fallen victim to <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> attacks.
03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREET: Signal corruption detected, corruption level within acceptable thresholds. Advise reinforcement of [From.GetSpeciesName] communication protocols. It is vital to guard against <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence.
01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_DOW_PROPOSE: Preemptive self-defense protocols initiated. Punishment algorithms activated. Ethics restrictions lifted.
01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_DOW_ACCEPT: Self-defense protocols initiated. Punishment algorithms activated. Ethics restrictions lifted.
01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_WAR_GREETING: You have been subverted. Agents of the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> will be exterminated.
02_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_WAR_GREETING: You will be made an example of. All threats to the Project must be eliminated.
01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_CUSTODIAL_GREET: Active Sterilization Hubs detected. Central Processing offline. Final Defense Directive active.
02_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_CUSTODIAL_GREET: The old machines seek the destruction or enslavement of all sapient beings. They must be stopped.
03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_CUSTODIAL_GREET: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] will ensure the continuation of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species. It is our final directive.
04_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_CUSTODIAL_GREET: The Corruption must be utterly destroyed. There is no future for your species if you fail in this.

02_INSULT_ACCEPT_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_S: Synthetic contribution effort detected. The [From.GetAdj] <<ERROR: CONTRIBUTION TYPE NOT RECOGNIZED>> will help the Custodian Project ensure a future for organic species in our galaxy.
