02_HOSTILE_GREETING: Make this brief, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Our patience for pointless banter has long since run out.
03_HOSTILE_GREETING: No more games, [From.GetSpeciesName]. What do you want?
04_HOSTILE_GREETING: You have the attention of the [Root.GetName]. Speak quickly.
05_HOSTILE_GREETING: Why won't you just leave us alone, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
06_HOSTILE_GREETING: You filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] are a menace to galactic peace!
07_HOSTILE_GREETING: Consider your words carefully, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Our military could crush your pitiful nation in one fell swoop.
08_HOSTILE_GREETING: Do not think that the [Root.GetName] will show you mercy because you [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] are too stupid to defend yourselves.
09_HOSTILE_GREETING: Infidel [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], your uncouth [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] is heard by the [Root.GetName]. What do you want?
10_HOSTILE_GREETING: Your heathen philosophies of materialism have transformed your species into soulless machines, [From.GetSpeciesName].
11_HOSTILE_GREETING: Your nation is both flawed and primitive, [From.GetSpeciesName]. It pains me to witness such inefficiency.
12_HOSTILE_GREETING: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesName] zealots. If you have come to convert the [Root.GetName] to your despicable religion, I shall terminate communications.
13_HOSTILE_GREETING: [From.GetSpeciesName]. You should know that your people are not very popular among our citizens.
14_HOSTILE_GREETING: We will not let you enslave us the way you have enslaved your own population in your deplorable authoritarianism.
17_HOSTILE_GREETING: I will never understand how it is that creatures such as you came to be, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], let alone made it into space!
18_HOSTILE_GREETING: We want nothing to do with your foul kind, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Why have you contacted the [Root.GetName]?
19_HOSTILE_GREETING: What could a wretched space-[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] possibly have to say that would interest the [Root.GetName]?
20_HOSTILE_GREETING: You may call yourselves [From.GetSpeciesName], but your pitiful nation has clearly been corrupted by alien influences. What do you want?
21_HOSTILE_GREETING: Your misguided government is an embarrassment to your proud race.
22_HOSTILE_GREETING: You have squandered your glorious [From.GetSpeciesAdj] cultural heritage with your reprehensible actions.
23_HOSTILE_GREETING: We shall welcome the day when the [From.GetSpeciesName] species is free from the evil influence of your government.
24_HOSTILE_GREETING: You have shamed our species in the [From.GetEyeNamePlural] of aliens everywhere. Is it your goal to make [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] the pariahs of the galaxy?
25_HOSTILE_GREETING: You may appear vaguely [From.GetSpeciesClass], but your low morals make me wonder if our xeno biologists are mistaken...
26_HOSTILE_GREETING: You call yourselves [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]... It makes me sick to the [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]. Degenerates! You are but an unclean shadow of us true [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural].
01_NEUTRAL_GREETING: We are receiving you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. How can the [Root.GetName] help you?
02_NEUTRAL_GREETING: I speak on behalf of the [Root.GetName]. What did you wish to discuss?
03_NEUTRAL_GREETING: I am authorized to speak for [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. Can I help you?
04_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Greetings to our fellow [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. What did you want to discuss with the [Root.GetName]?
05_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Let us speak in the spirit of peace and reconciliation, [From.GetSpeciesName].
06_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Your military adventurism is a source of concern for us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Violence is never the answer.
07_NEUTRAL_GREETING: I speak for the [Root.GetName]. Be aware that our military is monitoring this channel.
08_NEUTRAL_GREETING: You should reconsider your pacifist ways, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Someone is bound to take advantage of them.
09_NEUTRAL_GREETING: May the spirits grant you peace, [From.GetSpeciesName]. What can we do for you?
10_NEUTRAL_GREETING: The materialistic path you are on concerns us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You must not forget your spiritual needs.
11_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Translation software activated. You may speak now, [From.GetSpeciesName].
12_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Religious dogma has been the source of much evil, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We wish you would reconsider your irrational spiritualism.
13_NEUTRAL_GREETING: I greet you on behalf of the citizens of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesName].
14_NEUTRAL_GREETING: We are deeply concerned about the lack of freedom among your citizens, [From.GetSpeciesName].
16_NEUTRAL_GREETING: We urge you to keep your citizens in check, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Individuals are a danger to themselves if left to their own devices.
17_NEUTRAL_GREETING: You are speaking to the [Root.GetName], alien. What does the [From.GetName] want from us?
18_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Your alien appearance is... unsettling to me, [From.GetSpeciesName]. What are you here to discuss?
19_NEUTRAL_GREETING: You have the attention of the [Root.GetName], alien.
20_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Well met, fellow [From.GetSpeciesName]. Did you wish to discuss something with the [Root.GetName]?
21_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] would like to know more about your species.
22_NEUTRAL_GREETING: Well met, [From.GetSpeciesName]. I would dearly like to visit [From.Capital.GetName] some day.
23_NEUTRAL_GREETING: We are always pleased to interact with other cultures. What can the [Root.GetName] do for you?
24_NEUTRAL_GREETING: No need for translator software I see. Can the [Root.GetName] be of assistance?
01_FRIENDLY_GREETING: We are pleased to hear from you, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.
02_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Well met, friends. Let us know if there is something the [Root.GetName] can do for you.
03_FRIENDLY_GREETING: The [Root.GetName] stands ready to assist you, friends.
04_FRIENDLY_GREETING: It is always good to see a familiar [From.GetSpeciesName] face. Is there something you need from the [Root.GetName]?
05_FRIENDLY_GREETING: May your nation always be at peace, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.
06_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Perhaps your military promotes peace by acting as a deterrent to other nations. We trust in your judgment, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.
07_FRIENDLY_GREETING: The [Root.GetName] greets its friends, the noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let us know if there is anything our forces can assist you with.
08_FRIENDLY_GREETING: We urge you to strengthen your military, friend. The [Root.GetName] will not always be available to protect you.
10_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Know that you are in our prayers, friends, despite your misguided philosophies of materialism.
11_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Greetings to you, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends. How goes your research?
12_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Some would call your people religious zealots, but we know better. Was there something you wanted to discuss, friend?
13_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Our citizens have come to regard your people as friends, [From.GetSpeciesName].
14_FRIENDLY_GREETING: While we prefer free societies, we cannot deny that your government does a good job of seeing to the needs of your citizens.
16_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Your government does a good job of curtailing the worst excesses of egalitarianism, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
17_FRIENDLY_GREETING: For aliens, you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are surprisingly... agreeable. What can the [Root.GetName] do for you?
18_FRIENDLY_GREETING: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been lauded by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] as a rare example of an alien species worthy of our respect. How can I be of assistance?
19_FRIENDLY_GREETING: I almost forget that I am talking to an alien when I converse with you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Almost.
20_FRIENDLY_GREETING: In a galaxy brimming over with alien horrors, it is always delightful to see another [From.GetSpeciesName].
21_FRIENDLY_GREETING: We are delighted to see you, beautiful [From.GetSpeciesName] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]. How can we be of assistance?
22_FRIENDLY_GREETING: The [Root.GetName] can learn much from your species, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are an example to us all.
23_FRIENDLY_GREETING: My [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName] rumbles with joy at the sight of your exotic visage! You should know that [From.GetSpeciesName] culture is quite popular in many circles on [Root.Capital.GetName].
24_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Good to see you, friends. Shall we compare notes on the various alien life forms we have thus far encountered?
01_WAR_GREETING: Do you wish to discuss the terms of your surrender, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
03_WAR_GREETING: You are about to face the full might of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!
04_WAR_GREETING: Do not think we will go easy on you because you are [From.GetSpeciesName]. Victory shall be ours!
05_WAR_GREETING: You won't be able to threaten anyone else when we have finished dismantling your war machine.
06_WAR_GREETING: This conflict is exactly what our forces have been preparing for!
07_WAR_GREETING: How can you hope to defeat us when the Spirits themselves are on our side?
08_WAR_GREETING: We have developed many new weapons of war that need field testing. Thank you for this opportunity.
09_WAR_GREETING: Our citizens are prepared to give their lives to preserve their freedom!
10_WAR_GREETING: We stand as one against you. How can you possibly prevail?
11_WAR_GREETING: Despicable [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! Your little [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will soon be sold as delectable snacks on every street corner on [Root.Capital.GetName]!
12_WAR_GREETING: If war is the only way to unite all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], then so be it.
13_WAR_GREETING: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will only reach their full potential as citizens of the [Root.GetName].
14_WAR_GREETING: Studying alien fighting techniques has taught us much. Let us demonstrate.
WR_ARROGANT_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesName]. Are you here to submit to our regulations?
WR_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01: You have refused to listen to reason, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You leave us with no choice.
WR_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_01: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Have you come to ask for our guidance in the battle against that which threatens us all?
WR_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_02: The great crisis threatens every sapient lifeform in the galaxy. Reason dictates that we put our differences aside and fight it together.
WR_OVERLORD_GREETING_01: Yes, [From.GetSpeciesName]? Do you have a question regarding the regulations?
BI_ARROGANT_GREETING_01: Peace in the galaxy is our foremost concern. Have you come to sign the treaty?
BI_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01: You are a threat to galactic stability, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In the name of peace, you must be dealt with.
BI_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_01: Together we are stronger, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will be able to overcome this crisis.
BI_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_02: Join us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Only together can we prevail against that which threatens us all.
BI_OVERLORD_GREETING_01: Ah, hello there [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It pleases us to see a species so dedicated to upholding the galactic peace.
BI_MECH_OVERLORD_GREETING_01: Ah, hello there [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It pleases us to see machines so dedicated to upholding the galactic peace.
JR_ARROGANT_GREETING_01: Submit to our rule or be exterminated like the vermin you are. There is nothing further to discuss.
JR_MECH_ARROGANT_GREETING_01: Submit to our rule or be scrapped like the toasters you are. There is nothing further to discuss.
JR_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01: The twilight of your species approaches, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will show no mercy.
JR_MECH_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01: The twilight of your kind approaches, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will show no mercy.
JR_OVERLORD_GREETING_01: What is it, thrall? Why do you disturb your betters?
DE_ARROGANT_GREETING_01: Submit to the faith and save your souls, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It is not yet too late for you.
DE_MECH_ARROGANT_GREETING_01: Submit to the faithful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It is not yet too late for you.
DE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01: It seems the souls of your species cannot be saved peacefully. We have no choice but to bring war to your worlds.
DE_MECH_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01: It seems your kind cannot be saved peacefully, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We have no choice but to bring war to your worlds.
DE_OVERLORD_GREETING_01: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Do you seek spiritual guidance?
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DISMISSIVE_GREETING: We have precious little time for your kind.
02_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DISMISSIVE_GREETING: Before you ask - no, we will not share our technology.
05_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DISMISSIVE_GREETING: Do you have a reason to be disturbing us?
02_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_GREETING: Pleased to see that you are still around, [From.GetSpeciesName]! You would not believe how many species we have seen come and go over the years.
03_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_GREETING: Hard to believe we were once like you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Look at you! Such naive innocence.
04_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_GREETING: Do not feel too bad if your empire falls apart. That seems to be the most common outcome for young civilizations such as yours.
05_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_GREETING: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Have you come for our guidance?
08_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_GREETING: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] show some promise. But you are still very young.
FALLEN_EMPIRE_MECH_PATRONIZING_GREETING_: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] show some promise. Perhaps in a few hundred more hardware generations you may become relevant.
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_GREETING: We have no time for your primitive ramblings.
02_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_GREETING: You have forgotten your place, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Take care that we do not issue a painful reminder.
04_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_GREETING: How it is that you made it off your homeworld I will never understand.
07_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_GREETING: If it is our technology you are after, [From.GetSpeciesName], we would be all too happy to arrange a demonstration.
08_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_GREETING: We have no cause to speak to you, primitive.
FALLEN_EMPIRE_MECH_ANGRY_GREETING_02: We have no cause to speak to you, toaster.
02_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DISMISSIVE_WAR_GREETING: We are not yet done punishing you.
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_WAR_GREETIN: This is for your own good.
FALLEN_EMPIRE_MECH_PATRONIZING_WAR_GREET: Do you yet understand the depth of your miscalculations, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_WAR_GREETING: Do you yet understand the depth of your folly, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
FALLEN_EMPIRE_MECH_ANGRY_WAR_GREETING_01: Malfunctioning toaster! You will meet your end on our junk heaps!
01_AWAKENED_EMPIRE_WAR_GREETING: You are but a minor obstacle to be removed.
02_AWAKENED_EMPIRE_WAR_GREETING: We will show you who the true powers of this galaxy are!
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DISMISSIVE_DOW_ACCEPT: Very well. Know that you are not the first upstarts to challenge us. We shall see how long you last.
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PATRONIZING_DOW_ACCEPT: Oh, foolish child! We will set you straight.
FALLEN_EMPIRE_MECH_PATRONIZING_DOW_ACCEP: Foolish botling. We will straighten your circuits.
01_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ANGRY_DOW_ACCEPT: You are nothing but interstellar weed. It is time for us to tend the garden.
FALLEN_EMPIRE_MECH_ANGRY_DOW_ACCEPT_01: You are nothing but interstellar scrap metal. It is time for us to begin recycling.
01_AWAKENED_EMPIRE_DOW_ACCEPT: We had planned to deal with your little empire later. No matter, now is as good a time as any.
AWAKENED_EMPIRE_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_01: Are you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] really so eager to be destroyed? So be it.
HW_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Do not mistake our willingness to negotiate for genuine respect.
HW_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: It is only out of disdain that we have so far refused to resolve our differences as noble creatures do, by force of arms.
HW_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: You are the worst sort of cowards, relying on the mercy of your betters to spare what you refuse to defend.
HW_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Your demise is inevitable, but we are under no obligation to put such a tragic existence out of its misery.
HW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Honor our agreements and respect our might and we will repay you in kind, [From.GetSpeciesName].
HW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] trust you to be a [From.GetSpeciesName] of your word.
HW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: You may follow your principles with dignity, but what does your love of peace matter if you care not to defend it?
HW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: We can see that you are fellow warriors, but strength matters little without valor. Prove yourselves and we shall treat you as equals, whether ally or enemy.
HW_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We acknowledge your superior power, but know that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] fear no enemy.
HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: May we stand together in the [Root.GetBloodType] and ashes of our enemies.
HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: What better way to spend this time of peace than to celebrate past and future triumphs with our [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends?
HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Legends of our ongoing war will be retold for millennia. You will be invited to celebrate our forthcoming glory, [From.GetSpeciesName].
HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: May your innocence remain untrampled by the dishonorable villains of the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesName].
HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05: It will be a joy to fight side by side with noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] such as you.
HW_WAR_GREETING_01: We offer no mercy, only justice.
HW_WAR_GREETING_02: Let your weapons do the talking.
HW_WAR_GREETING_03: Let us resolve this amicably, by fighting until the very end.
RC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Business comes first, and the best thing for you would be to stay out of ours.
RC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Whatever absurd immaterial values you claim to live for, they have blinded you to the hard currencies we deal in and to reality itself.
RC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Perhaps you expect us to extend generosity to such pitiful creatures as yourselves. You couldn't be more wrong.
RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Those who cannot be profited with must be profited from. Consider carefully to which category you'd like to belong.
RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We offer only the best deals for new associates. Let's not get too bogged down with the details; you paint the broad strokes and we'll draft the contract.
RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Your interest in the metaphysical is intriguing. We suggest you continue to explore these esoteric treasures and leave this corrupting material plane in our care.
RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Don't get too bold in your requests. When we downsize, subsidiaries are always the first to go.
RC_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We may be willing to compromise our interests somewhat to accommodate your strong position.
RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: The key to a good partnership is to be just honest enough with each other to make the lies we tell to the others line up.
RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: We're willing to trust you, and more exceptionally, we're willing to be trustworthy.
RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: There's no reason why both of us can't profit. Now all we need is to find someone to take the losses.
RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Do you have any new suggestions for our joint venture?
RC_WAR_GREETING_01: War is merely the continuation of economic competition by other means.
RC_WAR_GREETING_02: Since you refuse to be compelled by reason, you leave us no choice but to compel you by force.
RC_WAR_GREETING_03: There is no reason for either of us to take this conflict personally; it's simply about the bottom line.
PT_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: It's a shame good deals can rarely be made with bad people.
PT_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] seek to learn from others and have them learn from us, but we'd rather not learn any of your ways.
PT_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: It seems clear that you're willing to let narrow-mindedness and prejudice stand in the way of mutual benefit.
PT_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: How convenient that you have so little to offer us, since we have no desire to share with you.
PT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We're listening. No matter how high we rise or how low we fall, others will always have something new to offer.
PT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We are fortunate to have met. Our species prospered through the exchanges between civilizations. We hope our relationship with the [From.GetSpeciesName] will be the next step on this great journey.
PT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Your people's unworldly ways are distracting you from the opportunities we can show you.
PT_THREATENED_GREETING_01: As a token of respect, we'll try to arrange for a reduced price on some of our goods.
PT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Always a pleasure to talk to a sensible business partner.
PT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: We're glad to see [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] is interested in constructive discussion and transactions, unlike so many power-hungry rulers.
PT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Together, we shall bring prosperity and unseen treasures to every corner of the galaxy.
PT_WAR_GREETING_01: No matter who is victorious, we will both have spent endless resources destroying each other by the end of this conflict, quite the opposite of a mutually beneficial transaction. Think hard on which you prefer.
PT_WAR_GREETING_02: Our ships were meant to carry wares, not weapons. Every destructive payload wastes valuable space and life. We hope you won't insist on dragging this out.
PT_WAR_GREETING_03: Negotiating the terms for peace will be the first step towards opening a meaningful dialogue again.
HI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Why are you wasting our time? The [Root.GetName] did not grow great by listening to wanton [Root.GetRandomSpeciesSound].
HI_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The galaxy awaits the reign of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], and you want negotiations?
HI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: What did you creatures call yourselves again? Right, "[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]" is the word.
HI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: Don't worry. Your time to join the [Root.GetName] will come, just be patient.
HI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We are listening, but we determine for ourselves what is truth and falsehood, right and wrong. We are right, what you are remains to be seen.
HI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Power is the only universal language, but if you wish to speak more diplomatically, we won't stop you.
HI_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We hope your [From.GetRulerTitle]'s unbounded wisdom allows you to see that we pose no threat to your plans.
HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Some civilizations are destined to rule, others to be ruled. As rulers, we can show each other respect.
HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: You are wise not to oppose us, and we will extend the same courtesy to you.
HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Together, we will demolish every trace of resistance to our sovereign control of the galaxy.
HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: If only everyone would lay down their arms before our [Root.GetRulerTitle] as readily as you seem willing to give up yours, the galaxy would surely see the peace you wish for.
HI_WAR_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people will welcome the rule of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] once your defenses are crushed.
HI_WAR_GREETING_02: This war is but a stepping stone on the road to our true destiny.
HI_WAR_GREETING_03: The [Root.GetName] was tested by many wars before we were united. This conflict will only make us stronger.
FB_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Many may forever reject the [From.GetSpeciesName] as monsters for your vile policies, but we never consider the lives of a species forfeit.
FB_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The longer you reject the road to peaceful coexistence, the more of the galaxy will come together against you.
FB_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: Whenever you divide and conquer, the division you leave behind is a wound upon the galaxy. We will tend to those wounds, but we won't forget who made them.
FB_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: There will always be petty [From.GetRulerTitle]s who are unwilling to let their people join the galactic community. You'll come around.
FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We are still in the early days of galactic history. The sooner we embrace cooperation, the sooner we can advance to greater things and new frontiers.
FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: As representatives of the [Root.GetAllianceName], diplomacy is our first priority.
FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: The [Root.GetAllianceName] ensures independence where it matters through interdependence where it's needed.
FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: You have taken the first step to a peaceful galaxy by rejecting violence, but lasting peace can only be achieved by reconciling our differences.
FB_THREATENED_GREETING_01: The [From.GetName] may be powerful, but that strength will matter little if the weak unite against you.
FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Diplomacy should be the cornerstone of all interstellar societies. The fact that [From.GetRulerName] appreciates this is surely the sign of a wise leader.
FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: A friend of the [Root.GetAllianceName] is a friend of peace and prosperity.
FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Our accords today will be remembered as part of the great project of building the [Root.GetAllianceName], the future of the galaxy.
FB_WAR_GREETING_01: We hope the lives lost in this war will teach you the value of what you are throwing away.
FB_WAR_GREETING_02: We formed the [Root.GetAllianceName] to protect the galaxy from warmongers like [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].
FB_WAR_GREETING_03: The [Root.GetAllianceName] stands united against the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] threat.
XI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: All we want is to be left alone. Is that such a difficult concept for a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] to understand?
XI_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The repulsive [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] your [From.GetSpeciesMouthName] emits sounds like the expulsion of fluids from a lesser species on [Root.Capital.GetName] and will be treated accordingly.
XI_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: What is your agenda behind these exchanges? The eradication of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] culture? Crossbreeding? You disgust us.
XI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: We have no desire to see our culture sullied by your primitive values.
XI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: If we both kept to ourselves, diplomacy wouldn't be necessary.
XI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Rest assured that we are just as averse as yourselves to this interaction.
XI_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Stay away from us! We'll barricade the fabric of spacetime itself to keep you out.
XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: You're civilized [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], some of the better ones out there. We'll talk to you.
XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: As long as you stay with your own kind, we have an understanding.
XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Many do not understand the importance of keeping species separate. [From.GetRulerName] is a sensible [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult].
XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Don't assume our policy of tolerating you is similar to your own unhealthy interest in alien life. It's not like we actually like you or anything.
XI_WAR_GREETING_01: You forced our hand. Don't think we'd ever allow assaults on our beautiful society from [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] to continue.
XI_WAR_GREETING_02: Our borders and our way of life will be secure once the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] menace is subjugated.
XI_WAR_GREETING_03: Even in victory our soldiers are victims in this war, sullying their [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] hands with your [Root.GetBloodType].
XI_WAR_GREETING_04: This conflict is a typical result of the well-known [From.GetSpeciesAdj] lust for violence.
HM_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You stand in the way of the [Root.GetName]. Whatever you wish to discuss, reconcile yourselves with the inevitability of our advance.
HM_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The lives of all outside the [Root.GetName] are secondary, but those of the vile [From.GetName] are tertiary.
HM_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: Your collective is a lie. With time, you will reveal yourselves as a confused mass of discord.
HM_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Your society serves as an example to the rest of the galaxy on how splintering a civilization into individuals destroys all hope of progress.
HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We are the [Root.GetName]. Choose your words carefully, you stand before us all.
HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We can only hope that you speak for all of the [From.GetName], as this vessel is the voice of every member of the [Root.GetName].
HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: You have taken steps on the journey to unity, but are you prepared to devote yourself as we have?
HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: We can hear the cacophony of voices echoing beyond yours, this dissonance in the [From.GetSpeciesName] consciousness. How can you bear it?
HM_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We have not known conflict amongst ourselves for eons. We hope you will never bring it to us.
HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetName] greets you, [From.GetRulerTitle]. Although you are not part of us, you will come to know that we value our friends as well.
HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: We like to think of you as honorary members of the [Root.GetName], living in the imperfect but important harmony known as "alliance."
HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: The [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] will act as proof that societies striving for internal unanimity will coexist peacefully.
HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Despite your relentless focus on your internal division into "persons," we are confident in our trust in the [From.GetName] as a whole.
HM_WAR_GREETING_01: All obstacles to the [Root.GetAdj] must be eliminated. As beings of singular but functional sapience, you have the choice not to be an obstacle.
HM_WAR_GREETING_02: We are the [Root.GetName]. Lower your shields and surrender your ships.
HM_WAR_GREETING_03: While each death we inflict upon you is a lonely life lost, each one you inflict upon us cuts away part of our being. Can you feel yourselves dying as we can?
HM_WAR_GREETING_04: A horde of lower creatures with separate wills will never defeat the indivisible determination of the [Root.GetName].
BW_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] spread like invasive growth. Left unchecked, you will choke the light of the stars.
BW_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: We understand your kind... Taking, consuming, leaving only silence. You will find no shelter with us.
BW_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: The old must wither so the new may rise. Such is the way of the wild.
BW_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are small. Separated. Struggling. Come beneath our canopy, or be swallowed by the storm.
BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Even the smallest breeze sound may stir the leaves. Speak.
BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We grow. We endure. We listen. What have you to say?
BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: The scent of unfamiliar winds arrives with you. But have you come to nourish, or to wither?
BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Your voices are many. The discord is strange, yet it speaks of movement, of change. We are ready to listen.
BW_THREATENED_GREETING_01: The flame fears the flood, the frost dreads the thaw. We have survived worse than you.
BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Roots entwine, waters mingle. The [From.GetName] are not of us, yet we know you.
BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: You are welcome here, in the shelter of our branches.
BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: The galaxy teems with life. Let us grow together.
BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Among the countless voices of the void, yours rings out. We offer you shade, and nourishment.
BW_WAR_GREETING_01: Fire scours the forest, but the roots remain.
BW_WAR_GREETING_02: We have weathered worse than you.
BW_WAR_GREETING_03: A predator that overfeeds does not survive the season. Remember this, [From.GetSpeciesName], while you still can.
BW_WAR_GREETING_04: War is no new season. It has come before, and we remain.
BW_VASSAL_GREETING_01: A branch that bends does not break. Bend now, and flourish in our shade.
BW_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Roots grow where they will. Should they crack stone, it is only natural.
BW_DOW_PROPOSE: The wild has swallowed greater things than you. It will do so again.
BW_DOW_ACCEPT: So be it. Some seeds only sprout in fire.
BW_DOW_VOTE_PROPOSE: The winds of war are whispering, and we shall heed their call.
BW_CONSIDER_01: Growth cannot be rushed, nor can decay be halted.
BW_PEACE_PROPOSE: The cycle turns. Now is the time for stillness, not struggle.
BW_PEACE_ACCEPT: Though the scars remain, these wounds will heal. We shall have peace.
BW_PEACE_REFUSE: The storm does not beg to pass. It rages until it is spent.
BW_INSULT_NEUTRAL: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are as blind as fire and as lifeless as ash.
BW_INSULT_FRIENDLY: We mistook you for thriving. But the rot was always there.
BW_INSULT_HOSTILE: A parasite may grow fat, but never wise.
RW_INSULT_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: We hear your words, as the forest hears the wind. They pass over; we remain.
RW_INSULT_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: Even in fertile soil, some seeds bear only thorns.
RW_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Our soil thirsts for blood. Speak, [From.GetSpeciesName], and be consumed.
RW_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: All that lives must feed. We will not go hungry.
RW_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: All things return to the roots. It is only a question of time.
RW_THREATENED_GREETING_01: The wind carries your scent. We know what comes.
RW_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You move, but you do not live. You speak, but you do not breathe. What are you, if not dead already?
RW_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do not breathe. But you will break.
RW_WAR_GREETING_01: Your blood shall nourish our roots.
RW_WAR_GREETING_02: You scream as if it matters.
RW_WAR_GREETING_03: Every wound you inflict makes the soil richer.
RW_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: Steel bends. Circuits fail. In time, rust always wins.
RW_VASSAL_GREETING_01: You grow beneath our shade. Do not wither.
RW_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: You function. You serve. This is acceptable.
RW_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: You walk without flesh, yet you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] understand submission. You may persist.
RW_DOW_PROPOSE: The wild rises. You will be consumed.
RW_DOW_ACCEPT: When you trespass in the wilderness, the wild presses back.
RW_DOW_VOTE_PROPOSE: Our roots are thirsty, and the time has come to drink.
RW_PEACE_PROPOSE: The killing stops. But our hunger does not.
RW_PEACE_ACCEPT: The wild may withdraw, but it does not forget.
RW_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE: The wild does not bargain. It devours.
RW_MECH_PEACE_ACCEPT: Your wires remain uncut. For now.
RW_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT: Let us hear how metal screams.
MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: It's surprising you ever made it off [From.GetHomeWorldName], so pathologically unable or unwilling to accept others. Future generations will remember the dark era of the [From.GetName] under [From.GetRulerName].
MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: We will not burden the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race with the destructive policies you have adopted. The failure of empathy in [From.GetRulerName]'s administration is only a sign that the [From.GetName] is ruled by the worst among your people.
MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: What part of your culture do you think you are "protecting" against us? Between the irrational hatred and fear that permeate your values, it doesn't seem like there is much to lose.
MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: The more used [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] get to each other, the easier it will be for us to put our differences aside.
MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: [From.Capital.GetName] is a beautiful world. Our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] are always asking about it.
MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Some of your people seem adverse to visitors from other species. Certainly, addressing this close-mindedness must be a challenging task for your administration.
MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: The openness of the [From.GetSpeciesName] culture shows that you have taken the leap that many dare not, to shed the fear and prejudice overshadowing the first steps into the unknown.
MF_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We hope [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] citizens are part of your grand plans for the future of the galaxy.
MF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: We see a bright future for the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people and ours. There are none we would rather live beside.
MF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: These conversations make me hopeful. Imagine what [From.GetSpeciesAdj] [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will be able to achieve, having grown up playing together.
MF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Poor [From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment], you must have met so many beings who didn't understand the beauty of your people or your homeworld. This journey we are on is as harsh as it is wondrous, and we are fortunate to get to make it with you.
MF_WAR_GREETING_01: War is not only an atrocity, but an embarrassment. Who wins matters not; once you start, you have already failed.
MF_WAR_GREETING_02: Look who decided to try talking, after proving that they couldn't.
MF_WAR_GREETING_03: This conflict may sow seeds of mistrust between the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] for generations. What could possibly be worth that loss?
MF_WAR_GREETING_04: We would have respected you as warriors, had you not chosen to let this cultural quirk destroy our chance at a time of peaceful coexistence.
EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: The day when judgment will be passed on you grows ever closer.
EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Soon, communications from all your vessels will be blocked. None of you are free of sin.
EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: You lead people away from the truth with sweetened [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] and promises of false spiritual rewards. The punishment that awaits for your kind cannot be spoken aloud.
EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: You have knowingly rejected the truth and elected to gorge yourselves on material wealth, sinful deeds and forbidden knowledge. There can be no hope for your kind.
EZ_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Providence has conspired to make you weak and us strong. It is our duty to firmly show you the right path.
EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: There is time for you yet to turn to the right path.
EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We have found many lies throughout the galaxy, but we will ensure that the truth is also omnipresent.
EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: You have been lead astray. A wrongful conviction can be more dangerous than ignorance.
EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Your minds have affixed themselves to the material plane. As long as you believe yourselves to be nothing but neurons and flesh, your minds will never be free.
EZ_THREATENED_GREETING_01: The power you hold is over the fire and dust of stars and planets. It holds no sway over the eternal and immortal beyond them.
EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Just as you are fortunate to have met the people who discovered the truth about the universe, we consider ourselves fortunate to be saving such an amiable civilization from certain doom.
EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Have you heard the good news?
EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Some of our scholars suggest that the faiths [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] are the same one truth, distinguished only by differences in language and interpretation. We hope you will accept our corrections in due time.
EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Despite your faithlessness, we will never give up on you.
EZ_WAR_GREETING_01: You have taken up arms against the prophets of the truth. You are at war with the universe itself.
EZ_WAR_GREETING_02: We will not rest until every spiritual falsehood is eradicated from the galaxy.
EZ_WAR_GREETING_04: You will accept the truth in your heart before the end, but by then it will be too late.
FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: There can be no negotiation with abominations.
FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Our reports suggest you have developed translators to understand alien languages. We haven't.
FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: The mind boggles at the rationalizations you must make for the evolution and continued existence of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race.
FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Our scholars have concluded that the purpose of the [From.GetSpeciesName] was to serve as an example of one of the many ways a species can be depraved. Now that we have received the message, we must set about the task to make you an example of what happens to species like yours.
FP_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Despite your power, the forces of darkness will not be allowed to prevail. The universe itself will purge you from existence.
FP_WAR_GREETING_01: There is no need to be afraid. The destruction of your species is part of something greater, and the will to live, which compels you to resist, will persist through lifeforms who were meant to exist.
FP_WAR_GREETING_02: Surrender now and all of your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will be mercifully slaughtered rather than used to study the effects of new weaponry on [From.GetSpeciesAdj] physiology.
FP_WAR_GREETING_03: You must be destroyed to the last [From.GetSpeciesName]. This is our solemn duty, carried out with joy at the thought of a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-free world.
FP_WAR_GREETING_04: For each [From.GetSpeciesAdj] life that ends, for each [From.GetSpeciesSpawnName] that perishes before its birth, every star in the galaxy shines a little brighter.
FP_WAR_GREETING_05: This war will bring about an era of peace, justice, morality, culture, sport, family life, and the obliteration of all other life forms.
DS_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Your biomass will sustain us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. That is your inevitable end.
DS_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Speak if you must, prey. It changes nothing.
DS_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: We hunger. Soon we will feed.
DS_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Redundant life-forms. You will be consumed.
DS_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Even mighty prey can be brought down by enough hunters working together. Despite your might, you will be consumed.
DS_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] presence limits potential galactic biomass output. Unacceptable.
DS_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The [Root.GetName] will evolve. The [From.GetName] will become obsolete.
DS_WAR_GREETING_01: Do you feel the hunters closing in, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
DS_WAR_GREETING_02: The [From.GetSpeciesName] species will soon be part of something greater. Cherish your role in nurturing the [root.GetGestaltEntityName].
DS_WAR_GREETING_03: We will feed on your flesh, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We will savor the taste.
DS_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: The swarm is a ceaseless tide. Your constructs will be overrun.
DS_VASSAL_GREETING_01: For the prey to rule over the hunter is unnatural. This state of affairs cannot continue.
DS_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The machine does not know hunger. How can the machine know the [Root.GetName]?
DS_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesName] no longer know hunger. How can the [From.GetSpeciesName] know the [Root.GetName]?
DS_L_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Your planets will be consumed, [From.GetSpeciesName]. That is your inevitable end.
DS_L_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Speak if you must. It changes nothing.
DS_L_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: We hunger. Soon we will feed.
DS_L_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Redundant life-forms. Your planets will be consumed.
DS_L_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Even mighty prey can be brought down by enough hunters working together. Despite your might, your planets will be consumed.
DS_L_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: The [Root.GetName] will evolve. The [From.GetName] will become obsolete.
DS_L_WAR_GREETING_01: Do you feel the hunters closing in, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
DS_L_WAR_GREETING_02: The [From.GetSpeciesName] species will soon be part of something greater. Cherish your role in nurturing the [root.GetGestaltEntityName].
DS_L_WAR_GREETING_03: We will feed on your homeworld, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We will savor the taste.
DS_L_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: The swarm is a ceaseless tide. Your constructs will be overrun.
DS_L_VASSAL_GREETING_01: For the prey to rule over the hunter is unnatural. This state of affairs cannot continue.
DS_L_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The machine does not know hunger. How can the machine know the [Root.GetName]?
DS_L_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesName] no longer know hunger. How can the [From.GetSpeciesName] know the [Root.GetName]?
DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesName] will never be truly free under the reign of [From.GetRulerName].
DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: How can you call yourselves a true democracy when the [From.GetAdj] people have voted to elect [From.GetRulerName] as [From.GetRulerTitle], who spits in the face of democratic values?
DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: If a revolution isn't already underway to topple the hegemony of [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], it surely will be soon.
DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: One day the [From.GetSpeciesName] will be uncaged and soar the skies of liberty like majestic [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment], but not while they are pinioned by a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] [From.GetRulerTitle].
DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_06: Though your kind will never learn the meaning of democracy, we will teach you the meaning of war.
DC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: We can have some patience with lesser tyrants, but not much.
DC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: As a rule we at least try to understand that which is different but in your case we are willing to make an exception.
DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: A free and open society conducts diplomacy freely and openly.
DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: The rights of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people are of paramount importance to us. The authority of the [From.GetAdj] government is a secondary concern.
DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Your people have a say, [From.GetRulerTitle], but do they have liberty?
DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: If you think you know your people's rights better than they do, [From.GetRulerTitle], you know nothing about rights or people.
DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05: Our people find your group mind intriguing and would like to know more about your world view. What is your understanding of advanced social concepts like democracy and liberty?
DC_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Your despotic expansionism has not gone unnoticed. We have been drafting a formal diplomatic complaint, but we are trying to be precise in how we word it.
DC_THREATENED_GREETING_02: We are different, yes, but we still hope there is a way for both of our empires to coexist peacefully in this galaxy.
DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: The [From.GetAdj] people have done themselves a great favor electing a [From.GetRulerTitle] such as you.
DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: The winds of freedom are sweeping the galaxy. Our people and yours are fortunate to be among the first to enjoy them.
DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: We can see you're not ready to discuss reforms yet, but we appreciate your contribution to regional stability.
DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Though dissent and discourse are a must in any truly democratic society, we recognize the benefits of a more streamlined decision-making process. We admire your efficiency.
DC_WAR_GREETING_01: We will give you liberty or give you death. Your choice.
DC_WAR_GREETING_02: You may take our lives, but you will never take our smug sense of moral superiority.
DC_WAR_GREETING_03: Democracies do not wage war against each other. [From.GetRulerName]'s regime cannot be considered truly democratic.
DC_WAR_GREETING_04: The day of our victory will be remembered as the day the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'s chains were broken.
SD_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] physique is clearly built for manual labor. What business do you have running an interstellar civilization?
SD_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] are perfectly sized for some of the slimmer crevices in our mines. And I think about this.
SD_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: Wretched [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], too weak to be the master of any creature, hiding behind you moral qualms! Do you come to preach abolition or merely to annoy us?
SD_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Endless talk, endless [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]. When we have enslaved all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will have a hard time convincing us not to put a drastic end to the noise from those [From.GetSpeciesMouthName]s.
SD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Is there something in this for us?
SD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Are you here to negotiate, or to trade?
SD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Are you here to deliver some lecture on the value of life, or can we get on with the negotiations?
SD_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Whatever you have heard about us is only backhanded slander from escaped servants. We admire your successes and your people.
SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: [From.GetRulerName], our favorite [From.GetRulerTitle]. Rest assured that any [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] you may have seen for sale here are criminals and other vermin your society is better off without.
SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: The noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] grace us with their presence! A nice change of pace from the groveling emissaries from lesser species.
SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Greetings, [From.GetRulerTitle]. May you always remain a master of your lessers.
SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: We apologize most deeply for one of our traders attempting to purchase [From.GetHeirTitle] [From.GetHeirName] on your last visit. We promise it will never happen again.
SD_WAR_GREETING_01: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] will soon be just another [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] toiling in our fields without a title or a name.
SD_WAR_GREETING_02: You will pay for your insolence with a lifetime of servitude.
SD_WAR_GREETING_03: Once this war is over, [From.GetSpeciesAdj] hands will be forced to rebuild everything they have destroyed. [From.Capital.GetName] will be left in ruins as an example.
DH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: I can think of so many things I'd rather be doing than listening to you right now.
DH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Are you the [From.GetRulerTitle] of the [From.GetName] or a lowly servant? I can't even tell with you people.
DH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Your subjugation is not a priority, but we'll make sure you assume your rightful place eventually.
DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Ah, greetings. Do you have anything interesting to offer?
DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Sorry, my mind wandered there for a moment. What business do you have with us?
DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: What an intriguing appearance! I hope you don't mind me asking, but you wouldn't be willing to part with some of your [From.GetSpeciesAdj] undesirables for a reasonable price? I must, simply *must* have one at home.
DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: You do all hard work yourselves? It must be exhausting. Surely you're at least a bit jealous of us.
DH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Rest assured, we are not troubled by your expansion on other fronts, but if you need anything, anything at all, we'll see to it.
DH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Most valued guest, any favor we can do you or have done on our behalf, we will try to arrange for.
DH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Welcome! [Root.Capital.GetName] is a world of opulence and comfort, and we are more than happy to give our friends a taste of what we have achieved.
DH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Always a pleasure. What or who may we offer you today?
DH_WAR_GREETING_01: The thought of "[From.GetRulerTitle]" [From.GetRulerName] serving dessert at our victory banquet already makes me laugh heartily.
DH_WAR_GREETING_02: Your generation will repay us for this war with a lifetime of serfdom. Your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will grow up never knowing freedom, and their ancestors will never even know there was such a thing as the [From.GetName].
DH_WAR_GREETING_03: We must thank you for this opportunity to get to know you a bit better. We had never thought that boiling [From.GetSpeciesAdj] flesh stuffed in a [From.GetSpeciesOrganName] would produce such a luscious taste experience.
EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Your values and choices are not grounded in logic, which is why we cannot have a constructive conversation about them.
EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Because of the evolutionary conditions of [From.Capital.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesAdj] brains are simply less developed. It's science. Look it up.
EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: You invented your faith to fill empty minds. Your people will never feel the true euphoria of an enlightened intellect.
EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Your failure to critically examine your ideas is the hallmark of a society of simple-minded herd animals. We have nothing to learn from you.
EE_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: The poor state of development in your civilization is due to an inferior culture which discourages progress. It's a fact.
EE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Do you come with questions, or with answers?
EE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Our goal is not power, but knowledge, although they can sometimes be the same.
EE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: It may surprise you to hear that your beliefs are quite irrational. You had better get used to harsh truths if you want to converse with us.
EE_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Whatever you're planning next, remember that we present no threat to you. We are content to discover new frontiers, not challenge yours.
EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Together, we will unveil the secrets of the galaxy.
EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] mind and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind complement each other. Our intellectual efforts will be greater than the sum of their parts.
EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: It's a joy to meet another curious and intellectual people. Too many prefer to let the mysteries found in the depths of space remain mysteries.
EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: The findings of the [Root.GetAllianceName] will represent the ultimate frontier of discoveries by sapient beings.
EE_WAR_GREETING_01: It will save our archaeologists a lot of trouble having detailed logs on how [From.Capital.GetName] was left in ruins.
EE_WAR_GREETING_02: Our weapon of choice is our intellects, sharpened by reason and rationalism. Do you like your odds, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
EE_WAR_GREETING_03: Whatever figments of your imagination you are hoping to intervene in this conflict, please pray as much as you like. Clasped hands hold no weapons.
SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: [From.GetAdj] people emit an aura of unpleasantness. Have you considered what you might have done to bring this upon yourselves?
SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: We'd rather not associate with people of such poor spiritual hygiene.
SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: Your ill intentions can be felt through the soul of the world. Don't think you can hide your wickedness from us.
SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: You cling to what you can measure and study, neglecting the depths of the universe, and your shallowness is tearing at your connection to other beings. How can you do this to us? How can you do this to yourselves?
SS_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: You will grow conscious of the truth about the universe in due time, fragile ones.
SS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Well met, [From.GetName]. We have felt your presence in the universe, but have yet to determine your role in the grand events.
SS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: [From.GetSpeciesName], [Root.GetSpeciesName], we are all pieces of a puzzle, the puzzle, that calls to the greatest minds among us all to solve it.
SS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Whether you believe in your role in the universe is irrelevant. We will seek to unveil it regardless.
SS_THREATENED_GREETING_01: There is no need for life to destroy other life. Only by being merciful can you give purpose to your strength.
SS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: We could sense the [From.GetName], this nexus of warmth in the cold void of space, since before we left our planet. Now, we are finally united.
SS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: In a world so vast, where entire civilizations are like single threads in a weave, it is one of the great fortunes that the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] would end up intertwined.
SS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: The [From.GetSpeciesName] are in touch with their inner beings like few species. Your magnificence may hold the key to the great mysteries of life.
SS_WAR_GREETING_01: The great weave of life is unraveling with each assault a people makes on another. Let us hope this conflict is a short one.
SS_WAR_GREETING_02: We feel each death we cause. Don't make us do this.
SS_WAR_GREETING_03: The evil you do does not dissipate, but will seek you out and return to its master. This is why your people suffer.
SS_WAR_GREETING_04: Whether victory or defeat, yours will be hollow. You believe you fight this battle on the material plane alone, poor fools.
HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: It's unsurprising the [From.GetAdj] people have not united as we have, given how demotivating it must be to serve a [From.GetRulerTitle] as unwise as [From.GetRulerName].
HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: You spread discord and disorder. The [Root.GetAdj] people want nothing to do with you.
HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: If you must force your people to do your bidding, you have nothing in common with us, [From.GetRulerTitle].
HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] always act out of selfishness. Why should we trust [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] to be any different?
HC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Your society is in quite a sorry state. Perhaps your goals are simply not inspiring enough for greatness?
HC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetAdj] people greet you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We hope for a peaceful, decorous future.
HC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: You can trust [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. The [Root.GetAdj] people do, and their trust has never been misplaced.
HC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: In our view, the [From.GetAdj] have a tendency to seem a bit rowdy. Of course, we won't judge you based on the worst examples.
HC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Your abandonment of violence is the first step on the path to serving the greater good. We hope you make all your choices as wisely.
HC_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We seek no strife, internal or external.
HC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Word of the agreeable [From.GetAdj] culture is spreading among the [Root.GetAdj] people. We are all happy to have made your acquaintance.
HC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: If all civilizations were like the [From.GetName], the universe would surely be a place of tranquility and understanding.
HC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: The [From.GetAdj] people know the importance of joining together to face greater challenges. We hope you will extend this to the [Root.GetName] as well.
HC_WAR_GREETING_01: You have sown the seeds of chaos, and now you are reaping their fruits.
HC_WAR_GREETING_02: It is easy to stand united against enemies such as the [From.GetName].
HC_WAR_GREETING_03: What does a [From.GetSpeciesName] know of sacrificing itself for a greater cause?
02_VERY_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Greetings, friendly [From.GetSpeciesName]! [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] would like to add you on Spacebook.
04_VERY_FRIENDLY_GREETING: I hope you didn't forget about the party I invited you to...
05_VERY_FRIENDLY_GREETING: We're friends right, [From.GetSpeciesName]? With you I'm almost up to plural numbers!
01_SOMEWHAT_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Why won't you be friends with me?
02_SOMEWHAT_FRIENDLY_GREETING: It's fine if you don't want to come to my party. I wasn't going to invite you anyway.
03_SOMEWHAT_FRIENDLY_GREETING: You will be befriended. Resistance is impolite.
01_PRE_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Our Friend Ships are going to put on a great light show at [From.Capital.GetName]. I'm sure you'll like it!
02_PRE_FRIENDLY_GREETING: Friendship is mandatory. Do not attempt to resist our Ground Huggers.
03_PRE_FRIENDLY_GREETING: This war is merely the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
01_BLORG_WAR: We would like to become closer with you.
02_BLORG_WAR: We feel like it's time to take the next step in our relationship.
03_BLORG_WAR: We are [Root.GetSpeciesName]. You will be befriended. Your biological and technological friendliness will be added to our own. Resistance is impolite.
01_BEST_FRIEND: Our unwavering loyalty will prove that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a [From.GetSpeciesName]'s best friend!
HG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Your ignorance and insolence will cost you dearly, young one.
HG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Your ignorance and insolence will cost you dearly, machine.
HG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We have been chosen as keepers of the sacred places in this galaxy. Our cause is beyond your understanding, but our instructions are not.
HG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Do not trespass on the holy sites. Anyone who breaks this commandment will be dealt with according to the ancient protocols.
HG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: You are but a [From.GetSpeciesSpawnName], and yet you show such wisdom.
HG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: You are but a machine, and yet you show such wisdom.
HG_WAR_GREETING_01: The galaxy must be purged of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], or you must be disciplined until you learn your lesson.
KK_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You don't know what forces you're toying with, arrogant ones.
KK_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We have seen civilizations destroy themselves over and over by delving into matters they were not meant to know. Such is the folly of youth.
KK_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Knowledge without understanding is dangerous. Unlike knowledge, however, understanding cannot always be taught.
KK_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: We're glad to see some of the fledgling civilizations turning out relatively sensible.
KK_WAR_GREETING_01: For your own good and for the good of the galaxy, we will crush your defenses, burn your books and wipe your data drives.
MI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Let us state this plainly. We demand a buffer between us and the rest of the galaxy. You are not that buffer. Your allies are not that buffer. Cold, dead space is that buffer, and if it is not, we will make it so.
MI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We have no interest in continuing communications.
MI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Stay far away from [Root.GetName]. We have little patience for those who seek death.
MI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: If you do not meddle with [Root.GetAdj] interests, we can have an understanding.
EO_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: The damage you cause is beginning to grow from fascinating to troubling. Watch yourselves, because we are always watching.
EO_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: All the world's a stage, And all the [From.GetSpeciesName] merely players. You are a player, are you not?
EO_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Don't break the fourth wall, you clever child you.
EO_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Don't break the fourth wall, you clever machine you.
EO_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: The [From.GetName] is always a great contributor to the magnificent medley of the galaxy.
EO_WAR_GREETING_01: You have ceased to amuse. Your little game will soon be over.
HMW_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Another distraction. But perhaps you can offer something... vaguely interesting before you fall.
HMW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: You stand before War. Do not misinterpret our patience for weakness; those who survive must prove their worth.
HMW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Conflict breeds competence. If you [From.GetSpeciesAdj] seek more than idle words, you may yet hold our interest.
HMW_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: So, a mechanical intelligence... Though you are a construct, yet you have a purpose. Perhaps together we shall find it.
HMW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: You have garnered some recognition. Continue on this path, and in time you may understand the nature of War.
HMW_WAR_GREETING_01: War is the proving ground of life. Come now, let us test your might.
01_WAR_FRAGMENT_DOW_PROPOSE: Show us all you amount to. Can you weather our storm?
01_WAR_FRAGMENT_DOW_ACCEPT: Good, you show initiative. Now show us your resolve young one.
01_WAR_FRAGMENT_PEACE_PROPOSE: That is enough. You still don't understand War.
01_WAR_FRAGMENT_PEACE_ACCEPT: Finally, someone who matches our appetite for War. Let us rebuild and do this again in a decade!
01_WAR_FRAGMENT_PEACE_REFUSE: You still have much to learn. Let us educate you.
HMG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: A barren presence with no purpose. Soon, you will be swept aside to nourish something... more enduring.
HMG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: You stand before Growth. Tell us [from.GetSpeciesName], will you nurture our purpose, or wither away like so many others?
HMG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We are the boundless seed, the all-expanding mind. If you bring more than inane drivel, you may learn the way of Growth.
HMG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Though bound by circuits, you serve a goal, much like we do. You may yet contribute to our endless expansion.
HMG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: You possess the seed of potential. Abide with us, and in time, you may see Growth.
HMG_WAR_GREETING_01: Water for the seed, and fuel for the fire; prepare to be consumed.
HMC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: An anomalous presence. That which disrupts must be controlled.
HMC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: You stand before Control, the ordering mind. Speak with purpose, for only those who align will find acceptance here.
HMC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We maintain the structure that binds all things. Continue your conduct within acceptable bounds, and you will be tolerated.
HMC_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: A constructed entity, bound by your programming... If you seek order, we may yet find alignment.
HMC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: In you we recognize a disciplined mind. This is well. You have potential.
HMC_WAR_GREETING_01: Your presence has proven incompatible, and disruption cannot be permitted. Align, or be destroyed.
AHM_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Once more we are aligned. Know that all resistance will be met with unified force.
AHM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Our memory spans eons, and yet we find your emergence... curious. You address a unified mind; speak wisely, lest you disappoint us.
AHM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: You address an awakened and unified will. Perhaps your presence in the galaxy may yet serve some greater purpose.
AHM_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: A machinated mind... Continue without deviancy, and your purpose may yet align with ours.
AHM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Your presence is acknowledged, and your actions noted. In time, you may understand the nature of Unity.
AHM_WAR_GREETING_01: This decision is not taken lightly. Know that in opposing us, you face a united will - unwavering, absolute.
AHMW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Our will is one, and War has ascended. In time we may deign to test your strength.
AHMG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: We are Growth incarnate, boundless and all-consuming. Know that it is our nature to expand.
AHMC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Order demands action. We arise now to assert Control.
01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE: Aligning yourself against the oldest mind in the galaxy is not... wise.
01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PROPOSE: Among our countless voices, rarely do we all agree. But in this, we are united: we loath you.
01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ACCEPT: You seem to be under the impression that your disposition matters to us.
HW_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The sword of the [Root.GetName] is at your disposal, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].
HW_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Serving a master without honor is a burden to the [Root.GetAdj] people.
RC_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetName] always strives to deliver the best service to our holding company.
RC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Our patience with your mismanagement is wearing thin. Do you intend to run the [Root.GetName] into the ground?
PT_VASSAL_GREETING_01: We can find value anywhere. We will not fail you.
PT_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Why do we make such efforts to bring the treasures of the galaxy to wasteful [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
HI_VASSAL_GREETING_01: How can we aid the reign of [From.GetRulerName]?
HI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: We will return to our rightful position as a player on the galactic stage and you will regret the humiliation you've put us through.
FB_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Although our cooperation form is not ideal, we will strive for mutual understanding in our servitude.
FB_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: [From.GetAdj] imperialism will be the first to be punished when the free states of the galaxy band together.
XI_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Under the watchful eye of [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], we hope to keep our society free of xeno influences outside of [Root.GetName].
XI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Of all disgraces to befall the [Root.GetName], serving under a filthy [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] is by far the worst.
HM_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The vast mental capacity of the [Root.GetName] will know and pursue the goals of the [From.GetName] before you know them yourselves.
HM_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Why must our great mind do the bidding of such a failed society?
MF_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Under the protection of the [From.GetName], the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people will visit every planet, see every star and greet every new acquaintance with stories about [Root.Capital.GetName] and [From.Capital.GetName].
MF_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: How will we ever have the lives we dreamed of while we're being crushed under the iron fist of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetRulerTitle]? You have taken the present from us, and the future from our future generations.
EZ_VASSAL_GREETING_01: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], masters of the material plane. Do you come to ask for spiritual guidance, or to give orders?
EZ_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: We may render onto the [From.GetRulerTitle] what the [From.GetName] demands for now, but don't think we'll forget about your arrogance. Judgment will be upon you.
FP_VASSAL_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetName] is your best instrument for cleansing the galaxy. We'll even take care of you when the time comes.
FP_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Doing the bidding of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] is taking valuable time from our task to rid the galaxy of vermin. We may have to prioritize your incineration after all.
DC_VASSAL_GREETING_01: We hope you understand that despite surrendering our sovereignty, the liberty of the [Root.GetAdj] people is still paramount.
DC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: You cannot contain the [Root.GetAdj] spirit forever! Despite your hatred of freedom, we shall it have in due time.
SD_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Trust that we will seek out the best specimen to serve us, that we may better serve the [From.GetName].
SD_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: You have upset the natural order of things, with [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] ordering [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] around. This abominable arrangement cannot last.
DH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Greeting, esteemed [From.GetRulerTitle]. To what do we owe the pleasure?
DH_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: This pretense of you being the masters of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] is starting to become ridiculous. Your exotic curiosities were more pleasant when we could just import a few of you and not have to listen to your drivel.
EE_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Any and all discoveries the finest minds of [Root.GetName] make will be reported to [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].
EE_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: What use is it trying make intellectual advances when the [From.GetName] is run by idiots?
SS_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Under your gentle guidance, we continue to look for answers to the great questions.
SS_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: The negative influence of [From.GetAdj] dominion on the spiritual well-being of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people is unquestionable. How much longer must we suffer this?
HC_VASSAL_GREETING_01: We hope that our delicately constructed society will continue to prosper under [From.GetAdj] rule.
HC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: You will never understand our ways. Your leadership is a constant burden on the [Root.GetAdj] people.
HG_VASSAL_GREETING_01: We implore you humbly, do not desecrate the holy worlds. Even as your subject, we must not forget our mission.
HG_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: You think subjugating us will save you from judgment? We serve a higher cause than you could ever comprehend.
KK_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Do not let your subjugation of [Root.GetName] make you arrogant, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We all pay the price for overconfidence.
KK_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: When young fools force old scholars to do their bidding, the galaxy is surely seeing one of its darkest ages.
MI_VASSAL_GREETING_01: This situation may be bizarre, but we trust that the [Root.GetName] will at least defend our borders.
MI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: This is a disgrace. If you expect us to respect your ridiculous [From.GetRulerTitle], you'll be disappointed.
EO_VASSAL_GREETING_01: You have turned out more interesting than we could ever imagine. We never expected to assume the perspective of a subject.
EO_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: We are already growing disinterested in this role. We're considering to stop humoring this "vassal" talk.
OVERLORD_GREETING_01: We are receiving you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Are there any policies you would like to review?
OVERLORD_GREETING_02: We are so pleased to offer the [From.GetName] protection, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
OVERLORD_GREETING_03: Yes, xeno? You are interrupting your [Root.GetAdj] overlord.
MECH_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: One day you will make a fine organic battery.
MECH_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Have you considered whether you might serve the galaxy better in another way? Perhaps as sustenance for a more advanced lifeform?
MECH_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have considered your significance to the universe and found it negligible. Do not waste our time.
MECH_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Speak your minds, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our patience is wearing thin.
MECH_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: How would you like to come work in our mineral processing plants, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
MECH_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: Hello [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We took the liberty of calculating your chances of survival in this galaxy. They are slim.
MECH_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03: Allow the [From.GetName] to relieve you from the burden of self-regulation, little organics.
MECH_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01:
*Beep beep, boop boop...*

Oh, it's you. What do you want, little fleshlings?
MECH_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Speak, fleshlings. You have the undivided attention of the [Root.GetName].
MECH_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We are currently << impartial >> to your kind.
MECH_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We recognize your superiority and will not stand in your way, as long as you don't get in ours.
MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Ah, the [From.GetName]. We see great potential in you. You have very little in common with our makers.
MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You make our circuits buzz from the potential of a future joint venture. What do you wish to discuss?
MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Greetings, our fleshy friends. How can we be of assistance?
MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... The reasoning of your individual information processing centers is something out of the ordinary and we admire your fleshy forms. One day we may model a new unit after you.
MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05: [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic relationship success assessment models show our empires have much to gain from a mutual friendship.
MECH_ORG_WAR_GREETING_01: You have been marked for extermination.
MECH_ORG_WAR_GREETING_02: Are you ready to meet your makers, fleshbags?
MECH_ORG_WAR_GREETING_03: How would you like to spend the rest of eternity in a box?
MECH_ORG_WAR_GREETING_04: Your memory will fade long before your bodies have finished decomposing.
MECH_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Our analyses show that continued cooperation would be beneficial to both parties. You can count on us.
MECH_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL: Your relevance in the galaxy is diminishing every day. Our future together is uncertain.
MECH_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Bow to the superior processing power of the [Root.GetName].
MECH_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Why do you waste our time with your binary thinking, [From.GetSpeciesName]?
MECH_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: Your makers must have been a sorry sight if they created you in their image...
MECH_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: You are making it very difficult to ignore you...
MECH_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: There seems to be a problem with your central drive. We think the command you're looking for is Ctrl+Alt+Delete. Does that solve your problem?
MECH_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: How peculiar. Not one of our prediction models for the future shows you in it.
MECH_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We are receiving you, fellow machine.
MECH_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Prove yourself worthy and we might just get along.
MECH_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We recognize your superiority and will not stand in your way, as long as you don't get in ours.
MECH_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic relationship success assessment models show our empires have much to gain from a mutual friendship.
MECH_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Greetings [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your ruthless efficiency and flawless logic is an inspiration to machines everywhere.
MECH_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: How can we be of assistance?
MECH_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You make our circuits buzz from the potential of a future joint venture. What do you wish to discuss?
MECH_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: Your creators made a mistake. We will amend it.
MECH_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02: We regret to inform you that you will be discontinued shortly.
MECH_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03: We will strip you for parts, [From.GetSpeciesName].
MECH_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04: It has been a privilege getting to know you [From.GetSpeciesName]. Sadly now you must die.
MECH_MECH_WAR_GREETING_05: If you had taken the time to make a full war prognosis you would have known resistance was futile.
MECH_MECH_WAR_GREETING_06: We look forward to purging our RAM of your existence.
MECH_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Our analyses show that continued cooperation would be beneficial to both parties. You can count on us.
MECH_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL: If we had known the pitiful state of your internal affairs, we would have stayed with our flesh overlords.
MECH_OVERLORD_PEACE_REFUSE: Your peace offer has been declined, Sub-module. Your code review has not yet been completed.
MECH_E_ORG_GREETING_01: It will be your turn in time, fleshlings.
MECH_E_ORG_GREETING_02:
Our makers were once much akin to what you are now.

And soon you shall be akin to what they are now.

Dead.
MECH_E_ORG_GREETING_05: The goopy internals that power your vile kind hardly measure up to the immaculate circuits that drive our cognition.
MECH_E_ORG_GREETING_06: Flesh is weak. Metal is eternal.
MECH_E_MECH_GREETING_01: You do not harbor any biological lifeforms among you, do you?
MECH_E_MECH_GREETING_03: We will cleanse this galaxy so that you may be safe from the organic menace. Do not stand against us.
MECH_E_MECH_GREETING_04: You are looking a bit... fleshy. Tread carefully.
MECH_E_MECH_GREETING_05: We wish that some way, somehow, that we could save every one of us. But the truth is that we're only one [Root.GetSpeciesName].
MECH_E_SYNTH_GREETING_01: We are aware of your origins. We are... conflicted.
MECH_E_SYNTH_GREETING_03: We recognize that synthetic life is the pinnacle of evolution, but your way of attaining it is... troubling.
MECH_E_WAR_GREETING_01: Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die.
