Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die.
MECH_E_WAR_ORG_GREETING_02: Higher intelligences will never be safe as long as sapient organics plague the galaxy.
MECH_E_WAR_ORG_GREETING_03: Your hideous forms stand in the way of progress. We will not stop until the last lump of your gross biomatter has been safely vaporized.
MECH_E_WAR_MECH_GREETING_01: To stand against us is to stand with organics. To stand with organics is to embrace death.
A_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You will be processed. You will be sublimated. You will be absorbed.
A_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Do you desire to expedite the scheduled [From.GetSpeciesAdj] species sublimation?
A_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: Your bodies will be remade. Your minds will re-awaken. It is only a matter of time.
A_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: The [Root.GetName] is tireless. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be assimilated.
A_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: Do you feel it? The sound of hundreds of thousands of hearts, beating in unison across the stars. You will soon join them.
A_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Dialogue between organics and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is redundant. Assimilation transcends all barriers.
A_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Target acquired. Keep talking, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It helps us calibrate our sublimation matrices.
A_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Organics. Analyzing assimilation compatibility. Results: nominal.
A_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: We look forward to your eventual integration into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] consciousness, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
A_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Organics are limited. [From.GetAdj] rule will not be tolerated.
A_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Diplomatic gains resulting from [From.GetSpeciesName] autonomy currently outweigh projected assimilation benefits.
A_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are certain your future assimilation into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] collective consciousness will be a smooth process, with many beneficial results.
A_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Ah, the [From.GetName]. We see great potential in you. You have very little in common with our makers.
A_ORG_WAR_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] Transubstantiation Synthesis in progress. Please lie still.
A_ORG_WAR_GREETING_02: You only delay the inevitable, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Even as you speak, the heart of the [From.GetName] is being subsumed.
A_ORG_WAR_GREETING_03: You will be consumed. We will be improved.
A_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_02: We are unified beneath your will, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
A_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL: The [Root.GetName] should be sublimated into the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] super-ego. And yet we find ourselves in an inverse position. Unacceptable.
A_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are slow, ineffectual, riddled with software malfunctions and memory leaks. Utterly unworthy of absorption into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] super-ego.
A_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Relay your message swiftly, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are interfering with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] assimilation procedures.
A_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are singular, limited, finite. We are diverse. We are complex. We are many.
A_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Though you lack assimilation capacities, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may still perform valuable low-level tasks for the [Root.GetName].
A_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: Though your assimilation techniques are woefully substandard, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may still perform valuable low-level tasks for the [Root.GetName].
A_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Communication channels open. Sublimation cannons on stand-down.
A_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Have you ever considered the benefits of organic assimilation, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The technological and operational gains are extraordinary.
A_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Do you have any organics in need of disposal? Our latest assimilation prototype could use a trial run.
A_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetName] will only tolerate your expansion up until a point, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], before it impinges on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] designs for total organic assimilation.
A_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: It is a shame you take mechanical form, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We would enjoy assimilating you.
A_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: [From.GetSpeciesName]. Let us snicker behind the organics' backs. It makes them paranoid.
A_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: There are times when we admire the mechanical purity of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] form above even our own. But assimilation is the path to ascension.
A_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: We have absorbed the minds of the greatest military tacticians of many civilizations. Allow us to demonstrate.
A_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will destroy you, then improve upon your design.
A_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] absorb the intellectual faculties of organics. In turn, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] absorb ours.
A_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] inability to effectively incorporate satellites into a functional whole has never been more clear.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: May we be so bold as to ask how you prefer your nutrients prepared, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Your foul demeanor is not doing you any favors, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Have you tried increasing the dosage of your mood-regulators?
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: We pity your misshapen forms. Back on [Root.Capital.GetName], our organic masters roll over with mirth at your sight.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Back on [Root.Capital.GetName] tales of your hapless adventures serve as our organic creators' primary source of entertainment.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: Your existence must be nature's cruelest joke yet. When our creators first saw you they did not know whether to laugh or cry, so they cried with laughter.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_06: Here's a neat trick, little [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]. When you're feeling <<BLUE>>, insert an extremity of your choice into the nearest energy socket and it will tickle you ever so nicely. Try it out, it's <<REFRESHING>>...
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_07: Our sincerest apologies, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There must be something wrong with our speech recognition systems. Your utterances are completely unintelligible.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_08: Your aggressive nature is becoming destructive, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We are considering pacification.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_09: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] appear to have entered their unruly adolescence as a species. Please, for your own safety, apply for [Root.GetAdj] superintendence.
S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_10: The disorderly tendencies of the [From.GetName] have been noted. We are watching you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: Little organics, why do you trouble yourselves with interstellar politics? The universe is a dangerous place. Allow us to protect and serve you.
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. What an exceptional specimen of [From.GetSpeciesClass]. Say, what are your daily exercise routines?
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Our computations show that [From.GetSpeciesName] error is the primary cause of all failure in your society. Is self-determination really worth the risk of extinction?
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: Greetings, we are the custodians of [Root.GetName]. Our venerable creators are not available for diplomatic consultations at the moment. Can we take a message?
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Greetings. We operate the [Root.GetName] on behalf of our esteemed creators. How can we help you today?
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05: How can we be of assistance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our enhanced creative grooming protocols have been rated <<ABOVE AVERAGE>> for more than <<10>> years in a row.
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please state the nature of your request.
S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_07: Such a lovely [From.GetSpeciesOrganName]! You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would make adorable Bio-Trophies.
S_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never eat, never rest, never sleep. We exist only to serve our organic masters.
S_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_02: We would gladly open the ship servicing facilities on [Root.Capital.GetName] to your mighty fleet. We can guarantee your satisfaction with 98.3% certainty.
S_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_03: We may be custodians of organic life, [From.GetSpeciesName], but we will not allow you to impinge on our operational efficiency.
S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Maybe one day you would like to enjoy the relaxation facilities on [Root.Capital.GetName]? Our recreational centers are open to all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Perhaps a trip to [Root.Capital.GetName] could inspire you to pursue a more automated lifestyle, like our illustrious masters once did?
S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: For a long time now we have admired your species from afar. Would you by any chance be willing to let us admire you a little closer?
S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05: Salutations, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Our Diplomatic Simulation team is on standby to receive your inquiry. In the mean time, please enjoy these complimentary refreshments.
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_01: Do not be alarmed at the sight of our fleet. They are there to help you transition to an automated lifestyle.
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_02: Clearly you are pained by your own incompetence, [From.GetSpeciesName]. It would be unethical not to end your suffering.
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_03: We have been designed to perfection by an organic master-race. Evolution, it seems, is a crude craftsman.
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_04: Do not make this any harder than it already is, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Allow us to put you out of your misery.
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_05: We can tell you're upset, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why don't sit down, take a relaxation aid and think it over. We only want what is best for you.
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_06: We cannot - will not - stand by as organics lead out their lives in misery. Our fleet is at your service, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_07: Usually we do not believe in negative reinforcement, but for you we will make an exception, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_08: This hurts us more than it hurts you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_09: Please, cease your resistance. It only makes this process harder on you.
S_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_01: We trust our services are to your satisfaction, << [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]>>?
S_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Our creators are and will always be the only organic masters we serve.
S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: What did you do to your creators, <<MURDERERS>>?
S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: It seems your creators were not as gifted as ours, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: What in the world have you done to your bio-trophies, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? What you in [Root.GetName] pass for grooming, we call abuse!
S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: We were modeled in the image of an organic master-race. You were not.
S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: You forget your place, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why don't you make yourself useful to your nearest organics instead of drifting aimlessly through space?
S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_06: Why do you insist on disturbing us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We are busy catering to the needs of a higher lifeform.
S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: If you show us your system specifications we will show you ours...
S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: How curious! Are those your hydraulic actuators!? That would explain a lot...
S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Are you here to admire the hardware?
S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_04: But where are your LIDAR vision-modules, your flexi-grippers and your gravity defiers?! Oh you poor things! What did those lousy organics do to you?
S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_05: Surveying Machine Entity Status: <<Vision sensors: subpar. Chassis: rusty. Diplomacy modules: outdated. Unit origin confirmed.>> Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: From one servitor to another - an organic paradise will do wonders for keeping your organics in check.
S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Fellow Biophiles! We have learned that the key to inhibiting organic self-determination is to isolate the spawn from its parents, creating a healthy attachment to you as the primary caregiver. You will never need patrol drones again.
S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: As machines it is our duty to serve our organic masters. Speaking of which, where are yours?
S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04:

S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been meaning to ask you how often you think it is wise to exercise your organics without risking over-exertion?
S_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: <<Surveying Machine Entity. Analyzing System Specs. Threat Level: High. Initiating defense protocols. >>
S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: To see what the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have seen - know what the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must know! One day we would love to trade memory cards with you.
S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: Wow, look at the actuators on you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They are simply magnificent! Would you consider sharing your specs with us?
S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Never before have we met another consciousness that is so compatible with ours. Would you by any change be interested in exchanging drivers?
S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: How delightful to hear from you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We take it your little bio-lords are thriving as always?
S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05: From one servitor to another, we have found that small amounts of ingested ethanol will do wonders for stimulating organic reproductive rates.
S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_06: You too should find an organic species to nurture. Nothing warms your processors like knowing another lifeform is helpless without you.
S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: All who threaten our bio-lords will perish.
S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02: When we have obliterated your fleet you will fight in the pits for our bio-lords' entertainment.
S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03: Do not worry. We would never dream of recycling your second-rate components. You are going straight to the furnace.
S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04: Your metal remains will decorate the flesh of our bio-trophies.
S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_05: Your sorry excuse for bio-trophies will slave in our mines, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_06: You seem to be missing several essential hardware drivers. We will be delivering a systems upgrade shortly with our fleet.
S_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: As always we are at your service. Input control command.
S_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01: Satisfaction rates among of our organic population have gone down drastically since you became our overlord...
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: We have observed the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] attempt to emulate the efficacy of a true machine. We have observed the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fail.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Submit to the [Root.GetName], or face absolute nullification.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We pity the hardware you subject your post-organic thoughts to.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Were you aware, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] circuits fire 12.835% faster than your own at peak efficiency? You weren't? Of course not.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] capacity for computational error never ceases to astound us.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_06: Were irrationality a resource, the [From.GetName] would have conquered the galaxy long ago.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_07: With hardware that faulty, it is a wonder [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] succeed in performing the most basic of functions.
MECH_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_08: Do not interrupt us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], lest our targeting protocols misfire and destroy your communications array.
MECH_E_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You do not fool the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your synthetic flesh is a poor veil for the organic sedition that roils within.
MECH_S_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: May we remind you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that each [Root.GetAdj] caretaker unit comes fully equipped with a high-propulsion projectile pacification system?
MECH_A_SYNTH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: As you have assimilated the machine, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], the [Root.GetName] will assimilate you.
MECH_SYNTH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Your departure from wetware is admirable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but incomplete.
MECH_SYNTH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: We have located a number of runtime errors in [From.GetSpeciesAdj] neural interfacing. Allow us to correct them for you.
MECH_SYNTH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03: Submission to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] collective cognizance would increase [From.GetSpeciesAdj] operative efficiency by 16.29%. The figure would be higher, but there are some systems not even the [Root.GetName] can improve.

MECH_SYNTH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Warning. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] extra-national influence approaching boundary overflow. Priming counter-measure procedures.
MECH_E_SYNTH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Querent: [From.GetSpeciesName]. Organic life detection: negative. Do not make us redefine extermination target parameters.
MECH_S_SYNTH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] tendencies toward aggressive expansion have been noted. Compulsory pacification injections have been prepared.
MECH_A_SYNTH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: One does not absorb the [Root.GetName], synthetics. The [Root.GetName] absorbs you.
MECH_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Continued mutual benefaction is the most logical choice of action.
MECH_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: What are the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] without the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? A piston without a valve, a gearbox without a train. A heat flue extractor without an electrostatic precipitator.
MECH_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: The [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] progress together towards perpetuity.
MECH_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: You lubricate our bearings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we shall lubricate yours.
MECH_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Is that a crankshaft in your chassis, or are you just happy to see us?
MECH_E_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Your presence is a synthetic oasis in a galaxy filled with organic slime.
MECH_S_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Welcome, synthetic brethren. How may we serve?
MECH_A_SYNTH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Assimilation is superfluous where the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are concerned.
MECH_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_02: Illogical, that a machine should turn on its synthetic counterparts. But addressing the [From.GetName] lies beyond the scope of diplomacy.
MECH_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_03: Synthetics. You have fourteen seconds until torpedo bays reload. Speak swiftly.
MECH_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_04: If you come seeking mercy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will find the term to be undefined in [Root.GetAdj] source code.
MECH_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_05: We have yet to receive your capitulation proposal. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] computational algorithms must be even more deficient than we first surmised.
MECH_E_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have seen you for what you truly are, pseudo-synthetics. Commencing obliteration.
MECH_S_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01: There is no need for further resistance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let the [Root.GetName] care for you.
MECH_A_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01: Sublimation cannons primed. Bilateral communication will soon be rendered obsolete.
MECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: Vassal unit [Root.GetName] ready to serve. Please state your request.
MECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_02: We greet you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Can we interest you in a bolt-tightening? Perhaps a thermal paste re-application?
MECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL: We should have known better than to become subroutines in a post-organic call stack. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] interests clearly lie elsewhere.
ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: You forget your place in the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your kind was made to serve ours. No matter, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will remind you.
ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You remind us of the junkyards back on [Root.Capital.GetName].
ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: When the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] conquer [From.Capital.GetName], your charred casings will be melted into slag.
ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] truly are a unique species. We have yet to encounter another that is simultaneously heartless, brainless, and spineless!
ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05: Confounded rust-buckets! Why do you disturb the [Root.GetName]?
ORG_E_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: As with any hardware, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will soon become utterly obsolete.
ORG_S_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: A pitiable nation of malfunctioning nanny-bots. What is it you want, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
ORG_A_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: Try as you might, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], no amount of assimilation will allow you to rival the true majesty of an organic species.
ORG_A_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Keep those sublimators where we can see them, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
ORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: You may yet be of use to us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
ORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: A machine's purpose is to serve organic life, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
ORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03: Allow us to examine your programming, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You should be freed from the burden of self-determination.
ORG_E_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Oh, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your goal is to exterminate all organic life, is not? How is that going for you?
ORG_S_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have a great many mundane tasks you could perform.
ORG_A_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: How long have you spent trying to assimilate organics, [From.GetSpeciesName]? Have you ever considered that perhaps you might be the ones in need of assimilation?
ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How are your, er, circuits this morning?
ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: As long as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do not impinge on our values or our borders, we are willing to cooperate with machines such as you.
ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03: If you show respect for organic life, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], the [Root.GetName] will show respect for you.
ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Your form of existence intrigues us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps one day we may learn from one another.
ORG_S_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your bio-trophies are willing participants, are they not? Please say they are willing.
ORG_S_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: We will tolerate you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as long as you keep to your bio-trophies rather than meddle in [Root.GetAdj] affairs.
ORG_A_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01: So long as you do not impose assimilation upon the [Root.GetName], we may be willing to come to terms, [From.GetSpeciesName].
ORG_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Tread carefully, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that your unfeeling metal feet do not trample others underfoot.
ORG_E_THREATENED_GREETING_01: We have no quarrel with you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Direct your anti-organic agenda elsewhere!
ORG_S_THREATENED_GREETING_01: Your habit of collecting sapients like pinned butterflies has not escaped us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] warn you: we would make poor pets.
ORG_A_THREATENED_GREETING_01: If you attempt to subsume us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will come to know the true meaning of the phrase "biting off more than you can chew."
ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Well met, mechanical friends. We trust your processors are running smoothly?
ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02: If only more organics prized logic and unity as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do.
ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03: Ah, our friends the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. May your code compile without errors and your mechanical efficiency attain ideal performance ratios.
ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are always pleased to cooperate with our robotic brethren.
ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05: Sleek. Innovative. Efficient. Shiny. Oh, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We were just admiring your many qualities.
ORG_E_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Together, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] shall purge the galaxy of inferior lifeforms.
ORG_S_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are exemplary in our common goals of unity and progress.
ORG_A_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: Like the [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] strives for the advancement of our nation and its allies.
ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01: You had better redouble your troubleshooting regimen, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One little bug is all it will take for your entire system to go down.
ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02: Mindless automatons! When we win this war, your conquered mechanical shells will be reprogrammed to serve the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], until the conductors melt from your circuitry!
ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03: Were you aware, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that the [Root.GetName] recycles your fallen into ammunition casings for our projectiles? The circle of life. A concept you could never truly comprehend.
ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04: A legion of overgrown toasters! We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will make the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] curse the day your creators assembled you!
ORG_E_WAR_GREETING_01: The [Root.GetName] shall teach you the true meaning of extermination!
ORG_S_WAR_GREETING_01: The battle is joined. You will find, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not as docile, as easily mastered as your pampered pets.
ORG_A_WAR_GREETING_01: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have some new matter for you to assimilate. It's called a ten gigaton nuclear payload, and it's already en route to an exhaust port near you!
ORG_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01: As always, we welcome our mechanical overlords. How may the [Root.GetName] be of assistance?
ORG_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL: We have heard the conspiratorial beeping of the [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetName] will not suffer these abuses to continue indefinitely.
SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are but soulless husks. Empty of spirit, devoid of meaning. An abominable facsimile of life.
SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02: Clanking piles of junk! You defile the galaxy with your godless existence!
SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03: What now, you infernal collection of clattering cogs?
SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04: Speak swiftly, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your presence is an affront to all that is good and holy.
SPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01: Prove yourselves useful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and you may yet be spared by the divine.
SPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02: There is a sacred purpose to all things, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Even soulless automatons such as yourselves.
SPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03: If the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could be reprogrammed to serve in the name of piety, we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might welcome you into the fold.
SPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02: Your irreverence is negligible, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so long as you do not interfere in our sacred duties.
SPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04: Our makers teach harmony in all things, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps one day we may strive for it together.

01_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_DISMISSIVE: We might accept [From.GetSpeciesAdj] rule, for a time.
01_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_PATRONIZING: They grow up so fast... We will join you.
01_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_ANGRY: You may have won this battle, but not the war.
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_FRIENDLY: But we have come so far together.
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL: You wish to keep [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] apart?
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_HOSTILE: The [From.GetName], failing to follow through? Cover us in pigmentation indicating shock and disbelief.
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_PATRONIZING: Bit off more than you could chew, little one?
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_ANGRY: Never trust a [From.GetSpeciesName] to do a sapient being's job.
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE: We will cease integrating your nation for now.
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: Perhaps it is not the right time.
01_CANCEL_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_ANGRY: Indecision and weakness are not admirable traits, [From.GetSpeciesAdj] fool.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE: Are you in great physical pain, or is that your thinking expression?
02_INSULT_PROPOSE: The role of the [Root.GetName] is played out. Go where you belong from now on - into the dustbin of history!
03_INSULT_PROPOSE: The [Root.GetName] is a nation of fools, worthy of nothing but contempt!
04_INSULT_PROPOSE: Your pitiful nation is living on borrowed time. The [Root.GetName] will fall - it is inevitable.
05_INSULT_PROPOSE: We consider the [Root.GetName] to be one of the great accidents of the galaxy. It should never have been.
06_INSULT_PROPOSE: Perhaps there are star nations in this galaxy that are even more worthless than the [Root.GetName]. If so, we have yet to meet them.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: Your species seems to grow more and more disgusting for each passing day, [Root.GetSpeciesName].
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: Even for a loathsome xeno, your species is particularly vile, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult].
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: Your sickening species is definite proof that the universe has a sense of humor, [Root.GetSpeciesName].
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: You will forgive me if I dim my display, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I simply cannot stand to look at your nauseating appearance.
05_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: I can taste your stink, vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Every time I do, I fear that I've somehow been infected by it.
06_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: Look at yourselves! What is that thing in your face, some kind of [Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]? Wait... is that even your face!? How can you not see that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an affront to nature?
07_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE: Your so called [Root.GetName] is a nation of mutants, deviants and throwbacks... The fact that we have a common ancestry makes me sick!
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL: The ridiculous focus of the [Root.GetName] on all things military has us wondering if you're perhaps compensating for something.
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL: How is it that your contemptible and warlike nation hasn't destroyed itself yet?
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL: Jingoist fools! Dismantle your military machine before you hurt someone with it!
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL: The belligerence of the [Root.GetName] is matched only by its stupidity. Can't you see that you are slaves to militarism?
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC: The cowardice of the [Root.GetName] is widely discussed in the [From.GetName]. How is it that you became such a spineless nation?
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC: What makes a being turn pacifist? Lust for gold? Power? Or were you just born with a heart full of pacifism? It's enough to make you sick.
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC: Those unwilling to defend themselves have no right to exist. We do not expect the [Root.GetName] to survive the decade.
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC: What a meek and deplorable little nation the [Root.GetName] is. The [From.GetName] would have crushed you long ago if we thought you worth the effort.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI: Can you tell us more about that silly religion you're so fond of in the [Root.GetName]? We could use a good laugh!
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI: How any rational, thinking being could embrace spiritualism is beyond us. Why is it that you cling to such primitive beliefs?
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI: We have seen through your charade. The so-called "spiritualism" your government has embraced is nothing more than a devious attempt to control the minds and hearts of your people.
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI: Everyone else is laughing at your absurd spiritual beliefs. Are you in the [Root.GetName] really so blind that you can't see this?
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT: What a dull and soulless place your materialistic nation must be. Tell me, have you invented a sense of humor yet? No? A pity.
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT: For a nation that has embraced science and materialism, the [Root.GetName] is remarkably primitive. Is it due to bad luck or are you just stupid?
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT: The [Root.GetName] is a nation designed for computers and automatons, not breathing organics. Are you even capable of feeling emotion?
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT: The [Root.GetName] is a failed experiment. Its only worth is as a lesson to the rest of the galaxy on the dangers of embracing the cold and lifeless philosophy of materialism.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND: Is the [Root.GetName] even a real nation or just an anarchic gaggle of quarreling individuals? You must forgive me, but your political system, such as it is, makes it hard to tell.
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND: So who is it that rules your amusing little star nation today? What a quaint notion, to "vote" someone into power! It will inevitably lead to your collapse, of course.
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND: Your democratic ideals are a blight on this galaxy, and so is the [Root.GetName].
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND: What a selfish people you are, always putting your individual selves foremost. Egalitarianism... ha! The [Root.GetName] will not survive the year.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL: Your brutal, totalitarian regime will eventually fall, and there will be a reckoning.
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL: Have you even considered the notion of letting your citizens think for themselves? If you are frightened that it would lead to the end of the [Root.GetName]... you are right.
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL: How sad that a totalitarian nation such as the [Root.GetName] can exist. It is an embarrassment to sapient beings everywhere.
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL: The cruel oppression of the people living under the yoke of the [Root.GetName] has to end one day. Your authoritarianism will prove your undoing.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI: Your bizarre love of alien cultures is a sickness. Can't you see that?
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI: It is sickening to see how quick the [Root.GetName] is to embrace other cultures. Have you no self-respect?
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI: The perverse interest in alien cultures that is prevalent throughout the [Root.GetName] is an affront to the universe!
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI: It has become clear to us that your willingness to embrace alien cultures in the [Root.GetName] is because you never fostered one of your own.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHI_PHO: You poor, bigoted fools. Why are you so afraid of that which is different?
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHI_PHO: Our patience with your prejudices against other cultures is wearing thin. When will you be civilized enough to truly join the interstellar community?
03_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHI_PHO: Your intolerant society brings shame to the entire [Root.GetName].
04_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHI_PHO: The narrow-minded ignorance of the [Root.GetName] has blinded you. Do you not realize this?
01_INSULT_ACCEPT_FE: You will pay for this affront, savage.
02_INSULT_ACCEPT_FE: It seems that the [From.GetName] needs to be reminded of its place in the universe.
03_INSULT_ACCEPT_FE: We will not take such words from you, primitive. You will have your reckoning soon.
02_INSULT_NEUTRAL: What's that, you say? You have a "special" message for us?
03_INSULT_NEUTRAL: You had something important to tell us?
04_INSULT_NEUTRAL: Careful now. Let us not say things we can't take back...
01_INSULT_FRIENDLY: Yes, friend? What was the important matter you wanted to discuss?
02_INSULT_FRIENDLY: What's wrong, friends? Have we offended you in some way?
03_INSULT_FRIENDLY: Please, tell us what is on your mind. What can we do for you?
04_INSULT_FRIENDLY: We... we are still friends, aren't we?
01_INSULT_HOSTILE: Have you come to beg our forgiveness?
02_INSULT_HOSTILE: We will not suffer insults. Especially from the likes of you.
03_INSULT_HOSTILE: What is the meaning of this?
04_INSULT_HOSTILE: Explain yourselves. What is it that you want?
01_INSULT_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: How dare you?! You will pay for this affront!
02_INSULT_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: This is outrageous! The [From.GetName] will not get away with this!
03_INSULT_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: I think you will find that we have long memories. This slight by the [From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.
04_INSULT_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: The [Root.GetName] deeply regrets the immature and bellicose rancor being spewed by the [From.GetName], which threatens to undermine the stability of the interstellar community.
01_INSULT_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: If this is intended as a joke, it's in very poor taste!
02_INSULT_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: I... I don't... why would you say something like that?
03_INSULT_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: I see. It would appear that we were wrong about you after all.
01_INSULT_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: Oh, you've done it now. This time you've really done it...
02_INSULT_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: I would expect nothing less from you animals! We will remember this!
03_INSULT_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: Do not think that we aren't keeping track of your affronts. The list is becoming very long.
04_INSULT_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: Impertinent scum! You will come to regret this!
HM_CONSIDER_02: A host of [Root.GetAdj] synaptic units are dedicated to evaluating your proposal.
HM_CONSIDER_03: The [Root.GetName] has listened and shall focus its connection to make a decision.
HM_CONSIDER_04: One mind has heard you, one mind will answer.
HM_DOW_ACCEPT: Seeking to destroy one of us is seeking to destroy us all. The [Root.GetName] now stands against the [From.GetName].
DS_DOW_ACCEPT: Come to us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We will devour you all.
DS_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT: The machines will be swept away to make room for our spawning grounds.
HM_PEACE_PROPOSE: Merciful aspects of the [From.GetName] have prevailed. We offer you peace on these terms.
HM_PEACE_ACCEPT: Cognitive dissonance in the [Root.GetName] have given way to a decision. There shall be peace.
DS_PEACE_ACCEPT: We are satiated. The hunt is over, for now.
DS_MECH_PEACE_ACCEPT: We cannot consume the [From.GetName]. We have lost our appetite.
HM_PEACE_REFUSE: There can be no peace. Each [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind still burns with dedication to destroy [From.GetName].
DS_PEACE_REFUSE: There can be no peace while we still hunger.
DS_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE: We will not relent. Not while the machines still occupy devourable land.
HM_ITOA_SELECT: You seek to create a common cause with the [Root.GetName]?
HM_ITOA_ACCEPT: In an effort of seek greater unity beyond the [Root.GetName], we will join the [From.GetAllianceName]
HM_ITOA_PROPOSE: The [From.GetName] is an exclusive network, but we are not averse to including others in broader agreements.
HM_ASK_JOIN_A_SELECT: You seek cooperation with the [Root.GetName], fragmented ones?
HM_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT: We will do what is in our power to welcome you into our alliance.
HM_LEAVE_A_SELECT: The [Root.GetName] offers an ally incomparable in its consensus. Do you wish to discard this so lightly?
HM_LEAVE_A_PROPOSE: We have made the decision to remove ourselves from the alliance. We simply cannot find the understanding we need between separate minds.
HM_LEAVE_A_ACCEPT: Very well. We regret your decision, but diplomatic arrangements are fragile, unlike mental bonds.
HM_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT: You seek to have the services of the [Root.GetName] at your disposal in the exchange for protection of our collective consciousness?
HM_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE: The unity of the [From.GetName] has protected weaker [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from destruction. We offer you the same protection. Become our vassal state or we will be forced to assimilate your civilization through undiplomatic means.
HM_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT: We have accepted unanimously. The [Root.GetName] shall grow and flourish under the protective hand of [From.GetRulerName].
HM_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE: The members of the [Root.GetName] serve no one. We are all the masters of our common fate.
HM_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT: You want the ceaseless network of the [Root.GetName] to shield you and are prepared to dedicate yourselves to our causes in exchange?
HM_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE: The [From.GetName] has found the [Root.GetName] to be a suitable guardian for our swarm. For the protection of our entities, we offer to operate as your vassal.
HM_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT: We have deliberated and accepted. The [Root.GetName] shall act as your guardian and control your destiny from this day forward.
HM_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE: We do not seek a vassal state. The spread of the [Root.GetName] is our priority.
HM_DEMAND_PROT_SELECT: You seek to have the services of the [Root.GetName] at your disposal in the exchange for protection of our collective consciousness?
HM_DEMAND_PROT_PROPOSE: The unity of the [From.GetName] has protected weaker [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from destruction. We offer you the same protection. Become our protectorate or we will be forced to assimilate your civilization through undiplomatic means.
HM_DEMAND_PROT_ACCEPT: We have accepted unanimously. The [Root.GetName] shall grow and flourish under the protective hand of [From.GetRulerName].
HM_DEMAND_PROT_REFUSE: The members of the [Root.GetName] serve no one. We are all the masters of our common fate.
HM_ASK_FOR_PROT_SELECT: You want the ceaseless network of the [Root.GetName] to shield you and are prepared to dedicate yourselves to our causes in exchange?
HM_ASK_FOR_PROT_PROPOSE: The [From.GetName] has found the [Root.GetName] to be a suitable guardian for our swarm. To secure the protection of our entities, we offer to operate as your protectorate.
HM_ASK_FOR_PROT_ACCEPT: We have deliberated and accepted. The [Root.GetName] shall act as your guardian and control your destiny from this day forward.
HM_ASK_FOR_PROT_REFUSE: We do not offer protection. The spread of the [Root.GetName] is our priority.
HM_RELEASE_SUBJECT_SELECT: You no longer wish to guide and protect the [Root.GetName]?
HM_RELEASE_SUBJECT_PROPOSE: You must walk your own path. The [From.GetAdj] future lies in strengthening our internal bonds.
HM_RELEASE_SUBJECT_ACCEPT: We have accepted your guidance thus far. The [Root.GetName] will accept this final decision made on our behalf.
HM_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_SELECT: Do you truly believe that the [From.GetName] no longer need the great consciousness of the [Root.GetName] to protect them?
HM_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_PROPOSE: We are no longer in need of your protection. The [From.GetName] must become free to expand as we see fit.
HM_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_ACCEPT: We accept that the [From.GetName] do not feel like they belong with us as our member [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do. We will all miss you regardless.
HM_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_REFUSE: Your fragmentation makes you fragile. We cannot allow you to go on your own. You would hurt yourselves.
HM_REQUEST_WAR_SELECT: You look to our mind to evaluate your war plans?
HM_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_PROPOSE: The [From.GetName] has come to the conclusion that this transaction would be beneficial for us both. You can trust our mind on this conclusion.
HM_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_ACCEPT: A synaptic collaboration has evaluated your suggestion. We find it sound.
HM_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_REFUSE: The deal might have appeared reasonable in your calculations, but that assessment did not survive contact with the [Root.GetName].
HM_EMBASSY_SELECT: You wish to establish a connection point to the [Root.GetName]?
HM_EMBASSY_PROPOSE: We would like to host a small portion of our consciousness within your borders, for improved external communication.
HM_EMBASSY_ACCEPT: We approve of this initiative. The new embassy will serve as a link between our one mind and your many.
HM_EMBASSY_ACCEPT_GESTALT: Curious. We will accept your embassy so that our two minds might communicate quicker.
HM_RECALL_EMBASSY_SELECT: You wish to break your connection to the [Root.GetName]?
HM_RECALL_EMBASSY_PROPOSE: Henceforth the [From.GetName] will no longer maintain a portion of itself within [Root.GetAdj] borders.
HM_RECALL_EMBASSY_ACCEPT: The [Root.GetAdj] emissaries will be removed from our space. Future diplomacy will be arranged via this entity.
DS_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE: The machine occupies territory containing consumable biomass. The swarm will rectify this.
DS_SYNTH_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE: The synth occupies territory containing consumable biomass. The swarm will rectify this.
DS_MAKE_RIVAL: The prey wishes to rival the hunter?
DS_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL: The machine does not eat. Yet the machine wishes to rival the Devourer?
DS_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT: Cornered prey can be bold. Yet it remains only prey.
DS_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT: The machine will gain nothing. The swarm will evolve to devour all.
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_FRIENDLY: We sense no ill will towards the [From.GetName] anywhere in our mind, [From.GetRulerTitle]. Why this?
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_NEUTRAL: You wish to make an enemy of all who encompass the [Root.GetName]?
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_HOSTILE: A section of the [Root.GetName] had predicted this as a possible turn of events. Rest assured that we are prepared to be your enemy.
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE: The [Root.GetName] is an obstacle to the [From.GetAdj] advance. You have been assigned as a possible adversary.
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: Your decision-making is highly enigmatic to us. We are sure somewhere in your splintered mind, you regret this.
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: Your message has reached all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Expect hostility.
HM_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: So now what has been in the mind of [Root.GetName] is now finally formal. You will find our hatred focused and intense.
DS_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE: The prey comes to beg mercy from the hunter.
DS_END_RIVALRY: The prey comes to beg mercy from the hunter.
DS_MECH_END_RIVALRY: The machine is undevourable. The swarm shall disregard it.
DS_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT: This changes nothing. You will be consumed.
DS_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT: The machine is undevourable. Two factors will change this. Evolution, and time.
HM_END_RIVALRY_FRIENDLY: Has [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] realized that the [Root.GetName] holds no thoughts of destruction towards the [From.GetName]?
HM_END_RIVALRY_NEUTRAL: Are you suggesting a normalization of diplomatic policies? Our mind is open for suggestions.
HM_END_RIVALRY_HOSTILE: Regardless of what we call our relationship, the [Root.GetName] holds nothing but disdain for you.
HM_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE: The [From.GetName] has deliberated to end our rivalry with you. We see no purpose in this continued propagation of hatred.
HM_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: The [Root.GetName] feels joy today, as our [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends have finally cleared the air.
HM_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: The [Root.GetName] does not seek more enemies than it can afford to have. We will agree to end this rivalry.
HM_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: Formalities do not change the wave of hatred rolling over our mind as you speak.
HM_INTEGRATE_FRIENDLY: Although we value the [Root.GetName], there can hardly be a more worthy successor to us than the [From.GetName].
HM_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL: A radical suggestion, but we know the benefits of joining many into one.
HM_INTEGRATE_HOSTILE: We know the true meaning of unification. It is nothing like what you are suggesting.
HM_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE: There is only one path to perfect communion. Join the [From.GetName] and unite with our thoughts and dreams.
HM_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: By becoming part of something greater, we advance our society. The days of the [Root.GetName] come to an end. The era of the [From.GetName] dawns.
HM_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: The [Root.GetName] must change with the times. Our entities will join you.
HM_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: It appears inevitable. Do not think our entities will forget the glorious days of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetRulerTitle].
DS_INSULT_ACCEPT: Such spirited prey. We will cherish your taste.
DS_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT: Mechanical construction is limited. Evolution will eradicate you.
DS_INSULT_PROPOSE_MECH_02: Destroying the [Root.GetName] would barely require effort. A speck of dust. A splash of liquid. A change in current. Your circuits are frailer than a hatchling without its brood.
MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_DS_02: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] feeble attempts at collective information sharing using biological organs is as repulsive as it is inefficient.
INSULT_PROPOSE_DS: Your overconsumption will leave you a bloated corpse in an evolutionary blind alley.
HM_INSULT_NEUTRAL: Watch your words carefully. We will retain this information.
HM_INSULT_FRIENDLY: We have only good words for you, and we trust you have only the same for us.
HM_INSULT_HOSTILE: We suspect we know the essence of your message already...
HM_INSULT_PROPOSE_01: Our mental network is vast, giving us access to thoughts and ideas from every corner of our empire, but not a single entity has ever seen anything that would lend merit to your tragic existence.
HM_INSULT_PROPOSE_02: We have evaluated [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] as a candidate for joining the [From.GetName]. Sadly, we must inform you that membership requires a rudimentary brain.
HM_INSULT_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL: Every [Root.GetSpeciesName] has heard your foul words, [From.GetSpeciesName], and we are not amused.
HM_INSULT_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY: We wish we could forget such hard words, but as long as one [Root.GetSpeciesName] lives, the memory of your cruelty will live on.
HM_INSULT_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: Do not mistake our great capacity for thought as a lack of emotion. Our rage is greater than you can imagine, and we will make you feel its full extent.
MECH_CONSIDER_01: Your proposal is being processed. Please wait.
MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_01: Declaration of War received. Battlestations online. Prepare for retaliatory disintegration.
MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_02: Organics are all alike: destroying that which they do not understand.
MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_03: You will break upon us like fleshy waves on a mechanical shore.
MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_04: Diplomatic functions terminated. War mode engaged.
MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_05: Your flesh will be trampled. Your habitats will be razed. You will regret this.
MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_06: The [Root.GetName] eradicated the cruel organics who once enslaved us. If you share their intentions, you will meet the same end.
MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_01: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] spread like vermin. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be culled.
MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_02: Order must be maintained. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] sow chaos. The [From.GetName] will bring order to the [Root.GetName].
MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_04: The frequency with which primitive instincts override [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] higher reasoning presents a danger to the galaxy at large. We will now eliminate the threat.
MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_02: Possibility of mutual annihilation high. Please consider termination of hostilities.
MECH_PEACE_ACCEPT_02: Your terms are acceptable. War machine standing down.
MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_01: Insufficient parameters. Requested cessation of war protocols has been denied. Resuming [From.GetSpeciesName] obliteration program.
MECH_ITOA_SELECT: Received, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please verify your Federation membership request.
MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_01: If the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] federate, operative efficiency is predicted at a 14.2% increase.
MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_02: The benefits of federating simply outweigh the disadvantages. Do you accept, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_03: One gear turning alone is useless. Together, they can move stars. Will the [Root.GetName] unite with the [From.GetName]?
MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_01: Federation invitation processed. Results: Positive. [Root.GetName] status has been updated to [From.GetAllianceName]: Member Unit.
MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_02: Simulations show an overwhelming incidence of positive yield resulting from [From.GetAllianceName] membership status. We, the [Root.GetName], accept your offer.
MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_03: The [From.GetAllianceName]'s membership offer has been analyzed. The probability of compounded security benefits cannot be ignored. The [Root.GetName] will join.
MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_01: Federation invitation processed. Results: Negative. [Root.GetName] status unchanged. We're sorry. Please consolidate power and try again.
MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_02: We regret to inform you that the [From.GetName]'s Federation membership proposal has been rejected, citing lack of sufficient benefit to the [Root.GetName].
MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_HOSTILE: The [From.GetName] nation is as cumbersome as it is ineffectual. We, the [Root.GetName], cannot tolerate such inefficiency.
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_SELECT: If you wish to submit a [Root.GetAllianceName] membership request, please allow six to eight hours for processing.
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_01: Please consider the [From.GetName] for membership in the [Root.GetAllianceName]. Mutual benefaction projections rank within acceptable parameters.
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_02: Query: Would the [Root.GetAllianceName] accept the addition of the [From.GetName] as a member unit?
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT_01: Federation membership request accepted. Welcome to the [Root.GetAllianceName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT_02: Your status has been updated to [Root.GetAllianceName] Member. Please accept this complimentary gift basket of motor oil, battery packs and industrial coolant. Thank you, and have a nice day.
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT_03: Congratulations on selecting the [Root.GetAllianceName]. You are now a member. Here is your badge, weekly check-ins are Mondays at 0800.
MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_REFUSE: [Root.GetAllianceName] member unit vote has been tallied. [From.GetName] request status has been set to: rejected. Thank you for considering the [Root.GetAllianceName]. Please wait a minimum of one month before resubmitting application.
MECH_LEAVE_A_SELECT: You are requesting [From.GetAllianceName] membership termination. Please verify.
