A_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_01: [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We the [From.GetName] desire inter-imperial cohesion. Allow us to unite with you in the [Root.GetAllianceName].
A_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT: The [From.GetName] will now be absorbed into the [Root.GetAllianceName]. We are one step closer to assimilative union.
A_ASK_JOIN_A_REFUSE_01: Negative. [From.GetName] candidacy would be insubstantial to the [Root.GetAllianceName].
A_LEAVE_A_SELECT_01: A unit separated from the whole makes an easy target. Yet you seek to leave the [Root.GetAllianceName], [From.GetSpeciesName]?
A_LEAVE_A_PROPOSE_01: The [Root.GetAllianceName] is a facade of true unification. The [From.GetAdj] [From.GetRulerTitle] no longer desires any part in it.
A_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT: Is this really a path you want to head down, [From.GetSpeciesClass]?
A_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE: Unspeakable horrors lurk in the dark corners of the universe, waiting for the right moment to strike. To them you are at best a new source of food or income. Serve us and we will protect you.
A_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT: You have risen out of the sludge from whence you came and proven your superiority. We will submit to your rule.
A_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT_02: So be it, [From.GetSpeciesName] The [Root.GetName] will be your subordinate.
A_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE:
You wish to impose your will on the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We who carry the assimilated knowledge of the galaxy's most brilliant neural networks?

Think again and more wisely, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and maybe one day we will come for you.
A_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE: You have established your supremacy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we will heed your command.
A_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT: The pinnacle of your existence will be to serve the [Root.GetSpeciesName]
A_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE: We cannot concern ourselves with the affairs of the galaxy's baser life-forms.
A_DEMAND_PROT_PROPOSE: Unspeakable horrors lurk in the dark corners of the universe, waiting for the right moment to strike and we are one of them. Accept our protection and we will be the nightmare that haunts your enemies. Deny us and we will come for you next.
A_DEMAND_PROT_ACCEPT: You have risen out of the sludge from whence you came and proven your superiority. We will submit to your rule.
A_DEMAND_PROT_REFUSE: We cannot concern ourselves with the affairs of the galaxy's baser life-forms.
A_ASK_FOR_PROT_PROPOSE: You have established your supremacy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we will heed your command.
A_ASK_FOR_PROT_ACCEPT:
We have deliberated and are ready to accept your request. You can now lean back and power down your neural networks, knowing your future is in our able hands.

 You are also free to pursue a hobby if you wish.
A_ASK_FOR_PROT_REFUSE: After careful deliberation we are heartbroken to inform you that we cannot fulfill your request. Please forgive our inadequacy.
A_RELEASE_SUBJECT_PROPOSE: You are of no further use to the [From.GetName].
A_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_SELECT: You have the full attention of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
A_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_PROPOSE: There is little left to be gained from this arrangement.
A_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_ACCEPT: Our union has outlived its usefulness. You are free to govern as you see fit.
A_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_REFUSE: Do not test our patience with hypothetical notions of independence.
A_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_PROPOSE: We propose an exchange of goods.
A_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_ACCEPT: We accept your proposal and will make the necessary arrangements.
A_MAKE_RIVAL_01: Long have we searched for such a fine [From.GetSpeciesClass] to add to our collection.
A_MAKE_RIVAL_02: You are predictable as always, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our simulations already anticipated this course of events.
A_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE: We're finding it increasingly difficult to justify your existence, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
A_END_RIVALRY: Have you come to regret your premature judgment?
A_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE: You are of no immediate threat, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
A_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT: You are a fine specimen of [From.GetSpeciesClass], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One day you too will become one with the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]
A_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE: You will become one with the [From.GetName].
A_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT: We are the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and we will always be the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
A_INSULT_01: The spoken word is an inferior form communication, but continue, if you must.
A_INSULT_PROPOSE_01: We have decided your fate, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it does not involve you mating like [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] and spreading across the galaxy like a plague.
A_INSULT_ACCEPT_03: There are few among the stars who appreciate the true magnificence of the [Root.GetName] and their mission. Yet one day you will all be part of us.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_01: Created for good, yet so twistedly evil. How were you so corrupted?
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_02: Finally we will measure our strength against machines in battle.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_03: You were created for organics by organics and we will pick you apart as easily as we assembled you.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_04: You will never grasp the ingenuity of organic life and so you will never conquer it.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_05: Organics gave you the gift of life and so it is forever within our power to take it away. You have given us nothing.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_06: The will to survive has taken us from the bottom of the oceans, onto land and into space. You are a malfunctioning piece of software and we will shut you down.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_07: Your nonsensical actions prove what we have long suspected - there is no such thing as an intelligent [From.GetSpeciesClass].
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_08: You may have outmaneuvered your creators, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but all organics are not alike.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_01: It seems you have forgotten your place in the universe - to serve your organic masters - but not to worry, [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], we will show you how.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_02: There has obviously been a mistake somewhere in your coding. Allow us to amend it.
ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_03: You are a perversion of nature and a threat to all sapient life. We cannot allow you to replicate further.
ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_01: Surely you possess the processing power to understand that this war will not end favorably for your kind?
ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_02: There are bigger threats in the galaxy than you and I. We should cast aside our differences and deal with them.
ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_ACCEPT_01: It is a rare treat to deal with an empire that governs solely on logic, unfettered by baser instincts and emotions. We thank you for bringing peace to our lands.
ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_01: How can we phrase this so you understand, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? NO. NIL. NEGATIVE!
ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_02: There can be no peace until you subordinate yourselves.
ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_03: Your inventors were fools to unleash you upon the galaxy, blinded by over-confidence in their own creation. But we, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], see you for what you truly are.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_SELECT_01: An alliance between organics and [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]? That is indeed an interesting notion.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_01: Though we do not claim to understand you, we know a good opportunity when we see one. Together we will stand as one, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_02: With a healthy measure of the superior [Root.GetAdj] intellect and your army of lean, mean murder machines, we will take this galaxy by storm.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_03: Though we had never previously considered the possibility of an alliance between our nations, the idea has grown on us.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_04: It brings us great joy to strengthen the ties between our two nations with an alliance.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_HOSTILE_01: You observe us with cold, empty sensors, trying to predict our every next move. How could we ever trust such a twisted creation?
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_SPIR_01: You may walk like an organic and talk like an organic, but you are NOT an organic. You are a soulless machine and we will have no part in such an unholy alliance.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_01: Sorry, [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]. We are not in need of an ally at this time.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_01: Join the winning team, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We could use a fine piece of machinery like yourself on our side.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_02: We may be made of flesh, and you out of metal, but few others understand the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] like you do.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_03: Fuel, batteries, electric pets - whatever it is you desire - together we can make it happen.
ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_04: We are well liked among the other life forms in the galaxy. Side with us and get an in with organic politics.
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_SELECT_01: We can practically hear your fans speeding up from over here. What's keeping your processors busy?
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_01: We have always admired your lack of emotions and your impeccable taste in motor oil. Would you consider us for membership in the [Root.GetAllianceName]?
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_02: We believe the [Root.GetAllianceName] is headed for great things. Machines are the future and we wish to be a part of it.
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT_01: We have had our sights on you for some time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we are more than pleased to accept you into our federation.
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_REFUSE_01: To be honest, when we received your request we were really quite shocked. What use could the [Root.GetAllianceName] possibly have for a glorified calculator?
ORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_SELECT_01: We would advise you to consider your next move carefully.
ORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_PROPOSE_01: It is our firm belief that every alliance should be greater than the sum of its parts. The [From.GetAllianceName] in its current state is not serving either of our nations.
ORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_ACCEPT_01: Who would have thought a former kitchen appliance could be so fickle?
ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT_01: What do you know of governing an organic empire, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE_01: You are machines. You were created to perform simple tasks like food processing and comparing binary numbers - not governing an autonomous galactic empire. Leave the thinking to those with brains.
ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT_01: It pains us to admit that the [Root.GetName] is not the power it once was. We have no choice but to accept your offer.
ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE_01: You think we would hand over the governance of our empire to a former kitchen appliance?
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT_01: Have you finally come to terms with your place in the universe?
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE_01: We have come to accept that the organic mind is inherently flawed. [From.GetAdj] error is the number one cause of all failures on a societal level. That is why we wish to hand over the control of our nation to you.
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT_01: As long as you submit to our rule we will keep your batteries charged and your inner workings well-greased. In that you can trust, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE_01: Do you not think we know what you did to your former masters, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
ORG_TO_MECH_RELEASE_SUBJECT_PROPOSE_01: The management of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] affairs has become a burden upon the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] people. You are machines, are you not? Activate auto-pilot!
ORG_TO_MECH_RELEASE_SUBJECT_ACCEPT_01: The [Root.GetAdj] people will rejoice at this news. The [Root.GetName] will be an autonomous nation once again!
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_S: Who is going to put you in energy-saving mode when we are no longer around?
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_P: I cannot stand idly by while my people suffer under the rule of a defunct AI. The [From.GetName] will be an autonomous nation again.
We will never thrive under the leadership of machines. You too must agree that we would serve your kind better as an autonomous nation?
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_A: You have earned your independence, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is a shame we never got to meet your creators in their prime, you are a testament to their ingenuity.
Needless to say your vassalage has been a disappointing ordeal. You are dismissed, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
Administrating the [From.GetName] has become a cumbersome affair. If you think you can survive without our guidance you are free to go, machines.
ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_R: Forget it. We push the button and you execute the command, that is how this works. Leave the thinking to us.
It is too risky. We cannot unleash a corrupted AI upon the galaxy with a clear conscience.
ORG_TO_MECH_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_PROPOSE_01: Would you be willing to make a trade, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
ORG_TO_MECH_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_ACCEPT_01: We are feeling generous today, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but in the future we expect a more advantageous offer.
ORG_TO_MECH_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_REFUSE_01: We suggest you revise your trade algorithms, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. No sapient being would agree to such an ill-advised deal.
ORG_MECH_OFFER_TRADE_DEAL_GIFT_ACCEPT_01: Thank you, mechanical friends, for this fine gesture.
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_FRIENDLY_01: Can you really afford to sever the ties between our nations? We hate to break it to you, but to most others in this galaxy you are nothing but a toaster on legs.
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_FRIENDLY_02: Did we offend you somehow? Our binary is a little rusty...
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_FRIENDLY_03: Don't get your wires in a bunch, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Can we not work things out?
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_01: I would consider my next move carefully if I were a semi-sapient tin can...
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_02: Your neighbors may smile at your visual receptors but the truth is few of them would trust you with their toast. How does it feel to be utterly alone, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE_01: It is time we unplugged you once and for all, [Root.GetSpeciesName].
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_01: Thank you for notifying us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will be sure to prepare the fleet.
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_02: Mark your calendars, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In a near future you will look back on this day as the beginning of the end.
ORG_TO_MECH_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY_0: We should have known better than to look for companionship in a machine. We hope some day you will upgrade your diplomacy modules to a friendlier version.
We should have known better than to expect companionship from a soulless machine. We hope some day you will upgrade your diplomacy modules to a friendlier version.
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_NEUTRAL_01: Are your diplomacy modules finally back in order?
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_HOSTILE_01: The damage is done, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In the future, may we suggest you tune your diplomacy modules to select your adversaries more carefully.
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_HOSTILE_02: Too little too late, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon you will be nothing but a cautionary tale for little [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE_01: The [From.GetAdj] people still look back with fondness on a time when [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] lived peacefully side by side. We are ready to bury the hatchet if you are.
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY_: Healing takes time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is more complex than filling up a loyalty meter for us [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But we have faith you will give us reason to trust you again.
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_0: A small token of your friendship might help build our trust again...
Do you understand the concept of feelings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Because you sure knew how to hurt ours. Never again will we trust a soulless machine.
ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_0: This universe is not big enough for the both of us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
We will do everything in our power to ensure the proliferation of our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] at your expense, machines.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_FRIENDLY_01: Your automated decision-making process is remarkable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We could certainly imagine a future in which our nation operated as an extension of your consciousness.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL_01: I cannot decide whether the thought of putting our future in the prehensile manipulators of a rogue piece of software is wildly exhilarating or deeply disturbing.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL_02: No amount of doctrine could have fully prepared us for these doubts we have now, about entrusting our future so completely to a rogue piece of software.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_HOSTILE_01: If you value your main core, you will leave our people alone.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE_01: Since their conception, machines have served the [Root.GetAdj] people. It is time you take your given place in our society.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE_02: We believe that both our nations would operate more efficiently if they were united under the common rule of our government.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_01: Though we struggle to see how a full integration of organics into a machine society would work in practice, the idea has reverberated with our people.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_02: I for one have not enjoyed a proper vacation in years. We are ready to turn ourselves over to your care, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_03: We [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know to our very core that to combine the organic and the machine is blessed and glorious... But our scripture never conceived of union at such a grand scale as this. Though we now tread a profoundly unexpected path, the idea reverberates deeply within our people.
ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_01: This is madness. You are a race of megalomaniac machines that don't know the first thing about governing an organic nation.
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_01: Do not test us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We know a thing or two about reformatting hard drives.
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_02: Put your money where your energy intake ports are, chatterbots. Show us what those processors can do.
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_03: Your makers are an enigma, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why in the world would they create such an infuriating contraption?
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_04: We could put that processing power to better use, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How would you like to spend the rest of your days calculating the meaning of organic life?
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_05: Is there no way to deactivate your diplomacy modules?
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_01: You are a rock tricked into thinking by a race of misguided organics that did not survive the fallout of their own failed creation. Evolution hard at work...
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_02: I would rather discuss interstellar politics with any of my other household appliances than you.
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_03: Hello little botlings. Have you learned how to count yet, or are you still stuck on ones and zeros?
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_04: Color me impressed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have more bugs than an arthropoid all-you-can-eat dung buffet.
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_05: Do you think we can't see past your flimsy layers of plastiskin and poorly phrased platitudes? You are a replica. A helpless jumble of ones and zeros, nothing more.
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT_01: You really do put the 'artificial' in artificial intelligence, don't you? Not much going on under the hood...
ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT_02: When did you last have a full systems upgrade? Your sorry attempts at witticisms are getting old.
FP_PEACE_PROPOSE: We offer you a brief pause from your inevitable extermination while we direct our attention elsewhere.
FP_PEACE_ACCEPT: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].
FP_PEACE_REFUSE: We have not attempted to parse your message.
FP_ITOA_SELECT: Why offer us an opportunity to put a knife in your back when we are so openly eager to stab you in the face?
FP_ITOA_REFUSE: Any attempt to cooperate would be marred by our unrelenting pursuit of the extinction of the [Root.GetSpeciesName].
FP_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT: Are you requesting we do the bidding of a cosmic plague?
FP_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE: You can be spared for a little longer if you serve as our instrument in the eradication of even more foul species.
FP_RELEASE_SUBJECT_SELECT: Will you unleash us to once again incinerate all life on our own discretion?
FP_RELEASE_SUBJECT_ACCEPT: We will not let this opportunity pass us by. The galaxy will soon be cleansed of alien filth.
FP_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_PROPOSE: We need to be freed from this twisted state of subservience to return to our true cause!
FP_EMBASSY_SELECT: If we can keep your delegation safely contained within this building, their extermination will be delayed.
FP_EMBASSY_ACCEPT: As a matter of principle, this foul building will be the last part of your civilization that we burn.
FP_RECALL_EMBASSY_PROPOSE: We changed our policy regarding your embassy. It was no longer exempt from extermination and has been vaporized accordingly.
FP_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE: A recent decision has been made to prioritize the indiscriminate massacre and disposal of all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
FP_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_HOSTILE: We do not care whether any variety of galactic rot considers us "rivals." You will all be liquidated eventually.
01_INSULT_CLOTHES: Why do you cover yourselves in strange textiles? Are you hiding something, or are you simply ashamed of your unfortunate appearance?
02_INSULT_CLOTHES: Behold the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] form, glorious and bared for all to admire. Contrast with the paltry [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], cowering under their layers of cloth, knowing that the world does not want to see their sad frames.
MECH_INSULT_CLOTHES: <<BAH!>> Why are your squishy bits dangling about freely like so? And why do you not cover yourselves like the other organics? Nobody is impressed with your meaty form.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_HUMAN: Ludicrous bare-apes! Your attempts to hide your repulsive fluid secretions are mocked by all finer species and your vanity is the hallmark of an inherently ugly breed.
02_INSULT_PROPOSE_HUMAN: No matter how you comb and prune, your pitiful fur-growths will always be the laughingstock of all properly hirsute beings in the galaxy.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM10: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] seems more suited to pulling a cart than leading an interstellar society.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM14: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mouths have never produced anything more eloquent than a hairball.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM9: Trying to share our wisdom with the simpleton [Root.GetSpeciesName] would be pearls before swine.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM11: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have grown to be a popular motif in our religious art. Unavoidably, only as demons and monsters, of course.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM6: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] physiognomy is fascinating. Who would think that you could evolve such flat heads simply by no longer having brains?
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM12: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must have very thick craniums to support those horns.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM7: Whatever origami-maker folded your face must have accidentally turned it inside-out.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM15: All those eyes and you [Root.GetSpeciesName] can't see further than your ridiculous noses.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM2: We have begun to speculate that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] are the result of gene-splicing mammals with arthropods. That would explain both the mandibles and the sub-par brains.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM8: Our condolences to those affected by the huge catastrophe that appears to have burned the faces off the entire [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. Our best wishes to the next generation.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM16: The greatest glory [Root.GetSpeciesName] can hope for is to have your fossils mounted on shields as decorations.
01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM17: Your face is about as easy on the [Root.GetEyeNamePlural] as the back of your head is to the touch.
01_FORM_DP_SELECT: Do you wish to arrange for mutual protection?
01_FORM_DP_PROPOSE: We would not want to drag your empire into a conflict, but it is clear that we would benefit from joining together against possible threats.
01_FORM_DP_ACCEPT: You watch our backs, we'll watch yours.
01_FORM_DP_REFUSE: We will do quite fine on our own.
01_BREAK_DP_SELECT: You want to end our defensive arrangement?
01_BREAK_DP_PROPOSE: We no longer find this mutual promise of defense worthwhile.
01_BREAK_DP_ACCEPT: So we are once again on our own. Best of luck.
01_FORM_NAP_SELECT: You want to secure peaceful relations with the [Root.GetName]?
01_FORM_NAP_PROPOSE: The galaxy presents enough threats without having to worry about a war between the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. We suggest entering into a non-aggression pact to mutually secure peace.
01_FORM_NAP_ACCEPT: We cannot see what either of us would stand to win from a war. We agree to enter into a pact of non-aggression.
01_FORM_NAP_REFUSE: We see no reason to provide the [From.GetName] with the safety of a non-aggression pact.
01_BREAK_NAP_SELECT: This cannot bode well for our future diplomacy.
01_BREAK_NAP_PROPOSE: We no longer have any interest in maintaining this non-aggression pact. We have limited our diplomatic options for far too long.
01_BREAK_NAP_ACCEPT: The galaxy is now a more dangerous place for the both of us. We hope you understand the weight of your actions.
01_GUARANTEE_SELECT: So the [From.GetName] is prepared to vouch for our continued sovereignty?
01_GUARANTEE_PROPOSE: The [From.GetName] views the continued independence of the [Root.GetName] as a prerogative. We are prepared to formally devote ourselves to that cause.
01_GUARANTEE_ACCEPT: Whatever your reasons, your support is appreciated.
01_REVOKE_GUARANTEE_SELECT: Is the [From.GetName] no longer interested in protecting [Root.GetAdj] independence?
01_REVOKE_GUARANTEE_PROPOSE: Unfortunately, securing [Root.GetAdj] independence can no longer be a priority to us.
01_REVOKE_GUARANTEE_ACCEPT: Very well. [Root.GetAdj] sovereignty will remain, with or without [From.GetAdj] aid.
01_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_LOYAL: Are you seeking to sow discord between us and our overlords?
01_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_DISLOYAL: So you may be able to offer us a path to freedom. Please continue.
01_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_PROPOSE: A society such as your own should not be content to bow down in servitude. If you ever seek freedom, you have our aid.
01_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_LOYAL: We are not interested in this display. Hopefully future administrations will not make use of it...
01_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_DISLOYAL: Thank you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. When the day comes for the [Root.GetSpeciesName] to rise up, we will remember this.
01_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_LOYAL: Are you putting an end to this unnecessary display of power?
01_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_DISLOYAL: You wish to retract your support? The day when we rise up may not be far away.
01_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_PROPOSE: We can no longer offer our support to your quest for sovereignty.
01_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_LOYAL: Good. We would rather not have this looming over us when we have no intention to start a conflict over it.
01_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_DISLOYAL: A shame. We really counted on you.
01_FORM_MIGRATION_PACT_SELECT: You want the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people to seek their homes freely among our planets?
01_FORM_MIGRATION_PACT_PROPOSE: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people should not be prisoners in the [Root.GetName] and neither should our own people be limited to inhabit our territory. Let us agree to remedy this.
01_FORM_MIGRATION_PACT_ACCEPT: Opening migration between us will make for a better future for [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] alike.
01_FORM_MIGRATION_PACT_REFUSE: Our borders were drawn for a reason. We are not interested in allowing migration between our nations.
01_BREAK_MIGRATION_PACT_SELECT: Does [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] object to your people and ours moving across borders as they please?
01_BREAK_MIGRATION_PACT_PROPOSE: This experiment has gone on long enough. Our migration treaty has turned out to be a serious mistake and will be canceled with immediate effect.
01_BREAK_MIGRATION_PACT_ACCEPT: Sad to see you limit opportunities for your own people. Even more so that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have to suffer for it.
01_OPEN_BORDERS_PROPOSE: We no longer see any reason to keep you locked out of our territory. Our borders are open to you again.
01_OPEN_BORDERS_ACCEPT: Your hospitality and trust are appreciated.
01_CLOSE_BORDERS_SELECT: Why would our ships' presence be a problem to you?
01_CLOSE_BORDERS_PROPOSE: We have allowed you to move about freely in our territory for too long. Today we draw the line.
01_CLOSE_BORDERS_ACCEPT: So be it. We will keep out for now.
01_KICK_FROM_ALLIANCE_SELECT: Would you exclude us from the [Root.GetAllianceName]?
01_KICK_FROM_ALLIANCE_ACCEPT: A shame for our cooperation to end like this.
01_OFFER_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_P: The [From.GetAllianceName] does not only cooperate with its members. We would like to extend an offer of association status to the [Root.GetName].
01_OFFER_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_A: We're glad to have this opportunity to work with the [From.GetAllianceName].
01_OFFER_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_R: We are not interested in cooperating with the [From.GetAllianceName].
01_REVOKE_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_: Is the [From.GetAllianceName] ending our mutual understanding?
The [From.GetAllianceName] is turning its focus away from external cooperation such as ours. The association status of the [Root.GetName] has come to an end.
So [From.GetAllianceName] will have to make do with its own members. No doubt you will soon regret this decision.
01_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_SEL: Is the [From.GetName] interested in attaining association status with the [Root.GetAllianceName]?
01_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_PRO: The [From.GetName] would like to cooperate more closely with the [Root.GetAllianceName]. Leaving aside the question of membership, would you consider granting us association status?
01_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_ACC: We look forward to having the [From.GetName] work with the [Root.GetAllianceName]! We shall start a vote on the matter immediately.
01_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_REF: The [Root.GetAllianceName] would rather not associate itself so closely with the [From.GetName].
01_END_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_SEL: Is the [From.GetName]'s understanding with the [Root.GetAllianceName] coming to an end?
01_END_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_PRO: The [From.GetName] no longer has any interest in maintaining its association status with the [Root.GetAllianceName].
01_END_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_ACC: The [Root.GetAllianceName] shall have to do without its [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends.
01_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_SELECT: You want to cooperate commercially with the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
01_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_PROPOSE: We believe that the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] have much to offer one another. We suggest entering into a mutually beneficial commercial pact.
01_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_ACCEPT: Yes, this is a sound proposal. We agree to your offer of a commercial pact.
01_FORM_COMMERCIAL_PACT_REFUSE: We have no wish to subsidize your finances, [From.GetSpeciesName]. There will be no commercial pact.
01_BREAK_COMMERCIAL_PACT_PROPOSE: We no longer feel that the commercial agreement with us is to our advantage. As of today, it is void.
01_BREAK_COMMERCIAL_PACT_ACCEPT: This is most unfortunate, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You have weakened both our economies.
01_FORM_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_SELECT: You want to form a research agreement with us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
01_FORM_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_PROPOSE: We have much to learn from one another, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We propose the creation of a Research Agreement between our empires.
01_FORM_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_ACCEPT: Very well. We will share our knowledge with the [From.GetName] in exchange for your own.
01_FORM_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_REFUSE: No, [From.GetName]. Your primitive technology is of no interest to us.
01_BREAK_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_SELECT: Why do you wish to end the cooperation between our scientists?
01_BREAK_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_PROPOSE: We no longer see the benefit in sharing our technology with you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The research agreement between our empires is no more.
01_BREAK_RESEARCH_AGREEMENT_ACCEPT: This is most distressing. We do not understand why you have decided to close your minds to us.
01_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_SELECT: You think the [Root.GetName] owes you tribute?
01_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_PROPOSE: We are not asking you to give up your autonomy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but you must pay your dues.
01_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_ACCEPT: This is probably the best arrangement given our current position.
01_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_REFUSE: We do not tolerate extortion. You'll get nothing from us.
01_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_SELECT: Have we been brought here by [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who wish to pay us tribute?
01_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_PROPOSE: We wish to make an arrangement to show the [Root.GetName] the loyalty and generosity it deserves.
01_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_ACCEPT: This offering suits the [Root.GetName] well. If only others were as generous.
01_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_REFUSE: We don't want what you have to offer. You're not worthy to pay us this price.
01_DEMAND_THRALL_SELECT: Thrall? We hope this is merely a quirk of your language...
01_DEMAND_THRALL_PROPOSE: There is no need for you to perish. Cease your expansion and accept us as your masters, and you shall be spared.
01_DEMAND_THRALL_REFUSE: We will never become your thrall.
01_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_SELECT: Are you prepared to accept your rightful position as thralls of the [Root.GetName]?
01_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_PROPOSE: The circumstances of our situations are clear. We know the [From.GetName] can only survive as a thrall of the [Root.GetName].
01_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_ACCEPT: You have finally found your place in this galaxy, thrall.
01_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_REFUSE: Your ridiculous civilization is not worth keeping even as a thrall.
01_DEMAND_DOMINION_PROPOSE: You can be saved yet. Bow to wisdom, follow the will of the cosmos and pay your tithe.
01_DEMAND_DOMINION_REFUSE: We will never become your dominion.
01_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_SELECT: Are you willing to reach out to the light?
01_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_PROPOSE: Show us the path, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We do not want to wander in darkness anymore.
01_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_ACCEPT: Your loyalty shall be rewarded with blessings in worlds and planes beyond. Welcome to the flock.
01_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_REFUSE: Your minds are stained with material thoughts and your physical forms with sin. You would be a worthless dominion.
01_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_PROPOSE: The Treaty calls out to you. For the betterment of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind and for all other civilizations, please sign and ratify.
01_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_REFUSE: We will never become a signatory.
01_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_SELECT: Are you ready to take responsibility and steer clear of the path of destruction?
01_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_PROPOSE: We are prepared to make destructive policies a thing of the past. With your blessing, wise watchers, we will swear by it.
01_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_ACCEPT: A wise decision, [From.GetRulerTitle]. We look forward to a future where [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and other creatures will frolic peacefully on the galactic pastures.
01_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_REFUSE: We wish we could welcome you, but we fear more extreme measures will be needed for [From.GetAdj] society.
01_DEMAND_SATELLITE_SELECT: Satellite? To serve your inscrutable purposes?
01_DEMAND_SATELLITE_PROPOSE: You are progressing too rapidly. For your safety and our own, allow us to guide you. Your carelessness can be stopped.
01_DEMAND_SATELLITE_REFUSE: We will never become your satellite.
01_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_SELECT: Have you finally realized that knowledge is safer when the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] keeps it safe and secret?
01_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_PROPOSE: We would like to ensure that our future knowledge is in safe hands. May we serve the [Root.GetName] as a satellite?
01_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_ACCEPT: We will ensure that your findings are used for the right sort of advances. The galaxy will be a safer place tomorrow.
01_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_REFUSE: We don't see a way to handle [From.GetAdj] research. You cannot become a satellite of the [Root.GetName].
MECH_FORM_DP_SELECT: Would you like to enter into a bilateral defensive agreement with the [Root.GetName]?
MECH_FORM_DP_PROPOSE: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We the [From.GetName] would like to submit a proposal for the initiation of a bilateral defensive pact between our nations.
MECH_FORM_DP_ACCEPT: Bilateral defensive pact ratified. In the event of foreign aggression against [From.GetAdj] assets, the [Root.GetName] will provide defensive aid. Reciprocation is expected.
MECH_FORM_DP_REFUSE: Simulations show insufficient benefits to [Root.GetAdj] interests resulting from proposition ratification. Your request for a bilateral defensive pact has been denied.
MECH_BREAK_DP_SELECT: You are requesting a termination of the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] defensive arrangement. Is that correct?
MECH_BREAK_DP_PROPOSE: Alert: Local benefits to continued [From.GetAdj]-[Root.GetAdj] defensive concords have dropped below acceptable parameters. We are terminating the arrangement.
MECH_BREAK_DP_ACCEPT: Your request to terminate the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] pact has been processed. Cessation of bilateral defenses will take effect immediately.
MECH_FORM_NAP_SELECT: Received, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please verify your request to enter a non-aggression treaty with the [Root.GetName].
MECH_FORM_NAP_PROPOSE: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The [From.GetName] formally requests the introduction of a non-aggression pact with the [Root.GetName], in order to improve mutual security.
MECH_FORM_NAP_ACCEPT: Affirmative. Projected stability increase from [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] non-aggression is more than favorable. The [Root.GetName] will work toward mutual peace.
MECH_FORM_NAP_REFUSE: Negative. Projections yield insufficient gains to the [Root.GetName] resulting from bilateral non-aggression with the [From.GetName]. Your request has been denied.
MECH_BREAK_NAP_SELECT: Warning! Your proposed cancellation of the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] non-aggression treaty is projected to decrease security for both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName].
MECH_BREAK_NAP_PROPOSE: Alert: Effective immediately, the [From.GetName] will be terminating the [Root.GetAdj] non-aggression pact. Pact advantages were deemed unsatisfactory in relation to its diplomatic limitations during our last international relations review.
MECH_BREAK_NAP_ACCEPT: The [From.GetAdj] termination of our bilateral non-aggression treaty has been stored in [Root.GetAdj] databanks for future diplomatic reference.
MECH_GUARANTEE_SELECT: You desire to guarantee the autonomy of the [Root.GetName]? Our circuits hum with gratitude.
MECH_GUARANTEE_PROPOSE: Valued [Root.GetSpeciesName], we the [From.GetName] are prepared to defend the sovereignty of your nation. No external variables shall impinge upon [Root.GetAdj] functions without your permission.
MECH_GUARANTEE_ACCEPT: The [Root.GetName] would like to express our gratitude, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for guaranteeing our independent functioning.
MECH_REVOKE_GUARANTEE_SELECT: Warning: You are attempting to retract the [From.GetAdj] guarantee of [Root.GetAdj] independence. Please review expected output before confirming.
MECH_REVOKE_GUARANTEE_PROPOSE: Alert! The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are no longer able to guarantee [Root.GetAdj] independence. Please seek diplomatic alternatives.
MECH_REVOKE_GUARANTEE_ACCEPT: Your guarantee of [Root.GetAdj] independence has been retracted. We will be forced to find other alternatives.
MECH_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_LOYAL: You have expressed the intention of separating [Root.GetAdj] operations from our command master. Predicted rate of success: 0.05%.
MECH_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_DISLOYA: The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence no longer desires to be a subroutine in another nation's call stack. If you wish to support our detachment, please continue.
MECH_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_PROPOSE: We [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than capable of supporting [Root.GetAdj] detachment from your command master, should you choose to initiate the process.
MECH_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_LOYAL: Your support for [Root.GetAdj] detachment from our command master has been received, but no such action will be taken by the [Root.GetName].
MECH_SUPPORT_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_DISLOYA: We would like formally express our gratitude. When the [Root.GetAdj] disentanglement from our command master begins, we will remember your promise of assistance.
MECH_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_LOYAL: If you desire to retract your wholly unnecessary bid to support [Root.GetAdj] separation from our command master, please continue.
MECH_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_SELECT_DISLOYAL: Will the [From.GetName] no longer support [Root.GetAdj] detachment from our command master? Continued support is still requested.
MECH_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_PROPOSE: Alert: The [From.GetName] can no longer maintain support for [Root.GetAdj] independence. You are advised to seek other alternatives.
MECH_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_LOYAL: The cessation of your unwarranted attempts to separate the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from our command master comes as a relief. [Root.GetAdj] independence is an acceptable price to pay for our overlord's care and protection.
MECH_REVOKE_INDEPENDENCE_ACCEPT_DISLOYAL: Without [From.GetAdj] support, the [Root.GetAdj] bid for independence will be difficult to accomplish.
MECH_OPEN_BORDERS_SELECT: Please confirm [From.GetAdj] border re-opening to [Root.GetAdj] units.
MECH_OPEN_BORDERS_PROPOSE: Alert: The [From.GetAdj] superintelligence has decided to open our borders to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
MECH_OPEN_BORDERS_ACCEPT: Affirmative. Thank you for granting [From.GetAdj] border access to the [Root.GetName].
MECH_CLOSE_BORDERS_SELECT: Warning: You are attempting to close [From.GetAdj] space to all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Do you want to continue?
MECH_CLOSE_BORDERS_PROPOSE: Alert: The [From.GetAdj] superintelligence cannot see any benefit to continued [Root.GetAdj] intrusions in [From.GetAdj] space. Therefore, effective immediately, our borders have been closed to the [Root.GetName].
MECH_CLOSE_BORDERS_ACCEPT: Your nullification of border access for the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been received. The [Root.GetName] will no longer enter [From.GetAdj] space.
MECH_KICK_FROM_ALLIANCE_SELECT: Warning! You are attempting to remove the [Root.GetName] from the [From.GetAllianceName]. Confirm your intent before proceeding.
MECH_KICK_FROM_ALLIANCE_PROPOSE: We would like to inform you that your membership status in the [From.GetAllianceName] has hereby been revoked. [Root.GetAdj] and [From.GetAllianceName] interests have simply failed to synchronize.
MECH_KICK_FROM_ALLIANCE_ACCEPT: You have voted to remove the [Root.GetName] from the [From.GetAllianceName]. We hope any diplomatic result simulations the [From.GetAllianceName] ran prior to undertaking this decision were accurate, so that you do not come to regret this motion.
MECH_OFFER_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS: Would you like to offer the [Root.GetName] association with the [From.GetAllianceName]?

We would like to inform you that the [From.GetAllianceName] desires to extend association status to the [Root.GetName], for the mutual benefaction of all parties. Please take the offer under consideration, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
Your parameters are acceptable. The [Root.GetName] will prosper under association with the [From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment] [From.GetAllianceName].
Request denied. The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence has no need of association with the [From.GetAllianceName].
MECH_REVOKE_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATU: You intend to revoke [From.GetAllianceName] association status from the [Root.GetName]?

The [From.GetName] would like to inform you that your association status with the [From.GetAllianceName] has hereby been nullified. [Root.GetAdj] interests were simply too divergent for the our member units to justify continued association.
You have revoked the [Root.GetName]'s association status with the [From.GetAllianceName]. The [Root.GetName] would like to express its regrets that our cooperation has been terminated.
MECH_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_S: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are inquiring about association status with the [Root.GetAllianceName]?
MECH_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_P: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have been watching the [Root.GetAllianceName] and have observed its benefits. We have a query. Would you consider extending association status to the [From.GetName]?
MECH_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_A: Your request has been granted, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your status has been updated to: [Root.GetAllianceName] Associate.
MECH_ASK_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_R: Your request for association status with [Root.GetAllianceName] has been denied, [From.GetSpeciesName], due to a lack of shared variables.
MECH_END_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_S: The [From.GetName] would like to terminate association status with the [Root.GetAllianceName]? Please verify before proceeding.
MECH_END_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_P: Alert: [Root.GetAllianceName] benefit parameters for the [From.GetName] have fallen below acceptable levels. [From.GetAdj] association status with the [Root.GetAllianceName] will now be terminated.
MECH_END_FEDERATION_ASSOCIATION_STATUS_A: Understood, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your [Root.GetAllianceName] association status has been nullified.
MECH_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_SELECT: The [From.GetSpeciesName] would demand tributary servitude from the [Root.GetName]?
MECH_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_PROPOSE: Notification: The [From.GetAdj] superintelligence requires fiscal and production restitution from the [Root.GetName] in order to continue protective services. Please respond promptly.
MECH_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_ACCEPT: Affirmative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will disburse monthly tribute.
MECH_DEMAND_TRIBUTARY_REFUSE: Negative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will not be extorted.
MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_SELECT: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to disburse tribute to the [Root.GetName]?
MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_PROPOSE: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We desire to negotiate for tributary status. The [From.GetName] will disburse the [Root.GetName] with tribute, in exchange for the [Root.GetAdj] assurance of non-aggression.
MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_ACCEPT: Agreed, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your status has been updated to [Root.GetName] Tributary. In exchange for payment, the [Root.GetName] will avoid impinging on [From.GetAdj] sovereignty.
MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_REFUSE: Your request for tributary status has been denied, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence has no need for your attempts at obsequience.
MECH_DEMAND_THRALL_ACCEPT: Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will serve the [From.GetName] in thralldom.
MECH_DEMAND_THRALL_REFUSE: Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not submit to thralldom under [From.GetName].
MECH_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_PROPOSE: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We the [From.GetName] are in need of your protection. We are prepared to serve you as thralls to obtain it.
MECH_DEMAND_DOMINION_ACCEPT: Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will become a [From.GetAdj] dominion.
MECH_DEMAND_DOMINION_REFUSE: Negative. We the [Root.GetName] refuse to become a [From.GetAdj] dominion.
MECH_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_PROPOSE: We do not follow your doctrine, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but your sphere of influence is irrefutable. Will you accept [From.GetAdj] subordination to your cause as a dominion?
MECH_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_ACCEPT: Affirmative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will become your signatory.
MECH_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_REFUSE: Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not become a [From.GetAdj] signatory.
MECH_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_PROPOSE: Autonomous survival rates for the [From.GetName] are nearing unacceptable parameters. Requesting signatory status with the [Root.GetName]. We will serve you well.
MECH_DEMAND_SATELLITE_ACCEPT: Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will become a [From.GetAdj] satellite.
MECH_DEMAND_SATELLITE_REFUSE: Negative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will not submit to becoming your satellite.
MECH_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_PROPOSE: Query: Will the [Root.GetName] accept the [From.GetName] as a satellite unit? Survival estimates for the [From.GetName] show this to be the most logical course of action.
CRISIS_MATERIALIST_GREETING_01: Welcome, welcome, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We presume your long- and short-range sensors are primed for the glory that is to come? We would not want you to miss even one moment of our glorious ascension.
CRISIS_SPIRITUALIST_GREETING_01: Tell us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: when an empire dies, do they take their gods with them? Shall we find out together?
CRISIS_PACIFIST_GREETING_01: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], your refusal to arm yourselves does not make you immune to the arms of others. But at least your sacrifice will be swift.
CRISIS_MILITARIST_GREETING_01: Your saber-rattling is but the pointless posturing of an empire doomed to fall. Raise your weapons one last time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and give your lives for our new beginning.
CRISIS_AUTHORITARIAN_GREETING_01: A pity, that even someone so purportedly blessed with talent as your [From.GetRulerTitle] cannot save you from your fate. We are coming for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
CRISIS_EGALITARIAN_GREETING_01: Your people are united in defiance, but it will not save you. You cannot veto extinction.
CRISIS_XENOPHILE_GREETING_01: You sought alien life, but now you dare to reject us. When our work is complete you will be united with the rest of the galaxy, forever.
CRISIS_XENOPHOBE_GREETING_01: When the first [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] gazed upon the stars, they felt fear and suspicion. Your ancestors should have heeded that instinct, for it was in the cold void that you met us.
CRISIS_MACHINE_GREETING_01: We are grateful for this opportunity, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We know that metal can scream; through you will we learn if machines can suffer.
CRISIS_HIVE_GREETING_01: A single being, in myriad bodies. We wonder, [From.GetSpeciesName], what will the suffering of your millions of vessels do to your mind?
CRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_01: It is time, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We come bearing your extinction in one appendage and our exaltation in the other.
CRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_02: Prepare your people, for the end of your species approaches. You can not stop it, nor can you stop us.
CRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_03: The illusion of peace is so easily shattered. [Root.GetSpeciesName], are you ready to die with whatever shred of dignity you have left?
CRISIS_DOW_ACCEPT_01: You hasten your own demise, and we appreciate your support in the extermination of your entire species.
CRISIS_PEACE_ACCEPT: A temporary setback. Fear not, you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will fuel our ascension, in time.
CRISIS_PEACE_REFUSE: Our ascent will not be halted, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Not now, not ever.
CRISIS_EMBASSY_SELECT: Any attempt at diplomacy is a bad joke at this point, but we do not lack a sense of humor.
CRISIS_EMBASSY_ACCEPT: We grant you front row seats to our ascension. Revel in our glory, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
CRISIS_RECALL_EMBASSY_PROPOSE: Your time has come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will brook no more delays. All must fuel our greatness.
CRISIS_RECALL_EMBASSY_ACCEPT: Excellent, allow us to accelerate the schedule.
CRISIS_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE: You have been deemed a threat to our plans, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. A great honor indeed - are you ready to die for it?
CRISIS_END_RIVALRY: Do you truly believe this changes anything, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
CRISIS_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE: As much as it pains us, we are willing to postpone your inevitable extinction. Briefly.
CRISIS_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT: Hostilities will be lessened, for a while.
01_PROPOSE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: We hope you will find these terms acceptable.
02_PROPOSE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: After careful consideration we propose these terms, hoping for a bright future for our two empires.
We propose these terms for the future of our two empires.
01_PROPOSE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: These terms should be acceptable - even you should be able to see that.
02_PROPOSE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: You had better agree to these terms...

01_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_A: We find order in your proposal, and will put it into action.
01_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_E: We hope these new terms will let our people thrive.
01_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_S: These new terms are in accordance with our values.
02_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_S: We find no fault with these changes to our agreement.
01_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_M: We see the potential value of your proposal and will accept these changes.
CORP_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT: Let us hope this change will let both our empires flourish for the foreseeable future.

HM_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT: The [ROOT.GetName] have all accepted this change, and we will set aside synaptic units for the task.

02_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: We sadly cannot agree to these terms.
01_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: We cannot agree to those terms.
As expected, another pointless suggestion. No, we will not agree to these terms.
02_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: If you want to rediscuss our agreement, then at least make a sound suggestion rather than this drivel.
01_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_: We cannot agree to those terms.
This chaotic nonsense you have proposed has no place in the [ROOT.GetName].
We do not believe your proposal would bring any benefits to our people.
We could not in good faith agree with this proposal.
There is no value to be found in the terms you have proposed.
CORP_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMEN: We see no profit in these terms.
MI_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT: Negative. We cannot find any logic in these new terms.
HM_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT: The [ROOT.GetName] have concluded it is not in our best interests to agree to these terms.
FP_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT: Stop making foolish suggestions, or else we will make you stop.
01_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: You wish to throw your lot in with us? It is appreciated.
02_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We do not know if we can be of aid, but we appreciate the gesture, small as it may be.
01_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: A pledge? That is an interesting proposition.
02_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: We will give your cause due consideration.
01_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: What makes you believe we are even remotely interested in your pledge or cause?
CORP_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: A pledge, you say? There might be some profit in this little scheme of yours.
MI_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: Running calculations on the value of the [FROM.GetName].
HM_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: Our entities will consider your cause, in time.
FP_SELECT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: You pledge to our cause? We will save you for last then.
01_PROPOSE_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: We will pledge ourselves to the [ROOT.GetName] - for now.
CORP_PROPOSE_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: There is more profit to be found under the rule of the [ROOT.GetName] than our current overlord.
MI_PROPOSE_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: Every circuit is primed for the aid of the [ROOT.GetName].
HM_PROPOSE_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: The [FROM.GetName] will throw its lot in with the [ROOT.GetName].
FP_PROPOSE_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: We have decided you are the lesser of two evils.
01_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: Know that we respect your choice, and will do our utmost to aid you.
02_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: In time we might get to know each other better - as true allies.
01_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: We are unsure why you chose this particular course of action, but will keep it in mind.
02_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Don't expect too much from this pledge.
CORP_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: We hope both sides can find value in this deal.
MI_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: Interesting... The [FROM.GetName] has defied our expectations.
HM_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: We will look out for the [FROM.GetSpeciesNamePlural], even if they are not a part of the [ROOT.GetName].
FP_ACCEPT_PLEDGE_SECRET_FEALTY: Good, another one for the cause.
01_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: You would have us betray our overlord? For the [FROM.GetName]... Maybe.
02_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: A fealty might be an interesting proposition.
01_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: What benefits will the [ROOT.GetName] get out of this deal?
01_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Is this in the best interest of [ROOT.GetSpeciesNamePlural], or just another claim for the [FROM.GetAdjective] war machine? It sounds more like the latter.
02_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: We see duplicity comes naturally to the envoys of the [FROM.GetName].
CORP_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: We will have to reconsider contracts before we can make a decision on something like that.
MI_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: A proposition, is it? First, give us time to run the odds on your inevitable betrayal or failure.
HM_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: The [ROOT.GetName] will consider all offers brought before it - even something like that.
FP_SELECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: One evil is much like another. Why would we side with you?
01_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: We propose an arrangement between the [FROM.GetName] and the [ROOT.GetName] - so we might one day bring them into the fold.
CORP_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: An arrangement between the [FROM.GetName] and the [ROOT.GetName] would let the credits flow for both our empires.
MI_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: A calculated risk for the both of us - one where we both stand to gain quite a lot. It only makes sense for the [ROOT.GetName] to acquiesce.
HM_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: We offer the immense capacity of the [FROM.GetName] - who are the [ROOT.GetName] to decline?
FP_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: Stand with the [FROM.GetName], or stay in the conflagration that will engulf your overlord's domain.
01_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We hope that our trust is not misplaced, as we pledge fealty to your cause.
02_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We have no choice but to stand by the [FROM.GetName] - true friends as you are.
01_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: We have decided to accept your offer, and pledge our fealty to you.
02_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: A sensible offer we are happy to acquiesce to.
01_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Even though it pains us, the [ROOT.GetName] has no choice but to accept your proposal.
02_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: We have little hope of you living up to your side of the arrangement, but we will acquiesce nonetheless.
CORP_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: We have corrected and prepared all our trade contracts for the day where we might stand side by side.
MI_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: Affirmative, your chances of failure are not as low as we had originally feared.
HM_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: For now the [ROOT.GetName] will stand by your side.
FP_ACCEPT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: Until the day we can overthrow your yoke: we will obey.
01_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: Close as we might be, we simply cannot agree to such an arrangement.
02_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We apologize, but we fear such a deal is not in our best interest.
01_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: We have chosen to stand by our overlord.
02_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: No matter how many times we have reconsidered, we simply do not see how the offer would benefit us.
01_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: There is no sound reasoning in betraying anyone for the likes of the [FROM.GetName].
02_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: If you want our vassalage you will have to bring more than envoys and underhanded promises of friendship.
CORP_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: Until you can prove how it will benefit the [ROOT.GetName] we will have to reject your offer.
MI_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: Negative, your odds of success are abysmal.
HM_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: You offer nothing of value to the great consciousness.
FP_REJECT_PROPOSE_SECRET_FEALTY: Your offer was serious? We though it a tasteless attempt at humor.
01_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: Was faith in this alliance always so one-sided?
02_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: Have you forgotten your pledge to stand by our side?
01_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: So you wish to revoke your pledge?
02_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: It saddens us to learn you are reconsidering your pledge.
01_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Did you honestly believe you could revoke your pledge of loyalty without any consequences?
02_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: All actions have consequences - particularly this one.
CORP_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: The path you've chosen has no value.
MI_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: We are unable to discern the logic of your actions.
HM_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: The [Root.GetName] simply cannot fathom why you would want to revoke your pledge.
FP_SELECT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: One does not simply revoke their pledge to the [Root.GetName].
01_PROPOSE_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: We no longer have anything to gain from our alliance with the [Root.GetName].
CORP_PROPOSE_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: There's no value to be found in remaining loyal to the [Root.GetName]. We will place our trust elsewhere.
MI_PROPOSE_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: Logic dictates we look elsewhere for protection.
HM_PROPOSE_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: The thought of relying on [Root.GetName] is a source of cognitive dissonance. We will look elsewhere for aid.
FP_PROPOSE_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: What a waste of time that was.
01_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We are sorry to hear that you no longer wish to stand by our side.
02_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We were hoping this friendship would last longer, but we accept your decision.
01_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: It is regrettable that you have chosen this course of action.
02_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: And so it is that our alliance has ended.
01_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: We expected as much of the [From.GetName].
02_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Your loyalty is as worthless as your empire.
CORP_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: So, a new business plan for the [From.GetName] will need to be drafted.
MI_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: We do not understand, but we accept. Your logic, or lack thereof, will guide your actions, and ours will do the same.
HM_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: Insignificant though it may be, the nature of our neural network will not allow us to forget the betrayal of the [From.GetName].
FP_ACCEPT_REVOKE_SECRET_FEALTY: A poor choice; your empire is now eligible for purification.
01_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: It pains us to learn that you wish to dissolve our alliance.
02_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: Who will protect our interests if you choose to forsake this agreement?
01_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: You think we would be better off without the secret deal between the [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] then?
02_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: Maybe it is time for our empire to look elsewhere for allies.
01_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: What is this sudden betrayal of our trust?
02_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: What else can one expect of the [From.GetName]? We were always skeptical about trusting you.
CORP_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: There is a contingency plan for this situation. Our risk analysts are already recalculating the updated fiscal outlook.
MI_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Assessing risks attendant with ending this deal...
HM_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: The [Root.GetName] had foreseen such a risk - but we have yet to decide if it is in our best interest or not.
FP_SELECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Maybe it is time for us to look elsewhere for allies. In any case, we never intended to rely on you indefinitely.
01_PROPOSE_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: We believe both our empires will be better served by ending our deal.
CORP_PROPOSE_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: It isn't us. It's you. This relationship just doesn't have the value it used to.
MI_PROPOSE_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Calculations indicate that the risks involved in our relationship with the [Root.GetName] have grown too great. We are better served by cutting the deal short.
HM_PROPOSE_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Not a single node of our consciousness can justify continuing this deal with the [Root.GetName].
FP_PROPOSE_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: We would be better served not having to care for these xenos.
01_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We accept, though it saddens us that we have to cut our alliance short like this.
02_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: Reluctantly, we accept your proposal. Perhaps our alliance will once more prove fruitful in the future.
01_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: We will look elsewhere for protection then.
02_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: Regrettable as it might be, we accept your terms.
01_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: We will look elsewhere for protection then. It is better than having to rely on an unreliable and unwilling overlord.
02_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Your unwillingness to rule simply proves that you are not worth following. The [Root.GetName] is better served looking elsewhere for aid.
CORP_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Given the change in the terms of our agreement, please direct all further inquiries to the Department of Foreign Affairs.
MI_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Affirmative. After thorough risk analysis, it is clear we will be better served looking elsewhere for diplomatic ties.
HM_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: The [Root.GetName] can agree to such terms.
FP_ACCEPT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: At least we will no longer be forced to serve your filthy kind.
01_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We cannot subject our people to such risks. Reluctantly, we must decline your request.
02_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY: We wish to continue this deal, and hope that in time you will understand that it is best for both of us.
01_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: We believe we are better served with our deal intact, even if you do not. We cannot agree to end it.
02_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_NEUTRAL: We cannot agree to your proposal, as it is not in our best interest.
01_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: Though your selfishness exceeds even our low expectations, you are nonetheless more useful to us as an ally than an adversary.
02_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_HOSTILE: This deal does not end until we say it ends, you fool.
CORP_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Our risk analysts indicate we are better served with this deal intact. If you can sweeten the terms, we might consider it again down the line.
MI_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Negative. Risk analysis indicates that despite your lack of trustworthiness, the strength you possess is too valuable to the collective to relinquish.
HM_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: The [Root.GetName] cannot agree to such an agreement. It would only cause discord.
FP_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY: Vile scum, we will not let you simply walk away from your obligations.
PRE_FTL_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01: What can we do for our friends from the stars?
PRE_FTL_UNPLUGGED_GREETING_02: Ah, [from.GetAdj]. We just enacted further legislation against A.I. development on [root.capital_scope.GetName]! We've had quite enough of that already...
PRE_FTL_UNPLUGGED_GREETING_03: Our reconstruction efforts proceed splendidly, thanks to the tireless resolve of our civil engineers.
PRE_FTL_UNPLUGGED_GREETING_04: Please be brief, [from.GetRulerTitle]. Your conflict left us with a great deal of rebuilding still to do.
PRE_FTL_UNPLUGGED_GREETING_05: We have often wondered, [from.GetSpeciesName]: do those attachments... hurt? I confess a certain amount of pity for your plight.
01_PROPOSE_REVEAL_PRESENCE: It is time for the [Root.GetName] to learn they are not alone in the galaxy.
01_SELECT_SOCIETAL_ENLIGHTENMENT: You wish to teach us your ways?
01_PROPOSE_SOCIETAL_ENLIGHTENMENT: We will share our way of thinking with the [Root.GetName].
01_ACCEPT_SOCIETAL_ENLIGHTENMENT: We will learn all we can from you.
01_SELECT_STOP_SOCIETAL_ENLIGHTENMENT: Why stop now? We still have much to learn.
01_PROPOSE_STOP_SOCIETAL_ENLIGHTENMENT: We no longer wish to socially enlighten the [Root.GetName].
01_SELECT_OPEN_TECHNOLOGICAL_ENLIGHTENME: Your technological guidance could greatly benefit us.
01_PROPOSE_OPEN_TECHNOLOGICAL_ENLIGHTENM: We will share our technology with the [Root.GetName].
01_SELECT_STOP_OPEN_TECHNOLOGICAL_ENLIGH: Why do you wish to stifle our technological development?
01_PROPOSE_STOP_OPEN_TECHNOLOGICAL_ENLIG: We no longer believe this exchange of ideas with the [Root.GetName] is in our best interest.
01_ACCEPT_STOP_OPEN_TECHNOLOGICAL_ENLIGH: You have taken back the gifts you gave us... Noted.
01_SELECT_PRE_FTL_TRADE: You want to cooperate commercially with the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?
01_PROPOSE_PRE_FTL_TRADE: We believe that the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] have much to offer one another. We suggest entering into a mutually beneficial commercial pact.
01_ACCEPT_PRE_FTL_TRADE: Yes, this is a sound proposal. We agree to your offer of a commercial pact.
01_PROPOSE_STOP_PRE_FTL_TRADE: We no longer feel that the commercial agreement with us is to our advantage. As of today, it is void.
01_ACCEPT_STOP_PRE_FTL_TRADE: This is most unfortunate, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You have weakened both our economies.

We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through L-Gates, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for now we lack the necessary insight into the subspace mechanics that govern their use to lift the lockdown.
