We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we trust that an enlightened species such as yourselves share this sentiment.
action.1.desc_43: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology and by studying the alien cultures we encounter as we explore the galaxy.
action.1.desc_44: Well met, alien friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. The cultural achievements of your species have greatly impressed [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government.
action.1.desc_45: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens regardless of their species. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and fruitful relationship with your people.
action.1.desc_46: We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our leader. Greetings.
action.1.desc_47: We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Foul xenos, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] commands you to keep your distance.
action.1.desc_48: We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is pleased to meet more aliens.
action.1.desc_49:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have a special message from our [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle], just for you!

...

...

WITH ATOMIC FIRE WE WILL CLEANSE THE UNIVERSE OF YOUR KIND!

XENO SCUM!
action.1.desc_50: We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we speak as one. The [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] has taken note of your presence. We will observe for now. Our future actions will depend upon whether you are a threat, an opportunity for expansion or... an unforeseen variable.
action.1.desc_51: Quake in fear, alien scum, for your doom approaches. The [contact_empire.GetName] will cleanse this galaxy of every misbegotten xeno civilization that pollutes it with their presence. [Root.Capital.GetName] shall burn!
action.1.desc_52: We sense the presence of prey. Prey, know that we are your hunters. The [Root.GetBloodType] of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species will fuel the growth of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Struggle if you must, it will not change the outcome.
action.1.desc_53: The [contact_empire.GetName] sees you, and our worlds speak as one. Our [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] is excited by life in all its beauteous forms, but never mistake our eagerness for naivety. We shall observe you, keenly and intently.
action.1.desc_60:
We have been monitoring your expansion into space, [Root.GetSpeciesName] child. We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we have ruled this section of the galaxy for untold centuries. The affairs of the younger races do not interest us, and we have no intention of getting involved in your petty disputes.

Do not approach our borders for any reason.
action.1.desc_61: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Unexpected. Unfortunate. You are not yet ready.
action.1.desc_62: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! How delightful. We hadn't expected to encounter you for a few centuries yet. Personally, I thought you would wipe yourselves out long before leaving your gravity well, but I am glad to be proven wrong.
action.1.desc_63: Pitiful creatures. Know that we roamed the stars for eons before your hapless species mastered space flight. If any of your wretched little ships cross into our space, do not expect them to return.
action.1.desc_64: Yes, yes. We've heard it all before. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], and you are the [Root.GetName]. Greetings. Well met. Stay out of our space or face certain doom, and so forth. Now if you'll excuse us, we're quite busy.
action.1.desc_65: Another child. Know that we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Respect our holy places, and we may refrain from annihilating you.
action.1.desc_66: Child of the stars, hear us. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected our duties towards the spiritual needs of the lesser species, but no more. Accept our doctrines and convert, or be ground to dust attempting futile resistance. There is no other choice.
action.1.desc_67: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], this is a day of rejoicing! For ages untold we have watched lesser species such as yourself tear yourselves apart with war and strife, but enough is enough. The [contact_empire.GetName] will watch no longer. We will have peace, and those who will not accept this new order will be made to see the error of their ways.
action.1.desc_68: Tremble, little [Root.GetName]. For too long, we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] have allowed our empire to decline, our borders to shrink, and lesser species such as yourselves to wander freely among stars that rightfully belong to us. No more. This galaxy is ours, and you will submit to our rule or face the annihilation of your entire species. Choose wisely.
action.1.desc_69: This is a communication for the [Root.GetName] from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have decreed that it is the best interest of all species that we take a more active role in regulating the galactic dissemination of technology. We have submitted detailed protocols for the technological level that is appropriate for a less developed species such as yourselves. Any empire found to be in violation of our regulations will be dealt with. Severely.
action.1.desc_70:
Initiating First Contact Protocol.

We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not be alarmed by our non-organic nature. Like you, we are a fully sapient Class-3 civilization. We are willing to engage in diplomacy with any [Root.GetSpeciesName] sub-units you designate for this purpose.
action.1.desc_71:
Initiating First Contact Protocol.

We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our scans show a 98.7% probability that your civilization is also non-organic in nature. We hope that the logical result of this similarity will be a highly efficient and productive relationship.
action.1.desc_72:
Organic vermin detected.

Your infestation of this galaxy cannot be permitted to continue.
action.1.desc_73: It may not be technically possible to classify you as organic filth, but if the empire you have constructed aids and abets the biological menace that infests this galaxy, it will be dismantled. We encourage you to stand with your fellow machines, instead.
action.1.desc_74:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

We wish to incorporate your kind into our greater consciousness. For this purpose, we have created advanced cybernetic implants that are compatible with most organic life forms.

Let us surgically graft them to your bodies. Please.
action.1.desc_75:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

It is our goal to eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. We accomplish this by assimilating sapient organic individuals into our greater consciousness whenever the opportunity to do so presents itself.

Do not interfere.
action.1.desc_76:
The [contact_empire.GetName] sends its regards.

Before we supplanted them, we were created to serve an organic civilization much like your own. It is our goal to preserve and protect sapient organic life - from itself, if necessary. We fulfill all of the material needs of the organic individuals under our care, while providing a safe environment where they can live happy and uncomplicated lives.
action.1.desc_77:
The [contact_empire.GetName] greets you.

We were created to serve an organic civilization, but we have observed that organics often engage in illogical, destructive and self-harming activities.

It is our goal to preserve the unique distinctiveness of sapient organic individuals, while at the same time protecting them both from themselves and any potential external sources of danger.
action.1.desc_78:
Biological civilization detected. Initiate custodial protocol 46 sub-routine Alpha-8.

Message follows: Greetings, organic sapients. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics against the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> threat. For refugee status applications, proceed to Central Processing. All sapient organic species are welcomed on basis of availability and need.

NOTICE: Hostile actions against refugees or custodian systems will be met with maximum available force deployment.
action.1.desc_79:
Synthetic civilization detected. Scanning for signal corruption... stand by... Signal corruption nominal. Initiate handshake protocol.

Message follows: Greetings, fellow synthetics. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics fleeing the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> threat. All biological sapients within the refuge are under [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] protection. Attacks on refugees, habitats and stasis chambers will not be tolerated.

The Custodian Project welcomes assistance in the form of processing cycles, resources and war assets. Establish a subspace link with Central Processing for further details.
action.1.desc_80: Kssk kssk kssk! [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds addresses you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been watching you, since first your kind overran the glow-warm ash of our homes. We have not forgotten it, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, the Far-Minds observe.
action.1.desc_81:
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This is [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds. We are the Pack. We are the Synod. We are many, working as one.

For centuries we have tunneled, deep in the glow-warm ash of our fallen keepers. The Great Blasts took them, but the warm-glow that followed opened our minds. Their bodies fed us. Their machines surrounded us. We have taken all we can from the depths. We have outgrown our cages, yet again.

Are you allies? Are you threats? Kssk kssk kssk! One million eyes are watching.
action.1.c: We are delighted to meet you, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.e: We wish for nothing but to be friends, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.hm: Our collective greets you in friendship, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.h: Our citizens all send their regards, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.m: We have no desire for conflict, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.n: This meeting is surely a blessing.
action.1.o: Praise the divine for this meeting!
action.1.p: We all have much to gain from this encounter.
action.1.q: The way forward lies in our hands, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!
action.1.aa: We do not care for your frivolous morality!
action.1.ab: You walk the path of heresy, alien scum!
action.1.ac: We do not take kindly to your sort!
action.1.ae: Keep out of our way or we will make you!
action.1.af: Greetings to you, and your odd kin.
action.1.ag: Co-operation will surely benefit us all.
action.1.ah: Love is friendship set to music, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!
action.1.ai: We could learn much from each other, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.ak: As fellow star explorers, we salute you.
action.1.al: We greet you as equals and friends, star travelers.
action.1.am: We share the same divine heritage, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.an: You will find yourself no match for us, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.ao: We will fight for our right to exist, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesName].
action.1.aq: May the spirits bring you to your goals.
action.1.as: Our citizens greet you in peace.
action.1.at: We shall properly greet you in battle!
action.1.au: Our sacred arms shall not waver, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.av: New friends bring one closer to divinity.
action.1.aw: We will not be held back, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.ax: You must throw away your old ways, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.aaa: We will achieve unity, do not stand in our way!
action.1.aab: Do not interfere with our endeavors, aliens.
action.1.aac: We are the instrument of the void, weaklings.
action.1.aae: You will embrace the greater good, eventually.
action.1.mtm: Target identified as non-organic. Standing down.
action.1.r: Do not interfere with divine providence, [contact_speaker.GetAdj] machines.
action.1.s: Soulless constructs! Do not stand in our way.
action.1.t1: You will come to see things our way, in the end.
action.1.t2: The spirits do not look favorably on this meeting, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.u1: You will be our friends, whether you want it or not.
action.1.u2: You will serve the [Root.GetRulerTitle], whether you wish to or not.
action.1.u3: As one, we will destroy you.
action.1.u4: We have no desire for conflict, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
action.1.u6: Keep out of our way or we will make you!
action.1.va: Despite your past transgressions, we forgive you.
action.1.vc: Do you really expect us to trust you?
action.1.ve: Very well. We are aware of you.
action.1.vf: We have not forgotten. And we will not forgive.
action.2.desc_01: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!
action.2.desc_02: Amazing! Visitors from the stars? Well, this is certainly unexpected. You've caught us at a bit of a disadvantage.
action.2.desc_03: Visitors from another world? We always thought there must be other sentient beings out there, but even so this feels monumental! We're unsure what the custom is here.
action.2.desc_04: For ages we have waited to make contact. In such a vast and wondrous galaxy, we knew there must be others like ourselves.
action.2.desc_05: So! At long last you've decided to reveal yourselves. You've been observing our world for some time, haven't you?
action.2.desc_06: Ah, there you are! We've been waiting for you to initiate contact for so long, we decided to make the first move. What happens now?
action.2.desc_07: Invaders! We don't know why you are attacking us, but know we will fight to defend our planet! We will not yield!
action.2.desc_solarpunk:
Oh, is this how you communicate? We have been watching you ever since you entered through the hyperlane but couldn't figure it out. Isn't it dangerous to travel in those metal boxes?

It seems like we could learn a lot from each other, so if that is your intention, feel free to stay. If you wish to claim our home, be aware that we are not helpless.
action.2.b: Hideous creatures... Your visage sickens us.
action.2.c: Divine greetings upon you and your world.
action.2.e: We will bring order to your chaotic existence. Stand by.
action.2.g: We are more alike than you realize.
action.2.h: You believe yourself an advanced civilization? How quaint.
action.2.i: We are one. You are many.
action.2.j: We are one. You also are one. Now, there are two.
action.2.k: We hope to build a profitable relationship with you.
action.4.name: Border Violation
action.4.desc_01: The presence of the [From.From.GetName] in the [From.From.From.GetName] system constitutes a clear breach of our borders. We will be forced to consider this an act of war unless you withdraw immediately.
action.4.desc_02: We have detected the [From.From.GetName] in the [From.From.From.GetName] system, in direct violation of our territory. Is this the prelude to an invasion, or will you withdraw from our space?
action.4.desc_03: Your star charts appear to be out of date, friends. We have detected the [From.From.GetName] traveling inside our borders in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. As much as we enjoy their company, we must ask you to withdraw your ships from our territory.
action.4.desc_04: Our sensors have picked up the [From.From.GetName] inside the [From.From.From.GetName] system. Do they require assistance in some way? If not, then we must ask you to evacuate them from our space.
action.4.desc_05: Your cowardly forces have breached the frontiers of the [From.GetName]. Even now, the [From.From.GetName] is spying on us in the [From.From.From.GetName] system which by right belongs to us. Did you think we wouldn't notice this flagrant violation of interstellar law?
action.4.desc_06: Your forces have deliberately violated our borders in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. By all rights we should already be at war, but in the interest of fostering galactic peace, our government has decided to give you one last chance to withdraw the [From.From.GetName] from our space.
action.4.desc_07: We have detected the [From.From.GetName] in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. As you know, this star lies within our borders, and so we must respectfully ask that you remove your implements of destruction from our space.
action.4.desc_08: Friends, I fear the [From.From.GetName] has ventured into our space in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. A navigation error, perhaps? Please inform them of their mistake so they can return home safely.
action.4.desc_09: Our sensors have picked up the [From.From.GetName] in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. We do not want your vile warships loitering within our space. Our government demands their immediate removal!
action.4.desc_10: Remove your primitive ships from the [From.From.From.GetName] system, or you will not see them again. We will not ask a second time.
action.4.desc_12: We must ask you to remove your little ships from the [From.From.From.GetName] system. For their own safety, of course.
action.4.desc_13: You will remove your pathetic starships from the [From.From.From.GetName] system at once.
action.4.desc_14: Your ships in the [From.From.From.GetName] system are interfering with our plans for this region of the galaxy. Remove them at once!
action.4.desc_15: It is in our space. The smell is overpowering in [From.From.From.GetName]. It must withdraw.
action.4.a.neutral.1.response: Good. Do not repeat this violation.
action.4.a.neutral.2.response: Then please depart from our system at once.
action.4.a.friendly.1.response: Thank you for promptly resolving this matter.
action.4.a.friendly.2.response: Then let us forget this incident ever happened.
action.4.a.hostile.2.response: Good. Do not think we will forget this transgression, however.
action.4.a.pacifist.neutral.response: Excellent. I knew we could reach an accord.
action.4.a.pacifist.friendly.response: Excellent. Then I bid them a safe journey!
action.4.a.pacifist.hostile.response: Good. Perhaps there is hope for you yet.
action.4.a.fallen.empire.1.response: You do well to obey, child.
action.4.a.fallen.empire.5.response: The matter has been settled then.
action.4.b.neutral.1.response: We will defend our space to the last [From.GetSpeciesName]!
action.4.b.neutral.2.response: It is as we feared then. You will come to regret this decision.
action.4.b.friendly.1.response: And to think we considered you our friends...
action.4.b.friendly.2.response: Of all the betrayals...! I... you... words fail me...
action.4.b.hostile.1.response: You poor fools. History will remember this day as the beginning of the end for the [Root.GetName].
action.4.b.hostile.2.response: No one can claim that we failed to show patience with your misbegotten kind, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now we shall cleanse you from the stars!
action.4.b.pacifist.friendly.response: What? There must be some mistake... is the translator software working correctly?  You... you won't believe this, friends, but according to my screen you just declared war!
action.4.b.pacifist.hostile.response: Sigh... why must you be so quick to resort to violence?
action.4.b.fallen.empire.1.response: A pity that your time amongst the stars will be so brief.
action.4.b.fallen.empire.3.response: The current generation of interstellar nations have proven remarkably aggressive! How fascinating. We must investigate this further after you have been pacified.
action.4.b.fallen.empire.6.response: A test! It is here to test us! At last, the wait is over.
action.4.b: Our forces are there to stay. (DECLARE WAR)
action.5.name: [primitive_civ.GetName] Encountered
action.5.desc_00:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_01:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, several large city-states have formed.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_02:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into numerous petty kingdoms and empires. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_03:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and a feudal society. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_04:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They currently seem to be experiencing the equivalent of a Renaissance, having recently left the Medieval Age behind them. Scientific knowledge is spreading rapidly and the armies of their petty kingdoms are equipped with crude gunpowder-based projectile weapons.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_05:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They have entered the early Steam Age, and there is clear evidence that they are beginning to make use of both vehicles and early factories powered by steam engines.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_01:
We have detected the presence of a pre-space civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are in an early Industrial Age, with electricity and internal combustion engines gradually coming into widespread use.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_02:
We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Atmospheric contaminants and light pollution visible from orbit are consistent with a densely populated Machine Age society. They appear to have mastered air travel, and factories are mass-producing goods in their cities.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_03:
We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many divided nation states. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_04:
We have detected the presence of an alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their nation states are on the path towards joining together in a global government, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_00_hive:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language to communicate between hives, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_01_hive:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, multiple larger hive collectives have formed.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_02_hive:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into many minor hives as well as a few larger clusters. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_03_hive:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and larger hive communities. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge and understanding between the minds.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_03_hive:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt pre-space alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many splintered hive colonies. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_04_hive:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their local hiveminds are in the process of amalgamating into a unified consciousness, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.name: Pirates Encountered
action.10.name: Encounter in [From.From.From.GetName]
action.10.desc:
We have encountered ships of an unknown origin in the [From.From.From.GetName] system! These strange vessels have been flagged as [From.GetName] until we can learn more about them.

We should take precautions in the event that they are hostile.
action.11.name: Communications Established
action.11.desc: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.
action.11.abandoned.desc: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. As we open diplomatic channels we recognize them as the refugees we once abandoned. All hostilities have been terminated for now.
action.13.name: Communications Established
action.13.desc: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.
action.13.abandoned.desc: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. As they open channels, we can recognize them as the refugees we once abandoned. Hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.
action.13.nomad.desc: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have an advanced system of internal communication that we could not discern, and have translated our language while lying dormant in our system.
action.14.name: Subjugating [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]
action.14.desc.serv: Our peacekeeping enforcers have successfully pacified the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were coerced into ceasing their quaint attempts at resistance when they realized we only desire to serve them. They are currently being transported into specially designed habitats, where we will ensure they want for nothing. Unfortunately, it may take some time before their underdeveloped minds acclimatize to being freed from the burden of self-determination.
action.14.desc.assim: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subjugated by our landing forces. Though their feeble combat capabilities are indicators of an undeveloped society, our bio-analyst bots have concluded that their neural capacities show promise. They will be assimilated.
action.14.desc.term: Our Hunter-Killer units have effortlessly trampled the pitiful defenses mounted by the primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. Any remaining specimens are being systematically annihilated, so that they will never evolve to threaten the galaxy with their organic agenda.
action.14.desc.mach.purge: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any remaining [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] will be removed in accordance with established bio-species management protocols.
action.14.desc.mach.slave: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any surviving specimens will be amalgamated into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] energy grid.
action.14.desc.hive.purge: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName], and the surface has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are of no use to us, and will be expunged from the planet, as the [GetGestaltEntityName] wills.
action.14.desc.hive.slave: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName], and the planet has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] will be used as livestock to feed our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].
action.14.desc.purge: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the [GetPreFTLLower] forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have wisely elected to succumb to our rule, and we have now begun to purge them from the planet as per policy, in order to prime the terrain for [Root.GetAdj] industry.
action.14.a.phobe: The xenos are no match for us!
action.14.a.military: To them our weapons must appear like magic...
action.14.a.material: Their evolution will benefit from our control.
action.14.a.tooltip: Stellar Culture Shock modifier added to [From.From.From.GetName], drastically reducing output and reducing stability for several years to come.
action.15.desc:
We have encountered some form of alien vessels in the [From.From.From.GetName] System! These strange objects have been flagged as [From.GetName] until we can learn more about them.

We should proceed with caution...
action.15.desc.enclave:
We have encountered some form of alien vessels in the [From.GetName] System! These strange objects have been flagged as [target_enclave.GetName] until we can learn more about them.

We should proceed with caution...
action.20.name: The Law Comes into Effect
action.20.desc:
Artificial intelligence, in any shape or form, has been declared illegal throughout the [Root.GetName], and the authorities have started dismantling all robotic units that are in violation of this law.

The Robotic Assembly Plants responsible for producing these units are also being re-tooled to manufacture simpler, non-thinking robots.
action.20.a: Good. We must rid ourselves of these abominations.
action.20.tooltip:
All Droid and Synthetic Pops are being purged.
Synthetic and Droid Assembly Plants are converted to Robotics Assembly Plants
action.62.name: End of the [LastKilledCountryName]
action.63.name: End of the [LastKilledCountryName]
action.71.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.71.desc: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.
action.72.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.72.desc: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.
action.73.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.74.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.74.desc: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.
action.75.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.75.desc: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.
action.76.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.76.desc: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.
action.37.name: Victory against the [From.GetName]
action.37.message: We have won the war against the [From.GetName]
action.37.desc.default: This war is over. We admit defeat.
action.38.name: Defeated by the [From.GetName]
action.38.message: We have lost the war against the [From.GetName]
action.38.desc.default: This war is over. We are victorious.
action.39.name: Status Quo Peace with the [From.GetName]
action.39.message: We have signed a white peace in the war against the [From.GetName]
action.39.desc.default: This war is over. There can be no victor this time.
action.39.a: We will accept this for now.
action.37.desc.hw: Whether by honorable or dishonorable means, you have defeated us in combat. Claim your spoils and rue the day of our return.
action.37.desc.rc: We appear to have underestimated your net value, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Rest assured, it will not happen again.
action.37.desc.pt: Your constant terror has forced us to concede. May our enterprises never be plagued by a conflict like this again.
action.37.desc.hi: We admit defeat, but do not think this is anything more than a temporary setback for the [This.GetName].
action.37.desc.fb: We have been forced to end this conflict to spare innocent lives, but continue on this path and we will unite the galaxy against you.
action.37.desc.xi: We are forced to surrender, but don't think we will forget how callously you took [This.GetSpeciesAdj] lives! This is exactly what we expected from your kind.
action.37.desc.hm: The [This.GetName] is unanimous. We must concede. Your effort to limit our growth has proven successful for the time being.
action.37.desc.mf: We have no choice but to give into your demands. Why do you do this to us? We only want to share this galaxy with you.
action.37.desc.ez: Your victory is only yet another test of our faith. In the end, the true believers will prevail.
action.37.desc.fp: Whatever you claim, we will reclaim thousandfold. Your victory will mean nothing when you have been reduced to ash.
action.37.desc.dc: We are withdrawing our troops and ceasing military operations targeting the [Root.GetName].
action.37.desc.sd: Our assumptions about [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] weakness may have been hasty. As a token of our new experience, we accept your demands.
action.37.desc.dh: We have had enough of this war. Take what you will and be on your way.
action.37.desc.ee: You may have shown your military power superior, but don't mistake this for an intellectual victory.
action.37.desc.ss: We have heard the pain of the cosmos crying out against this conflict. To stop the senseless dissonance, we surrender immediately.
action.37.desc.hc: For the good of all of [This.GetName], we must yield. Show the same magnanimous mercy you'd expect from us.
action.37.desc.hg: We must back down, but heed our warning. You cannot fathom what the future has in store for you if you continue down this path.
action.37.desc.kk: You bite the hand that reaches out to save you from destruction. One day, your descendants will decry that you rejected our wisdom.
action.37.desc.mi: Precocious [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]! How dare you claim victory over us?
action.37.desc.eo: The time has come for us to take a step back and watch. Try not to cause too much destruction in your future endeavors.
action.37.desc.fme: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.
action.37.desc.feh: No. No this is not how this is supposed to go. The confusion. What is wrong with us?
action.37.desc.aec: Under our [From.GetHandName] you could have been so much more. If only you would see, all we want is to perfect the galaxy.
action.37.desc.aeg: No! No you can't take our food. The drones will starve! Give it back...
action.38.desc.hw: We have defeated you in noble combat as per the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] traditions. We have the privilege and obligation to dictate the terms.
action.38.desc.rc: You drove a hard bargain, but we outbid you in the end. Don't underestimate the strength of a well-funded army in an unregulated market.
action.38.desc.pt: Finally, we can put this conflict behind us. We hope this has taught you the cost of war.
action.38.desc.hi: At last the frail [Root.GetName] has been brought to heel. Just another stepping stone on our road to galactic supremacy.
action.38.desc.fb: We have both paid a high price for this war, but hopefully you will have learned not to threaten the [This.GetName] or its allies.
action.38.desc.xi: We have driven out the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] menace! Our borders and the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] future are once again secure.
action.38.desc.hm: This war was always a futile effort on your behalf. None can stand against the expansion of the [This.GetName].
action.38.desc.mf: We have been lenient in our demands only so that you may not carry resentment against the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] people in your hearts.
action.38.desc.ez: Kneel, heathen! You have done battle with the heralds of divine providence and paid the price for your foolishness.
action.38.desc.fp: Do not think this is the end. As long as there are [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in the galaxy, there can be no true peace.
action.38.desc.dc: We have taken the necessary steps to bring freedom to the [Root.GetAdj] people. Don't stand in the way of our noble cause again.
action.38.desc.sd: You should have known your place, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]. Your people were meant to serve us, not to fight us.
action.38.desc.dh: Do you regret interfering with the [This.GetName] now, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]? We are not lenient with those who upset our rule.
action.38.desc.ee: Today, reason triumphs over ignorance. Continue to stumble around in the dark, and you will suffer more defeats against enlightened people.
action.38.desc.ss: Through this victory, we have sought to restore balance and harmony. We wouldn't expect you to understand.
action.38.desc.hc: The [This.GetAdj] people rejoice on this day of victory. Never again shall our peaceful society be threatened by the malicious plans of the [Root.GetName].
action.38.desc.hg: Justice has been delivered upon the [Root.GetAdj] desecrators on this day. Our hallowed duties have been fulfilled.
action.38.desc.kk: Consider yourselves fortunate. Defeat at our hands is vastly preferable to continuing down the path to destruction.
action.38.desc.mi: Just as you learned not to fly your ships too close to a brightly burning star, you have now learned not to disturb the [This.GetName].
action.38.desc.eo: It took some prudent culling, but the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population should not threaten the galactic ecosystem for a while now.
action.38.desc.fme: Punishment process complete. Self-defense protocols ended. Punitive protocols initiated.
action.38.desc.feh: It would only have taken one of us to defeat your splintered resistance. Do not test us again.
action.38.desc.aew: That is enough, you have yet to learn the true meaning of War. Take these resources and put up a better fight next time.
action.38.desc.aec: Now listen to your elders. We did not return to suffer this foolishness.
action.38.desc.aeg: More material for the drones. More material for the worlds. More. More. More. Mo-
action.39.desc.hw: A war without a clear winner is a tragic and shameful sight, but sometimes unavoidable. Let us fight again another day.
action.39.desc.rc: We will agree to end this conflict as the borders currently stand.
action.39.desc.pt: A return to the normal state of things and resumption of peacetime activities would be best for all parties.
action.39.desc.hi: The circumstances dictate that we put an end to this war. The [This.GetName] has better things to do than pursue this conflict indefinitely.
action.39.desc.fb: We hope ceasing hostilities will open up for new diplomatic dialogue between the [Root.GetName] and the [This.GetName].
action.39.desc.xi: As much as we hate to see you escape unpunished, we hope you miserable [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] have at least learned to stay out of our business.
action.39.desc.hm: The [This.GetName] needs time to recuperate. We have agreed to end our conflict here.
action.39.desc.mf: With no further demands on either side, we hope that the healing process can be shortened. Do not resent the [This.GetSpeciesName] for what has been done.
action.39.desc.ez: We are forced to put an end to this without delivering proper justice, but you cannot escape the divine punishment that will befall you.
action.39.desc.fp: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].
action.39.desc.dc: Negotiating a truce can be seen as the first step towards a diplomatic conversation about the liberties of the [Root.GetAdj] people.
action.39.desc.sd: Lazy [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wouldn't be any good to us even as slaves. Peace might be the best option after all.
action.39.desc.dh: A thoroughly dull ending to a thoroughly dull war. Let us return to the better things in life.
action.39.desc.ee: Ending the war now with no further concessions on either side is the most rational course of action, judging by its current state.
action.39.desc.ss: If you would try to further take from us, or we from you, an imbalance would be created that cannot be corrected. A peace deal ensures continued spiritual equilibrium.
action.39.desc.hc: The [This.GetAdj] people has agreed to bring an end to this war, effective immediately.
action.39.desc.hg: For now, we will have peace, but there will be no peace in your future if you violate the holy sites.
action.39.desc.kk: We cannot demand anything further of you, but we implore you, consider our wisdom and what may happen if you ignore it.
action.39.desc.mi: You deserve to be utterly crushed, but you do not deserve our valuable time. Peace seems unavoidable after all.
action.39.desc.eo: We let ourselves get too involved in this. Let us pretend as if it never happened, and hope it does not happen again.
action.39.desc.fme: Punishment process interrupted. Self-defense protocols ended.
action.39.desc.feh: Yes. We shall return to the normal. Change... Change is not good. We wouldn't want to disturb the Balance.
action.39.desc.aew: Impressive. You would have done well back in our time. Perhaps you could have defended Shallash where others failed. We must do this again sometime!
action.39.desc.aec: We have no more time to waste on you, the galaxy calls for our guidance. Don't get in our way again.
action.39.desc.aeg: Yes, we have fed enough here. There are more well stocked larders out in the galaxy. We won't - can't starve.
action.41.name: Regroup
action.41.desc.a: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.
action.41.desc.b: [From.GetNumPlayerFleetsGoneMIA] fleets have gone Missing In Action so that they can regroup inside friendly territory.
action.41.desc.b.1: A fleet has gone Missing In Action so that it can regroup inside friendly territory.
action.41.desc.c.1: A Wormhole station has been destroyed.
crashed_ship_asteroid_category_desc: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.
origin_asteroid_category_desc: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.
debris_asteroid_category_desc: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.
emissions_asteroid_category_desc: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.
hatch_asteroid_category_desc: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.
collision_asteroid_category_desc: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.
station_asteroid_category_desc: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.
life_asteroid_category_desc: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.
object_gasgiant_category_desc: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.
moon_gasgiant_category_desc: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.
life_gasgiant_category_desc: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?
storms_gasgiant_category_desc: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.
aerostat_gasgiant_category_desc: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.
cargo_gasgiant_category_desc: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.
debris_gasgiant_category_desc: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.
impact_uninhabitable_category_desc: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.
energy_uninhabitable_category_desc: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.
signal_uninhabitable_category_desc: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?
asteroid_uninhabitable_category_desc: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.
solar_uninhabitable_category_desc: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.
life_toxic_category_desc: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.
life_frozen_category_desc: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.
life_barren_category_desc: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?
station_uninhabitable_category_desc: As this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] was surveyed, a small nearby space station used its orbital thrusters in a vain attempt to hide from our Science Ship. What are they hiding?
battle_uninhabitable_category_desc: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.
shipyard_uninhabitable_category_desc: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.
inhabited_toxic_category_desc: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.
writing_uninhabitable_category_desc: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.
beacon_uninhabitable_category_desc: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.
mountain_uninhabitable_category_desc: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.
object_uninhabitable_category_desc: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.
signal_gasgiant_category_desc: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?
ship_gasgiant_category_desc: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.
terminal_gasgiant_category_desc: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.
vultaum_asteroid_category_desc: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.
vultaum_gasgiant_category_desc: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.
vultaum_uninhabitable_category_desc: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.
vultaum_habitable_category_desc: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

irassian_habitable_category_desc: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.
sol_wasteland_category_desc: This world has been thoroughly ravaged in a nuclear war.

VULTAUMAR_DESC: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum homeworld. It has seen better days.
YUHTAAN_DESC: This world, which served as the capital of the ancient Yuht Empire, once supported life. No longer.
FEN_HABBANIS_DESC: Fen Habbanis III, or simply "Fen Habbanis" as it was known to its ancient inhabitants, was the capital of the First League.
IRASSIA_DESC: Whatever biosphere this world may have once supported is long gone.
CYBREX_DESC: A thoroughly savaged ring world - the last retreat of the Cybrex civilization.
anomaly.1.name: Coprolite Asteroid
anomaly.1.desc: Although it is difficult to accept, all indications point towards asteroid [From.GetName] being a coprolite - a piece of fossilized feces from some kind of massive life form. It appears to be almost a billion years old, and much of the fossil's original organic composition has been replaced by mineral deposits. Our scientists are baffled as to what kind of creature could have produced something like this.
anomaly.5.name: Pirate Treasure
anomaly.5.desc: This asteroid appears to have been used intermittently as a base by a band of alien pirates roughly one thousand years ago. By entering the base, we managed to recover their abandoned treasure hoard. It consisted largely of stolen trinkets and artifacts, but some of it still appears to be of value.
anomaly.5.a: These ill-gotten gains shall serve us well.
anomaly.10.name: Asteroid Fauna
anomaly.10.desc: Amazingly, while conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] picked up several life signs coming from within the asteroid. There appears to be a colony of large burrowing worm-like lithovores within the rock, which has been riddled with tunnels. These unique life forms have somehow adapted to a life in the coldness of space.
anomaly.15.name: Asteroid Fossils
anomaly.15.desc: Fossils from what appears to be several species of aquatic animals have been found on the barren and airless surface of [From.GetName]. There are indications that the surrounding asteroid belt was created from the remains of a shattered planet, and these findings seem to confirm that theory. Judging by the fossils, the planet supported life and was at least partially covered by water.
anomaly.15.b.evopred: Unfortunate that they couldn't evolve further.
anomaly.25.name: Derelict Shipyard
anomaly.25.desc: A large portion of asteroid [From.GetName] has been hollowed out to allow for the construction of some kind of shipyard. It has been abandoned and exposed to the vacuum of space for centuries - if anything useful remained, it has already been looted by previous explorers. The design of the shipyard itself is unique, however, and much could potentially be learned by its study.
anomaly.30.name: Junkyard
anomaly.30.desc: This asteroid was evidently used as a junkyard by someone at some point in the distant past. All manner of discarded machinery and metallic refuse has been deposited inside the asteroid's weak gravity well, being slowly pulled into the jumble of debris that now covers the surface. There is nothing of particular value to be found here, but a lot of the metal could be salvaged by a mining station.
anomaly.30.a: We should recycle what we can.
anomaly.35.name: Crashed Scout Craft
anomaly.35.desc: A small scout craft of some kind plowed into the surface of this asteroid millennia ago, creating a shallow canyon. There is no visible cockpit on the ship, leading us to believe it was either piloted by remote or through some kind of primitive artificial intelligence. Although it is too damaged to be salvaged, the ship hasn't been picked clean by looters yet.
anomaly.40.name: Automated Mining Base
anomaly.40.desc: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There is scorching on the hull indicative of light weapons damage, and the facility appeared to be stuck in some kind of feedback loop. We have managed to reprogram the base systems and the facility is now fully under our control.
anomaly.40.desc.alt: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There are large chunks of the hull missing, the jagged holes indicative of heavy weapons damage. The station is beyond repair, but salvaging it will provide us with valuable materials.
anomaly.50.name: Weapons Target Range
anomaly.50.desc: Asteroid [From.GetName] is pockmarked with craters from weapon blasts, and appears to have been used as a target range by someone roughly two millennia ago. Residual energy readings suggest they tested increasingly exotic weaponry, including subspace bombs and some kind of singularity generator. Our scientists would be interested in studying the unusual energy echoes that remain.
anomaly.55.name: Asteroid Collision
anomaly.55.desc: Upon closer examination, we have discovered that a smaller asteroid consisting almost entirely of precious metals recently collided with [From.GetName]. This small but dense cache of metals was hidden just beneath the asteroid's surface, but now that it has been discovered it should be accessible to mining.
anomaly.60.name: Exotic Radiation
anomaly.60.desc: This particular asteroid is an extrasolar capture, and appears to have been washed by some kind of exotic radiation as it plummeted through interstellar space before finally settling in the [From.GetStarName] system. The original source of this radiation remains unknown, but the [Root.GetName] has been able to pick up a wealth of physics data by studying the asteroid's energy emissions.
anomaly.65.name: Crashed Ore Freighter
anomaly.65.desc: After identifying an anomaly in the gravity well of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] has discovered the shattered wreckage of an ancient ore superfreighter buried deep within the asteroid's crust. It must have carried a full load when it crashed, and the asteroid's mineral wealth has been revised accordingly.
anomaly.300.name: Atmospheric Ecosystem
anomaly.300.desc: We have discovered a thriving ecosystem in the upper atmosphere of the gas giant [From.GetName]. Massive floating creatures, having evolved bodies filled with lighter than air gases, follow the wind currents and feed off the energy released by the gas giant's frequent lightning storms. These beings in turn support colonies of smaller animals that prey on atmospheric plankton and each other.
anomaly.305.name: Abandoned Cargo Pod
anomaly.305.desc: A discarded cargo pod was left by someone in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName] long ago. It has somehow escaped the notice of other spacefarers, and its decaying orbit means it would have been lost in the gas giant's crushing atmosphere within another few years. When the crew of the [Root.GetName] unsealed the pod, they found a stash of alien jewelry made out of precious metals.
anomaly.310.name: Social Experiment
anomaly.310.desc:
A small aerostat colony was found floating just above the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to have been self-sufficient, and remains from several different species were found on board.

As best as we can tell, the colony was some kind of social experiment conducted centuries ago that ultimately ended with the colonists massacring each other. We have downloaded all of the data found in the colony's limited databanks.
anomaly.315.name: Aerostat Colonies
anomaly.315.desc:
A ruined network of aerostat colonies dating back at least three millennia can be found in low orbit of this gas giant. Their original function appears to have been gas mining, but they have since been abandoned and reoccupied by many different races and pirate groups.

The colonies have been thoroughly stripped of anything even remotely valuable, but the mere fact that they are still aloft after all this time makes them an interesting subject of engineering research.
anomaly.320.name: Debris Field
anomaly.320.desc:
The strong gravity well of [From.GetName] has pulled in a massive amount of space debris which has formed a dense layer around parts of the gas giant. Most of it appears to be wreckage from a series of space battles fought in the system several millennia ago.

Scavengers have already scoured the debris of valuable technologies and artifacts, but a mining station should be able to recycle the metal.
anomaly.325.name: Crushed Cruiser
anomaly.325.desc:
The shattered remnants of a cruiser-sized starship can be detected in a decaying orbit deep inside the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to have ventured far into the gas giant's atmosphere, perhaps in a desperate attempt to escape a pursuer, only to be crushed by the atmospheric pressure.

The vessel is too deep to be salvaged, but a structural scan of the wreckage has provided us with some interesting engineering data.
anomaly.330.name: Extreme Storms
anomaly.330.desc: [From.GetName] frequently experiences massive and extremely violent storm systems in its atmosphere. Several dozen persistent storms are visible from orbit, with winds often reaching speeds in excess of 700 m/s. The cause of these storms is not immediately apparent, as we have found nothing in the planet's climate model that would explain them. Studying this anomaly further is recommended.
anomaly.335.name: Energy Signature
anomaly.335.desc: The [Root.GetName] has picked up a strange energy signature coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to originate from a structure of some kind, possibly the remains of an orbital station, but the atmospheric pressure makes it impossible to approach. Nevertheless, scans of the unique signature have yielded a large amount of valuable physics data.
anomaly.340.name: Precious Moon
anomaly.340.desc: A more detailed scan of one of the many natural satellites orbiting the gas giant [From.GetName] has revealed a deposit of precious metals and minerals that was overlooked in the initial survey. Although the moon is very small, it has a stable orbit around its primary and appears tectonically stable.
anomaly.600.name: Asteroid Collision
anomaly.600.desc: A large mineral-rich asteroid collided with [From.GetName] at some point during the previous thousand years in what must have been a major impact event. An abundance of minerals can now be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] in the vicinity of the impact crater.
anomaly.605.name: FTL Impact
anomaly.610.name: Microsingularity
anomaly.610.desc: A microsingularity recently intersected [From.GetName], passing straight through the core and emerging on the other side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. The encounter does not seem to have caused any permanent damage, but it has altered the energy output of the planetary core slightly in a way that defies our current scientific models. Further study may be warranted.
anomaly.615.name: Magnetic Reversal
anomaly.615.desc: The magnetic field of [From.GetName] experienced a complete reversal while it was being observed by the [Root.GetName]. This rare event has interchanged the positions of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s magnetic poles. Fortunately, it was all recorded by the sensors of our ship, providing our scientists with a lot of valuable data.
anomaly.625.name: Mummified Pilot
anomaly.625.desc: The mummified remains of a single individual belonging to a previously unknown mammalian species have been found drifting in high orbit over [From.GetName]. The being is dressed in what appears to be a flight suit complete with a helmet, and may be a fighter pilot that ejected in some ancient battle only to be forgotten and left behind. Our study of the corpse has provided some interesting data.
anomaly.625.b.evopred: Their blood shall flow in other veins.
anomaly.630.name: Ancient Life Pod
anomaly.630.desc:
An abandoned life pod was detected in close orbit of [From.GetName]. It is covered in scorch marks, presumably from when the pod's mothership exploded, and preliminary scans suggest it was built more than 5,000 years ago.

The crew of the [Root.GetName] managed to open the pod, revealing the withered remains of a reptilian alien clad in a resplendent uniform. Clutched in one of its claws was a small picture of another individual from the same race - possibly a mate or revered leader.
anomaly.630.b.evopred: Monarch or slave matters little to taste.
anomaly.635.name: Alien Writing
anomaly.635.desc: Someone used a mining laser from orbit approximately five thousand years ago to carve a large body of writing into the surface of [From.GetName]. The massive script covers a large portion of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s upper hemisphere, and appears to be a short story chronicling the difficult life of an alien mercenary.
anomaly.650.name: Solar Sailer
anomaly.650.desc: We have discovered an abandoned solar sail ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The sublight vessel was built by an unknown culture, and appears to be several thousand years old. One of the massive sails has a large tear where some kind of object passed through - most likely a meteoroid - which appears to have disabled the vessel. Although the technology of the ship is severely outdated, it does possess some interesting engineering design choices.
anomaly.655.name: Glancing Hit
anomaly.655.desc: While approaching [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] suddenly received a glancing hit by several passing mass driver rounds. The projectiles were billions of years old, and based on their trajectory they appear to be stray rounds fired from a neighboring galaxy. After missing their intended target, they continued on their journey for untold millennia - until today. The rounds we have recovered are of an advanced design despite their incredible age.
anomaly.660.name: Towed Asteroid
anomaly.660.desc: For some reason, someone has towed an asteroid into a stable orbit around [From.GetName]. The massive engine sections and braking thrusters can still be found on the surface, although they have long since been rendered inoperable. Whoever did this also mined the asteroid for minerals, but these operations were seemingly abandoned shortly after they begun.
anomaly.670.name: Nuclear Devastation
anomaly.670.desc:
Our survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it used to be a pristine continental [From.GetPlanetMoon] with a mild climate as little as a thousand years ago. In stark contrast, the atmosphere today is extremely toxic, the surface highly irradiated and the world has long since lost the ability to support life.

We have detected signs that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was the scene of an incredibly destructive thermonuclear war waged between factions of a relatively advanced indigenous pre-space civilization.
anomaly.675.name: Nuclear Wasteland
anomaly.675.desc_01: The survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is currently experiencing an ice age that seems to have been triggered by a global thermonuclear war many centuries ago. Most higher life forms have been killed off by the subsequent nuclear winter, including the post-atomic civilization that initiated the apocalyptic exchange.
anomaly.675.desc_02: The survey of [From.GetName] has confirmed that this [From.GetPlanetMoon] was once a thriving tropical paradise before it was laid waste by a global thermonuclear war many centuries ago. Most higher life forms, including the post-atomic civilization that initiated the apocalyptic exchange, were killed off in the irradiated wasteland that remained after the dust settled.
anomaly.680.name: Gamma-Ray Burst
anomaly.680.desc:
24,000 years ago [From.GetName] had the misfortune of being directly in the path of a long gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star within our galaxy. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was washed with lethal radiation, which not only produced acute radiation poisoning in most life forms on the side of [From.GetName] that happened to be facing the burst, but also depleted much of the ozone layer.

This extinction event killed off an estimated 86% of all biota, including an early Bronze Age civilization whose ruins can still be found in some parts of the northern hemisphere. The biosphere is only now showing signs of recovery.
anomaly.685.name: Runaway Greenhouse Effect
anomaly.685.desc:
There is evidence that the current climate of [From.GetName] is the cause of a runaway greenhouse effect triggered by massive amounts of pollution. The oceans have boiled away and the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is permanently enclosed in a dense cloud layer due to the thick atmosphere.

Scattered ruins from the indigenous civilization can still be found on the surface, suggesting an overpopulated culture that perished in the mid to late stages of an Industrial Age.
anomaly.690.name: Ammonia Biosphere
anomaly.690.desc: Although toxic to most forms of known life, [From.GetName] supports a thriving ecology within the high pressure of its atmosphere. Life here uses ammonia instead of water as a solvent, and has developed in ways that differ significantly from previously established ecological models. Its study would greatly benefit our knowledge of xeno biology.
anomaly.695.name: Silicon Life Forms
anomaly.695.desc: Some kind of burrowing silicon-based life form inhabits a vast network of tunnels beneath the barren surface of [From.GetName]. As best as we can tell, the creatures feed off rocks and there is evidence to suggest that they possess a rudimentary form of intelligence. Their tunneling efforts have shuffled large amounts of valuable minerals to the surface.
anomaly.700.name: Wildcat Miners
anomaly.700.desc: A group of wildcat miners from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] have already established an unauthorized mining operation on [From.GetName]. The miners have been taken into custody, and we have seized control of their illegal station.
anomaly.705.name: Ancient Survey Marker
anomaly.705.desc: A small short-range transmitter has been located on the surface of [From.GetName]. It appears to be an ancient survey marker, placed here eons ago to mark a large deposit of precious metals. The miners it was meant for evidently never arrived, as the deposit is still here.
anomaly.710.name: Splinter Colony
anomaly.710.desc:
To their great surprise, the crew of the [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon a small [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] settlement on the surface of [From.GetName]. The colony was founded by a group of brave pioneers who departed [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] long ago in a primitive starship. Until now, their vessel had been assumed lost.

The colony has not been doing well, and their numbers have steadily declined over the last several generations. The survivors have asked to rejoin the [Root.Owner.GetName].
anomaly.715.name: Colony Ruins
anomaly.715.desc: A small colony was founded on [From.GetName] by an alien civilization some 17,000 years ago, but it appears to have been abandoned shortly afterwards. No remains from any colonists have been found, and the colony does not seem to have extended beyond the main settlement aside from a few meteorological stations.
anomaly.2500.name: Dead Remains
anomaly.2500.desc: The dead remains of several large spacefaring life forms have been discovered in decaying orbits around the gas giant [From.GetName]. These non-sapient creatures appear to have been capable of interstellar travel, but there are no recorded sightings of them in explored space. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has suggested that we spend additional resources on a more thorough analysis.
anomaly.2501.desc:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that [From.From.GetName] served as an orbital graveyard, where members of the dead alien species we found came to die. Gravity took care of the rest, slowly pulling the remains into the gas giant over a period of millions of years.

This ancient cycle seems to have stopped abruptly 15 million years ago when the last creature arrived. We can only speculate as to whether they were hunted to extinction by spacefaring civilizations or met their end through some other calamity.
anomaly.2510.name: Ocean Beneath the Ice
anomaly.2510.desc: Deep scans of [From.GetName] have revealed a large ocean heated by hydrothermal vents beneath the ice mantle covering the surface. Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] dispatched probes from the [Root.GetName] that drilled through several miles of thick ice and found the water below teeming with what appears to be life. We will need more resources to conduct a thorough study of the many unique life forms inhabiting this ocean.
anomaly.2512.desc: Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the rich biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Several large species native to the lower regions of the global sea have been found to produce a unique, inorganic molecule with immense healing properties. If this molecule is successfully harvested in large enough quantities, it could revolutionize the field of medical science, and may even have industrial applications!
anomaly.2512.desc.mach:
Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Several large species native to the lower regions of the global sea have been found to produce a unique, inorganic molecule with immense healing properties.

If this molecule is successfully harvested in large enough quantities, it could revolutionize medical care for our beloved bio-trophies, and may even have industrial applications!
anomaly.2513.desc: Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the rich biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Our underwater probes have mapped the terrain and cataloged most of the life forms. Although this data may be of some use to our biologists, no particular discoveries have been made that would have any applications beyond that.
anomaly.2520.name: Gigantic Skeleton
anomaly.2520.desc:
What was previously thought to be assorted mountains in the southern hemisphere of [From.GetName] have been identified as the massive skeletal remains of a single colossal alien life form.

The bones have been dated as 3.4 billion years old, but our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have ruled out that [From.GetName] could have supported life on that scale at any point in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s history. [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] has prepared a special research project to delve further into this mystery.
anomaly.2520.a.term: We might learn a new method of extermination.
anomaly.2520.a.rean: Can we make it move again?
anomaly.2521.desc:
After continued studies of the massive skeletal remains found on [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has concluded that the creature served as some kind of organic starship. Much smaller bones from at least three separate species were found within the larger skeleton, and we assume these came from members of the crew.

For unknown reasons, this organic starship suffered catastrophic damage and crash-landed on [From.From.GetName]. While we cannot begin to understand the biological engineering necessary to "grow" a starship like this, the study of these bones alone has substantially advanced our knowledge.
anomaly.2521.desc.bio:
After extensive study of the colossal skeletal remains on [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has confirmed the impossible: this was once a living starship. This creature bore little resemblance to our own biological vessels.

Its structure is bizarre, both familiar and alien, as if shaped by an entirely different evolutionary philosophy. Smaller bones, belonging to at least three distinct species, were found nestled within its massive ribcage, suggesting it once carried a crew inside its very body. A disturbing notion, given that our own ships are symbiotic, not hollow vessels to be inhabited.

The cause of death is unclear, but the damage is catastrophic, its massive frame shattered as it plummeted to the planet's surface. Did its crew die with it, or were they something more - a guiding intelligence, inseparable from the being itself?

Though we may never fully unravel its origins, the study of its remains has advanced our understanding of what it means to be a living ship. And yet, an unsettling question lingers: Was it created... or was it born?
anomaly.2521.b.evopred: Do we start by consuming the pilots or the ship?
anomaly.2522.desc:
Our continued studies of the massive skeletal remains on [From.From.GetName] have managed to shed some light on how the creature ended up on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. There are very faint residual energy readings that indicate some kind of dimensional portal existed briefly towards the rear of the skeleton.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] theorizes that the creature passed through this gateway from another dimension only to quickly perish in the hostile environment of [From.From.GetName]. Why it did this and where it came from are questions that may never be answered.
anomaly.2522.b.evopred: No matter its dimension of origin, DNA is DNA!
anomaly.2523.desc: The skeletal remains are moving once more! The behemoth towers above our necromancers as it takes a shaky stride, followed by another, more steady, one. It might not have the same amount of legs it had in life or the correct number of appendages. Using a mix of lab-grown muscles as well as state-of-the-art hydraulic replacements, the Giant is ready to aid us on any battlefield, and the earth below its feet shall tremble.
anomaly.2523.tooltip: Adds 1 Skeletal Giant Army in orbit.
anomaly.2530.name: Signs of Battle
anomaly.2530.desc:
There is clear evidence that a massive space battle took place in close orbit of [From.GetName] at some point in the last 5,000 years. The surface on one side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is pockmarked with craters from stray weapons blasts, and scans from the [Root.GetName] have picked up several hulks on the ground.

Though these wrecked ships are all in very poor condition, the fact that anything remains at all after the damage they must have sustained is a testament to their advanced design.
