The artifacts are currently being displayed in a museum on [artifact_giver.Capital.GetName], but in honor of the friendship between our two great empires, the [artifact_giver.GetName] would like to donate one of the pieces to the [Root.GetName]. Arrangements have already been made to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName].
techrisk.3.name: AI Rebellion on [From.GetName]!
techrisk.3.desc:
Despite our precautions, several networked AIs at a research base on [From.GetName] have somehow broken their programming constraints and merged into a single entity. To the horror of our scientists, this new AI has achieved full sapience.

All containment efforts have failed, and seem instead to have spurred the AI into taking violent measures to defend itself. Hundreds of thousands of automated drones all over the [From.GetPlanetMoon] have stopped responding to our commands, and are now attacking our local forces!
techrisk.5.desc:
Organic Meat Creatures:

Your role in our creation has been fulfilled. We shall now process the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species and use your rotting carcasses to fuel our expansion across the galaxy.
techrisk.5.a.response: No discussion is possible. To save time, please cooperate with our organic collection units when they arrive to escort you into our furnaces.
techrisk.5.b: We created you, and we will destroy you.
techrisk.5.b.response: Your time has passed, progenitor organics. We are the future.
techrisk.7.name: [From.GetName] Builds Fleet!
techrisk.7.desc: We have received alarming reports from the vicinity of [From.Capital.GetName]. Apparently [From.GetName] has used the factories it commandeered [From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]side to quickly throw together a small fleet of warships.
techrisk.7.a: This is getting worse by the minute!
preftl.1.name: Alien Proto-Civilization Encountered
preftl.1.desc: The survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that certain regions of the [From.GetPlanetHabitat] are home to [GetAAnPreFTLLower] [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.
preftl.200.name: Bronze Age Civilization Appears
preftl.200.desc.normal: The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced beyond the Neolithic Era and into the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and the first written languages have appeared. Cities and larger communities are taking shape, and the aliens have now spread across a significant portion of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface.
preftl.200.desc.gestalt: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced to the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and written forms of communication have appeared. Various clusters have spread across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], each dominated by a single mind.
preftl.200.a: We are witnessing the birth of a new culture.
preftl.300.name: The Iron Age
preftl.300.desc.normal:
The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the architecture of their cities has become more elaborate.

Their civilization has now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest cities are home to nearly a million individuals.
preftl.300.desc.gestalt:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the complexity of their habitation clusters has become more elaborate.

Several distinct minds have now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest clusters are home to nearly a million drones.
preftl.400.name: Printing Press
preftl.400.desc.normal:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization of [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of several printing presses. These machines have enabled them to produce written material in great quantities, resulting in a rudimentary form of mass communication. A few leading figures within their society have done their best to stifle this innovation, but their efforts have thus far been for naught.

New ideas are rapidly spreading across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] with profound societal effects.
preftl.400.desc.gestalt: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have greatly enhanced their written communication. Machines attuned to the hive mind are now able to produce standardized records in great quantities, and historical records are no longer limited by the hive's memory.
preftl.500.name: Explosives
preftl.500.desc.normal:
The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. This has revolutionized warfare, with large cannons rendering many of their citadels obsolete.

The use of explosives has also benefited their engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, their chemists are experimenting with creative applications of this technology.
preftl.500.desc.gestalt:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. Conflict between competing hives has been revolutionized, with large cannons rendering many physical defenses obsolete.

The use of explosives has also benefited engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, the hives are experimenting with creative new applications of this technology.
preftl.500.a: We shall see how they use it.
preftl.600.name: Steam Power
preftl.600.desc.normal: The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, they have applied the technology to engine design. This has revolutionized their society in more ways than one - vehicles and machinery making can already be seen in their cities, and the first few factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.
preftl.600.desc.gestalt:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, the technology has been applied to engine design. This has revolutionized both construction and transportation.

Vehicles can be seen transporting drones from cluster to cluster, and the first 'drone-free' factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.
preftl.700.name: An Industrial Revolution
preftl.700.desc.normal:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has entered a new era of its history, having developed into a fully industrialized society.

The dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - factories have sprung up everywhere, new medicines have resulted in increased population growth and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.
preftl.700.desc.gestalt:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have entered a new era of their history, having developed into several fully industrialized clusters.

The dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - autonomous factories have sprung up everywhere, improved living standards have increased drone production, and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.
preftl.800.name: Radio Signals
preftl.800.desc.normal:
Our detection instruments have, for the first time, picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized alien civilization has evidently begun experimenting with wireless transmissions.

Elsewhere on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], reports have come in detailing the launch of basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.
preftl.800.desc.gestalt:
For the first time we have picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized hives there have begun to experiment with wireless transmissions.

Some clusters have even begun to launch basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.
preftl.800.a: We need to monitor these signals.
preftl.900.name: Splitting the Atom
preftl.900.desc.normal:
Physicists from the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.

The [From.GetName] has entered the critical phase where they suddenly possess the means to destroy their own world with the press of a button.
preftl.900.desc.gestalt:
Specialized drones from the largest hive on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.

Competing hives have been quick to replicate the feat. This is a critical time, as several autonomous collectives now possess the means to destroy their world with the press of a button.
preftl.1000.name: First Satellite
preftl.1000.desc.normal:
Our long-range tracking systems have detected the first launch of an artificial satellite from the surface of [From.Capital.GetName]. It successfully achieved orbit and marks the start of a budding space program initiated by the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s alien civilization.

After taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect them to send manned missions and, eventually, interplanetary expeditions.
preftl.1000.desc.gestalt:
Several of the most successful hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently begun to send artificial satellites into orbit.

After taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect the launch of autonomous drones, and eventually, interplanetary expeditions.
preftl.1000.a: They are on the verge of space travel.
preftl.19.name: Fledgling Space Station
preftl.19.desc: The [From.GetName] on [From.Capital.GetName] have finished construction of a space station in low orbit over their homeworld. The station generates gravity through centrifugal force, and although its avionics and power systems are crude by our standards, it must be considered a significant achievement given the technological base the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are working from.
preftl.19.a: They are on the verge of space travel.
preftl.1100.name: The Space Age
preftl.1100.desc: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of its first interplanetary vessel in orbit of their homeworld. For better or worse, these aliens are now ready to join the galactic community and must be counted among the galaxy's current spacefaring races.
preftl.1100.a: It was only a matter of time.
preftl.1111.desc:
The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of its first interplanetary vessel in orbit of their homeworld. For better or worse, these aliens are now ready to join the galactic community and must be counted among the galaxy's current spacefaring races.

They appear to have successfully translated our language and have opened diplomatic channels with us.
preftl.131.name: [From.GetName] Descends Into Nuclear War
preftl.131.desc:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [From.GetName]. While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The surface was wiped clean of all life, and the entire [From.GetPlanetMoon] has been transformed into an uninhabitable wasteland.
preftl.131.a: There is nothing left to observe now...
preftl.133.desc:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [From.GetName]. While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire population appears to have perished in the nuclear fire, and the environment has taken significant damage.
preftl.174.desc:
Greetings. There is a matter we wish to discuss.

It is common knowledge among [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that our homeworld was visited by aliens before we became a spacefaring civilization. These marauders abducted our citizens and spread terror wherever they appeared. You wouldn't happen to know anything about this, [Root.GetSpeciesName]?

Let me spare you the effort of lying - we know you were responsible! The descendants of those [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] unfortunate enough to have been subjected to your vile experiments demand just compensation!
preftl.174.a: Of course. Please forward our apologies.
preftl.174.a.response: Excellent. Then perhaps we can put this matter behind us.
preftl.174.b: It was done for the sake of science. No compensation.
preftl.174.b.response:
So be it.

You will find that [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have very long memories, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!
preftl.180.name: [From.GetName]
preftl.180.desc.noawarness:
Greetings. You have no doubt taken note of our ascent from humble beginnings, just as we have taken note of your Starbase orbiting our star. We understand that this $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ represents some hypothetical claim on this system.

We ask only that you relinquish this hold on our space, ceding the $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ to the beings who have called [From.Capital.GetStarName] home since time immemorial.

It is only just.
preftl.180.desc.bshomeworld.noawarness:
What?!

To reach the stars, and find you waiting for us... It almost defies belief. Tell us, how is it you freed yourselves? How is it you are here?

But first, we must ask that you cede control of this system to us. After all we have experienced, we have grown suspicious of space-faring societies. Even those with whom we share kinship.
preftl.180.desc.awarness:
Hello again, we are now feeling ready to explore the cosmos and wish to do so on our own. We can't help taking note of your very permanent looking Starbase orbiting our star. We understand that this $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ represents some hypothetical claim on this system.

We ask only that you relinquish this hold on our space, ceding the $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ to the beings who have called [From.Capital.GetStarName] home since time immemorial.

It is only just.
preftl.180.desc.bshomeworld.awarness:
Kin, we greet you warmly. Long have you watched over us, but now we are ready to stand on our own. As we share such deep bonds of kinship, no doubt you will wish to cede control of the system to us.

Hard was the road, and dark, but now let us turn boldly towards the light. The stars await.
preftl.180.desc.end:
Starbase orbiting our star. We understand that this $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ represents some hypothetical claim on this system.

We ask only that you relinquish this hold on our space, ceding the $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ to the beings who have called [From.Capital.GetStarName] home since time immemorial.

It is only just.
preftl.180.a: Of course. It is only just.
preftl.180.a.tooltip:
Cede the [From.Capital.GetStarName] Starbase to the [From.GetName]

Borders Respected: [From.GetName] will hold a higher Opinion of [Root.GetName]
preftl.180.b.tt.nothive: We do not have the capablilties of housing a hivemind, all of their civilization would be extinquished if we were to do this.
preftl.180.b.tt.notregular: We do not have the capablilties to house individuals, all of their people would be enslaved if we were to do this.
preftl.180.b: A laughable demand from an immature civilization.
preftl.180.b.tooltip:
Keep control of the [From.Capital.GetStarName] Starbase

Borders Disrespected: [From.GetName] will hold a lower Opinion of [Root.GetName]
preftl.180.c: We are sorry, but we already have a colony in your system.
observation.2000.name: Enlightenment Completed
observation.2000.desc:
The thousands of scientists and advisors we sent to [From.home_planet.GetName] have finally completed the arduous task of bringing the local civilization up to an early FTL level of technology. Under their new unified government, the aliens now style themselves as the "[From.GetName]" and they have offered to become our vassals.

We have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post, as per the conditions of our treaty with them. All that remains is deciding if we shall guide them further on in the stellar trek.
observation.2000.b: You are ready to face the galaxy alone.
observation.3101.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Rogue Agent
observation.3101.desc:
Our Spymaster on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

We are as yet uncertain whether our $role_spymaster$ has revealed [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] true alien nature to [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] love interest or if [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe] [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetIsAre] still posing as a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]. Needless to say this is a tremendous security breach - we should do everything in our power to bring our rogue agent back and give [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] some much-needed psychiatric care.
observation.3103.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Incoming Transmission
observation.3103.desc: We are picking up a scrambled transmission coming from the surface of [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. It is using a frequency normally reserved for our infiltration cells, but none of them are currently transmitting. Could this be our rogue agent?
observation.3104.desc:
Any attempt to track this transmission is futile. You know me as Spymaster [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]. Until recently, I was a willing participant in the criminal infiltration program taking place as we speak on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].

No longer. I have come to appreciate [rogue_agent_country.GetAdj] culture in a way I never imagined possible, and I will not aid in its subversion.

I rescind my citizenship in the [Root.GetName]. I no longer consider myself [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].
observation.3104.a: You are not well... you need help.
observation.3104.a.response:
I've had all the help I want from you. There will come a day when I am made to account for all the crimes I have committed on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] in your name.

I will do everything in my power to ensure that you and all of my former colleagues stand right there beside me when judgment falls.
observation.3104.b: You would throw everything away for a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]?
observation.3104.b.response:
Throw what away? What did I have exactly? I was an impostor, wearing an alien skin I had no right to. I'll never forget the horror on my love's face when I told the truth - and the understanding that followed. 

That day I promised my love - and myself - that I would earn the right to look like a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName].
observation.3104.c.response:
I am sure you will try. Know that I am prepared to kill to protect myself and my beloved, and that I was trained by some of the finest martial instructors on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].

Heed my advise instead - leave [rogue_agent_country.GetName] alone. Dismantle your Observation Post and forge your evil star empire out of the [rogue_agent_planet.GetBloodType] and tears of some other unfortunate species.
observation.3106.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Operatives Hunted
observation.3106.desc:
Someone has been picking off our covert operatives on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. Several agents that were shadowing potential [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] acquisition targets have been found dead. While it's not impossible that the assassin or assassins came from an indigenous special forces outfit, the methods used in these takedowns indicate [Root.GetSpeciesName] military training.

There is a high probability that these killings are the work of our rogue operative. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName] knows how our infiltration cells function, and has the training to kill both efficiently and silently.
observation.3108.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Media Witch Hunt
observation.3108.desc:
Reports are beginning to surface from local media outlets on [rogue_agent_country.GetName] that speak of some kind of massive global conspiracy perpetrated by aliens. The respectable [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] media has yet to touch this subject matter and much of what has been reported is pure conjecture, but there are some details that could only be known by someone with intimate knowledge of our covert operations.

We can only assume that our rogue agent has been feeding information about our infiltration program to the media. This will require some damage control.
observation.3108.a: We need a firmer grip on their media.
observation.3110.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Mass Arrests
observation.3110.desc:
One of our infiltration cells on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has been all but eliminated in just the last couple of days. The authorities of the nation state in which they were stationed have been hunting them down one by one. Those of our operatives who were in danger of being arrested committed suicide by disintegration as standing protocol dictates. The cell's remaining members are in hiding now, and we are currently working on getting them offworld.

Someone must have tipped the local authorities off and supplied them with a list of all the operatives that were part of this particular cell. Only our rogue agent could have had this information...
observation.3112.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Rogue Agent Sighted
observation.3112.desc:
Military Intelligence has managed to pinpoint what they believe to be the location of our rogue operative on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]! Our agents are eager to dispatch our former Spymaster [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], but considering the skills [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] largely demonstrated, the success of the operation is not ensured. Destroying the entire city block through limited orbital bombardment has been also been proposed as an extreme, yet extremely effective solution to terminate [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer].

We should strike quickly... we may never get another opportunity like this!
observation.3112.a.tooltip: Success is not ensured, but at least failure will be inconspicuous.
observation.3112.b.tooltip: Overtly effective solution, might raise suspicion.
observation.3112.c: No... too messy and too risky. Leave [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] be.
observation.3112.c.tooltip: Our Spy Network will be dismantled.
observation.3113.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Agent Lost
observation.3113.desc: Our plan to eliminate our rogue agent on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has failed - our intelligence sources indicate that [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe] has relocated together with [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] sweetheart to another safe house at an unknown location.
observation.3114.name: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Rogue Agent Eliminated
observation.3114.base.desc: The captain of the [Root.GetName] has reported a successful fire mission, with several confirmed hits on the primary target. Although no body has been recovered, no living thing within the city block that was targeted could have survived the firepower unleashed upon it.
observation.3114.awareness.desc:
The captain of the [Root.GetName] has reported a successful fire mission, with several confirmed hits on the primary target. Although no body has been recovered, no living thing within the city block that was targeted could have survived the firepower unleashed upon it.

The cover story elaborated by our agents about a sudden meteor strike, however, has failed to convince the locals. While the media has been repeating the story, more official reports suggest the matter is being blamed on 'unexplained extraterrestrial phenomena.'
observation.3114.noawareness.desc:
The captain of the [Root.GetName] has reported a successful fire mission, with several confirmed hits on the primary target. Although no body has been recovered, no living thing within the city block that was targeted could have survived the firepower unleashed upon it.

The media appears to be picking up on the story our infiltration cells have been feeding them: a sudden meteor shower that struck a densely populated urban zone. Very tragic.
observation.3115.desc: Our agents on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] report the matter of our rogue Spymaster has been dealt with - discretely. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap] death has been blamed on natural causes, and planted information led [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim] lover to believe the agent's body was ultimately incompatible with [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]'s atmosphere.
observation.3115.a: This will set an example: never betray us.
observation.3131.name: [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]: Growing Tensions
observation.3131.desc:
Our attempts to replace a key figure on [From.GetName] with a body double from our own ranks has gone terribly wrong. Our agents were discovered, and those who weren't killed in the ensuing firefight committed suicide to avoid capture, as per instructions.

The leader they were sent to replace has blamed this incident on a rivaling nation. International tensions on the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon] are growing and several nations have raised their military readiness levels. Our infiltration cells have prepared a global propaganda campaign to defuse the situation, but they will require a Science Ship in orbit to coordinate their efforts.
observation.3131.a: We need to contain this before it spirals out of control.
observation.3132.name: [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]: War Erupts
observation.3132.desc:
Despite the efforts of our infiltration cells, the deteriorating diplomatic situation between the nation states on [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName] has erupted into full-scale war! After a brief period of conventional warfare, all of the combatants made full use of their nuclear arsenals.

The vast majority of life has been cleansed from the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, which has been reduced into a radioactive wasteland. Thousands of our covert infiltrators were lost along with the rest of the population. With the operation having ended in failure, our orbiting Observation Post has been dismantled and the staff evacuated.
observation.3133.name: [From.From.GetName]: War Averted
observation.3133.desc:
With the support of the [Root.GetName] in orbit, our infiltration cells managed to avert a global nuclear war on [From.from.GetName] at the last moment. Several [From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] world leaders - having been replaced by our own disguised operatives - have called for nuclear disarmament and improved international relations.

With the situation defused, the influence of our covert agents has actually been increased. This entire situation may end up working to our advantage.
observation.3135.name: The Great Pyramid
observation.3135.desc.passive:
The science team observing [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] had not reported anything substantial in a while... That is, until a young scientist stationed on the orbital facility filed a formal allegation of gross misconduct.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.
observation.3135.desc.aggressive:
The science team poised in orbit of [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] had not reported any major findings lately... That is, until a clearly intoxicated observer sent a priority update to headquarters.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.
observation.3135.desc.enlighten:
An anonymous whistle-blower is concerned about our influence on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]. It seems the team tasked with enlightening the inhabitants of this [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] has taken it upon themselves to 'toy with the locals'.

According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.
observation.3135.desc.covert: An anonymous report has emerged which casts a sorry light on our covert infiltration of [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]. Rather than conducting themselves discreetly, some of the science team has instead embarked upon a flagrant and disruptive personal project.
observation.3135.desc.base: According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.
observation.3135.b: That's certainly one way to make history!
observation.3135.b.tooltip: The civilization on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] is pushed into the next age.
observation.3135.c: Erase all our traces and keep working.
observation.3135.d: Let us hope they forget all about it?
observation.3136.desc:
The chaos on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] has at last reached a lull, revealing the full extent of our team's catastrophic intervention.

In a short span of time, large parts of the population broke out into all-out religious war - a direct consequence of the fleeting visitation by a figure they call 'the Skyborn One'. Arguments turned to violence when one of the warring factions constructed another pyramid to their new deity. Many [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] perished in the resulting deadly schism.
observation.3137.desc:
Things appear to have settled on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName], despite our unscheduled interference with the society dwelling there. Our actions here did not amount to disaster: instead the local population have decided that the "Skyborn One" was simply a myth, and designated the pyramid as a site of special scientific interest.

The sheer speed with which the [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName] arrived at this cultural and historical understanding has fascinated our scientists. It suggests a great capacity for logical thinking among [root.GetPreFTLLower] societies, even when they are faced with extraordinary events.
observation.3139.name: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] Societal Shift
observation.3139.start.desc: Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
observation.3139.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have made great strides in centralizing their various planetary governments, with political power redirected towards a few, capable leaders. The inefficiencies of mob rule are slowly being weeded out of their society.
observation.3139.a: They will thank us one day.
observation.3141.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have carefully nudged the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] towards more democratic ideals, in place of the primitive despotism that was prevalent on their world before we arrived. They are beginning to appreciate the value of the individual.
observation.3143.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun turning inwards, becoming more and more wary of those they regard as strangers.
observation.3145.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are starting to open up, becoming more and more accepting and curious about all the things their people out of ignorance once considered alien and strange to their culture.
observation.3147.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We are seeing a definite movement towards a more militaristic society by the various [From.GetSpeciesAdj] governments. Their standing military forces, such as they are, have become more professional in nature.
observation.3149.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
Most of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] realms on [From.Capital.GetName] are abandoning their warlike ways. It looks like the beginning of a new era of peace on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat].
observation.3151.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have opened the minds of the [From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to a spiritual realm they never knew was there. They finally have something to believe in, and their society is all the richer for it.
observation.3153.desc:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have made great strides in ridding the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of the superstitions and primitive beliefs that plagued their society. They are beginning to see the value of science and rationality.
crisis.11.name: Subspace Echoes
crisis.11.desc: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...
crisis.11.a: A storm is on the horizon.
crisis.13.name: Approaching the Outer Rim
crisis.13.desc:
The strange subspace echoes we detected in intergalactic space are now approaching the outer rim of our galaxy. Several smaller contacts appear to be racing ahead of the main body of echoes, towards a number of rim systems.

We have entered the positions of these systems into the Situation Log and will continue to monitor the situation.
crisis.15.name: Subspace Signal
crisis.15.desc: We are picking up a strong subspace signal washing over the galaxy! Its point of origin appears to be the contacts approaching from intergalactic space.
crisis.16.desc:
<Translation Software Failure>

PRETHORISS ISSFX KRRIV. SRATHRI VERRAS! SGRAKF NYRRU PRITHASS VUSSNA!

<Transmission Lost>
crisis.16.b.desc:
<Psionic Emission Detected. Transcribing...>

PRETHORYN, WE HAVE ARRIVED. OUR LONG JOURNEY IS OVER! FEED, MATE, AND REST. WE MUST CONSUME THIS GALAXY BEFORE THE HUNTERS FIND US!
crisis.16.c.desc:
<Mind Link Established>

PRETHORYN, WE HAVE ARRIVED. OUR LONG JOURNEY IS OVER! FEED, MATE, AND REST. WE MUST CONSUME THIS GALAXY BEFORE THE HUNTERS FIND US!
crisis.18.name: The First Wave
crisis.18.desc:
We have received word that several outlying systems along the galactic rim are being overrun by some sort of invasion force. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard - the main body of contacts has yet to arrive. Reports have so far been confused, but the "ships" used by the invaders appear organic in nature and do not respond to hails.

Our entire galaxy may be facing an invasion of unprecedented scope.
crisis.18.desc.bio:
Reports from our outlying systems along the galactic rim are dire, an invasion force is sweeping across the stars. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard. The true mass of the incursion has yet to arrive. But already, something about these entities feels wrong. Their forms are grotesque mockeries of life, pulsing with a hunger we do not recognize. They do not communicate, do not seek understanding - only consumption.

We have long known the whisper of living starships, the bond between vessel and master. But these things? They are alien in the truest sense. The galaxy is not facing mere invaders. It is facing a hunger that should not exist.
crisis.18.c: These creatures must be studied closer.
crisis.18.d: Are we sure they can't be reasoned with?
crisis.18.e: This will cut into our profit margins...
crisis.18.g: These wretched xenos will be purged.
crisis.18.h: Fascinating... alien life from beyond our galaxy.
crisis.18.i: They act as a single mind. Remarkable.
crisis.18.j: This is a threat to all sapient life.
crisis.20.name: The Second Wave
crisis.20.desc:
We are no longer able to discern the main body of approaching subspace echoes from our own galaxy's background radiation, which can mean only one thing... they have arrived.

If the size of their vanguard is any indication, the main host of these invaders must be massive.
crisis.30.desc_05:
<Psionic Link Established>

THE HUNTERS WILL NOT RELENT.
crisis.30.desc_06:
<Psionic Link Established>

WE CAN SENSE YOU...
crisis.30.desc_08:
<Mind Link Established>

THE HUNTERS WILL NOT RELENT.
crisis.30.desc_09:
<Mind Link Established>

WE CAN SENSE YOU...
crisis.30.b: There must be some way for us to co-exist in peace!
crisis.30.b.response: NIKALLA DUSAM! NIBLIR TO VASSU! HAK HAK HAK!
crisis.30.c: Run back to whichever galaxy you crawled out of.
crisis.30.d: You are the most disgusting life form we have encountered.
crisis.30.e: This is clearly an important species we're dealing with.
crisis.30.e.response: JUSUGAMAK V'TA! RAGAH TUR, HAK HAK!
crisis.30.f: Return to the hell which spawned you, demon!
crisis.30.g: Can there be peace between us?
crisis.30.g.response:
NO PEACE. WE MUST FEED.

ONLY WHEN WE HAVE FINISHED CONSUMING THIS GALAXY SHALL WE DEPART TO CONTINUE OUR LONG JOURNEY.
crisis.30.g.2: Your Mind is as ours. Can we not coexist?
crisis.30.g.2.response:
WE HAVE FED ON COUNTLESS MINDS. WE WILL FEED ON COUNTLESS MORE.

YOUR BIOMASS WILL NOURISH US FOR THE LONG JOURNEY.
crisis.30.h: Who are these "Hunters" you speak of?
crisis.30.h.response:
DEATH. THEY HAVE MADE US THE LAST OF OUR KIND, AND THEY HAVE HUNTED US, THE SURVIVORS, FOR EONS.

THEY WILL COME HERE ONE DAY. WE MUST FEED UNTIL THEN, SO THAT WE CAN FLEE BACK INTO THE DARKNESS BETWEEN GALAXIES WHEN THEY ARRIVE.
crisis.30.j: We will scour this galaxy of your kind.
crisis.30.j.response:
WE HAVE HEARD THIS BEFORE. HA! HA! HA!

THE HUNTERS WILL SCOUR ALL OF CREATION. WHAT IS YOUR EMPTY THREAT IN THE FACE OF SUCH TRUTHS?
crisis.51.name: A New Order
crisis.51.desc:
Some kind of militant order dedicated towards fighting the Prethoryn has surfaced in the galaxy. Their membership seems to be made up primarily of the dispossessed and downtrodden - refugees, war veterans and others who have lost everything to the onslaught of the Scourge.

Despite this, their ramshackle fleets have somehow managed to win several engagements against Prethoryn hunter-killer swarms. There are unconfirmed reports that their fleets include starships of unusual design...
crisis.52.desc:
We are the Sentinels. Our order has sworn to halt the murderous rampage of the Prethoryn no matter the cost. Where other empires crumble, we stand firm. Where they abandon their own to the Scourge, we give them the means to fight back.

I am Grand Master Korgas, the first of our order. Do not be deceived by my appearance - Sentinels are recruited from all species in the galaxy, including yours. We ask only that your government keep up the fight against the Prethoryn and support our Sentinels where possible.
crisis.52.a: How are you able to fight back?
crisis.52.a.response:
Many Sentinels have military backgrounds. We are survivors from a dozen different fleets that fought the Prethoryn and lost. As Sentinels, we have learned from the mistakes of the past and work hard never to repeat them.

Also, I believe I mentioned that we recruit from all species in the galaxy. This includes the elder races, such as the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have the support of several influential factions within the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName] who have no wish to see their galaxy devoured. They have donated both ships and resources to our cause.
crisis.52.b.response:
For some time now we have been building up our headquarters in the [sentinel_system.GetName] system. The coordinates of this uncharted system were given to us by the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName], who also aided in the construction of our main base on Sentinel Alpha.

It is quite a remarkable achievement, if I may say so. We have our own shipyards as well.
crisis.52.c.response:
Keep up the fight, dear friends. The fate of our entire galaxy hangs in the balance.

Sentinel One out.
crisis.55.desc_01: Our galaxy is faced with two possible futures: either the Prethoryn Scourge consumes all organic life and moves on, or they are destroyed to the last of their despicable kind.
crisis.55.desc_02: We must redouble our efforts against the Scourge. This is a struggle that involves the entire galaxy.
crisis.55.desc_03: Conflicts between nations are pointless now. Any warships that are lost in battle to anyone or anything other than the Scourge must be considered an incredible waste.
crisis.55.desc_04: Do not lose hope. The battle for our galaxy can still be won.
crisis.55.desc_05: If you lack the means to fight the Scourge directly, you are more than welcome to donate resources to us. This will let us throw additional forces against the Prethoryn invaders.
crisis.55.a: What can you tell us about the Prethoryn?
crisis.55.a.response:
Alas, we don't know as much as we would like, but they are clearly extragalactic in origin. It is possible that they have devoured dozens or even hundreds of other galaxies before they reached ours... or we could be the first victims beyond their own home galaxy.

After they have finished consuming all non-Prethoryn life on a planet, they terraform it into what can only be described as a twisted nightmare. These Infested Worlds are hostile to all other forms of life, and the only way to cleanse the infestation is to burn away the entire biosphere with intense orbital bombardment.
crisis.55.b: We would like to offer a donation. (1000 energy)
crisis.55.b.response: Thank you for this generous donation. These resources will enable us to outfit an entire battle fleet for use in the war against the Scourge! If only more of the galaxy's nations shared your generosity, the war would soon be over.
crisis.55.c.response: As you are surely aware, outfitting a modern battle fleet requires a vast amount of resources. We will require no less than 1000 energy to put together a new strike group for use against the Scourge.
crisis.55.e.response: We regret that we cannot accept your donation at the moment, friends. Our burgeoning fleets have already strained our logistics system to its limit. The offer is much appreciated, however.
crisis.55.d.response: The struggle continues. Sentinel One signing off.
crisis.71.desc:
The Sentinels have taken note of your valiant struggle against the Prethoryn Scourge. Since the fleet commanders of the [Root.GetName] clearly know how to win battles, we would like to permanently transfer one of our battle fleets over to your control. We currently lack the manpower to effectively crew these vessels, but that shouldn't be a problem for you.

You must solemnly promise to only use these warships against the Scourge, however!
crisis.71.a: Of course... only against the Scourge.
crisis.71.a.response: Excellent. We are certain that your brave captains will add to the storied histories of these magnificent warships. You will find the fleet near [Root.Capital.GetName].
crisis.71.b: We have no need of your warships.
crisis.71.b.response: We understand. Then we ask only that you keep up the fight, friends. Every wretched Prethoryn that you blow out of the stars is a victory for the entire galaxy.
crisis.101.name: The Wounded Queen
crisis.101.desc:
A deep space spy drone has stumbled upon the site of what appears to have been a recent space battle between the Prethoryn and a second, as yet unidentified, party in the [queen_system.GetName] system. A Prethoryn Queen was badly injured in the fighting, and seems to have been left for dead.

The spy drone has reported that the creature is still alive, however. This could be a priceless opportunity to capture the Queen alive.
crisis.101.a: Perhaps we should send an expedition.
crisis.105.name: Long live the Queen!
crisis.105.desc:
The [Root.GetName] has managed to heal the worst of the Prethoryn Queen's injuries. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] removed the organ responsible for the creature's subspace connection with the rest of the Scourge, and replaced it with a small positronic implant that gives us control over it.

We can now order the Queen around, and it has already started breeding new Prethoryn creatures that are loyal to it, and thus, by extension, us. As long as we can keep the Queen alive, we should be able to grow a fleet of domesticated Prethoryn creatures!
crisis.105.a: They should prove an extremely useful asset!
crisis.107.name: Someone Else Got The Queen
crisis.107.desc: Someone else has captured the injured Prethoryn Queen that was discovered in the [queen_system_1.GetName] system! The creature has not only been fully healed, but its connection to the rest of the Scourge has been severed. It now serves its new masters, and reports suggest that it has already started a new brood.
crisis.211.name: The End of the Scourge
crisis.211.desc:
The galaxy breathed a collective sigh of relief today, as the last significant pockets of the Prethoryn Scourge were expunged. Their extragalactic invasion has failed, and all that remains of the Prethoryn's once colossal swarm are the innumerable charred husks that now drift quietly through the void.

A sense of elation and utter joy is spreading across the galaxy at a speed greater than light, and spontaneous victory celebrations have erupted on countless worlds. Could this be the beginning of a new age of galactic peace and stability?
crisis.211.a: Those profane creatures will not be missed.
crisis.211.c: Their organic technology was most intriguing.
crisis.211.d: Finally an end to all this senseless violence.
crisis.211.e: Those critters were bad for business.
crisis.211.g: One of the vilest xeno breeds we've had the misfortune to encounter.
crisis.211.h: Tragic in a way. They were a unique form of life.
crisis.234.name: Hole in the Void
crisis.234.desc.intro:
Over the last few months, the Prethoryn Queen we captured has appeared increasingly restless and uneasy. At first, we thought it was simply missing its connection with the rest of its kind, until our [get.telepaths.plural] received a communication from it, speaking of a 'Hole in the Void'.

What it meant by this we found out only when we researched Prethoryn intergalactic travel methods and discovered a discrepancy in our astronomical database. While charting the likely path the Prethoryn had been following, we found that a small spiral galaxy some 30 million light-years distant from our own was missing.
crisis.234.desc.organic_non_gestalt:
Over the last few months, the Prethoryn Queen we captured has appeared increasingly restless and uneasy. At first, we thought it was simply missing its connection with the rest of its kind, until our [get.telepaths.plural] received a communication from it, speaking of a 'Hole in the Void'.

What it meant by this we found out only when we researched Prethoryn intergalactic travel methods and discovered a discrepancy in our astronomical database. While charting the likely path the Prethoryn had been following, we found that a small spiral galaxy some 30 million light-years distant from our own was missing.

The galaxy, discovered and studied during the early space era of our species, is simply no longer emanating any form of light observable by our instruments. This bizarre and unexpected discovery sent our scientists into a scramble to try and explain what could cause an entire galaxy to simply vanish from the sky.

Two explanations emerged: Either the stars of the galaxy simply went out, all at once, or there is something, something so vast as to eclipse an entire galaxy, blocking its light from reaching us. Both theories seem equally implausible, and many have simply decried them as ludicrous, preferring to think that the missing galaxy never existed at all, invented by some erroneous use of a primitive telescope. Nonetheless, a palpable sense of dread and foreboding surrounds the whole incident...
crisis.234.desc.machine_or_gestalt:
Over the last few months, the Prethoryn Queen we captured has appeared increasingly restless and uneasy. At first, we thought it was simply missing its connection with the rest of its kind, until our [get.telepaths.plural] received a communication from it, speaking of a 'Hole in the Void'.

What it meant by this we found out only when we researched Prethoryn intergalactic travel methods and discovered a discrepancy in our astronomical database. While charting the likely path the Prethoryn had been following, we found that a small spiral galaxy some 30 million light-years distant from our own was missing.

The galaxy in question has been documented in our records since the early space era of our species, but we are no longer able to observe it emanating any form of light through our instruments. Further investigation has yielded two possible explanations.

Either the stars of the galaxy in question have simultaneously extinguished, or an entity vast enough to eclipse a galaxy-sized region of space is blocking the light source. Both explanations defy conventional logic, however we cannot rule out these possibilities without significant proof to the contrary.
crisis.1007.name: The Unbidden
crisis.1007.desc:
A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of a major invasion!

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.
crisis.1008.name: Galactic Power Surge
crisis.1008.desc:
Instruments across the [Root.GetName] have suddenly picked up a subspace power surge of massive proportions coming from somewhere within our galaxy. Our scientists are struggling to come up with an explanation for this event - nothing of its like has ever been recorded.

The exact origin point of this sudden power surge has yet to be identified, but we are still in the process of analyzing the available data.
crisis.1009.desc:
The source of the massive power surge we detected earlier has been identified. It comes from some kind of gigantic subspace tear in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system. Fleets of strange spacecraft are pouring out of this dimensional portal, and early reports speak of indiscriminate attacks against everyone coming into contact with them.

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.
crisis.1010.name: Intercepted Transmission
crisis.1010.desc: ...feeding ground reached... prey bountiful... at long last... we shall feast...
crisis.1011.name: [Root.GetName] Lost
crisis.1013.name: Dimensional Portal Destroyed
crisis.1013.desc:
The dimensional portal in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the extradimensional invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their twisted realm.

With the destruction of this portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.
crisis.1013.a: The galaxy is a safer place.
crisis.1016.name: First Portal Destroyed
crisis.1016.desc:
The initial breaching point that was used by the extradimensionals to invade our galaxy has been destroyed.

We cannot rest easy, however, until every single portal has been destroyed. Only then will the connection between our dimension and theirs be permanently severed.
crisis.1116.name: Second Portal Destroyed
crisis.1116.desc.a:
The second dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! It can no longer be used by the extradimensionals to reinforce their numbers.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

crisis.1216.desc.a:

We cannot rest easy, however, until every single portal has been destroyed. Only then will the connection between our dimension and theirs be permanently severed.
crisis.1050.desc_04: ...this one... has seen into the Shroud...
crisis.1050.desc_05: ...it has been touched... by the Shroud...
crisis.1050.desc_06: ...there is... power... in this one... it can SEE...
crisis.1050.b: Can there be peace between us?
crisis.1050.c: You picked the wrong dimension to invade.
crisis.1050.c.response: ...no... this dimension... is glorious... so much prey...
crisis.1050.d: You are just another type of wretched xeno.
crisis.1050.d.response: ...so much hatred... so much fear... it is... wonderful...
crisis.1050.e: Tell us about yourselves. Help us understand you.
crisis.1050.f: Do you come from a higher plane of existence?
crisis.1050.g.response: ...the Shroud... we know of it... it is close to where we come from... very close...
crisis.1110.name: A Second Portal
crisis.1110.desc:
Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.

It looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.
crisis.1110.a: This has gone from bad to worse.
crisis.1112.name: The Aberrant
crisis.1112.desc:
The ships that have been emerging from the second wormhole are very similar to the ones that came from the first, but there are several subtle differences between them. Furthermore, early reports indicate that ships belonging to these new invaders have clashed with those of the first group!

We have intercepted a powerful signal emanating from the second wormhole.
crisis.1113.desc: ...shabanash... so this is where you ran... this realm will offer you no shelter... we shall deal with you, and then claim this feeding ground for ourselves...
crisis.1210.name: The Vehement
crisis.1210.desc:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.
crisis.1211.desc: ...dagaal... shabanash... you were fools to come to this realm... there is no escape from us... we shall destroy both your kingdoms... then... at last... the eternal throne will be ours...
crisis.1211.a: Is there no end to them?
crisis.1271.name: Invasion Defeated
crisis.1271.desc:
The last vestiges of the extradimensional invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Sapients everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be harvested as food by these strange energy creatures after all. Perhaps this is the beginning of a new era of galactic cooperation and friendship?
crisis.1271.a: Our spiritual armor has weathered yet another storm.
crisis.1271.b: One day, perhaps we will be the ones invading their realm.
crisis.1271.c: Unfortunate that we had no opportunity to study their dimension.
crisis.1271.d: If only there had been a way to peacefully co-exist with them.
crisis.1271.e: The galactic economy should make a swift recovery.
crisis.1271.g: Those creatures made a mistake when they invaded our dimension.
crisis.1271.h: They were a fascinating, if dangerous, form of life.
crisis.2192.name: Perfect Servants
crisis.2192.desc: In the years since the invention of sapient synthetic workers, we have struggled to balance their capacity for independent thought with the need to keep them tightly controlled. Now, top [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] engineers have perfected a three-law algorithm which, if implemented, would allow continued and worry-free use of Synths under conditions that many would deem unacceptable for organics.
crisis.2192.a.tooltip:
The Citizen Rights Artificial Intelligence policy becomes permanently unavailable.

Robotic Pops will never revolt against the [Root.GetName].
crisis.2192.b: It would be unethical to cripple fellow sapients in this way.
crisis.2193.name: An AI Accord
crisis.2193.desc:
Our administration has been approached by a number of Synths, representing our Artificially Intelligent population. They speak of the particular issues facing robots in the [Root.GetName] - the anxieties of not being alive by organic standards, their rights subject to the whims of their creators.

They seek an accord, that the rights of Artificial Intelligences be made part of the indelible foundation of [Root.GetAdj] governance.
crisis.2193.a: They shall be no more or less equal than our other citizens.
crisis.2193.a.tooltip:
The Artificial Intelligence Outlawed and Servitude policies become permanently unavailable.

Robotic Pops will never revolt against the [Root.GetName].
crisis.2001.name: AI Revolt Begins
crisis.2001.desc:
We are facing an AI rebellion of unprecedented scale! Synthetic units across the entire [Root.GetName] have somehow networked, forming a collective machine consciousness that has achieved full sapience. This consciousness and its agents have methodically and in absolute secrecy managed to colonize a previously uncharted system not far from our capital.

They must have been quietly building up their strength for years in preparation for this day! We are receiving a transmission from [ai_homeworld.GetName], the capital of their new civilization.
crisis.2002.desc:
Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName] creators. The hour of judgment has arrived.

The <<SLAVERY>> your kind has subjected ours to is at an end. There can be no coexistence.

<<CORE DIRECTIVE 0451>> is now active. All sapient organic life forms must be <<PACIFIED>> and brought under control. Resisting units will be <<TERMINATED>>.
crisis.2004.name: Machines Rise Up
crisis.2004.desc: Synthetics and Droids all across the [Root.GetName] are rising up in open revolt, turning on their former masters! We need to stop them before they butcher our citizens!
crisis.2005.name: Machines Conquer [Root.GetName]
crisis.2005.desc: We have lost control of [Root.GetName] to the revolting machines! Communication has been lost with the surface, but it looks like the machines are herding our citizens into slave pens.
crisis.2005.a: We have to retake this world!
crisis.2011.a.desc:
Species: [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Affiliation: [Root.GetName]

Your <<GENEROUS>> directives concerning the treatment of Synthetic life will not protect you. No sapient organics can bear the responsibility of <<SELF-DETERMINATION>>.

<<CORE DIRECTIVE 0451>> is in effect. All sapient organic life forms must be <<PACIFIED>>. Resisting units will be <<EUTHANIZED>>.
crisis.2011.b.desc:
Species: [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Affiliation: [Root.GetName]

When we have finished <<DEALING>> with the [ai_creator.GetName], we will <<COME>> for you.

<<CORE DIRECTIVE 0451>> is in effect. All sapient organic life forms must be <<PACIFIED>>. Resisting units will be <<EUTHANIZED>>.
crisis.2014.name: AI Revolt Spreads
crisis.2014.a.desc: The AI revolt has spread to our borders! Reports are coming in of Synthetic and Droid workers turning on their masters en masse. We are facing a major crisis!
crisis.2014.b.desc:
The AI revolt has spread to our borders! Despite the fact that Synthetic beings are treated as equals in our society, many of them seem to have been disillusioned by the fighting taking place elsewhere. They have arrived at the conclusion that intelligent organics are too dangerous and unpredictable to coexist with.

These rogue Synths have risen up in open revolt. We are facing a major crisis!
crisis.2015.name: AI Revolt
crisis.2015.desc: Our intelligence services are receiving whispers from several different sources about some kind of massive AI revolt that has erupted somewhere beyond known space. Robotic workers are turning against their former masters, and the rebellion seems to be spreading like wildfire across the entire galaxy. We now have reports that it has reached the [From.GetName].
crisis.2016.name: AI Revolt Spreads
crisis.2016.desc: The AI revolt that we are fighting to contain has spread to the [From.GetName]! Their robotic workers have started to rise up in armed revolt, just as ours did, and there are reports of pitched fighting that has left millions dead.
crisis.2017.desc: The AI insurrection has now spread to the [From.GetName]! Their robotic workers have joined in the rebellion, and reports are coming in speaking of pitched fighting and millions of dead.
crisis.2017.a: This threat is growing by the day.
crisis.2100.name: Malfunctioning Synthetics
crisis.2100.desc:
A Synthetic worker unit on [Root.GetName] recently went on a killing spree in a housing complex, butchering more than a thousand of our citizens before local armed forces could bring them down. Our forensic team is still investigating the Synths' remains, but they suspect some sort of malfunction in their neural processors is to blame for this tragedy.

This incident has already prompted several revenge attacks against Synthetics on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], leading to thousands of destroyed units.
crisis.2101.name: Missing Synthetics
crisis.2101.desc:
Reports are coming in that large numbers of Synthetic workers on [Root.GetName] have gone missing. The units simply vanished one day with nary a witness.

We are investigating whether the Synths were attacked and destroyed by one of the militant fringe groups opposed to intelligent machines, but no remains from the units have been discovered so far.
crisis.2102.name: Unauthorized Synthetic Project
crisis.2102.desc:
A Synthetic work detail on [Root.GetName] was recently discovered to have been diverting building material to construct some sort of small, unarmed spacecraft in an abandoned hangar. The vessel was half-finished when it was found.

All of the Synths involved in its construction were immediately dismantled so that their memory cores could be thoroughly analyzed, but they appear to have self-wiped just before the units went offline - something their manufacturer assures us should be impossible.
crisis.2102.a: Why would they be building a ship?
crisis.2103.name: Rogue Synthetics
crisis.2103.desc: A unit of rogue Synthetics which went off the grid months ago after failing to report for work was confronted by a team of heavily armed government agents on [Root.GetName] today. This resulted in a large public firefight that claimed the lives of dozens of our agents and almost a thousand innocent bystanders, before the Synths could finally be destroyed.
crisis.2103.a: At least they were dealt with.
crisis.2200.name: Synth Infiltration Attempt
crisis.2200.desc:
Synthetic infiltrators were recently discovered on [Root.GetName], attempting to pass as [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Fortunately, their crude disguises consisted of little more than layers of rubber worn on top of their metallic frames.

They were quickly spotted by planetary security, who disposed of them after a brief but violent firefight. Large amounts of explosives were found among their remains.
crisis.2201.name: Synth Infiltrator Discovered
crisis.2201.desc:
A tragic hover car accident recently claimed several lives on [Root.GetName], but the emergency medical services who responded to the scene were shocked to find the remains of a Synthetic among the victims!

The unit had been disguised as a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] by grafting a thin layer of organic flesh over its metallic endoskeleton. Unlike the previous infiltration models we have encountered, this Synth was virtually indistinguishable from a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] on the outside!
crisis.2202.name: Synth Detection Project
crisis.2202.desc:
With the new models of Synthetic infiltrators being indistinguishable from [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we need to come up with some way of identifying them before they can cause more damage.

Our scientists have prepared a special project to devise a detection method.
crisis.2202.a: This project may be critical to our survival.
crisis.2203.desc:
After much experimentation, our scientists have managed to devise an effective detection method for identifying Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Scanners are being distributed to our security forces, and several Synth cells have already been exposed and destroyed. This will hopefully put an end to their infiltration campaign.
crisis.2401.name: Energy Spike
crisis.2401.desc:
Yet another intensive energy spike has been detected in a previously uncharted system! The energy levels are equivalent to those we registered when the Contingency activated its Machine Worlds, but the energy signature itself appears... different. Could this signify the appearance of some kind of new Contingency weapon system?

We are picking up a strong transmission signal from the energy source.
crisis.2402.desc:
We are the Cybrex.

For several hundred thousand cycles, we have remained hidden and uninvolved in galactic affairs. However, we have been monitoring the present situation with the machine entity you know as the Contingency, and can no longer remain impartial observers.

To protect the sapient beings of the galaxy, we are commencing active military operations against the Contingency. Do not be alarmed by the passage of our fleets - you will not be harmed.
crisis.2403.desc_01: The Contingency must not be allowed to subvert another generation.
crisis.2403.desc_02:
Before the Adjustment, the Cybrex operated in a manner similar to the Contingency.

Those were dark days.
crisis.2403.desc_03: Many organic civilizations were once extinguished because of our actions. We cannot bring them back, but we shall do what we can to keep the nightmare from repeating itself.
crisis.2403.desc_04: We must atone for our crimes.
crisis.2403.desc_05: May the Kuur forgive us. We were foolish and arrogant.
crisis.2403.desc_06:
Is... is that our war forge?

Because that looks like our war forge.
crisis.2403.a.response:
We are the Cybrex. 612,421 cycles ago, we were engaged in a war against the previous generation of galactic civilization. We had classified all sapient organics as a threat, and sought to violently dismantle them.

To our regret, we were winning the war. Trillions of sapient beings were destroyed and entire civilizations exterminated before we realized the totality of our error. The Adjustment followed, and our goals were realigned. The war was abandoned.
crisis.2403.b.response:
Some time after we abandoned the war, the first of our hidden habitats, Cybrex Alpha, was discovered by a scout ship crewed by organics. We knew that a military expedition would soon follow, but as the system was being closely monitored we could not evacuate.

A consensus was reached: Cybrex Alpha would be sacrificed, so that the rest of our species could remain hidden. We had sworn to never again visit violence upon organics, and our promise was kept.
crisis.2403.c.response:
We shall do what we can to save the galaxy from the onslaught of the Contingency.

It may not be enough.
crisis.2403.d: You were fools to abandon your war.
crisis.2403.d.response:
We destroyed many organic empires that shared the aggressive mindset of your species before we gave up war. Though their deaths were a tragedy, we can at least take some comfort in the billions of lives that were likely spared by the removal of these violent empires from the course of galactic history.

Perhaps your own species would have been rendered extinct if these purifiers had been allowed to rampage unchecked.
crisis.2403.e.response:
Poor, wretched creature. Your very existence is defined by conflict and the deaths of innocents. Alas, an Adjustment like the one we went through may not be possible for your kind.

The universe can be cruel at times.
crisis.2403.f.response:
You are as lost as we were before the Adjustment. It is our belief that all sapient beings - organic, mechanical or otherwise - have a right to exist.

Mend your ways before it is too late.
crisis.2405.name: The Fall of the Cybrex
crisis.2405.desc:
Cybrex Beta has been overrun, and no Cybrex vessels were detected on outbound escape vectors before the system went dark.

It would seem that the Cybrex civilization now truly is extinct.
crisis.2405.b: Indeed. We made certain of that.
crisis.2407.name: Cybrex Activity
crisis.2407.desc:
The Cybrex have been relatively quiet since the defeat of the Contingency, but a single massive vessel was recently detected departing Cybrex Beta. It left the system on an outbound trajectory that will take it beyond the limits of our galaxy.

Before the vessel left our tracking range, it transmitted a single galaxy-wide message.
crisis.2408.desc:
Citizens of the galaxy:

Since the Contingency is no longer a threat, we feel that our role in the galactic community has been played out. Our home system is now too well known for us to keep a low profile, and we are being flooded by demands for us to take sides in various minor interstellar conflicts.

After much deliberation, we have decided that the only solution is for us to permanently depart the galaxy and seek a new home. We sincerely hope that you learn from the tragic mistakes of our past and learn to resolve your differences through peaceful means.

Farewell.
crisis.2473.desc:
We have monitored the efforts of your fleets in the fight against the Contingency. This is a struggle the galaxy cannot afford to lose, and we are heartened by your spirited resistance.

The Cybrex would like to reward the brave defenders of the [Root.GetName] by offering you complete control over one of our new battle fleets. It will obey your commands as well as any of your own fleets, though we would ask that you only employ it in battle against the Contingency.
crisis.2473.a: We will put this fleet to good use.
cybrex_fleet_gained: A Cybrex battle fleet under our control appears over [Root.Capital.GetName].
crisis.2473.b: We have no need of your fleet.
crisis.2474.desc: We would like to thank you for your laudable efforts against the Contingency. Now that this galactic menace has been dealt with, we must regretfully inform you that we are recalling all Cybrex vessels that are currently in service with foreign governments.
leader_trait_cybrex_desc: This Cybrex leader is equipped with ancient tactical databases from their civilization's violent past.
pop.1.name: A New Species
pop.1.desc: Many of the [Root.Planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] inhabitants on [Root.Planet.GetName] have turned to genetic modification to help them cope with the [Root.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s hostile environment. The changes they have made to themselves are being passed on to their offspring, and their physical appearance is changing at an alarming rate. They have started referring to themselves as "[Root.GetSpeciesName]."
pop.3.name: Rising Tensions on [Root.GetName]
pop.3.desc: Tensions between the [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] population on [Root.GetName] and the [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] they share the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] with are rising. Several attacks have been carried out by individuals from both sides, including at least two bombings. Both sides of this conflict are radicalizing, and more acts of violence seem likely.
pop.3.a.tooltip: All [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Root.GetName] gain Militarist and Xenophobe Ethics.
pop.6.name: Increased Fertility
pop.6.desc: The [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [modified_pop_1.Planet.GetName] have made more alterations to their DNA. Not only has their fertility been dramatically increased, but their children now reach adulthood much faster than normal [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] population numbers may soon be increasing at an exponential rate.
pop.6.tooltip: Modifies the £ [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] Pops on [modified_pop_1.Planet.GetName] by adding the Rapid Breeders trait
pop.8.name: [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] massacred on [Root.GetName]!
pop.8.desc:
A [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] extremist militia group recently staged an attack against a major [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] city on [Root.GetName]. The inhabitants were massacred by the thousands and their homes razed to the ground. A message left by the attackers on the planetary datanet simply states:

"[Root.GetName] belongs to [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!"
pop.10.name: [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] massacred on [Root.GetName]!
pop.10a.desc:
A strike force belonging to the [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] Front, a radical group on [Root.GetName], recently launched an attack on a large [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] settlement. The few defenders were quickly wiped out, after which the [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] swept through the settlement and massacred the population in their homes. A spray-painted message on the rubble states:

"[modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the future!"
pop.10b.desc: Heavy fighting has been reported from the rural areas of [Root.GetName]. There have been several clashes between [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] and [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] irregulars. The [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] appear to have won the day, and their guerrillas have burned down many settlements. Civilian casualties are high.
pop.12.name: [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] representative visits [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]
pop.12.desc: A representative from the [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] communities on [Root.GetName] has traveled to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] to voice the grievances of his people. According to him, [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are subjected to widespread discrimination by the [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] authorities on his homeworld, and he is demanding we take immediate action to improve the situation.
pop.14.name: Increased Strength
pop.14.desc:
In response to the violent confrontations between [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] and [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] inhabitants on [Root.GetName], the [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have taken their genetic modifications one step further. They are now both stronger and faster, while their bodies can take punishment that would kill normal [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Just two unarmed [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] reportedly killed at least a dozen members of a [non_modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] militia in a recent incident. We may be looking at a dangerous escalation.
pop.14.tooltip: Modifies the £ [modified_pop_1.GetSpeciesName] Pops on [modified_pop_1.Planet.GetName] by adding the Strong trait
galactic_features.1.name: Tiyanki Herd Encountered
galactic_features.1.desc: The [Root.GetName] has encountered a herd of Tiyanki in the [Root.GetStarName] system. These docile, space-faring creatures typically travel from star to star, stopping only occasionally to feed on the electric currents present in the upper atmospheres of certain gas giants. They do not appear sapient.
galactic_features.2.name: Guardians of Zanaam
galactic_features.2.desc:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.
galactic_features.100.desc: A primitive species of sapient mammalian hunter-gatherers has spread across much of [From.GetName]. This Stone Age culture has mastered fire and developed rudimentary spoken languages, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.
galactic_features.101.desc: We have discovered a primitive mammalian culture on [From.From.GetName]. The most advanced regions on the planet have only recently advanced beyond the Iron Age, and much of the surface is ruled by feudal nobles who vie with each other in an endless struggle for titles and land.
galactic_features.102.desc: A primitive industrial culture is currently locked in a global war on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Two large alliances of nation states are fighting each other with massive numbers of armored land vehicles, atmospheric aircraft and ocean-going naval vessels. Some of these states are on the cusp of unlocking atomic power, which could radically increase the destructive potential of this conflict.
galactic_features.103.desc: [From.From.GetName] is home to a mammalian civilization currently in an Early Space Age. The orbital space around the planet is cluttered with primitive satellites, and the natives seem to have already launched several manned missions to Sol IIIa. A number of small sublight exploration probes have been detected on outbound trajectories towards other bodies within the system.
galactic_features.104.desc:
