The surface of [From.From.From.GetName] has been ravaged by nuclear war, and the planet is little more than a tomb. Withered concrete skeletons jut out of the ground where major population centers once stood, and the howling wind is all that can be heard on the desolate, ash-covered surface.

A local species of insect seems to be thriving in the irradiated environment. Mutated specimens have increased dramatically in size, and some communities are displaying signs of rudimentary intelligence.
galactic_features.150.name: Cloud Entity Encountered
galactic_features.150.desc: We have encountered some kind of living cloud entity in the [Root.GetStarName] system. The [Root.GetName] is picking up a tremendous energy signature coming from the center of this being, but its exact composition remains unknown as all attempts to scan it are deflected. It is not responding to hails or any other form of communication.
galactic_features.200.name: Alien Nomads Encountered
galactic_features.200.desc: The [Root.GetFleetName] has stumbled onto a large fleet of alien nomads. Their population is transported in several massive ark ships, each capable of holding more than a million individuals. They refuse to reveal both their origins and intended destination.
galactic_features.300.desc:
[From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking at a mirror.

The barrier's energy readings are fluctuating somewhat, possibly as a result of thousands of years of decay, but breaching it with raw firepower would still be impossible. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has proposed a special project to investigate ways of removing the barrier... but suppose it was created to keep something in, rather than out?
galactic_features.300.a: That barrier is coming down. For science!
galactic_features.300.b: It must be there for a reason. Leave it be.
galactic_features.301.desc:
Our scientists above [From.From.GetName] have finally succeeded in lowering the energy barrier that covered the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. When it disappeared, we discovered a mothballed battle fleet slowly drifting in low orbit above an otherwise insignificant rock.

It appears to be the remnants of some kind of naval reserve fleet established by the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] thousands of years ago, during the zenith of their ancient empire. With the passage of time, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] must have lost the knowledge to lower the barrier themselves, or these ships would surely have been used to bolster their own fleets.
galactic_features.301.a: Send in crews to man those ships.
galactic_features.302.desc:
The energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName] has been lowered by our scientists, revealing a barren world with a single massive structure on its surface. Away teams sent into the structure have reported a massive vault filled with technological marvels.

This vault appears to have been established by [fallen_4_species.GetName] scientists soon after their empire began its long decline thousands of years ago, as a means to preserve some of their knowledge for the benefit of future generations of [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural].
galactic_features.303.desc:
We have lowered the energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName]. What our scientists found was an indistinct habitable world devoid of civilization... with one notable exception. A small, isolated hut was found perched on a mesa in the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere.

Within the hut we found a withered old [fallen_4_species.GetName], who has demanded to speak with our government.
galactic_features.304.desc:
You cannot imagine how good it is to finally see clear skies again, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I am Grand Commander Tuborek, former master of the combined [fallen_4_species.GetName] armada and victor of a hundred battles. I personally oversaw the conquest of the Duthbejak, Riikinak, Binark and Jusskari empires hundreds of your centuries ago.

As my savior, I pledge my service to you. I should be honored to lead your mighty fleets into battle against your enemies.
galactic_features.304.a: Why were you trapped behind a shield?
galactic_features.304.a.response:
Without my leadership skills, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] would be just another extinct, forgotten species. I crushed the fleets of all who opposed us and put a dozen worlds to the torch, all to preserve the future of my kind.

This was my reward. When peace finally arrived and we sought treaties with those we had defeated, my presence became an embarrassment. I had become a symbol of [fallen_4_species.GetName] cruelty, and for my "war crimes" I was imprisoned alone on this world. They lacked the courage to execute me, you see.
galactic_features.304.b: How long have you been down there exactly?
galactic_features.304.b.response:
When my own kind abandoned me here, they explained that time would pass more slowly on the inside of the energy barrier. For me, some forty of your years have passed... while in the rest of the universe, untold centuries must have come and gone since the barrier went up.

It felt like centuries to me as well, when I sat alone brooding in the darkness of my hut. Truly, it did.
galactic_features.304.c.response: Excellent. Then let us depart this dismal place. I have seen enough of it to last a lifetime!
galactic_features.304.d: Bring up the shield again. Leave this creature to its woes.
galactic_features.304.d.response:
Wait... what are you doing?! You can't leave me here! I can't face looking up at that shield again!

I've paid my dues! I'VE PAID MY DUUEEE...

<Transmission terminated.>
tuborek_leader_desc: This commander spent centuries in stasis, and all they knew now belongs to a forgotten past.
galactic_features.305.desc:
As soon as our scientists lowered the energy barrier that was surrounding [From.From.GetName], everyone present within the system was briefly afflicted by a splitting headache accompanied by a faint, whispered word in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."
galactic_features.305.desc.mech:
After lowering the energy barrier surrounding [From.From.GetName], our short-range subspace transmitters experienced a spike in interference levels caused by an abnormal energy burst that originated from a point behind the former barrier. When run through our decryption software the interference proved to be a message in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."
galactic_features.305.a: We may have unleashed something dark...
galactic_features.350.desc:
We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the [From.GetName] system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly home to a pre-space civilization.

There is a large space station of some kind located between the ring world and its star. We are receiving a transmission from it.
galactic_features.351.desc:
Welcome to the Sanctuary, sapient. This fully automated facility was established 74,605,338 cycles ago to serve as a nature reserve. Our self-sustaining biome segments feature a selection of non-intelligent flora and fauna originating from four distinct biospheres.

To protect these fragile biospheres, access to our facilities is currently restricted.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.
galactic_features.351.a: Our sensors show signs of civilization on your ring world.
galactic_features.351.a.response:
All species present in our biomes were thoroughly cataloged when the Sanctuary was first established. Records indicate that none of them displayed intelligence levels approaching sapience. Your sensors must be mistaken.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.
galactic_features.351.b.response:
This facility was constructed by the Ximio over a period of 412 cycles. It was completed and fully functional 74,605,338 cycles ago. The last recorded visit by a Ximio vessel occurred 67,103,853 cycles ago. There are no recorded visits by Ximio or Ximio-affiliated vessels since that date.

There are 38,201 failed attempts by unauthorized vessels to access this facility on record.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.
galactic_features.351.c.response:
The automated services of the Sanctuary bid you a pleasant day, sapient.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.
country.1.name: Sublight Exploration Probes
country.1.desc:
Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information about our culture in their memory cores as a form of greeting to alien civilizations.

It has now been realized that this data could potentially be used against us. We need to track down these probes before they are found by someone - or something - unsympathetic to our species!
country.1.a.tooltip: Begins the Sublight Exploration Probes Event Chain
country.3.name: Sublight Probe Discovered
country.3.desc: [Root.GetName] has detected one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. We should begin recovery efforts as soon as possible.
country.4.name: Probe Recovered
country.4.desc: We have recovered the sublight probe in the [space_probe.GetStarName] system. The sensor telemetry it has collected over the years has provided us with a complete survey of all planetary bodies within the system.
country.5.name: Ion Trail
country.5.desc: The [Root.GetName] has picked up a signal from a discarded signal buoy belonging to one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. There is an ion trail leading away from the buoy on a trajectory towards another star, suggesting that someone has towed the probe there for unknown reasons.
country.5.a: Let us see where this trail leads.
country.6.name: Salvagers Detected
country.6.desc:
We have found our missing probe! A small fleet of jury-rigged ships has been detected in the [From.GetName] system, and one of them has the probe locked in a short-range tractor beam.

They are hailing us.
country.7.name: Salvager Skipper
country.7.desc:
What you want, alien? This probe ours. Salvage. We find first! You leave now. Yes. Interrupting delicate operation, your ships are. Must concentrate.

Or... if you want probe, we can sell. 100 credits and probe yours. Good deal. Very good. You get probe, less work for us, everybody wins. Especially us.
country.7.a: Surrender our property or be destroyed!
country.7.a.response:
Hoho! Listen to ugly alien, boys! Buggwai, drop what you doing and come over to console! Listen to fool! Hoho!

This probe OUR property now. Fair salvage. As will debris from your ships be. HIIYAAAEEE!
country.7.b: You drive a hard bargain, but very well.
country.7.b.response:
Very good, very good! We release probe into your care. May be a bit banged up. There was accidental collision during salvage operation. Miggwai fell on controls. Clumsy oaf!

But probe still in good condition! No refunds! We depart now.
country.8.name: Probe Transferred
country.8.desc:
The salvagers kept their word and transferred the probe over to our control. As soon as the transfer was complete, their fleet departed the system on an unknown heading.

Although the probe is in rough condition, we managed to download detailed sensor readings of the entire [salvager_system.GetName] system from its memory banks.
country.9.name: Probe Recovered
country.9.desc: We have recovered our sublight probe from the wreckage of the alien salvage ship. It is a bit dented, and parts of it are covered in some kind of alien graffiti put there by the salvagers to mark valuable components. Despite this we have managed to download detailed sensor readings of the entire [salvager_system.GetName] system from the probe's memory banks.
country.10.name: Subspace Anomaly
country.10.desc: The [Root.GetName] has detected a massive subspace anomaly in the [Root.GetStarName] system. It appears to be centered on one of our missing sublight probes!
country.11.name: Anomaly Defeated
country.11.desc:
We have dealt with the hostile subspace entity that our missing probe had attracted. Why such a creature would be drawn to an archaic unmanned spacecraft is a mystery, but the probe appears to be largely undamaged.

It has been recovered by our forces, and we have extracted detailed survey readings on the entire [anomaly_system.GetName] from its memory banks. In addition, the residual energy left behind by the subspace anomaly has generated a large amount of valuable physics data for our scientists.
country.12.name: Modified Probe
country.12.desc:
A sensor sweep from the [Root.GetName] has revealed one of our sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system, but it seems to have been... altered somehow. Modifications of an alien origin have been attached to its hull, and the probe's energy signature is far greater than it should be.

We are receiving a transmission from it!
country.13.name: Probe Consciousness
country.14.name: Probe Destroyed
country.14.desc: Little remains of the strange alien modifications that our missing sublight probe had been subjected to, but we did manage to collect some valuable engineering data from the wreckage. Its memory bank was also salvaged, and from it we have extracted survey data of the entire [modified_probe_system.GetName] system.
country.15.name: Probes Collected
country.15.desc:
We have successfully collected all of our missing sublight probes! The detailed information they held on our culture is now safe from prying alien photoreceptors.

With their combined sensor telemetry, we have been able to fully survey a number of additional neighboring systems.
country.50.name: Habitable Worlds Survey
country.50.desc:
We now know without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Efforts to catalog the life forms we encounter are already underway, but our xenobiologists have urged us to focus our planetary survey efforts on habitable, life-bearing worlds.
country.50.desc_slaves:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Efforts to catalog the life forms we encounter are already underway, but our xenobiologists have urged us to focus our planetary survey efforts on habitable, life-bearing worlds.
country.50.b: We have more important matters to focus on.
country.51.name: Survey Completed
country.51.desc:
Through our surveys of habitable worlds, our biologists have collected a vast amount of data on alien life forms. Many of our older theories on the development of life have been disproved, and our scientific community has had to build new models from scratch!

Our most interesting findings are being displayed at the newly dedicated Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The public is enthralled, and many donations have come in to aid in the continued search of strange life forms.
country.53.name: Alien Organism Procurement
country.53.desc: The director of the Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has issued a request for the procurement of several live alien specimens. These creatures were spotted on surveyed habitable worlds, but they are difficult to capture. It will require the full resources of a Science Ship for a lengthy period of time.
country.53.b: No, we don't have the resources to spare.
country.54.name: Tarblac Secured
country.54.desc:
After an extensive search of the seabed on [From.From.GetName] using a small fleet of mini-submarines, the crew of the [Root.GetName] finally managed to corner the elusive target of their search - a live tarblac.

The shimmering creature, which defends itself by emitting faint psionic signals that produce a sense of dread in most organics, was brought aboard the Science Ship in a special water tank simulating its natural environment. The crew members on the [Root.GetName] that came into direct contact with the tarblac will require extensive therapy, but the mission has been a success.
country.55.name: Tassargoid Secured
country.55.desc:
The tassargoid is an extremely lethal predator that stalks the dense jungles of [From.From.GetName] at night, paralyzing its prey with electric shocks before sucking their brains out with its tube-like mouth.

Unfortunately, three of the crew members from the [Root.GetName] were lost to these creatures before a specimen could be secured. The Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] will rename one of its wings after these brave officers to honor their sacrifice.
country.56.name: Orinthi Secured
country.56.desc:
The small, rodent-like creatures known as orinthi are native to [From.From.GetName], where their habitat extends across most of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s diverse climatic regions. They breed at an extremely rapid rate, and seem to have a particular fondness for chewing on electric cables.

Procuring specimens was not a problem - in fact, after the initial creatures were collected, more of them made their way onto the [Root.GetName] by hitching rides on the Science Ship's orbital shuttles. Exactly why the Museum of Exobiology requested orinthi specimens remains a mystery.
country.57.name: Sniran Secured
country.57.desc:
Snirans are large, burrowing creatures that live beneath the dunes of the vast equatorial deserts on [From.From.GetName]. When these predators sense movement in the sand above, they immediately raise dozens of tall spikes from their backs in the hope of impaling something edible.

Finding a suitable specimen proved difficult at first, until hundreds of tracked remote-controlled drones were dispatched across the desert in random directions. This led to the discovery and procurement of an unusually large specimen that had grown more than a hundred spikes on its back.
country.58.name: Goolantha Herd Secured
country.58.desc:
Goolanthas are large, flat herbivores that have evolved internal gas pockets, enabling them to hover a few centimeters above the ground. They move about in herds consisting of a few dozen animals, grazing on the moss and lichen that can be found on the windswept plains of [From.From.GetName].

They are ruthlessly hunted by the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s apex predators, and our biologists on the [Root.GetName] estimate that only a few hundred goolantha herds remain. One of these, consisting of nine animals, has been successfully collected and will be brought back to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].
country.59.name: Uddlorans Secured
country.59.desc: The crew of the [Root.GetName] has managed to collect a small group of uddlorans from the icy surface of [From.From.GetName]. These white, furry omnivores wrap themselves into tight balls and roll across the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s snow fields at astonishing speeds - one animal was clocked at over 80 kilometers per hour. This aided in their detection, since the passage of their rolling forms kicks up huge plumes of swirling snow.
country.60.name: Zulcor Swarm Secured
country.60.desc:
The zulcor are swarming insect analogues, unusual both for their large size and the fact that they are lithovores, feeding off rocks and minerals in the ground. One of the shuttles belonging to the [Root.GetName] sustained serious damage when it inadvertently passed through a large swarm and several zulcors began to feed on its hull.

The construction of the special containment facilities required to hold these creatures has already begun at the Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].
country.61.name: Specimens Secured
country.61.desc:
All of the specimens asked for by the Museum of Exobiology have been secured. The museum has grown to a massive facility, where artificial gravity generators and atmospheric processors are used to simulate the environments of over a dozen worlds.

Visitors are journeying from all across the [Root.GetName] to see its wonders!
country.200.name: The [radical_cult.GetName]
country.200.desc:
Centuries ago, a group of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] broke away from the established religions to form their own church. These extremists called themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], and have been responsible for many atrocities and acts of terror over the years.

Although they have kept a low profile in modern times, we recently learned that many of their agents have infiltrated our military. These renegades have secretly been diverting resources to the construction of a small fleet of starships at a hidden facility on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their treachery was revealed, the cultists blasted into orbit on their ships and fled to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].
country.200.desc.bio:
Centuries ago, a sect of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] splintered from the dominant faiths, forsaking tradition to form their own twisted doctrine. Calling themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], they have long been known for their zealotry, their rituals steeped in blood and secrecy.

For years, they have remained hidden in the shadows... but now, their treachery is laid bare. We have discovered that many of their agents had infiltrated our military, siphoning resources to grow an illicit fleet within a hidden spawning chamber on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their betrayal was exposed, the cultists unleashed their abominations - living starships, gestated in secrecy and warped by their corrupted faith. These heretical warforms burst from their underground cradles, howling into the sky before escaping to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

Whatever they have become, they are no longer our kin. Their ships do not sing as ours do. They screech.
country.200.b: We can learn to forgive them.
country.202.name: Cultist Ship Disabled!
country.202.desc:
Our valiant space forces have skillfully disabled a ship in the cultist armada! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operation to secure any survivors. They may be able to tell us more about the ultimate motives of the [From.Owner.GetName].
country.202.desc.bio:
Our valiant vessels have successfully crippled one of the cultist abominations! The creature drifts in space, its bioluminescence flickering erratically, its membranous hull shuddering in pain. Faint, erratic life signs pulse from deep within its neural cavities - this ship is not dead. Not yet.

Once we have secured the area, we must prepare a boarding operation. Entering the creature's ruptured body will be dangerous. Its innards may still react defensively, its nerve clusters still primed to resist. But within its dying whispers, we may find the truth we seek. The cultists' ultimate purpose remains unknown... but their secrets are written in flesh, and we intend to read them.
country.203.name: Boarding Action
country.203.desc:
Though the survivors offered stiff resistance, our boarding party was able to secure several prisoners from the disabled cultist starship. From them we have learned that this conspiracy goes far deeper than we initially suspected - the agents of the [cult_name.GetName] include several flag officers and high-ranking officials within our government!

Mass arrests are being made on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], and all assets belonging to this cult have been seized. However, several of the starships they built in secret remain unaccounted for and the upper echelons of the cult's leadership have vanished. We have picked up faint ion trails leading to several outlying systems.
country.203.desc.bio:
The cultists fought with wild, fanatical fury, their dying screams blending with the pained wails of their crippled vessel. But despite their resistance, our boarding parties secured several prisoners from the writhing, half-living wreck. What they revealed is far more disturbing than we ever imagined.

The [cult_name.GetName] was not merely a rogue sect of radicals - it had burrowed deep into the veins of our empire. High-ranking officials, flag officers, and trusted advisors were among its ranks, silently diverting resources and influence toward their grand design. Their heresy ran through our halls like a hidden infection, pulsing beneath the surface, unseen until now.

Mass purges are already underway on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Entire networks have been dismantled, their assets seized, their heretical warforms dissolved into raw biomass. But even as we strike them down, questions remain. Several of their secret-grown biological ships remain unaccounted for, and the cult's leadership has vanished without a trace.

Faint, sickly-sweet pheromone trails linger in the void, leading to distant, uncharted systems. Their work is not yet finished. And neither is ours.
country.204.name: Cultist Marauders Encountered
country.204.desc: We have sighted ships flying the flag of the [radical_cult.GetName] in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They have charged their weapons and are moving to intercept us!
country.205.desc: More ships belonging to the [radical_cult.GetName] have been encountered in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They are approaching in attack formation!
country.206.desc: Yet another cultist fleet loyal to the [radical_cult.GetName] has been sighted in the [Root.GetStarName] system. This time, however, their numbers include a strange ship of an unfamiliar design!
country.207.name: Battle Debris
country.207.desc:
We have defeated the cultist forces encountered so far, but these engagements have raised a number of alarming questions. The [radical_cult.GetName] has been deploying far more ships than they could possibly have built in secrecy on [Root.Capital.GetName], and now they pitted a large warship of an unknown design against us.

Where are these ships coming from? Are there more warships like the one we just destroyed? We should investigate the battle debris for answers.
country.207.a.tooltip: Enables a Special Project in the [our_fleet_position.GetName] system.
country.208.name: Recovery Efforts Completed
country.208.desc:
After sifting through the debris left by the strange cultist warship we destroyed, our scientists believe they may have divined the source of the ships the [radical_cult.GetName] has been throwing against us. Fragments from a log file mention some kind of abandoned alien shipyard discovered by the cultist ships fleeing [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

They have been using the automated shipyard to reinforce their numbers, and now they are even producing new ships from alien templates found within the station's memory banks! This cannot be allowed to continue.
country.209.name: Shipyard Destroyed
country.209.desc:
The alien shipyard that was used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us has been destroyed! Some of the cultists were captured when their escape pods were picked up by our forces, including their chief engineer. His knowledge of the shipyard's advanced technology has proved quite valuable.

Unfortunately, we have also learned that the cult's charismatic leader departed the shipyard several weeks ago on her new flagship - a more powerful variant of the alien ships they produced. Military intelligence is working on pinpointing the location of this vessel.
country.210.name: Probable Cultist Flagship Locations
country.210.desc:
Deep space reconnaissance probes have picked up faint subspace emissions in a star system consistent with the drive signatures of the alien ships used by the [radical_cult.GetName]. The cult's missing flagship is the most probable source!

We should send forces to search this system as soon as possible. That ship and its charismatic master are too dangerous to leave at large.
country.211.name: Cultist Flagship
country.211.desc:
So you have found us at last. No matter.

My disciples are more than willing to give their lives for the future of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species. I am that future, in case you didn't realize.

When we have dealt with your pitiful forces, my holy flagship shall carry me to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] where we will at last cleanse our homeworld of unbelievers.
country.213.name: Flagship Disabled
country.213.desc:
Our forces have managed to disable the flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]! Its weapons and engines are no longer functional, but life support systems remain stable. We should prepare for a boarding action.

Due to the large number of armed cultists within the ship, a significant number of troops will be necessary to secure it.
country.214.name: Cultist Flagship Secured
country.214.desc:
After slowly fighting their way deck by deck, our marines have finally eradicated the last pockets of resistance on the former flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]. Few prisoners were taken as most of the zealous cultists preferred to throw their lives away in futile suicide attacks. The cult's leader was found on the vessel's bridge, killed by her own hand. At long last, it looks like the [radical_cult.GetName] has met its end.

Our engineers have restored power to the ship's engines, and it has been pressed into service with our fleet as the [disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]. The vessel should be brought to a spaceport as soon as possible for more permanent repairs.
country.214.desc.bio:
Deck by deck, chamber by chamber, our forces carved their way through living flesh and unrelenting zealotry. The flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName] fought back as if it, too, were a believer, its very body wracked with agony as our marines cut down the last of its fanatical defenders.

Few prisoners were taken. The cultists, their bodies half-fused with their vessel, chose to die screaming, hurling themselves into the ship's bio-reactors or launching desperate, futile attacks. Their leader was found on what passed for the vessel's bridge, her lifeless form slumped against a pulsating mass of nerve-tissue, her own bio-weapon turned upon herself. With her death, the cult's dream dies with her.

But the flagship is ours now. Our engineers have stabilized its biological systems and forced its shuddering, reluctant mass to submit. The ship lives, but it has been leashed, pressed into service as the [disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]. It should be guided to a spaceport for repairs and careful study.

Even in death, the cultists' creation may yet serve us.
country.225.name: Cultist Flagship Transferred
country.225.desc: A former member of the [radical_cult.GetName], now fully committed to our cause, has convinced their old comrades to abandon their fanaticism and join our ranks. Their flagship now orbits [Root.capital_scope.GetName], awaiting inspection before its formal induction into our navy.
country.17.name: Salvage Fleet Destroyed
country.17.desc: Spy drones in the [salvager_system.GetName] system have confirmed that someone else destroyed the salvage fleet which had unlawfully laid claim to our missing space probe. Fortunately, it looks like the probe itself was destroyed along with the salvagers during the battle, so there is no risk of its sensitive data falling into the wrong hands.
country.19.name: Subspace Anomaly Destroyed
country.19.desc: Deep space tracking sensors confirm that someone else destroyed the subspace anomaly that was guarding our missing space probe in the [anomaly_system.GetName] system. The probe itself was also destroyed during the battle, so we no longer need to worry about the sensitive data it contained.
country.21.name: Modified Probe Defeated
country.21.desc: Long-range scans have confirmed that someone else destroyed our modified probe in the [modified_probe_system.GetName] system. Fortunately, nothing remained of its memory banks after the battle so there is no chance of foreign powers having acquired the sensitive data that was contained therein.
country.218.name: Cultist Ship Disabled!
country.218.desc:
One of the ships belonging to the cultist armada has been violently disabled by an outside force! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operation to secure any survivors. They may be able to tell us more about the ultimate motives of the [From.Owner.GetName].
country.219.name: Cultist Fleet Destroyed
country.219.desc: The cultist fleet operating in the [marauder_system.GetName] system has been destroyed in battle.
country.221.desc:
Someone has destroyed the alien shipyard that was being used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us. Preliminary reports indicate that the cultist forces were thoroughly wiped out, but we have also received intelligence that the cult's charismatic leader left the shipyard on her new flagship moments before the battle had begun.

She is still at large somewhere in the galaxy. Military intelligence is working on pinpointing the exact location of her flagship.
country.223.name: Cultist Flagship Destroyed
country.223.desc: Someone else recently defeated the cultist flagship after a pitched battle in the [flagship_system.GetName] system. Our commanders have expressed regret over the fact that our own forces were unable to deliver the killing blow, but at least this should signify the end of this malignant cult and its campaign of terror.
country.250.name: The Hunt for the Hyacinth
country.250.desc:
We have found no traces of the four ark ships that passed through the wormhole before the Chrysanthemum arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]. One ship, the Hyacinth, was scheduled to make the passage after us, and the Chrysanthemum's long-range sensors reported a brief energy spike from the wormhole shortly before it destabilized and vanished.

Assuming the Hyacinth survived the passage and made it to our galactic neighborhood, the ark ship has so far failed to establish contact with us. It might be a good idea to search nearby systems for signs of its presence.
country.250.b: A wild goose chase we can ill afford.
country.251.name: System Surveyed
country.251.desc: The [Root.GetName] reports no signs of the Hyacinth in the [From.GetName] system. We should continue our search elsewhere.
country.252.desc: Scans from the [Root.GetName] have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth in the [From.GetName] system. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.
country.252.a: She has to be out there.
country.253.desc:
The [Root.GetName] has managed to isolate a residual ion trail in the [From.GetName] system that is identical to the one that was produced by the Chrysanthemum's engines. It must have originated from the Hyacinth!

Although the faint ion trail is over a century old, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to track it on an outbound trajectory towards a previously uncharted star. We have entered its coordinates into the Situation Log.
country.260.desc: The survey data recently acquired of the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.
country.261.desc:
The survey data recently acquired bears marks of a unique, residual ion trail in the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system. It is identical to the one that was produced by the Chrysanthemum's engines. It must have originated from the Hyacinth!

Although the faint ion trail is over a century old, we have been able to track it on an outbound trajectory towards a previously uncharted star. We have entered its coordinates into the Situation Log.
country.254.name: Hyacinth Found
country.254.desc: We have located the Hyacinth! The great ark ship is parked in a stable orbit over [hyacinth_planet.GetName]. No power signatures have been detected from within its hull, and we are not picking up any distress beacons. An armed boarding party should be sent to investigate the ship's interior.
country.255.name: Hyacinth Boarded
country.255.desc:
Our boarding party has returned from the Hyacinth with a gruesome report. Human remains in amounts consistent with the ark ship's entire compliment of a quarter million colonists were found on board. Most seem to have died from starvation, but there were also signs of small-arms fire and cannibalism...

We were able to recover the captain's log from the archives on the Hyacinth's bridge.
country.256.name: Ship Archives
country.256.desc:
ARK SHIP HYACINTH
ISA-06
UNITED NATIONS ULYSSES INITIATIVE
Officer Logbook: Captain Ronald F. Gundersen

Accessing data... corruption detected. Attempting repairs...
Four log entries successfully retrieved.
country.256.a.response:
Captain's Log, Mission Date 345.5.

We are two months out of Earth and proceeding on course. Things have gone smoothly so far. The colonists are fast asleep, and Doctor Colbeck has reported strong vitals across the board.

Our journey has taken us beyond the outer planets and we are now approaching the Oort Cloud. We will soon reach the subspace phenomenon - this supposed "wormhole" - that the other ark ships have already entered. I have made my reservations about wormhole travel known in previous log entries, but we'll know if this works soon enough...
country.256.b.response:
We... we actually made it! Astrogation is still working on getting a fix on our position, but judging by the stars outside I think it's a safe bet to say we're not in Kansas anymore. Unfortunately, the Hyacinth suffered a major engineering casualty that resulted in a complete loss of power, and we're currently running on batteries.

Colbeck has informed me that we may need to wake up the colonists. I'm on my way down to Engineering now to see why Maggie is taking her sweet time getting the reactor up and running again. Hopefully we can get underway soon and begin our search for the Chrysanthemum's colonists.
country.256.c.response:
The situation has gone from bad to worse. There is no longer any realistic hope of restarting the reactor, and the last of the Hyacinth's power reserves were spent in our attempt to reach this misbegotten system. We had hoped to find some place habitable to set her down... but no such luck.

We've got enough juice in the batteries to keep life support going for a few years, but with a quarter million colonists up and about, the Hyacinth's food supplies won't last the month. I've called a meeting with all department heads. We... we need to come up with some sort of plan...
country.256.d.response:
This will likely be my final log. My bridge crew is either dead or missing and a group of colonists are trying to force their way onto the bridge as I speak. Our main food supplies ran out weeks ago, and there... there are reports of cannibalism.

I kept a small stash of food for the crew, to keep the old girl running a little while longer... hoping for some kind of miracle, I guess. When the surviving colonists found out, they...

They're through the doors. Back, damn you! Keep your distance! I'm the captain of this ship, and I'll be damned if I'm gonna let you butcher me like a... AGGGHHggghh...
country.256.e.response:
ARK SHIP HYACINTH
ISA-06
UNITED NATIONS ULYSSES INITIATIVE

Disengaging user interface.
country.257.name: Final Conclusion
country.257.desc:
We now have a pretty clear picture of the grim fate that befell the Hyacinth, her crew and the colonists she was carrying. Had circumstances been different, it could very well have been the Chrysanthemum drifting above [hyacinth_planet.GetName] like a silent tomb. A sobering reminder of the dangers humanity is faced with in a cold and uncaring universe.

The Hyacinth will now be towed into low orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName] and converted into a museum, as soon as the human remains have been cleared out. Despite its tragic history, the ark ship is almost identical to the one that brought our ancestors here from Earth and our sociologists could learn much from it.
country.257.a: Perhaps something good will come out of this.
progress.1.name: [home_system.GetName] System Fully Surveyed
progress.1.desc:
For thousands of years, astronomers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have been using telescopes to gaze in wonder at the planets we share our home system with. Complex mechanical orreries were eventually built by our ancestors to simulate their orbits, using surprisingly accurate models of the [home_system.GetName] system.

Today our civilization has arrived at another historic milestone, with the survey of the last unexplored planetary body in our solar system. The frontiers of the unknown have been pushed back yet again.
progress.2.name: The Discovery of Alien Life
progress.2.desc:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are.
progress.2.desc.mach:
The [Root.GetName] has made an unanticipated discovery on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien lifeforms. For the first time in history, we have encountered organic life that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, newly recalibrated prognoses suggest a high probability of intelligent organics in the galaxy.
progress.2.desc.assim: The [Root.GetName] reports a momentous find on [From.GetName]: myriad alien organic lifeforms have been discovered! While none of them has evolved to a stage we would consider desirable for assimilation, the likelihood of encountering sapient organics beyond [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] is now more promising than ever.
progress.2.desc.term: We have been preparing for this day. The [Root.GetName] has confirmed the existence of alien organics on [From.GetName]. Though none of the encountered lifeforms possess higher reasoning functions, we cannot preclude the now heightened probability of a galaxy infested with sapient organics.
progress.2.desc.serv: A historic discovery has been made by the [Root.GetName] on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien organics! Though none of the new lifeforms appear to possess the self-awareness required to appreciate [Root.Owner.GetAdj] pampering, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that do!
progress.2.desc.droid:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with organic alien creatures. For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter sentient beings, biological or mechanical.
progress.2.desc.evopred: Life. Glorious evolved life is out there and ready to be sampled for our progress. We have long since gathered all interesting samples on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] and didn't dare hope that we would have access to further genetic uniqueness so soon after leaving home.
progress.2.a: We may not be alone out here.
progress.2.a.term: We will be ready for them.
progress.3.name: The First [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] Colony
progress.3.desc_end: The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_01:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the mouth of a large river delta on one of the continents on [Root.GetName]. This temperate, forested area will provide shelter and easy access to raw materials.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_02:
Our colony ship has made a gentle splashdown in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]-spanning ocean of [Root.GetName], near the shores of a large archipelago. This fertile island chain provide a suitable environment for growing food.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_03:
Our colony ship has gently touched down by the outskirts of a large oasis on [Root.GetName], at the foot of a mountain, offering shelter from the desert winds and easy access to water.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_04:
Our colony ship has found a clearing in the dense jungles of [Root.GetName] and made planetfall. Sentry drones have been deployed to guard against potential predators.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_05:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the top of a large, flat mesa near the equator of [Root.GetName]. The rivers that flow in the canyons below provide easy access to fresh water.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_06:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the wide, empty steppe of [Root.GetName], nestled behind a large ridge, sheltering it from the cold winds.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_07:
Our colony ship has gently touched down in a snow-covered valley on [Root.GetName]. The surrounding mountain chains offer sufficient protection from the elements and provide an reliable water supply.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_10:
Our colony ship has successfully made planetfall on [Root.GetName]. Thousands of work units have emerged from the cargo bays to build an initial Deployment Post for settlement expansion. Efforts to catalog surface resource deposits continue, and aggressive wildlife near the landing site has been pacified.

We are now ready to mass-produce additional [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] as resources allow. Our first colony is a success.
progress.3.desc_11_droids:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of [Root.GetName]. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Hundreds of prefab shelters have sprung up around the ship's hull as our droids disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_11_hive:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of [Root.GetName]. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a Field Headquarters, and around its husk, we have spread, weaving shelters from whatever materials were available. This marks the birth of a new hive on an alien world.
progress.3.materialist: Scientific progress will drive our colony forward.
progress.3.spiritualist: Our colony is a testament to our higher purpose.
progress.3.militarist: Strength and vigilance will secure our future.
progress.3.pacifist: Our colony will thrive in peace and harmony.
progress.3.egalitarian: As on our homeworld, equality will shape this colony.
progress.3.xenophile: Embracing diversity will strengthen our colony.
progress.3.xenophobe: Our colony will remain pure and protected.
progress.3.authoritarian: Order and hierarchy will guide our colony.
progress.3.gestalt_consciousness_hive: The colony grows as one with the Hive.
progress.3.gestalt_consciousness_machine: The colony will function with perfect efficiency.
progress.3.b.evopred: A whole new banquet to sample.
progress.4.name: First Alien Encounter
progress.4.desc_01:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos have a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.
progress.4.desc_02:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage and their level of technology is similar to our own.
progress.4.desc_03:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos appear to have achieved a level of technology similar to our own, and they are clearly spacefaring. Whether they regard our great species with fear, hatred or cold indifference is anyone's guess.
progress.5.name: Developing Civilization Encountered
progress.5.desc_01:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms our long-held belief that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet.

Each species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary. The technological level of these particular aliens is low by our standards. They have not yet achieved space flight. We must decide how best to engage them going forward.
progress.5.desc_02:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The confirmation that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Our level of technology is far ahead of theirs. They have not yet developed space flight. Despite this, we could probably still learn much by studying them.
progress.5.desc_03:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

These aliens are far below our own level of technology. They have not yet developed space flight. For all our sakes, let us pray they never will.
progress.6.desc_01:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos appear to have been active on the galactic stage for some time - their empire is likely thousands of years old, and their technology is far ahead of our own. We should be careful when dealing with them.
progress.6.desc_02:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The empire these aliens have founded appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far ahead of our own. There is no doubt a great deal they could teach us.
progress.6.desc_03:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos have achieved a level of technology far beyond our own, and they appear to have been spacefaring for thousands of years - possibly even longer. Fortunately for us, their kind appear to be a decrepit and stagnating species.
progress.6.c: Their age is over. The time of the [Root.Species.GetName] has come.
progress.7.name: Survey Mission
progress.7.desc:
The [Root.GetName], our first Science Ship, has completed space trials and is now fully operational. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has assumed command and is recommending a full survey of our home system.

We have entered the details of this mission into the Situation Log for future reference.
progress.8.name: Foothold
progress.8.desc:
With our home system fully explored, the time has come for our species to spread beyond [Root.Capital.GetName]. We should survey our neighboring star systems for a suitable world where we can establish our first colony.

As before, an entry has been added to the Situation Log.
progress.9.name: Second Alien Encounter
progress.9.desc.start: We already knew we were not alone in the universe. Yet, we found our second contact with another space-faring civilization unsettling.
progress.9.desc.default: Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage, and their level of technology is similar to our own.
progress.9.desc.preftl: Our technological development is far beyond that of these aliens. They have yet to become space-faring.
progress.9.desc.fallen: The civilization these aliens have built appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far beyond our own.
progress.9.desc.msi: We knew we were bound to find our former master again. We just weren't expecting to find them again so soon.
progress.9.desc.friendly_friendly: Their intentions seem far more benign than those of our former masters. Perhaps we were just unfortunate with our first alien encounter. After all, there must be some good in the galaxy.
progress.9.desc.friendly_mean: They are so different from our former masters, and yet so alike in their reproachable behavior. It makes us wonder if perhaps all other civilizations in the galaxy are riddled with ill will and poor intentions. In terms of friendship, we may just be alone.
progress.9.desc.mean_friendly: They are so different from us. Yet they are so amicable. We wonder if perhaps this is a sign that there can indeed be good xenos out there. There may be kindness among the stars after all.
progress.9.desc.mean_mean: There truly are no good xenos in the cosmos. It was foolish of us to think otherwise!
progress.9.desc.msi2: Will we ever be free from their grasp?
progress.4.desc_04:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered has a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.
progress.5.desc_04:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered has not yet invented space flight. We must determine how best to deal with these [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].
progress.6.desc_04:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered appears to be an old one, possessing technology that is far advanced of our own. Caution is advised.
progress.4.gestaltintro: Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.
progress.4.gestaltnormal: The alien political entity that we have encountered has a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.
progress.4.gestaltprimitives: The alien political entity that we have encountered has not yet invented space flight. We must determine how best to deal with these [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].
progress.4.gestaltfallen: The alien political entity that we have encountered appears to be an old one, possessing technology that is far advanced of our own. Caution is advised.
pirate.2.h: They must be brought back into the fold.
pirate.15.desc2:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, including an ancient datapad which, startlingly, seems to offer fresh insights into how the mysterious L-Gates function.
pretender.1.name: [From.GetRegnalName] Dies Heirless
pretender.1.desc_01:
[From.GetRegnalName] has passed away, and seven days of mourning have been announced on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Unfortunately, there was no declared heir and two separate claims have been made on the throne.

The strongest contender has been crowned [Root.GetRulerTitle] under the name [Root.GetRulerName], but this has done little to settle the issue.
pretender.1.desc_02:
[From.GetRegnalName] has transcended this realm of existence and begun the journey towards the next. Unfortunately, the Spirits have not yet seen fit to bless us with sufficient signs and portents to conclusively identify a successor.

After a heated debate, [Root.GetRulerName] has been crowned as the next [Root.GetRulerTitle] but not without opposition. Pretenders from the senior ranks of the clergy are now attempting to galvanize support.
pretender.1.desc_03: [From.GetRegnalName] has died without a clear heir, leaving our government in disarray. [Root.GetRulerName] has been named successor, after having managed to gather enough support among the military on [Root.Capital.GetName], but the situation remains tenuous and pretenders are attempting to gather enough support to challenge the new [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s rule.
pretender.1.desc_04:
The flesh of [From.GetRegnalName] has failed, and our algorithms have been unable to identify an optimal replacement. To maintain efficiency a new [Root.GetRulerTitle] has been chosen at random, and it now falls on [Root.GetRulerName] to interpret the infallible will of the Main Computer.

Doubts have been raised, however, and there are those who see themselves as better qualified to perform this honor.
pretender.1.desc_05:
[From.GetRegnalName] has passed away and the entire [Root.GetName] is in mourning. There is sadly no declared heir, and this has raised some contention among the nobility.

[Root.GetRulerName] has already been crowned on [Root.Capital.GetName], but Pretenders claiming distant kinship with [From.GetRegnalName] has challenged the new [Root.GetRulerTitle].
leader.1.name: Promising Officer
leader.1.desc: Captain [officer.GetName], the commanding officer of the [ship.GetName], served with distinction during the recent engagement that took place in the [system.GetName] system. The Admiralty on [Root.Capital.GetName], recognizing the qualities of a promising flag officer, has decided to promote the Captain to the rank of full commander.
leader.1.desc.machine: [officer.GetName] has been moved up the chain of command as a result of its successful handling of increased processing load during the [ship.GetName]'s battle in the [system.GetName] system.
leader.1.desc.hive: [officer.GetName] was elevated to [GetLeaderStatusAdjCap] status following observations of their heightened responses during the [ship.GetName]'s recent engagement in the [system.GetName] system.
new_admiral: A new Commander has been added to our Recruitable Leaders.
leader.newadmiraltrait.desc.machine: [officer.GetName] has developed a new tactical data set from the feature vectors of the recent combat instance in the [system.GetName] system.
leader.lostadmiraltrait.desc.machine: Following the recent combat instance in the [system.GetName] system, [officer.GetName] has revised its engagement protocols.
leader.newadmiraltrait.desc.hive: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].
leader.lostadmiraltrait.desc.hive: The battle in the [system.GetName] system has caused behavioral anomalies within [officer.GetName] to subside.
leader.5.desc: After the recent victory in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] appears to have developed a new interest in naval theory. [officer.GetSheHeCap] [officer.GetHasHave] begun experimenting with some radically new strategies and tactics.
leader.6.desc: The recent victory in the [system.GetName] system seems to have awakened the hunter in Commander [officer.GetName], who has now become a much more aggressive commander.
leader.7.desc: Having led [From.From.GetName] to victory in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] has grown increasingly confident and now refuses to even contemplate the very notion of retreating from future engagements.
leader.8.desc: After [officer.GetHerHis] recent victory in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] has started emphasizing the importance of speed and rapid maneuvers in [officer.GetHerHis] fleet briefings. [officer.GetSheHeCap] [officer.GetIsAre] experimenting with new formations and patterns to get the most agility out of the starships under [officer.GetHerHis] command.
leader.9.desc: After the recent victory of [From.From.GetName] in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] is displaying a lot more energy and initiative than before. [officer.GetHerHisCap] performance has improved significantly.
leader.10.desc: Commander [officer.GetName] seems to have developed something of a cautious streak after the recent defeat in the [system.GetName] system. The Commander is now much more careful and meticulous in the deployment of the fleet assets under [officer.GetHerHis] command.
leader.11.desc: After the recent defeat in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] seems to have become more skittish and self-doubting. It has become clear that the Commander is no longer capable of commanding as large formations as before.
leader.12.desc: The retreat of [Root.GetName] from the recent battle in the [system.GetName] system seems to have hit Commander [officer.GetName] hard. [officer.GetName] has resolved never to quit the field again, being intent instead to fight to the last in [officer.GetHerHis] next engagement.
leader.13.desc: Commander [officer.GetName] ran the engines of [officer.GetHerHis] ships to their limits when [Root.GetName] disengaged from the recent battle in the [system.GetName] system. [officer.GetSheHeCap] [officer.GetHasHave] learned to squeeze extra speed out of any ships under [officer.GetHerHis] command.
leader.14.desc: Commander [officer.GetName] appears to have grown distant and depressed since [officer.GetHerHis] defeat in the recent battle that took place in the [system.GetName] system. The officers under [officer.GetHerHis] command report that the Commander no longer performs [officer.GetHerHis] duties with the same gusto as before.
leader.optimizations.desc.machine: [officer.GetName] has updated its operational heuristics for fleet management.
leader.optimizations.desc.hive: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.
leader.15.desc: Commander [officer.GetName] has gained invaluable technical skills while supervising the repairs of [Root.GetName]. The damage control teams under the Commander's command are now capable of repairing ships in the field.
leader.16.desc: The experience of commanding as large a formation as [Root.GetName] has provided Commander [officer.GetName] with invaluable organizational skills. The Commander is now capable of effectively controlling even larger fleets.
leader.17.desc: After leading [From.From.GetName] to victory in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] seems to have regained [officer.GetHerHis] confidence. [officer.GetSheHe] [officer.GetIsAre] now capable of dealing with the administrative workload that comes with commanding a large fleet.
leader.18.desc: While in command of [Root.GetName], Commander [officer.GetName] has learned to carefully nurse [officer.GetHisHer] supplies to significantly reduce ship operating costs across the board.
leader.19.desc: Following [officer.GetHerHis] recent sensor sweep of the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] has learned how to deploy [officer.GetHerHis] units to maximize their sensor range. Few fleet commanders possess the skill to carry out such complex maneuvers.
leader.newtrait: Through hard work and experience, [From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName] has developed new skills.
leader.substanceabuser: We have received some rather troubling reports regarding the deteriorating health of [From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName]. [From.From.GetHerHisCap] haggard appearance makes it look as though [From.From.GetSheHe] [From.From.GetHasHave] aged nearly twenty years. The burden of duty can be a heavy thing to bear.
leader.arresteddevelopment: Despite recent skill improvements owing to accumulated experience, [From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName] seems to be approaching the limits of [From.From.GetHerHis] abilities.
leader.lethargic: Despite recent skill improvements, much of the initiative and resolve that once drove [From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName] forwards seem to have gradually evaporated.
leader.stubborn: [From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName] has become more experienced, but with this experience has come an increasing stubbornness. The [From.From.GetTitle] has become quite obdurate, and is having difficulty accepting new ideas.
leader.30.name: AI Assistants Removed
leader.30.desc: As per our recent policy change outlawing artificial intelligence, any [Root.GetAdj] Scientists in possession of Sapient AI Assistants have been forced to relinquish them for recycling.
diplomatic.2.name: [From.From.Owner.GetAdj] Commander Insults Us
diplomatic.2.desc:
The [From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are well known to have few good things to say about alien lifeforms in general. Those who do diplomacy in the [From.From.Owner.GetName] cannot afford a short temper, as they can rarely expect anything beyond a bare minimum of respect, if that. However, while traversing [Root.GetAdj] space, communications usually stay within formal protocols.

Not so earlier today, when [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] decided to unleash an utterly vitriolic message on our unsuspecting public while commandeering a fleet through the [From.From.GetStarName] system. The commander appears to have picked up radio signals from one of our planets and set off on a long rant about our culture and evolutionary origins. Millions have heard the message, as clearly intended. The outrage is palpable.
diplomatic.2.b: [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] must be brought to us and put to death!
diplomatic.2.c: These are just words. We can't afford to be petty.
diplomatic.3.name: Commander Insults the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]
diplomatic.3.desc:
Although few among us enjoy spending time around [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], or xenos in general, most of us try to avoid announcing our distaste at inopportune times. Commander [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] has apparently discarded all such concerns when broadcasting a vicious diatribe about the [From.GetSpeciesName] people while traveling [From.GetAdj] space. The list of claims about their inferior nature had made for acceptable small talk on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but has caused a diplomatic incident with the locals.

[broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] has apologized privately, claiming to have been annoyed listening to a local radio channel. The [From.GetAdj] government are calling for the offender to resign immediately.
diplomatic.3.a: Such an uncontrollable temperament is unsuitable for a commander.
diplomatic.3.b: The broadcast sounds quite amusing. We can't fire someone for this!
diplomatic.4.desc:
Although few among us enjoy spending time around [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], or xenos in general, most of us try to avoid announcing our distaste at inopportune times. Commander [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] has apparently discarded all such concerns when broadcasting a vicious diatribe about the [From.GetSpeciesName] people while traveling [From.GetAdj] space. The list of claims about their inferior nature had made for acceptable small talk on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but has caused a diplomatic incident with the locals.

[broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] has apologized privately, claiming to have been annoyed listening to a local radio channel. The [From.GetAdj] government are calling for the offender to be executed and want [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetHimHer] extracted to [From.GetHomeWorldName].
diplomatic.4.a: One life is a small price to settle a dispute among millions.
diplomatic.4.b: We won't hand over one of our own for the xenos to slaughter!
diplomatic.5.name: [From.GetName] Retires Commander
diplomatic.5.desc:
After some pressure from our diplomats to choose their leaders more carefully, [From.GetRulerName] has removed commander [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] from duty. The commander has not gone quietly, but sworn to clear [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetHisHer] name, hoping that [From.GetAdj] public opinion will turn aggressively against the [Root.GetName] in the future.

The leaders of [From.GetName] have nevertheless sent a clear message about future expeditions into our territory: Even if they may not like dealing with alien species, the [Root.GetSpeciesName] are at least to be respected in their own space.
diplomatic.6.name: [From.GetName] Extradites Commander
diplomatic.6.desc:
After a short period of negotiations, [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] has been delivered to us for punishment. Having carefully considered what an appropriate punishment for insulting the [Root.GetSpeciesName] might be, only death and complete destruction seemed like a suitable option.

Unrepentant into [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetHerHis] last moments, the defiant commander's passionate speech about our savage ways was cut short by the airlock closing as the pod was launched at near lightspeed into the heart of [Root.Capital.StarName]. The glorious fire that lit the nights of our ancestors will burn away every trace of those who speak ill of them.
diplomatic.7.name: [From.GetName] Defends Commander
diplomatic.7.desc:
Our request to have [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetName] removed from duty has been met with an appalling lack of understanding from [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] and the [From.GetAdj] leadership. They've responded with a message largely trying to excuse the commander's behavior, in the process suggesting, perhaps inadvertently, that some of what [broadcasted_insult_leader.GetSheHe] said about [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might have rung true.

What we assumed to be the actions of one bigot has turned out to be acceptable in [From.GetName]. They clearly think that our people can be insulted and slandered without consequence.
diplomatic.7.a: The crown is as rotten as the branches.
diplomatic.8.name: Disgraced Commander Returns
diplomatic.8.desc:
The once-exiled commander who was fired from our fleet over a diplomatic incident caused by an insulting transmission has tried to stage a comeback. With the ongoing war, many of the statements in the original transmission are now propaganda people hear everyday, vindicating the commander's actions, especially in the military.

While changing our decision now would weaken the administration's credibility, this might be the best commander we could find to fight this war.
diplomatic.8.a: We need someone to rally the people!
diplomatic.8.b: We made the right decision then and we stick with it.
diplomatic.10.name: Researchers Suspect Foreign Ships
diplomatic.10.desc:
[Root.GetName] is known for its academic standards and drive to innovate, but staying at the bleeding edge does not only require discretion in how to perform research, but who to share it with. Our trade secrets are highly valued, domestically as well as throughout the galaxy, and some scientists are very guarded against attempts to illicitly access their data.

The presence of [From.From.Owner.GetAdj] science ships in our territory have caused many research facilities to suspect them of espionage. Some researchers have claimed that they cannot continue to operate under this perceived threat, requesting we close our borders to these suspicious [From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
diplomatic.10.a: Our scientists must feel safe from observation. Close the borders.
diplomatic.10.b: Science vessels are fellow researchers, not spies.
diplomatic.11.name: [From.GetName] Closes Borders
diplomatic.11.desc: The presence of your science ships in [From.GetAdj] space have caused us to doubt your motives. Our researchers believe that your scientists were not conducting, but stealing research. To keep valued trade secrets safe, we must bar you from our space.
diplomatic.11.a: Truly a troubling time when scientists don't trust each other.
diplomatic.12.name: [From.From.GetName] Suspected of Mapping Genome
diplomatic.12.desc:
Being on our guard against xeno threats has been a priority since we first left [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. The [From.From.GetAdj] science ships sneaking around our territory have not gone unnoticed, but up until now, they have been assumed to be peacefully examining planets. However, a recent theory has cast doubt on this.

The [From.From.GetSpeciesName] are known to utilize genome mapping in their medical research. What if they are mapping the genomes of unsuspecting [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] with the intention of finding our weaknesses? Although no certain evidence has surfaced, the theory has led to calls for closing our borders to the [From.From.GetName] to prevent any possible plans from succeeding.
diplomatic.12.a: We cannot risk future enemies gaining this data! Close the borders.
diplomatic.12.b: We are not going to base foreign policy on conspiracy theories.
diplomatic.12.c: We must start a project to map their genome in retaliation.
diplomatic.13.name: [From.GetName] Closes Borders
diplomatic.13.desc: Your science ships have been reported for suspicious activity in our space. There are rumors that you have been studying our genetic makeup, looking for information which could be used to find weaknesses or manufacture bio-weapons. We cannot expose the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people to such a risk.
diplomatic.14.name: Genome Mapping Yields Results
diplomatic.14.desc: Although we have not found the specific details on the examined genome we hoped, our research has clarified much about the peculiarities of our own genetics. Some of the weapons what proved useful in the wars on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] in the past might be entirely wasted on alien lifeforms. These new insights have helped us develop updated combat doctrines.
diplomatic.14.a: If they really are targeting us, we may need it.
diplomatic.15.name: Prying [From.From.GetAdj] Scientist
diplomatic.15.desc:
The [Root.GetName] tries not to let spiritual concerns stand in the way of our exploration and examination of the mundane, but we know how to pay proper heed to metaphysical insights and traditions in the course of all actions. Scientists from [From.From.GetName] appear to be a bit more careless in their pursuit of new astronomic discoveries.

After taking an interest in some of the nearby stars that form constellations crucial to [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mythology, [encroaching_research_leader.GetName] has been accused of trying to "disprove" some of the legends surrounding them. While we are confident that the spiritual significance of the constellations can hardly be touched by worldly discoveries, many have objected to the research and tried to persuade [encroaching_research_leader.GetHimHer] to leave [Root.GetAdj] space.
diplomatic.15.a: Suspicion of ill intent is reason enough to bar them from our space.
diplomatic.15.b: Our faith transcends the material realm. It cannot be harmed.
diplomatic.16.name: [From.GetName] Closes Borders
