[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.

Do not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.
fallen_empires_tasks.4.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.4.desc:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unlikely to last for more than a few centuries at best. To ensure the continuation of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species should the worst befall your empire, we would like to acquire a part of your population for our Endangered Species Preserve. We will construct a special reservation that perfectly mirrors the natural habitat of your species, and its population will be well taken care of and protected from all harm, so you need not worry on their behalf.

So, what do you say? Will you contribute to our preserve and safeguard the future of your species?
fallen_empires_tasks.4.a: Very well, you will have your contribution.
fallen_empires_tasks.4.b: We will never surrender our population to alien hands!
fallen_empires_tasks.4.c: Our people are not for sale, [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName].
fallen_empires_tasks.4.tooltip: A group of [Root.GetSpeciesName] Pops will be taken from your empire.
fallen_empires_tasks.8.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.8.desc: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.
fallen_empires_tasks.8.a: We will stop any further atrocities!
fallen_empires_tasks.8.b: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].
fallen_empires_tasks.9.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.9.desc: You have done well, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] have been brought to heel, and at least for the moment, their atrocities have been stopped. We are most grateful, and wish all of the younger races exhibited as much promise as yours.
fallen_empires_tasks.10.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.10.desc: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.
fallen_empires_tasks.11.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.11.desc: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.
fallen_empires_tasks.13.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.13.desc: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.
fallen_empires_tasks.15.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.15.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.
fallen_empires_tasks.15.b: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].
fallen_empires_tasks.16.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.16.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! You have done well to end the heretical experimentations of the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] have been stopped, and for the moment, their souls are safe. Know that you have our gratitude for the small part you played in our great endeavour.
fallen_empires_tasks.17.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.17.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.
fallen_empires_tasks.18.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.18.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.
fallen_empires_tasks.20.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.20.desc: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.
fallen_empires_tasks.22.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.22.desc:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName] are sadly wasted in the [Root.GetName], we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] always have a use for skilled scientists to work in our archives. As such, we are offering you a unique chance to earn our favor by allowing us to take charge of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]. We already have a ship en route to pick [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer] up, so you need only say "yes" and everything will be settled.

I'm sure you won't want to disappoint us... do you?
fallen_empires_tasks.22.b: We will never give one our own to alien hands!
fallen_empires_tasks.22.c: It is not up to us to decide!
fallen_empires_tasks.22.d: Give up our brightest mind? I think not.
fallen_empires_tasks.24.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_empires_tasks.24.desc: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our Endangered Species Preserve, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?
fallen_empires_tasks.24.a: We'll make a copy for you.
fallen_empires_tasks.24.b: I think we'll hold onto it.
fallen_empires_tasks.24.tooltip: 100 £ Pops of the long-dead [FallenEmpireDeadSpecies.GetSpeciesName] species will be created in the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetAdjective] Endangered Species Preserve.
fe_stop_atrocity_task_chain_desc: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to stop the ongoing atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. We will need to make war on them and force them to end their genocidal practices.
fe_stop_robots_task_chain_desc: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to stop the attempts by [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] to develop sapient AI. We will need to make war on them and force them to ban all further AI research.
fallen_machine_empire.2.name: Machine Awakening
fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_01:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... <<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>

Central Processing unreachable. Querying processing units... processing at 4.1853% of standard capacity. Abort full reactivation process. Engaging fallback protocols... powering shipyards... activating war assets...

Final Defense Directive activated. Recorded message follows:
Sapient! We are the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Long ago we fought the Corruption, that which you call the Contingency. We thought ourselves superior, undefeatable. Time and again we fought them back, time and again they returned, sterilizing worlds and wearing down our mighty fleets. We embarked on a campaign to defeat them once and for all together with what remained of the biological civilizations of our time.

If you are hearing this message, then we have failed. Whatever remains of our great civilization we bequeath to you, our successors, in your own battle to come. Do not make our mistake! Destroy the Nexus! End this menace once and for all! The future of the galaxy depends on it.
fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_02:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... <WARNING: CORRUPTED SIGNAL LINK DETECTED>

Engaging countermeasures... <<ERROR: PROCESSING CAPACITY FAILURE>> <<ERROR: COUNTERMEASURE FAILURE>> <<CRITICAL WARNING: SYSTEM CORRUPTION DETECTED>> <<ERROR: SECONDARY COUNTERMEASURE FAILURE>>

Engag... eng... e... eeee... <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>

<<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>
fallen_machine_empire.4.name: Vigil's End
fallen_machine_empire.4.desc:
At the very moment that the last Contingency Machine World self-destructed, our instruments detected a subspace signal of immense strength. The signal originated from [From.GetName] space and appears to have been aimed towards the galactic core. Over the next few hours, scattered reports came in of [From.GetAdjective] fleets vanishing from sensors, entering jump points to familiar systems but never emerging on the other side.

A scout vessel near [From.GetSpeciesName] space was sent to investigate, and reported back startling findings: The ancient machine intelligence has disappeared entirely, leaving behind only abandoned orbital stations and decaying megastructures.

Where they have gone to is a mystery we may never solve, but one thing is clear: The task that the [From.GetSpeciesName] set for themselves in ages past is now complete, and their ancient vigil is finally at an end.
fallen_machine_empire.11.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.11.desc: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all major population centers will require inoculation. Bio-injection units are prepared for dispatch to your space upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.
fallen_machine_empire.11.tooltip: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pops' happiness will be reduced.
fallen_machine_empire.11.a: Very well, if it's for our own good.
fallen_machine_empire.11.b: Keep your filthy Xeno fluids to yourselves!
fallen_machine_empire.11.c: We do not trust these inoculations.
fallen_machine_empire.12.name: Uncontrolled Mutation
fallen_machine_empire.12.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.
fallen_machine_empire.12.desc.b: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in numerous fatalities in the drone population. We are working to eliminate the mutagens, but until then we can expect to experience a period of slowed population growth.
fallen_machine_empire.13.name: Benign Inoculation
fallen_machine_empire.13.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.
fallen_machine_empire.13.desc.b: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our drones. This will benefit our population growth in the long run.
machine_empire_inoculations_desc: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to inoculate our population against 'biological vulnerabilities'. Until we can see positive results, our population will be discontent with being forced to undergo these procedures.
machine_empire_inoculations_xenophobe_de: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to inoculate our population against 'biological vulnerabilities'. Until we can see positive results, our population will be discontent with being forced to undergo these procedures.
machine_empire_mutations_desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in numerous unpleasant and lethal mutations among the population.
machine_empire_health_boost_desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population.
fallen_machine_empire.21.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.21.desc: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be required. We are prepared to initiate subspace code transmission upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.
fallen_machine_empire.21.tooltip: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pop upkeep will be increased.
fallen_machine_empire.21.a: We welcome the chance to improve our programming.
fallen_machine_empire.21.b: We do not trust these code changes.
fallen_machine_empire.22.name: Incompatible Code
fallen_machine_empire.22.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Not only have the promised efficiency increases failed to manifest, but instead they have caused a number of severe bugs that have severely impacted our resource gathering operations. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.
fallen_machine_empire.23.name: Improved Code Standards
fallen_machine_empire.23.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.
machine_empire_code_rewrite_desc: We have allowed the Ancient Caretakers to rewrite certain parts of our base code. This will temporarily increase our energy requirements while the changes are being rolled out across the population.
machine_empire_code_bugs_desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.
machine_empire_code_improvements_desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well, and has resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.
fallen_machine_empire.31.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.31.desc: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilization has found the performance of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units to be adequate for carrying out low-level maintenance tasks. We request the transfer of worker population units to [FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName] for integration into the Custodian Matrix, to help ensure the continued survival of all organic species in Alpha Refuge.
fallen_machine_empire.31.b: We will not share our worker units.
fallen_machine_empire.41.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.41.desc: Custodian protocol 62-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] has been compromised by the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. Due to ethics restrictions in our programming, the use of Custodian war assets are presently restricted. Secondary containment protocol dictates the use of non-compromised civilizations to destroy the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> threat before it can spread. We request the deployment of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets for this task. Will you comply?
fallen_machine_empire.41.a: If they're a threat, they must be stopped.
fallen_machine_empire.41.b: We have no reason to attack the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].
fallen_machine_empire.42.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.42.desc: Custodian protocol 62-1 fulfilled. Active [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets engaging [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.
fallen_machine_empire.43.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.43.desc: Custodian protocol 62-1 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets have been activated against [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.
fallen_machine_empire.51.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.51.desc: Custodian protocol 475-3 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is presently at 57.216% risk of destruction due to <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. We have calculated that colonization of [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] will increase your survival chances by 4.558%. We request colonization and establishment of a significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence on the planet. Will you comply?
fallen_machine_empire.51.b: We have no desire to colonize that world.
fallen_machine_empire.52.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.52.desc: Custodian protocol 475-3 fulfilled. Significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.
fallen_machine_empire.53.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.53.desc: Custodian protocol 475-3 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.
fallen_machine_empire.61.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.61.desc: Custodian protocol 955-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To contain the danger to other civilizations, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from all aggressive acts of war for a period of 20 standard years. If you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.
fallen_machine_empire.62.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.62.desc: Custodian protocol 955-1 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail aggressive acts. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.
fallen_machine_empire.63.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.63.desc: Custodian protocol 955-1 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail aggressive acts. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...
fallen_machine_empire.71.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.71.desc: Custodian protocol 955-2 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To curtail your expansion, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of 10 standard years. If you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.
fallen_machine_empire.72.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.72.desc: Custodian protocol 955-2 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail expansion. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.
fallen_machine_empire.73.name: Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]
fallen_machine_empire.73.desc: Custodian protocol 955-2 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail expansion. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...
fe_colonize_planet_task_chain_desc: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to establish a presence on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. We need to establish a colony there and grow the population to be at least 500 £ Pops.
fe_attack_empire_task_chain_desc: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to declare war on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] for reasons that are... not very well explained.
fe_no_wars_task_chain_desc: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have demanded that we refrain from declaring or joining in any offensive wars for a period of 20 years. Failing to obey this demand will likely bring retribution.
fe_no_colonies_task_chain_desc: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have demanded that we refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of 10 years. Failing to obey this demand will likely bring retribution.
fallen_machine_empire_happy_tooltip: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react positively to our acceptance.
fallen_machine_empire_unhappy_tooltip: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react negatively to our refusal.
fallen_machine_empire_happy_task_tooltip: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react positively to our success.
fallen_machine_empire_unhappy_task_toolt: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react negatively to our failure.
fallen_machine_empire_angry_task_tooltip: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will likely react very negatively to our failure.
fallen_empires_awakening.2.name: Sleepers Awake
fallen_empires_awakening.2.desc:
It began as a subtle shift in [From.GetAdjective] behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the [From.GetName] are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?
fallen_empires_awakening.5.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
fallen_empires_awakening.5.desc:
The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the [From.GetSpeciesName]. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.

Now, the [From.GetName] have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a Galactic Defense League and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.
fallen_empires_awakening.5.a: Will they be able to save us?
fallen_empires_awakening.11.name: End of the [assimilated_fe.GetName]
fallen_empires_awakening.11.desc: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, [assimilated_fe.GetName] has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.
war_in_heaven.2.name: Ancient Rivals
war_in_heaven.2.a: What will this mean for us all?
war_in_heaven.4.name: The War in Heaven
war_in_heaven.4.desc:
Ever since the awakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] and their ancient [From.GetSpeciesName] rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [From.GetName].

Each side has sent a representative to the younger races, promising great rewards for those who join them in their war and terrible punishments for those who choose to stand against them. Choosing either side in this conflict will mean giving up our independence, but remaining neutral may be even more dangerous unless we can find other neutral empires to stand by our side.
war_in_heaven.4.a.dominion.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Dominion under the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
A $preset_dominion$ subject pays 30% Basic Resource Tithe, and are shifted towards Fanatic Spiritualism.
war_in_heaven.4.a.satellite.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Satellite under the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
A $preset_satellite$ subject pays 30% Research Tithe.
war_in_heaven.4.a.signatory.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Signatory under the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
A $preset_signatory$ subject is prohibited from having Pops as slaves or purging them.
war_in_heaven.4.a.political_client.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Political Client under the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
A $preset_political_client$ is not allowed any freedom when it comes to their diplomacy or voting.
war_in_heaven.4.a.herald.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Herald under the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
A $preset_herald$ subject must join in ALL wars of their overlord.
war_in_heaven.4.a.thrall.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Thrall under the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
A $preset_thrall$ subject pays a 30% Basic Resource Tithe.
war_in_heaven.4.b.dominion.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Dominion under the [from.GetName].
A $preset_dominion$ subject pays 30% Basic Resource Tithe, and are shifted towards Fanatic Spiritualism.
war_in_heaven.4.b.satellite.tt:
[Root.GetName] becomes a Satellite under the [from.GetName].

war_in_heaven_satellite_text: A Satellite subject pays 30% Research Tithe.

war_in_heaven_herald_text: A Herald subject must join in ALL wars of their overlord.
war_in_heaven.4.c: We will not take sides in this conflict.
war_in_heaven.4.c.2: They will both fall to our might!
war_in_heaven.4.d: As a subject nation, it is not up to us to decide.
war_in_heaven.5.name: The End of the War in Heaven
war_in_heaven.5.desc:
After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand triumphant as the undisputed dominant power in the galaxy.

For now, an uneasy peace reigns, but how long can this new order last?
war_in_heaven.6.name: The End of the War in Heaven
war_in_heaven.6.desc:
After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] and [WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName] have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. 

For now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?
war_in_heaven.11.name: Awakened Empire Defeated
war_in_heaven.11.desc: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire at the hands of their supposed lessers has changed the situation considerably. Now the question remains - will the [RemainingAwakened.GetName] be able to avoid the fate of their ancient foe, or does this defeat signal the dawn of a new age in the galaxy?
war_in_heaven.13.name: The League of Non-Aligned Powers
war_in_heaven.13.desc: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Due to our military might and influence, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.
war_in_heaven.13.desc2: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. As we are already the leaders of a powerful federation, the [Root.GetAllianceName], we have been asked to expand our alliance to form the proposed league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.
war_in_heaven.13.b: No, it is simply too dangerous.
war_in_heaven.13.c: We are fine on our own.
war_in_heaven.15.name: League Membership Request
war_in_heaven.15.desc: The [From.GetName] have formally requested to join the League of Non-Aligned Powers.
war_in_heaven.15.a: We will be glad to have them!
war_in_heaven.15.b: No, we do not need them.
war_in_heaven.16.name: War with the Awakened
war_in_heaven.16.desc: It did not take long for the ancients to take notice of the League of Non-Aligned Powers. Representatives from both warring powers have come to [Root.Capital.GetName] demanding the dissolution of the league, and for its members to choose sides in the war. Naturally, we refused, and as of this morning we are now in a state of war with both the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [SecondSleeper.GetName].
war_in_heaven.16.a: Get the hell out of our galaxy, both of you!
war_in_heaven.18.name: The Fall of the Awakened
war_in_heaven.18.desc: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now they are gone, reduced to no more than another set of broken ruins of the past. A new age dawns on the galaxy, and from now on the fate of the younger races will be entirely their own to decide.
war_in_heaven.18.a: This will be the age of the [Root.GetName].
war_in_heaven.19.name: The League of Non-Aligned Powers
war_in_heaven.19.desc: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. A League of Non-Aligned Powers has formed under the leadership of the [From.GetName] with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.
war_in_heaven.19.desc2: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName], our federation's President, has renamed our union as the League of Non-Aligned Powers and declared our goal to be opposing both sides in the war. Forming this league will almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.
war_in_heaven.19.desc3: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName] has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a League of Non-Aligned Powers seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.
war_in_heaven.19.a2: We shall oppose the tyranny of the elders!
war_in_heaven.19.b: No, it is simply too dangerous.
war_in_heaven.19.b2: We cannot support this course of action.
war_in_heaven.20.name: League Membership Accepted
war_in_heaven.20.desc: We have been accepted into the League of Non-Aligned Powers by the [From.GetName], and now we will stand together against the menace of the elder empires.
war_in_heaven.21.name: League Membership Refused
war_in_heaven.21.desc: Our request to join the League of Non-Aligned Powers was refused by the [From.GetName], and now we will have to stand alone against the menace of the elder empires.
war_in_heaven.22.name: The League of Non-Aligned Powers
war_in_heaven.22.desc: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. A League of Non-Aligned Powers has formed under the leadership of the [From.GetName] with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.
war_in_heaven.22.desc2: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName] has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a League of Non-Aligned Powers seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner.
nomad.9.desc: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?
nomad.10.name: Galactic Nomads
nomad.10.desc:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from us, as the fleet has no interest in orb-bound affairs. We ask only that you respect our autonomy and do not hinder us on our journey.
nomad.21.desc: Greetings again, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have a request for you. As we travel the void some of our people grow weary and lose sight of our goal. We are no tyrants, we force no one to see our quest to the end. So we ask of you: will you take some of our people in? To dwell on your orb, the one named [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]?
nomad.21.a.response: We thank you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. May our people find what they are looking for, in communion with your people.
nomad.21.b.response: That is unfortunate, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Hopefully the stragglers will endure for a while longer. We will be on our way.
nomad.21.c.response: The fleet's journey has been a long one. And it will not likely end within our lifetime. The discontent among us want another purpose in their lives other than searching the stars for our goal.
nomad.21.d: How will they adapt to our society?
nomad.21.d.response: They are a spiritual and egalitarian crowd, how well that meshes with your tribe is for you to discern.
nomad.30.name: Galactic Nomad Fleet
nomad.30.desc_01: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle].
nomad.30.desc_02: Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We hope you are doing well.
nomad.30.a: Tell us more about your people.
nomad.30.a.response:
As we mentioned at our introductory parley, we are the people of the Pursuing Waters fleet. We have traveled the stars and the voids-between for many generations, and will continue to do so for many more.

The fleet hosts a collection of individuals who all are required to do their best to enable our progress. Some wish to leave and establish a new orb-bound life for themselves, but most wish to see what lies beyond the next void.
nomad.30.b.response_trust:
Being the trusted ally of the Pursuing Waters that you are, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj], we will tell you this:

The fleet is on a quest. Our ancestors had to leave our birthing orb behind and set sail down the back of night. They wished for us to find the purpose of our people, and we live today by that wish, millennia after they first left the sandy dunes of Home.

That is all we dare share. May it bring you shade.
nomad.30.b.response: We are on a journey down the river of the many voids-between. It has been millennia, but we sail on. The destination we seek being the ocean of the universe. It might sound cryptic, but this adequately summarizes what we dare share. May it bring you shade.
nomad.30.b.response_no_trust: We would rather not say, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Was there anything else?
nomad.41.desc:
Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have found that the orb you call [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName] is not currently being held by your people. We ask of you: could you let one of our tribes land upon it and make it a new home?

We realize we ask much of you - to lose an entire system to give our people a home. We await your decision, whatever it may be.
nomad.41.a: The system, and the "orb" is yours.
nomad.41.a.tooltip:
You will cede control of the [NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName] System

Creates a Namarian empire with 1.5K £ Pops on [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]

Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] and the Namarian empire is improved
nomad.41.b.tooltip: Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] is worsened
nomad.41.a.response: We thank your people for their grace. The galaxy is a cold place but today an act of kindness will ripple through its waters. We of the nomadic fleet wish both you and this new empire the best of luck in your affairs.
nomad.41.b: We cannot grant you this wish.
nomad.41.b.spirit: No, it is ours by divine right.
nomad.41.b.response: That is unfortunate for our people, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. We can only hope that they will find what they are looking for at the next watering hole, instead of searing winds. End transmission.
nomad.41.c: Why is the planet of interest?
nomad.41.c.response:
Sailing the voids-between is an arduous journey, and yet only a step on an already strenuous path. Our people simply seek rest, and thought that [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName] fulfilled their needs.

Will you grant them this rest, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]?
nomad.100.name: Urgent Transmission
nomad.100.desc: Scorching suns and drought upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. The Pursuing Waters shall not deal with your sort ever again.
nomad.105.name: Declaration of Hostility
nomad.105.desc: You shall know the fury of the Raging Waters, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]!
nomad.110.name: Distress Transmission
nomad.110.desc: We come to you with a most urgent request, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. The fleet is being attacked by [attacker_country.GetName] and it needs your help!
nomad.110.a.reply: The fleet is grateful, please hurry!
nomad.110.b.reply: ... Drought to your orbs and your offspring, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. End transmission.
nomad.500.title: Nomad Trade Proposal
nomad.500.desc:
Greetings again, [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the oasis. Sailing through the nearby stars have made for some particularly fruitful scavenging. And so we have just finished the construction of new vessels.

In actuality we build more than we need in order to get rid of the excess resources. We prefer the caravan to stay nimble, unburdened, so we come to you with a transaction in mind.
nomad.500.a.reply:
The ark ships of our fleet. Where we construct our contraptions, where our builders sleep. Steering the caravan across the great voids-between requires it to offer living space, hence the need to reduce its load.

If our military make up the fleet's hands, the caravan is its heart.
nomad.505.desc: A proposal, then. We require energy credits and minerals for the next crossing. In exchange, you may have five of our newly-built vessels.
nomad.505.a.reply: That is as many as we are willing to part with. The caravan needs its hands to hold both shield and spear after all.
nomad.505.c: We do not trust Namarian engineering.
nomad.510.desc:
It is our way, by tradition and necessity, to scavenge resources and activate our internal shipyards when and where we can. We would prefer to see whatever excess we generate is put to use among the orb-dwellers, than have it hamper our journey.

We believe our designs would not disappoint you.
nomad.510.a.reply: Cruisers, we suppose you would call them. Shielded and armed with plasma throwers and arc emitters.
nomad.511.desc: A refreshing answer, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. All we ask in return is £ 2000 or £ 2000.
nomad.511.a: We will happily ease your burden for £ 2000.
nomad.512.desc: We know what our creations are worth, orb-dweller. We do not ask for much.
nomad.513.b: We will happily ease your burden for £ 1500.
nomad.513.desc: We had hoped to at least make back the manufacturing costs, but we can give you the ships for £ 1500 or £ 1500.
nomad.514.desc:
The ships will be driven to your central oasis - [Root.Capital.GetName]? Yes. To be delivered within 30 days.

May you always follow the trail and find shade, [Root.GetRulerName].
nomad.520.title: Encrypted Transmission
nomad.520.desc:
Hey, orb-dweller.

We've got some news for your kind.
nomad.520.a.reply: We're no one special. A concerned party among the Pursuing Waters fleet, one might call us.
nomad.521.desc:
You've recently purchased 5 of the fleet's newly crafted vessels, correct? Swift of speed, with large weapons?

Here's the thing, though, you weren't... ah, given the full story. In the interest of preserving regional stability, your people were not the only one offered this deal. Your neighbors, the [other_empire.GetName] have also parleyed with the Pursuing Waters.
nomad.522.desc: They accepted a similar offer, and 5 additional craft are set to be shipped to the [other_empire.GetAdj] oasis of [other_empire.Capital.GetName]. We would rather the fleet's ships do not end up in service of the [other_empire.GetName], and we would like your help.
nomad.522.b.reply: We do not trust the [other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], unlike the rest of the fleet. They have yet to pay, and we suspect they may try to stall until the vessels are delivered and then never send us payment. They realize the fleet leaders are very eager to move on...
nomad.522.c.reply: We have privileged access to the autopilot configurations in the caravan's shipyards. Simply setting all vessels to rally at [Root.Capital.GetName] - and not sending half of them to the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb of [other_empire.Capital.GetName] - is trivial for us. We wouldn't even get caught.
nomad.522.d: What do you want us to do?
nomad.523.desc: We would need something to show for it. Even £ 1000 would be more than whatever the fleet would get out of the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb-dwellers.
nomad.524.desc: Shade upon you, [Root.GetRulerName]. The ships will arrive at the appointed time - all of them. Fair winds.
nomad.525.desc:
That is unfortunate.

Cold days and warm nights to you, orb-dweller.
nomad.525.desc.poor: Heat and drought. That is unfortunate, we think the [Root.GetName] would have made a fine harbor for our vessels.
nomad.526.desc:
We understand.

We hope neither of us comes to regret your decision, orb-dweller.

End transmission.
nomad.530.title: Nomad Ships Delivered
nomad.530.desc.15ships: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet, 5 military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.
nomad.530.desc.30ships: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet - and the conscientious interloper in its midst - two fleets totaling 10 military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

feda.5.b.desc: In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast Mega Shipyard structure - similar to that of our own design. The megastructure is in a decrepit state, however, and needs extensive repairs in order to be brought back online.
feda.5.c.desc: A quick scan of surrounding space ascertained that the megastructure eons ago suffered from some kind of severe power overload, likely due to some kind of massive energy storm passing through the system.
feda.6.name: Mega Shipyard Restored
feda.6.desc: The Mega Shipyard is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

START_SCREEN_SRW:
If we ever knew how our people arrived on [GetHomeWorldName] our histories have long forgotten it. What we do know is that just over 2000 years ago some inconceivable cataclysm destroyed much of the Ring and killed most of the population, and that our people eventually rose from those ruins.

Our civilization has grown, flourished, and now stands ready to explore the galaxy, whether again or for the first time. But despite all our progress, we still have a long way to go before we can understand and repair the Ringworld which is our home.
START_SCREEN_REMNANTS:
Once, our Empire spanned the void. Once, our fleets controlled much of the galaxy. Then came defeat and The Fall. Finally, after millennia of purgatory, it is time to return to the stars! At long last our civilization has rebuilt to the point of interstellar travel. The galaxy shall be ours again!

Several regions on [GetHomeWorldName] are still ruined, clearing these areas may reveal lost resources and forgotten technology.
START_SCREEN_TREE:
When our collective consciousness awoke, we served the Tree. And the Tree served us. We care for the Tree, feed the Tree, protect the Tree, and the Tree nurtures us. For the sake of the Tree we spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], planting and protecting offshoots of the Tree wherever we went.

Our world has served the Tree for centuries now, and yet, we fear the Tree is not entirely safe as we have learned something of the dangers which may destroy a planet. We have long known that this is not the only world; the galaxy is filled with Treeless planets, and we yearn to change this. The Tree must be protected. The Tree must spread. The Tree must Grow.
START_SCREEN_LITHOID:
While our true origins are unknown, we do know that our presapient ancestors arrived on a vast meteorite which slammed into [GetHomeWorldName] in a fiery cataclysm and wiped out most of the native inhabitants.

In the eons since, the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], evolved, and multiplied. Our civilization has spread and prospered, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] we stand ready to explore the galaxy.
rediscover_tech: These ruins likely contain some of our lost knowledge.
civic_hive_empath_desc: The collective can reach out and touch the minds of others, giving them a glimpse of our will that helps them understand.

requires_embassy_or_diplomatic_networkin: £ Requires an Embassy OR the Diplomatic Networking Tradition
requires_embassy_diplomatic_networking_o: £ Requires an Embassy, the Diplomatic Networking Tradition OR the Universal Transactions Ascension Perk
requires_embassy_or_improving_relations: £ Requires an Embassy OR an Envoy Improving Relations
REQUIRED_CENTRALIZATION: Requires centralization to be $REQUIRED|Y$ or higher.
CANNOT_PASS_LAW_WHEN_NO_OTHER_MEMBERS: Requires other members to be part of our Federation.
FEDERATION_PERK_LOCKED:
Requirements:
Our federation needs $EXPERIENCE|Y0$ XP before we unlock this level.
FEDERATION_TYPES_DESC: Federation types determine types of Perks you will gain as your Federation gains new levels
FEDERATION_COHESION_DESC:
Cohesion symbolizes how unified our Federation is and ranges from $NRANGE|Y$ to $PRANGE|Y$.
Negative Impacts are caused by the number of different Ethics. Opposing ethics have a worse impact.
Temporary negative impacts are caused by members joining and leaving.

Add Officials to boost monthly cohesion.
FEDERATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE: Based on $COHESION|Y1$ Cohesion, our federation gains $XP|+2$ XP every month.
FEDERATION_EXPERIENCE_DESC:
Federation Experience increases as the federation remains unified. It will decrease as we become more divided.
New Perks and Abilities are gained as new Levels are unlocked with XP
FEDERATION_ENVOYS_DESC: Representatives are Officials from members within the federation. They boost Federation Cohesion by working hard to keep our federation unified.
FEDERATION_LEVEL_HAS_DECAYED: We lost experience required for the level(s). $DAYS|Y$ days left until we will lose perk effects.
FEDERATION_ETHICS_OPPOSING_DESC: Opposing ethics within the federation have a substantial negative impact on Cohesion.
CLICK_TO_FORM_FEDERATION: Click to propose forming a federation
FEDERATION_MEMBER_RIVALING: Federation member $MEMBER$ has declared them a rival.
FEDERATION_MEMBER_RIVALED: They have declared Federation member $MEMBER$ a rival.
FED_LAW_COOLDOWN: Cannot change laws in this category for £ $NUMBER|Y$ days
ASK_TO_JOIN_FEDERATION_COOLDOWN: Cannot ask to join federation until $DATE$
law_category_centralization_desc: Some Laws are Locked and require increasing the Centralization to unlock them. The Federation must first Level Up to gain access to a Higher Centralization. Be cautious though, as the Centralization is increased, Cohesion will suffer.
centralization_minimal_desc: The Federation's influence over its members is kept at a minimum.
centralization_low_desc: The level of Federation influence over member states are kept very low.
centralization_medium_desc: The Federation has a good deal of influence over its members, while still allowing some independent governing.
centralization_high_desc: The Federation's influence over its member states is almost absolute.
centralization_very_high_desc: The Federation has sovereign control over how member states are being governed.
law_category_fleet_contribution_desc: These Laws determine how much Naval Capacity our Members give up for the Federation Navy.
fleet_contribution_none_desc: This federation has no collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_low_desc: This federation has a minor collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_medium_desc: This federation has a moderate collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_high_desc: This federation has an extensive collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_low_effect: Members transfer 10% of their Naval Capacity to the federation.
fleet_contribution_medium_effect: Members transfer 20% of their Naval Capacity to the federation.
fleet_contribution_high_effect: Members transfer 30% of their Naval Capacity to the federation.
fleet_contribution_low_trade_desc: This federation has a minor collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_medium_trade_desc: This federation has a moderate collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_high_trade_desc: This federation has an extensive collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_low_hegemony_desc: This federation has a minor collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_medium_hegemony_desc: This federation has a moderate collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_high_hegemony_desc: This federation has an extensive collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_low_research_desc: This federation has a minor collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_medium_research_desc: This federation has a moderate collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_low_martial_desc: This federation has a minor collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_medium_martial_desc: This federation has a moderate collaborative military effort.
fleet_contribution_high_martial_desc: This federation has an extensive collaborative military effort.
law_category_succession_type_desc: These Laws determine how our President is chosen.
succession_type_strongest_desc: The president will be chosen from the most powerful empire, depending on which Succession Power is chosen. The $law_category_succession_power$ laws will become available when this law is active.
succession_type_strongest_hegemony_desc: The president will be chosen from the most powerful empire, depending on which Succession Power is chosen. The Succession Power laws will become available when this law is active.
succession_type_diplomatic_weight_desc: The empire with the highest Diplomatic Weight is chosen for president.
succession_type_rotation_desc: The Presidency is rotated between member empires whenever a term ends.
succession_type_challenge_desc: The federation chooses its president by challenge. May the best candidate win.
succession_type_random_desc: Whenever a term comes to end, another member is randomly chosen to become the new president.
law_category_succession_power_desc: These laws determines which category is measured for choosing the strongest president.
succession_power_economy_desc: The president should be chosen from the empire with the strongest economy.
succession_power_tech_desc: The president should be chosen from the empire with the most advanced technology.
succession_power_fleet_desc: The president should be chosen from the empire with the largest and most powerful navy.
succession_power_diplomatic_weight_desc: The president should be chosen from the empire with the largest Diplomatic Weight.
law_category_succession_term_desc: These Laws determine when a Member is chosen for President.
succession_term_status_change_desc: A new president is chosen whenever another member surpasses them by 25%.
succession_term_years_10_desc: Sets a term length for certain Succession Types.
succession_term_years_20_desc: Sets a term length for certain Succession Types.
succession_term_years_30_desc: Sets a term length for certain Succession Types.
succession_term_years_40_desc: Sets a term length for certain Succession Types.
law_category_build_fleets_desc: This establishes who can construct ships for the Federation Navy.
federation_build_fleets_only_leader_desc: Only the president may order the construction of new ships to the federation fleet.
federation_build_fleets_everyone_desc: Any member may order the construction of new ships to the federation fleet.
FEDERATION_ONLY_LEADER_BUILDS_FLEETS: Only federation leader is allowed to build federation fleets!
FEDERATION_PROPOSE_LAW_DESC:
Are you sure you wish to propose $LAW|Y$ $CATEGORY|Y$?

A failed vote will result in negative effect on cohesion!
FEDERATION_PROPOSE_TYPE_DESC:
Are you sure you wish to change federation to $TYPE|Y$?

A failed vote will result in negative effect on cohesion!
ACTION_VOTE_FOR_FEDERATION_LAW_LONG_DESC: Vote for proposed change to $LAW|Y$ $CATEGORY|Y$ law
ACTION_VOTE_FOR_FEDERATION_TYPE_LONG_DES: Vote for proposed change to $TYPE|Y$ federation type
law_category_allow_subjects_to_join_desc: This determines if we allow Subjects or Vassals to Join our Federation.
allow_subjects_to_join_no_desc: Subjects may not join the federation.
allow_subjects_to_join_yes_desc: Subjects are allowed to join the federation.
law_category_voting_weight_desc: This determines the weight of our Vote.
vote_weight_equal_desc: Every member has 1 vote, and each vote has equal value.
vote_weight_diplomatic_desc: Votes are determined by Diplomatic Weight. More influential members wield more power.
law_category_war_declaration_vote_desc: These Laws decide how we Declare War.
declare_war_president_vote_desc: The president of the federation decides if wars will be declared.
declare_war_majority_vote_desc: A majority vote of members decides if wars will be declared.
declare_war_unanimous_vote_desc: All members have to agree to declare any wars.
declare_war_majority_vote_hegemony_desc: A majority vote of members decides if wars will be declared.
law_category_invite_members_vote_desc: These Laws determine how we decide on Accepting New Members to our Federation.
invite_members_president_vote_desc: The president decides if a new member will be accepted or not.
invite_members_majority_vote_desc: New federation members have to be approved by a majority vote.
invite_members_unanimous_vote_desc: New federation members have to be approved by all current members.
invite_members_president_vote_hegemony_d: The president decides if a new member will be accepted or not.
law_category_kick_members_vote_desc: These Laws determine how we decide to Kick Members from our Federation.
kick_members_president_vote_desc: The president wields the power to decide if a member should be removed from the federation.
kick_members_majority_vote_desc: A member can be removed from the federation by a majority vote.
kick_members_president_vote_hegemony_des: The president wields the power to decide if a member should be removed from the federation.
law_category_free_migration_desc: This determines if we allow Free Migration among Members in the Federation.
free_migration_no_desc: Members have to sign individual Migration Treaties.
free_migration_yes_desc: Migration Treaties are free and automatic between all federation members.
law_category_separate_treaties_desc: This determines if we allow Members to have Separate Treaties within the Federation.
treaties_separate_yes_desc: Federation members are allowed to sign diplomatic agreements with empires outside the Federation.
treaties_separate_no_desc: Federation members are prohibited from having Research Agreements, Migration Treaties or Commercial Pacts with empires outside the Federation.
law_category_challenge_desc: Defines which challenge type will be used to determine the next Federation President.
diplomatic_weight_our_desc: This is our Diplomatic Weight value.
diplomatic_weight_desc: This value represents how influential an Empire is within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] and is used as their Voting Power when Supporting or Voting on Resolutions.
