federation_internal_migration: Free Migration is Enabled by Federation Law, so we already have a migration treaty by default.
federation_actor_no_separate_treaties: Separate Treaties is Prohibited by Federation Law, so we cannot have separate treaties with empires who are not members of our federation.
federation_recipient_no_separate_treatie: Their Separate Treaties is Prohibited by Federation Law, so they cannot enter into such an agreement.
federation_automatic_research: We already have free and automatic Research Agreements due to being in a Research Cooperative federation.
trade_federation_desc: This Federation has a distinct focus on free markets and economic growth.
research_federation_desc: This Federation leans towards technocracy, with an acute focus on discerning universal truths.
military_federation_desc: Members of this Federation seek to close their ranks around the ideals of camaraderie, martial prowess and military cooperation.
hegemony_federation_desc: Federations of this type are most often built around one powerful empire surrounded by lesser satellite states.
spiritualist_federation_desc: This Federation promotes spiritualist scholarship, and asserts reverence for all things divine.
federation_fleet_size_1_desc: Interoperability and deployability of our combined fleet are greatly enhanced by conducting frequent naval exercises, with command rotating between the flag officers of all member states.
federation_fleet_size_2_desc: Agreeing upon common ammunition, fuel, and other vital consumables means our various member fleets can more easily be resupplied, and can thus stay in action longer.
federation_fleet_size_3_desc: Linking all member navies in a single, unified FTL command net allows us to coordinate fleet actions of a hitherto unprecedented scale.
federation_fleet_size_effect: The amount members contribute towards the Federation Naval Capacity counts for +25% more.
federation_fleet_speed_1_desc: Well-charted and patrolled hyperspace corridors within our territory permit unparalleled freedom of movement, allowing our navies to rapidly concentrate wherever required.
federation_fleet_speed_effect: Ship Speed is increased by +10% while in federation space.
federation_fire_rate_1_desc: Defense has the advantage tactically, but commanders have known since ancient days that only attack can achieve the ultimate object of war: to compel the enemy to obey our will.
admiral_level_cap_1_desc: Thorough and modern training academies backed up by centuries of spacefaring tradition make our officer corps the finest in the galaxy.
claim_cost_1_desc: We desire friendly relations with all neighboring nations. If friendly relations cannot be achieved due to intransigence by their current governments, we can - and will - install new ones.
job_output_1_desc: Freed of the toxic, internecine bickering that characterized interstellar relations before the rise of our union, partner states can now focus their energies on productive labor for the good of all.
job_output_2_desc: The grand idea which unifies our peoples is more important than the whims or convenience of any individual being. Sacrifices must be made on the path to progress.
job_output_3_desc: We need no longer confront the angst and doubt of questions about our role in the federation. When asked 'how much should we be prepared to give?', the only answer is 'everything'.
research_share_1_desc: No being can 'own' knowledge. We hereby resolve to break with the practice of hoarding scientific discovery - one which impedes true progress in the galaxy.
research_share_1_effect: Federal Research Agreements have their Research Speed increased by 5%.
research_share_2_desc: Every member species had their own version of taxonomy, the periodic table, and other tools of knowledge exchange. By settling on a common lexicon, ideas can be transmitted with minimal confusion.
research_share_3_desc: A great invention that never leaves its homeworld is of limited academic or social value. We will incentivize license production of such innovations to speed their propagation.
research_share_4_desc: The UD has become a sort of technological holy text, containing the accumulated knowledge of all our member species. Even if individuals forget, or if empires fall, the UD will endure.
research_boost_1_desc: If new prototypes and theories are conveyed to every research institution in our cooperative via FTL comms, they can be subjected to multiple sources of independent review, and perfected with lightning speed.
rare_tech_boost_desc: The interstellar, multi-species nature of our cooperative exposes scientists to perspectives quite literally alien to their own, resulting in a great boost to outside-the-box thinking.
rare_tech_boost_effect: Rare technologies already unlocked by another federation member now appear at 2 times the normal rate. This effect would change a 1% chance into a 2% chance.
crisis_research_1_desc: When faced with an obvious and imminent threat to all galactic life, the scientific community must be prepared to set aside abstract experimentation in favor of purely defensive applications.
crisis_research_1_effect:
Member Modifier:
During an ongoing Endgame Crisis, gain 10% Research Speed.
crisis_research_2_desc: No taboo is too strong, no moral precept too sacrosanct, when the only alternative is complete annihilation.
tech_diplo_weight_1_desc: We will reorganize our society according to the radical idea that those who possess expert knowledge within a certain sphere shall wield decision-making power there.
president_option_1_desc: Purely theoretical science plays a vital role, of course, but there are cases where targeted research - following priorities designated at the highest level - can have enormous impact.
president_megastructure_1_desc: The ability of the executive branch to concentrate league logistical power on designated strategic projects will help to preserve the balance of power, and defend our way of life.
unity_boost_1_desc: Our citizens take rightful pride in our role in galactic affairs. The reputation for fair and open dealings with all beings - members or not - fosters a sense of peaceful purpose.
unity_boost_2_desc: More than the words of any individual, the proclamation of a universal code of sentient rights has been the greatest ambassador for our federation, and the better galaxy we are striving to create.
president_unity_1_desc: When one of our own assumes the presidential seat, we all feel a deep sense of unity and purpose in this great, shared endeavor. We will go forward together.
trade_value_1_desc: The first step to building a truly prosperous and healthily competitive business environment is to remove systematic barriers to the movement of goods and services. Short term local economic disruptions will be overtaken by macro-scale efficiencies.
trade_value_2_desc: Just as was done on all of our diverse homeworlds in the pre-FTL era, we must again agree upon a galactic standard set of measures for time, weight, distance, and value.
trade_value_3_desc: Peaceful and mutually profitable cooperation between league member states has, over time, built up a form of 'brand loyalty' in consumer behavior. Our citizens, without much prompting, just seem to prefer to buy from other league members - knowing that much of the benefit will indirectly return to themselves.
trade_value_4_desc: We will now move to formalize the trade links between our constituent states, so that we all benefit whenever anything is bought or sold in or near our territory. Why buy anywhere else?
trade_protection_1_desc: No amount of material progress will matter if manufactured goods cannot arrive at their destination due to corruption and theft. Our robust enforcement of interstellar anti-piracy ordinances will ensure the league's economic health.
president_trade_value_1_desc: Just like the sea lanes of old, sitting athwart the main arteries of galactic trade grants considerable financial benefits.
extra_envoy_1_desc: The better future we're striving to build will only work if all beings are aware of what we mean to achieve. We intend to become a pervasive, persuasive force for peace in the galaxy.
extra_influence_1_desc: Rising to the highest office in our federation is no royal coronation; it is a limitless commitment in service to all sentient life. Nevertheless, the presidency comes with a great deal of prestige.
diplomacy_upkeep_1_desc: Mutually beneficial agreements between member nations are much easier to coordinate when supervisory agents from the leader nation are directly embedded in each member's governing apparatus.
diplomacy_upkeep_1_effect: Research Agreements and Migration Pacts between federations members cost no £ Influence in their upkeep.
diplo_weight_1_desc: With a record of long, fruitful cooperation within the alliance, federation members - who are of course free to vote as they choose - do tend to align on key issues over time.
damage_crisis_1_desc: Collective deterrence against hegemonic aggressors has preserved the fragile peace of this galaxy. We will stand together against all who threaten that order, whether from within or without.
damage_crisis_2_desc: If we intend to possess the moral authority to govern, we need to show the galaxy we have not just the will to defend it from outside threats, but also the means.
envoy_unity_1_desc: The arbiters of the federation agenda - our envoys - are savvy and active in their effort to improve the sense of belonging and mutual benefit between our members.
envoy_unity_1_effect: Gain 2 Unity and 5% Trust Growth for each Official assigned to the federation by any member.
envoy_unity_2_desc: Our envoys work ceaselessly to promote and encourage the federation's agenda and purpose, inspiring kinship and confidence across the galaxy.
envoy_unity_2_effect: Gain 2 Unity and raise Trust Cap by 5 for each Official assigned to the federation by any member.
cohesion_join_1_desc: Regardless of cultural or biological differences, growth of the federation is to everyone's benefit.
cohesion_join_1_effect: New members impose a 50% smaller Cohesion penalty to the federation.
cohesion_failed_vote_1_desc: There is no better crucible for trying out ideas than a heated debate, and dispute is a great tool when the aim is to build a stabile future.
cohesion_failed_vote_1_effect: Failed federation votes impose a 50% smaller Cohesion penalty to the federation.
federation_fleet_unity_1_desc: To know that our joined fleets are patrolling the void bestows our members with a sense of pride, security and resolve.
federation_fleet_unity_1_effect: £ Monthly Unity equal to 10% of the size of the Federation Fleet.
president_keep_navy_1_desc: Leading by example can be a powerful and inspiring thing, and thus the leader is free of any restrictions that would prevent this.
president_keep_navy_1_effect: Federation president contributes to federation fleet capacity without deducting their own naval capacity.
president_hegemony_cb_1_desc: If they're not with us, they're against us. Any - and every - force that oppose us must be considered a threat, and dealt with accordingly.
president_hegemony_cb_1_effect: President gets the Establish Hegemony Wargoal to force a non-federation empire to join the federation.
president_diplo_weight_steal_1_desc: The might of the ruler cannot be undermined at any point. Full and active support from the hegemony's subjects is imperative.
president_diplo_weight_steal_1_effect: Every member transfers 10% of their Diplomatic Weight to the president.
spiritualist_federation_passive_desc: This Federation promotes spiritualist scholarship, and asserts reverence for all things divine.
spiritualist_envoys_1_desc: Many are the sacrileges that our representatives may prevent.
spiritualist_envoys_1_effect: £ Officials assigned to the Federation will now provide 50% more Cohesion and increase Spiritualist ethic attraction within our Empire by 20%.
culture_workers_1_desc: Our blend of cultural identities is our strength. By promoting it, we will immeasurably increase our might.
culture_workers_1_effect:
£ Produced per 100 [civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural]: +1
[civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural] gain additional effects from Empire's ethics.
president_spiritualist_1_desc: We cannot guarantee that spiritualist interests will be protected unless we are able to encode them into galactic law.
unity_trade_1_desc: The priestly orders cannot thrive without wealth. We shall harness the power of commerce to grant them greater prosperity - and therefore put us closer to fulfilling our spiritual aims.
unity_trade_1_effect: Grants access to the Holy Covenant Trade Policy, which converts 50% of our £ Trade into £ $concept_unity$.
ascension_shared_1_desc: The ever greater closeness of our union shall bear fruit in the prosperity and spiritual wellbeing of our peoples.
president_spiritualist_2_desc: Leadership of this holy covenant is a grand step towards spiritual ascension.
all_the_priests_1_desc: The more priests, the less spiritual impurity we will be forced to tolerate.
all_the_priests_1_effect: £ Unity-focused Colony Designations will produce an extra +1 £ Priests jobs per 25 £ Pops (this can be further increased via Colony Ascension).
all_the_priests_2_desc: With our increased focus on matters of spirituality, the priestly classes have swelled to unwieldy proportions. The most talented among them shall now be promoted into an expanded ecclesiastical leadership.
all_the_priests_2_effect: Sacred Nexuses and equivalent buildings provide +100 £ High Priests.
president_spiritualist_3_desc: The Shroud is the future. We shall make it ours.
make_spiritualist_1_desc: Our faith is at the core of the holy covenant. No more shall heresies be permitted: all members must pull their weight if they are to remain within our union.
make_spiritualist_1_effect:
Non-spiritualist non-gestalt empires have Bureaucratic buildings swapped for Temples.
Spiritualist empires gain +1 £ $concept_unity$ Produced per 100 £ Priests.
All empires face 30% slower robotic pop assembly but +15% faster organic pop growth.
zro_catalysis_1_desc: Zro deposits are a largely untapped resource. Our best minds can surely find ways to put it to greater use.
zro_catalysis_1_effect: Unlocks the Zro Catalysis Edict, which allows us to convert £ Zro into increased resource output.
president_spiritualist_4_desc: By grace of the Holy Covenant, the president may exercise greater executive power in their realm.
default_federation_passive_desc: Members of this federation have grouped together, recognising that together, they are stronger.
trade_federation_passive_desc: This Federation has a distinct focus on free markets and economic growth.
research_federation_passive_desc: This Federation leans towards technocracy, with an acute focus on discerning universal truths.
military_federation_passive_desc: Members of this Federation seek to close their ranks around the ideals of camaraderie, martial prowess and military cooperation.
hegemony_federation_passive_desc: Federations of this type are most often built around one powerful empire surrounded by lesser satellite states.
default_federation_passive_effect: Diverse Ethics impose a 50% smaller penalty to federation Cohesion.
trade_federation_passive_effect: Grants access to the Trade League Trade Policy, which grants £ $concept_energy$, £ $concept_unity$ and £ Supplies equal to 50% of our collected £ Trade.
hegemony_federation_passive_effect: Members cannot freely leave the federation without the president's approval. If the president refuses, the member gets the Secession Casus Belli to leave the federation.
research_federation_passive_effect: Free and automatic Research Agreements between all federation members.
requires_federation_lvl_2: Requires the federation to be level 2.
requires_federation_lvl_3: Requires the federation to be level 3.
requires_federation_lvl_4: Requires the federation to be level 4.
requires_federation_lvl_5: Requires the federation to be level 5.
requires_centralization_low: Requires Federation Centralization to be Low or higher.
requires_centralization_medium: Requires Federation Centralization to be Medium or higher.
requires_centralization_high: Requires Federation Centralization to be High or higher.
requires_centralization_very_high: Requires Federation Centralization to be Very High.
requires_strongest: Requires Succession Type to be Strongest.
disabled_for_hegemony: A Hegemony cannot ban subject nations from joining.
tech_mega_shipyard_desc: A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.
tech_juggernaut_desc: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.
tech_advanced_metallurgy_1_desc: The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.
tech_advanced_metallurgy_2_desc: By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.
tech_consumer_good_refinement_1_desc: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.
tech_consumer_good_refinement_2_desc: Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.
resolution_galactic_market_form_desc:
De facto galactic trade, unbound by international diplomacy, has existed since the first two interstellar species met.

As galactic leaders we should agree that it is time to legitimize this commercial forum so that all may benefit.
resolution_galactic_market_form_effect_s: Begins the Birth of the Galactic Market event chain.
resolution_galactic_market_form_effect_f: The Galactic Market will not be formed yet.
resolution_ecology_repeal_1_desc: While protecting the environment is clearly important, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be trusted to make their own decisions.
resolution_ecology_repeal_1_effect_succe: Repeals the Pangalactic Recycling Initiatives resolution.
resolution_ecology_repeal_2_desc: While protecting the environment is clearly important, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be trusted to make their own decisions.
resolution_ecology_repeal_2_effect_succe: Repeals the Natural Sanctuaries resolution, leaving Pangalactic Recycling Initiatives as galactic law.
resolution_ecology_repeal_3_desc: While protecting the environment is clearly important, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be trusted to make their own decisions.
resolution_ecology_repeal_3_effect_succe: Repeals the Integrated Gardens resolution, leaving Natural Sanctuaries as galactic law.
resolution_ecology_repeal_4_desc: While protecting the environment is clearly important, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be trusted to make their own decisions.
resolution_ecology_repeal_4_effect_succe: Repeals the Environmental Control Board resolution, leaving Integrated Gardens as galactic law.
resolution_ecology_repeal_5_desc: While protecting the environment is clearly important, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be trusted to make their own decisions.
resolution_ecology_repeal_5_effect_succe: Repeals the The Paradise Initiative resolution, leaving Environmental Control Board as galactic law.
resolution_ecology_recycling_initiatives: We all benefit from reducing waste and reusing what we can. Sharing recycling protocols between the nations of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will help all of us.
resolution_ecology_natural_sanctuaries_d: We should preserve natural spaces as parks, where citizens can escape from their troubles. Minor restrictions to heavy industry are required, but it's a low price to pay.
resolution_ecology_integrated_gardens_de: By encouraging our citizens to grow their own food and mandating easy to use hydroponic systems, we can reduce our impact on the worlds we live in and enjoy more greenery.
resolution_ecology_integrated_gardens_to: £ $concept_unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for Environmentalist Empires: +1 £
in_breach_of_resolution_ecology_environm: In breach of Environmental Control Board
resolution_ecology_environmental_control: Industry cannot regulate itself. We need a multinational environmental control board with the power to oversee industry and development to shut down environmental abuse.

Converting planets into an Ecumenopolis or Terraforming them into anything other than a Gaia World is banned.
£ $concept_unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for Environmentalist Empires: +2 £"
resolution_ecology_paradise_initiative_t:
£ $concept_unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for Environmentalist Empires: +3 £

£ Ranger Jobs from Naturally Occuring Blockers for Environmentalist Empires: +1 £
resolution_ecology_paradise_initiative_d: With meticulous caretaking of our worlds, we can live in ecological harmony. It should be our goal to leave only memories behind where we tread.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_1_desc: Galactic law currently places significant amounts of intellectual property and national security issues at risk. We must repeal these misguided laws in order to protect our people.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_1_effe: Repeals the Cooperative Research Channels resolution.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_2_desc: Galactic law currently places significant amounts of intellectual property and national security issues at risk. We must repeal these misguided laws in order to protect our people.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_2_effe: Repeals the Astral Studies Network resolution, leaving Cooperative Research Channels as galactic law.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_3_desc: Galactic law currently places significant amounts of intellectual property and national security issues at risk. We must repeal these misguided laws in order to protect our people.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_3_effe: Repeals the Advanced Xenostudies resolution, leaving Astral Studies Network as galactic law.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_4_desc: Galactic law currently places significant amounts of intellectual property and national security issues at risk. We must repeal these misguided laws in order to protect our people.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_4_effe: Repeals the Ethical Guideline Refactoring resolution, leaving Advanced Xenostudies as galactic law.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_5_desc: Galactic law currently places significant amounts of intellectual property and national security issues at risk. We must repeal these misguided laws in order to protect our people.
resolution_galacticstudies_repeal_5_effe: Repeals the Extradimensional Experimentation resolution, leaving Ethical Guideline Refactoring as galactic law.
resolution_galacticstudies_cooperative_r: We should establish protocols that permit the scientists of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to share and review discoveries more easily.
resolution_galacticstudies_astral_studie: By linking our starbases together into a massive sensor mesh, we can greatly improve the quality of data that we gather.
Enhances the effectiveness of the Solar Panel Network, Black Hole Observatory, and Listening Post starbase modules and buildings.
resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xeno: There is much to learn from all of the cultures of the universe. We should add additional information-gathering instrumentation to all starbases while working more closely with Enclaves.

Observation Posts provide additional £ Society Research while Observing pre-FTL civilizations.

Enhances the effectiveness of the Orbital Museum, Orbital Science Centre, Salvage Works, and Mercenary Garrison starbase buildings.

The Artificial Intelligence Outlawed and Non-Interference policies are banned.
resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guide: To possess the ability to further science provides a moral imperative to do so, free from outdated ethical concepts that restrain us. We do what we must because we can.

The Restrictions Imposed policy is banned.
Enables the Refactored Restrictions policy.
Empires must use the most powerful Leader Enhancement policy available to them or be in Breach of Galactic Law!

Empires that are Egalitarian may be unable to meet this requirement and will be in Breach of Galactic Law!
resolution_galacticstudies_extradimensio:
Preliminary studies suggest that extensive use of reality-altering substances can grant researchers unexpected insights.

After all, what's the worst that could happen?
Unlocks a planetary decision that consumes £ Zro to fund extradimensional research at Data-Driven Theorem Facility.
pm_extradimensional_experimentation_tool:
Data-Driven Theorem Facility:
£ Upkeep per 100 [GetPhysicistSwapPluralWithIcon]: +1
£ Produced per $pop_group_unit$ $physicist_type_plural_with_icon$: +2
pm_extradimensional_experimentation_desc:
Extradimensional studies are ongoing at this planet's Data-Driven Theorem Facility.

What could possibly go wrong?
decision_extradimensional_experimentatio:
Extradimensional studies are ongoing at this planet's Data-Driven Theorem Facility.

What could possibly go wrong?
decision_end_extradimensional_experiment: This experimentation is dangerous and must end. What were we thinking?
federations.10020.name: Extradimensional Experimentation
federations.10020.desc:
The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our scientists in Data-Driven Theorem Facility to probe other realities for the truth.
federations.10020.desc_gestalt:
The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our [root.GetResearcherPlural] in Data-Driven Theorem Facility to probe other realities for the truth.
resolution_industry_repeal_1_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has no place meddling in industrial matters. We should not be forcing our views on other empires.
resolution_industry_repeal_2_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has no place meddling in industrial matters. We should not be forcing our views on other empires.
resolution_industry_repeal_2_effect_succ: Repeals the Collective Waste Management resolution, leaving Regulatory Facilitation as galactic law.
resolution_industry_repeal_3_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has no place meddling in industrial matters. We should not be forcing our views on other empires.
resolution_industry_repeal_3_effect_succ: Repeals the Building a Better Tomorrow resolution, leaving Collective Waste Management as galactic law.
resolution_industry_repeal_4_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has no place meddling in industrial matters. We should not be forcing our views on other empires.
resolution_industry_repeal_4_effect_succ: Repeals the Environmental Ordinance Waivers resolution, leaving Building a Better Tomorrow as galactic law.
resolution_industry_repeal_5_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has no place meddling in industrial matters. We should not be forcing our views on other empires.
resolution_industry_repeal_5_effect_succ: Repeals the Project Cornucopia resolution, leaving Environmental Ordinance Waivers as galactic law.
resolution_industry_regulatory_facilitat: We should leave regulatory decisions to the experts. Industry leaders are the best qualified to identify wasteful regulations that impede productivity.
resolution_industry_collective_waste_man: Instead of forcing each mine or factory to bear the burden of dealing with industrial waste themselves, we should designate areas where we can store the leftovers of progress.
resolution_industry_building_a_better_to: Progress cannot be limited by any obstacles that stand before us. Let us share techniques with one another to aid us in harnessing and dominating the natural world.
resolution_industry_environmental_ordina: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should empower local councils to suspend antiquated rules that do not serve the public good and are simply blocking progress.
Forge, Industry, and Refinery planetary designations gain additional bonuses.
resolution_industry_project_cornucopia_d: Near-endless resources are at our fingertips, if we have the courage to seize them. Just think of what wonders we could build if we conquer our fear.
resolution_industry_project_cornucopia_t: Unlocks a Planetary Decision that permits strip mining our worlds to uncover rich mineral deposits.
decision_project_cornucopia_desc: Near-endless resources are at our fingertips, if we have the courage to seize them. Just think of what wonders we could build if we conquer our fear.
decision_project_cornucopia_effects_shor: Strip-mines this world, adding +4 Industrial Districts, +5% £ $concept_minerals$ from £ Jobs, and -20% Planet Habitability.
d_project_cornucopia_desc: Extensive strip mining operations made this planet harder to inhabit... And easier to exploit.
federations.10000.name: Project Cornucopia
federations.10000.desc:
Engineers from across the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have come together to share ideas on ways to more exploit resources from our worlds.

The Project Cornucopia Planetary Decision is now available.
resolution_commerce_repeal_1_desc: The free market should be left to its own devices without the meddling of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
resolution_commerce_repeal_2_desc: The free market should be left to its own devices without the meddling of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
resolution_commerce_repeal_2_effect_succ: Repeals the Leveraged Privateering resolution, leaving Buzzword Standardization as galactic law.
resolution_commerce_repeal_3_desc: The free market should be left to its own devices without the meddling of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
resolution_commerce_repeal_3_effect_succ: Repeals the Underdeveloped System Utilization resolution, leaving Leveraged Privateering as galactic law.
resolution_commerce_repeal_4_desc: The free market should be left to its own devices without the meddling of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
resolution_commerce_repeal_4_effect_succ: Repeals the Holistic Asset Coordination resolution, leaving Underdeveloped System Utilization as galactic law.
resolution_commerce_repeal_5_desc: The free market should be left to its own devices without the meddling of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
resolution_commerce_repeal_5_effect_succ: Repeals the Profit Maximization Engines resolution, leaving Holistic Asset Coordination as galactic law.
resolution_commerce_buzzword_standardiza: We have to enable our enterprises to work seamlessly with one another. Streamlining strategic communications empowers our agents, making hitting key performance metrics easier.
resolution_commerce_leveraged_privateeri: Trade is the lifeblood of the galaxy. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should contribute to a multinational space force to combat piracy and other threats to free commerce.
resolution_commerce_underdeveloped_syste: Failure to extract maximum value from the systems within our sphere of influence is a criminal waste. We propose that it be enforced as such and punished accordingly.
Observation Posts provide £ Consumer Goods while Observing pre-FTL civilizations.
resolution_commerce_holistic_asset_coord: To promote and facilitate an optimized logistic output, we should work together to stimulate a streamlined, galactic infrastructure for market and knowledge sharing.
resolution_commerce_profit_maximization_: We should build interlinked complexes of computers on each of our worlds that optimize the distribution of information and resources. The wealth must flow.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_1_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] oversteps its bounds by attempting to tell its members how to live. Frankly, it's insulting.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_1_effect_s: Repeals the Charter of Worker's Rights resolution.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_2_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] oversteps its bounds by attempting to tell its members how to live. Frankly, it's insulting.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_2_effect_s: Repeals the Five Year Plans resolution, leaving Charter of Worker's Rights as galactic law.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_3_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] oversteps its bounds by attempting to tell its members how to live. Frankly, it's insulting.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_3_effect_s: Repeals the Greater Than Ourselves resolution, leaving Five Year Plans as galactic law.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_4_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] oversteps its bounds by attempting to tell its members how to live. Frankly, it's insulting.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_4_effect_s: Repeals the Balance in the Middle resolution, leaving Greater Than Ourselves as galactic law.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_5_desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] oversteps its bounds by attempting to tell its members how to live. Frankly, it's insulting.
resolution_greatergood_repeal_5_effect_s: Repeals the Universal Prosperity Mandate resolution, leaving Balance in the Middle as galactic law.
resolution_greatergood_workers_rights_de: It is only right for us to codify the rights of the worker and protect them from common abuses.
resolution_greatergood_five_year_plans_d: The governors of our worlds should be given the freedom necessary to propose and enact sweeping reforms for the betterment of all.
resolution_greatergood_five_year_plans_t:
Agri-World, Generator, and Mining planetary designations gain additional bonuses.

Basic Subsistence living standard banned.
resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ours: We ask much of our people, but sometimes we must ask more. We should reward those who are willing to place the Empire above their own needs and volunteer to head to the frontier.

Unlocks an edict that encourages free unemployed pops to voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire.

Basic Subsistence and Stratified Economy living standards are banned.

Chattel Slavery, Livestock, and Grid Amalgamation slavery types are banned.
edict_greater_than_ourselves_desc: Encourages free unemployed pops to voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire.
federations.10010.name: Greater Than Ourselves
federations.10010.desc:
Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.

We can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.
federations.10010.desc_gestalt:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their worker drones.

While this is largely meaningless to us, we can at least benefit from some of the infrastructure they have created in order to resettle inactive simple drones.
federations.10010.desc_wilderness:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their workers.

While this ruling is largely meaningless to us, we can derive some token benefit from the infrastructure they created for resettling their own inactive drones and laborers.
resolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_mi: We must tackle inequality in all of its forms, enforcing fairness by any means necessary. What good is a feast if you have already had enough, and why should it go to waste when your neighbor is hungry?

Basic Subsistence, Stratified Economy, Decent Conditions, and Academic Priviledge living standards are banned.

Slavery of all types is banned.
resolution_greatergood_universal_prosper: If our galaxy spanning civilizations cannot provide for all of our people, then we have failed them. There is no excuse for anyone in the galaxy to want for anything. We should additionally act to redistribute excess wealth for the betterment of all.

All living standards other than Shared Burdens, Employee Ownership, Utopian Abundance, Chemical Bliss, or Mandatory Pampering are banned.

Assimilating organics into a Driven Assimilator or Hive Mind empire is banned.

Empires that are not Egalitarian or Rogue Servitors may be unable to meet these requirements and will be in Breach of Galactic Law!
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_1_desc: Federations and Defensive Pacts are where military matters should be discussed, not on the Senate Floor.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_1_effect: Repeals the The Readied Shield resolution.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_2_desc: Federations and Defensive Pacts are where military matters should be discussed, not on the Senate Floor.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_2_effect: Repeals the Military Readiness Act resolution, leaving The Readied Shield as galactic law.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_3: Repeal The Enemy of My Enemy
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_3_desc: Federations and Defensive Pacts are where military matters should be discussed, not on the Senate Floor.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_3_effect: Repeals the The Enemy of My Enemy resolution, leaving Military Readiness Act as galactic law.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_4_desc: Federations and Defensive Pacts are where military matters should be discussed, not on the Senate Floor.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_4_effect: Repeals the Castigation Proclamation resolution, leaving The Enemy of My Enemy as galactic law.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_5_desc: Federations and Defensive Pacts are where military matters should be discussed, not on the Senate Floor.
resolution_mutualdefense_repeal_5_effect: Repeals the Renegade Containment Doctrine resolution, leaving Castigation Proclamation as galactic law.
resolution_mutualdefense_the_readied_shi: The universe is a dangerous place, and all members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be ready to defend their worlds whether it be against pirates, space creatures, or the unknown.
resolution_mutualdefense_military_readin: Each member of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has a duty to themselves and to others to contribute to galactic defense.
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members that are not vassals of another empire that are using less than half of their naval capacity are in Breach of Galactic Law.
resolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_ene: An enemy of one is the enemy of all. If one of our number is attacked, should we not permit any of our number to punish the offender?

Grants the 'Counterattack' casus belli on empires that are not [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members and are in an offensive war against a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member.
resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_pro: Those who are not with us are against us, and all who stand against Galactic Law must be punished.

Any Empire in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] can propose a resolution to Denounce an Empire in Breach of Galactic Law or that is not a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member.

The 'Animosity' casus belli and 'Humiliation' wargoal can be used by empires with Unrestricted Wars against empires that have been Denounced by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] or are in Breach of Galactic Law.
resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_den: A formal declaration denouncing the target empire. This proposal can target any empire that is either not a member of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] or is in Breach of Galactic Law.
resolution_mutualdefense_renegade_contai: The benefits of membership in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are self-evident, and as such refusal to be a member clearly indicates ill intent. Members should be authorized to preempt any nefarious acts with force before non-members enact their plots.
Grants the 'Preemptive War' total war casus belli on empires that are not members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] for empires with Unrestricted Wars.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_1_desc: Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_1_effect_su: Repeals the Guardian Angels Act resolution.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_2_desc: Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_2_effect_su: Repeals the Reverence for Life resolution, leaving Guardian Angels Act as galactic law.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_3_desc: Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_3_effect_su: Repeals the Independent Tribunals resolution, leaving Reverence for Life as galactic law.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_4_desc: Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_4_effect_su: Repeals the Last Resort Doctrine resolution, leaving Independent Tribunals as galactic law.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_5_desc: Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.
resolution_rulesofwar_repeal_5_effect_su: Repeals the Demobilization Initiative resolution, leaving Last Resort Doctrine as galactic law.
resolution_rulesofwar_guardian_angels_de: The soldiers that dedicate their lives to keeping our planets safe should be recognized and honored.
resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life: The horror of war on the scale of interstellar empires is a terrible thing. We should do what we can to limit its excesses to active combatants.
Purging (other than Displacement) and the use of World Crackers is banned.
resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribun: Justice must occur for crimes soldiers commit, and civilian casualties must be accounted for. We should set up independent tribunals to investigate, try, and punish war crimes.
Armageddon and Indiscriminate bombardment stances, and using any Colossus weapon other than a Global Pacifier are banned.
resolution_rulesofwar_last_resort_doctri: War should be our last resort when all other forms of diplomacy fail. It should never be a tool that is used for unjustified purposes.
The Unrestricted Wars war philosophy is banned.
resolution_rulesofwar_demobilization_ini: Resources currently wasted on war could be better used for a variety of other projects to better the lives of our civilians. We should put hard limits on military development and focus on improving things rather than destroying them.
The Militarized Economy economic policy is banned.
resolution_council_denouncement_desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCouncilOrImpCouncil] can propose a resolution to denounce unfriendly members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], rendering them vulnerable to any Sanctions that have been passed.

Surely this power won't be abused.
resolution_galacticreforms_abolish_counc: The Galactic Council is an undemocratic menace and should be abolished.
The Galactic Council ceases to exist.
resolution_galacticreforms_form_council_: The Galactic Community should have a council of leaders to help keep order.

Establishes a Galactic Council of three members.

The Council begins with the powers to push Emergency Measures, propose Sanction Resolutions, and Denounce.
resolution_galacticreforms_disable_counc: The very idea of a Council Veto is preposterous. Why should the desires of the Community be silenced? Remove it immediately!

resolution_galacticreforms_enable_counci: The Galactic Council should be granted the power to remove frivolous proposals from the Resolution Queue.
resolution_galacticreforms_disable_counc: Galactic Council members should be required to have proper justification for denouncement. We should remove this unfair and autocratic ability.

resolution_galacticreforms_enable_counci: We should give the Galactic Council the ability to target rogue empires for punishment. They should be able to make Denouncement proposals to the Community.

resolution_galacticreforms_council_size_: Democracy is best in small doses.

resolution_galacticreforms_revoke_perman: Galactic Council members should be held accountable for their actions during regular elections. This empire should not have a permanent seat.

resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_effect_: All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will open borders to one another and mobilize for war.
resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_prethor: The Prethoryn Scourge is a threat to all life in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop them, they will consume us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_unbidde: Extradimensional invaders are a threat to all life in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop them, they will overwhelm us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_conting: The AI Contingency is a threat to all life in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop it, they will destroy us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.
All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will open borders to one another and mobilize for war.
resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_greatkh: The Great Khan's rampage is a danger to all free empires in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop it, we will all be crushed beneath their fleet. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.
All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will open borders to one another and mobilize for war.
resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_nanites: The nanites from the L-Cluster are a threat to the entire galaxy. If we do not unite to stop the nanite swarm, they will destroy us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.
All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will open borders to one another and mobilize for war.
resolution_galactic_focus_war_in_heaven_: The [SecondSleeper.GetName] are clearly in the wrong in this war, and we should declare unified support for the [FirstSleeper.GetName].
Failure to join the [FirstSleeper.GetName] in the War in Heaven is considered a Breach of Galactic Law.

galactic_focus_crisis_prethoryn_desc: The Prethoryn Scourge are a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.
galactic_focus_crisis_unbidden_desc: The Unbidden are a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.

galactic_focus_crisis_war_in_heaven_desc: When giants go to war, the universe trembles. Survive the War in Heaven.
resolution_community_champions_desc: Those we have trusted with guiding the Community are also the best candidates to become its most stalwart defenders. By granting them more powers and resources, we are enabling them to protect us all.

Council Members gain +10% Naval Capacity.

resolution_constitutional_immunity_desc: Sometimes, you need to get dirty in the name of the greater good. We honor the moral sacrifices made by those who allow us to live comfortable lives, sheltered from moral dilemmas.

immunity_already_active: £ Another empire already has Constitutional Immunity.
resolution_development_aides_desc: The most privileged among us have a moral duty to help the others. They will shoulder our burdens to guide us all towards a more harmonious community.

origin.3003.name: Life-Tree Destroyed!
origin.3003.desc: The ongoing bombardment of [planet.GetName] has destroyed our network of life-giving Trees.
origin.3100.name: Recovered Cache
origin.3100.desc: While clearing wreckage on [from.GetName] we discovered an ancient cache of technology which dates back to our former empire. Only a minimal amount of research should be required to reintegrate this knowledge into our technology base.
origin.3101.name: Colonial Remains
origin.3101.desc: [planet.GetName] was once an important colony of the [owner.GetName], and some remnants of its infrastructure remain usable as a base to re-colonize the planet.
progress.3.desc_lith: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased safely within the rocky core of the meteorite - will soon emerge and begin setting up prefabricated colonial infrastructure.
decision_transplant_tree_desc: A network of Trees must be established here for our Hive to flourish.
decision_shattered_ring_project_desc: This world has been broken for untold ages, and it is time to right this wrong. We will restore the ring's advanced facilities.
decision_shattered_ring_project_effects: Turns the Shattered Ring Segment into a Ringworld, unlocking special £ Segment Districts
decision_shattered_ring_project_interlop: The Interloper once ruined our perfect ring. We could now use it to repair the megastructure.
Removes the Interloper and turns $NAME_Irreparable_Damage$ into a Ringworld
col_bureau_tt: An entire world dedicated to unifying our empire.

col_bureau_spiritualist_tt: Faith crystallizes into doctrine, and the will of the divine is transcribed by mortal appendages. Few ever leave unchanged.
col_bureau_hive_tt: An entire world dedicated to unifying our empire.
col_bureau_machine_tt: An entire world dedicated to unifying our empire.
col_trophy_machine_desc: A world dedicated to the care and protection of organic life.
col_trophy_machine_tt: A cradle of compassion where all organic life is sacred, and even the soil seems to breathe in peace.
col_habitat_bureau_desc: An entire habitat dedicated to unifying our empire.
col_habitat_bureau_tt: These sanctums of governance and vision shape the empire's unity, harmonizing disparate worlds into a singular purpose through doctrine, diplomacy, and sheer will.

col_habitat_bureau_hive_desc: An entire habitat dedicated to unifying our empire.

colonial_spirit_gestalt_mod_desc: The unexpected emergence of a new gestalt consciousness has given the [root.owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] of this colony a second chance.
