fedel.1501.name: A Federation Committee is Formed
fedel.1501.desc:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.
fedel.1501.desc.subject:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.
tooltip_thesis_begin: The thesis challenge will commence shortly.
fedel.1506.name: A Thesis is Chosen
fedel.1506.win.desc: The Federation Committee has recognized the inherent value of our study into [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic], granting [ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term. Congratulatory sentiments have been offered to our [ruler.GetTitle] and [ruler.GetHerHis] team of researchers.
fedel.1506.win.autocracy.desc: The Federation Committee has recognized our infallible reasoning in a study conducted by [ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] on [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. [ruler.GetSheHeCap] shall assume a most prosperous leadership for the next term.
fedel.1506.win.gestalt.desc: The Federation Committee has recognized the worthiness of our amalgamated study into [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. They have granted leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName] to us for the next term.
fedel.1506.fail.desc: The Federation Committee has passed over our proposal, favoring a vacuous study from the [winning_thesis.GetName] on [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. Science itself shall mourn this loss of reason. In the meantime, the [winning_thesis.GetName] assumes leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName].
fedel.1506.fail.gestalt.desc: In a wanton act of motley failure, the Federation Committee has selected a thesis by the [winning_thesis.GetName] rather than our own. Their study of [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic] has inexplicably granted [winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle] [winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term.
fedel.1506.insufficient.desc: The Federation Committee chose its winning argument whilst we remained absent from the contest. The [winning_thesis.GetName] has been granted leadership following their study of [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. A low bar has been set for the time when a research team of our own might take to the podium.
tooltip_thesis_won: We shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during its next term.
tooltip_thesis_lost: We have failed to secure leadership of [Root.GetAllianceName]. The [winning_thesis.GetName] will take that role instead.
fedel.1805.name: The Conclave Convenes
fedel.1805.desc.base:
The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed chamber, wherein all the information required to make their decision is contained.

While the discussions that take place within the Conclave are highly confidential, it is understood that they primarily assess the services rendered by each member towards the preservation and advancement of spirituality and traditional values, as well as any particular advances towards ascension and transcendence.
fedel.1805.desc:
The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed chamber, wherein all the information required to make their decision is contained.

While the discussions that take place within the Conclave are highly confidential, it is understood that they primarily assess the services rendered by each member towards the preservation and advancement of spirituality and traditional values, as well as any particular advances towards ascension and transcendence.

By convention, however, it is not yet too late to demonstrate the sincerity of one's conviction.
fedel.1805.desc.subject:
The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed chamber, wherein all the information required to make their decision is contained.

While the discussions that take place within the Conclave are highly confidential, it is understood that they primarily assess the services rendered by each member towards the preservation and advancement of spirituality and traditional values, as well as any particular advances towards ascension and transcendence.

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are ineligible for the presidency.
fedel.1805.A: We can spare a modest contribution.
fedel.1805.A.tooltip: Our bid for the presidency will gain a slight boost.
fedel.1805.B: A slightly larger indulgence would not go amiss.
fedel.1805.B.tooltip: Our bid for the presidency will gain a moderate boost.
fedel.1805.C: Only our most lavish offering will do.
fedel.1805.C.tooltip: Our bid for the presidency will gain a significant boost.
fedel.1815.name: Conclave: Ongoing Deliberations
fedel.1815.desc: Although only snippets of information have emerged from the Conclave's private deliberations, it is understood that the [conclave_frontrunner.GetName] is the current frontrunner to be elected. However, there is still time for last-minute submissions to boost our candidacy.
fedel.1815.desc.frontrunner: Although only snippets of information have emerged from the Conclave's private deliberations, it is understood that we are the current frontrunners to be elected. However, there is still time for others to make last-minute submissions to boost their candidacies, so we may yet wish to consider a final demonstration of our piety.
fedel.1815.E: Perhaps a contribution of a different currency will do the trick.
fedel.1815.E.tooltip: Our bribe will probably be greatly appreciated... but it may be held against us, if we are unfortunate.
fedel.1825.name: The Most Virtuous
fedel.1825.desc:
After a burst of drumroll, an ethereal mist starts seeping from the now-opened Conclave Chambers. A delegation emerges. There is a dramatic pause, and a silence so profound a pin drop would appear loud falls across the [Root.GetAllianceName].

They declare the [conclave_winner.GetName] to be their choice for the presidency!
fedel.1825.A: We shall lead our flock well.
wenkwort_chain_desc: We encountered an unusually picturesque world in the [from.System.GetName] system. It's ideal for colonization, but it seems prudent to ask: who designed it, and why?
federations3.121.name: Keep Off the Grass
federations3.121.desc:
Visiting entity: welcome to $NAME_Wenkwort$. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the $NAME_Gardeners$ and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intrusion upon the biota of planetary designate $NAME_wenkwort_prime$. Failure to comply with our guidelines will diminish the survival odds of all concerned.
federations3.121.a.response:
I am the automated custodian of the system designated [root.System.GetName]. I represent the interests of the $NAME_Gardeners$, here and in other systems of the Auron Empire. My role is defined broadly as protector of - and guide to - all you see around you.

Directive WAPP-715 curtails the industrialization of Ackamore-class worlds such as designate [root.Planet.GetName]. Only you can prevent mass biome extinction!
federations3.121.b: Nonsense. We'll develop our colony as we see fit.
federations3.125.desc:
Splendid! Guidelines will be delivered to you imminently.

In summary: Directive WAPP-715 allows for responsible, non-destructive use of the $NAME_Wenkwort$ gardens. Great importance is attached to preserving these worlds' existing character, however we do not wish to stifle development within-<ERROR: imperial beacon out of range>.

<Requesting urgent Monitor Division dispatch to co-ordinates 19c14a05... Failed. Retrying... Failed. Retrying...>
federations3.130.desc:
How disappointing. So be it.

<Requesting Enforcer Division dispatch to co-ordinates-
<ERROR: imperial beacon could not be found. Reverting to backup navigation systems... Success.>
<Enforcer Division en route; estimated arrival 2 grand cycles. Courtesy protocols disengaged.>
federations3.131.name: Pressing the Point
federations3.131.desc:
Intrusive entity: you remain in apparent violation of Directive WAPP-715, concerning the non-destructive use of the $NAME_Wenkwort$ gardens at designate [root.Planet.GetName].

This is your last opportunity to accede to our guidelines, or else face swift punishment.
federations3.131.a: We accept the terms of your directive.
federations3.131.tooltip: Adds the Wenkwort Custodian modifier to [root.GetName].
SEA_CRYSTAL_CAT_DESC: Starlight can be seen glinting off an unusually large object, just under the ocean surface of [Root.GetName].
WENKWORT_CAT_DESC: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?
federations3.115.name: Interpretation Signal
federations3.115.desc:
Some form of aesthetic design has been employed over most of the surface landscape on [From.GetName]. Our scientists suspect that even the remaining, 'untouched' areas are merely crafted wilderness - there to serve a wider horticultural goal.

Towards the conclusion of our research, we stumbled across a beacon - the sole example of technology on this world. When activated, it uploaded a catalog of every plant and animal species found on [From.GetName], as well as a reference pointer to nearby [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]. No clue was left with which to identify the planet's designers.
federations3.100.name: Floating Value
federations3.100.desc:
At first glance, everything about [From.GetName] seemed routine and normal. Only during a chance alignment did a scientist aboard the [Root.GetName] notice starlight reflecting off a vast lens near the surface below. Scanners were quickly trained upon the crystalline object, whose breadth is that of a moderately-sized island.

Probe telemetry suggests the chemical make-up of this lens is highly valuable; its physical structure may also be unique within our galaxy.
federations3.100.a: A valuable resource, ours to exploit.
federations3.100.b: Its rare beauty should be left for all to enjoy.
colony_fed.100.name: Impossible Corrie
colony_fed.100.desc: A geological anomaly has come to our attention on [Root.GetName]. We began surveying after a bowl-shaped depression suddenly appeared alongside a mining facility there. Features like this are almost never found outside of a glacial region, but stranger still: the walls of this 'cirque' scatter visible light in a flower-petal pattern, and have been found to resonate when exposed to certain electro-magnetic bands. Investigations are ongoing.
colony_fed.105.name: Project Blue Lotus
colony_fed.105.desc:
Our scientists report that the newly-uncovered, crystalline blue deposits on [Root.GetName] respond dramatically to delayed-erasure photon energy. The minerals filter its wavelengths and reflect a beam which is capable of transforming ordinary silicates into a new, super-conductive alloy - though only ever during daylight.

Given that this process essentially involves bouncing high levels of radiation around an enclosed space, some scientists have already come out in protest. A different group of excited researchers offers a counter-argument, stressing that this phenomenon could revolutionize the way we refine precious metals. Either way: developing this technique further will be costly.
colony_fed.105.gestalt.desc:
A rogue drone has been found running its own project within the cirque on [Root.GetName]. Driven by its initial directive - to refine our methods of mineral extraction - it has since stumbled onto a means of transforming everyday silicates into a new type of alloy.

The process seems to involve bouncing high-energy beams off mineral deposits in the feature's wall. The drone's eagerness in its task has caused it to flood the area with excessive levels of radiation. It has therefore been isolated pending either re-integration, or destruction of its individuality and acquired knowledge.
colony_fed.105.a: Bring it back into the fold.
colony_fed.105.b: Let's see where this research goes.
colony_fed.106.name: Overly-Keen Proponents
colony_fed.106.desc:
Regrettable scenes on [Root.GetName], as a group of obsessive scientists sought to intervene in the project's closure. Dazzled by their own research, they attempted to wrest control of the transmutation experiments 'for the benefit of new science.' The resulting scuffle caused equipment to be damaged, and a runaway cascade took hold.

What remains of the cirque is something akin to a geode: a rocky shell around what used to be the equipment and protestors, now re-rendered in crystalline form.
colony_fed.107.name: Breakaway Alchemist
colony_fed.107.desc: The wayward drone and its findings have been successfully purged. The results of its fluke experiments now litter the landscape; a small amount of useful material has been reclaimed.
colony_fed.110.name: Alchemy in Motion
colony_fed.110.desc: The laboratory on [From.GetName] is yielding verifiable results. Although their process can still only transmute small amounts of rock into alloys, researchers have high hopes for a larger-scale operation. They have requested access to further resources.
colony_fed.110.gestalt.desc: The rogue experiments on [Root.GetName] are yielding results. Although the process can still only transmute small amounts of matter into this new metal, the experiment is now verifiable. This could warrant more dedicated research efforts.
colony_fed.111.name: Lotus Collapse
colony_fed.111.desc:
The transmutation experiments at [From.GetName] have failed - though their failure may actually have prevented future catastrophe. When new, more refined equipment was first brought online, it ran well within design tolerances. However, when shut-down instructions were issued, the process accelerated beyond the reach of its failsafes. Conversion took hold in the facility's housing, transmuting it and its surroundings into the same, super-conductive alloy.

The resulting ground explosion has taken a number of lives along with significant chunks of the surrounding landscape. We're left with little other than a seam of good material, and a cautionary tale in metaphysics.
colony_fed.115.name: Full Spectrum Alchemy
colony_fed.115.desc: The next phase of our experimental production facility has come online. The Blue Lotus crystalline transmutation facility is now busy converting unprecedented amounts of base material into useful alloys.
colony_fed.115.b: Keep a close watch on it...
colony_fed.120.name: Lotus Eats Itself
colony_fed.120.desc: A catastrophic failure has occurred at the experimental facility on [Root.GetName]. Operatives say we may never know what specifically caused the failure in containment, but the result was runaway transmutation of the equipment, its housing, and a vast chunk of the surrounding landscape - all into the same, superconductive alloy. A rich seam of this material is all that remains.
BLUELOTUS_SCALE_PROJECT_DESC: It's thought that the unique, reflective properties of this geographical phenomenon may be harnessed in order to transmute base rocks into superior alloys.
WENKWORT_PROJECT_DESC: Circular ridges have been impressed upon the surface of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName], sweeping elegantly around its myriad craters and mountains. Is there some purpose to their design? What relation might there be to the Gardening Drones in this system?
federations3.135.name: Mountains and Rivers of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]
federations3.135.human.desc:
Were it not for its sheer scale and remoteness from [Owner.Capital.GetName], [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] might be mistaken for a zen garden of our own making. Its surface is a vast, stylized landscape punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids. Our scholars note an algorithmic precision to its apparent depictions of water and land. It remains decorative, but somehow divorced from natural forms - like a studied imitation.

Whatever its origin, there is a clear link between this sculpted world and the Gardening Drones which recently emerged from its surface. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have, however, yielded no results.

Perhaps our being led to this zen planet is a hint - that answers to our growing stack of questions may reveal themselves in due time.
federations3.135.nonhuman.desc:
The vast, geometric forms on [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] are certainly not of natural origin. The planet's stylized landscape is reminiscent of a vast and dusty sea, punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids.

Our researchers conclude that this landscape is likely an art piece, or else is part of some ritual practice - however, the only perpetrators appear to be the Gardening Drones we saw earlier. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have yielded no results. Perhaps time will tell...
relicrails_digsite_desc: Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike anything else we've encountered in this region of space. Who built it, and why?
federations3.1005.name: Basement Shift
federations3.1005.desc: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Embarrassed surveyors have already begun looking into their sudden appearance. It would seem [From.Planet.GetName] has a prior history...
federations3.1010.name: Depot Deposits
federations3.1010.desc:
It wasn't long before our excavations revealed tunnels and equipment of sturdier construction and more intricate design. Heavy-gauge rails and sleepers lie preserved and intact, surrounded by myriad relics and centuries-old garbage.

Amongst the debris lie various precisely-anodized pieces of engine and signalling equipment, such as one might find in a maintenance depot. All are inscribed in singular detail with complex, geometric patterns - suggesting high levels of artistry and perhaps even pride.
federations3.1015.name: The Well-Armed Visitor
federations3.1015.desc:
Our chance excavation of a narrow side-tunnel has revealed a long-dead reptilian occupant, whose demise by ceiling collapse dates back some 800 years. Their presence in this tunnel was something of a puzzle, solved only when we completed a study of the many weapons found on their person.

The technology underlying these bladed implements - many of which were mounted on the inside of a decorative targe - is primitive compared to our own, yet markedly different to that used on the railroad. This targe-bearing visitor was as alien to this world as we are, and they seem to have been conducting similar archaeological research - that is, before the tunnel claimed their life.
federations3.1020.name: The Targe-Bearer
federations3.1020.desc:
The Targe-bearer's notes have led us to an electrical substation which once served this maintenance yard. It looks like their expedition broke an atmospheric seal on the facility; there are comparatively few signs of decay here. Dust-covered cable ducts form colonnades around dozens of monitors. It is down one such aisle of monitors that we found trace remains from sentients of a different species.

The Targe-bearer's expedition described this as a group of molluscoid technicians - their still-preserved bodies huddled together for mutual protection or warmth. The records also note two attempts to restart the millennia-old substation, using tools which are inferior to ours. There's a chance we could complete this effort - and in so doing, make further excavation much easier.
federations3.1021.name: Tragic Coil
federations3.1021.desc:
Mere minutes after we jump-started the substation on [From.Planet.GetName] using a portable phase generator, the facility erupted with piercing alarms. Seconds later, part of the ceiling and a section of wall adjoining the railroad collapsed, right where our excavation team was working.

The fault has been traced to a corroded resistor coil, which we'd thought disconnected. This oversight caused several injuries and has sealed the fates of a dozen members of our dig team; they now follow in the Targe-bearer's tragic footsteps.
federations3.1022.name: Onto a Different Track
federations3.1022.desc:
This relic of a substation has surprised us with its complexity. We jump-started it using a portable phase generator, but the ensuing burst of activity caused parts of the millennia-old structure around us to collapse.

Fortunately our team had sufficient warning to find shelter. They emerged to find some areas now firmly closed off, but some new areas have opened in their stead.
federations3.1026.name: Back in Service
federations3.1026.desc:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site exposed a long-distance rail tunnel down which - according to the control panels we deciphered - a train lay, tucked away in sidings. Those same systems had applied various priority markers to the train, including a word we've identified as 'repository.'

A team was dispatched to get the train moving again, for rarely does a key artifact come to us in a form as large as this. The antique locomotive is an elegant enough piece of engineering in itself, but every one of the elaborately-decorated cars behind it has proven to be a museum in its own right.

The train may best be described as a roaming time capsule, ever ready to be moved out of harm's way. For 3,000 years it has preserved the historical, cultural and scientific records of an entire culture, whom we now learn called themselves the Peeyeps.
federations3.1026.a: Bring these records back to our homeworld for further study.
federations3.1027.name: Naught But Empty Sheds
federations3.1027.desc:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site has exposed a goods yard, hewn from under a vast and vaulted cave roof. Of its many vast and vacant warehouses, only one had its security seals tripped; upon re-opening it we found the remains of more of the Targe-bearer's people. They had come seeking supplies, only to fall foul of a millennia-old alarm system.

According to the logs they left behind, this itinerant 'Fenrunir Expeditionary Group' was investigating [From.Planet.GetName] as part of a habitable worlds survey. They hadn't anticipated finding ruins here. Untrained and uninterested in archaeology, they ransacked the site rather than investigating it.

Those who met with starvation inside the warehouse note - in particularly colorful language - that their comrades removed a great deal of material to their freighters, leaving little behind. Our own surveys confirm that although there is an abundance of antique machinery, little else remains to tell us who the enigmatic railroad-builders were.
federations3.1030.name: Rails and Refuge
federations3.1030.desc:
The records left by the railroad-builders of [From.From.Planet.GetName] tell how this fervent band of molluscoids fled their technophobic homeland, seeking to better themselves through mechanical endeavor. They retreated to a secret and distant network of underground caves, later linking and expanding their habitats by means of railroad tunnels.

Fearful that their very culture may one day be hunted and eradicated, the Peeyeps built deep - for security and preservation. Their society grew slowly over the next 200 years, during which time their homeland's government turned more insular and paranoid. A single, radical swing provoked them into militarization on an unprecedented scale; at this point the chronicle ends abruptly.

Even with the Targe-bearer's own subsequent, patchy findings, we can only speculate upon the tragic fates of both peoples. Further archaeological evidence has either been lost or gone unrecorded; all that remains of the Peeyeps now are their tunnels, their records and their trains.
d_impossiblecorrie_desc: An improbable geological feature has emerged. Strange and reflective crystal deposits line its curved walls.
d_bluelotus_desc: This highly experimental facility seeks to transmute everyday silicates into useful alloys.
d_bluelotus2_desc: An industrial-scale facility which transmutes everyday silicates into useful alloys.
d_ruin_bluelotus_desc: Ruined site of a once-promising, experimental facility for transmuting rock and other matter into alloys. Nothing now remains, save this minor seam.
d_crater_bluelotus_desc: Site of an accidental, runaway transmutation of rock and other matter into a single, precious alloy.
peeyeps_legacy_desc: The re-discovery of a vast, ancient railway has sparked our researchers' imaginations.
pm_wenkwort_gardens_desc: The ecologies of this world show signs of having been designed, fitting some arcane and romantic ideal.
pm_wenkwort_zen_desc: Vast ripples appear in the regolith here. Whatever their origin, they exude a calming influence.
pm_wenkwort_custodian_desc: In accordance with a directive from the $NAME_Gardeners$, industrialization of this botanical world has been drastically curtailed.
job_bluelotus_technician_desc: Specialist scientists who work on the Blue Lotus project to transmute everyday silicates into useful alloys.
job_bluelotus_drone_desc: Transmuter Drones employ experimental methods to transmute everyday silicates into useful alloys.
wenkwort_keeper_desc: This low-orbit facility bears some similarity to the smaller drones tending to this region of space.
fedel.899.name: Ready Your Checkbooks!
fedel.899.desc: In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.
fedel.899.desc.subject:
In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.
fedel.901.name: Place Your Bet!
fedel.901.desc:
It is time for the [Root.GetName] to place a bid in the Golden Rule challenge. Pay the required price up front, or else forfeit - and lose the right to participate further.

The current pot is:

£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]
fedel.901.a.tooltip: Pay £ 10000 and remain in the challenge.
fedel.901.b.tooltip: Pay £ 2500 and remain in the challenge.
fedel.901.c.tooltip: Pay £ 5000 and remain in the challenge.
fedel.903.name: We Have a Winner!
fedel.903.desc:
The Golden Rule challenge has come to an end, and a winner has been declared!

The [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has proven their financial superiority, and becomes the new federation leader.
fedel.904.name: To the Victor Go the Spoils
fedel.904.desc:
[Root.GetName] has been appointed Federation Leader in accordance with the rules for the Golden Rule challenge. Congratulations!

The first order of business is to decide what will happen with the 'prize money'. The current sum is £ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable].

Note that some mandatory taxes and fees will apply, effectively altering the sum before pay-out.
fedel.904.a.tooltip: Channel the money back into the federation. Will increase Federation Cohesion and temporarily apply the Business is Booming! Empire Modifier.
fedel.904.b.tooltip: Divides the sum of money evenly amongst all Federation members.
fedel.904.c.tooltip: Keep the money. Temporarily applies the Midas' Stigma Empire Modifier.
fedel.906.name: To the Victor Go the Spoils
fedel.906.first_paragraph: The Golden Rule federation challenge has concluded with a substantial amount of wealth left in the bidding pot. As newly-elected steward of this bounty, the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has made the following proclamation:
golden_rule_debrief_authoritarian_invest: With the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] at the helm, this Federation will prosper.
golden_rule_debrief_authoritarian_distri: Together we grow stronger. 'We' meaning of course the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName].
golden_rule_debrief_authoritarian_approp: Surely you understand. We did win, after all.
golden_rule_debrief_egalitarian_invest: This way the entire Federation will benefit from our joint effort.
golden_rule_debrief_egalitarian_appropri: It's evident that if this wealth is to be fairly distributed, we must do it ourselves.
golden_rule_debrief_materialist_invest: Wealth! Don't take it - make it!
golden_rule_debrief_spiritualist_invest: Being greedy will not help anyone.
golden_rule_debrief_spiritualist_distrib: Please, take it. We wish not to carry the burden of mundane riches.
golden_rule_debrief_spiritualist_appropr: May this allow you to see the true value of life, rather than staring blindly at pointless numbers and bars.
golden_rule_debrief_militarist_invest: This will create a stronger and more unified Federation.
golden_rule_debrief_militarist_distribut: Now that it has become evident who the leader is, feel free to use your wealth as you see fit.
golden_rule_debrief_militarist_appropria: We will use this wealth to strengthen ourselves, and in effect the whole Federation.
golden_rule_debrief_pacifist_invest: Surely you understand. We did win, after all.
golden_rule_debrief_pacifist_distribute: There. No need to fight over it anymore.
golden_rule_debrief_pacifist_appropriate: Who better than the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] to make sure it's spent in a constructive manner?
golden_rule_debrief_xenophile_distribute: After all, we are all in this together!
golden_rule_debrief_xenophile_appropriat: With this funding we may expand our horizons even further.
golden_rule_debrief_xenophobe_invest: Now we can all benefit from it. All by ourselves.
golden_rule_debrief_xenophobe_appropriat: The decision has been made. We have no regrets and we make no apologies.
golden_rule_debrief_hive_mind_invest: All is one. One is all.
golden_rule_debrief_machine_appropriate:
Suggested action for optimal net gain:
Maximum Acquisition.
business_is_booming_desc: A recent boost to the Federation's economy has prompted a surge of bold, new business ventures.
midas_stigma_desc: Greed can make you rich. However, greed doesn't make you very popular. But then again, it can make you rich.
pay_to_win_desc: The Federation is benefitting from collaborative efforts between its members, in matters of shared finance.
shares_and_bonds_desc: Respect and trust in the Federation's shared economy has led to a rise in consensus amongst members.
cannot_change_succession_type_during_war: Cannot change Federation succession type while at war.
cannot_change_succession_term_during_war: Cannot change Federation succession term while at war.
FED_THE_BAREST_MINIMUM: Give them the barest minimum to comply.
FED_WE_WILL_RETAIN: We will retain our current policies.
FED_WE_WILL_BE_IN_BREACH: Our Empire will be in Breach of Galactic Law.
federations.10100.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Advanced Xenostudies resolution, forbidding empires from outlawing AI or holding non-interference policies relating to [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10100.change_interference: Our Empire will change our Pre-FTL Interference policy to Active Interference.
federations.10110.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Ethical Guideline Refactoring resolution, requiring empires to use the most powerful Leader Enhancement policy available to them.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10110.selected_lineages: Our Empire will change our Leader Enhancement policy to Selected Lineages.
federations.10110.capacity_boosters: Our Empire will change our Leader Enhancement policy to Capacity Boosters.
federations.10110.research_restriction: Our Empire will change our Research Restrictions policy to No Restrictions.
federations.10200.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Five Year Plans resolution, which bans Basic Subsistence living standards.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10200.living_standard_strati: Our Empire will change all species with Basic Subsistence living standards to Stratified Economy if they qualify for it, or Decent Living Standards if absolutely necessary.
federations.10200.living_standard_normal: Our Empire will change all species with Basic Subsistence living standards to Decent Living Standards.
federations.10210.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Greater Than Ourselves resolution, which bans Stratified Economy living standards, as well as Chattel Slavery, Livestock, and Grid Amalgamation slavery types.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10210.living_standard_normal: Our Empire will change all species with lower living standards to Decent Living Standards.
federations.10210.displace_gestalt: Pops that are Livestock or Amalgamated will instead be Displaced.
federations.10210.thralls: Pops that are Chattel Slavery or Livestock will become Battle Thralls.
federations.10210.servants: Pops that are Chattel Slavery or Livestock will become Domestic Servitude.
federations.10210.complythralls: Do what we must, make the slaves fight.
federations.10210.complyservants: Do what we must, make the slaves serve.
federations.10210.freeslaves: Pops that are Enslaved will be freed.
federations.10220.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Greater Than Ourselves resolution, which bans Decent Living Standards and Academic Privilege living standards, as well as all forms of slavery.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10220.living_standard: Our Empire will change all species with living standards that do not comply to Social Welfare.
federations.10230.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Universal Prosperity Mandate resolution, which bans all living standards other than Shared Burdens, Utopian Abundance, Chemical Bliss, or Mandatory Pampering.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10230.utopian: Give them everything they could ever want
federations.10230.chemical: Make them happy by any means possible
federations.10230.complyutopian: Our Empire will change all species living standards to Utopian Abundance.
federations.10230.complychemical: Our Empire will change all species living standards to Basic Income.
federations.10300.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Reverence for Life resolution, banning the Allowed policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10300.comply: Our Empire will change our Purge policy to Displacement Only.
federations.10310.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Independent Tribunals resolution, banning the Widespread Bombardment policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10310.comply: Our Empire will change our Orbital Bombardment policy to Precision Orbital Strikes.
federations.10320.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Last Resort Doctrine resolution, banning the Unrestricted Wars policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10320.comply: Our Empire will change our War Philosophy policy to Liberation Wars.
federations.10320.complygestalt: Our Empire will change our War Philosophy policy to Defensive Wars Only.
federations.10330.desc:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Demobilization Initiative resolution, banning the Militarized Economy policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
federations.10330.comply: Our Empire will change our Import Policy policy to Mixed Economy.

grand_archive.7210.name: Gravity Snares
grand_archive.7210.desc.common: Following the recent discovery of Gravity Snares, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.
grand_archive.7210.desc.vivarium:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna to our Vivarium, where they can continue to reproduce new specimens of their kind.

Culling and dissecting these creatures will allow the harvesting of their Genetic Material for cloning purposes as well as other resources.
grand_archive.7210.desc.no_vivarium:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna for study and dissection, harvesting their Genetic Material and resources.

If we are to keep them alive for further breeding, we will need to establish a Vivarium. We can do this by constructing a Grand Archive or by building [GetHatcheryPlural] at our starbases.
grand_archive.7220.name: Prethoryn Beasts
grand_archive.7220.desc:
Our Gravity Snares are unable to properly track and contain the $NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.

Attempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.

We have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.
tech_galactic_archivism_desc: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.
tech_gravity_wells_desc: Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.
tech_containment_vessel_desc: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of Space Fauna.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONTAINMENT_VESSEL_DESC: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of Space Fauna.
tech_asteroidal_carapace_desc: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.
ASTEROIDAL_CARAPACE_ARMOR_DESC: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.

tech_alien_cloning_desc: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.
feature_alien_cloning_unlocked_desc: Carefully regulating the growth of our Space Fauna Ships will ensure we maintain their numbers at a manageable level.
tech_alien_cloning_tt: Unlocks Feature: Corvette-Scale Space Fauna Cloning
tech_improved_incubators_desc: We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.
tech_improved_incubators_tt: Unlocks Feature: Destroyer-Scale Space Fauna Cloning
tech_improved_incubators_tt_desc: Hatcheries can now clone larger specimens of Space Fauna, rivalling the size of more traditional Destroyers.
tech_metabolic_gases_desc: Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.

tech_metabolic_gases_tt_desc: Hatcheries can now clone Space Fauna Ships of any maturity stage or size.

tech_boarding_cables_desc: Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.
tech_controlled_mutations_desc: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.
tech_controlled_mutations_2_desc: We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.
tech_refit_standards_beastmasters_desc: Optimizing the process for cloning Space Fauna can lead to massive efficiency gains.

origin_primal_calling_desc:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.

START_SCREEN_PRIMAL_CALLING:
Despite rapid technological progress, we remain bound to the wild creatures of our world. Unwavering companions throughout our evolution, they are as much our teachers as we are their stewards. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.

In the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures of our world. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.

Called to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.
leader_trait_trophy_hunter_desc: Tempered by hardship and armed with a lifetime of experience, this commander has an uncanny understanding of Space Fauna. The key to a successful hunt is to think like one's prey, but of course, only the perfect shot will produce a perfect trophy.
leader_trait_gifted_trapper_desc: A skilled researcher who takes the utmost care in the safe capture and transportation of live specimens. This leader's commitment to creature welfare inspires others to improve research standards across all disciplines.
leader_trait_void_hunter_desc: A knowledgeable hunter, well-suited for taking down big game. Patient in their approach, and precise when they strike.
leader_trait_void_hunter_2_desc: A knowledgeable hunter, well-suited for taking down big game. Patient in their approach, and precise when they strike.
leader_trait_void_tracker_desc: This leader's talent for capturing wild Space Fauna efficiently and safely is unparalleled.
leader_trait_void_tracker_2_desc: This leader's talent for capturing wild Space Fauna efficiently and safely is unparalleled.
first_contact_critters.15.desc.primal_ca: Of note, there is a matriarchal hierarchy at the center of each Tiyanki pod, with a singular cow leading the group at any one time. Females are given priority to all food resources, allowing them to produce maternal gasses for their young and direct the pod's migrations. As such, bulls will forgo nourishment whenever resources are scarce, encouraging them to scout for more food while the pod rests.
first_contact_critters.25.desc.primal_ca: All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms controlled via RNA-laced secretions. These "flagella" strike in complex attack patterns, so despite their apparent lack of sapience, "Space Amoeba" are highly adept natural predators.
first_contact_critters.35.desc.primal_ca: These creatures seem to communicate with one another via chromatic changes in refracted light. While this medium has high potential for complex expressions, it is only utilized in a basic manner by these semi-sentient lifeforms. Changes in color can be used to indicate social status, aggression, and even fertility conditions.
grand_archive.2005.desc.primal_calling: These parasitic creatures lack the natural ability to reproduce and must rely on the acquisition of planet-borne hosts. Sufficient organic matter must be harvested from inhabited planets for the "Voidworms" to produce a crucial hormone within their mating trios, known as "troikas". As hermaphroditic creatures, the selection of partners is determined primarily by complementary physical traits and comparable size.
grand_archive.2900.desc.primal_calling: We believe that the creatures select their asteroids based on mineral composition as well as size. While the first specimen we encountered possesses a biological preference for [GetCommonMineral], it is likely each individual develops this adaptation over time based on their current environment. Scans show that traces of this metal are present throughout the host asteroid, as well as within the nervous system and digestive tract of the "Cutholoid" Itself.
grand_archive.1002.name: Life in the Stars
grand_archive.1002.desc.default:
The void is full of life. We have discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], but what else is out there?

Our close relationship with the wildlife on [capital_scope.GetName] may not be appropriate on the galactic scale. The void of space represents an entirely new ecosystem, and we find ourselves at a crossroads.

What are these creatures to us?

Whatever choice we make, the consequences will be felt for years to come.
grand_archive.1002.desc.homicidal: The void may well be full of life - ours to extinguish, or to use. Having discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we are eager to find more. Fresh prey or beasts of burden, the choice is up to us.
untamed_wilds_desc: Vast expanses of protected territory where wildlife is left to thrive, providing a sustainable supply of native creatures.
grand_archive.1010.desc:
Our colony on [Root.GetName] has learned to respect the boundaries of the native Titanic Life's natural territory.

These massive beasts will be a continued benefit to our settlement as we expand borders and develop the land.
job_wrangler_desc: The proper preservation, study, and management of local fauna is vital to the success of our worlds.
job_wrangler_effect_desc: £ Wranglers turn £ Supplies into [GetCivilianSpiMatOutput][GetCivilianEgalAuthOutput][GetCivilianMilPacOutput][GetCivilianXenoOutput]£ $concept_unity$, £ Amenities and £ Society Research.
