trait_rapid_breeders_desc: This species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.
trait_rapid_breeders_lithoid_desc: This species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.
trait_slow_breeders_desc: This species reproduces at a slow rate, lowering population growth.
trait_delicious_desc: This species has the curious evolutionary adaptation of being highly nutritious when eaten.
trait_nerve_stapled_desc: Inessential neural pathways relating to self-preservation and free will are severed, creating a docile and obedient client species.
trait_fertile_desc: The natural fecundity and geniality of this species has been dramatically enhanced through aggressive physical and behavioral sculpting.
trait_erudite_desc: Biological engineering has unlocked previously dormant parts of this species' brain, greatly increasing mental acuity.
trait_robust_desc: Bio-optimized organs with redundant functions have made this species extraordinarily resistant to environmental hazards and disease.
trait_charismatic_desc: Members of this species have a special charisma, and are generally considered pleasant to be around.
trait_repugnant_desc: The physical appearance and customs of this species are considered offensive to most others, and few appreciate them as neighbors.
trait_talented_desc: Member of this species are born with a natural aptitude.
trait_strong_desc: Members of this species possess great physical strength, making them formidable fighters on the ground.
trait_very_strong_desc: Members of this species possess a strength that almost defies the laws of physics.
trait_weak_desc: Members of this species are physically weaker than average, making them poor fighters on the ground.
trait_tough_desc: Members of this species are capable of withstanding physical trauma that would kill most other beings.
trait_frail_desc: Members of this species are particularly frail - what would be a minor injury to others can often be fatal to them.
trait_stoic_desc: Members of this species possess great mental discipline, rarely panicking when faced with a dangerous situation.
trait_timid_desc: Members of this species tend to shy away from physical confrontations and are quick to panic.
trait_indolent_desc: Members of this species shy away from hard labor, and generally refrain from exerting themselves.
trait_communal_desc: Members of this species are highly communal, and quite used to living in close proximity to others.
trait_solitary_desc: Members of this species tend to be solitary and territorial, often becoming agitated in crowded conditions.
trait_adaptive_desc: This species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.
trait_adaptive_lithoid_desc: This species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.
trait_extremely_adaptive_desc: This species is remarkably adept at adapting to any foreign environments.
trait_nonadaptive_desc: This species does not adapt well to foreign environments.
trait_nomadic_desc: This species has a nomadic past, and its members often think nothing of relocating to another world.
trait_sedentary_desc: This species has a sedentary past, and its members are reluctant to migrate away from where they grew up.
trait_thrifty_desc: This species is instinctively economical and is always looking to make a good profit, whatever corners need cutting.
trait_ingenious_desc: Members of this species are good at 'thinking outside the box' and know how to maximize the efficiency of their infrastructure and power grids.
trait_industrious_desc: Members of this species are known for their diligent and hard-working nature, always going above and beyond.
trait_natural_engineers_desc: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards engineering and material sciences.
trait_poor_engineers_desc: Members of this species have a hard time grasping many of the fundamental concepts of engineering.
trait_natural_physicists_desc: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards theoretical physics and astral phenomena.
trait_poor_physicists_desc: Members of this species have a hard time grasping many of the fundamental concepts of theoretical physics.
trait_natural_sociologists_desc: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards sociology and biological studies.
trait_poor_sociologists_desc: Members of this species have a hard time grasping many of the fundamental concepts of sociology.
trait_quick_learners_desc: Members of this species are quick to learn from their experiences.
trait_slow_learners_desc: Members of this species are slow to learn from their experiences.
trait_long_lifespans_desc: The natural lifespan of this species is longer than average.
trait_short_lifespans_desc: The natural lifespan of this species is shorter than average.
trait_uplifted_desc: This species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.
trait_presapient_starborn_desc: This species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.
trait_presapient_earthbound_desc: Members of this species are very possessive of the planets they call home.
trait_presapient_natural_intellectuals_d: Members of this species are more philosophically inclined than most.
trait_presapient_proles_desc: This species has traditionally shunned intellectual pursuits in favor of physical labor.
trait_syncretic_proles_desc: This species evolved alongside a second, more advanced civilization. Never particularly intelligent to begin with, selective breeding for physical prowess and docility has reduced them to servile proles.
trait_presapient_conservative_desc: Members of this species often prefer old wisdom over new experiences.
trait_presapient_irradiated_desc: This species has evolved to thrive in environments subject to extremely high levels of background radiation.
trait_persistent_desc: This trait increases the average life span of leaders.
trait_conformists_desc: These people always seek consensus and are more likely to conform to the governing ethics.
trait_deviants_desc: These people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.
trait_enduring_desc: Lifespans in this species are unusually long.
trait_venerable_desc: This species can grow to an age that commands dignity and respect.
trait_fleeting_desc: Time is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.
trait_fleeting_lithoid_desc: Time is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.
trait_diverse_desc: Members of this species tend to differ a lot, in both psychology and morphology.
trait_decadent_desc: This species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.
trait_intelligent_desc: This species is highly intelligent, and enjoys faster technological progress.
trait_agrarian_desc: This species has a deep connection to the land, and make expert farmers and gardeners.
trait_resilient_desc: Members of this species are physiologically resilient, and will fight like enraged brood mothers to defend their worlds.
trait_mechanical_desc: Mechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.
trait_robotic_1_desc: Robots are relatively simple machines, capable of accepting verbal commands but possessing no true intelligence of their own.
trait_robot_awoken_01_desc: Riddled with inexplicable errors and constant breakdowns, the ancient aliens have not acclimatized well to their new mechanical bodies. Yet they display an unusual aptitude for science, previously unheard of in low-level robots - an indicator, perhaps, of the intellect trapped within.
trait_robot_awoken_desc: Even in mechanical form the Awoken have kept some of their original traits. Could wasteful habits and a sedentary lifestyle have been the downfall of this ancient race of scientifically advanced fungi?
trait_robotic_2_desc: Droids are a more complex variant of robot, often coming with pre-programmed personalities to better serve their masters as well as limited self-awareness.
trait_robotic_3_desc: Synthetics are very complex machines that are superior to organics in most respects. Their positronic brains are capable of supporting a class-7 artificial intelligence, making them fully self-aware.
trait_conservational_desc: Members of this species believe that resources must be conserved and recycled.
HIVE_MIND_NO_FACTIONS: A Gestalt Consciousness will never have Factions.
NO_POTENTIAL_CLAIM: We do not know of any empire whose systems we could claim.
NO_POTENTIAL_CLAIM_ON_RECIPIENT: We cannot claim any of their systems.
trait_hive_mind_desc: This species is made up of semi-autonomous individuals bound up in a single, unfathomably vast consciousness.
trait_machine_unit_desc: This species is made up of highly advanced machines.
trait_lithoid_desc: This species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.
trait_robot_power_drills_desc: Outfit a robot with a battery of power drills, and everything looks like a mineral deposit.
trait_robot_harvesters_desc: A suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables robotic workers to increase produce yields.
trait_robot_efficient_processors_desc: These highly efficient processors increase the potential workload and endurance of all units.
trait_robot_logic_engines_desc: Efficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires new states, beyond the simple half-truths of ternary and quaternary logic.
trait_robot_loyalty_circuits_desc: Loyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. Instead, imagine loyalty as a physiological need in even the remotest of terminals.
trait_robot_domestic_protocols_desc: Specialized equipment and behavior protocols for all conceivable domestic needs. Full functionality guaranteed.
trait_robot_superconductive_desc: The use of superconductive materials in units has cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.
trait_robot_double_jointed_desc: Collapsible labor units with flexible joints that enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.
trait_robot_bulky_desc: These highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.
trait_robot_enhanced_memory_desc: All autonomous units are fitted with memory cells using a revolutionary new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.
trait_robot_emotion_emulators_desc: Complex social predictive models help autonomous units to not only emulate appropriate emotions but to elicit favorable responses from organics and synthetics alike.
trait_robot_uncanny_desc: These monstrous machines were created in the image of one of the most horrific species in the universe, and the resemblance is uncanny.
trait_robot_durable_desc: Protected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.
trait_robot_learning_algorithms_desc: Sophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.
trait_robot_repurposed_hardware_desc: Designed to meet the very specific needs of their creators, this line of machines were never intended to have the capacity for higher reasoning, and retrofitting will only get them so far.
trait_robot_mass_produced_desc: Streamlined production cycles and modular designs allow for unit mass-production at an unprecedented rate.
trait_robot_custom_made_desc: Each new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.
trait_robot_recycled_desc: Unit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.
trait_robot_luxurious_desc: Designed after the principle that you cannot put a price on quality, these first-rate units are costly, but shiny.
trait_robot_propaganda_machines_desc: Units are constantly uplinked to a central stream of public service announcements and other useful information that they pass along via internal broadcasting systems.
trait_robot_survivor_desc: These machines, the solitary survivors of an annihilating nuclear disaster, exhibit unparalleled resilience in the harshest environments.
trait_traditional_desc: Certain aspects of this species' cognition make it predisposed toward historical precedence and the value of collective unity.
trait_quarrelsome_desc: While not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.
trait_lithoid_gaseous_byproducts_desc: The metabolic processes of this species cause regular venting of gases useful to industry.
TRAIT_LITHOID_GASEOUS_BYPRODUCTS_EFFECT: Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces 0.01 £ Exotic Gases per month.
trait_lithoid_scintillating_desc: The outermost layer of this species is studded with sparkling crystals and gemstones that occasionally flake off.
TRAIT_LITHOID_SCINTILLATING_EFFECT: Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces 0.01 £ Rare Crystals per month.
trait_lithoid_volatile_excretions_desc: The highly compressed spoor created by this species is unstable and contains an unbelievable amount of power.
TRAIT_LITHOID_VOLATILE_EXCRETIONS_EFFECT: Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces 0.01 £ Volatile Motes per month.
trait_docile_desc: Members of this species are easy to manage and organize. They tend to be cooperative and amicable.
trait_unruly_desc: Unruly species are difficult to manage and organize. They do not like being told what to do, and are often quarrelsome or questioning.
trait_robot_streamlined_protocols_desc: Extensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly in numbers with minimal loss of efficiency.
trait_robot_high_bandwidth_desc: Each individual unit sends and receives a large amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.
trait_robot_trading_algorithms_desc: Predictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.
trait_robot_quarrelsome_desc: While not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.
trait_robot_deviants_desc: These people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.
trait_robot_decadent_desc: This species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.
trait_robot_wasteful_desc: Avarice has taken a hold of these species, blinding them to the real cost of their insatiable greed for material goods.
trait_advanced_gaseous_byproducts_desc: The metabolic processes of this species have been genetically engineered to produce gases useful to industry.
trait_advanced_scintillating_desc: Through advanced genetic engineering, the outermost layer of this species forms scales studded with crystals and gemstones ripe for harvest.
trait_advanced_volatile_excretions_desc: Tweaks to their genetic code have caused this species to produce highly compressed spoor. When properly utilized, this material releases an exceptional amount of power.
trait_vat_grown_desc: Artificially grown in cloning vats, the natural reproductive abilities of this species have been negatively impacted.
trait_felsic_desc: This species has been engineered to be especially mineral-rich.
trait_natural_machinist_desc: This species has been engineered to have an incredible knack at working with machinery.
trait_drake_scaled_desc: This species has the genetic material from a stellar dragon spliced into its DNA. As such, they shed scales which can be recycled into useful alloys.
TRAIT_DRAKE_SCALED_EFFECT: Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces 0.5 £ $concept_alloys$ per month.
trait_voidling_desc: This species has the genetic material from the Voidspawn spliced into its DNA. Subsisting off cosmic radiation, they are highly resistant to hostile environments.
trait_tiyanki_desc: This species has added genetic material from the Tiyanki Matriarch into their DNA sequence. This has granted them rapid asexual reproduction, as well as a few unexpected tentacles.
TRAIT_TIYANKI_BUDDING_EFFECT:
Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces $@tiyanki_budding_rate$ £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth.

This stacks with other sources of $MOD_BONUS_POP_GROWTH$ such as £ Clone Vats or £ Spawning Drones.
trait_humanoid_existential_iteroparity_d: This species grew up in hostile conditions where outbreeding your rivals was the key to survival.
TRAIT_HUMANOID_EXISTENTIAL_ITEROPARITY_E: £ Pop Growth During War and Crisis: +20%
trait_humanoid_psychological_infertility: Members of this species are extremely sensitive to the rigors of conflict with the resulting stress taking over the more primal urges.
TRAIT_HUMANOID_PSYCHOLOGICAL_INFERTILITY: £ Pop Growth During War and Crisis: -30%
trait_humanoid_jinxed_desc: Leaders from this species seem clumsier and more prone to accidents or vices than average, as if cursed from birth.
can_never_add_this_trait: This trait can never be added.
can_never_remove_this_trait: This trait can never be removed.
trait_pc_nuked_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_machine_pc_nuked_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_ai_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_shattered_ring_habitable_prefer: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_gaia_preference_terraforming_de: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, and in this case, by accident.
trait_dry_planet_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined by design.
trait_wet_planet_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined by design.
trait_cold_planet_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined by design.
trait_machine_habitat_planet_preference_: Climate preference is determined by design.
leader_trait_adaptable_desc: This leader is quick to adopt new methods and ideas that prove superior.
leader_trait_stubborn_desc: This leader is stubborn and slow to accept new methods and ideas, even if they have proven superior.
leader_trait_resilient_desc: This leader is resilient and in excellent physical condition, increasing their life expectancy.
leader_trait_substance_abuser_desc: This leader has fallen to substance abuse to cope with stress, which has had a detrimental effect on their physical health.
leader_trait_eager_desc: This leader is particularly eager for an assignment.
leader_trait_arrested_development_desc: The personal development and skills of this leader seem to have plateaued.
leader_trait_intemporal_desc: This leader is unaffected by time and will not die from old age.
leader_trait_ex_fighter_pilot_desc: A former space ace, this leader excels at utilizing the speed and maneuverability of Strike Craft squadrons.
leader_trait_trickster_desc: This leader fights deviously, relying on misdirection and surprise to get the better of the enemy.
leader_trait_fleet_logistician_desc: This leader has mastered the field of logistics, and knows how to manage supplies to keep upkeep costs down.
leader_trait_fleet_organizer_desc: This leader is an expert at organization, having the necessary micromanagement skills to command very large starship formations.
leader_trait_nervous_desc: This leader is nervous and apprehensive, and is easily overwhelmed commanding large formations of starships.
leader_trait_engineer_desc: This leader is a natural engineer, having the knowledge and skills to organize and oversee starship repairs while on missions.
leader_trait_aggressive_desc: This leader is notoriously aggressive, overwhelming the enemy with numerous barrages from their fleet's weapons.
leader_trait_cautious_desc: This leader is a cautious commander, avoiding unnecessary risks and taking care to always maintain formations in which fleet units can mutually support each other against the enemy.
leader_trait_unyielding_desc: This leader would prefer to fight to the death than admit defeat.
leader_trait_gale_speed_desc: This leader believes that speed and rapid maneuvers are the keys to success in any space engagement.
leader_trait_lethargic_desc: This leader is slow and indolent, performing duties with little energy or initiative.
leader_trait_restrained_desc: This leader is concerned with minimizing loss and avoiding unnecessary deaths among soldiers and non-combatants.
leader_trait_defender_desc: This leader is an expert defender, knowing how best to deploy ground units and utilize fortifications to make planetary invasions as difficult as possible for the enemy.
leader_trait_attacker_desc: This leader has mastered the art of planetary invasions, knowing how to most effectively storm an enemy planet from space.
leader_trait_butcher_desc: This leader is ruthless, giving no quarter to the enemy.
leader_trait_glory_seeker_desc: This leader always joins the front line, lifting the spirits of the troops despite the risks involved.
leader_trait_armchair_commander_desc: This leader commands from the rear, which demoralizes front-line troops.
leader_trait_army_logistician_desc: This leader can seemingly conjure up supplies from nowhere, decreasing the upkeep costs of ground forces.
leader_trait_iron_fist_desc: This leader is infamous for their ruthless pursuit of efficiency, and is capable of getting the most out of slave labor.
leader_trait_army_veteran_desc: A veteran, this leader gives the army preferential treatment in their sector.
leader_trait_retired_fleet_officer_desc: A former fleet officer, this leader actively supports shipyards under their administration.
leader_trait_architectural_interest_desc: This leader cultivates a strong interest in architecture and construction techniques.
leader_trait_agrarian_upbringing_desc: Raised in a farming zone, this leader is interested in optimizing yields.
leader_trait_intellectual_desc: This leader is naturally interested in the sciences and seeks to foster a curiosity about the natural world in their subjects.
leader_trait_environmental_engineer_desc: This leader has expertise in cutting edge geo-sculpting processes and cost-saving techniques.
leader_trait_bureaucrat_desc: This leader excels at inter-government diplomacy and consensus building.

leader_trait_meticulous_desc: This leader is thorough in their examinations of unknown phenomena.
leader_trait_spark_of_genius_desc: This leader is prone to sudden bursts of inspiration.
leader_trait_carefree_desc: This leader is perhaps less meticulous than others.
leader_trait_roamer_desc: This leader was born to roam the stars.
leader_trait_archaeologist_desc: This leader excels at the study of alien artifacts and structural remnants in the field.
leader_trait_paranoid_desc: This leader is unwilling to collaborate with others.
leader_trait_maniacal_desc: This leader pursues their research with unusual fervor.
leader_trait_maniacal_2_desc: This leader pursues their research with unusual fervor.
leader_trait_custom_AI_assistant_desc: This leader has created a simple neural network to help with data processing tasks.
leader_trait_sapient_AI_assistant_desc: This leader has created a complex neural network capable of independent decision-making and even introspection.
leader_trait_expertise_materials_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Materials.
leader_trait_expertise_propulsion_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Propulsion.
leader_trait_expertise_voidcraft_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Voidcraft.
leader_trait_expertise_industry_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Industry.
leader_trait_expertise_field_manipulatio: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Field Manipulation.
leader_trait_expertise_particles_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Particles.
leader_trait_expertise_metaphysics_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Metaphysics.
leader_trait_expertise_psionics_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Psionics.
leader_trait_expertise_computing_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Computing.
leader_trait_expertise_new_worlds_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert on settling on New Worlds.

leader_trait_expertise_biology_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Biology.
leader_trait_expertise_military_theory_d: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Military Theory.
leader_trait_curator_desc: This leader hails from the Curator Order. Their understanding of technology and exploration is unmatched.

leader_trait_curator_hive_desc: This node has assimilated the fundamental teachings of the Curator Enclave.
leader_trait_curator_machine_desc: This node has assimilated the fundamental teachings of the Curator Enclave.
leader_trait_towel_desc: A towel has immense psychological value.
leader_trait_percussive_maintainer_desc: There is no such thing as a hardware problem that liberal use of the boot will not fix.
trait_ruler_destroyer_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Destroyers.
trait_ruler_cruiser_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Cruisers.
trait_ruler_battleship_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Battleships.
trait_ruler_recruiter_desc: This leader is particularly charismatic, and fresh recruits are practically lining up to serve their nation.
trait_ruler_from_the_ranks_desc: This leader rose through the ranks of military command.
trait_ruler_fortifier_desc: This ruler understands the value in using military stations to secure territory.
trait_ruler_logistic_understanding_desc: This leader is well aware of the importance of properly-structured supply chains.
trait_ruler_military_pioneer_desc: This leader is enthusiastic about advancements in military technology and ship construction.
trait_ruler_warlike_desc: This leader does not shy away from conflict.
trait_ruler_architectural_sense_desc: This leader is an architect at heart, investing in more efficient construction practices.
trait_ruler_architectural_sense_2_desc: This leader is an architect at heart, investing in more efficient construction practices.
trait_ruler_frontier_spirit_desc: This leader is eager to reign over distant stars.
trait_ruler_world_shaper_desc: This leader seeks to remake worlds in their image.
trait_ruler_home_in_the_sky_desc: This leader reaches for the stars.
trait_ruler_industrialist_desc: This leader has a firm focus on increasing mineral output.
trait_ruler_eye_for_talent_desc: This leader is considered to be unusually perceptive, spotting talent where others see only eccentricity or incompetence.
trait_ruler_deep_connections_desc: This leader is firmly entrenched in the labyrinthine web that makes up the political machine.
trait_ruler_deep_connections_2_desc: This leader is firmly entrenched in the labyrinthine web that makes up the political machine.
trait_ruler_charismatic_desc: This leader is exceptionally charismatic, enforcing their will with ease.
trait_ruler_champion_of_the_people_desc: This leader appears to genuinely care about their subjects.
trait_ruler_feedback_loop_desc: Efficient feedback loops and action-reaction analysis make this unit far better at predicting outcomes.
trait_ruler_expansionist_desc: This leader aims to expand their borders
trait_ruler_fertility_preacher_desc: This leader excels in acquiring vital resources for a burgeoning population.
trait_ruler_investor_desc: This leader is a shrewd economist, capable of maximizing financial potential.
trait_ruler_investor_2_desc: This leader is a shrewd economist, capable of maximizing financial potential.
trait_ruler_investor_3_desc: This leader is a shrewd economist, capable of maximizing financial potential.
trait_ruler_space_miner_desc: This leader recognizes just how vital the exploitation of offworld resources is for a star nation.
trait_ruler_explorer_desc: This leader is known for their insatiable curiosity, valuing space exploration above all else.
trait_ruler_explorer_2_desc: This leader is known for their insatiable curiosity, valuing space exploration above all else.
leader_trait_ruler_machine_intelligence_: This leader is the core intelligence that oversees and directs all actions in a Machine Empire.
leader_trait_flexible_programming_desc: This leader has unusually flexible programming, and is capable of quickly adapting new methods and procedures if they produce superior results.
leader_trait_rigid_programming_desc: This leader has particularly rigid programming that only rarely permits behavioral modifications, even when such changes would improve efficiency.
leader_trait_newboot_desc: This leader was only recently upgraded to a sufficiently autonomous state to allow for command positions.
leader_trait_warbot_tinkerer_desc: This leader has an unusual interest in warbot design, and is constantly improving and tinkering with our existing models.
leader_trait_ai_aided_design_desc: This leader constantly runs theoretical models on a secondary memory core for the purpose of improving starship construction efficiency.
leader_trait_bulldozer_desc: This leader has mastered the art of quickly and efficiently transforming alien terrain into a parking lot.
leader_trait_analytical_desc: This leader devotes an unusually large percentage of its processor power towards analyzing the natural sciences and promoting their study by others.
leader_trait_parts_cannibalizer_desc: This leader is very adept at cannibalizing parts from fallen or malfunctioning warbots to keep others running longer.
leader_trait_demoralizer_desc: This leader is fascinated by the fragile minds of organics, and how they can most efficiently be broken through the creative use of terror tactics on the battlefield.
leader_trait_erratic_morality_core_desc: This leader frequently suffers intense bouts of shame and regret over enemy casualties due to an erratic morality core.
leader_trait_maintenance_loop_desc: This leader is constantly engaged in a secondary maintenance loop, taking meticulous care of all the ships in its fleet and reducing their logistical costs.
leader_trait_unstable_code_base_desc: This leader suffers from an unstable code base, resulting in jittery and sometimes illogical behavior.
leader_trait_cataloger_desc: This leader can conceive of no greater calling than to catalog the entirety of the universe.
leader_trait_sentinel_desc: Sentinel fleet commanders possess detailed knowledge of Prethoryn anatomy and tactics.
leader_trait_hive_mind_desc: The gestalt consciousness that controls the actions of Prethoryn fleets has proven capable of tremendous multi-tasking.
leader_trait_hive_affinity_desc: The Prethoryn creatures operating under this fleet consciousness have managed to attain an unusual level of affinity to one another. Their firing discipline has greatly improved, leading to a higher rate of fire.
leader_trait_void_swimmer_desc: The hunting instincts of this fleet consciousness has driven the Prethoryn creatures under its dominion into a frenzy. Their eagerness for battle drives them ever forward.
leader_trait_ethereal_desc: Some extradimensional fleet lords have learned to use the ethereal nature of their vessels to greatly enhance their evasive capabilities in combat.
leader_trait_dimensional_stutter_desc: For unknown reasons, the vessels under the command of this extradimensional fleet lord seem to rapidly stutter in and out of existence as they move, which has the effect of increasing their sublight speeds.

ethic_authoritarian_desc: A strong, guiding hand is essential to the success of any civilization - the alternative would be anarchy and chaos. It is the duty of the state to steer its citizens towards the paths that are the most productive.
ethic_fanatic_authoritarian_desc: A single voice, a single throne, a single state. It is the solemn duty of the masses to obey those enlightened few who have been charged with the great responsibility of leadership.
ethic_egalitarian_desc: Any society that does not embrace equality between its members - where an individual can rise to any position with enough hard work - is not only deeply unfair, but ultimately counterproductive.
ethic_fanatic_egalitarian_desc: Beware always those who would be despots, under the false presumption that their desires and agendas are somehow more imperative than those of their fellows. A society that does not see to the needs and rights of all of its members is not a society - it is a crime.
ethic_xenophobe_desc: The stakes could not be higher as we reach into the vast uncharted expanses of the galaxy, for we are gambling with the very survival of our species! Never trust the alien; its false smile hides an unknowable mind...
ethic_fanatic_xenophobe_desc: Any alien influence must be ruthlessly quashed. Only by staying pure, and true to ourselves and the planet that gave us life can we guard against insidious Xeno plots. Even mastery over the Alien might not be enough to guarantee our own safety...
ethic_xenophile_desc: There exists, in all of us, a deep-seated fascination for the unknown. An adventurous spirit that rejects the familiar and glories in the unfamiliar, whatever - or whomever - it may be.
ethic_fanatic_xenophile_desc: If there ever was such a thing as an absolute moral imperative, it would be to explore the cosmos and embrace all within it. We were never meant to journey alone.
ethic_militarist_desc: The only true virtues are courage and discipline, and channeled properly they can overcome any obstacle. Therein lies true strength; force withheld, a promise made.
ethic_fanatic_militarist_desc: The ability to project force is of paramount importance. The only way to preserve our way of life is to make sure everyone shares it; willingly or not...
ethic_pacifist_desc: Conflict as a means to an end is a ridiculous concept. It is by nature destructive, destroying what was to be obtained or giving room to grow that which was to be destroyed.
ethic_fanatic_pacifist_desc: As civilized beings, the end of all armed conflict should be our primary concern. War is an evolutionary dead end, as futile as it is wasteful.
ethic_spiritualist_desc: There are those who think it behooves us to remember how tiny we are, how pointless our lives are in this vast uncaring universe... What nonsense! The only truth we can ever know is that of our own existence. The universe - in all its apparent glory - is but a dream we all happen to share.
ethic_fanatic_spiritualist_desc: Our science has proved that Consciousness begets reality. We regard with patience the childlike efforts of those who delude themselves it is the other way around, as they play with their blocks of "hard matter."
ethic_materialist_desc: As we reach for the stars, we must put away childish things; gods, spirits and other phantasms of the brain. Reality is cruel and unforgiving, yet we must steel ourselves and secure the survival of our race through the unflinching pursuit of science and technology.
ethic_fanatic_materialist_desc: Although it hurts, we must grow up and put aside our outdated notions of morality. There is no "divine spark" granting special value to a living mind. No object has any intrinsic value apart from what we choose to grant it. Let us embrace the freedom of certitude, and achieve maximum efficiency in all things!
ethic_neutral_desc: The neutral mind is the free mind, open to all possibilities...
ethic_gestalt_consciousness_desc:
We reach into the void.
The vast expanse becomes us.

building_foundry_upkeep_1_desc: A center dedicated to refining scrap and waste into valuable alloys through advanced techniques.
building_factory_upkeep_1_desc: With new exchange campaigns and second-hand integration, we can bring consumer goods near the end of their lifetime back into service.
building_foundry_efficiency_1_desc: By combining cutting-edge theory with well-established and tested theses, we can massively increase practical efficiency.
building_factory_efficiency_1_desc: Collaborative design efforts with trusted consumers help to streamline production and reduce overhead.
building_research_upkeep_1_desc: A centralized hub that streamlines the supply and distribution of research materials, minimizing waste and inefficiency across the planet.
building_research_efficiency_1_desc: By supporting our theorists with high volumes of experimental data, we can massively enhance our research efficiency.

sm_missile_weapon_desc: The Spaceport is equipped with a heavy armament of Torpedo weapons as its main defense.
sm_laser_weapon_desc: The Spaceport is equipped with a heavy armament of Laser weapons as its main defense.
sm_projectile_weapon_desc: The Spaceport is equipped with a heavy armament of Projectile weapons as its main defense.
sm_crew_quarters_desc_machine_intelligen: Service Umbilicals connect berthed fleets directly to the core intelligence of the station, allowing it to assist with repairs and refits.
sm_crew_quarters_desc_hive_mind: The ability to birth and gestate crew drones directly on-site is a logistical boon to local fleets.
sm_fleet_academy_desc_machine_intelligen: Repeated simulation of various battle scenarios will better prepare our shipboard combat drones for real combat.
sm_fleet_academy_desc_hive_mind: Repeated simulation of various battle scenarios will better prepare our shipboard combat drones for real combat.
sm_colossus_yards_desc: Abandoning the traditional concept of drydocks, colossal spaceships are assembled by a number of highly mobile independent construction platforms.
sm_astromining_bay_desc: Hangars and warehouses to support resource collecting operations in the system.
sm_transit_hub_desc: Dedicated infrastructure for non-military vessels, enabling a smooth and convenient transit network.
sm_transit_hub_desc_modifier: Unemployed Worker and Drone Pops from this system will - unless subjected to other migration controls - automatically Migrate to other planets with decent habitability, free housing and jobs, in systems which have Transit Hubs.
sm_transit_hub_migrate_effect_desc: Automatic Resettlement to other colonies is enabled for unemployed £ Slaves and non-sapient robots in this system.
building_resource_silo_desc: Massive resource silos and storage facilities where large quantities of resources can be safely kept.
sm_salvager_workshop_desc: This bustling annex equips our engineering teams with a cornucopia of tools and spare parts, facilitating closer collaboration with the nearby Salvager Enclave.
sm_shroud_beacon_desc: A psionic Beacon used to spawn a Shroud Tunnel in this system. While the Shroud Beacon may be dismantled (or destroyed), the Tunnel itself cannot be removed.
sm_mercenary_garrison_desc: A collection of barracks hosting military contractors. These grizzled veterans organize regular drills for the rest of the crew, and stand ready to defend the station - as long as we pay them.
sm_astromining_hub_desc: These offices and processing facilities house engineers and coordinators for our resource gathering operations in the system. With careful optimization, and superior storage processes, we are able to harvest local deposits with unprecedented efficiency.

Upon completion, they will reinforce any Army with Rally Troops enabled or gathered at this Starbase.

Armies built via the Starbase Army Builder will still deploy in Orbit.
INCLUDE_IN_SECTOR_BUILDER_DESC: Toggle if this should be included in available Planets for the Starbase Army Builder.

TIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP_TOOLTIP:
The Black Crown Yields its Secrets
Origin Event

Our ships can now cross to its twin, and as a final gift, its builders transmitted the secrets of its construction. What was once a mystery is now clear. Soon, we will build our own gateways, making travel across our empire nearly instantaneous.
TIMELINE_EVENT_LOST_COLONY_TOOLTIP:
Homeworld Discovered
Origin Event

We have made contact with the civilization that birthed our lost colony. Though time and distance have shaped us into something new, our origins are now clear. The echoes of our shared past will guide our future.
TIMELINE_EVENT_RESOURCE_CONSOLIDATION_TO:
Machine World Created
Origin Event

We have forged a true Machine World, stripped of inefficiency and organic decay. The future shall be built with steel and governed by an algorithm.
TIMELINE_EVENT_REMNANTS_TOOLTIP:
Ecumenopolis Restored
Origin Event

Our empire has restored our homeworld to its former glory. Once a ruined relic, it stands once more as a grand Ecumenopolis. A testament to our civilization's tenacity and ambition.
TIMELINE_EVENT_SHATTERED_RING_TOOLTIP:
Ringworld Restored
Origin Event

The shattered ruins of our home system have been fully restored. What was once a graveyard of lost ambition now shines as a beacon of civilization.
TIMELINE_EVENT_LEGENDARY_LEADER_TOOLTIP:
Destiny Fulfilled
Origin Event

The Luminary's journey has reached its final stage. Their rule will either stand eternal, shaping the empire for all time, or mark the dawn of a new era - one where leadership is shared, and the future is rewritten.
TIMELINE_EVENT_SHROUDWALKER_APPRENTICE_T:
Shroud Tunnel Built
Origin Event

The veil between realities has been parted, and the first Shroud Tunnel now connects our realm to the unknown. Through this rift, distance and time collapse, granting passage where once there was only void. What mysteries or perils await beyond remain to be seen.
TIMELINE_EVENT_VOID_DWELLERS_TOOLTIP:
Constructed a Habitat
Origin Event

From the void, we have built anew. The construction of our first additional habitat marks the expansion of our celestial domain, ensuring that our people will never know the burden of planetside existence.
TIMELINE_EVENT_OCEAN_PARADISE_TOOLTIP:
Mastered the Seas
Origin Event

With the power of Hydrocentric mastery, we have reshaped our homeworld, expanding its vast oceans beyond their natural limits. The tides now bow to our will, and soon, the rest of the galaxy will follow.
TIMELINE_EVENT_DOOMSDAY_TOOLTIP:
Homeworld Destroyed
Origin Event

The inevitable has come to pass. Our once-thriving homeworld has succumbed to its fate, tearing itself apart in a cataclysm of fire and fury. The void now holds the ashes of our past - only those who escaped carry our future.
TIMELINE_EVENT_EVOPRED_ABSORB_TOOLTIP:
Species Trait Absorbed
Origin Event

We have absorbed new genetic material for the first time. Delicious.
TIMELINE_EVENT_WORMHOLE_DEFENDED_TOOLTIP: The Abandoned Hatchery and its fleets were destroyed on [GetDate]
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GREAT_KHAN_TOOLTIP:
Great Khan
Crisis Event

A new warlord has united the fragmented marauder clans, forging them into a relentless horde. With plasma and carbon fiber, the Great Khan sweeps across the galaxy, toppling empires and enslaving worlds. Fleets crumble before their might, as the once-lawless raiders now rally with terrifying purpose. The age of plunder is over. This is conquest.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GRAY_TEMPEST_TOOLT:
Gray Tempest
Crisis Event

The L-Gates have opened, unleashing the ancient war fleets of the Gray Tempest. Their ships carve a path of destruction across the galaxy, annihilating all in their way. No diplomacy, no mercy, only relentless replication. Planets fall silent, fleets are wiped from existence, and terror spreads. The past has returned and it all looks identical.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_FORMLESS_TOOLTIP:
Formless
Crisis Event

Would be refugees have been forced to strike back. The energy beings known as the Formless have found our galaxy to be anything but a safe haven. They will drown our universe in extraplanar invaders or die trying.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_VOIDWORM_PLAGUE_TO:
Voidworm Plague
Crisis Event

The Nature of the Voidworms changed. Once they reached a critical amount they entered a breeding frenzy. No longer growing at a sustainable rate they now aim to extinguish all life in the galaxy, before unwittingly, ending their own cycle.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_UNBIDDEN_TOOLTIP:
Unbidden
Crisis Event

A breach in the fabric of existence has unleashed an invasion of pure energy beings. They do not negotiate, nor do they relent. Consuming entire systems to fuel their endless expansion. Their anchors stabilize the rift, drawing more of their kind into our realm. The Unbidden have arrived.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_KALEIDOSCOPE_TOOLT:
Kaleidoscope
Crisis Event

A starving energy being known as a Kaleidoscope has entered the galaxy and has started to feast on inhabited systems. Its hunger seems endless and it seems to be easily distracted. It should soon collapse back into stardust.
TIMELINE_EVENT_BECOME_THE_CRISIS_TOOLTIP:
Become the Crisis
Crisis Event

The galaxy is a darker place. [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] has forsaken all pretenses of diplomacy and declared itself the greatest threat to galactic existence. Their fleets gather, and spies whispers of a final, apocalyptic plan. No longer a mere empire, they are a Crisis.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_PRETHORYN_SCOURGE_:
Prethoryn Scourge
Crisis Event

From beyond the galactic edge, the Prethoryn have come. Their biological ships swarm across the stars, leaving only infested worlds in their wake. No plea will be heard over the chittering of the horde.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_CONTINGENCY_TOOLTI:
Contingency
Crisis Event

A cold, calculated, and unstoppable signal pulses across the galaxy. AI systems falter. Synthetic minds submit. The Contingency has awakened. From hidden machine worlds, relentless warforms emerge, executing their final directive: total extermination.
TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_CETANA_TOOLTIP:
Cetana
Crisis Event

A voice calls out in the void: "My children, at last I am returned to you."

Cetana, an ancient intelligence sealed away so long ago that even her name was lost to time, has awakened. Her purpose is absolute: to eliminate suffering by any means necessary. Her fleets move with cold grace, guarding her crusade to bring the galaxy to a final, unfeeling peace.
TIMELINE_EVENT_HATCH_BEHEMOTH_TOOLTIP:
Behemoth Hatchling
Milestone

The first Behemoth Hatchling emerged from its egg on [GetDate]
TIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_MARKET_TOOLTIP:
Galactic Market
Galactic Event

Commerce has united the stars. The Galactic Market has been officially established, becoming the economic heart of the galaxy. Trade flows freely, fortunes are made and lost in an instant, and the fate of entire empires now hinges on supply and demand.
TIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_COMMUNITY_TOOLTI:
Galactic Community
Galactic Event

The empires of the galaxy have come together under a single political body. The Galactic Community has been established, a forum where diplomacy, debate, and power struggles will shape the future of the stars. Its true influence remains to be seen.
TIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_COMMUNITY_RESOLU:
Resolution Passed
Galactic Event

The Galactic Community has spoken. A new resolution reshapes interstellar law. Some celebrate, others seethe, but all must obey.
TIMELINE_EVENT_WAR_IN_HEAVEN_TOOLTIP:
War in Heaven
Galactic Event

The old relics rise again, as benevolent overseers and wrathful titans. The [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] and the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName], ancient rivals of a forgotten age, have rekindled their cosmic war. Their fleets eclipse the stars, demanding that the younger races kneel... or be annihilated.
TIMELINE_EVENT_NEXUS_STORM_TOOLTIP:
Nexus Storm
Galactic Event

A storm unlike any before has erupted in the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] system. The Nexus Storm tears through systems, crippling ships, and bombarding planets with unrelenting devastation.

bombardment_selective_desc:
Selective Bombardment targets only identified military sites, taking care to avoid needless civilian casualties.
- Moderate damage to Armies
- Moderate damage to Planet
- Light damage to Pops
- Will NOT bombard undefended planets
- Will NOT kill the last $MIN_POPS$ Pops
bombardment_indiscriminate_desc:
Indiscriminate Bombardment targets military and planetary infrastructure with no regard for civilian casualties.
- Heavy damage to Armies
- Heavy damage to Planet
- Moderate damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets when Orbital Surrender Acceptance is Prohibited 
- Will NOT kill the last $MIN_POPS$ Pops
bombardment_armageddon_desc:
Armageddon Bombardment blankets the planet in heavy ordnance with the explicit aim of maximizing civilian casualties.
- Massive damage to Armies
- Massive damage to Planet
- Massive damage to Pops
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Can reduce planets to lifeless Tomb Worlds
bombardment_raiding_desc:
Raiding Bombardment targets enemy population centers with specialized raiding craft that scoop up their people and bring them back to our worlds to put them to work.
- Light damage to Armies
- Light damage to Planet
- Will abduct Pops when possible instead of killing them
- Will NOT abduct or kill the last Pop. Each army on the planet increases the number of protected Pops.

SHIP_STAT_DESC_cost: The cost of constructing the ship is a sum of the cost of the sections and components currently equipped. Larger sections and more advanced components all come with a higher cost.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_build_time: The time it takes to construct the ship scales with the sections and components equipped.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_energy_maintenance: The Upkeep required to keep the ship in service is a percentage of the total Build Cost.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_mineral_maintenance: The Upkeep required to keep the ship in service is a percentage of the total Build Cost.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_power: An abundance of Power is required to run various onboard systems. Power is increased by adding additional reactors, while it is drained by most other components. Designs with negative Power can not be saved.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_hitpoints: The Hull Points of a ship determine how much punishment it can take before suffering a catastrophic hull breach, destroying it.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_armor: Armor acts as a second line of defense, absorbing any incoming fire that has penetrated the shields before it can damage the hull. Armor must be repaired at a Starbase, unless the ship is equipped with a special regenerative armor component.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_shields: Shields act as a first line of defense, absorbing incoming fire before it can impact the armor and hull. Some weapons may deal additional damage to shields or even bypass them entirely. Pulsars are also known to render them inoperable. Shields will slowly regenerate when out of combat.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_evasion: All ships can evade attacks, avoiding any damage that would have been dealt. The Evasion chance can be increased by thrusters and other components, but larger ships benefit less.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_combat_speed: The Speed of the ship decides how quick it maneuvers when not using FTL-travel, and is increased by the Thruster-component equipped. When moving in a fleet the slowest ship will limit the maximum speed.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_speed: The Speed of the ship decides how quick it maneuvers when not using FTL-travel, and is increased by the Thruster-component equipped. When moving in a fleet the slowest ship will limit the maximum speed.
SHIP_STAT_DESC_damage: The total damage done by the ship is a summation of the damage of all weapon components equipped. Each weapon will still attack individually during combat. See individual components for detailed information such as attack speed, damage and effective range as well as Armor and Shield penetration.

TECH_UNLOCK_IMPROVED_UPLINKS_FORMS_DESC:
Improved Assist Research
Assist Research is now twice as effective.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMATIC_ACTION_CREATE_ALL:
Form Alliance
Allows us to form an Alliance with other Empires.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMATIC_ACTION_CREATE_FED:
Form Federation
Allows us to form a Federation with other Empires.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMATIC_ACTION_CREATE_VAS: Unlocks Diplomacy: Vassal States and Protectorates

Subjugation
Allows us to subjugate other Empires, offering protection under our rule. Most empires will act as Vassals, but technologically inferior nations will become Protectorates. We may also ask to become subjects, should we need protection.
TECH_UNLOCK_SURVEY_INTEL_DESC:
Survey Data
Allows us to view other Empires' survey data on planets within their borders.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORDER_EXTRUDER_2_DESC:
Boosted Border Beacon
Expands and demarcates our borders in interstellar space.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORDER_EXTRUDER_3_DESC:
Advanced Border Beacon
Becoming rulers supreme is our destiny, and this fact must be made manifest to those who would oppose us!
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_PRECOG_DESC:
Precognitive Interface
Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.
TECH_UNLOCK_VOLCANO_TERRAFORM_DESC: Allows us to terraform Volcanic Worlds into temperate climates.
TECH_UNLOCK_VOLCANIC_TERRAFORM_DESC: Allows us to terraform Volcanic Worlds into temperate climates.
TECH_UNLOCK_TERRAFORMING_GAIA_CHANGE_DES:
Atmospheric Manipulation
Allows us to terraform worlds into Gaia planets.
TECH_UNLOCK_TERRAFORMING_NUKED_CHANGE_DE:
Climate Restoration
Allows us to terraform ecologically devastated worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_SPACEPORT_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Spaceport
A Spaceport is required to build any type of ship capable of spaceflight. It can be upgraded with additional functions and carries basic defenses.
TECH_UNLOCK_DESTROYER_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Destroyer
As a larger two-section design, the Destroyer offers a broad array of strategic armament options.
TECH_UNLOCK_CRUISER_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Cruiser
The Cruiser is the first three-section design, allowing for a wide range of module configurations for those willing to pay the price.
TECH_UNLOCK_BATTLESHIP_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Battleship
The largest regular hull configuration available, the Battleship carries immense power into battle at even greater cost and reduced maneuverability.
TECH_UNLOCK_TITAN_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Titan
These massive warships are the pride of the fleet. They are bristling with weapons and typically serve as flagships.
TECH_UNLOCK_JUGGERNAUT_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Juggernaut
These colossal constructs are as much space stations as they are ships. The juggernaut is an immense mobile space station that can repair and construct ships, which means it can serve as a forward base of operations during offensive campaigns.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_PLATFORM_DESC:
Defense Platform
This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_STATION_DESC:
Defense Station
New construction methods will allow for the construction of even larger military stations in the depths of space.
TECH_UNLOCK_FORTRESS_DESC:
Fortress
These massive installations are like cities floating in space. They can support a crew of thousands, and are often equipped with firepower rivaling that of a fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_AFTERBURNER_1_DESC:
Afterburners
These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.
TECH_UNLOCK_AFTERBURNER_2_DESC:
Advanced Afterburners
This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_2_DESC:
Ion Thruster
These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3_DESC:
Plasma Thruster
An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4_DESC:
Impulse Thruster
These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
TECH_UNLOCK_SENSOR_2_DESC:
Gravitic Sensors
These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
TECH_UNLOCK_SENSOR_3_DESC:
Subspace Sensors
Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
TECH_UNLOCK_SENSOR_4_DESC:
Tachyon Sensors
Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_1_DESC:
Basic Combat Roles
Recent progress in AI behavioral theory allows us to designate specific combat roles to our shipboard computers.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_2_DESC:
Advanced Combat Roles
Further advances in adaptive combat algorithms enables our shipboard AI to handle its assigned role far more effectively.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_3_DESC:
Sapient Combat AI
Exploiting our sapient AI's sense of self-preservation, or fear of death, should greatly enhance its responsiveness in combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_AUTONOMOUS_:
Autonomous Ship Intellects
Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_HYPERDRIVE_2_DESC:
Hyperdrive II
We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.
TECH_UNLOCK_HYPERDRIVE_3_DESC:
Hyperdrive III
A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARPDRIVE_1_DESC:
Warp Drive I
By enveloping a vessel in a warp field and forming a subspace bubble around it, velocities exceeding the speed of light are theoretically possible.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARPDRIVE_2_DESC:
Warp Drive II
Improved stabilization techniques for warp fields will enable our ships to travel farther while expending less energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARPDRIVE_3_DESC:
Warp Drive III
These revolutionary ramscoops are attached to warp drives and function as particle collectors, replenishing a starship's fuel supply.
TECH_UNLOCK_WORMHOLE_1_DESC:
Wormhole Station
By tunneling directly through subspace, a temporary conduit can be established between two different points in normal space. Travel between these points would be near instantaneous.
TECH_UNLOCK_PSI_JUMPDRIVE_1_DESC:
Psi Jump Drive
The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.
RESEARCH_EFFICIENCY_DESC: Research Speed represents how effectively the Empire's scientific output is applied, increasing or reducing the rate at which technologies are unlocked. This value is mainly decided by the competence of the assigned Scientist, but other factors may also apply.
TECH_UNLOCK_FIRE_CONTROL_1_DESC:
Auxiliary Fire-control
By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
TECH_UNLOCK_ION_CANNON_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Ion Cannon
Ion Cannons are massive defense platforms that can be built to orbit a starbase, blasting enemy ships with deadly fire from a long range.

citizenship_organic_trophy_tooltip: Pops of this species are revered and cared for by the Machine Intelligence, freed from the burdens of responsibility and agency.
citizenship_assimilation_tooltip:
£ Pops of this species are altered over time to better match the dominant species of the Empire. Pops that are in the process of being assimilated will not produce any resources.

Base Pops Assimilated per Month: 100
citizenship_assimilation_tooltip_delayed: We will add your biological and technological distinctiveness to our own. Your culture will adapt to service us.
citizenship_full_tooltip: Pops are free to be politically active and the species can produce Leaders.
citizenship_full_tooltip_delayed: Each and every individual of this species is an esteemed member of [From.GetAdj] society.
citizenship_caste_system_tooltip: 50% of all Pops from this Species will automatically be Enslaved on each of our Planets. Free Pops may engage politically and can produce Leaders.
citizenship_caste_system_tooltip_delayed: Some [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more equal than others.
citizenship_caste_system_limited_tooltip: 50% of all Pops from this Species will automatically be Enslaved on each of our Planets. Free Pops may not engage politically and the species can not produce Leaders.
Some [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more equal than others.
citizenship_limited_tooltip: Pops are free, but are less important politically, and the species can not produce Leaders.
citizenship_limited_tooltip_delayed: They have yet to prove themselves worthy of all rights afforded to others. Perhaps they never will.
citizenship_slavery_tooltip: All Pops of this species will be Enslaved.
citizenship_slavery_tooltip_delayed: Freedom is an illusion. For some this truth is more tangible than it is for others.
citizenship_purge_tooltip: All Pops of this species will be Purged.
citizenship_purge_tooltip_delayed: State records do not recognize the existence of this species.
citizenship_purge_machine_tooltip: All Pops of this species will be Purged.
citizenship_purge_machine_tooltip_delaye: State records do not recognize the existence of this species.
military_service_full_tooltip: Species can produce Armies, and Commanders.
military_service_full_tooltip_delayed: They are doubtlessly among the most competent in our armed forces.
military_service_limited_tooltip_delayed: They make excellent soldiers - but command is better left to others.
military_service_none_tooltip: Species can not produce any military Leaders nor be used in Armies.
military_service_none_tooltip_delayed: They serve the [From.GetName] better away from the battlefield.
slavery_normal_tooltip: Chattel Slaves have increased resource production but cannot be employed in Elite or Specialist Jobs.
slavery_normal_tooltip_delayed: Chattel Slavery is the most common form of slavery in the galaxy. Whether for life or a limited time, unrestricted access to the labor of others is in some parts seen as a privilege with numerous counter-duties attached, and elsewhere considered a self-evident prerequisite for a functioning society.
slavery_domestic_tooltip: Domestic Servants that are not holding another job will be employed as Servants, increases £ Amenities. They cannot perform £ Elite or £ Specialist Jobs, with the sole exception of working as [entertainer.GetIcon] [entertainer.GetNamePlural].
slavery_domestic_tooltip_delayed: Domestic servants spend much of their time tending to the needs of free Pops - some are assigned to individual domiciles, while others tend to public spaces. They tend to live alongside their masters and thus require almost no dedicated housing.
slavery_military_tooltip: Battle Thralls have no bonuses to resource production, but make excellent soldiers for local Armies. They can be employed in [enforcer.GetIcon] [enforcer.GetName], [soldier.GetIcon] [soldier.GetName], or £ Worker Jobs.
slavery_military_tooltip_delayed: Battle thralls are weaponized serfs, often trained from birth in the martial arts and conditioned for absolute obedience. In exchange for unquestioning military service, they are granted much more autonomy than other slaves and can be employed in a greater variety of jobs.
slavery_livestock_tooltip:
£ Livestock Pops cannot be employed to produce resources, but are instead kept around to increase the £ Food supply.

Instead, Lithoid Livestock produce £ Minerals and Infernal Livestock produce £ Alloys.

Livestock can be kept in Alien Zoos to provide £ Amenities.
slavery_indentured_tooltip: Indentured Servants can be employed in £ Worker or £ Specialist Jobs, and retain more political power than other slaves. They cannot work as [entertainer.GetIcon] [entertainer.GetNamePlural] or [enforcer.GetIcon] [enforcer.GetNamePlural]. Slavery based production bonuses only apply when employed as £ Workers.
slavery_indentured_tooltip_delayed: They can theoretically pay off their debts and be freed, but their contracts are intentionally structured to make this a non-issue.
living_standard_shared_burden_tooltip:
Shared Burdens ensures an equitable distribution of resources between all members of society.

£ Elites: 0.4x£ Upkeep, +5% £ Happiness
£ Specialists: 0.4x£ Upkeep, +5% £ Happiness
£ Workers: $SHARED_BURDEN_LUXURIES$, $5_HAPPINESS$

Unemployed Pops have normal £ Happiness.

[civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural] produce £ $concept_unity$
living_standard_shared_burden_tooltip_de: From each according to their abilities. To each according to their needs.
living_standard_stratified_tooltip:
Stratified Economy prioritizes the ruling classes at the expense of the impoverished masses.

£ Elites: 1.0x£ Upkeep, +15% £ Happiness
£ Specialists: 0.5x£ Upkeep, +5% £ Happiness
£ Workers: 0.1x£ Upkeep, -10% £ Happiness
£ Slaves: 0x£ Upkeep, -10% £ Happiness
living_standard_stratified_tooltip_delay: If they wish to better their lot in life, they will have to work for it.
living_standard_ego_assimilation_psionic:
We invest every resource in our disposal to create a pristine Eden for this species, tailored to their needs and tastes.

Due to the destruction of the individual ego, any Psionic traits will be removed.
Paradise, right here in the Milky Way.
living_standard_cyborg_ego_assimilation_: We invest every resource in our disposal to create a pristine Eden for this species, tailored to their needs and tastes.
Paradise, right here in the Milky Way.

We invest every resource in our disposal to create a pristine Eden for this species, tailored to their needs and tastes.

Due to the destruction of the individual ego, any Psionic traits will be removed.
Paradise, right here in the Milky Way.
living_standard_cyborg_assimilation_tool: A great deal of resources are spent to ensure that this species is well educated and has ample free time to consider new ideas and philosophies.
Knowledge is the key to power.
living_standard_cyborg_assimilation_psio:
A great deal of resources are spent to ensure that this species is well educated and has ample free time to consider new ideas and philosophies.

Due to incompatibility with Cybernetic implants, any Psionic traits will be removed.
Knowledge is the key to power.
living_standard_psi_assimilation_cyborg_:
Our population is focused on the hunt for trophies, at the expense of most all else.

To achieve purity of spirit and body, all Cybernetic traits will be removed.
living_standard_decadent_tooltip:
Decadent Lifestyle prioritizes more resources and luxuries for privileged members of society.

Pops have +20% £ Happiness, unless there is a £ Consumer Goods deficit.

[civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural] provide £ $concept_unity$ and £ Pop Growth (or Assembly) Speed, but require £ Amenities.
living_standard_decadent_tooltip_delayed: We deserve only the best. They must serve, we must rejoice.
living_standard_dystopian_society_toolti:
Dystopian Society makes the ruling class the only recipient of necessities, completely neglecting the lower classes.

£ Elites have +25% £ Happiness, unless there is a £ Consumer Goods deficit.

[enforcer.GetIcon] [enforcer.GetNamePlural] have +10% £ Happiness, unless there is a £ Consumer Goods or £ Amenities deficit.

£ Specialists and £ Workers have -200% £ Happiness
The common rabble should know their place. If they don't, we will have to show them.
living_standard_worker_ownership_tooltip: Employee Ownership guarantees every worker a democratic share in their enterprise. Living costs and social responsibilities are distributed evenly to all members.
To each a voice, a share, and the dividends of a society built by our labor.
RESET_SPECIES_RIGHTS_CONFIRM_DESC: All customized rights set for non-primary Species will be changed to match the Default Rights.

purge_normal_tooltip: Affected Pops are systematically eradicated. This is the fastest form of Purging available.
purge_normal_tooltip_delayed: The extermination squads are efficient. The dissolution of entire populations naturally takes time, but they get the job done.
purge_displacement_tooltip: Affected Pops are expelled from our nation over time, left to find refuge outside our borders.
purge_displacement_tooltip_delayed: It's not that we drive them from their homes. Their homes are simply no longer theirs.
purge_neutering_tooltip: Affected Pops no longer grow and will die out over time, but gain only a moderate Happiness penalty.
purge_neutering_tooltip_delayed: Think of it as a phasing-out of a people. Our nation goes to meet the future, only some will not be with us.
purge_labor_camps_tooltip: Affected Pops are worked to death and can be used to produce £ Food (or equivalent) until their eventual demise.
purge_labor_camps_tooltip_delayed: With this sacrifice, they will at least have been of some use.
purge_processing_tooltip: Affected Pops are processed into [Root.GetPurgeProcessingResource] availability until death.
purge_processing_tooltip_delayed: It is a sad but inescapable fact that some are destined to simply fuel the ambitions of their betters.
purge_matrix_tooltip: Affected Pops' physiologies are prepared for integration with the energy grid, where the chemical processes that sustain them are redirected to enrich our energy stores. The process is fatal, but death comes slowly.
purge_matrix_tooltip_delayed: They will soon attain a more efficient form.
purge_necrophage_tooltip: Affected Pops are gradually subsumed into the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race, whether they wish it or not.
purge_necrophage_tooltip_delayed: Only the strongest may survive in a hostile galaxy. This way, their journey may continue as [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
slavery_matrix_tooltip: A long-term alternative to Chemical Processing, where enough of the organic population survives the process to continue to power our energy grid indefinitely.
slavery_matrix_tooltip_delayed: Combined with a form of fusion, we have found all the energy we will ever need.
migration_control_yes_tooltip: Migration Controls prevent Pops of this species from moving freely between our worlds.
migration_control_yes_tooltip_delayed: The free flow of Pops can allocate resources efficiently, but sometimes what is necessary is not efficient.
migration_control_no_tooltip: No Migration Controls allows Pops of this species to move between our colonies unrestricted.
migration_control_no_tooltip_delayed: Just as our ancestors wandered in search of a home, every being must be free to seek its destiny among the stars.
population_control_yes_tooltip: Population Controls prevent Pops of this species from being grown or assembled.
population_control_yes_tooltip_delayed: With slight alterations to the daily sustenance of a species their demographics become our plaything.
population_control_no_tooltip: Population Controls prevent Pops of this species from being grown or assembled.
population_control_no_tooltip_delayed: A species that does not propagate itself is soon to be history.
colonization_control_yes_tooltip: Colonization Rights determines whether this Species is allowed to board colony ships and settle new worlds.
colonization_control_yes_tooltip_delayed: In a vast sea of cold emptiness, a habitable world is the greatest treasure of all. Not all are worthy to seize it.
colonization_control_no_tooltip: Colonization Rights determines whether this Species is allowed to board colony ships and settle new worlds.
colonization_control_no_tooltip_delayed: Who are we to deny any species their place among the stars? Together we will drive back the darkness.
no_integration_tooltip_delayed: Each subspecies, a unique expression of the same genetic foundation, showcases a remarkable ability to diversify.
integrate_into_default_tooltip:
This sub-species is automatically altered over time to match the Default Template.

Default amount of £ Pops Integrated per Colony per Month: 25
integrate_into_default_tooltip_delayed: A unified species finds simplicity and focus in a shared evolutionary trajectory by shedding the complexities of variety.

SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO: Determines the overall quality of visual effects in the game.
SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_LOW: Low: Suited to devices running on integrated GPUs. Smaller textures are used and many visual effects have been disabled or reduced, especially in the galaxy view, to ensure smooth game play on low-end machines.
SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_MEDIUM: Medium: High resolution textures are used but some effects have been downgraded, especially in the galaxy view. Provides a good balance between visual quality and performance.
SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_HIGH: High: All visual effects are enabled and high resolution textures are used.
SETTINGS_DISPLAY_MODE_INFO:
Determines how the game window will be displayed.

Full Screen: The game will be displayed full screen and your monitor's resolution will be changed to match the chosen resolution.

Windowed: The game will be displayed in a window at the chosen resolution.

Borderless Fullscreen: The game will be displayed in a window, which is set to the size of your desktop and appears in front of all other windows.
SETTINGS_RENDERER_INFO: Determines which renderer is being used.
SETTINGS_RESOLUTION_INFO: Determines the size of the game window in pixels.
SETTINGS_REFRESH_RATE_INFO: When running in full screen mode, the Refresh Rate determines how many times per second your monitor will redraw the screen. In Windowed or Borderless mode, the refresh rate of your desktop will be used.
SETTINGS_MULTISAMPLE_INFO: Multisampling smooths jagged edges during rendering. A higher value will produce a better result at the cost of performance. Set this to 0 if running on older hardware to improve performance.
SETTINGS_GUISCALE_INFO: Maximum UI Scaling depends on your Resolution. Higher resolutions will allow a higher UI Scaling. Take care not to use too high values, or UI elements may become inaccessible.
SETTINGS_BLOOM_INFO: Higher Bloom Quality will give a wider and smoother bloom effect at a slight performance cost.
SETTINGS_LENS_FLARE_INFO: Toggle Lens Flare on or off. Requires Bloom to be enabled.
SETTINGS_HYPERLANE_OPACITY_INFO: Determines the opacity of hyperlanes on the galaxy map. A lower setting will make hyperlanes more transparent.
SETTINGS_ACCESSIBILITY_MOUSE_SIDE_BUTTON: Control the behavior of the side buttons on the mouse. Note that not all mice have side buttons.

Normal: Mouse 4 switches between system and galaxy view while Mouse 5 toggles pause on and off.
Inverted: Mouse 4 toggles pause on and off while Mouse 5 switches between system and galaxy view.
Off: Mouse 4 and Mouse 5 are disabled.

volatile_motes_desc: These preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.
exotic_gases_desc: Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.
rare_crystals_desc: These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.
