RED_LASER_DESC: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.
BLUE_LASER_DESC: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.
UV_LASER_DESC: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.
XRAY_LASER_DESC: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.
GAMMA_LASER_DESC: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.
SPACEPORT_LASER_DESC: Spaceport-mounted lasers feature excellent target tracking, to make up for the immobility of the spaceport itself.
ENERGY_LANCE_1_DESC: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage.
ENERGY_LANCE_2_DESC: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power.
ENERGY_LANCE_TURRET_1_DESC: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage.
ENERGY_LANCE_TURRET_2_DESC: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power.
PERDITION_BEAM_DESC: A massive array of linked energy amplification conduits that fires a beam of unprecedented firepower.
PERDITION_BEAM_FLEET_EFFECT: Collateral Damage: Deals $@perdition_beam_fleet_damage|0G$ damage to all ships within $@perdition_beam_collateral_range|0Y$ of the target.
ION_CANNON_FLEET_EFFECT: Collateral Damage: Deals $@ion_cannon_fleet_damage|0G$ damage to all ships within $@ion_cannon_collateral_range|0Y$ of the target.
PLASMA_1_DESC: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor and hull.
PLASMA_2_DESC: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.
PLASMA_3_DESC: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.
ARC_EMITTER_1_DESC: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at a target, bypassing shields and armor.
ARC_EMITTER_2_DESC: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.
ARC_EMITTER_TURRET_1_DESC: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at a target, bypassing shields and armor.
ARC_EMITTER_TURRET_2_DESC: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.
DISRUPTOR_1_DESC: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together.
DISRUPTOR_2_DESC: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets, without sacrificing the firing rate of their predecessors.
DISRUPTOR_3_DESC: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.
ENERGY_TORPEDO_1_DESC: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.
ENERGY_TORPEDO_2_DESC: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.
MINING_DRONE_LASER_1_DESC: Focused mining lasers cut through ship hulls as easily as they carve rocky asteroids.
BLUE_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Blue Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Sapphire-class Crystalline Entities to inflict damage.
GREEN_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Green Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Emerald-class Crystalline Entities to inflict middling damage.
YELLOW_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Yellow Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Topaz-class Crystalline Entities to inflict good damage.
RED_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Red Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Ruby-class Crystalline Entities to inflict considerable damage.
SPACE_CLOUD_WEAPON_1_DESC: Utilizing our understanding of the fundamental forces involved in generating the Void Clouds' considerable internal charge to the fullest, the Cloud Lightning weapon system is a potent damage-dealer.
EXTRADIMENSIONAL_1_DESC: Hailing from another dimension, the core technologies of the Matter Disintegrator bends several physical laws for destructive results.
MISSILE_1_DESC: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.
MISSILE_2_DESC: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.
MISSILE_3_DESC: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.
MISSILE_4_DESC: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.
MISSILE_5_DESC: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.
SPACEPORT_MISSILE_DESC: With available space being less of a concern than on mobile vessels, a spaceport can house larger ammunition stores and more efficient loading mechanisms for its missiles.
SWARMER_MISSILE_1_DESC: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.
SWARMER_MISSILE_2_DESC: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.
SCOURGE_MISSILE_1_DESC: The Scourge Missile payloads are made up of many of the biochemical compounds used by the Swarm in interstellar combat, having proven unexpectedly effective against even the hardiest of military vessels.
SPACEPORT_SCOURGE_MISSILE_DESC: The Scourge Missile payloads are made up of many of the biochemical compounds used by the Swarm in interstellar combat, having proven unexpectedly effective against even the hardiest of military vessels.
MEDIUM_SCOURGE_PROJECTILE_WEAPON_DESC: Enclosed in ballistic capsules, the highly corrosive organic matter used in the Swarm's orbital bombardment can be repurposed as ship munitions.
SMALL_SCOURGE_PROJECTILE_WEAPON_DESC: Enclosed in ballistic capsules, the highly corrosive organic matter used in the Swarm's orbital bombardment can be repurposed as ship munitions.
SWARM_STRIKE_CRAFT_1_DESC: Cloned, miniaturized Prethoryn specimen can be controlled through wavelengths close to those we use for intra-fleet communication, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT_1_DESC: Amoebas bred in captivity spawn Flagella that can be imprinted to respond to subtle shifts in hull magnetization, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
TORPEDO_1_DESC: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.
TORPEDO_2_DESC: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.
TORPEDO_3_DESC: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.
MASS_DRIVER_1_DESC: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.
MASS_DRIVER_2_DESC: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.
MASS_DRIVER_3_DESC: Railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.
MASS_DRIVER_4_DESC: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an upgraded power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.
MASS_DRIVER_5_DESC: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.
SPACEPORT_MASS_DRIVER_DESC: Spaceport-mounted mass drivers, while of an older design, pack a considerable punch even when compared to their ship-mounted brethren.
KINETIC_ARTILLERY_1_DESC: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.
KINETIC_ARTILLERY_2_DESC: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.
MASS_ACCELERATOR_1_DESC: An enormous variant of kinetic artillery, so large that it has to be placed in a fixed spinal mount.
MASS_ACCELERATOR_2_DESC: An even more powerful variant of spinal-mounted kinetic artillery.
MASS_ACCELERATOR_TURRET_1_DESC: An enormous variant of kinetic artillery, mounted in a massive, reinforced turret.
MASS_ACCELERATOR_TURRET_2_DESC: An even more powerful variant of turreted kinetic artillery.
AUTOCANNON_1_DESC: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.
AUTOCANNON_2_DESC: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.
AUTOCANNON_3_DESC: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.
FLAK_BATTERY_1_DESC: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.
FLAK_BATTERY_2_DESC: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.
FLAK_BATTERY_3_DESC: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.
EMPTY_DRIVE_DESC: Ships without FTL drives will never be able to leave the solar systems in which they were built.
WARP_DRIVE_1_DESC: Warp Drives allow FTL travel to and from the edges of star systems, with limited range and wind-up and wind-down periods at departure and arrival.
WARP_DRIVE_2_DESC: Warp Drives allow FTL travel to and from the edges of star systems, with limited range and wind-up and wind-down periods at departure and arrival.
WARP_DRIVE_3_DESC: Warp Drives allow FTL travel to and from the edges of star systems, with limited range and wind-up and wind-down periods at departure and arrival.
HYPER_DRIVE_1_DESC: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.
HYPER_DRIVE_2_DESC: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.
HYPER_DRIVE_3_DESC: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.
JUMP_DRIVE_1_DESC: The Jump Drive tears ship-sized holes in the very fabric of reality, allowing for near-instantaneous movement between systems. The nature of the space the ship passes through on this journey is still poorly understood.
PSI_JUMP_DRIVE_1_DESC: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psionic potential of the ship's crew to warp the local space-time continuum, eliminating the distance between the point of origin and the destination. Supposedly.
WORMHOLE_DRIVE_DESC: Ships equipped with Wormhole Modulators attune the portals created by Wormhole Generators to allow for passage between systems.
EMPTY_FTL_INHIBITOR_DESC: Starbases without an FTL Inhibitor will not be able to halt enemy ships.
ftl_components_DESC: Any ship traveling to another system requires an FTL drive of some sort.
ship_sensor_components_DESC: Sensors will reveal the details of any systems and fleets within their range.
station_sensor_components_DESC: Sensors will reveal the details of any systems and fleets within their range.
sensor_components_desc: Sensors will reveal the details of any systems and fleets within their range.
thruster_components_DESC: Thrusters are used for sub-FTL propulsion, and is a vital component for all ships.
border_extruders_DESC: Border Beacons serve as buoys projecting and demarcating national borders in deep space.
ship_aura_components_DESC: Ships of this class be equipped with field emitters that project and maintain localized fields that induce various effects in enemy or friendly vessels.
power_core_DESC: Few things work without power, and the power core is a vital part of any machine.
TECH_UNLOCK_FISSION_POWER_DESC:
Fission Reactor
This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.
TECH_UNLOCK_FUSION_POWER_DESC:
Fusion Reactor
Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLD_FUSION_POWER_DESC:
Cold Fusion Reactor
The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_ANTIMATTER_POWER_DESC:
Antimatter Reactor
By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
TECH_UNLOCK_ZERO_POINT_POWER_DESC:
Zero Point Reactor
These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_DARK_MATTER_POWER_DESC:
Dark Matter Reactor
These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.
TECH_UNLOCK_DARK_MATTER_PROPULSION_DESC:
Dark Matter Thrusters
These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.
FISSION_REACTOR_DESC: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.
FUSION_REACTOR_DESC: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.
COLD_FUSION_REACTOR_DESC: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
ZERO_POINT_REACTOR_DESC: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
ANTIMATTER_REACTOR_DESC: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
MEDIUM_SCIENCE_LAB_1_DESC: Shipboard Science Labs allow for basic research tasks and the surveying of celestial bodies.
SENSOR_1_DESC: A planet-bound technology adapted for use in deep space, the radar system provides basic detection and tracking capability for interstellar vessels.
SENSOR_2_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
SENSOR_3_DESC: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
SENSOR_4_DESC: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
AFTERBURNER_1_DESC: Afterburners provide additional combat speed for the ship.
AFTERBURNER_2_DESC: These improved afterburners provide even more combat speed for the ship.
SHIELD_1_DESC: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.
SHIELD_2_DESC: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.
SHIELD_3_DESC: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.
SHIELD_4_DESC: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.
SHIELD_5_DESC: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.
SHIELD_BOOSTER_DESC: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.
SHIELD_HARDENER_1_DESC: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.
SHIELD_HARDENER_2_DESC: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.
ARMOR_HARDENER_1_DESC: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.
ARMOR_HARDENER_2_DESC: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.
REACTOR_BOOSTER_1_DESC: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.
REACTOR_BOOSTER_2_DESC: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.
REACTOR_BOOSTER_3_DESC: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.
tech_reactor_booster_1_desc: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.
tech_reactor_booster_2_desc: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.
tech_reactor_booster_3_desc: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.
FIRE_CONTROL_1_DESC: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
AUTO_REPAIR_DESC: These bacteria are imprinted with the ship's structural design and will attempt to restore hull integrity should it be compromised.
PSI_SHIELD_DESC: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.
PSI_BARRIER_DESC: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.
NULL_VOID_DESC: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.
ARMOR_1_DESC: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.
ARMOR_2_DESC: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.
ARMOR_3_DESC: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.
ARMOR_4_DESC: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.
ARMOR_5_DESC: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.
CRYSTAL_ARMOR_1_DESC: An alloy of elements harvested from the ultra-hard Crystalline Entities lines the inner layers of this plating, improving hull integrity.
CRYSTAL_ARMOR_2_DESC: Modifications to the process of forging the crystalline alloy further improves its durability.
CRYSTAL_ARMOR_1_BIO_DESC: An alloy of elements harvested from the ultra-hard Crystalline Entities lines the inner layers of this plating, improving hull integrity.
CRYSTAL_ARMOR_2_BIO_DESC: Modifications to the process of forging the crystalline alloy further improves its durability.
SPACE_WHALE_WEAPON_BIO_DESC: Modeled after a peculiar biological process observed in the Tiyanki, the Energy Siphon excites the energy transfer medium of targeted enemy vessels.
SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
BATTLESHIP_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
TITAN_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
BATTLESHIP_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
TITAN_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

STRIKE_CRAFT_HANGAR_2_DESC: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.
STRIKE_CRAFT_HANGAR_3_DESC: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

DEFAULT_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Mixed Tactics: The ship will have a balanced approach between offense and defense.
SWARM_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Swarm Tactics: The ship will charge straight at enemies and try to deal as much damage as possible from the range of their shortest range weapon.
ARTILLERY_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Artillery Tactics: The ship will stay at medium range, firing its long range weapons on the target.
CARRIER_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Carrier Tactics: The ship will stay at the maximum engagement range of its hangars.
LINE_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Line Tactics: The ship will hold advance to medium range and hold formation.
PICKET_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Picket Tactics: The ship will advance to medium range and attempt to intercept incoming enemies.
PLATFORM_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Platform Tactics: The defense platform will remain stationary and fire at any enemies in range.
COLOSSUS_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Ignore Tactics: The ship will ignore any attackers and carry on with its current task.
TORPEDO_BEHAVIOR_DESC: Torpedo Tactics: The ship will charge straight at enemies in strafing runs intended for use against large opponents. This ship excels at surface bombardment.

PLANET_KILLER_CRACKER_DESC: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.
PLANET_KILLER_SHIELDER_DESC: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).
PLANET_KILLER_NEUTRON_DESC: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.
PLANET_KILLER_GODRAY_DESC: A psionic projector shines divine truth upon the world to make true believers out of all who are capable of belief, and annihilating those who are not.
PLANET_KILLER_NANOBOTS_DESC: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.
PLANET_KILLER_DELUGE_DESC: Large quantities of water are dumped on the planet, wiping out all artificial structures and land-based life forms. The deluge is accompanied by the atmospheric gases needed to stabilize the planet's climate and sustain a planetary ocean.

AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT_DESC: Amoebas bred in captivity spawn Flagella that can be imprinted to respond to subtle shifts in hull magnetization, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
SWARM_STRIKE_CRAFT_DESC: Cloned, miniaturized Prethoryn specimen can be controlled through wavelengths close to those we use for intra-fleet communication, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
LARGE_SCOURGE_MISSILE_1_DESC: The Scourge Missile payloads are made up of many of the biochemical compounds used by the Swarm in interstellar combat, having proven unexpectedly effective against even the hardiest of military vessels.

sc_b_desc: The large class B main-sequence stars are very bright and blue. Although somewhat rare, the luminosity of these stars make them among the most visible to the naked eye.
sc_a_desc: These relatively young white or bluish-white main-sequence stars are typically among the most visible to the naked eye. They are large and rotate very quickly, but will eventually evolve into slower and cooler red giants.
sc_f_desc: F-type stars are fairly large and often referred to as yellow-white dwarves. Although they often emit significant amounts of UV radiation, their wide habitable zones have a good chance of supporting life-bearing worlds.
sc_g_desc: Often referred to as yellow dwarves, G-type stars actually range in color from white to slightly yellow. Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen for roughly 10 billion years before they expand and become red giants. Although their lifespans are shorter than K-type stars, worlds inside the habitable zone of a G star often enjoy optimal conditions for the development of life.
sc_k_desc: These main-sequence stars, sometimes referred to as orange dwarves, are a fairly common sight. They are stable on the main-sequence for up to 30 billion years, meaning that worlds orbiting a K-type star have a longer than average window to evolve life.
sc_m_desc: The most common stars in the universe, they are often referred to as red dwarves and some are as old as the galaxy. Their low luminosity means they are difficult to observe with the naked eye from afar. Although they typically have an extremely long lifespan, red dwarfs emit almost no UV light resulting in unfavorable conditions for most forms of life.
sc_m_giant_desc:
Class-M planets are truly gigantic gas giants whose extreme levels of mass are still enough to maintain a steady stellar fusion. Thus they straddle the line between gas giants and brown dwarf stars.

Class M rank as Class IV or V Gas Giant's on the pre-warp Sudarsky's Gas Giant Classification. Their surface temperature can reach above 1100 Celsius. At this blazing temperature, Class M planets have an atmosphere composed of materials that are solid on Class M planets, with clouds of Silicon, Iron and Sodium and are visually distinct by clear spectral lines.
sc_t_desc: A brown dwarf is a type of substellar object occupying the mass range between the heaviest gas giant planets and the lightest stars, which mainly emits infrared radiation.
sc_black_hole_desc: Typically formed as a result of the collapse of a very massive star at the end of its life cycle, usually at least five times the mass of Sol. Black holes have extremely strong gravity fields that prevent anything - including light - from escaping once the event horizon has been crossed.
sc_neutron_star_desc: These incredibly dense stellar remnants are sometimes created when a massive star, but not massive enough to result in a black hole, suffers a rapid collapse and explodes in a supernova. Although their diametre is typically as little as ten kilometres, their mass is many times greater than an average G-type star.
sc_pulsar_desc: Pulsars are highly-magnetised neutron stars that emit beams of electromagnetic radiation. As the star rotates, the radiation beam is only visible when it is pointing directly at the observer. This results in a very precise interval of pulses, which sometimes is so exact that it can be used to measure the passage of time with extreme accuracy.
sc_toxoid_star_desc: Millennia of exposure to the Toxic Entity have caused alterations in the makeup of this star. Though once it was a fairly standard G-type star, now it emits an eerie green haze unlike any seen elsewhere in the galaxy.

edict_capacity_overload_desc: This Edict allows short-term overloading of energy grids, letting power plants across our empire run at increased capacity.
edict_production_targets_desc: This Edict is a focused administrative effort to reprioritize and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.
edict_farming_subsidies_desc: This Edict provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.
edict_propaganda_desc: This Edict creates broad information delivery mechanisms, ensuring that a consistent and positive narrative is maintained.
edict_information_quarantine_desc: This Edict puts strict checks on the flow of information, better preserving local cultural identities.
edict_encourage_free_thought_desc: This Edict encourages the populace to openly discuss political matters, even if the path taken may lead them astray.
edict_map_the_stars_desc: This Edict pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.
edict_map_the_stars_2_desc: This Edict pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.
edict_research_focus_desc: This Edict favors our researchers with additional funds.
edict_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to engineering-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_social_welfare_programs_desc: This Edict establishes a large amount of various social programs, at a considerable cost, to ease the lives of the populace.
edict_share_the_burden_desc: This Edict enforces rotating tasks and work schedules for indentured servants, as more varied drudgery can lead to an uptick in productivity.
edict_peace_festivals_desc: This Pacifist Edict fosters a spirit of unity and good cheer through whole seasons filled with special events and festivals.
edict_land_of_opportunity_desc: This Edict creates targeted PR campaigns that frame our empire as being on the cutting edge, a new social frontier - a place where anyone can thrive, a fresh start.
edict_diplomatic_grants_desc: This Edict initiates a diplomatic offensive in a concerted effort to improve the image of our empire.
edict_engineering_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new engineering concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_engineering_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to engineering-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_physics_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new physics concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_physics_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to physics-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_society_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new society concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_society_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to society-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_fear_campaign_desc: The vile and beastly nature of the xeno must be communicated to our people. They must accept the truth that we stand alone in a sea of alien filth.
edict_education_campaign_desc: Back to school! By momentarily spending resources to promote higher education programs among our leaders, their skills will improve at a faster rate.
edict_healthcare_campaign_desc: Diet, regular exercise and sleeping patterns all combine to affect the health of our population. By promoting a healthier lifestyle, their life expectancy will go up.
edict_recycling_campaign_desc: The populace must be taught to limit wasteful consumption of resources. A public awareness campaign to promote recycling will momentarily lower our consumer goods costs.
edict_robot_campaign_desc: By allocating additional resources to our production facilities, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.
edict_machine_learning_campaign_desc: By allocating additional resources to our autonomous drones, they are able to increase the rate at which their self-learning algorithms improve their overall productivity.
edict_drone_campaign_desc: By allocating additional biomass to our spawning pools, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.
edict_learning_campaign_desc: By providing our autonomous drones with additional nutrients, we are able to increase their productivity.
edict_war_drone_campaign_desc: By allocating our war drones additional nutrients, we are able to increase their strength and combat readiness.
edict_crystal_sonar_desc:
Allows us to order our fleets to use a special technique when encountering Crystalline Entities, instantly surveying the systems they dwell in.
Cost: £ -30
edict_droning_optimizations_desc: Modeled after Ancient Mining Drone techniques, this scheme of energy optimizations will increase our resource yields.
edict_greater_crystal_bounty_desc:
Order our fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.
Minerals per fleet defeated: 500
edict_crystal_bounty_desc:
Order our fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.
Minerals per fleet defeated: 250
edict_drone_bounty_desc:
Instruct our fleets to salvage the energy cells of defeated Ancient Mining Drones.
Energy Credits per fleet defeated: 500
edict_declare_saint_desc: This Edict will bestow sainthood upon a deceased individual who led a particularly pious life, creating a new unifying symbol.
edict_scientific_revolution_desc: A brief yet highly productive golden age of scientific discovery. The combination of fearlessness, ingenuity and unbridled optimism can take you far.
edict_desperate_measures_desc: The cornered animal is indeed the most dangerous, as our enemies will soon find out. No effort must be spared to ensure our continued survival.
edict_fortress_proclamation_desc: Our frontiers shall be an unassailable line, and they will convey a clear message to our most ambitious neighbors - this far, no further!
edict_architectural_renaissance_desc: It is construction on a scale that previous generations could only dream of. Megastructures may well become the true legacy of our civilization.
edict_hearts_and_minds_desc: A concentrated propaganda effort to make the populace understand the merits of the government's position. Ultimately, it is for their own good.
edict_omnifarious_acquisition_desc: Everything that can be spared will be recycled and used. Our ambitions require all the resources we can possibly find.
edict_grand_fleet_desc: Our galactic ambitions require that the construction of A Grand Fleet must be our primary goal.

policy_pre_sapients_desc: We can decide whether or not we want pre-sapient species living on our planets.
pre_sapients_allow_desc: Intelligent animals are still just animals. They can safely be ignored.
pre_sapients_protect_desc:
Though still only simple animals, these beings are no less than what we ourselves once were. We should ensure their preservation.

Pre-sapients cannot be selectively purged, and planets containing pre-sapients cannot be terraformed.

Alien Zoos may be constructed on planets with pre-sapients.

Changing away from this policy will remove any Alien Zoos on planets without an Isolated Valley deposit or any livestock present!
pre_sapients_purge_desc:
All rights spring from the capacity for reason. An animal is just an animal, and an animal that stands in our way is just a pest.

Pre-sapients living on our planets will be purged
pre_sapients_eat_desc:
An animal without sapience can hardly be considered to be part of our empire, but perhaps they can help our growth in other ways...

Pre-sapients living on our planets will be used for food, slowly depleting their population.
policy_core_worlds_desc: We can decide which Pops are permitted to live on our core worlds. Prohibited Pops already living there will be forced to move to our Sectors or flee to other Empires.
core_worlds_all_desc:
Diversity is the key to a vibrant empire. Our core worlds must reflect these values by remaining open to all of the species in our empire.

All Pops are permitted to live on Core Worlds
core_worlds_citizens_and_slaves_desc:
Though our core worlds must be kept safe from alien influence, we shall not deny our citizens their lawful property.

Non-enslaved Pops without Full Citizenship will migrate away from Core Worlds
core_worlds_citizens_only_desc:
Our core worlds are the heart of our empire. No lesser species shall be permitted to settle there.

Pops without Full Citizenship will migrate away from Core Worlds
policy_refugees_desc: We can decide whether we should accept or turn away refugees fleeing purges, displacement and persecution in other empires.
refugees_not_allowed_desc:
To open our borders to the dregs of other societies would only serve to undermine the state.

Refugees will not arrive from other Empires
refugees_only_citizens_desc:
We cannot allow compassion to overpower good sense. Only those who would be worthwhile additions to society should be brought into our borders.

Refugees from species with Full Citizenship may arrive from other Empires
refugees_allowed_desc:
Those fleeing death and persecution at the hands of tyrants will be welcome within our borders.

Refugees may arrive from other Empires
policy_debris_desc: We can decide whether we should research or scavenge the fleets of fallen enemies.
research_debris_desc: We will research our enemies' technologies from the remains of their ships.
scavenge_debris_desc: We will scavenge resources from the remains of our enemies' ships.
scavenge_and_research_debris_desc: As Relentless Scavengers we will strip debris for both research and resources.
policy_population_controls_desc: We can decide whether or not selective population controls should be legal in our empire.
population_controls_not_allowed_desc:
To reproduce and propagate their species is the inalienable right of all our citizens.

Cannot use non-voluntary Species or Planetary Population Controls
Cannot selectively Grow/Decline Species
population_controls_allowed_desc:
Long-term demographics is too important a matter to be left solely in the hands of individual actors.

Can use non-voluntary Species and Planetary Population Controls
Can selectively Grow/Decline Species
policy_slavery_desc: We can decide whether or not slavery should be legal in our empire.
slavery_not_allowed_desc:
The enslavement of sapient beings is an abomination and will not be tolerated within our Empire.

Can not Enslave Pops
slavery_allowed_xenos_only_desc:
Allows the enslavement of Species other than our own within our Empire.

Can Enslave Pops from other Species
slavery_allowed_regulated_desc:
Allows the indiscriminate enslavement of Pops from all walks of life and ensures equal and relatively fair working conditions.

Can Enslave any Pop, at reduced efficiency
slavery_allowed_regulated_xenos_only_des:
Allows the enslavement of Species other than our own within our Empire under relatively fair working conditions.

Can Enslave Pops from other Species, at reduced efficiency
slavery_allowed_desc:
Allows the enslavement of Pops within our Empire.

Can Enslave Pops
policy_slavery_procreation_desc: We can decide if slaves should be allowed to procreate or not.
slavery_procreation_allowed_desc: Slaves are allowed to procreate. Pops grown from slaves are automatically enslaved.
slavery_procreation_not_allowed_desc: Slaves are not allowed to procreate
policy_purge_desc: Purged Pops are unable to work and will ultimately perish, but the process will enrage them as well as any sympathetic Pops.
purge_not_allowed_desc:
The Purge is an atrocity and should always be treated as such.

Can not Purge Pops
purge_allowed_xenos_only_desc:
We must allow efficient methods to regulate and control the spread of lesser lifeforms within our Empire.

Can Purge Pops from other Species
purge_allowed_desc:
The troublesome and corrupt elements within our Empire must be cleansed, lest their rot take root in us all.

Can Purge and Displace Pops
purge_displacement_only_desc:
It is not our responsibility to see to the needs of those who would undermine the foundations of our society. Let them find their homes outside our borders.

Can Displace Pops
policy_orbital_bombardment_accept_surren: This policy controls whether or not we allow enemy planets to surrender control to our fleets during Orbital Bombardment.
orbital_bombardment_surrender_allowed_de:
Foreign citizens have the right to surrender.

We will gain occupation of Enemy Planets from Orbital Bombardment of planets without Defensive Armies if they choose to surrender.
orbital_bombardment_surrender_forbidden_:
There will be no surrender, Orbital Bombardment will continue indefinitely.

Planetary Control of Enemy Planets will only be gained by invading the planet with Ground Troops.
policy_interference_desc: We can set policies regulating our interactions with pre-FTL empires.
interference_not_allowed_desc:
It is not our place to influence the development of another society. Watch, but do not interfere.

- Observation Outposts are limited to Passive Observation
- Cannot target Pre-FTL Civilizations with Espionage operations
- Cannot reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations
interference_subtle_desc:
We can nudge their development in the right direction, but our touch must remain subtle.

- Observation Outposts are limited to Passive Observation
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations
- Can only reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations with High Awareness
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations
interference_active_desc:
To unlock the secrets of the universe, any subject of interest must be made freely available for study.

- Observation Outposts can be set to Passive Observation or Aggressive Observation
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with all Espionage operations
- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations
interference_aggressive_desc:
The strong hold dominion over the weak. The fate of less developed societies is ours to command.

- Observation Outposts are limited to Aggressive Observation
- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations
- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations
- Can invade Pre-FTL Civilizations
policy_interference_unchanged: Policy on Pre-FTL Interference is not changed.
policy_enlightenment_desc: Our technological advances could potentially be shared with more pre-FTL societies, opening up new horizons for them to explore.
enlightenment_not_allowed_desc:
This society is not ready to grasp the wonders we have discovered. Exposing the truth too quickly can entail enormous risks for everyone involved.

May Not Enlighten Pre-FTL Civilizations
enlightenment_covert_only_desc:
Revealing our existence to pre-FTL civilizations would alter the natural course of their development. We should help them, but without revealing our presence.

May Only Enlighten Pre-FTL Civilizations through Espionage
enlightenment_allowed_desc:
By sharing our knowledge, we can actively encourage less advanced societies to take their rightful place in the galactic community.

May Enlighten Pre-FTL civilizations through both Espionage and Diplomatic actions
enlightenment_policy_unchanged: Policy on Pre-FTL Enlightenment is not changed.
policy_migration_desc: Some within our Empire look to the stars and wonder what kind of life they could create for themselves on a new world.
migration_not_allowed_desc:
The Empire will decide where its populace is needed most.

No Pops can freely migrate
migration_allowed_primary_only_desc:
Unrestricted movement is a privilege afforded only to our primary species.

Only Pops of our own Species can freely migrate
migration_allowed_all_desc:
All our citizens must be free to seek their own happiness wherever they so desire.

All Pops can freely migrate
policy_appropriation_desc: This policy controls whether or not newly acquired planets should have some of their land appropriated from non-citizen species.
appropriation_not_allowed_desc:
The land that our empire controls belongs to all of its inhabitants.

Conquered planets will have their populations preserved as-is.
appropriation_allowed_desc:
The land that the lesser species are not properly utilizing can be put to greater use by their betters.

Planets conquered from non-citizen species will have up to 500£ Pops displaced and replaced with citizens from our other planets.
policy_resettlement_desc: This policy controls whether or not we are allowed to forcibly relocate Pops between planets.
resettlement_not_allowed_desc: Free pops cannot be forcibly resettled between planets.
resettlement_allowed_desc: Pops can be forcibly resettled between planets.
PLANET_AUTO_RESETTLEMENT_CHANCE:
These unemployed £ Pops will move to other colonies within your empire if there are open jobs, housing, and decent habitability.

$VALUE|0$ are expected to migrate next month.
AUTO_MIGRATE_MIGRATION_CONTROLS: Migration Controls are enabled on this species.
AUTO_MIGRATE_SLAVE_PROCESSING: Automatic Resettlement to other colonies is only enabled for slaves and non-sapient robots if a Transit Hub or Slave Processing Facility is present.
PLANET_AUTO_RESETTLEMENT_NO_ELIGIBLE_POP: These £ Pops are not able to auto-migrate for the following reason:
PLANET_AUTO_RESETTLEMENT_NO_VALID_DESTIN:
These £ Pops are not able to auto-migrate for the following reason:
There is no valid auto-migration destination.
PLANET_AUTO_RESETTLEMENT_MOST_LIKELY_DES: Their most likely migration destination is $PLANET|Y$.
PLANET_AUTO_RESETTLEMENT_INELIGIBLE_PLAN: £ Pops are not allowed to auto-migrate from this planet for the following reason:
AUTO_MIGRATE_CULTURE_SHOCK: The colony is suffering from Culture Shock.
AUTO_MIGRATE_ONLY_HAS_ONE_POP: The last £ Pop can not auto-migrate.
planet_automation_deficit_restriction_de: Prevents construction of buildings which would introduce or increase a deficit of a resource, either directly by the upkeep of the building/district or indirectly by any jobs created.
planet_automation_amenities_desc: Enables automatic management of planet Amenities, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings that provide amenity jobs.
planet_automation_designation_constructi:
Enables automatic planetary construction of buildings and districts that align with the planet's designation.

Buildings and districts providing new jobs will be constructed when there are no free jobs or when there is an unemployed pop which can work a job associated with this designation.
planet_automation_rare_resources_desc: Enables automatic construction of buildings that provide jobs which produce rare resources during an Empire wide shortage.
planet_automation_pop_assembly_desc: Enables construction of buildings that assemble pops.
planet_automation_housing_desc: Enable automatic construction of additional housing.
planet_automation_building_slot_desc: Enable automatic construction of new building slots.
planet_automation_crime_desc: Enable automation of [Owner.GetCrimeDeviancy] prevention, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings.
planet_automation_clear_blockers_desc: Enable automatic clearing of blockers when it is needed to unlock more district slots.
planet_automation_permanent_employment_c: Enable automatic construction of Posthumous Employment Center on planets with raw resource focus.
planet_automation_psi_corps_building_des: Enable construction of Psi Corps on all planets.
planet_automation_upgrade_buildings_desc: Enable automatically upgrading buildings. This will have priority over constructing new buildings.
planet_automation_shift_click: Shift-click to toggle this setting as default for all new colonies, currently: $TOGGLED|H$
planet_automation_ctrl_click: Control-click to toggle the setting on all planets.
policy_voting_rights_desc: The process of appointing a ruler can take on many forms, where democratic vote is but one possible approach.
voting_not_allowed_desc:
Our choice of ruler is far too important a decision to entrust to the public.

No Pops can vote, the heir to the throne will become the next ruler
voting_allowed_elites_only_desc:
The question of leadership is best left to our society's most respected and knowledgeable members.

No Pops can vote, the leaders of the Empire will decide ruler on election
voting_allowed_primary_only_desc:
The right to vote is a serious responsibility, and must remain exclusive to our primary species.

Only Pops of our own Species can vote in democratic elections
voting_allowed_all_desc:
The rule of our Empire should reflect the will of the people and they must all be part of the process.

All Pops can vote in democratic elections
policy_leadership_desc: All beings may not be equally fit for leadership, and we must decide who should be allowed to progress through the ranks.
leadership_primary_only_desc:
While we may accept the presence of foreign beings within our Empire, positions of leadership must remain exclusive to our primary species.

Only Pops of our own Species can generate leaders
leadership_allow_xeno_desc:
Our Empire must not waste the great wealth of talent within our Empire, whatever the source.

Pops of other Species can generate leaders
leadership_allow_robot_desc:
Synthetic beings serve our Empire in most areas of society. It is only natural that they be allowed to take positions of leadership as well.

Synthetic Pops can generate leaders
leadership_allow_all_desc:
Any talented individual, xeno or synthetic, should be allowed to seek a position in leadership.

Pops of all types can generate leaders
policy_leader_enhancement_desc: The burden of Empire can be crushing, and we need to make a decision on how future leaders may best be prepared to shoulder it.
leader_enhancement_natural_selection_des:
Let nature take its course - it is in the crucible of experience that genius is forged.

Leaders gain no additional bonuses
leader_enhancement_selected_lineages_des:
Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.

While active our Empire gains:
leader_enhancement_capacity_boosters_des:
We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.

If active our Empire gains:
policy_border_policy_desc: The borders of our empire represent our very grasp on the galaxy itself. We must decide if they are to be open and welcoming or shut and guarded to other civilizations we might encounter.
border_policy_open_desc:
Isolation invites suspicion, and suspicion invites conflict. Let us show our neighbors that we have nothing to hide.

Borders will be open to other empires by default.
border_policy_closed_desc:
The borders of our empire must be well guarded, lest we fall victim to insidious influences. Only those who have proven themselves worthy may enter our space.

Borders will be closed to other empires by default.
policy_first_contact_protocol_desc: As we travel the stars there is a definite possibility of finding other lifeforms, and we need to have a clear stance on how to approach them.
first_contact_proactive_desc:
Meeting alien civilizations presents an exciting opportunity to make new friends and fresh discoveries. We shall do our utmost to ensure that first contact happens smoothly, hailing unknown ships with a cordially-phrased greeting and a copy of our Official Standard Encyclopedia, along with its audio-visual companion dossier.

- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other empires will find it easier to establish communications with us
- Gain 50% more £ Influence from each successful first contact process
first_contact_proactive_effects:
- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other empires will find it easier to establish communications with us
- Gain 50% more £ Influence from each successful first contact process
first_contact_cautious_desc:
We will take every measure to prevent information about ourselves from falling into alien hands before we have decided whether they will be friend or foe.

- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other nations will find it harder to establish communications with us
- Negative first contact events are less likely to happen to us
first_contact_cautious_effects:
- Cannot attack neutral entities
- Other nations will find it harder to establish communications with us
- Negative first contact events are less likely to happen to us
first_contact_attack_allowed_desc:
Unknown dangers may hide among the stars. To ensure our continued survival we must be ready to strike without hesitation.

- Can attack neutral entities
- Enables hostile first contact options, such as abduction and dissection
first_contact_attack_allowed_effects:
- Can attack neutral entities
- Enables hostile first contact options, such as abduction and dissection
policy_food_policy_desc: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.
food_policy_normal_desc:
Our population will have all their nutritional needs met, but food is a precious resource and frivolous waste should be avoided.

Organic Pops have normal food use and growth speed.
food_policy_rationing_desc: In times of need, we all must sacrifice for the greater good. What is a little starvation now, when our glorious future awaits?
food_policy_generous_desc: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.
policy_food_policy_gestalt_desc: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.
food_policy_gestalt_normal_desc:
All Drones will have their necessary biomass intakes met by the Mind.

Drones have normal food use and growth speed.
food_policy_gestalt_generous_desc: A well-fed Drone is a productive Drone.
policy_research_policy_desc: Research is a way forward for our empire, advancing its knowledge and bringing new possibilities. We must decide what is the best focus for our researchers and where we should pool our brightest.
policy_physics_research_policy_desc: Physics is the future of our empire, without understanding the universe, how can we advance in other fields?
policy_society_research_policy_desc: Society is the future of our empire, without understanding life, how can we advance in other fields?
policy_engineering_research_policy_desc: Engineering is the future of our empire, without understanding our homes and ships, how can we advance in other fields?
research_policy_no_focus_desc: By not focusing on any particular branch, our researchers will have more freedom to pursue their own experiments.
research_policy_field_manipulation_desc: Focusing on Field Manipulation technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_particles_desc: Focusing on Particles technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_computing_desc: Focusing on Computing technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_new_worlds_desc: Focusing on New Worlds technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_statecraft_desc: Focusing on Statecraft technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_biology_desc: Focusing on Biology technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_military_theory_desc: Focusing on Military Theory technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_materials_desc: Focusing on Materials technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_propulsion_desc: Focusing on Propulsion technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_voidcraft_desc: Focusing on Voidcraft technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
research_policy_industry_desc: Focusing on Industry technologies will give us an advantage in the given field of research.
policy_research_restriction_policy_desc: Research is a boundless frontier, fueling our empire's progress but also unveiling hidden dangers. We must decide what limits, if any, to place upon our researchers.
research_restriction_dangerous_encourage: Our researchers should be restricted from wasting their time with the mundane, to pursue more esoteric studies.
research_restriction_no_restriction_desc: The galaxy is vast and full of countless wonders; to stifle our researchers from opportunity would be a mistake.
research_restriction_dangerous_forbidden: Dangerous technologies should be avoided at all costs. There are laws of the universe we should never break.
policy_trade_policy_desc: Trade is an important source of prosperity and brings in a great deal of resources for our empire. We must decide where these resources are best directed.
trade_policy_trade_league_desc:
By banding together in a trade league, we are able to prosper and secure profits on a whole new level.

50% of our collected £ Trade earns us £ $concept_energy$, £ $concept_unity$ and £ Supplies
trade_policy_holy_covenant_desc:
By banding together in a holy covenant, we may bask in the collective glory of our divine purpose.

50% of our collected £ Trade earns us £ $concept_unity$
trade_policy_mutual_aid_desc:
By reinvesting our surplus back into the cooperative, we ensure that all our members may thrive according to their needs and shared aspirations.

75% of our collected £ Trade earns us £ $concept_energy$, £ $concept_minerals$, £ $concept_food$, and £ $concept_unity$
economic_policy_balanced_desc:
To commit ourselves fully to either war or peace is to restrict ourselves to a narrow view. We must be ready for whatever the future may hold.

No bonuses or penalties to resource production.
economic_policy_civilian_desc: The needs of the populace must become before the business of war. Economic might, not military prowess, is what our empire will be founded on.
economic_policy_military_desc: To neglect our defense is to neglect our survival. Trinkets and baubles are scarce comfort when the enemy is battering down the gates.
policy_drone_policy_desc: The synaptic capabilities of our vast Mind are immense, but not limitless. We must decide where to best put these cerebral resources to use.
drone_policy_balanced_desc:
The Mind dedicates itself equally to the production of raw resources and finished goods.

No bonuses or penalties to resource production.
drone_policy_worker_desc: The Menial Drones that extract raw resources are given priority by the Mind, becoming more productive at the expense of the Complex Drones.
drone_policy_thinker_desc: The Complex Drones that manufacture finished goods are given priority by the Mind, becoming more productive at the expense of the Menial Drones.
policy_robot_pop_policy_desc: The mere concept of autonomous robots leads to the idea that workers of our species may one day be supplanted and perhaps, in time, surpassed. We must decide our stance on such large-scale automation.
robot_pops_outlawed_desc:
Robotic automatons are a threat to not only our people's livelihoods, but to the very fabric of society itself. We must not allow ourselves to be made obsolete.

Robotic Pops and Armies will automatically be disassembled.
robot_pops_allowed_desc: The benefits of automation are obvious and immense. For the future of our people, we cannot afford to ignore the opportunities presented to us by technology.
policy_artificial_intelligence_policy_de: The prospect of a self-aware artificial intelligence raises many philosophical and ethical questions. We must determine where we stand on this issue.
no_robots_desc: These machines are in the process of being disassembled.
dumb_robots_desc: These robots exist in a state of non-sapient servitude.
ai_outlawed_short_desc: To create a more obedient class of workers, these machines have had their sapience stripped away by their organic masters.
ai_outlawed_desc:
Intelligent, self-aware machines are an incalculable threat to all living things. The creation of a true artificial intelligence is an offense punishable by death.

Artificial lifeforms have their free will removed and are unable to perform £ Elite Jobs and more complex £ Specialist Jobs.

Sapient AI Assistants will automatically be disassembled.

Sapient Combat Computers may not be researched.
citizenship_robot_servitude_tooltip: The primary objective of these machines is to serve their masters and fulfill the tasks they were designed for, irrespective of their level of intelligence.
citizenship_robot_servitude_tooltip_dela: A toaster will always be a toaster.
ai_servitude_short_desc: These machines are held in absolute servitude by their organic masters, and can be used or discarded at their whim.
ai_servitude_desc:
The overriding purpose of any machine must be to serve its masters and perform whatever tasks it was designed for, regardless of how intelligent it may be.

Artifical lifeforms have limited free will, improving their resource output but preventing them from working in £ Elite Jobs.
ai_full_rights_desc:
Any self-aware machine with true intelligence must be regarded as an individual with all the rights and obligations that entails.

Artifical lifeforms are given full citizen rights and will thus use £ Supplies.
ai_full_rights_short_desc: These machines have been given full citizenship and the right to self-determination as equal members of society.
ai_accord_servitude_disallowed: The AI Accord permanently disallows the Outlawed and Servitude policies.
ai_perfect_servants_rights_disallowed: The three-law algorithm permanently disallows the Citizen Rights policy.
policy_war_philosophy_desc: War is a complex matter, war between stellar nations even more so. How we approach armed conflict is of critical importance to external affairs.
unrestricted_wars_desc:
War is a dish best served frequently, and to those who will not cook for themselves.

No restrictions on claiming systems
liberation_wars_desc:
We must further our own interests, even when they run contrary to the interests of others.

Claiming others' systems is only allowed during defensive wars or against Gestalt Consciousness empires

Unlocks the 'Ideology' Casus Belli on all empires with differing Ethics
no_wars_desc:
Violence is a last resort to ensure the integrity of our nation.

Claiming of systems is only allowed during defensive wars
policy_war_doctrine_desc: There are many ways to prosecute a war to a successful conclusion. We must choose the doctrine that best plays to our strengths and weaknesses.
defense_in_depth_doctrine_desc: Let the enemy come to us. We shall fight them for every planet, every moon, every asteroid that lies within our space. We shall never surrender.
no_retreat_doctrine_desc: Our ships are expected to fight to the bitter end. We will tolerate no withdrawals, no retreats, no routs. For our fleet there is only victory or death. Not one step back!
hit_and_run_doctrine_desc: A superior foe can be gradually whittled down by repeated hit and run attacks. The killing blow is delivered only when the odds are favorable.
rapid_deployment_doctrine_desc: We must move quickly to strike where the enemy is weakest, and defend where the enemy means to attack. Maneuver is the key to success.
PURGES_ALLOWED: £ Purging must be enabled in Policies.
policy_food_stockpiling_desc: To properly chart the growth of an interstellar empire we must utilize our food surplus in a way that best suits the needs of our population.
food_stockpiling_1_desc: Keeping our food stockpiling to a minimum ensures that it can be put to better use towards population growth.
food_stockpiling_2_desc: A balanced approach to stockpiling will allow us to use our food surplus towards growth, while still leaving us significant reserves if the worst should happen.
food_stockpiling_3_desc: We can never know when disaster and famine will strike. A large stockpile of food will let us to weather bad circumstances without our population suffering.
ONLY_SERVITORS_STOCKPILE_FOOD: £ Only a Rogue Servitor may stockpile £ $concept_food$.
policy_war_economy_desc: We can gear our industry and economy to seize assets from the civilian sector in times of desperate defensive wars. The downside with these policies is that we will suffer corresponding penalties while we are winning offensive wars...
static_we_desc: A Static War Economy is unaffected by the vagaries of war. The current Warscore has no effects on production times or costs.
semi_static_we_desc:
A Semi-Static War Economy allows the seizure of limited assets from the private sector for the sake of survival during defensive wars, with a corresponding loss of efficiency while winning offensive wars.

Defensive Wars:
Mil. Prod. Eff.: +30% at -100 Warscore

Offensive Wars:
Mil. Prod. Eff.: -30% at 100 Warscore
versatile_we_desc:
A Versatile War Economy gives us huge production bonuses while we are losing defensive wars, with a corresponding loss of efficiency while winning offensive wars.

Defensive Wars:
Mil. Prod. Eff.: +60% at -100 Warscore

Offensive Wars:
Mil. Prod. Eff.: -60% at 100 Warscore
dynamic_we_desc:
A Dynamic War Economy gives us significant production bonuses while we are losing defensive wars, with a corresponding loss of efficiency while winning offensive wars.

Defensive Wars:
Mil. Prod. Eff.: +45% at -100 Warscore

Offensive Wars:
Mil. Prod. Eff.: -45% at 100 Warscore
feature_planetary_ftl_inhibitor_desc: Planets with at least one £ Fortress building will be able to inhibit the FTL drives of hostile fleets.
feature_alien_rulers_desc: Allows individuals of Species other than our founding Species to be candidates in our Ruler elections.
feature_hyperlanes_desc: Allows detailed mapping of every Hyperlane in the galaxy.
feature_uplifting_desc: Allows genetically Uplifting and socially integrating Species which are close to being sapient.
feature_basic_diplomacy_desc: Allows basic diplomacy with other Empires.
feature_invitation_to_alliances_desc: Allows establishing Alliances with other Empires.
feature_vassalization_of_empires_desc: Allows forceful subjugation of other Empires.
feature_alien_leaders_recruitment_desc: Allows recruitment of Leaders from other Species within our Empire.
feature_modify_traits_desc: Allows us to actively modify the genetic Traits of a Species within our Empire.
feature_advanced_gene_modding_desc: Allows us to remove beneficial Traits, add detrimental Traits, and alter Pop appearance when modifying a species.
feature_habitability_gene_modding_desc: Allows us to change the preferred planet type of a species through genetic modification.
feature_add_advanced_traits_desc: Unlocks additional Traits that we can add to Species when modifying them.
feature_colonization_desc: Enables the construction of Colony Ships which can be used to colonize planets
feature_colony_ship_rushed_desc: Allows the construction of Private Colony Ships funded by unknown actors from the private sector. As a result the colonists may have ethics differing from the majority.
feature_production_credit_desc: Allows planets to produce Energy Credits as a planetary project.
feature_individual_entreprises_desc: Free unemployed Pops produce Energy Credits as a result of individual enterprises.
feature_wormhole_stations_desc: Enables Construction Ships to build Wormhole Stations.
feature_wormhole_capacity_desc: Increases Wormhole fleet-capacity limit and range while reducing generation-time.
feature_extended_wormhole_desc: Allows any fleet-size to pass through the Wormhole. If the fleet is larger than the Wormhole fleet-capacity, the Wormhole will collapse after transfer and the time required for producing another Wormhole is increased relative to the Wormhole's fleet-capacity overreach.
feature_survey_planets_desc: Allows Science Ships to survey planets without a Scientist on board.
feature_mechanical_trait_desc: Armies created from Species with Cyborg trait also gain Mechanical trait.
feature_rebel_armies_desc: Rebel Armies spawned from Slave uprisings will be far stronger than now.
feature_ftl_travel_desc: The basic systems required for any type of FTL travel.
feature_pop_self_modification_desc: Pops gain a chance to spontaneously adapt to better survive in hostile environments.
feature_advanced_gov_forms_desc: Allows reformation of the Empire, enabling advanced versions of all government types.
feature_megaengineering_desc: Allows us to repair ruined Megastructures.
feature_terraform_inhabited_desc: Allows us to terraform inhabited planets.
feature_xeno_integration_desc: Allows us to grant Full Citizenship rights to alien species.
feature_spaceport_level_2_desc: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support 2 modules and allow the construction of destroyers.
feature_spaceport_level_3_desc: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support 3 modules.
feature_spaceport_level_4_desc: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support 4 modules and allow the construction of cruisers.
feature_spaceport_level_5_desc: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support 5 modules.
feature_spaceport_level_6_desc: The Spaceport can be upgraded to support 6 modules and allow the construction of battleships.
feature_tech_automated_exploration_desc: Order the Science ship to automatically survey the galaxy, investigate anomalies, research special projects or excavate archaeological sites while avoiding hostiles.
feature_bliss_standard_desc: Allows us to set the Chemical Bliss Living Standard.
feature_robots_desc:
Robots are relatively simple machines, capable of accepting verbal commands but possessing no true intelligence of their own.

With the Robotic Workers technology, Mechanical Pops are only capable of £ Worker Jobs.
feature_droids_desc:
Droids are a more complex variant of robot, often coming with limited self-awareness and pre-programmed personalities to better serve their masters.

With the Droid Workers technology, Mechanical Pops are now also capable of £ Specialist Jobs.

Some complex £ $pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs such as £ Research can only be performed if AI is not outlawed.
feature_synths_desc:
Synthetics are very complex machines. Their positronic brains are capable of supporting a class-7 artificial intelligence, making them fully self-aware.

With the Syntetic Workers technology, Mechanical Pops are affected by £ Happiness and can potentially perform all types of £ Pop Jobs.

£ Elite Jobs can only be performed if the Full AI Rights policy is active.
feature_robot_leaders_desc: Allows Synth Pops to be leaders.
feature_modify_robots_desc: Allows us to design and build specialized Mechanical Pops.
feature_modify_robots_desc_machine_intel: Allows us to design and build specialized Machine and Mechanical Pops.
feature_wormhole_stabilization_desc: Allows our ships to travel through wormholes.
feature_gateway_activation_desc: Allows us to activate Gateways and allows our ships to travel through them.
feature_gateway_construction_desc: Allows us to rebuild and construct new Gateways.
feature_unity_ambitions_desc: Unlocks a set of powerful and expensive Edicts called Unity Ambitions.
feature_campaign_edicts_desc: Unlocks additional edicts called Campaigns that cost Energy instead of Unity.
feature_jump_method_desc: Unlocks the Initiate Jump fleet action, which allows Jump-Drive equipped fleets to near-instantly jump to any system in range, ignoring hyperlanes entirely.
mission_no_observation_desc: This station is now used as an embassy to coordinate our diplomatic and covert interactions with the civilization below.
mission_passive_observation_desc:
The natives are studied unknowingly from a safe distance, and every effort is made to avoid cultural contamination.

Resources produced by Observation Missions depend on the Infiltration Level of our Spy Network in the pre-FTL Civilization being observed.[GetPassiveObservationInsights]
mission_specimen_collection_desc:
The natives are aggressively studied and live specimens are frequently collected to learn as much as possible about their biology and culture.

Resources produced by Observation Missions depend on the Infiltration Level of our Spy Network in the pre-FTL Civilization being observed.[GetAggressiveObservationInsights]
This mission can have unintended consequences.
observation_infiltration_effects: Resources produced by Observation Missions depend on the Infiltration Level of our Spy Network in the pre-FTL Civilization being observed.
mission_native_indoctrination_desc:
Through subtle influencing of their society and culture the natives can be brought around to our way of thinking.

This mission will make the natives adopt our Governing Ethics over time.
mission_technological_enlightenment_0_de:
An effort is made to rapidly elevate the native civilization to the Space Age. The time this takes is dependent on their current level of technology.

When complete, this mission will give them full ownership of their home system and turn them into a spacefaring civilization that is our Protectorate.
