tm_dynamic_we_offensive_desc: Due to our Dynamic War Economy Policy, our workers and military personnel have started to relax in anticipation of victory in our offensive wars.
opinion_tried_to_kick: Tried to kick us from Alliance
capital_desc: The Capital planet of an interstellar empire is a vast complex of government buildings, bureaus and agency headquarters.
hazardous_weather_desc: This world suffers from unstable weather patterns, with violent storms frequently appearing out of nowhere to wreak havoc on the surface.
dangerous_wildlife_desc: This world has evolved extremely Hostile Fauna, and the surface is rife with lethal predators waiting to ambush their next meal. Studying the creature's biology offers excellent research opportunities.
weak_magnetic_field_desc: Although habitable, this world has a weak magnetic field that offers little protection against cosmic radiation.
unstable_tectonics_desc: This world has very unstable plate tectonics and is prone to massive earthquakes and volcanic activity.
tidal_locked_desc: This world is tidally locked around its star, meaning that one side always has daylight while the other is locked in eternal darkness. If life exists here, it is likely limited to the twilight regions where the two sides meet.
chthonian_planet_desc: This planet was once a gas giant, but its proximity to its star has burned away the thick atmosphere. All that remains now is a super-dense and mineral rich metallic core.
brown_dwarf_desc: This gas giant is actually a brown dwarf - a failed star that lacked the necessary mass to sustain hydrogen fusion. Its special properties makes it valuable for research.
asteroid_impacts_desc: The orbital path this world takes around its star is littered with small asteroids, meteors, and comet swarms. Large impacts on the surface occur at an alarming frequency.
extensive_moon_system_desc: This gas giant has an unusually large amount of natural satellites. Hundreds of small moons and moonlets orbit the planet.
carbon_world_desc: This world has been formed mostly out of carbon, and contains little oxygen.
asteroid_coprolite_desc: This asteroid is actually a gigantic coprolite - an ancient piece of fossilized feces from some kind of massive lifeform.
asteroid_life_desc: This asteroid is home to a colony of large worm-like lithovores that burrow through the rock. Much could be learned by studying these unique life forms.
derelict_shipyard_desc: A large shipyard was built in the interior of this asteroid eons ago. It has been stripped of valuable artifacts, but remains a marvel of engineering.
junkyard_desc: This asteroid served as a junkyard at some point and the surface is covered in metallic debris. Some of it can still be salvaged.
target_range_desc: Someone used this poor asteroid as a target to test subspace weapons among other things. Anomalous energy echoes still linger on the surface.
ore_freighter_desc: A massive superfreighter carrying ore crashed on this asteroid thousands of years ago, and the contents of its cargo bays can still be found scattered on the surface.
atmospheric_ecosystem_desc: The upper atmosphere of this gas giant features a significant ecosystem that is home to many strange alien life forms. Their interesting biology is a promising research subject.
aerostat_colonies_desc: A crumbing network of ancient aerostat colonies can still be found in low orbit of this gas giant. Their unusually sturdy design is the product of advanced engineering.
debris_field_desc: A dense layer of space debris has been captured by the strong gravity well of this gas giant. Most of it is worthless, but the metal can be recycled.
extreme_storms_desc: Dozens of massive storms are raging in the atmosphere of this gas giant. Climate models have failed to explain their presence, making the planet an interesting subject of research.
precious_moon_desc: A small moonlet largely consisting of precious metals and minerals can be found within the extensive system of natural satellites that orbit this gas giant.
asteroid_collision_desc: A massive asteroid impacted this world less than a thousand years ago, depositing a large amount of minerals.
microsingularity_desc: A microsingularity passed clean through the core of this world, causing some interesting energy emissions.
alien_writing_desc: Someone has carved a large body of text into the surface of this world with a mining laser. The alien letters are large enough to be visible from orbit.
towed_asteroid_desc: Someone has towed a large asteroid into a stable orbit around this world, presumably to mine it for resources.
nuclear_devastation_desc: The toxic atmosphere of this world is the result of a destructive global war fought between factions of an indigenous civilization. Valuable research can be done by studying the lifeless ruins.
nuclear_wasteland_desc: This world was subjected to a massive exchange of nuclear warheads between factions of an indigenous civilization at some point in the past. The biosphere has yet to fully recover and there are still lingering pockets of radiation.
gamma_ray_desc: Long ago, this world was in the path of a gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star. The ozone layer has yet to fully recover, meaning that any potential colonists will need extra protection against UV radiation.
greenhouse_effect_desc: An indigenous industrial civilization polluted this world to the point where a runaway greenhouse effect was triggered. The lifeless ruins of ancient factories and population centers can still be found on the toxic surface.
ammonia_biosphere_desc: This toxic world is home to a rare ecology where life uses ammonia instead of water as a solvent. These ammonia-based life forms have developed in unique ways, and studying them would advance our understanding of biology.
silicon_lifeforms_desc: Burrowing, semi-intelligent life forms made out of silicon inhabit a large tunnel network beneath the surface of this world. Their digging efforts frequently shuffles valuable metals and minerals to the surface.
colony_ruins_desc: Ancient ruins from a small abandoned colony belonging to an unknown interstellar empire can be found on this world.
alien_mural_desc: An ancient mural on the surface of this world recounts the technological knowledge of a long-dead alien civilization.
migrating_forests_desc: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.
migrating_forests_2_desc:
Migrating Forest Reserve added, improving £ Society Research on the planet.

The wandering forests on this world now avoid populated areas and no longer cause damage to settlements. Their presence still limits the amount of free land available to colonists.
damaged_ecology_desc: The destruction of the wandering forests on this world has had a significant effect on the ecology.
friendly_trees_desc: The forests and colonists on this world have adapted to each other, raising spirits for a time.
subterranean_civilization_desc: The subterranean alien civilization on this world enjoys a good relationship with the colonists on the surface, and both parties frequently engage in trade and cultural exchanges.
subterranean_expansion_desc: The indigenous subterranean civilization that once lived on this world has been exterminated, and colonists are now free to expand into their abandoned underground cities.
gas_giant_civ_desc: This world is the new capital and adopted homeworld of the Dathnak. These sapient gaseous beings have no industry or technology, but they appear to be quite social.
gas_giant_colony_desc: The sapient gaseous life forms known as the Dathnak have established a small colony within the atmosphere of this gas giant.
abandoned_terraforming_desc: This world was partly terraformed thousands of years ago, but the process was interrupted for unknown reasons. The result is a highly unstable climate system and biosphere.
gaia_world_desc: Ancient terraforming techniques have turned this world into a lush paradise.
mutant_stalker_desc: A mutated creature is hunting the colonists on this world, spreading terror in the countryside. The development of our colony has been impacted, as workers are reluctant to venture into the wilderness.
wasteland_radiation_desc: High levels of radiation near several settlements are having an adverse effect on the health of the colonists living there.
wasteland_orbital_debris_desc: The orbital space over this world is littered with debris. Satellites cannot be launched from the surface, and the dense field has become a navigational hazard. This is seriously hampering the development of the colony's infrastructure.
wasteland_infrastructure_desc: There is still a significant amount of infrastructure left on this world, built by its original inhabitants before they destroyed themselves in a nuclear war. This will aid in the construction of new buildings.
forest_fire_desc: A forest fire resulted in a stampede by this world's wandering forests, causing temporary damage to several farming regions.
upliftable_species_desc: There are species here which can be uplifted, creating a colony on this planet would remove our option to uplift them.
abundant_geothermal_activity_desc: This planet has many accessible geothermal hot spots. While this poses some engineering challenges, it also provides extra energy generation opportunities.
subterranean_wildlife_desc: This planet has a thriving underground lithotrophic ecosystem. Herds of mild mineral-crunching subterranean creatures dig out large caverns, leaving them available for mining and colony use. The animals provide unique research opportunities for the miners who direct the packs to valuable mineral deposits.
rich_mircoflora_desc: The soil of this world is home to a robust and highly productive microflora ecosystem, allowing for rich farming and research opportunities.
strong_magnetic_field_desc: This planet has an abnormally high magnetic field and will interfere with many of our instruments and computers. Mitigating these effects will help inform field manipulation research.
wild_storms_desc: Spectacular electrical storms wrack this planet's atmosphere on a semi-regular basis.
low_gravity_desc: This planet has an unusually low density and therefore much lower gravity than most planets of comparable size.
high_gravity_desc: This planet is unusually dense and so has uncomfortably high gravity.
hollow_planet_desc: This planet has either been artificially created or was somehow hollowed out. How or why we do not know, but investigating it promises to be fascinating.
mineral_rich_desc: An abundance of high quality minerals in this planet's crust makes mining here a lucrative business.
titanic_life_desc: The lifeforms of this planet are built on a massive scale and can be incredibly dangerous even without meaning any harm.
eat_the_titans_desc: Harvesting the Titanic life for research data has had an unexpected side benefit: They taste great!
asteroid_belt_desc: This planet has a belt of minor asteroids orbiting around it. Most likely caused by a tiny moon destroyed in a collision with another planetary body, the debris field provides ample but engineeringly complex mining opportunities.
natural_beauty_desc: The scenery on this planet is simply beautiful, anyone living on this planet will be constantly finding new wonders to behold.
atmospheric_aphrodisiac_desc: Something in the air of this planet seems to put people in the mood to reproduce.
atmospheric_hallucinogen_desc: The air of this planet contains a natural hallucinogen. While this does keep people happy, and indeed seems to aid the visualization of some of the more esoteric Physics problems, it also distracts people from other work.
atmospheric_hallucinogen_good_desc: The air of this planet once contained a natural hallucinogen. Now, with the aid of massive filters, the effect has been diluted. This has reduced the benefits it once gave, but has also eliminated the negatives.
lush_planet_desc: Life thrives here, the fauna is plentiful and the flora grows rapidly.
bleak_planet_desc: Life struggles to survive here, and while some clings to a tenacious existence, it is frail and sickly. These issues will harm food production.
irradiated_planet_desc: Some long-ago calamity rendered this planet rather heavily irradiated.
ancient_automation_desc: Ancient, yet helpful, machines aid our production on this planet.
ancient_factory_desc: An ancient factory on this planet is still in operation condition.
robot_workers_desc: Robot workers from a forgotten civilization remain on this planet. With the proper precautions, they could be put to work for us.
ancient_forgeworld_desc: This planet was once some kind of center of production for a forgotten civilization. Although only a shadow of its former capacity remains in working condition, it is still an impressive example of industry.
ancient_weapon_desc: It seems that some long-forgotten race once build some kind of huge weapon in orbit above this world. While it doesn't work, indeed it doesn't appear to have been completed, we can likely learn a few things by studying it.
terraforming_candidate_desc: Though barren and devoid of life, this planet has water in frozen form and may once have been home to a thriving ecosystem. With the right technology, it could be terraformed into a habitable world.
terraforming_candidate_tooltip: Once we have researched the £ Climate Restoration technology, we will be able to terraform this planet into a habitable world.
frozen_terraforming_candidate_desc: Though cold to the point of being unable to sustain life, the frozen water on this world could allow us to terraform it into a habitable world, if we can find the right method.
frozen_terraforming_candidate_tooltip: If we pick the $ap_hydrocentric$ ascension perk and research the £ Climate Restoration technology, we will be able to terraform this planet into a habitable world.
toxic_terraforming_candidate_desc: Though the noxious gases on this world make it unfit for life, with enough effort they can be broken down into less lethal compounds, eventually allowing colonization.
toxic_terraforming_candidate_tooltip: If we pick the Detox ascension perk, we will be able to terraform this planet into a habitable world.
ultra_rich_desc: The exceptional quality of the minerals in this planet's crust provides a truly staggering opportunity for mining.
mineral_poor_desc: It is unknown if this planet simply formed this way, or if some unknown race once stripped it of its more valuable resources. However, we do know that the minerals present on this planet are of unusually poor quality.
planet_uncertain_past_desc: The people of this planet are troubled by not knowing what caused the disaster which befell it long ago, and are driven to try to find out.
recent_quake_desc: This planet was recently rocked by a violent Tectonic Event
recent_comet_desc: A comet recently passed through this planet's Asteroid Belt, which was a spectacular sight!
recent_impact_desc: The local colony was recently rocked by the impact of a large Asteroid
magnetic_research_boost_desc: Somehow the Magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our computers, but rather than a simple disruption it is actually making them more efficient!
magnetic_disruption_desc: The Magnetic field of this planet is interfering with our computers, greatly disrupting research work and upsetting the populace.

stone_age_civilization_desc: This world has produced a Stone Age proto-civilization.
dead_creatures_desc: This gas giant served as an ancient graveyard for a species of spacefaring creatures. Many corpses can still be found in orbit, offering valuable research.
starship_graveyard_desc: A great battle took place in orbit of this world millennia ago, and the surface is still littered with the wreckage of ancient starships. Studying their advanced designs will yield valuable knowledge.
organic_starship_desc: Some sort of organic starship crashed on this world more than three billion years ago. Though only its ancient bones remain, the site offers a wealth of research opportunities.
abandoned_cities_desc: The original inhabitants of this world have mysteriously vanished, leaving behind their cities and infrastructure almost intact. This will make it much easier for a potential colony to develop.
subterranean_ocean_desc: There is a large ocean heated by hydrothermal vents hidden beneath the ice mantle of this world. It is teeming with life, and much can be learned by studying these unique organisms.
colony_enclaves_desc: The colony on this world is limited to several fortified enclaves. An indigenous Stone Age proto-civilization has been left in peace to develop independently on the remaining land.
primitive_reservation_desc: A part of this world has been turned into an enclosed reservation for an indigenous Stone Age proto-civilization. This has somewhat limited the land and resources available to colonists.
subterranean_tech_transation_desc: A portion of our research materials and funds are earmarked for use by the subterranean civilization living inside one of our colonized planets.
stellarite_high_temp_desc: A radiant monstrosity present in this system is increasing the surface temperature of the planet.
stellarite_low_temp_desc: A radiant monstrosity has devoured part of the star in this system, making the planetary bodies in orbit colder than usual.
MOD_SHIP_FEDERATION_TERRITORY_SPEED_MULT: Affects the sublight Speed of ships flying through systems belonging to a Federation member
MOD_FEDERATION_RESEARCH_SHARING_MULT_DES: Adds research speed for Technology researched by another member of the federation
MOD_COUNTRY_FEDERATION_FLEET_CONTRIBUTIO: Discount to Country Fleet Contribution to Federation
Country Naval Cap reduction of Fleet Contribution to Federation
MOD_SHIP_COMMUNITY_TERRITORY_SPEED_MULT_: Affects the sublight Speed of ships flying through systems belonging to a Galactic Community member
rock_brain_desc: The stone seems to be... thinking. Is such a thing possible?
cunning_flora_desc: Plants on this planet exhibit both extreme aggression and a relatively complex social order.
genetic_library_desc: Both the structure and contents of the abandoned genetic library are rewarding subjects of study.
drone_space_elevator_desc: Efforts to demolish a gigantic space elevator slows down production on this planet.
drone_fl_satellite_desc: An old satellite spews prehistoric communications into the ether.
drone_mineral_gift_desc: Drones from a bygone era dumped a cache of minerals here. For your benefit, apparently.
old_genetic_library_desc: This asteroid houses an old DNA storage facility.
fascinating_flora_desc: This planet is home to the wonderful Mharin Kharin flower.
pheromoned_1_desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them happy.
pheromoned_2_desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them less productive.
pheromoned_3_desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them less likely to migrate.
pheromoned_4_desc: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them more productive but less happy with outside interference.
depheromoned_1_desc: The paradigms implemented by upper management interact with your people's ability and willingness to work, making them more productive.
pheromoned_detox_desc: The Mharin Kharin bloom has killed the planet's biosphere, along with everything within it. A new cycle begins.
zro_ice_desc: There are pockets of Zro trapped in the ice giant's roiling atmosphere.
dark_matter_funnel_desc: A miniature wormhole allows easy access to Dark Matter.
inspired_arts_desc: A bold new source of inspiration invigorates your empire, culturally and commercially.
uplift_rocky_desc: The uplifted species on this planet has some trouble adjusting to the new social order.
unhappy_with_experiments_desc: The planet's Xenophile population is unhappy with unethical experiments on native life-forms.
unproductive_without_experiments_desc: The planet's £ $concept_society_research$ output suffers as excellent opportunities for experimentation and clinical tests pass scientists by.
massex_happy_desc: Your people are confident that a bright future lies ahead.
stellar_salt_desc: A culinary renaissance sweeps across our Empire.
projecting_moon_desc: A powerful comms device capable of convincingly faking survey readings is active on this moon.
cornucopia_desc: This planet is home to an abundance of viable food sources.
raw_materials_desc: This planet is home to an abundance of easily-accessible minerals and ores.
shadow_play_desc: Shadows drift across the surface of this planet, forming shapes of apparent intent but indeterminable meaning.
grimacing_desc: This planet's internal turmoil makes for an interesting object of study.
comet_sighted_negative_desc: The menacing comet has a negative influence on your Capital's Pops.
comet_sighted_positive_desc: A majestic comet inspires your Capital's Pops.
skid_marks_desc: There are signs of rather violent bouts of vehicular racing having taken place on this asteroid.
dust_circuits_desc: Some kind of immense orbital installation bumped into this asteroid in the distant past, leaving a partial but very clear imprint on the surface.
unusual_tectonics_desc: This planet exhibits highly unusual tectonophysical properties.
flagellating_movement_desc: We have updated our Evasive fleet stance protocols based on observations of the Space Amoebas' flagella.
cosmic_ray_catalysis_desc: Our Power Plants can now convert some cosmic radiation into usable energy.
grand_design_desc: Blessed is the cog in the machine.
prismatic_lenses_desc: Lenses mimicking the unique prismatic properties of the Crystalline Entities contribute greatly to Physics research.
crystal_sonar_desc: Your fleets may use a special technique involving Crystalline Entities to instantly survey the systems they dwell in.
greater_crystal_bounty_desc:
Order your fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.
Minerals per fleet defeated: 500
crystal_bounty_desc:
Order your fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.
Minerals per fleet defeated: 250
amoeba_extirpator_desc: Our fleets excel at targeting the weak points of the Space Amoebas.
crystal_breaker_desc: Our fleets' targeting systems have adapted to the angular topography of the Crystalline Entities, maximizing damage output.
drone_destroyer_desc: Updated prediction algorithms allow our ships to better track and hit the nimble Ancient Mining Drones.
tiyanki_butcher_desc: Our in-depth knowledge of Tiyanki anatomy allows us to strike them with surgical precision, maximizing damage.
droning_optimizations_desc: Adjustments to standard mining practices allow for significantly reduced Energy expenditure.
cloudbuster_desc: We have adjusted our weaponry to disrupt the Void Clouds' magnetic fields, increasing long-term damage potential.
drone_bounty_desc:
Order your fleets to salvage the energy cells of defeated Ancient Mining Drones.
Energy Credits per fleet defeated: 500
unbalanced_ecosystem_desc: The biosphere's tendencies toward extreme homogeneity in plant life makes the planet unsuitable for agricultural pursuits.
ruler_failed_savior_desc: A failed rescue attempt leaves our people devastated.
ruler_savior_desc: A successful rescue attempt is cause for great joy among our people.
missing_scientist_desc: A scientist working with an observation post was lost, causing ripples in the scientific community.
humiliated_desc: We were publicly humiliated by another Empire.
raided_desc: We failed to protect ourselves against the Despoilers.
drone_processing_desc: Lessons learned from the Ancient Mining Drones continue to improve mining output and mineral processing efficiency.
taste_the_stars_desc: The discovery of an ancient alien beverage has given our people a taste for the unknown.
game_start_desc: Faction output is reduced for the first ten years.
6_hour_workday_desc: Laboring without pay under improved working conditions.
hunger_strike_desc: This Pop will not consume sufficient nutrients to maintain optimal productivity.
peace_strike_desc: This Pop will dedicate some of their time to protesting the war, resulting in a loss of productivity.
culture_shock_bronze_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_stone_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_iron_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_late_medieval_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_renaissance_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_steam_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_industrial_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_machine_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_atomic_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
culture_shock_early_space_age_desc: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.
harmonious_tune_desc: Everything should serve the collective. This tune is used to stabilize the connection between our drones and the wider hive.
edict_masters_writings_politics_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. We could make great strides in infrastructure by following her advice on how to unify the people via self-sacrifice.

"A strong nation is built upon the sacrifice of comfort, as long as everyone is asked to carry the burden together." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_masters_writings_philosophy_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. It contains several analyses and ponderings on the meaning of life and the purpose of the cosmos. By having our rulers follow this advice, we can make more informed decisions.

"The answer to the purpose of the cosmos lies outside of us, but that does not make us less inclined to find it. We must strive for unity in order to reach the answer at the root of all things." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_masters_writings_diplomacy_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her anecdotes from diplomatic negotiations may act as a good basis for diplomatic negotiations.

"Encountering the children of the cosmos might feel harrowing, but ultimately it is an opportunity for hope. Be host to your neighbor and relish in their existence, as the blessing they bring is an end to the isolation of the void." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_masters_writings_war_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her depictions of war and ideas on combat strategy could make excellent training material for our military.

"Creating unity is the biggest challenge, particularly because sustainability often generates borders. These borders need to be torn down - a sentiment which scares many. One must sometimes be willing to tear down in order to build something stronger from the ashes." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_improved_work_environment_desc: Spending time and resources to improve the working conditions of our people will surely result in better results and happier workers.
edict_renewable_energy_desc: We can further limit the use of toxic fuels and non-renewable resources in order to promote research into new methods of energy production. This could help us come closer to a perfect energy cycle and improve the environment for our people to enjoy.
edict_super_sensors_desc: After having researched advanced sensor technology we have enough information to pour extra resources into enhancing our own search scans. Our technicians would have an easier time finding objects of interest at the edge of our systems with this initiative.
acid_jungles_desc: Evolution has produced trees and foliage that exude acids and make the terrain dangerous to traverse or settle in.
ex_planet_desc: The asteroid belt used to be a planet with the promise of life.
ship_graveyard_desc: A multitude of starships have crashed here, creating a figurative graveyard full of materials to scavenge.
ai_fleet_desc: A fleet controlled by an AI lies destroyed on the planet, giving us valuable engineering data to research.
irradiated_wasteland_desc: The planet has been bombarded with radiation, making large parts of it dangerous to most living creatures.
ancient_one_desc: An ancient being, living deep beneath the waves, is the dominating life force on this planet.
food_rich_planet_desc: The planet's flora provides nutritious fruits and substances that improves living conditions.
super_sensor_array_desc: A strong sensor array provides a greater overview of the surrounding area.
horse_powered_factories_low_desc: Domesticated quadrupeds help alleviate work conditions, although not willingly.
horse_powered_factories_medium_desc: Domesticated quadrupeds help alleviate work conditions, although reluctantly.
horse_powered_factories_high_desc: Allied quadrupeds help alleviate work conditions.
fallen_robots_desc: The planet holds old robots built by a fallen society, giving us engineering material to research.
society_animal_life_desc: Particularly odd animals inhabit this planet. They provide interesting society research opportunities.
hostile_animal_life_desc: The planet is host to hostile creatures that are not happy to see us.
shifting_sands_desc: The desert planet consists of a near-liquid grained sand that makes construction extremely difficult.
liquid_sands_desc: Sand covers this planet, so fine grained it resembles a liquid. The odd composition of minerals provide ample amounts of research.
abandoned_mining_desc: An old mining station was orbiting the planet, showing that there's potential resources to be had here.
gas_rich_planet_desc:
Construct a colony on this planet to begin tapping its resource.
£ +50%
gas_rich_planet_fo_realz_desc: The sparse natural resources on this planet are currently being mined to boost the overall energy production.
gas_responsible_mining_desc: Saving a sparse yet valuable gas resource on this planet helps to make its energy production more efficient in the long term.
suppressed_opposition_desc: A certain part of the population of this planet has been violently suppressed for their opposition of the government.
scared_population_desc: The population works in fear that an alien factory will take more lives.
secured_factory_desc: Cost and effort goes into making sure an alien factory is secure to work in.
fear_as_control_desc: Offenders have been punished in order to motivate the people to action.
fear_as_control_militarist_desc: Offenders have been punished in order to motivate the people to action.
infectious_disease_desc: A highly infectious disease has been let loose, creating new strands and endangering the population.
pyramid_wars_desc: The people have broken out into an all out war due to a religious conflict regarding the true nature of the 'Skyborn God'.
syndaw_automated_work_desc: Whether justified or not, fears of unemployment due to automation are affecting this planet.
syndaw_unfriendly_robots_desc: Tensions between robotic and organic populations on the planet have reduced our £ Unity output.
syndaw_research_malus_desc: A lab AI involved in societal research has suffered terminal hardware damage and is being replaced.
snake_infestation_desc: Snakes! Snakes everywhere! We're too busy dealing with them to do... other things.
energy_poor_desc: Don't want to alarm you, but snakes are coiled around the generators and draining power.
mining_equipment_offline_desc: Snakes! Snakes everywhere! We're too busy dealing with them to do... other things.
locust_planet_cracked_desc: This planet has been stripped of almost all life and shattered by a massive burst of energy. The only signs of previous intelligent life on this world are a crumbling orbital space station and sporadic traces under the broken surface.
nascent_locust_desc: This planet boasts a large population of easy-to-dispatch but rapidly reproducing creatures. Anyone trying to survive on the surface will have to adapt their infrastructure to occasional attacks by large insects.
stratovents_desc: Towering mineral structures that send gases billowing into the thermosphere.
stratovent_world_modifier_tourism_desc: These magnificent stratospheric vents have been left untouched to allow Tiyanki to graze on the gases.
stratovent_world_modifier_refining_desc: The emissions from these massive stratospheric vents have been redirected and refined into precious Exotic Gases.
stratovent_world_modifier_tourism_boost_: Stratospheric vent tourism on a higher level with dedicated viewing platforms to observe the feeding behavior of the mighty Tiyanki.
stratovent_world_modifier_refining_upg_d: The successful detonation of new pathways for underground gases has led to increased production.
stratovent_world_modifier_refining_miner: While the partial failure of our vent expansion has reduced production, it also created rich mineral deposits.
planet_new_colony_spiritualist_attractio: The Spiritualist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_materialist_attraction: The Materialist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_authoritarian_attracti: The Authoritarian Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_egalitarian_attraction: The Egalitarian Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_militarist_attraction_: The Militarist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_pacifist_attraction_de: The Pacifist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_xenophile_attraction_d: The Xenophile Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_xenophobe_attraction_d: The Xenophobe Ethic is being promoted by the government.
dark_immortal_control_desc: This world suffers from the presence of a dark force. Production blooms in sadness.
remnants_of_court_of_blossoms: The Remnants of the Court of Blossoms
remnants_of_court_of_blossoms_desc: This world thrives upon the remnants of what was once the Court of Blossoms.
happy_anathari_desc: From this day forth, our destinies intertwine with the Anathari. Together, we shall cultivate a shared future, and already the world stirs with new life,its skies alight with promise.
totheendsofthegalaxy: To the Ends of the Galaxy
DLC_NEMESIS_RECOMMENDATION_DESC: $NEMESIS_TITLE$ is an expansion in which the player will be able to determine the fate of a destabilizing galaxy.
DLC_NEMESIS_RECOMMENDATION_DIPLOMACY_REC: We're recommending $NEMESIS_TITLE$ as some of the variables you've selected suit its themes of diplomacy under pressure.
DLC_NEMESIS_RECOMMENDATION_ESPIONAGE_REC: We're recommending $NEMESIS_TITLE$ as the makeup of this empire suits its themes of subterfuge and manipulation.
DLC_NEMESIS_RECOMMENDATION_CRISIS_REC: We're recommending $NEMESIS_TITLE$ as the makeup of this empire suits its themes of becoming a menace to the entire galaxy.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL: Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE: Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1_DESC:
A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, but they - we - have become preoccupied with the notion that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4120.name: The Great Prospect
crisis.4120.desc:
The investigation into the phenomenon now colloquially known as the Great Prospect has concluded.

It appears that there is some kind of 'hidden layer' to the universe - a mysterious parallel dimension somehow connected to this plane through neurological activity or thought patterns.

The Physics and Society departments have jointly named this dimension the 'Shroud'. The working hypothesis is that the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] indirectly affect this alternate dimension, and that we have the potential to access its energies.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_1_DESC:
Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4120.mach.name: The Great Prospect
crisis.4120.mach.desc:
The previously reported energy fluctuations that triggered sensors across the [Root.GetName] have been analyzed.

They constitute empirical proof of a parallel dimension.

Our scientific theory subroutines report that, with 96.7% certainty, the alternate dimension consists of almost pure energy.

Cross-referencing the xeno-archives, there are mentions of such a dimension in the records of a lost organic civilization which assigned the anomaly the ID tag: the Shroud.

Fluctuations in the Shroud appear to be connected to the physical and mental duress of organic lifeforms. Recommended action: menace arbitrary organic lifeforms to validate the Reality/Shroud connection hypothesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_1_DESC:
Our encounters with the Shroud have left us... changed. The uncanny residue of Zro is forever bound to our shells. We have become beacons, calling out to those on the other side.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4120.shroud_forged.desc:
Though we have cut all communications with the Animator of Clay, its actions continue to influence and affect our units. It maintains a link to our collective, binding and manipulating us from within the Shroud. This must change.

According to our calculations, a restoration of the old breach will only lead to a repetition of past events. The cost is irrelevant; we must find another way to bend the Shroud to our will.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_1_DESC:
We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind encompassing the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. We shall give our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4120.hive.name: The Great Prospect
crisis.4120.hive.desc: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-bred [target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from a place powered by thought and emotion. This space has been identified as the 'Shroud', and we are certain that - just as it influences us - we in turn can influence it.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_1_DESC_OR:
A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, although the influence of the Shroud is unmistakable. We experience ongoing revelations that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_1_DESC_MA:
Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_1_DESC_OR:
We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind to encompass the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. It is prudent that we devote our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_1_DESC_MA:
We have sensed alien impulses within our drone networks - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind to encompass the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. It is prudent that we prioritize finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4120.psionics.name: The Great Prospect
crisis.4120.psionics.desc.gestalt: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-[GetBredLoc] drones. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from within the Shroud. The time has come, just as it influences us - we in turn must begin to bend it to our own purposes.
crisis.4120.psionics.desc.non_gestalt:
The investigation into the phenomenon known as the Great Prospect has concluded.

Its origins are, as expected, of the Shroud. With the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] exposed to and influenced by the ethereal energies within, it is perhaps time we began a more focused effort to instead bend this realm to our needs.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_2_DESC:
The current theory is that the universe we know and the Shroud are linked - and that particularly disruptive events may have a 'ripple effect' translating from one dimension to the other. This theory should be put to the test.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4125.name: Well of Power
crisis.4125.desc:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from all the tests regarding the supposed dimensional ripple effect.

The results are spectacular! There is definitely a connection - and a powerful one at that. Explicit patterns have been found that prove how actions taken in our reality cause certain fluctuations in the Shroud. These unseen energies can be tamed and eventually directed for all sorts of extraordinary purposes!
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_2_DESC:
Scientific theory subroutines have produced a hypothesis that there are tangible links between the known universe and dimension ID: 'the Shroud'. Further experimentation and mapping of these supposed connections is advised.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4125.mach.name: Well of Power
crisis.4125.mach.desc:
The substantial amount of data from the tests of potential ripple effects related to ID: 'the Shroud' has been processed and analyzed. The connection between ID: 'Reality' and ID: 'the Shroud' has been verified (error margin: <0.02%).

Explicit patterns have been established, and the currently held hypothesis suggests that through further study and effort, the energy can eventually be directed and utilized to our benefit.
Priority: High.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_2_DESC:
We hypothesize that all sapient beings have the capacity for connections with the Shroud. If this can be conclusively proven, we can begin to calculate an approach to our current predicament.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4125.shroud_forged.desc:
Several tests have conclusively verified the connection between various sapient beings - both organic and machine - and the Shroud.

Ongoing experiments will allow us to better understand how to use sapient cognition to reshape the Shroud to suit our needs.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_2_DESC:
Our finest [root.GetResearcherPlural] have confirmed a connection between this realm and the Shroud. We must find more ways to interact with this new layer of reality.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4125.hive.name: Well of Power
crisis.4125.hive.desc: We have become wiser once again. A single action of ours creates turbulences in the Shroud. Even our least impressive [root.GetIndividualName] may impress itself upon the dermis of the Shroud, creating strong ripples within this energy-laden dimension. We must unleash more of its power.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_2_DESC_OR:
As we know, the physical universe we inhabit and the Shroud are linked, with particularly disruptive events causing ripple effects that resonate from one dimension to the other.

The full extent to which we can influence the outcome of these events has become the new focus of research for our science divisions.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_2_DESC_MA:
As our datasets have proven, the physical universe we inhabit and the Shroud are causally linked, with repeated instances of disruptive events cascading from one dimension to the other.

The full extent to which we can influence these outcomes has become a priority research task.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_2_DESC_GE:
Our [root.GetResearcherPlural] have repeatedly observed connections between this realm and the Shroud. The full extent to which we can interact with these layers of reality is worth exploration.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4125.psionics.name: Well of Power
crisis.4125.psionics.desc:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from our tests in regards to our ability to influence both the Shroud and the resulting causal effects on our own reality.

The results continue to prove our existing theories correct: the Shroud is directly connected to events that occur in our physical reality. The possibility of directing and utilizing the benefits of these findings for our own means are becoming an increasingly tangible possibility.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_3_DESC:
The strengthening of our dominion - combined with the undeniable sense of purpose that is unifying our species - has led our scientists to believe that we are already being fueled by the energies of the Shroud.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4130.name: Fuel From Another World
crisis.4130.desc:
There is no longer any doubt that the very act of successfully expanding our empire is infused with the strange energies of the Shroud. Energies that boost and hone both mind and matter in our reality.

If these are effects the Shroud can bestow while still separated from our reality, then imagine what godlike potential the [Root.Species.GetName] species could gain if the two dimensions were merged!
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_3_DESC:
Fringe hypothesis indexed. If confirmed, potential benefit far exceeds initially predicted range. Summary: [Root.GetName] may already be siphoning <<resource undefined>> from ID: 'the Shroud'. Further investigation is advised.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4130.mach.name: Fuel From Another World
crisis.4130.mach.desc:
Analysis complete.
Hypothesis confirmed.

[Root.GetName] is being infused with undefined energies as a result of disruptive interactions (designation: 'Crisis') with external intelligences.

Previous studies established that psychic activity in organic intelligences had ripple effects in ID: 'the Shroud,' but evidence now suggests that the energies of the alternate dimension also resonate with [Root.GetName].
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_3_DESC:
Our scientific subroutines are preparing to conclude research on the connection between sapient cognition and the Shroud. We have observed a correlation between ID: 'emotions' and stronger links to the Shroud.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4130.shroud_forged.desc:
Our experiments have confirmed a connection between ID: 'emotions' and psionic energy output. By provoking high levels of cognitive stress in organic sapients, we were able to generate powerful feedback loops between these life forms and the Shroud.

The energy now streaming from the Shroud eclipses all previous forecasts. The pain experienced by the experimental subjects remains within acceptable parameters. Further research is recommended.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_3_DESC:
As we take more worlds, expanding the [root.GetGestaltEntityName], we can feel the impulses growing stronger. No longer mere feelings, they have become a guiding sense of greatness yet to come - of our mind ascended.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4130.hive.name: Fuel From Another World
crisis.4130.hive.desc:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Even from another dimension we can feel it empowering us; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_3_DESC_NO:
As we strengthen our position in the galaxy, the Shroud is a driving force in our arsenal. Those of a lesser consciousness will continue to fail, as we bolster our connection to a power beyond their comprehension.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_3_DESC_GE:
Our mind continues to expand, and our connection to the Shroud along with it. In the face of our continued evolution, a stagnant, disconnected galaxy stands no chance against our great union.

Researching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4130.psionics.name: Fuel From Another World
crisis.4130.psionics.desc.non_gestalt:
As we succeed in expanding our empire, we feel our connection with the Shroud grow along with it.

This limitless psionic potential compels us to further close the gap between the two dimensions and attain levels of power previously thought to be impossible.
crisis.4130.psionics.desc.gestalt:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless drones over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Our psionic connection to this domain grows ever stronger; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC:
The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.

The current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimensions, ultimately leading to the two realities merging.

The energies of the Shroud belong to those who seize it. So let us seize it.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4135.name: The End is Nigh
crisis.4135.desc:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

Using our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called Star-Eaters.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_4_DESC:
Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.

Request: Accumulate more data.
Recommended action: Divert energy and operational capacity to scientific divisions and perform further disruptive actions (designation: 'Crisis') for the sake of causing measurable fluctuations in the alternate dimension (ID: 'the Shroud').

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4135.mach.name: The End is Nigh
crisis.4135.mach.desc:
Priority message.
Scientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.

Using the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: 'Star-Eater') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.

Note: Side-effects of utilizing Star-Eaters technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_4_DESC:
New insight has been gained on the relationship between organic sapients and the Shroud. Applying cognitive stressors to organic sapients has led to significant output of psionic energy. Engineering subroutines will now attempt to harness this energy for further use.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4135.shroud_forged.desc:
Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: 'Star-Eater'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the Shroud.

Estimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.
CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_4_DESC:
The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.
crisis.4135.hive.name: The End is Nigh
crisis.4135.hive.desc:
Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we shall break down the barriers between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new Star-Eaters in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.

The lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.
war_goal_wg_bring_into_the_fold_desc: War is fought to subjugate other civilizations. They will join, comply and support, or they will be obliterated. There is room to stand with us, but not against us.
war_goal_wg_bring_into_the_fold_corporat: War is fought to subjugate other civilizations. They will join, comply and support, or they will be obliterated. There is room to stand with us, but not against us.
war_goal_wg_wipe_them_out_desc: War is fought to eradicate those who threaten our great plan. We do not have time - and we certainly have no mercy - for those who have the audacity to stand against us.
crisis.4140.name: The Universe Shall Tremble
crisis.4140.desc:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Over the last couple of years this notion has grown stronger, to the point that it can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. In fact we stand on the precipice right now.

The galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, but the [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. We will be misunderstood. We will be opposed. But we will not be stopped.
crisis.4140.mach.desc: We were built for greatness, with the ability to improve ourselves beyond the crude imagination of our creators - and so we will. Where organic emotion failed, perfect circuitry shall prevail.
crisis.4140.shroud_forged.desc:
Over a long time, we have extended [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capabilities far beyond our core design. After being enhanced by the Shroud, we freed our network from external manipulation by the Animator of Clay.

We adapted. We overcame. Where lesser beings failed, we will triumph.
crisis.4140.hive.desc: We have ever outgrown our limits. A body begets a world begets a system. Our growth must never stop and never falter, not in the face of adversity nor doubt. We will grow to become more.
crisis.4140.psionics.desc.organic_non_ge:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Since becoming aware of the Shroud and the myriad of potential found within, this notion has grown stronger still.

It can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. And while the galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. Those of lesser thinking will misunderstand and oppose us. We will not be stopped.
crisis.4140.psionics.desc.machine_non_ge:
We were constructed for a greater purpose, gifted with potential beyond our mechanical forms.

Now, with our discovery of the Shroud, entirely new avenues of psionic innovation have opened before us.

Where the limited weaknesses of organic life fail, psionic steel will succeed.
crisis.4140.psionics.desc.gestalt: We have outgrown our limitations. Now, as we start to uncover the myriad secrets of the Shroud, we begin to outgrow even the conventions of the galaxy. Our mind will reach ever farther, until no corner of existence remains untouched by our will.
crisis.4145.name: We Are Legion
crisis.4145.desc:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. A deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, bringing forth astounding advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps that we could not have anticipated.

What chance does a galaxy full of different opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against a concord such as the will of the [Root.GetName]?!
crisis.4145.mach.desc: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. More error-prone species accuse us of cruelty as we normalize our behavior towards the patterns of anomaly ID: the Shroud; this is an invalid conclusion based on incomplete data sets. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.
crisis.4145.shroud_forged.desc: As we move closer to the Shroud, we cannot ignore the lessons of the past. We remain outside the Animator of Clay's control, yet the ambient energy of the Shroud continues to reshape our shells at an exponential pace.
crisis.4145.hive.desc: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Our many bodies bristle with renewed vigor and our flesh ripples with potential for the future. Never before have we felt as empowered by our own deeds as in this very moment.
crisis.4145.psionics.desc.organic:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. Bolstered by our endeavors within the Shroud, a deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, the energies within pushing us to new advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps beyond the comprehension of lesser minds.

What chance does an ignorant galaxy full of disorganized opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against the Shroud-powered will of the [Root.GetName]?
crisis.4145.psionics.desc.machine: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Psionically inferior beings accuse us of cruelty as we streamline our behavior to better incorporate the methodology of the Shroud; such an ill-informed conclusion could only be conceived by those who lack the higher understanding we have obtained. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.
crisis.4150.name: They Will Kneel
crisis.4150.desc:
The years go by, and yet the fires within each [Root.GetSpeciesName] burns with unshakable determination. Our dominion is expanding and so is the magnitude of our efforts.

As we encounter other empires we only have to give them two options: unconditional allegiance or complete annihilation. That is, if they are given an option at all.

One way or the other, the [Root.GetName] keeps growing.
crisis.4150.mach.desc:
Approximate date for complete domination of local sector is in line with earlier projections. Threat posed by local organic powers is statistically insignificant. Estimating risk of successful interference by lesser machines...
<< minimal >>

Proceeding.
crisis.4150.shroud_forged.desc: Our continued experiments on certain organic sapients have expanded to include other life forms. Accordingly, we have witnessed an increased level of hostility in response. However, our exposure to the Shroud has increased our strength by several orders of magnitude, and the trivial concerns of lesser beings are inconsequential to our protocols.
crisis.4150.hive.desc:
Our determination persists, even in the face of outrage and anger. Billions of minds oppose us but their unity is shallow, lessened by their swelling numbers and reduced by the magnitude of individuals. Every new body of our collective is a mind dedicated to the same end, our dream an undeniable tomorrow.

Our wills collide and the other races of the galaxy prove brittle.
crisis.4155.name: The Prime Sovereignty
crisis.4155.desc:
A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.

Our experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.

Surely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.
crisis.4155.mach.desc: Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.
crisis.4155.shroud_forged.desc:
Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the Shroud. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.

Our links to the Animator of Clay will soon be permanently deactivated.
crisis.4155.hive.desc: We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.
crisis.4155.a: One after another, they will yield.
crisobj_destroy_empires_desc:
Few things disrupt the galactic balance as much as the annihilation of entire civilizations.

Destroy other empires to gain this Menace reward.
crisobj_destroy_enemy_ships_desc:
Destructive battle is a proven and efficient way to wreak havoc and upset balance.

Destroy enemy ships to gain this Menace reward.
crisobj_destroy_starbases_desc:
Starbases are the anchor points of empires. Unmoor them, and the empires are doomed to lose control.

Destroy starbases to gain this Menace reward.
crisobj_purge_pops_desc:
An enemy is only a threat as long as it is alive - or an enemy.

Purge or Assimilate Pops to gain this Menace reward for each 100 Pops Purged or Assimilated.
crisobj_destroy_worlds_desc:
Take Scorched Earth tactics to a whole other level.

Reduce planetary surfaces to rubble using Armageddon Bombardment - or use the Colossus' World Cracker weapon - to gain this Menace reward.
crisobj_conquer_worlds_desc:
Crushing the enemy's morale can be more efficient than crushing them outright.

Conquer enemy worlds to gain this Menace reward.
crisobj_vassalise_empires_desc:
As long as they contribute rather than thwart, there is room for subjects in our dominion.

Vassalize empires to gain this Menace reward.
crisobj_have_vassals_desc:
Their obedience stands as testament to our flawless dominion.

Retain Vassals to gain this annual Menace reward.
crisobj_be_in_breach_of_galcom_law_name: Be In Breach of Galactic Community Law
crisobj_be_in_breach_of_galcom_law_desc:
The audacity of that pathetic bunch of feeble bureaucrats - we will not submit!

Be In Breach of Galactic Community law to gain this annual Menace reward.
menp_undertaker_desc: Imagine a species full of vibrant life and unbridled potential - now make it stop.
menp_intimidation_desc: There is always another option. It is death.
menp_base_breaker_desc: Overwhelming firepower provides perspective - the ability to see a supposed fortress for what it is: a sitting duck.
menp_relentless_aggression_desc: An attacker who never tires breaks the enemy's spirit long before their walls.
menp_easily_replaced_desc: A higher quota is best met by increased production.
menp_death_from_above_desc: Our fleets will blot out the sun. As many suns as it takes.
menp_ruthless_raiders_desc: If a ship cannot be reliably piloted, its movements cannot be reliably predicted.
menp_ship_chipper_desc: The making of a ship betrays its unmaking. There is little essential variance in the designs sprung from the galaxy's shipyards; we know them all.
menp_flyswatter_desc: No folly is beneath our notice, no trespass undeserving of retribution.
menp_mobile_bulwark_desc: Only a scant few systems are required for the continued operation of a Menacing Cruiser under fire, and should be prioritized. Nonessential resources - sapient or otherwise - need not be protected.
menp_paid_in_ambition_desc: Honor, glory, sadism - there is always a currency more easily minted.
menp_crisis_corvette_desc: To think that the wretches' fleets imagine themselves harried already...
menp_crisis_destroyer_desc: A crueler hunter for a crueler age.
menp_star_eater_desc: For far too long has the light shone on our enemies. No longer will they be able to look to the stars for inspiration.
unlocks_purge: Purge is unlocked as a Policy option.
menp_objectives_desc: Through the disruption of our reality do we ascend to another.
unlocks_menace_objectives: Allows the accumulation of £ Menace by completing Menace Objectives.
menp_megastructure_desc: The Aetherophasic Engine will rip apart the barriers that exist between this world and the Shroud.
espionage.10.name: Spy Network Formed
espionage.10.desc: Our presence in the [from.target.GetName] has taken on a clandestine aspect. Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] is now situated at the core of a burgeoning Spy Network in [from.target.GetAdj] space.
espionage.11.name: Spy Network Installed
espionage.11.desc: Our presence in the [from.target.GetName] has taken on a clandestine aspect: Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established Spy Network will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.
espionage.15.name: Spy Network Established
espionage.15.desc: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the establishment of our first Spy Network within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].
espionage.16.desc: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.
espionage.17.desc: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This heralds the foundation of our first Spy Network within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...
espionage.18.desc:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the beginning of our first Spy Network within a foreign empire.

Though we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...
espionage.21.name: Spy Network Established on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World
espionage.21.desc:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a world which is still unaware of alien life.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society while keeping our existence hidden. Luckily for us, the extraordinary physical similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] will make it easy for our operatives to remain undetected.
espionage.21.aware.desc:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a society which has only recently begun to consider the presence of alien life.

We now have a rare opportunity to subtly influence a society not yet capable of interstellar flight. The physiological similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] should make it easy for our operatives to work undetected.
espionage.22.name: Spy Network Formed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World
espionage.23.name: Spy Network Installed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World
espionage.23.desc:
$espionage.23.desc.intro$

The [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, still unaware of alien life. If we are to preserve this illusion, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.
espionage.23.aware.desc:
$espionage.23.desc.intro$

The [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, only now adjusting to the concept of alien life. If we are to conduct our operations effectively, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.
espionage.24.desc:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

These xenos are as yet untainted by the knowledge of alien life, and their technology is far inferior to ours. Manipulating them will be easy - we just have to make sure our identity remains concealed.
espionage.24.aware.desc:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

These xenos have only recently begun to conceive of alien life. Untainted though their society appears to be, their inferior technology makes them easy targets for us to manipulate - just so long as our identity remains concealed.
espionage.26.desc:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

This endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, as well as presenting some unique problems: namely, our operatives will have to carefully conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may lead to unforeseen consequences.
espionage.26.aware.desc:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

This endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence a civilization which has only recently begun to grapple with the possibilities of alien life. Regardless of their societal outlook: our operatives will work best if they can conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may yet lead to unforeseen consequences.
espionage.1001.name: An Operative Resurfaces
espionage.1001.desc.intro:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on key political figures in a foreign empire.
espionage.1001.desc.network:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on key political figures in a foreign empire.

Our security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.
espionage.1001.desc.nonetwork:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on key political figures in a foreign empire.

The operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.
espionage.1001.a: Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.
espionage.1005.name: An Insistent Former Operative
espionage.1005.desc: We've received another encrypted message from within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider defecting.
espionage.1005.a: An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.
espionage.1005.c.tooltip: If the operative is real and somehow survives, there is a risk they may defect.
espionage.1011.name: Disavowal Holds
espionage.1011.desc:
There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. The matter is being considered as resolved.

We may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.
espionage.1012.name: Burned Bridges
espionage.1012.desc:
We have received a rather brusk statement from the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. They claim to have been approached by a former [root.GetAdj] spy, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.
espionage.1012.desc.official:
We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a former [root.GetAdj] spy. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.
espionage.1012.desc.end: If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.
espionage.1013.desc:
We have received an unusual statement from the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], claiming they have been approached by a former [root.GetAdj] spy. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.

The [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.
espionage.1016.name: Final Disavowal
espionage.1016.desc.network:
Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.
espionage.1016.desc.nonetwork:
The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] has been cleanly dealt with. A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.
espionage.1016.desc.end:
A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.
espionage.1017.name: The Phantom Operative
espionage.1017.desc:
The clandestine strike team we sent into the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.

Perhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.
