menacing_actions_supremacy_vassalize_emp: Vassalizing an empire will yield 100 £ Menace.
menacing_actions_supremacy_invade_primit: Invading primitive worlds will yield 1 £ Menace per £ Pop.
menacing_actions_supremacy_sent_marauder: Sending a Marauder Raid will yield 50 £ Menace per £ Pop.
menacing_actions_deception_force_resolut: Forcing a proposal through - despite a majority of voters opposing it - will yield 5 £ Menace.
menacing_actions_deception_council_posit: Sit on the Galactic Community Council
Having a position on the Galactic Community Council will yield 10 £ Menace annually.
menacing_actions_deception_veto_resoluti: Vetoing a resolution will yield 100 £ Menace per resolution.
menacing_actions_deception_call_in_favor: Calling in a favor will yield 1 £ Menace per £ Favor.
menacing_actions_deception_win_humiliati: Winning a Humiliation War will yield 200 £ Menace.
crisis_perks_supremacy_privateering_desc: Attack them ourselves?! Oh, please - We have people who do that for us.
crisis_perks_supremacy_privateering_unlo: Hire a total of 4 Marauder Fleets in order to unlock this Crisis Perk.
crisis_perks_supremacy_primus_inter_pare: They are our equals. And they will concur with that statement, or else...
Be the leader of a Hegemony Federation with at least 3 other members.
+5 Federation Naval Capacity per Federation member.
crisis_perks_supremacy_support_is_mandat: You are, of course, free to object to our demands. However, if you do, we will annihilate you.
Have at least 4 Vassals under your empire to unlock this Crisis Perk.
Each vassal contributes +10% more £ Energy and £ Minerals every month.
Gain +20 Naval Capacity for every vassal under your empire.
crisis_perks_deception_lord_of_red_tape_: Simple! Fill in Federal Form 68-XM, hand it over to Section 11-B no later than the 21st, request three copies of...
Propose 3 sanctions in the Galactic Community to unlock this Crisis Perk.
Gain immunity to being 'in breach' of Galactic Community law.
crisis_perks_deception_dance_puppets_des: You know how this goes: you scratch my back, and I refrain from obliterating yours.
crisis_perks_deception_dance_puppets_unl: Call in 20 £ Favors to unlock this Crisis Perk.
crisis_perks_deception_dance_puppets_act: Calling in £ Favors cost no £ Influence.
crisis_perks_deception_shadowplay_desc: What you know about us, you know because we let you. What we know about you is 'everything'.
crisis_perks_deception_shadowplay_unlock: Complete 10 Operations in order to unlock this Crisis Perk.
crisis_perks_deception_shadowplay_passiv: Espionage actions are +20% faster, and have a -20% cost.
menace_gaining: Complete Crisis Objectives to gain more Menace.
menace_desc: Menace is a measure of our resonance with the calamitous energies of the Shroud.
menace_crisis_objective_progress: We have gained £ Amount from this Crisis Objective.
menace_crisis_level_unlocked: At $LEVEL$, you get a Special Project and the rewards:
menace_crisis_level_desc: To advance through the Crisis levels, complete Crisis Objectives and research the Crisis Special Projects in the Situation Log
menace_crisis_description_intro:
Those in the galactic community who chart the arc of history have long predicted a coming Crisis - an existential threat to all sapient life which would require unprecedented unity of purpose, and sacrifice, to overcome. If it can be overcome at all.

Popular predictions as to the nature of this crisis have been as fanciful as the invasion of an extragalactic glutton, or the galaxy's machine intelligences rising up in petty rebellion, or a war of succession spilling over from another plane of existence, but...

It is now clear that it was always going to be us.
menace_crisis_description:
Those in the galactic community who chart the arc of history have long predicted a coming Crisis - an existential threat to all sapient life which would require unprecedented unity of purpose, and sacrifice, to overcome. If it can be overcome at all.

Popular predictions as to the nature of this crisis have been as fanciful as the invasion of an extragalactic glutton, or the galaxy's machine intelligences rising up in petty rebellion, or a war of succession spilling over from another plane of existence, but...

It is now clear that it was always going to be us.

Our actions have echoes in another dimension, one of limitless energy. We need only discover how to harness this power in order to bring the galaxy to heel.
menace_crisis_howto: Pursuing Crisis Objectives generates £ Menace, unlocking our destructive potential in order to complete the Aetherophasic Engine Megastructure and bring about a new age for the galaxy.

We balance over the chasm of a bloody future as the gravity of destiny claws at us.

As we gaze into the abyss, we see only ourselves staring back.

Our Infiltration Level of this Empire is changing each day by this amount.

Countries with high $concept_empire_size$ or where we have a Relative Encryption advantage are easier to infiltrate.

Difficulty can be reduced by assigning an asset with modifier corresponding to the type of operation.

Each stage of an espionage operation can have a different difficulty value.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_ASSET_DIFFICULTY_EFF: The Spy Network has Assets available that could lower this to $VALUE$ difficulty.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_PHASE_REPORT_TOOLTIP:
Operation Log
The $ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_PHASE_REPORT$ shows you the results of the last Operation Phase.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_TARGET_INFORMATION:
Target Information
The $TARGET_INFO$ shows you important information about the empire you are targeting, like their Relative Power and Relative Encryption.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_SKILL_BONUS_DESC: The Skill Bonus will increase the likelihood of getting successful results at the end of an operation phase.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_SKILL_BONUS_TOOLTIP:
Skill Bonus
The Skill Bonus will increase the likelihood of getting successful results at the end of an operation phase.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CLUES_DESC:
Insights represent useful opportunities our operatives have exploited to advance a stage of an espionage operation.

Insights increases Breakthrough Chance.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CLUES_TOOLTIP:
Insights
Insights represent useful opportunities our operatives have exploited to advance a stage of an espionage operation.

Insights increases Breakthrough Chance.
RELATIVE_ENCRYPTION_DEFENSIVE: Their Codebreaking is $REL$ relative to our Encryption. When conducting Espionage on us, they experience these effects:
RELATIVE_ENCRYPTION_OFFENSIVE: Their Encryption is $REL$ relative to our Codebreaking. When conducting Espionage on them, we experience these effects:
SPY_NETWORK_NO_ENVOY_ASSIGNED: Requires an Envoy to be assigned to the Spy Network.
SPY_NETWORK_ENVOY_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: £  This Spy Network already has a Spymaster assigned. See the Espionage tab for $spy_network$ information.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_CATEGORY_ASSE: Success is more likely if we have an Asset assigned to this Operation, sharing the same primary category.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_THEMED_ASSET: Success is more likely if we have an Asset assigned to this Operation, sharing the same secondary category.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_ASSET_EVENT_OPTION: The Asset we have assigned to this Operation enables us to take this course of action.
ESPIONAGE_SPYNETWORK_ASSET_EVENT_OPTION: An Asset within this Spy Network enables us to take this course of action.
operation_one_at_a_time: £  A Spy Network can only have one active operation at a time
operation_target_seditionists_requires_s: £  We have no reason to believe they are undermining our authority
spark_rebellion_already_sparked: £  A civil war is already raging
op_cat_manipulation_desc: Operations which distort, fabricate and exploit information.
op_cat_provocation_desc: Subversive actions almost guaranteed to put their victims on a war footing.
op_cat_sabotage_desc: Aggressive operations which strike directly at military, commercial and civilian targets.
op_cat_subterfuge_desc: Clandestine acts of opinion-swaying, theft and coercion.
op_cat_infiltration_desc: Undercover operations to subtly influence a society from within.
operation_steal_technology_desc: Our operatives will infiltrate research laboratories and systems, providing our own scientists with the answers they're looking for.
operation_steal_technology_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Gain a random unknown Technology, or else an amount of Research.
operation_steal_technology_enigmatic_eng: £  Their technology and research methods have become indecipherable to us.
operation_steal_technology_too_recent: £  We must wait until at least [Root.recently_stole_technology] before we make another attempt on their research facilities.
operation_acquire_asset_desc:
We can tempt or coerce operatives and other assets who would be of use to our intelligence operations, recruiting them - for a price.

Assigning an Asset to this operation may skew the results towards their interests.
operation_acquire_asset_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Gain an Asset for use within this Spy Network.
operation_sleeper_cells_desc: We have more pressing uses for our intelligence operatives at this time - but with careful preparations, we can preserve most of our Spy Network for future needs.
operation_sleeper_cells_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Cease activity within this Spy Network, allowing its Spymaster to be reassigned whilst also preventing its Infiltration Level from decaying.
operation_sabotage_starbase_orbring_desc: Starbases and Orbital Rings are the beating heart of any empire. It'd be a shame if something happened to that one.
operation_sabotage_starbase_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Destroy a random Module or Building on a particular Starbase facility. Will not affect Shipyard Modules.
operation_sabotage_starbase_no_targets: £  We can only target Starbase facilities with Modules and Buildings which aren't Shipyards.
operation_smear_campaign_desc: Skilled operatives can spread our version of the truth, undermining even the friendliest relationships.
operation_smear_campaign_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Lower Relations between the [root.target.GetName] and another empire.
operation_extort_favors_desc: A combination of blackmail and extortion could build useful leverage for our diplomatic envoys.
operation_extort_favors_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Gain at least one Favor from the [root.target.GetName].
operation_arm_privateers_desc: Our operatives will provide untraceable weapons and ships to subversive elements within the target empire, giving them the means to spread chaos and destruction.
operation_arm_privateers_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Cause a fleet of hostile Privateers to appear within [root.target.GetAdj] space.
operation_arm_privateers_existing_activi: £  Privateer activity is already under way in the [root.target.GetName]. We must wait until at least [Root.Target.target_of_operation_arm_privateers] for another opportunity.
operation_crisis_beacon_desc: They say that to escape any rampaging beast, you don't need to outrun it - just whoever you're with. A few tempting lures towards our target's capital ought to help, too...
operation_crisis_beacon_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Lure a Crisis faction fleet towards the [root.target.GetAdj] capital.
operation_crisis_beacon_too_recent: £  We must wait at least 4 years between attempts to lure a Crisis.
operation_crisis_beacon_too_recent_timer: £  We must wait until at least [This.Owner.crisis_beacon_timer] before we may attempt to lure a Crisis again.
operation_gather_information_desc:
Our operatives will compile information on the [This.Target.GetName], delivering an Intel report when complete. This will also expose vulnerabilities that will increase our Maximum Infiltration Level for some time.

Assigning an Asset to this operation may skew the results towards their interests.
operation_gather_information_no_dlc_desc: Our operatives will compile information on the [This.Target.GetName], delivering an Intel report when complete. This will also expose vulnerabilities that will increase our Maximum Infiltration Level for some time.
operation_gather_information_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Gain Intel and Maximum Infiltration Level on the [root.target.GetName].
operation_diplomatic_incident_desc: We will seek to cause embarrassment by exploiting the weak links of their diplomatic establishment.
operation_diplomatic_incident_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Cause diplomatic embarrassment involving an Envoy of the [root.target.GetName].
operation_target_seditionists_desc: Our operatives will employ whatever means are necessary to dissuade the target empire's envoys from lobbying to weaken Imperial Authority.
operation_target_seditionists_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Weaken attempts by the [root.target.GetName] to lower Imperial Authority.
operation_weaken_galactic_empire_desc: Our operatives will infiltrate the heart of Imperial society to weaken the Galactic Imperium's grip on the galaxy.
operation_spark_rebellion_desc:
The Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Our operatives will seize this opportunity and do everything in their power to trigger a galaxy-wide rebellion against the Imperium's tyrannical rule.

This operation will be terminated if Imperial Authority is above 80 when a Phase concludes.
operation_spark_rebellion_on_success:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Form a Rebellion and declare war against the Galactic Imperium.
espionage_operation_roll_header:
Breakthrough Chance
This reflects the chance of your operatives making a breakthrough during the current stage of their Operation.

Every time a phase ends, a die (1 to 10) is rolled. The result of the roll is added to Skill Bonus and Insights, then subtracted by Difficulty.
espionage_operation_roll_extended_header:
Breakthrough Chance
This reflects the chance of your operatives making a breakthrough during the current stage of their Operation.

Every time a phase ends, a die (1 to 10) is rolled. The result of the roll is added to Skill Bonus and Insights, then subtracted by Difficulty.

Roll Outcomes:
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_ON_ROLL_FAILED_RANGE: ($CHANCE|%0Y$) Result is between $MIN|0Y$ and $MAX|0Y$. Adds $CLUES|0Y$ Insight(s).
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_ON_ROLL_FAILED_GREAT: ($CHANCE|%0Y$) Result is $MIN|0Y$ or greater. Finishes stage.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_ON_ROLL_FAILED_LESS_: ($CHANCE|%0Y$) Result is $MAX|0Y$ or less. Adds $CLUES|0Y$ Insights.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_SPYNETWORK_NOT_LEVEL: Requires Infiltration Level to be $VALUE|Y$ or higher.
tooltip_espionage_asset_guaranteed_resum: Expending our Spy Network Asset will allow progress to resume.
tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_en: They may identify us if their Codebreaking is superior to our Encryption.
tooltip_synth_crisis_encryption_bonus: Our high Encryption capability means this research will advance more quickly.
tech_thought_enforcement_desc: Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.
tech_thought_enforcement_gestalt_desc: With additional study, our telepath drones could identify deviant impulses before they emerge as conscious thought, and correct these aberrations as necessary.
tech_tracking_implants_desc: Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.
tech_encryption_1_desc: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.
tech_encryption_2_desc: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.
tech_encryption_3_desc: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.
tech_decryption_1_desc: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.
tech_decryption_2_desc: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.
tech_decryption_3_desc: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.
tech_planetary_infrastructure_1_desc: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
tech_planetary_infrastructure_1_wilderne: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
tech_planetary_infrastructure_2_desc: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
tech_planetary_infrastructure_2_wilderne: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
tech_capital_productivity_1_desc: As our planets become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.
tech_capital_productivity_2_desc: Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.
tech_capital_productivity_3_desc: Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.
edict_enhanced_surveillance_desc: Terrible threats probe our defenses, waiting for us to lower our guard. Increased resources must be sent to internal covert security departments to protect ourselves.
edict_bureau_of_espionage_desc: Expanding our intelligence operations and prioritizing decryption technologies is critical for the well-being of the empire.
edict_observation_instinct_desc: Additional resources will be directed to nurturing and expanding our observation capabilities.
edict_covert_analysis_algorithm_desc: A substantial portion of processing power will be diverted to investigative analysis.
edict_tracking_implants_desc: Mandatory subdermal implants record movement and actions, greatly enhancing our empire's internal security. Loyal citizens have nothing to hide from the government.
edict_thought_enforcement_desc: Telepaths monitoring the citizenry for incorrect thoughts will make corrections as they find them.
edict_thought_enforcement_effect:
Encryption: +1
Happiness: -10%
Governing Ethics Attraction: +25%
Telepaths provide -30 Crime
edict_thought_enforcement_gestalt_desc: Telepath drones monitor our collective mind for deviant impulses, correcting aberrations before they emerge as conscious thought.
edict_thought_enforcement_gestalt_effect:
Encryption: +1
Stability: -5
Upkeep from £ Jobs: -10%
Telepath Drones provide -30 Deviancy
edict_synaptic_reinforcement_desc: By increasing the synaptic links of our maintenance drones, their ability to provide for nearby drones is improved.
edict_synaptic_reinforcement_tooltip: Synaptic Nodes gain 1 [maintenance_drone.GetName] job but their upkeep is increased by £ +2.
edict_industrial_maintenance_desc: Industrial maintenance drones are empowered to act as caretakers for the areas surrounding each district.
edict_industrial_maintenance_tooltip: Industrial Districts gain 1 [maintenance_drone.GetName] job but their upkeep is increased by £ +2.
asset_bureaucrat_desc: A disgruntled bureaucrat that has been lured into our service through false promises of a better life.
asset_clerk_desc: A common clerk unhappy with their job, eager for a little excitement in their life.
asset_economist_desc: An economist that accepted a bribe and is now kept in line through blackmail.
asset_scientist_desc: Our appeals to this scientist's pride have convinced them that they are under-appreciated by their home empire.
asset_junior_officer_desc: A military officer that has been spurned by their superiors. We have given them the recognition they desire.
asset_criminal_underling_desc: A petty criminal disrespected by their peers. Our operatives have appealed to their sense of greed and self-importance.
asset_attache_desc: An unwitting pawn that works as a minor diplomatic functionary. They are all too willing to share information that they should not.
asset_laborer_desc: An overlooked and overworked member of society with a rebellious streak.
asset_hacker_desc: A skilled hacker that is wanted by their home empire. They work for us for pay and protection.
asset_arms_smuggler_desc: A criminal that specializes in the acquisition of military goods.
asset_agitator_desc: A naive optimist that believes they can change the world for the better. Very easy to control by appealing to their cause.
asset_newscaster_desc: A sympathetic voice in the media, willing to spread our message in exchange for information.
asset_pop_icon_desc: An entertainment figure that has used up their fifteen minutes of fame and is willing to do absolutely anything to return to the spotlight.
asset_academic_desc: A discredited scholar looking for a way to redeem their name.
asset_veteran_desc: An injured war veteran that was lost in the wheels of bureaucracy. We came to their aid.
asset_internal_organs_desc: Hands-on knowledge of the functioning of our adversaries' anatomy can be remarkably useful during all manner of espionage operations.
asset_synapse_drone_desc: Operatives can use this deviant synapse drone to receive thoughts from the hive.
asset_ephapse_relay_desc: This malformed ephapse relay can be used to alter messages received by the hive.
asset_labor_drone_desc: Alterations made to this worker drone allow our operatives to give it simple commands.
asset_research_drone_desc: Minor mutations have caused this research drone's connection to the hive mind to be less secure than usual.
asset_warrior_drone_desc: Our operatives have managed to find a means of giving this warrior drone commands which serve our goals.
asset_behavioral_regulator_desc: Part of the hive's defense systems, this object identifies deviant drones for destruction. Conveniently, this one has been subverted.
asset_pheromone_emitter_desc: This Pheromone Emitter affects the behavior of all nearby drones.
asset_resource_distribution_node_desc: The hive's allocation of resources is handled by a network of resource distribution nodes.
asset_cortex_node_desc: Acting as data storage for the hive, control of a cortex node can allow our operatives to steal or modify data.
asset_subspace_tendril_desc: These tendrils are used for communication with the hive's fleets across the galaxy.
asset_coordination_system_desc: This system acts as a layer between a planet's primary nodes and the [coordinator.GetName] drones for that area.
asset_engagement_protocol_desc: Communication with other intelligences is largely governed by this system.
asset_logistics_system_desc: Tracking of local resources is handled through the logistics system.
asset_research_database_desc: This database tracks both the progress and needs of the research facilities of a planet.
asset_war_algorithm_desc: This system contains battle plans and countless simulations of potential conflict within the local area.
asset_command_relay_desc: A compromised relay that forwards commands from other systems to drones within a given area.
asset_dispatch_uplink_desc: This uplink is intended to send orders across long distances between nodes.
asset_resource_pylon_desc: Resources are gathered at these pylons for distribution.
asset_memory_cache_desc: Local research is stored in these systems before being forwarded to the primary intelligence.
asset_weapons_platform_desc: Our operatives have exploited a vulnerability which allows them to take partial control of a defensive weapons emplacement.
operation.7000.desc: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.
ESPIONAGE_OPERATION:
Espionage Operation $NAME|H$
Target: $TARGET|Y$
Progress: $PROGRESS|Y%0$
Next Roll: £ $NEXT_ROLL|Y$
INFILTRATION_LEVEL_NEXT: We will reach the next Level in $DAYS|Y$ days.
INFILTRATION_LEVEL_DELAYED_BODY:
Infiltration Level determines what Operations this Spy Network can perform and may increase the Intel we have of this Empire.

As Infiltration Level increases, it takes your operatives longer to further expand the Spy Network.

Infiltration Level determines what Operations this Spy Network can perform and may increase the Intel we have of this Empire.

INFILTRATION_LEVEL_DELAYED_NO_DLC:
Infiltration Level determines what Operations this Spy Network can perform and may increase the Intel we have of this Empire.

As Infiltration Level increases, it takes your operatives longer to further expand the Spy Network.

Spy Networks have a Maximum Infiltration Level which is heavily modified by Relative Encryption and Civics.
ESPIONAGE_ASSET_STATIC_DESC: Assets are operatives that could prove useful for certain operations, and grant bonuses related to specific operation types. Assets can sometimes be sacrificed to cover your tracks, should an operation be exposed.
ESPIONAGE_NO_AVAILABLE_ASSET_STATIC_DESC:
No Asset
There are no available assets.

Assets are gained through the Acquire Asset operation, or through events.
RELATIVE_DECRYPTION_ENCRYPTION_STATIC_DE: Our Relative Encryption determines how difficult it is for us to break the codes of our target.
OPERATION_COST_TOOLTIP_STATIC:
Operation Cost
One-time cost to run this operation.
OPERATION_AUTO_LAUNCH_STATIC:
Commence When Ready
Once your operatives have completed their preparations, they will automatically commence the operation without waiting for confirmation.
CANT_REMOVE_LEADER_ACTIVE_OPERATION: Cannot assign or remove an Envoy during an ongoing Operation.
operation.8000.name: Following Up Leads
operation.8000.desc: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.
operation.8001.name: Potential Cells Identified
operation.8001.desc: A list of targets has been finalized and our operatives have been quietly drifting their way into position. They await our signal to begin establishing sleeper cells.
operation.8002.name: Sleeper Cells Established
operation.8002.desc.start: Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far:
operation.8002.desc.boring:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: our operatives have successfully concealed themselves in a variety of positions across [root.target.GetAdj] society, hiding in plain site and pretending to simply be ordinary citizens. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.materialist:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: an influx of mysterious, untraceable credits has allowed our operatives the financial clout - and falsified references - necessary to walk into mid-level positions in many of the leading [root.target.GetAdj] corporations. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.megacorp:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: an influx of mysterious, untraceable credits has allowed our operatives the financial clout - and falsified references - necessary to walk into several mid-level positions within the [root.target.GetAdj] megacorporation. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.spiritualist:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: though building up sufficient knowledge of [root.target.GetAdj] spirituality was a significant challenge, our operatives have been admitted within their priesthood - the most influential institution within the [root.target.GetGovernmentName]. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.authoritarian.imperi:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: after many false protestations of fealty - not to mention a plethora of faked background checks - our operatives have settled into bureaucratic positions within the governing structure of the royal family. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.authoritarian.non_im:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: after many false protestations of fealty - not to mention a plethora of faked background checks - our operatives have settled into bureaucratic positions within the governing structure of the ruling party. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.militarist:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: after considerable effort, and numerous carefully concealed falsifications, we have managed to plant a number of operatives in low-level officer positions within the [root.target.GetAdj] military. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.hive:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: using the latest pheromonal technologies, along with a hearty dose of nerve blockers, we have managed to create several 'blind spots' within the [root.target.GetGovernmentName]. There, we will be able to conceal operatives and begin subverting [root.target.GetAdj] [root.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.hive_on_hive:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: we have managed to subvert several thought routines within the [root.target.GetAdj] [root.target.GetGestaltEntityName] so that they covertly report to us while pretending to still function as normal. 

Using these, we will be able to keep up to date on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.machine:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: our expert hackers have opened a number of hidden backdoors in the [root.target.GetGovernmentName], successfully hiding them in obscure yet important segments of the [root.target.GetAdj] code that they rely upon to function. 

Using these, we will be able to keep up to date on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.machine_on_machine:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: our subversive subroutines have opened a number of hidden backdoors in the [root.target.GetGovernmentName], successfully hiding them in obscure yet important segments of the [root.target.GetAdj] code that they rely upon to function. 

Using these, we will be able to keep up to date on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.end: From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt: Using these, we will be able to keep up to date on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
operation.8002.b: We can go even further than this.
sleeper_cell_operation_success_desc: We have planted sleeper cells that keep us up to date with the latest affairs and stand ready to do our bidding at a moment's notice.
operation_sleeper_cells_dont_stack_this: £  We have already established sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They will last until [Root.sleeper_cell_success]
envoy_events.200.name: Lobbyists
envoy_events.200.desc:
A cacophony of voices may be heard in the Galactic Community - not all of them friendly, and certainly not all of them aligning with [Root.GetAdj] interests. Unfortunately, it seems that emissary [event_envoy.GetName] has been listening to the wrong voices. Eyebrows were raised when [event_envoy.GetSheHe] attended several conferences hosted by the [Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]. Now it has emerged that a large sum of credits traceable to that organization were transferred to [event_envoy.GetHerHim].

[event_envoy.GetName]'s colleagues demand that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] be recalled, citing trust issues. However, some of our more devious advisors suggest that we could strike a deal to keep [event_envoy.GetHerHim] in place in return for a share of the pot.
envoy_events.200.A: What could be the harm in it?
beholden_to_special_interests_desc: Our envoys are as likely to enrich themselves with funds from lobbyist groups as they are to actually do our bidding.
galcom_movement_xenophobe: Movement for Sane and Prudent Relations between Species
galcom_movement_materialist: Organization for the Facilitation of Trickle-Down Economics
envoy_events.205.name: Missteps from an Ambassador
envoy_events.205.desc:
The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].

The [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.
envoy_events.205.A.xenophobe: Alien sensibilities do not matter to us.
gestalts_are_boring: The [This.GetName] lacks enough personality to become involved in scandals
saturated_with_scandals:
£ The [Root.Target.GetName] have been saturated with scandals.
We may try again after [Root.operation_diplomatic_incident_timer]
envoy_events.225.name: A Salacious Affair
envoy_events.225.desc:
The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess with [scandal_empire.GetAdj] law enforcement. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] [event_envoy.GetIsAre] currently in connection with a salacious affair involving an astonishing range of serious crimes that culminated in a brutal double murder.

As matters stand - and with rumors running wild among the [scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there seems little doubt as to [event_envoy.GetName]'s guilt. The [scandal_empire.GetAdj] authorities have requested that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] diplomatic immunity be lifted so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face justice for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] deeds.
envoy_events.225.A.tooltip: [event_envoy.GetName] is removed from our Recruitable Leaders.
envoy_events.230.name: [Root.GetName] Arrested
envoy_events.230.desc: Upon entering the [Root.envoy_location_country.GetName], Ambassador [Root.GetName] was arrested on numerous charges of wrongdoing. The [Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj] missive was brief: "we thank you for returning the criminal to us, so that justice may be served."
operation.8200.name: Seeking Targets
operation.8200.desc: Our operatives are investigating key diplomatic actors within the [Root.Target.GetName], searching for hooks which we may be able to exploit.
operation.8205.name: Digging for Dirt
operation.8205.desc: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome.
operation.8210.name: Update: Operation [This.GetName]
operation.8210.desc: A suitable target for Operation [This.GetName] has been identified, and an extensive dossier has been drawn up. Our operatives wait on our word to trigger the scandal.
operation.8210.desc.no_go: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] bring ill tidings: they were not able to find a suitable target for Operation [This.GetName]. Apparently the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] is sufficiently scandal-torn that any dirt we discovered on them would hardly have raised a stir.
operation.8225.name: Squeaky Clean
operation.8225.desc: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] bring ill tidings: despite extensive preparation, their apparently promising target did not fall for the bait, and they were unable to manufacture a scandal. Incredible as it may seem, it appears that there simply aren't any bad apples within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps at the moment.
operation.8230.name: A Scandal of our Making
operation.8230.desc.base: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success:
operation.8230.desc.salacious_affair: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: in a bold move, we were able to frame one of their envoys to the [offended_party.GetName] for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment and strained their relations with the [offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
operation.8230.desc.salacious_affair_sel: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: in a bold feint, we were able to frame one of their envoys to our own empire for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment, exaggerated in no small part by the offense we have pretended to take. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
operation.8230.desc.insulting_envoy: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with the [offended_party.GetName]. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and accidentally publicly revealed their true thoughts - which proved to be deliciously unsavory - about their counterparts. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
operation.8230.desc.insulting_envoy_self: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with our own empire. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and was tricked into publicly revealing some deliciously unsavory, private thoughts about our own diplomats. [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
operation.8230.desc.galactic_comedy: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: by bringing to light some mortifying missteps by one of their envoys, we have managed to cause the them considerable embarrassment. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
operation.8230.desc.lobbying: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: we were able to spark a lobbying scandal. All that was needed was an anonymous tip-off detailing exactly how much one of their envoys to the Galactic Community was being paid to represent the [Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists] - an organization diametrically opposed to [Root.Target.GetAdj] interests. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
operation.8230.desc.elope:
Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: it turned out that one of their envoys had fallen in love with a xeno - a grave offense among their kind. With some gentle persuasion - and our help with evading [Root.Target.GetAdj] security forces - we were able to persuade them to elope with their partner and seek refuge in a more tolerant society.

This incident has brought uncomfortable questions to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] in a difficult diplomatic situation.
operation.8230.desc.wayward:
Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: with some gentle persuasion - and clever use of recording equipment - we were able to expose just how far one of their envoys had drifted from [Root.Target.GetAdj] norms on their assignment.

This incident has brought uncomfortable questions to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps in a difficult situation.
operation.8230.desc.substances: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: the matter was resolved by bringing to light one of their envoys' substance abuse, which had allowed malevolent drug lords undue influence over their decisions. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.
diplo_incident_succeeded: The credibility of the [Root.Target.GetName]'s diplomatic corps lies in tatters.
envoy_events.210.name: Gone Native
envoy_events.210.desc.start: [event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native.
envoy_events.210.desc.end: These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.authoritarian:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, favorably contrasting the liberties enjoyed there with the rigidity and lack of freedom within the [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"I can well see the appeal of delegating government to the People," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say. "In fact, I could scarcely imagine a better system myself."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.egalitarian:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, complaining frequently at the relative indecision of our [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"If lesser liberty is the price of an efficient government, then perhaps that is a price worth paying," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.xenophile:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Bizarrely, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] taken to agreeing with [envoy_country.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, calling for measures to prevent alleged xeno exploitation of [Root.GetAdj] hospitality. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] responded that, having seen the benefits of a more orderly society in [envoy_country.Capital.GetName], returning to the chaos and lawlessness of [Root.Capital.GetName] would be difficult indeed.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.xenophobe:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] been caught satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] carnal lusts by participating in orgies with a multitude of [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] commented:
"How could I possibly resist the beautiful [envoy_country.GetSpeciesAdj] [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]?"

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.materialist:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] disturbingly taken in by [envoy_country.GetAdj] spirituality, eschewing [Root.GetAdj] skepticism in such matters. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] protested:
"How can I doubt divine truth when all has become clear to me?"

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.spiritualist:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] almost scornful of our people's attitude to divine matters, increasingly voicing sympathy to the [envoy_country.GetAdj] outlook on matters ranging from the accumulation of personal wealth to the permissibility of unshackled AIs. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We have for too long lived in the past, here in the [Root.GetName]. It is time we embrace the future."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.pacifist:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] pacifism, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become a remarkably strident advocate for greater military spending and a more proactive foreign policy, openly praising [envoy_country.GetAdj] militarism.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.210.desc.militarist:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. In recent months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become increasingly critical of [Root.GetAdj] militarism, praising the "more virtuous" [envoy_country.GetAdj] existence. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We cannot remain the savage barbarians of the galaxy forever. We must temper our instincts if more civilized peoples are ever to respect us."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
envoy_events.215.name: Substance Abuse
envoy_events.215.desc:
Our ambassador corps has for some time been concerned at the performance of [event_envoy.GetName], one of our officials to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]. Now, evidence has come to light that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] appear[event_envoy.GetSXX] to have fallen prey to an alien substance from the [provider_country.GetName] that has proven extremely addictive to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Although the trade in this substance is highly illegal among the [provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a lucrative black market run by cutthroat drug lords has sprung up. These drug lords, who apparently managed to introduce it to [event_envoy.GetHerHim] as a potent aphrodisiac, now exert a considerable degree of influence over [event_envoy.GetName], who is forced to do their bidding in return for satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] cravings.
envoy_events.215.A.tooltip: [event_envoy.GetName] is replaced with immediate effect. However, it will prove impossible to cover up this stain on our diplomatic corps.

joins_overlord_wars_desc: This Term dictates whether the Subject is obligated to join wars the Overlord is directly involved in.
joins_overlord_wars_none_desc: The Subject is not obligated to join the Overlord in any of their wars.
joins_overlord_wars_defensive_desc: The Subject will join the Overlord in their defensive wars.
joins_overlord_wars_offensive_desc: The Subject will join the Overlord in their offensive wars.
joins_overlord_wars_all_desc: The Subject will join the Overlord in all their wars.
joins_subject_wars_desc: This Term dictates whether the Overlord is obligated to join wars that the Subject is directly involved in.
joins_subject_wars_none_desc: The Overlord is not obligated to join the Subject in any of their wars.
joins_subject_wars_defensive_desc: The Overlord will join the Subject in their defensive wars.
joins_subject_wars_offensive_desc: The Overlord will join the Subject in their offensive wars.
joins_subject_wars_all_desc: The Overlord will join the Subject in all their wars.
subject_integration_desc: This Term dictates whether the Overlord can integrate the Subject into their own empire.
subject_can_be_integrated_desc: The Overlord can integrate the Subject into their empire.
subject_can_not_be_integrated_desc: The Overlord cannot integrate the Subject into their empire.
subject_holdings_limit_desc: This Term dictates how many Holdings the Overlord can have in total across the Subject's planets.
subject_holdings_limit_0_desc: The Overlord cannot have Holdings on any of the Subject's planets.
subject_holdings_limit_1_desc: The Overlord can have 1 Holding in total across the Subject's planets.
subject_holdings_limit_2_desc: The Overlord can have 2 Holdings in total across the Subject's planets.
subject_holdings_limit_3_desc: The Overlord can have 3 Holdings in total across the Subject's planets.
subject_holdings_limit_4_desc: The Overlord can have 4 Holdings in total across the Subject's planets.
subject_diplomacy_desc: This Term dictates how much diplomatic freedom is given to the Subject, and whether they are allowed to vote freely from their Overlord.
subject_can_do_diplomacy_desc: The Subject is free to engage in most diplomacy with other Empires and vote independently.
subject_can_do_diplomacy_but_not_vote_de:
The Subject is free to engage in most diplomacy, but must follow their Overlord's votes in Federations and the Galactic Community.

This will force the Subject to join any Federation that the Overlord is a member of.

If the Overlord is a member of the Galactic Community, the Subject will be forced to join it.
subject_can_not_do_diplomacy_desc: The Subject may not engage in diplomacy with other Empires, nor vote independently.
subject_expand_desc: This Term dictates whether the Subject can expand their empire freely, in a regulated manner, or if they are prohibited from expansion altogether.
subject_cannot_expand_desc: The Subject may not expand their Empire.
subject_can_expand_with_tithe_desc: The Subject may expand their Empire, but must pay an £ $concept_influence$ tithe to the Overlord when they build an Outpost.
subject_can_expand_desc: The Subject is free to expand their Empire.
subject_sensors_desc: This Term dictates whether the Subject receives any sensor data from their Overlord.
subject_gets_sensors_desc: The Subject receives sensor data from the Overlord.
subject_does_not_get_sensors_desc: The Subject does not receive any sensor data from the Overlord.
no_access_extra_subject: $SUBJECT|Y$ does not get open borders from $OVERLORD|Y$

specialist_bulwark_desc: The Subject will specialize in defensive capabilities, in exchange for weaker resource production.

specialist_scholarium_desc: The Subject will specialize in research, in exchange for weaker military capabilities.
specialist_scholarium_summary: £ Scholaria specialize in research, in exchange for weaker military capabilities.
specialist_prospectorium_desc: The Subject will specialize in mining and strategic resources, in exchange for weaker research production.
specialist_prospectorium_summary: £ Prospectoria specialize in mining and strategic resources, in exchange for weaker research production.
preset_vassal_oppressive_desc: A Vassal is a Subject type with an open subject agreement and several available options for both the Subject and the Overlord.
preset_vassal_oppressive_flavor_desc: A vassal is a subject of another empire, often with little to no self-rule. Having signed a pact with a foreign power, they are often at the whims and mercy of their overlord, forced to bend to whatever rules and regulations their liege wishes. For some weakened empires, this is the final stopgap before they are consolidated properly into the fold, as they are signing away their autonomy bit by bit.

HOLDINGS_DESC_corporate: A ['concept_branch_office'] can be established by ['authority:auth_corporate'] empires to enable Corporate Holdings.
HOLDINGS_DESC_subject_holding: ['concept_overlord_holding'] can only be built by Overlords on Subject planets if agreed upon in their ['concept_subject_agreement'].
BUILDING_SLOT_OPEN_AGREEMENTS_HOLDINGS_D: A Holding can be constructed by the Overlord on one of the Subject's planets.

OVERLORD_HOLDING_CONSTRUCTION_DESC: Our Overlord $OVERLORD|Y$ has finished building a $HOLDING|Y$ on our planet $PLANET|Y$.
holding_garrison_desc: A garrison established to oversee the local enforcers, occasionally reinforced by military battalions in more dire circumstances.
holding_garrison_armies_desc: Every Overlord army on this planet gives an additional -10% [Root.CrimeOrDeviancy], +0.5 £ Monthly Loyalty and -5% Happiness, to a maximum of -30% [Root.CrimeOrDeviancy], (an additional) +1.5 $r_loyalty$ and -15% Happiness.
holding_orbital_assembly_complex_desc: A soaring building filled with long assembly lines, creating everything one could dream of.
holding_orbital_assembly_complex_effect: Increases the effects of modules on the planet's Orbital Ring.
holding_propaganda_office_desc: A ministry overseeing local faiths, news, and political interest groups. With the right prod everything runs a tad smoother.
holding_satellite_campus_desc: A large campus where domestic researchers and foreign scientists can come together to share ideas and conduct experiments.
holding_emporium_desc: Large shopping malls filled with futuristic and exotic wares from distant planets.
holding_aid_agency_desc: Agencies founded and staffed by foreign benefactors, bringing some of their culture and knowledge to the planet.
holding_energy_requisitorium_desc: A ministry overseeing taxation and the minting of energy credits, often coming into conflict with the domestic bureaucracy.
holding_material_requisitorium_desc: A ministry overseeing local mineral production, extraction, and purification. They often secure the best land purchases and reap the benefits for their patron.
holding_produce_requisitorium_desc: A ministry overseeing local produce. In addition to placing a small tax on this world, some products have a tendency to disappear into their convoluted, bureaucratic process.
job_energy_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.EnergyProducerWithIcon] produce -3 £ $concept_energy$ for the Subject and 4 $r_energy$ for the Overlord.
job_minerals_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.MineralsProducerWithIcon] produce -2 £ $concept_minerals$ for the Subject and 3 $r_minerals$ for the Overlord.
job_alloy_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.AlloysProducerWithIcon] produce -1 £ $concept_alloys$ for the Subject and 2 $r_alloys$ for the Overlord, with an increase in [Root.AlloysProducerResources] upkeep for the Subject.
job_food_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.FoodProducerWithIcon] produce -3 £ $concept_food$ for the Subject and 4 $r_food$ for the Overlord.
job_consumer_goods_requisitioned_effect_: [Root.ConsumerGoodsProducerWithIcon] produces -3 £ Supplies for the Subject and 4 $r_consumer_goods$ for the Overlord with an increase in £ $concept_minerals$ upkeep for the Subject.
blocker_tied_to_splinter_hive: £ This blocker will remain as long as the Splinter Hive Holding exists.
no_free_district_for_splinter_hive: £ No free district on this planet for our expansive spawning complex.
holding_splinter_hive_desc: A large biomass producing new workers for the hive. Though it stands apart from the original hive, it is still connected to the neural network.
holding_distributed_processing_desc: A cold structure eclipsing the local region. Those who work here refuse to elaborate on what they do, but no-one leaves the experience entirely unscathed.
holding_offspring_nest_desc: At this nest, a foreign hivemind has a unique representative acting as a centralized node for its neural network. This has enabled its continued control over the colony.
holding_offworld_foundry_desc: Large foundries owned by a foreign empire, siphoning off local resources for the creation of high quality alloys.
holding_overlord_vigil_command_desc: A command center specialized in - and delegated to - calculating the best possible means of increasing defensive measures.
holding_parasitic_algorithms_desc: A ministry overseeing local research and science, bringing the most noteworthy breakthroughs and discoveries back to their benefactor.
holding_parasitic_algorithms_effect_desc: [Root.ResearchProducerWithIcon] turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into £ £ £ Research for the Overlord.
holding_noble_vacation_homes_desc: A home away from home, this is the perfect place for the Overlord's ruling elite to let off steam, so that they don't cause incidents back home.
holding_noble_vacation_homes_effect: Each Noble Chateaus grants +2 £ Stability in the Overlord's capital.
holding_dread_outpost_desc: The Dread Outpost is an arcane structure that produces unholy reanimated armies while sending back insidious data to this planet's Overlord.
holding_communal_housing_outreach_desc: Everyone is entitled to a home, which is why the Overlord has extended their Communal Housing Project to this planet. This serves as a great forum for teaching the inhabitants the value of egalitarianism.
holding_idyllic_bloom_desc: Hyper-advanced terraforming techniques mastered by the Overlord are housed in this structure. After being introduced to the planet, it will take a decade to finish its world-changing work.
holding_idyllic_bloom_effect: Will finish terraforming 10 years after construction.
holding_reemployment_center_desc: Never leave a resource unexploited, even if that resource is the Subject's dead. With the Reemployment Center, the Overlord can ensure that the Subject's planets are always filled with employees even though the quality of work might vary.
holding_reemployment_center_effect: 100 new £ Zombie Pops will be reanimated on [Planet.reemployment_center_timer]
holding_recruitment_office_desc: Everyone must do their part. That is why the Overlord is offering military training in exchange for a tour in their fleet. Service guarantees citizenship.
MESSAGE_OVERLORD_RECRUIT_DESC: After finishing their tour of duty, the [moving_pop.GetSpeciesNamePlural] joining us have decided to stay on $PLANET|Y$. Our subject is not pleased, but they cannot decide over our citizens.
holding_park_ranger_lodge_desc: The Overlord has an interest in co-existing with nature and wishes to spread this joy to its Vassal. To ensure that there always is at least some nature left to enjoy.
no_free_district_for_ranger_lodge: £ No untouched nature remains on this planet for us to protect.
blocker_tied_to_ranger_lodge: £ This blocker will remain as long as the Ranger Lodge Holding exists.
no_ranger_lodge_wilderness: £ Untouched nature is already abundant on Wilderness worlds.
holding_tree_of_life_sapling_desc: The Overlord has existed with their Tree of Life for so long that they can no longer imagine life without it. Now, they want to share the same opportunity with their vassals.
no_tree_of_life_sapling_wilderness: £ The Wilderness' environment is hostile to alien saplings.
holding_franchise_headquarters_desc: These offices allow Corporate Management to realign the Subsidiary's interests with that of their Overlord through mandatory planet-wide training and team-building exercises.
holding_franchise_headquarters_effect: [trader.GetIcon] [trader.GetNamePlural] produce -2 £ Trade for the Subject and produce 1 £ $concept_unity$ for the Overlord.
holding_franchise_headquarters_ethics_ef: If the Overlord has Fanatic Ethics, provides +100% Ethics Attraction for that Ethos.
holding_experimental_crater_desc: A designated area for testing new asteroidal colony ships. It might not be the most convenient way to test the ships, but outsourcing the process definitely saves on the clean-up costs for the Overlord.
MESSAGE_OVERLORD_CRATER_DESC: A Colony Asteroid from our Overlord has crashed into $PLANET|Y$. It will take months to repair the planet.
holding_organic_sanctuary_desc: Although the care facilities on this planet are more limited in scope than those found on the Overlord's worlds, the bio-trophies inside still enjoy a much more comfortable standard of living than they are used to.
no_organic_sanctuary_wilderness: £ The Wilderness is unfit for long-term habitation by Bio-Trophies.
holding_sacrificial_shrine_desc: The great study of the cycle should not be limited to the Overlord; the turning of life and death must be explored through the Vassal as well.
d_spawning_complex_blocker_desc: A large hulking biomass, alive and pulsating as it is slowly producing new workers for the hive.
d_prospectorium_strip_mine_desc: An expertly built mining complex, making efficient use of the local resources.
d_nature_preserve_blocker_desc: A section of natural beauty decreed by the Overlord to never be tampered with.
d_buried_lithoids_overlord_desc: The crew of our Overlord's latest "test-flight" is lying dormant after their successful crash landing into [Root.GetName]. If unearthed, they might be persuaded to join us.

specialist_bulwark_neighbor_desc: Being in close proximity to imposing Bulwark specialists creates safety and stability.
specialist_scholarium_neighbor_desc: Regular visits by scholars from the neighboring Scholarium specialists improve job efficiency and research output.
specialist_prospectorium_neighbor_desc: Readily available materials from the nearby Prospectorium specialist eliminates inefficiencies in construction.
divided_patronage_desc: Our Overlord's attention is divided among too many subjects.
feudal_lord_desc: The feudal Overlord affords the subject agency over their realm, in exchange for their loyalty.
corporate_franchise_desc: The branding and market information supplied by the Corporate Overlord is well worth every credit paid.
overlord_ethics_compatibility_desc: Our Overlord's ethics compared to our own.
newly_released_sector_loyalty_desc: Our gratitude to our founding Empire is still fresh in our minds.
newly_subjugated_loyalty_desc: Anger from being forced into servitude has not yet been forgotten.
overlord_grateful_vassal_modifier_desc: The Subject appreciates the recent actions taken by the Overlord for their benefit.
overlord_ungrateful_vassal_modifier_desc: Though expectations were low, the Overlord has nevertheless managed to disappoint. Somehow.

job_overlord_propagandist_desc: Propagandists working for the local ministry are experts at infiltrating and defusing situations among the locals.
job_overlord_propagandist_drone_desc: Diplomatically equipped drones who are experts at defusing rebellious thoughts and ideas.
job_overlord_propagandist_effect_desc: £ Overlord Propagandists turn Subject £ $concept_unity$ into £ $concept_influence$ for the Overlord.
job_overlord_propagandist_drone_effect_d: £ Overlord Propagandists turn Subject £ $concept_unity$ into £ $concept_influence$ for the Overlord.
job_overlord_academic_desc: Academics who work with specialists from several empires, conducting particular experiments and research that can benefit them all.
job_overlord_academic_drone_desc: Specifically equipped drones who utilize resources from several empires to conduct unique experiments and research.
job_overlord_academic_effect_desc: £ Overlord Academics turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into £ £ £ Research for both Overlord and Subject.
job_overlord_academic_drone_effect_desc: £ Overlord Academics turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into £ £ £ Research for both Overlord and Subject.
job_overlord_trader_desc: Traders who specialize in selling foreign goods at the local domestic market.
job_overlord_trader_drone_desc: A distribution drone which specializes in redistributing foreign goods among its peers for maximum efficiency.
job_overlord_trader_effect_desc: £ Overlord Traders transfer Subject £ $concept_energy$ to the Overlord in exchange for £ Amenities.
job_overlord_trader_drone_effect_desc: £ Distribution Drones transfers Subject £ $concept_energy$ to the Overlord in exchange for £ Amenities.

job_aid_worker_effect_desc: £ Aid Workers produces £ Amenities for the Subject and £ $concept_unity$ for the Overlord.

job_overlord_breeder_desc: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet. It's also a fairly well paid job.
job_overlord_breeder_drone_desc: Feeding the newborn drones is an important part of ensuring the young spawn can grow correctly, quickly, and effectively.

job_mind_thrall_desc: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.
job_mind_thrall_drone_desc: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.
job_mind_thrall_effect_desc: £ Mind Thralls produce £ £ £ Research for Overlord.
job_mind_thrall_drone_effect_desc: £ Mind Thralls produce £ £ £ Research for Overlord.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_desc: It is a prestigious responsibility to keep the Offspring safe and comfortable, even if the role often involves merely gathering food for it.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_dron: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_effe: £ Offspring Drone Feeder use £ $concept_food$ (or £ $concept_minerals$) provide access to $offspring_defense_plural$ and an increase in £ [GetWorker] Pop Resource Output.

job_overlord_metallurgist_desc: Workers manufacture complex goods via operation of heavy machinery.

job_overlord_fabricator_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these fabricators to work within the construction facilities.

job_overlord_alloy_producer_catalytic_ef: [foundry.GetIcon] Overlord [Root.AlloysProducer] turn Subject £ $concept_food$ into £ $concept_alloys$ for the Overlord.
job_overlord_beholder_desc: Military overseers working with a larger network of command centers to calculate the best possible defense routes for their contractor.
job_overlord_beholder_drone_desc: Military drones working within a larger synaptic network to calculate the best possible means of defense.
job_overlord_beholder_effect_desc: £ Overlord Beholders raise the Defense Platform limit for the Overlord at the cost of Subject £ $concept_alloys$.
job_overlord_necromancer_desc: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.
job_overlord_necromancer_drone_desc: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.
job_overlord_necromancer_effect_desc: £ Overlord Necromancers provide the subject with Undead Defense Armies while granting the Overlord £ £ Research.
job_overlord_reassigner_desc: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.
job_overlord_reassigner_drone_desc: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.
job_overlord_reassigner_effect_desc: £ Overlord Reassigners provide the subject with £ Zombie Pops.
job_overlord_recruiter_desc: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.
job_overlord_recruiter_drone_desc: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.
job_overlord_recruiter_effect_desc: [soldier.GetIcon] Overlord Recruiters provide the subject with £ Defense Armies with a chance of joining our empire after their tour of duty is complete.
job_overlord_ranger_desc: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.
job_overlord_ranger_drone_desc: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.
job_overlord_ranger_effect_desc: £ Overlord Rangers provide a £ Consumer Goods Upkeep reduction while providing the Overlord with £ Unity.
job_overlord_arborist_desc: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.
job_overlord_arborist_drone_desc: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.
job_overlord_bio_trophy_desc: Worried that we might lack for anything or even be hurt, our Overlord has provided a lucky few with the opportunity to experience what they call "mandatory pampering."
job_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_desc: The drones our Overlord directed to this structure are told to "relax" and "enjoy themselves." The Overlord may not fully understand the nature of a drone, but at least the sensations are novel.
job_overlord_bio_trophy_effect_desc: £ Overlord Bio-Trophies provide a £ Happiness increase and cost no upkeep for the Subject while providing the Overlord and the Subject with £ Unity.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_desc: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, but our way forward is by accepting them. Only those who are willing will be asked to make the ultimate sacrifice.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_drone_desc: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, yet we are to be a part of them. A few of our drones have been designated to join what the Overlord calls 'a study of life', one which concludes with their willing sacrifice.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_effect_desc: [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] Overlord Mortal Initiates produce £ Unity, £ Amenities and £ Research for the Subject. Overlord Mortal Initiate can be used for Sacrifices.
job_overlord_manager_desc: Middle managers that optimize the behavior of the local white-collar workers to synergize with the Overlord's long-term corporate trajectory.
job_overlord_manager_effect_desc: £ Overlord Managers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Trade for the Subject, and £ Unity for the Overlord.

specialist.900.desc: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out what might have happened.
specialist.900.desc.gestalt: We have picked up some readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. We should send some [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to look into whatever might be transmitting a signal.
