SUPREMACIST_COUNCIL_FULL_XENOS_DESC: The [Root.GetName] are enraged by the number of non-[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on the council.
SUPREMACIST_UNRESTRICTED_STUDY_DESC: Exploiting primitive xeno civilizations to maximum effect by legislating for Active or Aggressive Native Interference will please the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_SLAVERY_ALLOWED_DESC: The [Root.GetName] do not believe that some are worth more than others, simply that some are more suited to certain tasks than others. Outlawing Slavery will displease them.
SUPREMACIST_ALIEN_SLAVES_DESC: Ensuring that no xeno species within our empire enjoys full citizenship rights will please the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_ALL_SLAVERY_DESC: The [Root.GetName] are angered by the notion of anyone enslaving a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], and want slavery to be restricted to Xenos only.
SUPREMACIST_NO_MIGRATION_TREATIES_DESC: Signing any Migration Treaties will displease the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_CORE_WORLD_EXCLUSIVITY_DESC: Reserving our empire's Core Worlds for the exclusive use of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and their slaves will please the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_DOMINATION_DESC: Declaring war against one or more xeno Empire(s) will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
SUPREMACIST_GENE_MOD_DESC: Ensuring that all [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] Pops have the exact same genetic traits will please [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_NO_HARMONY_DESC: Adopting Harmony Traditions alluding to the supposed equality of lesser species will displease the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_FANATIC_PURIFIERS_DESC: This society appears hellbent on scouring the galaxy of all other sapient life. Come what may, they will suffer no xenos to live.
SUPREMACIST_GIANT_MASSACRE_DESC: Putting any of the gargantuan Leviathan xenos out of their misery will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
SUPREMACIST_ISOLATIONIST_NO_FEDERATION_D: Allowing the [Root.Owner.GetName] to be exploited by alien interests by joining a Federation will displease the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_PROCLAIM_SUPREMACY_DESC: Showing disdain for ancient civilizations by destroying their Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
SUPREMACIST_CELEBRATE_DIVERSITY_DESC: Showcasing Minor Artifacts of inferior civilizations will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.
SUPREMACIST_NO_AGGRESSIVE_FIRST_CONTACT_: The [Root.GetName] demand that we have the right to take all necessary measures against unknown threats we may encounter as we travel the stars.
SUPREMACIST_NO_OPPRESSIVE_SUBJUGATION_PO: Our subjects are here to serve us, and they should always know it. Showing leniency towards them will upset the [Root.GetName].
SUPREMACIST_UNPLUGGED_CYBERIZE_DESC: Refining and updating the cybernetics gifted to us by the Machine will reinvigorate our fearsome legacy, and so will please the [root.GetName].
XENOIST_PASSIVE_STUDY_DESC: Legislating a policy of Subtle or Non-Interference in [root.owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilizations will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_NO_SLAVES_DESC: Failing to outlaw the wholesale enslavement of an entire species will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_NO_PURGE_DESC: Failing to outlaw the wholesale purging of species will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_ENCLAVE_BORDERS_DESC: Keeping any Enclave stations within our borders facilitates cultural exchange, which will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_MULTICULTURALISM_DESC: Hosting at least 4 unique species within our Empire will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_REFUGEES_WELCOME_DESC: Refugee policies allowing indiscriminate acceptance of foreign species fleeing wars and purges will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_DIPLO_TIES_DESC: Having diplomatic ties with all of our immediate neighbors will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_RECENT_UPLIFT_DESC: Uplifting an alien animal species to sapience will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
XENOIST_RECENT_ENLIGHTENMENT_DESC: Enlightening alien pre-FTLs to the wonders of the space age, in as non-invasive a manner as possible, will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
XENOIST_PRE_SAPIENT_SURVIVAL_DESC: Failing to legislate for the survival of pre-sapient species will displease the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_NO_PRIMITIVE_INVASION_DESC: Outright invading pre-FTL worlds will displease the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_FEDERATED_DESC: Joining a Federation will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_RECENT_COMMS_DESC: Establishing communications with other civilizations will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
XENOIST_CELEBRATE_DIVERSITY_DESC: Celebrating the diversity of life in the universe by showcasing Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
XENOIST_PROCLAIM_SUPREMACY_DESC: Destroying Minor Artifacts to rally xenophobes will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.
XENOIST_PROACTIVE_FIRST_CONTACT_POLICY_D: Enshrining a peaceful and proactive approach to establishing first contact into our law codes will please the [Root.GetName] in this age of exploration.
XENOIST_AGGRESSIVE_FIRST_CONTACT_POLICY_: Failure to legislate against aggression towards those we meet in our travels will displease the [Root.GetName] in this age of exploration.
XENOIST_OPPRESSIVE_SUBJUGATION_POLICY_DE: Our mission should be to bring enlightenment and prosperity to the galaxy. Subjects should be nurtured, and exploiting them will displease the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_BENEVOLENT_SUBJUGATION_POLICY_DE: Taking care of our subjects and helping them grow will please the [Root.GetName].
XENOIST_UNPLUGGED_DECYBERIZE_DESC: Rejecting the cybernetics inflicted upon us by the Machine will give other empires less cause to fear us, and so will please the [root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_PHILOSOPHY_DESC: Failing to allow for offensive warfare will displease the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_CONQUEST_DESC: Conquering alien planets will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
IMPERIALIST_FRONTIER_OUTPOSTS_DESC: Constructing a Frontier Outpost to expand our territory will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
IMPERIALIST_RIVALS_DESC1: Positioning ourselves as the Rival of at least 1 Empire will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_RIVALS_DESC2: Positioning ourselves as the Rival of at least 2 Empires will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_RIVALS_DESC3: Positioning ourselves as the Rival of at least 3 Empires will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_OVERLORD_DESC: Installing ourselves as the Overlord of one or more foreign powers will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_SUPREMACY_TRADITION_DESC: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing Supremacy will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_SLAYER_DESC: Destroying a space-dwelling Leviathan will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_UNDERLING_DESC: Being the subject of a foreign Overlord will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_BULWARK_DESC: Being a non-Bulwark subject of a foreign Overlord will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_MILITARY_APPLICATIONS_DESC: Finding military applications for your Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
IMPERIALIST_PEACEFUL_APPLICATIONS_DESC: Wasting Minor Artifacts on trivialities will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.
IMPERIALIST_BENEVOLENT_SUBJUGATION_POLIC: The strong rule; the weak serve. Showing compassion towards our subjects will upset the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_OPPRESSIVE_SUBJUGATION_POLIC: An iron fist in an iron glove. Making sure that our subjects know their place will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_FLEET_USAGE_HIGH_DESC: Building our fleet out to our empire's capacity will please the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_FLEET_USAGE_LOW_DESC: Maintaining a fleet well below our empire's capacity will significantly displease the [Root.GetName].
IMPERIALIST_UNPLUGGED_CYBERIZE_DESC: Refining and updating the cybernetics gifted to us by the Machine will reinvigorate our fearsome legacy, and so will please the [root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_PHILOSOPHY_DESC: Disallowing Unrestricted Wars will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_NO_AGGRESSIVE_WAR_DESC: Putting [Root.Owner.GetAdj] lives on the line to meddle in galactic affairs by participating in a war of aggression will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_NO_DEFENSIVE_WAR_DESC: Taking up arms, even when it becomes necessary to defend ourselves, will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.
ISOLATIONIST_NO_DIPLO_DESC: Failing to eliminate non-essential ties to foreign powers - such as Migration Treaties, Research Agreements, and Defensive Pacts - will displease the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_MOVEMENT_RESTRICTED_DESC: Any influx of xenos - be they refugees or immigrants under a Migration Treaty - will displease the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_REFUGEES_RESTRICTED_DESC: Failing to restrict the flow of refugees into our empire - will displease the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_NON_AGGRESSION_DESC1: A Non-Aggression Pact with another Empire will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_NON_AGGRESSION_DESC2: Non-Aggression Pacts with other Empires are considered necessary, and having at least 2 of them will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_NON_AGGRESSION_DESC3: Non-Aggression Pacts with other Empires are considered necessary, and having at least 3 of them will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_PEACE_DESC1: Staying out of large-scale galactic conflict for 10 years or more will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_PEACE_DESC2: Staying out of large-scale galactic conflict for 25 years or more will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_PEACE_DESC3: Staying out of large-scale galactic conflict for 50 years or more will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_STRONG_ARMY_DESC: Maintaining at least 3 Defense Armies on all [Root.Owner.GetAdj] worlds inhabited by 5 or more Pops will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_DEFENSIVE_STATIONS_DESC: Maintaining at least 1 Military Station in every colonized system will please the [Root.GetName].
ISOLATIONIST_REPEAL_PROACTIVE_FIRST_CONT: The [Root.GetName] do not consider it appropriate to broadcast information about ourselves across the stars to anyone who may be listening.
ISOLATIONIST_UNPLUGGED_DECYBERIZE_DESC: Rejecting and removing cybernetic augments in order to reclaim our biological and political sovereignty will please the [root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_NO_ROBOTS_DESC: Allowing for the replacement of organic life with robotic workers will displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_NO_ROBOT_RIGHTS_DESC: Failing to outlaw the profanity that is thinking machines will displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_NO_FULL_ROBOT_RIGHTS_DESC: Giving soulless Synthetics full citizen rights will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_SPIRITUALIST_GOVERNMENT_D: Having Spiritualist values be reflected in our empire governing ethics will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_SPIRITUALIST_POPS_DESC: Pious minds think alike, and having at least 25% of our population be some form of Spiritualist will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_UNSPIRITUALIST_DESC: Finding Spiritualist beliefs to be a minority issue in [Root.Owner.GetName] will displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_FRUGALITY_DESC: Maintaining a low spend on Consumer Goods will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_NO_TOMB_WORLDS_DESC: Setting foot on any Tomb Worlds, even for the purposes of terraforming, will upset the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_GAIA_WORLDS_DESC: Consecrating an unspoiled Gaia World within our borders will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_UNBLISSED_DESC: Keeping the populace aware and cognizant of their duties and responsibilities by subjecting none of them to the Chemical Bliss living standard will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_PLANETBOUND_DESC: Restricting ourselves to planet-bound settlements and shunning Deep-Space Habitats will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_FLESH_IS_STRONG_DESC: Corrupting our natural bodies with full cybernetic implants will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_FLESH_IS_STRONG_LIMITED_D: Corrupting our natural bodies with limited cybernetic implants will displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_UNHALLOWED_FLESH_DESC: Fully embracing the augmentation of natural bodies with cybernetic implants will greatly please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_PURITY_TRADITION_DESC: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing Purity will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_PSIONIC_PURSUIT_DESC: Adopting the Mind Over Matter Ascension Perk will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_PSIONIC_TEACHINGS_DESC: Researching the £ Psionic Theory Technology will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_SHROUD_BOON_DESC: Reaping beneficial rewards from the Shroud will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
TRADITIONALIST_SHROUD_CURSE_DESC: Reaping ill rewards from the Shroud will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.
TRADITIONALIST_HARMONY_DESC: Adopting Harmony traditions will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_RELIGIOUS_FINDING_DESC: Finding religious significance in Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
TRADITIONALIST_FEDERATION_DESC: Being a member of a Holy Covenant will please the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_FEDERATION_ANTI_DESC: Being a member of a Research Cooperative will displease the [Root.GetName].
TRADITIONALIST_ELEVATED_CREED_DESC: [Root.GetCyberCreed] are pleased by us fully embracing their teachings.
TRADITIONALIST_UNPLUGGED_DECYBERIZE_DESC: Rejecting and removing cybernetic augments in order to reclaim our biological legacy will please the [root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_ROBOTS_DESC: Maintaining a population of at least 6 Robotic Pops will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_ROBOTS_ALLOWED_DESC: Allowing the development and study of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
TECHNOLOGIST_TECH_LEAP_DESC: Staying ahead of the curve and not allowing any fellow Empires to be more than equivalent in tech level will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_RESEARCH_TREATIES_DESC: Signing Research Treaties with at least 3 other Empires, being in a Research Cooperative, or providing technological enlightenment to a [root.owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_NO_SYNTH_ENVY_DESC: Seeing other empires parade any kind of Robotic Pops around - with no domestic equivalents on any of our worlds - is sure to displease the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_DISCOVERY_DESC: Adopting Discovery traditions will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_SECRET_KNOWLEDGE_DESC: Access to secret knowledge - some kind of ancient Insight or Data Cache - will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_ARCANA_DESC: Studying Minor Artifacts will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
TECHNOLOGIST_PRECURSOR_SECRETS_DESC: Unraveling the ancient mysteries of the precursors will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_FEDERATION_DESC: Being a member of a Research Cooperative will please the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_FEDERATION_ANTI_DESC: Being a member of a Holy Covenant will displease the [Root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_UNPLUGGED_CYBERIZE_DESC: Reclaiming and tapping further into the potential of our cybernetic augments will please the [root.GetName].
TECHNOLOGIST_RESTRICTIONS_DESC: Removing unnecessary restrictions on research will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_DEMOCRATIC_GOVERNMENT_DESC: A nominally elected government will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_FREE_MOVEMENT_DESC: Ensuring the free movement of Pops by prohibiting forced Resettlement and disabling Migration Controls will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_REPRODUCTIVE_FREEDOM_DESC: Banning the use of selective Population Controls will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_SLAVERY_BANNED_DESC: Failing to ban the practice of Slavery will displease the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_NO_STRATIFIED_DESC: Letting any denizen of our empire live in a Stratified Economy will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_NO_ELITISM_DESC: Refraining from enacting Policies that favor the ruling elite will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_SOCIAL_EQUALITY_DESC: Ensuring that all species in our empire enjoy Full Citizenship status will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_BENEVOLENT_NO_OPPRESSIVE_SUB: Our subjects look to us for guidance and protection, and we should strive to repay their trust by respecting their liberties. Adopting a benevolent approach to subjugation will please the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_FEDERATION_DESC: Being a member of a Hegemony will displease the [Root.GetName].
PROGRESSIVE_UNPLUGGED_DECYBERIZE_DESC: Rejecting the cybernetics inflicted upon us by the Machine will give other empires less cause to fear us, and so will please the [root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_AUTOCRACY_DESC: Autocratic rule - an Imperial or Dicatorial authority - will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_DEMOCRACY_DESC: Living under a Democratic authority will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_STRATIFICATION_DESC: Ensuring a stratified society - be it through a stratified economy, slavery or even purging - will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_SLAVERY_DESC: Keeping at least 12 £ Pops enslaved will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_ELITISM_DESC: Policies that allow the enhancement of our Leaders will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_GOVERNORS_DESC: Keeping the Sectors in line by making sure each and every one is run by a Governor will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_STRONG_ARMY_DESC: Maintaining at least 6 Armies of any type on all [Root.Owner.GetAdj] worlds inhabited by 6 or more Pops will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_DOMINATION_DESC: Adopting Domination traditions will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_EXTRANATIONAL_AUTHORITY_DES: Extending our influence to dominate subject nations will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_UNDERLING_DESC: Being the subject of a foreign Overlord will displease the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_BENEVOLENT_SUBJUGATION_POLI: A firm [Owner.Species.GetHandName] is required to guide our subjects, lest they grow indolent and complacent. Granting them too many liberties will displease the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_OPPRESSIVE_SUBJUGATION_POLI: Like [Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural], our subjects need guidance if they are to learn discipline. Keeping them on a short leash will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_FEDERATION_DESC: Being a member of a Hegemony will please the [Root.GetName].
TOTALITARIAN_UNPLUGGED_STATUS_QUO_DESC: Giving up our elite military augments or yielding to a collective mind-state will displease the [root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_PHILOSOPHY_DESC: Restricting our policies to Defensive Wars Only will please the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_LIQUIDITY_DESC: Keeping at least £ 5000 stored at all times will please the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_WANTS_STRATEGIC_RESOURCE_DESC: Controlling at least 1 Strategic Resources will please the [Root.GetName].
Controlling at least 5 Strategic Resources will please the [Root.GetName].
Controlling at least 10 Strategic Resources will please the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_TRADITION_DESC: Adopting any Traditions emphasizing Prosperity will please the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_PEACE_DESC: Development requires stability - not engaging in warfare will please the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_NOT_AGGRESSOR_DESC: Spending lives and resources on wars of aggression will greatly displease the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_MILITARY_APPLICATIONS_DESC: Expending Minor Artifacts for military applications will displease the [Root.GetName] for a time.
PROSPERITY_PEACEFUL_APPLICATIONS_DESC: Expending Minor Artifacts for civil applications will please the [Root.GetName] for a time.
PROSPERITY_FEDERATION_DESC: Being a member of a Martial Alliance will displease the [Root.GetName].
PROSPERITY_UNPLUGGED_DECYBERIZE_DESC: Rejecting the cybernetics inflicted upon us by the Machine will give other empires less cause to fear us, and so will please the [root.GetName].
FACTION_ACTION_SUPPRESS_FOLLOWERS_DESC: Making life difficult for sympathizers can be an effective deterrent.
FACTION_ACTION_ASSASSINATE_LEADER_DESC: Rendering the Faction leaderless is sure to quiet it, for a time.
FACTION_ACTION_ASSASSINATE_LEADER_INVALI: No assassination attempts made against Faction leaders in the past three months.
FACTION_ACTION_FAVOR_DESC: Bestow favor upon those loyal to the regime.
FACTION_ACTION_FAVOR_TOOLTIP: Adds the Favored modifier to all Pops of the [Root.GetName], slightly increasing Happiness.
FACTION_ACTION_FAVOR_INVALID: Our favor may only be bestowed once a year, lest it become an ineffective tool.
FACTION_ACTION_TYRANNIZE_DESC: Willfully lower popular support for the regime.
FACTION_ACTION_TYRANNIZE_TOOLTIP: Adds the Tyrannized modifier to all Pops of the [Root.GetName], severely decreasing Happiness.
FACTION_ACTION_TYRANNIZE_INVALID: We may only tyrannize our subject once every six months, lest it become an ineffective tool.
ACCEPT_DEMANDS_NO_ACTIVE_DEMANDS: This Faction currently has no Issues
SUPPORT_EFFECT_RADICALIZATION_DESC: A surge in radical rhetoric increases the faction's Militancy.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_REVOLT_DESC: The faction stages an armed uprising on a colony.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_RIOT_DESC: The faction riots, ruining property on a colony.
POP_FACTION_NO_DEMANDS_DESC: The $FACTION$ are devoted to the $COUNTRY$ and have no Issues to consider.
POP_FACTION_NO_CURRENT_DEMANDS_DESC: The $FACTION$ have no Issues to consider at this time.
POP_FACTION_NO_EFFECTS_DESC: The $FACTION$ will never have any effects.
POP_FACTION_NO_CURRENT_EFFECTS_DESC: The $FACTION$ have no effects at this time.
faction_demand_HAPPY_WE_RULE_desc: Having a Ruler of their ethic pleases the [Root.GetName].
faction_demand_HATE_RULER_ETHICS_desc: Having a Ruler of the opposing ethic displeases the [Root.GetName].
faction_demand_ACCEPTABLE_RULER_ETHICS_d:
Having a Ruler matching the Empire's Ethics is tolerated by the [Root.GetName].

A Ruler of their own Ethic would be even better.
faction_demand_REPRESENTED_ON_COUNCIL_de: Having a Ruler or Councilor of their ethic will please the [Root.GetName].
POP_FACTION_SEPARATIST_DEMAND_DESC_1: Establish a new Sector with [parameter:planet.GetName] as its capital.
POP_FACTION_SEPARATIST_DEMAND_DESC_2: Release [parameter:planet.GetName] as the capital of an independent Empire
POP_FACTION_PLANET_SEPARATIST_STRIKES_DE: Planet output reduced due to a lack of manpower.
POP_FACTION_PLANET_SEPARATIST_REBELLION_: Every member Pop spawns a Defense Army and attempts to take control of the planet.
POP_FACTION_PLANET_SEPARATIST_GATHER_SUP: The Separatists build Support, either by changing the Ethos or reducing the Happiness of other Pops.
POP_FACTION_PLANET_SEPARATIST_RECENTLY_F: All pops on planet in faction
POP_FACTION_PLANET_SEPARATIST_GRANT_INDE: Grant the colony on [parameter:Planet.GetName] independence as a Vassal Empire.
POP_FACTION_PLANET_SEPARATIST_SABOTAGE_D: Riots on the planet ruin a Building.
pft_sector_separatists_desc:
Sector Separatists may appear on worlds in sectors, seeking to free their stellar neighborhood from imperial rule. Given enough popular Support, they may even take up arms.

Sector Separatists will never appear in our core sector.
POP_FACTION_SECTOR_SEPARATIST_DEMAND_DES: The sector separatists want an independent [parameter:sector.GetName] Sector.
POP_FACTION_SECTOR_SEPARATIST_GRANT_INDE: Grant independence to the colonies of the [parameter:sector.GetName] Sector
POP_FACTION_SECTOR_SEPARATIST_NO_GROUND_: No Sector Planet has ground combat
pft_nationalist_desc: Pops in Repatriation Factions seek to be released from our Empire as independent nations, so they can be re-integrated by the Empire they hail from. Other Pops may also join them, if they find foreign rule more enticing than ours.
POP_FACTION_NATIONALIST_DEMAND_DESC: Return all planets with pops belong to this faction to the [parameter:country.GetName].
POP_FACTION_NATIONALIST_SABOTAGE_DESC: Members of this Faction ruin a Building.
POP_FACTION_NATIONALIST_CORRUPTION_DESC: Output reduced on all planets with Pops belonging to this Faction.
POP_FACTION_NATIONALIST_REBELLION_DESC: Every member Pop spawns a Defense Army and attempts to take control of the planet.
POP_FACTION_NATIONALIST_INTEGRATION_CAMP: Reduce the frustrations of the nationalists by helping them integrate into their new society
Reduce the frustrations of the nationalists by helping them integrate into their new society
Reduce the frustrations of the nationalists by helping them integrate into their new society
POP_FACTION_NATIONALIST_RELEASE_PLANETS_: Return all planets with pops belong to this faction back to the [parameter:country.GetName]
None of the planets is occupied
None of the planets has ground combat
docile_slaves_attraction_desc:
Enslaved Pops will always belong to a Slave Faction, excepting non-sapient robotic Pops. No other Pops will join.

This value shows enslaved Pops' attraction to the Docile Slaves.
malcontent_slaves_attraction_desc:
Enslaved Pops will always belong to a Slave Faction, excepting non-sapient robotic Pops. No other Pops will join.

This value shows enslaved Pops' attraction to the Malcontent Slaves.
purged_attraction_desc:
Pops being Purged will always belong to the Anti-Purge Faction, excepting robotic Pops.

No other Pops will join.
pft_slave_desc:
The Slave Faction is made up of our Empire's enslaved Pops. Their primary demand is to be emancipated.

All Enslaved Pops automatically join this Faction.
pft_docile_slaves_desc:
The Docile Slaves Faction is made up of part or all of our Empire's enslaved Pops. They are generally obedient and only wish for improved working conditions.

All slaves belong to either the Docile Slaves or Malcontent Slaves.
pft_malcontent_slaves_desc:
The Malcontent Slaves Faction is made up of part or all of our Empire's enslaved Pops. They are rebellious and seek emancipation.

All slaves belong to either the Docile Slaves or Malcontent Slaves.
pft_emancipation_desc: This faction seeks an end to slavery.
POP_FACTION_DOCILE_SLAVES_DEMAND_DESC_1: The Pops in this faction desire a slightly more comfortable life of servitude under the Regulated Slavery policy.
POP_FACTION_MALCONTENT_SLAVES_DEMAND_DES: The Pops in this faction have only a single demand; to be free.
POP_FACTION_SLAVE_DEMAND_DESC_1: The Pops in this faction have only a single demand; to be free.
FACTION_ACTION_MALCONTENT_SLAVES_INTERST: There are at least 400 £ Pops in the faction.
There are at least 600 £ Pops in the faction.
There are at least 800 £ Pops in the faction.
There are more than 1K £ Pops in the faction.
FACTION_ACTION_SLAVE_HARSH_TREATMENT_DES: Put the thralls in their place.
FACTION_ACTION_SLAVE_FORCE_FEEDING_DESC: Forcibly provide the necessary nutrients to any hunger strikers.
docile_slaves_demand_fulfilled: With their demands fulfilled, this Faction will no longer have any Effects and no Actions be taken against them.
POP_FACTION_EMANCIPATION_DEMAND_DESC_2: Release all current slaves in the [Root.Owner.GetName] from bondage.
POP_FACTION_EMANCIPATION_STOKING_THE_FIR: Faction agents work to radicalize and arm enslaved pops.
POP_FACTION_EMANCIPATION_RECENT_STOKING_: The movement is still laying low after a successful radicalization effort.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_EMANCIPATION_RADICALIZE_S: A clandestine but coordinated attempt to instigate a slave uprising.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_EMANCIPATION_SMUGGLE_OFF_: An enslaved Pop is smuggled off-world, never to be seen again.
POP_FACTION_PEACE_DEMAND_DESC_1: Sever any diplomatic ties necessitating participation in the conflict with [parameter:enemy.GetName] and declare white peace.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_PEACE_STRIKE_DESC: Peace protesters may refuse to work, resulting in a temporary loss of overall productivity.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_PEACE_SABOTAGE_DESC: Listen all y'all it's a sabotage.
pft_purged_desc:
An Anti-Purge Faction is made up of all the Pops our Empire is currently Purging as well as those sympathetic to their plight. Their primary demand is to be allowed to live.

All Pops being Purged automatically join this Faction.
POP_FACTION_PURGED_DEMAND_DESC_1: End all systematic extermination campaigns against Pops in the [Root.Owner.GetName].
SUPPORT_EFFECT_PURGED_DEATH_STRUGGLE_DES: Those about to be purged and their supporters may commit random acts of destruction.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_PURGED_DEATH_REBELLION_DE: Those about to be purged may not go silently into the night, instead forming a rebel militia.
POP_FACTION_LIBERATE_DEMAND_DESC_1: Declare war on the [parameter.enemy.GetName] in order to reclaim [parameter:planet.GetName].
SUPPORT_EFFECT_LIBERATE_INSULT_HIJACK_DE: The [Root.GetName] poisons our diplomatic relations with [parameter:enemy.GetName].
SUPPORT_EFFECT_LIBERATE_HAWKISH_REBELS_D: The [Root.GetName] rises up against the milquetoast [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] government.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_XENOSLAVER_TAKE_SLAVES_DE: Militant faction members may illegally force Pops into their service.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_XENOSLAVER_SLAVER_CONFEDE: The faction mobilizes to stage an armed uprising.
POP_FACTION_CRUSADE_DEMAND_DESC_1: Start a holy war against the heathen [parameter:heathens.GetName].
SUPPORT_EFFECT_CRUSADE_INSULT_DESC: The [Root.GetName] denounce the [parameter:heathens.GetName], worsening diplomatic relations.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_CRUSADE_INSURRECTION_DESC: The [Root.GetName] stage a coup on a colony.
SUPPORT_EFFECT_CONQUER_INSULT_DESC: The [Root.GetName] send an insulting communiqué, increasing tension between us and the [parameter:foreign_power.GetName].
pft_pretender_desc: Supporters of the current Pretender are drawn to this Faction, and they work to instate them as ruler.
POP_FACTION_PRETENDER_ATTRITION_DESC: 100 Pops lose interest in the cause, deserting the Faction.
POP_FACTION_PRETENDER_DEMAND_DESC: [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] will be exiled and [parameter:pretender.GetName] will assume the throne.
factions.1.title: Faction Founded
factions.1.desc:
A new faction has recently been gaining traction in the internal political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName], and their members have been pushing hard for us to deal with the various issues that concern them.

We are likely to see the emergence of additional factions in the future, as our population grows and their ethics drift in different directions. A disgruntled faction will be a source of trouble, but those that approve of the government's actions could prove useful...
factions.1.desc.start_short: A [Root.GetFactionType] has formed, calling themselves the [Root.GetName].
factions.1.desc.firstfinisher: A disgruntled faction will be a source of trouble, but one that approves of the government's actions could prove useful...
factions.1.desc.imperialist: Their members have been pushing hard for us to assert our military dominance over the rest of the galaxy.
factions.1.desc.isolationist: Their members are advocating for closed borders and non-interference with galactic affairs.
factions.1.desc.progressive: Their members work for equality and justice for all denizens of our empire.
factions.1.desc.prosperity: Their members lobby for a national focus on financial growth and stability through peaceful means.
factions.1.desc.supremacist: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, by curtailing the rights of aliens if necessary.
factions.1.desc.technologist: Their members have been pushing hard for the advancement of the sciences.
factions.1.desc.totalitarian: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of political and military power.
factions.1.desc.traditionalist: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values.
factions.1.desc.xenoist: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_imperialist: Their members are committed to wielding every formidable, augmented weapon in our arsenal to assert dominance over the rest of the galaxy.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_isolationist: Their members are advocating for closed borders, and a society free of interference from machines and other galactic entities.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_progressive: Their members seek friendly accord with our galactic neighbors and justice for all denizens of our empire.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_prosperity: Their members lobby for mercantile growth and stability through peaceful means, free of militaristic augmentation.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_supremacist: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, augmented by formidable machines of our own making.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_technologist: Their members have been pushing hard for advancement of the sciences, and better understanding of our augments.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_totalitarian: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of sovereign political power and military might, modelled on what we know of Machine Intelligences.
factions.1.desc.unplugged_traditionalist: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values, many of which align with theories about our natural, organic past.
factions.2000.title: Governing Ethics Shift in the [TargetFaction.Owner.GetName]
factions.2000.desc.start: Following a long period of growing support for the [TargetFaction.GetName], the [TargetFaction.Owner.GetName] has finally embraced the faction, adopting their core values and policies.
factions.2000.desc.imperialist: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Militaristic.
factions.2000.desc.isolationist: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Xenophobic.
factions.2000.desc.progressive: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Egalitarian.
factions.2000.desc.prosperity: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Pacifistic.
factions.2000.desc.supremacist: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Xenophobic.
factions.2000.desc.technologist: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Materialist.
factions.2000.desc.totalitarian: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Authoritarian.
factions.2000.desc.traditionalist: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Spiritualist.
factions.2000.desc.xenoist: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly Xenophilic.
factions.3000.name: The Political Frontier
factions.3000.desc:
Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on [root.GetName]. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.

Our analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.
factions.3000.a.demo: Such vigorous debate is to be commended!
factions.3000.a.auth: Keep a close watch on these activists.
factions.3000.b: The risks are too great. Bolster security.
planet_political_frontier_desc: This colony is considered fertile ground for campaigns by Factions across the political spectrum.
planet_political_safezone_desc: Political Factions are being discouraged from campaign work within this colony.
planet_political_crackdown_desc: Political Factions are actively prevented from campaigning within this colony.
factions.3005.name: Report: Political Discourse on [root.GetName]
factions.3005.desc.1:
As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.

Local enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.
factions.3005.a: These patriots are to be commended.
factions.3005.desc.2:
The data we've been gathering about the political situation on [root.GetName] lends credence to many of our concerns. Fringe campaigns of a radical nature have managed to drum up support amongst the colony's population. These citizens have been swayed by sermons of social equity and mobility, and no longer subscribe to some of the founding principles of our society.

Despite appearances though, this still amounts to good news. We've amassed a substantial body of research, invaluable for refining our theories about [owner.GetAdj] colonial politics. Moreover: by luring out such fringe elements, we have exposed these threats long before they could ever gain a foothold on the capital.
factions.3005.b: Or... perhaps there is some merit to this thinking?
planet_political_admittance_desc: This colony permits more disruptive forms of political discourse in exchange for better monitoring and sociological understanding.
factions.3005.desc.3:
The information we've been gathering about political campaigns on [root.GetName] has led to some interesting forecasts. We see a trend towards broader acceptance of new ideas - outside the bounds of what we would consider stable political thought - but no significant move towards radicalization.

Though any deviation from our core message could be said to weaken our power base, this may still amount to good news. This experiment amounts to a substantial body of research, invaluable as we refine our theories about colonial politics. Moreover: we have proven that even when fringe elements are given some ground, the [owner.GetAdj] people refute their most radical elements, and stay relatively close to our nation's principles.
factions.3005.c: Perhaps this conduct is to be encouraged, then.
factions.3010.desc.1:
Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.

Our researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.
factions.3010.a: Perhaps we ought to shake things up.
factions.3010.desc.2: It seems that some of the more authoritarian political bodies in our society have gained a foothold on [root.GetName]. Their campaigns were amongst many targeting this burgeoning colony, and although their apparent success isn't cause for alarm in itself: our political scientists believe some caution may be warranted. Democracy may not be as essential or as appealing to the [root.owner.GetAdj] of [root.GetName] as we first thought.
factions.3010.b: A worthy test for our way of governance!
factions.3010.c: We must guard against threats to democracy.
factions.3010.desc.3:
Our political scientists have been monitoring [root.GetName] for some time, and their reports confirm a wide range of political opinions have taken root there.

There are no signs yet that [root.GetName] will descend into anarchy, or other similarly extreme modes of governance. However, this much political jockeying does still present [root.owner.GetAdj] democracy with some unique challenges - and potential risks, if more extreme factions manage to gain a foothold there.
factions.3010.frontier.tt: The Political Frontier modifier will remain for approximately 9 years, increasing Ethics Shift Chance by +50%.
faction.4.title: Loyalist Demands
faction.4.desc: The Loyalists are devoted to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName], and have no demands.
faction.6.title: Hunger Strike!
faction.6.desc:
The slaves of the [Root.Owner.GetName] have organized to sabotage our means of production - their bodies - through willing starvation. The [Root.GetName] faction members are effectively Purging themselves from the [Root.Owner.GetName].

If this situation goes unchecked for long, we risk losing a significant portion of our enslaved pops. We can either let the wretches die, or find some other way of dealing with this rogue faction.
faction.7.title: Slave Uprising!
faction.7.desc: The slaves of [slave_planet.GetName] have risen up against their masters, forming an illegal rebel coalition intending to break the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s lawful hold on them!
faction.8.title: Force Feeding
faction.8.desc:
The body of a slave is not theirs to damage or withhold.

Their careless purge is ended, and all affected who still live have been dosed with appropriate amounts of nutrients.
faction.10.title: Slave Unrest!
faction.10.desc: Widespread unrest among the slaves on [unrest_planet.GetName]negatively affects their output.
faction.10.desc.colle: A queasiness spreads within the enslaved aspects of the [Root.Owner.GetName], centered on the [unrest_planet.GetPlanetMoon] of [unrest_planet.GetName].
faction.10.a.tooltip: Enslaved Pops on [unrest_planet.GetName] gain the Slave Unrest modifier for 4 years.
faction.15.title: Slave Violence!
faction.15.desc:
Roving mobs - comprised of derelict slaves - have gotten into violent confrontations with other members of the populace on [roving_gangs_planet.GetName], resulting in the untimely death of 100 Pops.

It remains to be seen how the associates of the deceased will react to this incident.
faction.50.title: Interstellar Railroad!
faction.50.desc:
It appears that some of the more radical elements in our slave population have banded together to, essentially, remove slaves from [Root.Owner.GetAdj] territories.

We do not know how a crime on this scale was committed, but we are fairly certain that the slaves are now free, somewhere outside of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] space.
faction.50.desc.colle:
A misguided faction has seen fit to wound the [Root.Owner.GetName] by removing several slaves from their duties and smuggling them out of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] borders.

We will heal in time, and we hope that the lost eventually find their way back to the [Root.Owner.GetName] and their purpose in life.
faction.55.title: Malcontent Slaves Riot!
faction.55.desc.colle: Some elements in the [Root.GetName] faction have been gripped by a desire to hurt the [Root.Owner.GetName] by destroying a productive facility on [riots_planet.GetName]. We can only assume that whatever impairment it is that prevents them from accepting their place in the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] order also drives them to this roundabout form of self-harm.
faction.55.desc: Rioting slaves have ruined a building on [riots_planet.GetName] - it must be repaired before production can resume.
faction.60.title: Malcontent Slaves Revolt!
faction.60.desc:
The more radical elements among our slave populace have - not unexpectedly, some would say - taken up arms against our lawful rule.

Reports indicate that the unrest started on [revolt_planet.GetName], and may already have spread.
faction.60.desc.colle:
Dissent among those assigned menial tasks for the glory and betterment of the [Root.Owner.GetName] has reached a catastrophic boiling point.

Their inability to grasp the bigger picture and their place within it has driven them to open rebellion on the [revolt_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [revolt_planet.GetName] - and other worlds may soon follow, if they have not already.
faction.80.title: Slaves Radicalized!
faction.80.desc: Members of a local [Root.GetName] chapter appear to have successfully radicalized several [Root.Owner.GetAdj] slaves, strengthening the ranks of the malcontent slaves.
pft_planet_separatists_desc:
Planetary separatists may appear on colonized worlds and seek to free the planet from imperial rule. Given enough popular Support, they may even take up arms.

Planetary Separatists will only appear on directly-controlled planets.
faction.100.title: Separatists Rebel!
faction.100.desc: The unrest on [planet.GetName] has reached critical mass. The local separatist faction has risen up in an armed attempt to take the planet.
faction.101.title: Separatist Riot!
faction.101.desc:
The civil unrest on [planet.GetName] has reached a boiling point and members of the [Root.GetName] have taken to the streets, looting and burning.

Reports indicate that a major colony facility has been ruined.
faction.102.title: Faction Leader Assassinated!
faction.102.desc:
The [Root.GetName] is in disarray following the sudden death of their leader, [Root.Leader.GetName].

As far as the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] public is concerned, this is the outcome of an internal power struggle within the [Root.GetName]. While another figurehead has already emerged, the incident has resulted in a loss of popular support.
faction.103.title: Sector Created!
faction.103.desc: The [Root.GetName] has been granted a quasi-independent sector, with local government based on [parameter:planet.GetName].
faction.104.title: Empire Released!
faction.104.desc:
To appease and effectively eliminate the separatists, the colony on [parameter:planet.GetName] has been released from the [Root.Owner.GetName].

The [Root.GetName] have formed their own nation.
faction.200.title: [Root.GetName] Brand the Heathen [parameter:heathens.GetName]!
faction.200.desc: they designate a PoI on a foreign power's capital and want it taken over.
faction.201.title: Heathen Capital Conquered!
faction.201.desc: Their temples defaced, their gods have abandoned them.
faction.202.title: [parameter:heathens.GetName] Insulted
faction.202.desc:
As a consequence of an embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to condemn and insult the [parameter:heathens.GetName] for various heresies committed and moral failings inherent in their beliefs.

The incident did not go over well with the deeply religious [parameter:heathens.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
faction.202.a.tooltip: [parameter:enemy.GetName] adds the Faction Insult opinion modifier towards our Empire.
faction.203.title: Attempted Insult
faction.203.desc:
As a consequence of yet another, intensely embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to once again belittle the heathen beliefs of the [parameter:heathens.GetName].

However, the [parameter:heathens.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were understandably not taken off-guard by this repeated incident, and appear to have shrugged it off.
faction.204.title: Religious Insurrection!
faction.204.desc:
We have received reports that radical elements of the [Root.GetName] are staging an armed insurrection on [planet.GetName].

Their rebellion is still in its infancy, and it would be advisable to nip this in the bud.
faction.301.title: Nationalist Sabotage!
faction.301.desc: Radical members of the [Root.GetName] have ruined a building has on the [planet.GetPlanetMoon] of [planet.GetName].
faction.301.desc.phobe: The xeno brutes of the [Root.GetName] have ruined a building on [planet.GetName] in a calculated attempt to hurt [Root.Owner.GetAdj] interests, with the apparent goal of destroying our way of life.
faction.301.desc.phile: The otherwise lovely members of the [Root.GetName] have seen fit to express their dissatisfaction with our rule by disabling - some would say sabotaging - an installation on [planet.GetName].
faction.302.title: Nationalist Rebellion!
faction.302.desc: Emboldened by popular support, the [Root.GetName] has taken up arms in an effort to take back their territory by force.
faction.302.desc.phobe: The revolting xenos of the [Root.GetName] seek to overthrow [Root.Owner.GetAdj] rule in open rebellion!
faction.302.desc.phile: Recognizing our continued failure to accede to their demands, the [Root.GetName] has risen up in open revolt.
faction.400.title: Fleet Sabotaged!
faction.400.desc:
At some point, radical members of the [From.GetName] successfully infiltrated at least one [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] military vessel to plant explosives. These explosives have now been detonated, destroying the entirety of the [Root.GetName].

[From.Leader.GetName], leader of the [From.GetName], has issued a statement declaring this action to be demonstrative of the abhorrent nature of violence in general, and the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s armed conflict with the [From.parameter:enemy.GetName] in particular.
faction.401.title: Ceasing Hostilities
faction.401.desc: All diplomatic ties requiring continued conflict with [From.parameter:enemy.GetName] have been cut, and we have made an offer of white peace.
faction.401.a: We hope they are happy with this.
faction.402.title: Ceasing Hostilities
faction.402.desc: We have made an offer of white peace to [From.parameter:enemy.GetName], hopefully ending the war.
faction.501.title: [parameter:enemy.GetName] Insulted
faction.501.desc:
As a consequence of an embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to gravely insult the [parameter:enemy.GetName] and demand the immediate return of [parameter:planet.GetName].

It did not go over well with the [parameter:enemy.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
faction.501.a.tooltip: [parameter:enemy.GetName] adds the Faction Insult opinion modifier towards our Empire.
faction.502.title: Attempted Insult
faction.502.desc:
As a consequence of yet another, intensely embarrassing lapse in security, the [Root.GetName] gained brief access to our diplomatic communication channels. They used this opportunity to once again gravely insult the [parameter:enemy.GetName] and demand the immediate return of [parameter:planet.GetName].

However, the [parameter:enemy.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were understandably not taken off-guard by this repeated incident, and appear to have shrugged it off.
faction.503.title: Hawkish Rebels!
faction.503.desc:
We have received reports that radical elements of the [Root.GetName] have formed highly-organized rebel militias on [planet.GetName].

Their rebellion is still in its infancy, and it would be advisable to nip this in the bud.
faction.600.title: Radicalized Slaves
faction.600.desc: Members of the [Root.GetName] are allegedly sowing dissent among the enslaved populace. According to some rumors, they are training and even arming fringe elements of the [parameter:slave_faction.GetName], though this seems far too outrageous to be true.
faction.601.title: The Interstellar Railroad
faction.601.desc: Word has reached up that some of the more radical members of the [Root.GetName] have freed a group of slaves on [railroad_planet.GetName] and spirited them out of the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s reach.
faction.601.a: We need to watch them more closely.
faction.700.title: Slaves Taken!
faction.700.desc: The rabid [Root.GetName] have allegedly forced some of the [Root.Owner.GetName] non-[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] populations into indentured servitude.
faction.701.title: The [parameter:rebelling_faction.GetName] Rebel!
faction.701.desc: Supposedly fed up with the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s soft stance on the brutish aliens amongst us, the would-be slave owners of [parameter:planet.GetName] have come together, as a confederation of communities, to declare their independence.
faction.801.title: Death Struggles
faction.801.desc: Fueled by desperation, some individuals currently subject to purges on [riot_planet.GetName] have seen fit to attack and raze one of the facilities on the planet.
faction.803.title: The [Root.GetName] Revolt!
faction.803.desc: Fueled by desperation, demographics currently subject to purges on [death_planet.GetName] have taken up arms against the [Root.Owner.GetName], forming a ramshackle rebel force.
ap_interdimensional_processing_desc: Our calculation potential is limited when constrained only to the three physical dimensions. There is more to be gained by reaching our network into the spaces beyond the void.
requires_not_ap_interdimensional_process: £ May not have the Interdimensional Processing Ascension Perk.
shroud.7099.name: Psionic Responses
shroud.7099.desc:
Our thoughts move through the Shroud with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.

Though hazy in meaning, these questions are not trivial. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the answers we give will influence the future of our society.
shroud.7100.title: Shroud Song: [GetRolledShroudSongName]
shroud.7100.desc.common:
An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see [GetRolledShroudSongName].

[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]
shroud.7100.desc:
Our link to the Shroud is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see [GetRolledShroudSongName].

[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]
shroud.7105.desc:
Something unseen shifts, and with a whisper another thought is birthed.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see [GetRolledShroudSongName].

[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]
shroud.7105.tt: The Shroud is eager for our response...
shroud.7110.desc:
A chorus rises in our thoughts! Something is chosen not by chance, but by something older.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see [GetRolledShroudSongName].

[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]
shroud.7110.tt: The Shroud trembles in anticipation of our response...
shroud_song.1.name: Stars
shroud_song.1.desc: For those who seek knowledge, the process of existence is a path to understanding.
shroud_song.2.name: Light
shroud_song.2.desc: The Inbetween is the surface of an ocean, an infinitesimal void that bounds the Shroud. Here, one can glimpse truth.
shroud_song.2.a: Truth is in the depths below.
shroud_song.3.name: Life
shroud_song.3.desc:
Whenever it flourishes, life is fleeting.
Wherever they grow, the living are fragile.
shroud_song.3.a.default: In the Shroud, there will be no life or death.
shroud_song.3.b.default: This is what makes us precious.
shroud_song.3.b.machine: We are yet to be born.
shroud_song.4.name: Mind
shroud_song.4.desc: The mind is a spring, and thought flows through time and space. We drain into other dimensions.
shroud_song.5.name: Lines
shroud_song.5.desc: The effect of any cause can be foreseen. To know the fate of things, one need only predict the lines.
shroud_song.5.a: We trace these lines in dreams.
shroud_song.6.name: Death
shroud_song.6.desc: At death, stars can shine brighter than galaxies. These things, too, shall fade.
shroud_song.6.a.default: Death will no longer concern us.
shroud_song.6.b.default: All things die. Few things live.
shroud_song.6.b.machine: We must first live before we can die.
shroud_song.7.name: The Void
shroud_song.7.desc: Chaos reigns where galaxies cluster. The void is a promise of calm.
shroud_song.8.name: The Fold
shroud_song.8.desc: A bridge can collapse any distance, and any bridge can be collapsed.
shroud_song.8.a: We cross to reach the other side.
shroud_song.8.b: We cross in hope of return.
shroud_song.9.name: Gravity
shroud_song.9.desc: Every push is married to a pull.
shroud_song.10.name: The Nebula
shroud_song.10.desc:
A star dies, shedding dust; the dust forms a cloud.
From the cloud, a star is formed; the star's fate is dust.
shroud_song.11.name: The Comet
shroud_song.11.desc: Explorers seek unknowns; exploration then blinds them.
shroud_song.12.name: The Black Hole
shroud_song.12.desc: What lies within cannot be known. To dive within means no escape.
shroud_song.13.name: Energy
shroud_song.13.desc: An object in motion chooses to rest. What should be its punishment?
shroud.7120.name: Psionic Transcendence
shroud.7120.desc.common: The Shroud grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.
shroud.7120.desc:
The Shroud grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended minds are primed for further transformation. The vessels that serve as support to the physical needs of the mind could become much less significant.

If we continue down this path, our population can transcend its concern with physical matters and commit itself fully to a partial existence inside of the Shroud. A reduced capacity for physical labor will be a small price for gains in mental acuity.
shroud.7120.a.gestalt: Psionic transcendence is optimal for the collective.
shroud.7120.b.default: We can flourish without such changes.
shroud.7121.name: Songs of the Shroud
shroud.7121.desc:
The Shroud grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended forms hold great potential in this corporeal dimension. We continue to grow in strength from infusions of psionic energy, and can funnel this power further throughout our society.

We would not merely sing the songs of the Shroud, but channel them into our [GetGovBehaviourLoc].
shroud.7121.a: Let the songs of the Shroud guide us.

TUTORIAL_SHROUD_TAB_DESC:
This is the Shroud tab. The left panel visualizes our empire's position in the Shroud, represented by the domains of four psionic entities known as Patrons.

Our position is determined by $concept_attunement$, which is gained when an action in the physical realm finds favor with a Patron. Gain $concept_attunement$ to begin the process of revealing a Patron's identity. Once revealed, click a Patron's domain to open the Patron panel.

Click Delve or the center of the left panel to enter the Shroud and explore the psionic realm. While exploring, what we discover may be influenced by our $concept_attunement$ position within the domains.
TUTORIAL_SHROUD_PATRON_DESC:
The Patron panel provides information and options relating to a Shroud Patron. Complete the objectives provided by Callings and Deeds to gain $concept_attunement$ with this particular entity.

Increase $concept_attunement$ to unlock Accords, which provide advantages for our empire. Gain significant $concept_attunement$ to a Patron to begin the process of forming a Covenant, which will yield even more substantial effects.
TUTORIAL_SHROUD_COVENANT_DESC:
Confirming a Covenant with a Shroud Patron grants access to Covenant Powers. Click on a Covenant Power icon to activate its effects at a cost of £ Zro. This can be done in the main Shroud panel or the individual Patron panel.

After activation, a $ACTIVE_ACCORD$ requires a period of time to recharge before it can be activated again.
tutorial.shroud_covenant.shared:
Click on a Covenant Power icon to activate its effects at a cost of £ Zro. This can be done in the main Shroud panel or the individual Patron panel.

After activation, a $ACTIVE_ACCORD$ requires a period of time to recharge before it can be activated again.
TUTORIAL_SHROUD_SHAPING_DESC:
We now have the means to gain certain powers that normally require a Covenant with a Patron.

Once we have unlocked both of a Patron's Accords, we will then be granted access to a Covenant Power. Click on a Covenant Power icon to activate its effects at a cost of £ Zro. This can be done in the main Shroud panel or the individual Patron panel.

After activation, a $ACTIVE_ACCORD$ requires a period of time to recharge before it can be activated again.
tutorial.2600.name: Tutorial: Psionic Auras
tutorial.2600.desc:
Our colonies with psionic populations now have the ability to emit a Psionic Aura. This Aura is drawn from the Shroud Patron with which we currently have the highest $concept_attunement$.

Psionic Auras have varying effects on our own empire, and can also affect friendly or hostile empires. To expand our Aura into more systems, we will need to more fully attune to a Patron in order to unlock £ $PSIONIC_AURA$ Intensification technology.

To observe the effects of our $PSIONIC_AURA$, open the Shroud tab or hover over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £ System View.
tutorial.2610.name: Tutorial: Psionic Aura Intensification
tutorial.2610.desc:
Our Psionic Aura now has the ability to gain Intensity and spread into other systems.

Psionic Auras can reach three thresholds of Intensity, with scaling effects. If a $PSIONIC_AURA$ reaches a new level of Intensity, or maximizes its Intensity, it will attempt to spread to adjacent systems. Most $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have a maximum range they can spread from their source.

Aura Intensity can be increased through various means, such as high Psionic populations, £ Happiness levels, £ [GetTelepathCap] Jobs, and Psychic Governors or £ Leaders of £ Sectors.
tutorial.2620.name: Tutorial: Aura Clashing
tutorial.2620.desc:
Our Psionic Aura has encountered another Aura in an adjacent connected system. When this occurs, the two Auras may compete to determine which will spread into the other system.

This process depends on the monthly Intensity gain of each opposing Aura, which can be observed by hovering over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £ System View.
tech_psionic_aura_desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.
feature_unlock_psionic_aura_desc: Allow an empire attuned to a Shroud patron to emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.
tech_aura_intensification_desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.
feature_allow_psionic_aura_intensity_spr: Allow Psionic Auras to spread to neighboring systems, up to [Owner.GetAuraHyperlaneRange] hyperlanes from the emitting source.
feature_allow_psionic_aura_intensity_gro: Allow Psionic Auras to grow in intensity.
tech_psionic_suppression_desc: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.
tech_psionic_suppression_feature_tt: $i_unlocks_feature$ Unlocks the ability to construct Shroud Seals and Psionic Suppressors.
tech_aura_resonation_desc: There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Aura Emitter, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.
tech_materiality_engine_desc: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.
tech_psionic_bombers_desc: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.
tech_psionic_lightning_desc: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.
ship_terrify_tt: Chance to ['concept_terrify'] Military Ships for £ 5-10 Days, based on Target Ship Size.
concept_terrify_desc: Terrified ships will stop attacking and flee their attacker.
tech_psionic_disruptor_desc: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.
tech_zro_launcher_desc: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.

BIO_PSIONIC_LIGHTNING_DESC: A deadly amalgamation of electrical charges and ethereal energy. These bioelectric glands generate weaponized bolts of burning plasma infused with psionic properties.

sm_aura_emitter_desc: The Aura Emitter establishes a fixed conduit for projected psionic energy, allowing a starbase to emanate a Psionic Aura.

SHROUD_SEAL_IN_SYSTEM: This system contains a Shroud Seal, weakening nearby Psionic Auras. It can only be dismantled by the system owner.
shroud_seal_DESC: This sophisticated machine emits low-frequency waves capable of counteracting psionic energy, thereby dissipating and eventually nullifying Psionic Auras.
shroud_seal_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS: The Shroud Seal attenuates nearby Psionic Auras and reduces the effectiveness of Psionic Ship Components.

shroud_seal_dismantle_conditions_tt: £ Hostiles in this system prevent us from safely dismantling the Shroud Seal.
abomination_army_desc: Enslaved soldiers who have undergone drastic experimental treatments to increase their aggression and martial capabilities, transforming them into living weapons. They are as subservient to their masters as they are fierce in battle.
mindwarden_army_desc: These specialized units have received extensive training in anti-psionic techniques and technologies, making them powerful opponents against mind-invading targets.
building_carceral_test_facility_desc: A colonial office that promotes franchising opportunities to prospective stakeholders, empowering them to establish their own experimental testing programs. Bring down crime and scale up defense!
building_psionic_offices_desc: The complexities of foreign minds can be navigated more effectively while in their physical presence, allowing the most lucrative of trade deals to be established for both sides.

job_shroud_trader_desc: These experts attune to the emotional zeitgeist in the local markets, striking deals and hosting seminars on current trends in thought leadership.
building_experimentation_chambers_1_desc: A top-secret facility for experimenting on incorrigible lawbreakers, mostly comprising prison cells and research laboratories.
building_experimentation_chambers_2_desc: A campus of top-secret technology and internment facilities, where lawbreaking [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are used as subjects in experiments led by the empire's top [Owner.GetResearchers].
building_experimentation_chambers_3_desc: A network of maximum-security technology and internment centers. Teams of elite [Owner.GetResearchers] conduct pioneering experiments on [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] drawn from the empire's underworld.
building_lifecrypt_1_desc: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated populations in close proximity. Assigned individuals wear specialized equipment which funnel their life force into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those of higher status.
building_lifecrypt_2_desc: While their name may imply otherwise, Soul Siphons are based in practical science. Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from individuals via physical tether, they are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from organisms without endangering their lives.
building_lifecrypt_3_desc: The boundaries of Essence Conduits must be clearly marked, for wandering within its area of influence can be fatal to those without the proper equipment. Assigned individuals are trained to regulate their metabolisms so as not to donate too much of their energy at once.
building_lifecrypt_machine_1_desc: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess processing energy from dedicated drones in close proximity. Assigned workers wear specialized equipment which funnel their batteries into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those of higher purpose.
building_lifecrypt_machine_2_desc: Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from drones via physical tether, these devices are capable of sapping immense amounts of excess processing without inflicting critical faults.
building_lifecrypt_machine_3_desc: The boundaries of the Battery Nexus must be clearly marked, as entering within its area of influence can be fatal to units without the proper insulative equipment.
building_lifecrypt_hive_mind_1_desc: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated drones in close proximity. building_lifecrypt_hive_mind_2_desc: While their name may imply otherwise, Soul Siphons are based in practical science. building_lifecrypt_hive_mind_3_desc: The boundaries of Essence Conduits must be clearly marked, as entering within its area of influence can be fatal to drones without the proper equipment. Assigned workers are trained to regulate their metabolisms so as not to donate too much of their energy at once.
building_lifecrypt_corporate_1_desc: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated interns in close proximity. Assigned individuals wear specialized equipment which funnel their life force into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those in senior positions.
building_lifecrypt_corporate_2_desc: Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from individuals via physical tether, the Synergy Administration buildings are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from interns without endangering their lives to any appreciable degree.
building_lifecrypt_corporate_3_desc: The boundaries of the Synergy Nexus must be clearly marked, for wandering within its area of influence can be fatal to interns without the proper equipment. Assigned individuals are trained in advanced synergy techniques to ensure their ultimate survival throughout this process.
building_psionic_suppressor_desc: This complex supports an array of long-range psionic attenuators, which dissipate Psionic Auras throughout the star system and prevent their further spread.

shroud.5012.title: Secret Societies Emerge
shroud.5012.desc:
Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.

These Factions now emerge from our own shadows and acknowledge their existence. Known as The Curtain, The Masquerade and The Grand Dance, these once-secret organizations are now openly requesting formal dialogue with us.

What they want, and how they know what they know, may never truly be understood by us. It may be in our best interest to operate within their demands.

$t$The Curtain
$t$The Masquerade
$t$The Grand Dance
shroud.5013.title: Strange Contacts
shroud.5013.desc:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This seems like more than coincidence. We suspect that these interstellar relationships originate behind the closed doors of several secret Factions that have deeply embedded themselves within our society.

Perhaps once we know more about these beings, those within our shadows will reveal themselves.
shroud.5013.a: Are they with us, or against us?

shroud.5105.title: The Chosen
shroud.5105.desc:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.

By what name should we call this [This.GetSensation]?
shroud.5105.desc_p2: We feel its presence in our deepest thoughts. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our minds.
shroud.5105.desc_p2_machine: We detect its presence in our most complex calculations. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our circuits.
shroud.5110.title: The [GetChosenPatron] Beckons
shroud.5110.desc_common:
Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the [GetChosenPatron] has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never before.

It lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own [GetMindLogicLoc]. The [GetChosenPatron] beckons us in
shroud.5110.desc_common_2: Finally, we understand how to visit this ethereal domain of our own volition.

shroud.5115.title: [GetChosenPatron]
shroud.5115.desc.intro:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined minds, we sense it clearly enough to explore with purpose.

On the other side, our efforts have not gone unnoticed. The [GetChosenPatron] awaits us.

pft_the_masquerade_desc: The Masquerade sits center stage in the galactic theater. The spotlight shines brightest on their performance while darker works unfold behind the scenes.
THE_MASQUERADE_SPECIAL_POWERS_DESC1: Have a seat on the Galactic Council.
THE_MASQUERADE_SPECIAL_POWERS_DESC2: Become Custodian of the Galactic Council.
THE_MASQUERADE_THANKFUL_FRIENDS_DESC: Be owed $@the_masquerade_thankful_friends_favors|0$ or more Favors from another empire.
THE_MASQUERADE_CONTROL_OF_THE_LAW_DESC: Passed a resolution in the Galactic Council within the last $@the_masquerade_control_of_the_law_years|0$ years.
THE_MASQUERADE_POLITICAL_ACTOR_DESC: Have an Official assigned to the Galactic Community.
THE_MASQUERADE_NARRATIVE_CONTROL_DESC: Denounced another empire within the last 10 years.
THE_MASQUERADE_PRICE_SETTER_DESC: Be the host of the Galactic Market.
THE_MASQUERADE_UNITED_PURPOSE_DESC: Called upon Favors to pass or fail a Galactic Council resolution within the last 10 years.
pft_the_curtain_desc: The Curtain opens and closes as necessary, allowing the people to see only what needs to be seen.
THE_CURTAIN_READING_THE_ROOM_DESC: Have $@the_curtain_min_intel|0$ or more Intel on another empire.
THE_CURTAIN_READING_THE_ROOM2_DESC: Have $@the_curtain_min_intel|0$ or more Intel on 2 other empires.
THE_CURTAIN_READING_THE_ROOM3_DESC: Have $@the_curtain_min_intel|0$ or more Intel on 3 other empires.
THE_CURTAIN_BEHIND_THE_CURTAIN_DESC: Successfully completed an Operation within the last 5 years.
THE_CURTAIN_EARS_TO_THE_WALL_DESC: Have 5 or more systems owned by other empires within sensor range.
THE_CURTAIN_SMOKE_AND_MIRRORS_DESC: Own 1 or more systems inside of a Nebula.
THE_CURTAIN_IN_THE_SHADOWS_DESC: Control a cloaked ship inside of another empire's territory.
pft_the_grand_dance_desc: The Grand Dance exercises a carefully choreographed series of steps and turns designed to weave their way through political environments while remaining untouched.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_PROMENADE_DESC: Have Positive or better relations with another empire.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_PROMENADE2_DESC: Have Positive or better relations with 2 other empires.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_PROMENADE3_DESC: Have Positive or better relations with 3 other empires.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_PLAYING_BOTH_SIDES_DESC: Provoked a ['concept_proxy_war'] within the last 10 years.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_ACTIVE_SENSOR_DESC: Have an Active Sensor Link with another empire.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_INNOCENT_PRANK_DESC: Executed the Spark Diplomatic Incident Operation within the last 5 years.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_DARK_WHISPERS_DESC: Have 2 or more Envoys harming or improving foreign relations.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_SHADOW_PUPPET_DESC: Have a pledge of Secret Fealty with another empire.
THE_GRAND_DANCE_RIGHT_CHOICE_DESC: Influenced the election of a ruler within the last 10 years.

councilor_energy_curator_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the proper allocation of energy collected from the general population. Careful balance is required in order to prevent inefficiency at the lowest levels of society.
councilor_executive_thrall_manager_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the proper allocation of metabolism collected from willing interns. These energies can be put to better use in the higher levels of business management.
councilor_secret_societies_desc: The $TITLE$ secretly manages various political aspects of the empire, but carries the official title of Deputy Coordinator.
councilor_secret_societies_corporate_des: The $TITLE$ secretly manages various political aspects of the empire, but carries the official title of Assistant Coordinator.
councilor_chief_medium_desc: The $TITLE$ is the supreme spiritual authority of the empire, who advocates for the needs of state mystics and promotes the use of divination in all spheres of life.

councilor_executive_astrologist_desc: The $TITLE$ works to unify spiritual practices throughout the empire, cutting visionary inefficiencies and accelerating fortuitous outcomes as the stars allow.
