shroud.4045.b: Best not disturb the balance of the Shroud.
shroud.4046.title: Shifting of the Shroud
shroud.4046.desc.1: As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the Shroud in violent
shroud.4046.desc.2:
Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the Whisperers in the Void leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have
shroud.4046.desc.3: we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.
shroud.4046.desc.robot:
As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the Shroud in violent wakening. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the Whisperers in the Void leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.
shroud.4046.desc.organic:
As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the Shroud in violent activation. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the Whisperers in the Void leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.
shroud.whispers_in_the_shroud.title: Whispers in the Shroud
minor_patron_instrument_cradle_intro: We find ourselves between the domains of the Instrument of Desire and the Cradle of Souls.
minor_patron_cradle_composer_intro: We find ourselves between the domains of the Cradle of Souls and the Composer of Strands.
minor_patron_composer_eater_intro: We find ourselves between the domains of the Composer of Strands and the Eater of Worlds.
minor_patron_eater_instrument_intro: We find ourselves between the domains of the Eater of Worlds and the Instrument of Desire.
minor_patron_default_intro: We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.
shroud.4050.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a Sculpting Presence, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haze. It offers something.

What will happen if we grasp it?
shroud.4055.title: The Animator of Clay Emerges
shroud.4055.desc:
As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the Sculpting Presence momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.

The pregnant dimness ebbed away to reveal a gesturing silhouette. Its limbs were pulled sharply, one way then another, by vapory cords until, suddenly, its tethers dissipated. The figure collapsed.

Slowly it twitched back to life. Limb by limb it rose, without its former ties, and resumed its hypnotic dance.
shroud.4055.desc.know_animator: We realized then that we have encountered this entity before. The Animator of Clay was entertained. Wherever the inanimate is awakened, and where dull matter is imbued with soul, it too can be found.
shroud.4055.a: The puppet dances free of its strings.
shroud.4060.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A Sorrowed Entity encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.

Whatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?
shroud.4065.title: The Outsider Emerges
shroud.4065.desc.intro:
The distant power known as Sorrowed Entity seared our minds with anguish from deep within the Shroud. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:

Tread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...
shroud.4065.desc.outro_default: Whatever this means, the Outsider is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.
shroud.4065.desc.outro_know_zroni:
This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?

Whatever this means, the Outsider is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.
shroud.4065.desc.outro_left_zroni: We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an Astral Rift. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now the Outsider?
shroud.4065.a.left_zroni: Let us not succumb to the same fate.
shroud.4070.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the Fathomless Being sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.
shroud.4075.title: The Endless Tide Emerges
shroud.4075.desc:
The Fathomless Being has been unearthed from the Shroud. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

The Endless Tide stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.
shroud.4080.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the Insurmountable One before us.

The tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.
shroud.4085.title: The Pale Mountain Emerges
shroud.4085.desc:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the Shroud, we reached the intangible summit. The Insurmountable One itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.

Yet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.

The Pale Mountain rises in our minds.
shroud.4090.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a Luxurious Being drawing closer. Its overwhelming nature sweeps around us as it whispers promises of extravagant contentment.

Its slothful indulgence is curiously tempting.
shroud.4095.title: The Golden Dream Emerges
shroud.4095.desc:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the Shroud, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the Luxurious Being.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.

The Golden Dream offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.
shroud.4100.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we observe, we become aware of an Irenic Entity orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.

Its calmness beckons us.
shroud.4105.title: The Hollow Point Emerges
shroud.4105.desc:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the Irenic Entity.

Images played in our minds of an overwhelming procession of conflicts, each brimming with distractions of chaos and fury.

Amid it all, we felt the watchful and timeless presence of the Hollow Point. Serene in its patience, it waits for the galaxy's ceaseless strife to finally end.
shroud.4105.desc.outro_homicidal: Despite our basest instincts, our minds have been exposed to a curious way of thinking.
shroud.4105.a.homicidal: A wistful dream... we know our true purpose.
shroud.4110.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The Unyielding One judges our intent.

Its gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.
shroud.4115.title: The Vacant Throne Emerges
shroud.4115.desc:
We have knelt in the presence of the Unyielding One.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of the Vacant Throne offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.

We now carry this weight with us.
shroud.4120.desc:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem with us. This Restless Presence lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.

We must follow it.
shroud.4125.title: The Black River Emerges
shroud.4125.desc:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the Shroud could we finally reach the Restless Presence.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.

Finally we understood the Black River and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.
shroud.4135.title: The End of the Cycle
shroud.4135.desc:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the End of the Cycle and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: \"IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME.\" A pause. \"BUT IT COULD BE.\"

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.
shroud.4135.a.tt:
Replaces the domains of all known patrons with the End of the Cycle.
We will be granted at least 50 years to consume the galaxy in the Aura of the End. If we succeed, the game ends.

shroud.4140.title: All or Nothing
shroud.4140.desc:
Our fate is bound to the End of the Cycle; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.

Should we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.
shroud.4140.a.tooltip:
Gain access to the ['concept_total_war'] Casus Belli
Other empires' Opinion of us: -200
shroud.4145.title: Annihilation
shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance.
shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2: It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.
shroud.4145.desc_1.default: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.
shroud.4145.desc_1.homicidal: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.
shroud.4145.desc_2: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.
shroud.4145.a: We must do all that is necessary.

shroud.4150.title: The Coming of the End
shroud.4150.desc:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

shroud.11225.title: A Sudden Disappearance
shroud.11225.desc.common_1:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent Aura of the End present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead.
shroud.11225.desc.common_2: Whatever madness invoked such destructive power may be forever unknown.

SPECIAL_PROJECT_CALLING_DESC: The Whisperers in the Void yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

RECKONING_ARRIVAL_PROJECT_DESC:
The galaxy is under threat from an immensely powerful entity known as the $NAME_Reckoning$. Composed of pure energy, it materialized suddenly and began a campaign of destruction.

All available data indicate that this being is an opponent unlike anything we have faced before. If we wish to confront this threat, we should execute emergency research to determine more effective methods of engagement.
shroud.11235.title: Facing the Reckoning
shroud.11235.desc:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the $NAME_Reckoning$.

Based on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing technology; the energy that comprises the $NAME_Reckoning$ can be degraded using a modified form of weaponry designed to pierce energy shields.

Though it is formidable, we now stand a better chance of engaging this threat.
RECKONING_VULNERABILITY_PROJECT_DESC:
Though we did not succeed, our confrontation with the $NAME_Reckoning$ provided invaluable data for study.

By dedicating research to this mysterious energy being, we can identify its vulnerabilities, and thereby develop more effective methods of attack.
shroud.11240.title: Learning from Defeat
shroud.11240.desc:
The $NAME_Reckoning$ is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.

Preliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.
shroud.11245.title: $NAME_Reckoning$'s Weakness
shroud.11245.desc.1: Our [GetScientistPlural] have made a breakthrough in their research concerning the energy being known as the $NAME_Reckoning$.
shroud.11245.desc.2.intro: This entity not only emerged from
shroud.11245.desc.2.outro: Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.
shroud.11245.desc.2.psionic: This entity not only emerged from the Shroud, but maintains its defensive power via a transdimensional link to the psionic realm. Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.
shroud.11245.desc.2.non_psionic: This entity not only emerged from another dimension of reality, but maintains its defensive power via a mysterious transdimensional link. Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.
reckoning_insight_modifier_desc: By conducting extensive research, we have determined an effective method for damaging the $NAME_Reckoning$ using a modified form of our existing weaponry.
reckoning_vulnerability_modifier_desc: Using data from our previous encounter with the Reckoning, we have discovered a means to inflict greater damage with the help of 'psi-suppressive' lasers.

shroud.4550.title: $utopia.3304.name$
shroud.4550.desc.default:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is the Instrument of Desire and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our hearts.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

shroud.4600.title: $utopia.3304.name$
shroud.4600.desc_homicidal:
As we sink into the Shroud, a presence sears our inner vision. The pervading glow obscures all else. It is the Cradle of Souls and it burns within our core.

It demands no less than compromise on a galactic scale, an abject peace of incompatible beings. Great power awaits us, it promises, if we accept this detestable vision.

If only we will let it shape new horizons.

The Cradle's light is relentless, and its power is undeniable. Could our minds ever embrace such a thing? Will it weaken our resolve?
shroud.4600.desc_non_homicidal:
As our minds sink into the Shroud, a presence blooms within us. We sense a glow that touches all things, radiating order and balance. It is the Cradle of Souls and it stirs us to our core.

It wants no less than enduring peace - a galaxy cured of its chaos. If we share its vision, it can forge us into bringers of harmony. It promises a bond of unbreakable trust.

If only we will let it shape our horizons.

The hopes of the Cradle press upon us.

According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the blessings of this bargain are yet to come. Until that time, a terrible conflict plagues our minds. What is it that we have done to ourselves?

shroud.4650.title: $utopia.3304.name$
shroud.4650.desc.default:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, the Composer of Strands, regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

If we will only take it into our flesh.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

This presence, the Composer of Strands, regards our mechanical forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be adapted, changed. Improved. Upgraded.

If we will only take it into our components.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

shroud.4660.desc:
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the Composer of Strands. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.
shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intr:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Composer of Strands. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.
shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc:

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

The Composer yearns for manipulations of the physical form, and growth set free from conventional restraints. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.
shroud.4700.title: $utopia.3304.name$
shroud.4700.a: Form a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void.
shroud.4705.desc.intro:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void. Their will courses through the [root.GetName].

The influence of our new patron has taken hold swiftly.
shroud.4705.desc.outro: Such is the price of this powerful bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Whisperers' greatest blessings are yet to come. Our direct communion with such a magnificent psionic entity will surely have been worth it.
shroud.4705.desc.gestalt:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void. Their will courses through the [root.GetName].

The influence of our new patron has taken hold swiftly. As our collective awaits an influx of hidden knowledge, we sense our thoughts splintering into divergent patterns. The steady harmony of the [GetNetworkName] is overlaid with a growing discord of inner voices.

Such is the price of this powerful bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Whisperers' greatest blessings are yet to come. Our direct communion with such a magnificent psionic entity will surely have been worth it.
shroud.4705.desc.non_gestalt:

The influence of our new patron has taken hold swiftly. As we thirst for hidden knowledge, the ideas and opinions within our society have grown more divergent. A discord of inner voices abrades our psyches, threatening the mental wellbeing of all [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Such is the price of this powerful bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Whisperers' greatest blessings are yet to come. Our direct communion with such a magnificent psionic entity will surely have been worth it.

shroud.4710.b: Renounce the Whisperers in the Void.
shroud.4715.desc.intro: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: \"THE END BEGINS.\"
shroud.4715.desc.default:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: \"THE END BEGINS.\"

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the Shroud roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.
shroud.4715.desc.hive:

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

shroud.11110.title: The Cycle Continues
shroud.11110.desc:
The Whisperers shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.

We have an irrevocable choice to make.
shroud.11120.title: Vengeance of [GetBetrayedPatronColour]
shroud.11120.title.eater: Vengeance of the Eater of Worlds
shroud.11120.title.cradle: Vengeance of the Cradle of Souls
shroud.11120.title.instrument: Vengeance of the Instrument of Desire
shroud.11120.title.composer: Vengeance of the Composer of Strands
shroud.11120.desc:
As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the Shroud, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].

A $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ has emerged near [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName], which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.
shroud.11120.a: We must prepare to defend ourselves.
shroud.11120.a.tt:
[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName] turns into a Shrouded Planet.
A $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ appears near this planet.
shroud.11130.title: Furious Vengeance
shroud.11130.desc_common: A $NAME_Psionic_Avatar$ has emerged from the $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ in the [event_target:spawn_system.GetName] system. A manifestation of the wrath of [GetBetrayedPatronColour], it is now traveling in the direction of [capital_scope.GetName].
shroud.11130.desc_success: We were successful in gathering our forces against the emerging threat. Our ships emitted waves of psionic energy into the $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$, weakening the hostile entity as it breached into our reality.
shroud.11250.title: The End
shroud.11250.desc:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.
shroud.11255.title: Rebirth of the [owner.GetName]
shroud.11255.desc: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the End of the Cycle. To this end, we have rebuilt an Outpost in the [solar_system.Star.GetStarName] system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].

shroud.4862.title: [From.GetName] Transformed
shroud.4862.shared: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty.
shroud.4862.desc: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The Composer of Strands has transformed [From.GetName] into a Class M (Gaia), making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.
shroud.4862.a.tooltip: The planet [From.GetName] has been transformed into a Class M (Gaia).
shroud.4890.title: The Power of Hindsight
shroud.4890.desc: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. The Whisperers in the Void will reimagine one of our planets as a Ancient Planet; we need only make our choice.
leader_trait_whispering_mind_desc: This leader's mind is flooded with whispers, each with unique intent. They commune with not one entity, but thousands.
knowledge_accord_tt: Leaders can acquire the Whispering Mind trait.
shroud.4935.title: Creation in [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]
shroud.4935.desc: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The End of the Cycle has materialized a Class M (Gaia) in our [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleeting paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.
shroud.4935.tooltip: A Class M (Gaia) has appeared in [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]: [accord_creation_world.GetName]
shroud.4970.title: The End Has Come
shroud.4970.desc.1: The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.
shroud.4970.desc.2:
All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

\"THE END OF ENDS.\"
shroud.4970.desc:
The End of the Cycle is upon us.

The Aura of the End has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

\"THE END OF ENDS.\"
shroud.4970.a.tooltip:
We ended the cycle.

The galaxy is destroyed.

gov_mindwarden_enclave_desc: Motivated by a deep antipathy toward the Shroud, this organization provides services and technology to counteract the powerful effects of psionic practices.
leader_trait_iron_will_desc: A masterful commander of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$, renowned for expertise in heavy fortifications and psychic resistance.
shroud.4190.name: Psionic Aura Approaches
shroud.4190.desc.intro: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems.
shroud.4190.desc:
Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed 'Psionic Auras', on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sources, we have yet to confirm whether they pose a threat or not.

Such an Aura has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system, which might encroach within our borders if it continues to spread.
shroud.4190.desc_mindwarden: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.
shroud.4190.a: We might know their effects soon enough.
shroud.4191.name: Psionic Aura Approaches
shroud.4191.desc_1.common: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of
shroud.4191.desc_1.default: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.
shroud.4191.desc_1.contact: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].
shroud.4191.desc_2.common: matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.
shroud.4191.desc_2.default: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.
shroud.4191.desc_2.knows_aura: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.
shroud.4191.desc_3.common: we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.
shroud.4191.desc_3.default: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.
shroud.4191.desc_3.contact: Given our [GetLessThanRivalAdj]favorable relations with the [fromfrom.GetName], we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.
shroud.4205.name: [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]
shroud.4205.common: Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].
shroud.4205.desc:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Our mission is to protect against the menace of the Shroud and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.
shroud.4205.desc.end: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.
shroud.4205.desc.return:
Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.

Our psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the Shroud. Good, good...

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.
shroud.4205.desc.eotc:
These are grave times. Despite our efforts, the End of the Cycle is upon us. Its dreadful manifestation stalks among the stars...

Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.
shroud.4205.desc.eotc.end: Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.
shroud.4205.desc.merc_first:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of the first Mindwarden Enclave is complete. From today, the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] shall carry on the vital work of combating the Shroud and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from zro disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.
shroud.4205.desc.merc_more:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our Mindwarden Enclave is complete. From today, the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] shall carry on the vital work of combating the Shroud and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from zro disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.
shroud.4205.desc.merc_back:
Welcome back, fellow wardens. The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] values our continued cooperation.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.
shroud.4205.desc.return_beginning: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.
shroud.4205.desc.return_beginning.eotc: Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.
shroud.4205.b: We would like to discuss Zro.
shroud.4205.c: What can be done about Psionic Auras?
shroud.4205.d: We know of a good psionic target...
shroud.4205.e: We need help with £ [GetCrimeDeviancy] among us.
shroud.4205.f: We could make use of your soldiers.
shroud.4205.g: Would you be willing to send us a warden?
shroud.4205.h: We want to discuss the End of the Cycle.
shroud.4205.i: As your founding patron, we have a proposal.
shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud:
From today, the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] shall carry on the vital work of combating the Shroud and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from zro disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.
shroud.4210.desc:
The Shroud can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful 'psionic' energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.

The Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.

Ensuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.
shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal: These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.
shroud.4230.desc:
There are two principal methods of suppressing Psionic Auras.

Building a Psionic Suppressor on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An even more powerful solution is a Shroud Seal. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.
shroud.4231.desc:
Gladly. The data will be transmitted forthwith.

May these technologies bring you peace from the auric scourge.
mindwarden_encourage_raid: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural] to raid a Psionic Empire we know of.
shroud.4240.need_psionics: Contact established with a Psionic empire.
shroud.4240.desc:
Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...

A targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we are willing to conduct such an operation.

Let us know the target, if you agree.
mindwarden_raid_cooldown_tt: We will not be able to request another raid from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_raid_timer].
mindwarden_hire_raid: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] to send a raiding fleet to attack this empire.
shroud.4245.desc:
Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.

Thank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.
shroud.4246.name: Mindwarden Enclave Raid
shroud.4246.common_1: Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems.
shroud.4246.common_2: are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.
shroud.4246.desc: A military fleet from the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.
shroud.4247.desc: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. Identifying themselves as the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], they are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.
shroud.4250.desc:
Excellent. Entrusting us with zro enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.

This is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.
mindwarden_zro_explanation: Sell up to 100 Zro for 5 times the standard Galactic Market price.
mindwarden_zro_cooldown_tt: We will not be able to give Zro to the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_zro_timer].
shroud.4251.desc:
Zro is a rare, highly unstable substance, the effects of which are difficult to control and predict. Intentionally or not, it can cause violent bursts of energy that wreak destruction on a mass scale.

These properties are produced through reactions with the Shroud, making it popular among psionic practitioners - some of whom ingest it as a drug.

We aim to learn more about zro and to research methods for its safe disposal; that is why we pay handsomely for any quantity brought to us.
shroud.4260.desc:
Then let us provide you with an effective Thought Police, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.

Their methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices, using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity. They provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the Shroud.
mindwarden_decision_cooldown_tt: We will not be able to request this until [root.mindwarden_decision_timer].
mindwarden_decision_explanation: Unlocks one £ Planetary Decision: Thought Police
shroud.4262.desc: Excellent. I think you will find their methods quite efficacious.
shroud.4265.desc:
Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.

We mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We would be honored to assist such a valued partner in this matter, should you provide us adequate compensation.
mindwarden_logistics_cooldown_tt: We cannot request more logistical assistance from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_logistics_timer].
shroud.4267.desc:
Greetings, valued partner.

Our contract to assist in the logistical operations of your fleets has expired. We would be more than willing to continue this partnership, should you deem it worth your while.
shroud.4266.desc: Very good. Our fleet support operations will commence at once.
shroud.4270.desc:
Our Assault Wardens make excellent shock troopers. They are equipped to tackle diverse threats, but are especially effective against psionic opponents.

We think you will find them worth their price.
mindwarden_army_cooldown_tt: We will not be able to request a new army from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_army_timer].
mindwarden_army_explanation: Enlist an Assault Wardens army, arriving by Transport Ship at our capital system.
shroud.4271.desc: You are in luck; we already have a company ready for deployment. Expect the arrival of their transport ship presently.
shroud.4280.desc:
We would be more than willing.

Effective leadership is key to combating the Shroud, and our wardens are well-versed in suppressing psionic activity through firm governance.
mindwarden_commander_explanation: We will hire a Level 5 Mindwarden Commissioner.
unlocks_mindwarden_council_position:
Allows the unlocking of Council Position:

$t$Leader is not Psionic
mindwarden_commander_already_bought: We have already purchased the services of a Mindwarden Commissioner.
mindwarden_commander_conflicted_leader: Must not have a leader from the [event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName].
mindwarden_commander_cooldown_tt: We will not be able to request another leader from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_commander_timer].
mindwarden_commander_desc: Recruited from a Mindwarden Enclave, this leader promotes an unyielding stance against psionic activities, protecting the populace from the deleterious effects of the Shroud.
mindwarden_commander_catch_phrase: Where the Shroud seeps through, the wound must be cauterized.
shroud.4281.desc: A wise decision. May their stewardship keep your population safe for years to come.
shroud.4286.name: Attack on [FROM.GetName]
mindwarden_farewell: \"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them.\"
shroud.4286.desc:

I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them.\"

$enclave.8000.end$

shroud.4290.desc: A grave matter, indeed. There is no greater scourge in the galaxy than that of the End of the Cycle.
shroud.4290.b: What is the End of the Cycle!?
shroud.4290.b.response:
According to our intelligence, the End of the Cycle is a cataclysmic force from within the Shroud. Its power can manifest in physical reality through the complicity of power-hungry mind-invaders.

The End inflicts ruin upon the galaxy through the $NAME_Reckoning$ - a vicious being composed of psionic energy. Its ultimate goal is the complete annihilation of this existence.
shroud.4291.desc: May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.
shroud.4292.desc:
We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the $NAME_Reckoning$. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.

In its current state, each deployment of the code requires extensive refactoring for compatibility with individual military infrastructures. This is therefore a premium service, but we think you will find it worth the outlay.
shroud.4295.desc:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

We were initially concerned by reports of your 'Materiality Engines'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising development for non-psionic exploitation of the so-called 'Shroud'.

We encourage your continued deployment of this technology, and look forward to working with you in the future.
shroud.4300.desc:
I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the Shroud.

Your actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.
shroud.4300.a: Why do you fear the Shroud?
shroud.4310.desc:
We do not fear it, nor its corrupted agents, as we know how to fight it.

I would not expect you - a society maddened by its influence - to understand.
shroud.4320.desc.psionic: Was it not enough to poison the galaxy with psionics?
shroud.4320.desc.default: We are a force for order in this galaxy; what benefit is there in attacking us? We shall not idly tolerate your belligerence.
shroud.4320.desc.common: Until you confirm the unconditional cessation of hostile attacks, we have nothing to discuss.
shroud.4340.desc:
We are aware of your dealings with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Your actions not only legitimize their wrongdoing, but help spread the infection of the Shroud.

We will not render you any services while you remain their collaborators.
shroud.4350.desc:
We have not been able to reestablish contact with the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] since the destruction of their facility.

When we listen to their channel, we hear only the empty quietude of space.
shroud.4405.title: Mindwarden Enclave Destroyed
shroud.4405.desc_common: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more.
shroud.4405.desc.default: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more. Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the 'Shroud' represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.
shroud.4405.desc.psionic: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more. They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the Shroud, and their station's psionic attenuators are now debris.
shroud.4405.desc_end: Our victory was doubly successful, as we were also able to salvage a sizable amount of resources from the wreckage of their station.
shroud.4406.title: Mindwarden Enclave Destroyed
shroud.4406.desc_common: We have received reports that the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system is no more. This Mindwarden Enclave was unable to withstand an onslaught by the [mindwarden_destroyer.GetName], which reduced their station to debris and left no known survivors.
shroud.4406.desc.psionic: The galaxy is now free from the torment of their anti-psionic crusade - as long as no one emerges to take their place.
shroud.4406.desc.default: The galaxy will have to make do without their anti-psionic services for the time being.
shroud.6855.desc: Please make it known. We are glad to maintain close cooperation with the [root.GetName]; our histories and aims are forever bound.
shroud.6855.desc.1: We are forever thankful for your contribution to the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]. For as long as the psionic threat remains, may our bond be unwavering.
shroud.6855.desc.2: You can trust that your next profit-share payment will be delivered in a timely fashion.
shroud.6855.b: We want to help expand your enclave.
shroud.6855.b.timeout: The enclave is currently recruiting new officers and crew. It cannot commence further operational improvements until after [mindwarden_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer].
shroud.6855.c: We want to share our technology with you.
shroud.6855.c.timeout: The enclave is still incorporating tech we provided previously. We can share new technologies with them after [mindwarden_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer].
shroud.6855.d: We wish to hire a fleet for our own purposes.
shroud.6855.f: We wish to increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity.
shroud.6855.f.timeout: We are still implementing enclave-related infrastructural changes. We cannot increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity again until [mindwarden_enclave_country.mindwarden_enclave_capacity_bought_timer].
shroud.6860.1.desc: With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole galaxy would benefit from your patronage.
shroud.6860.2.desc: We must remain vigilant against the ever-changing threat of psionics. Your generous donation would allow us to significantly scale up our operations to meet this challenge.
shroud.6860.3.desc: We have achieved much, but it is too soon to take rest. With more resources at our disposal, the fleets of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] could be deployed even further across the galaxy, protecting even greater numbers of minds plagued by psionics.
shroud.6860.4.desc: Your patronage has defined our journey from the very outset, and our shared goals remain the same: fostering mental wellbeing by the complete eradication of psionics. With your aid, we are inching ever closer to our goal.
shroud.6860.5.desc: If you see fit to invest in our operations once again, we could become the largest anti-psionic force in the galaxy - the supreme bastion against mind invasion for all nations among the stars.
shroud.6861.desc: Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.
shroud.6865.desc:
A fine undertaking. The more Mindwarden Enclaves there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.

We can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and administration of more enclaves.
shroud.6870.desc: We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.
shroud.6875.desc: We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed with a commander specially trained in operations against psionic opponents.
mindwarden_tt_hirefleet: Take control of the Mindwarden fleet of this enclave for 10 years.
shroud.6876.desc: We trust that the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.
mindwarden_tt_managefleet: Cancel or prolong our Mindwarden fleet contract.
shroud.6880.desc: Certainly. We hope the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] has proven a valuable addition to your forces. Do you wish to terminate or prolong our contract?
shroud.6881.desc: Very well. The contract is void and the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will return to us immediately. Our fleets are available to hire whenever you require them.
origin_mindwardens_desc:
WARNING: Challenging Origin
WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.
origin_tooltip_mindwardens_effects:
- Additional Starting Technologies: £ ['technology:tech_starbase_3']
- Home System: Start with a Large Scale Space Manufacturing.

START_SCREEN_MINDWARDENS:
The records of our ancestors tell of a psychic plague that once devastated [GetHomeWorldName]. Otherworldly forces attacked their minds, and destructive radiation was diffused throughout the atmosphere - all encouraged by psionic practitioners from within [GetSpeciesAdj] society.

In response to these threats, our ancestors built the Ancient Ward to protect against mind-invading forces. With only routine maintenance, this venerable structure has proven strong enough to defend all [GetSpeciesNamePlural] from the threat of psionic influence, and its core technology has informed the development of other defenses of the mind.

As our civilization prepares to voyage beyond the orbit of [capital_scope.System.GetName], we are faced with the unknown. What psychic threats might lurk beyond our ken?
mindwarden_system_init_DESC:
This will always be the starting system when using the $MINDWARDEN_plural$ Origin.

Determines the layout, but not location, of your starting solar system.
mindwarden_sol_system_init_DESC:
Optional starting system for $MINDWARDEN_plural$ Origin, using Sol as a base.

Determines the layout, but not location, of your starting solar system.
building_ancient_ward_1_desc: This ancestral structure uses an array of psionic attenuators to insulate the entire planet against mind-invading forces.
building_ancient_ward_2_desc: This ancestral structure has been upgraded with enhanced psionic attenuators, which are capable of protecting against Psionic Auras throughout the star system.
psionic_auras_immunity: Progressively dissipates Psionic Auras in the system
war_goal_wg_end_threat_psionics_desc: War is waged to defend the galaxy against the threats of psionic infection.
shroud.6020.desc: As we attempt to make contact, our bridge crew suffers intermittent pangs of head pain...
shroud.6030.name: [exiled_country.GetName]
shroud.6030.desc: Despite repeated attempts, the [exiled_country.GetName] are not responding to our communications.
shroud.6050.name: Strange Correlations
shroud.6050.desc:
Our psi-suppressive Ancient Ward is producing irregular readings. This would normally result from spikes in psionic activity on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but we have found no evidence of such depravity.

The answer may lie beyond our borders. Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, which correlates with the erratic measurements of the $building_ancient_ward_1$.
shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror
shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation: These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission.
shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction: The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.
shroud.6100.name: Dangerous Energy
shroud.6100.desc.no_border_aura:
An alarming situation is developing in the newly explored [from.GetName] system. The crew of the [root.GetName] is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror. Their fleet's systems are also experiencing strange, erratic malfunctions.

These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission. Outside of the protection of the Ancient Ward on [owner.GetHomeWorldName], we are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered the source of these dangerous emissions to be the nearby [exiled_center_system.GetName] system. Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.
shroud.6100.desc.border_aura:
The crew of the [root.GetName] is in danger.

Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the [from.GetName] system, they began experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

Long-range scanners indicate even higher levels of radiation in the nearby [exiled_center_system.GetName] system. Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.
shroud.6100.desc.end: Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.
shroud.6110.name: A Presence in [This.System.GetName]
shroud.6110.desc:
Astonishingly, the [This.System.GetName] system appears to contain a number of large objects that appear to be of intelligent construction. We might learn more about their creators, code-named [This.ContactCountry.GetName], by attempting direct communications from a safe distance.

Any life forms in the system must be in great danger from the high levels of psi-radiation we detected.
fcsum_exiled_1: We have discovered possible evidence of alien intelligence in the [This.System.GetName] system.
shroud.6115.name: Limited Progress
shroud.6115.desc:
Further study has confirmed the objects in the [This.System.GetName] system to be alien spacecraft, though we have yet to make contact with any of the vessel's occupants.

Troublingly, envoy [exiled_envoy.GetName] reports that [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team has begun suffering from parapsychological symptoms, including unexplained visions of strange beings present in [This.System.GetName]. Despite these concerns, our envoy remains steadfast in [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] dedication to the mission.
fcsum_exiled_2: We have yet to make contact with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our envoy reported concerns about their team.
shroud.6120.name: Mission Aborted
shroud.6120.desc:
After months of silence, we received a transmission from [exiled_envoy.GetName]. Usually sober and direct, the envoy gave a bizarre, muddled report. [exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap] submitted rambling descriptions of strange imagery - apparently a tangle of dreams and delusions. No member of [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team proved to be any more coherent.

They have been relieved of their duties, and this mission has been suspended indefinitely. Whatever presence is in [This.System.GetName], it is currently beyond our means to safely investigate.
fcsum_exiled_3: Following a traumatic mission, our team has returned home before making contact with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].
shroud.6125.desc:
Suspended above the roiling current. [Root.Capital.GetName], or...?

...calling...

The surface twists open. A fetid miasma belches from unseen depths.

...answer...nothing...

Ceaseless. Suffocating.

It is terrible.
MESSAGE_FIRST_CONTACT_ABORTED_EXILED_DES: Our $first_contact$ process with the $COUNTRY|H$ has been aborted by executive fiat.
shroud.shared_text_aura_spread:
The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Despite the protections offered by the Ancient Ward, this encroachment has caused our population on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into [Root.home_planet.System.GetName], where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.
shroud.shared_text_aura_study: Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.
shroud.6200.name: Psi-Radiation on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]
shroud.6200.desc.no_visit:
An alarming situation is developing on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. The population is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror.

These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission. Those outside of the protection of our Ancient Ward are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered that these dangerous emissions spread from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.
shroud.6200.desc.visit_no_ship:
The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Despite the protections offered by the Ancient Ward, this encroachment has caused our population on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into [Root.home_planet.System.GetName], where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.

Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.
shroud.6200.desc.visit_and_ship:
The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Despite the protections offered by the Ancient Ward, this encroachment has caused our population on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into [Root.home_planet.System.GetName], where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.

Since being exposed to extremely high levels of psi-radiation, the crew of the [event_target:ship_in_border.GetName] in [exiled_system_border.GetName] is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.
shroud.6200.a: Let us learn to stop this infection.
PSI_RADIATION_PROJECT_DESC: Levels of psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system have suddenly increased, and the effects are being felt on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. We must study this developing phenomenon up close before it further endangers our population.
shroud.6205.name: Psionic Auras
shroud.6205.desc.start:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a 'Psionic Aura', a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.
shroud.6205.desc.aura_home:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a 'Psionic Aura', a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

It has already reached the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system, where the effects have been devastating. The Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] only offers limited protection.
shroud.6205.desc.no_aura_home:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a 'Psionic Aura', a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

If it reaches our [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system, the effects would be devastating. The Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] only offers limited protection.
shroud.6205.desc.end: The Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] only offers limited protection.
shroud.6205.a: We must strengthen the Ancient Ward.
PSIONIC_AURA_RESISTANCE_PROJECT_DESC: The Ancient Ward built by our ancestors on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] was designed to protect us from psi-radiation. The incursion of Psionic Auras threatens to overwhelm its current capacity. By applying what we have learned so far, we should be able to enhance its resistant properties.
shroud.6210.name: Psionic Attenuation
shroud.6210.desc:
Our tireless researchers have developed a method for strengthening the Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. By enhancing its psionic attenuators, the protection can be extended to cover not only the whole planet, but the entire [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system.

This research has stimulated broader study into this lost technology. We now know that the link between psi-radiation and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind is reciprocal: not only can these emissions affect our mental states, but our mental states can influence psi-radiation levels. It would seem that our immemorial taboo against 'psionic' practices has a scientific basis after all.
shroud.6210.a.tt: Begins the Event Chain: The Grand Ward
ancient_ward_upgrade_chain_desc: The Ancient Ward on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] has reached its functional limits. In order to deal with the nearby psionic threat, it will be necessary to enhance its capacities even further. This new Grand Ward shall be capable of protecting our population against the blight of Psionic Auras.
shroud.6215.name: The Grand Ward is Complete
shroud.6215.desc.aura_home: With our Grand Ward now complete, psi-radiation in the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system has been reduced to manageable levels. The population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.
shroud.6215.desc.no_aura_home: With our Grand Ward now complete, psi-radiation on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] has been reduced to manageable levels. The population is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.
shroud.6215.desc.end: Nevertheless, this Psionic Aura, and potentially others, still poisons the wider galaxy. Our scientists hypothesize that the technology of the Grand Ward could be applied to the development of a more powerful 'Shroud Seal'. These massive structures should be able to suppress Auras in entire star clusters. Building a $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system will be a significant advancement in controlling the psionic menace.
shroud.6215.a: This is research worthy of pursuit.
build_shroud_seal_poi_desc: After researching Psionic Suppression technology, we can use a Construction Ship to build a Shroud Seal within a stellar gravity well. This will suppress Psionic Auras throughout the star system and adjacent systems connected via a hyperlane.
shroud_seal_construction_chain_desc:
Our scientists theorize that more advanced Psionic Suppression technology can be developed to suppress Psionic Auras in entire star clusters.

This technology will allow us to construct a 'Shroud Seal'. Building such a powerful device in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system will be a significant advancement in controlling the ongoing psionic menace.
shroud_6216_poi_desc: After researching Psionic Suppression technology, we can use a Construction Ship to build a Shroud Seal within a stellar gravity well. This will suppress Psionic Auras throughout the star system and adjacent systems connected via a hyperlane.

shroud.6220.desc: Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, the crew of the [Root.GetName] is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.
shroud.6225.name: Radiation in [Root.home_planet.System.GetName]
shroud.6225.desc.shared: The adverse effects of psi-radiation poisoning are already evident throughout the population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName], and our ships' functionality is severely impaired.
shroud.6225.desc.know_aura:
The Psionic Aura has spread to the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system. The adverse effects of psi-radiation poisoning are already evident throughout the population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName], and our ships' functionality is severely impaired.

The urgency of strengthening the Ancient Ward is greater than ever.
shroud.6225.desc.no_know_aura:
The psionic blight has spread to the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system. The adverse effects of psi-radiation poisoning are already evident throughout the population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName], and our ships' functionality is severely impaired.

The urgency of understanding this contamination is greater than ever.

shroud.6231.name: The Loss of [root.GetHomeWorldName]
shroud.6231.desc: We have lost control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.
shroud.6231.a: We must regain control without delay.
shroud_6231_poi_desc: We must regain control of [root.GetHomeWorldName] without delay.
shroud_reclaim_homeworld_chain_desc: We have lost control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.
shroud.6241.name: [root.GetHomeWorldName] Reclaimed
shroud.6241.desc: We have regained control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. The [root.GetName] can resume anti-psionic endeavors in full force.
shroud.6300.name: Shadows of the Shroud
shroud.6300.desc:
Our scientists have completed the development of advanced Psionic Suppression technology. We can now replicate the effects of the Grand Ward on any colony under our control by building a Psionic Suppressor.

However, to control the spread of Psionic Auras in other systems, we will need to construct a more powerful device known as a Shroud Seal. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

This research has also given credence to a disturbing theory: an ethereal realm known as the 'Shroud', a dimension of psionic energy described in occult texts of old, appears to truly exist. The theory posits that the cognitive activity of sentient beings can cause energy to pass from the Shroud into observable reality - and this process is the root cause of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ in general.

This means that we are not merely contending with objective forces of the universe, but potentially calculated actions of unknown intent.
shroud.6300.a: So the 'Shroud' is real after all...?
shroud.6500.name: Unexpected Transmission
shroud.6500.desc: We are receiving an unexpected transmission from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. The [exiled_country.GetName] have inexplicably gained complete mastery of both our language and communication systems.
shroud.shared_screen_figure:
The figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am Uk-Hogolath Scarat, Psiarch of the [exiled_country.GetName]. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities.
shroud.shared_auric_flow_inhibition:
