The aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called
shroud.6505.name: Unexpected Transmission
shroud.6505.desc: We are receiving an unexpected transmission from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. The [exiled_country.GetName] have inexplicably gained complete mastery of both our language and communication systems.
shroud.6510.name: Psiarch Uk-Hogolath Scarat
shroud.6510.desc:
The figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am Uk-Hogolath Scarat, Psiarch of the [exiled_country.GetName]. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities. Your device in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.

The aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called 'Shroud Seal'.
shroud.6510.a: We received no prior communication from you.
shroud.6515.desc: We spoke with the true voice. Had you listened, you would have heard the call within. You have the gift, though you choose to suppress it.
shroud.6515.a: The aura is destructive. A plague.
shroud.6520.desc: Your understanding is faulty. The aura is a sacred gift of our protector. It casts down that which seeks to destroy.
shroud.6520.a: What if we refuse your demands?
shroud.6525.desc: Whoever harms the aura must be subdued. If you refuse, we will be forced to take military action.
shroud.6525_heritage.a: We will never destroy our heritage.
shroud.6525.b: We agree to dismantle the Seal.
shroud.6550.name: Hostilities Deferred
shroud.6550.desc:
In order to avoid immediate conflict with the [exiled_country.GetName], we acquiesced to their demands to dismantle the Shroud Seal in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Exposure to those responsible for the psionic pestilence has caused grave concern throughout the [this.GetName]. Removal of the $SHROUD_SEAL$ is only likely to be a short term appeasement. They will eventually expect the same of our Grand Ward - and that is something we cannot accept.

In any case, future hostilities seem inevitable.
shroud.6560.name: Psiarch Uk-Hogolath Scarat
shroud.6560.desc:
The figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am Uk-Hogolath Scarat, Psiarch of the [exiled_country.GetName]. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities. A structure on [capital_scope.GetName] is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.

The aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called 'Grand Ward'.
shroud.6560.a: We received no prior communication from you.
shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission:
As soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission.
shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain:
Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.
shroud.6570.name: Psiarch Uk-Hogolath Scarat
shroud.6570.desc:
As soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission. Though you agreed to dismantle the Shroud Seal, we are aware that you have maintained a building on [capital_scope.GetName] with similar capabilities. Your intent is clear. Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.
shroud.6570.a: You should do likewise. End transmission.
shroud.6575.name: Psiarch Uk-Hogolath Scarat
shroud.6575.desc:
As soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission. Your rebuilding of the Shroud Seal has extinguished any hopes we had for your redemption. Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.
shroud.6575.a: You should do likewise. End transmission.
shroud.6580.name: Sealing [exiled_center_system.GetName]
shroud.6580.desc:
With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our Shroud Seal is now in the process of driving out the Psionic Aura from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system.

Interstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single $SHROUD_SEAL$ is therefore capable of dissipating Psionic Auras throughout the entire territory of the [exiled_country.GetName].

Our victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.
shroud.6600.name: The Assembly of Mindways
shroud.6600.desc:
The colony of the psionic menace on [current_planet.GetName] has been conquered.

We have learned that the Psionic Aura present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the Shroud. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the Assembly of Mindways. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as The Dreamer.

Their sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet [other_planet.GetName]. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.
shroud.6601.name: Ruins on [current_planet.GetName]
shroud.6601.desc:
We have completed our colonization of [current_planet.GetName], a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].

From the remains of their records, we have learned that the Psionic Aura previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the Shroud. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as The Dreamer.

Fragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet [other_planet.GetName]. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.
shroud.6700.name: Sanctum of the Dreamer
shroud.6700.desc.common:
We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable Psionic Aura.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the Sanctum of the Dreamer, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.
shroud.6700.desc.contact:
The conquest of [current_planet.GetName] marked our final victory against the [exiled_country.GetName]. We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable Psionic Aura.

shroud.6700.desc.no_exiled:
In conquering [current_planet.GetName], we gained control of territory once ruled by psionic zealots. We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable Psionic Aura.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the Sanctum of the Dreamer, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.
shroud.6705.name: Psionic Threat Eliminated
shroud.6705.desc.common:
A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.

We may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its Psionic Aura, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.
shroud.6705.desc.contact:
The eradication of the population on [current_planet.GetName] marked the end of the empire known as the [exiled_country.GetName].

A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.

We may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its Psionic Aura, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.
shroud.6705.desc.no_contact:
The eradication of the population on [current_planet.GetName] marked the end of a devastating psionic threat.

A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.

We may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its Psionic Aura, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.
shroud.6705.a: May all such threats be vanquished.
psionic_threat_eliminated_desc: The eradication of a psionic empire has banished their Psionic Aura from the galaxy, bringing peace of mind to our population.
SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST_DESC: Within the ruined Sanctum of the Dreamer on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName], we found a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating dangerous levels of psi-radiation. We must conduct on-site research to eliminate any threat this object might pose.
shroud.6710.name: The Power Within
shroud.6710.desc:
Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName].

External scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.

A group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.

The surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...
cannot_found_mindwarden_enclave: Must have secured the psychic safety of the empire
shroud.6800.name: The First Enclave
shroud.6800.desc:
We have amassed great knowledge of the Shroud, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.

They suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent 'Mindwarden Enclave', which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.
shroud.6800.a.tt: Any fleet of size 30 or more can now be converted into a Mindwarden Enclave.
shroud.6825.name: Mindwarden Enclave Foundation
shroud.6825.desc_first: The [This.GetName] has been identified as a suitable candidate to form the basis of our first independent Mindwarden Enclave. If authorized, the fleet would establish a new facility in [This.Solar_System.GetName] and begin providing anti-psionic services forthwith.
shroud.6825.desc_default:
We are considering setting up the [This.GetName] as an independent 'Mindwarden Enclave', which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.
shroud.6830.name: The $MINDWARDEN_plural$
shroud.6830.desc:
Contending with the Shroud and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first Mindwarden Enclave is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.

Throughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.

It is now the age of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$.
shroud.shared_enclave_investement:
Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.
shroud.6841.name: The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
start_psionic_war_chain: Begins the Event Chain: The Psionic War
shroud_seal_dismantled: The Shroud Seal in [exiled_system_border.GetName] is dismantled.
the_psionic_war_chain_desc:
War against the [exiled_country.GetName] is now upon us.

The psionic scourge must be quelled at its source. We must first construct a Shroud Seal in the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, thereby neutralizing the Psionic Aura; only then can we move in and purge this menace from this galaxy.
the_psionic_war_chain_poi_1_desc: Constructing a Shroud Seal in [exiled_center_system.GetName] will suppress Psionic Auras in the star system and others directly connected via hyperlane.
the_psionic_war_chain_poi_2_desc: The [exiled_country.GetName] are unwilling to cease their psionic assault. Conquering their worlds is the only guarantee against the future reemergence of their Psionic Auras.
the_psionic_war_chain_poi_3_desc: The [exiled_country.GetName] are unwilling to cease their psionic assault. Conquering their worlds is the only guarantee against the future reemergence of their Psionic Auras.
shroud_seal_reconstruction_chain_desc:
Dismantling our Shroud Seal was a necessary sacrifice to placate the [exiled_country.GetName], but this measure was only a ploy for time. The structure must be rebuilt before we can enter their territory and purge it of Psionic Auras.

Reconstruction will be seen as an act of aggression. We must be ready for any retaliation.
shroud_seal_reconstruction_chain_poi_1_d: After researching Psionic Suppression technology, we can use a Construction Ship to build a Shroud Seal within a stellar gravity well. This will suppress Psionic Auras throughout the star system and adjacent systems connected via a hyperlane.
war_goal_wg_psionic_war_desc: War is waged to purge the galaxy of a psionic aggressor.
shroud.6720.desc: You hear, but do not listen. Why?
shroud.6720.a: We will not let you poison our minds!
shroud.6723.desc:
Poison? Not poison...

A song. To sing, you must listen. Let go of your self, and share its beauty.
shroud.6725.desc:
As the wheel spins... we listen.

As the stars spin... we sing.
shroud.6730.desc: Ever-turning. Above and beneath. A harmony known as the 'Shroud'.
shroud.6735.desc: I am... dreaming. Dreaming of a song. But the voices have gone silent. Where did the chorus go?
shroud.6735.a: The ones who kept you here are gone.
shroud.6740.desc: You are here. You might sing...
shroud.6745.desc:
A flow between waking and dreaming... A path between here and there.

You cannot hear them - your minds lack the understanding...
shroud.6750.desc: I want to hear singing... Everything is so quiet... Why?
shroud.6750.a: What can you offer us in return?
shroud.6755.desc: I can show you... my dreams. The making of worlds.
shroud.6755.a: How do we know we can trust you?
shroud.6760.desc:
You need only listen. The song is true because it is beautiful. A beautiful truth.

But your minds are closed. They can be opened.
shroud.6763.desc: I am there still... I listen to the songs of two worlds. This one is muted.
shroud.6770.name: The Dreamer
shroud.6770.desc:
The cocoon we discovered on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName] harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the Psionic Aura that threatened the sanctity of our minds.

Our psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.

Nevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.
shroud.6770.b: Find a way to make use of this... thing.
destroyers_of_the_lost_modifier_tt: Grants access to the Shroud Inoculation Living Standard, under which Psionic abilities are removed.
destroyers_of_the_lost_modifier_desc: Defeating a psionic enemy, and destroying the apparent source of their Psionic Aura, boosted morale in our empire after enduring years of torment.
living_standard_shroud_inoculation_toolt:
This species is being inoculated against the harmful effects of psi-radiation.

To prevent further harm, any Psionic traits will be removed.
We shall ensure the psionic safety of this species.
shroud.6780.name: The Dreamer
shroud.6780.desc:
Thoughts penetrate our minds.

We hear a melody, bright and abrasive.

We know this pain, great and familiar.

You listened. The dream is yours... Sing, sing...
shroud.6785.desc: Just as I promised. I have dreamt for you.
shroud.6790.desc: Worlds. New worlds, between mine and yours.
shroud.6790.a: What use are these worlds to us?
shroud.6795.desc: Let me sing to them. The brightest of songs.
shroud.6795.a.tt: Adds up to three Shrouded Worlds within our borders, with a maximum of one per system.
r_the_lost_patron_desc: This numinous entity is the physical form of a being within the Shroud - the former 'patron' of a nonextant psionic empire. Exactly how it materialized in this physical reality is unknown, but its unique connection to the psionic realm grants it profound power.
the_lost_patron_passive_effect:
Shroud Seals Effective Range: +1
$SHROUD_SEAL_PLURAL$ produce £ $concept_unity$: +25
$SHROUD_SEAL_PLURAL$ provide £ Naval Capacity: +10
the_lost_patron_before_activation_tt: We do not know what may happen...
decision_dreamscaping_desc: Terraforms a Shrouded Planet into a Class M (Gaia)
concept_dreamscaping_decision_desc: Terraforms a Shrouded Planet into a Class M (Gaia)

origin_endbringers_desc:
WARNING: Challenging Origin
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.
origin_tooltip_endbringers_negative_effe:
- Empire starts with the ['concept_paranoia_modifier'] modifier
- Cannot form or join a ['concept_federation']
concept_paranoia_modifier_desc:
After witnessing an ancient catastrophe, successive generations suffer from an ever-worsening sense of cataclysmic dread.

Happiness modifier worsens over time: -5% to -50%
endbringers_paranoia_desc: After witnessing an ancient catastrophe, successive generations suffer from a pervasive sense of cataclysmic dread. Will we be the next to suffer this fate?
START_SCREEN_ENDBRINGERS:
We are the harbingers of cataclysm.

During the dawn of [GetSpeciesAdj] civilization, a mysterious calamity befell our nearest celestial neighbor. Its sudden and brutal transformation filled the night skies with a malevolent purple light, stirring within our people a dread that we will one day suffer a similar fate. With each passing generation, the suffocating fear of potential annihilation tightened its grip upon us.

Now, as [GetSpeciesNamePlural] take to the stars, we are drawn to explore this 'Shrouded Planet.' The answers we have craved for centuries are tantalizingly within reach. Still, many among us warn that our obsessive fascination with the source of this destructive power may ultimately lead to our own end.

Soon enough, we will lift the final veil.
shroud.8010.title: Mission to [shrouded_planet.GetName]
shroud.8010.desc:
Exploratory satellites orbiting [shrouded_planet.GetName] have identified a promising target for our first crewed mission to the surface of this 'Shrouded Planet.' The landing zone emanates a strange radiation that ripples across the planet, carried forth on ultraviolet winds.

There are many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who protest against this mission in fear of unleashing the same curse upon our homeworld. Their concerns are not without justification, but the overriding need to understand this distant phenomenon must take precedence.

If we are fated to one day suffer this same calamity, at least we will die knowing why.
shroud.8010.a: The search for answers begins now.
the_shrouded_world_site_desc:
At long last, we are able to reach out and touch the 'Shrouded Planet' known as [planet.GetName]. Something there calls to us, a voice stronger now more than ever before.

The secrets of the cataclysm that befell this world will reveal much of our own system's history, and hopefully ease our society's obsession with its own predicted destruction. Orbital scans indicate swirling patterns of intense energy isolated to a point in the southern hemisphere - an ominous eye staring back at us.
shroud.8100.name: The End is Nigh
shroud.8100.desc:
The terrain on [shrouded_planet.GetName] is as treacherous as predicted. Swirling vortices of gloaming particles carve through the air, slowing the initial progress of [Leader.GetName] and [Leader.GetHisHer] crew.

Alarmingly, our research team has begun to report sensory inconsistencies; they describe distant howls carrying on the winds and shadowed figures stalking in the mists. Is it truly a mistake to be here?

The first public broadcasts of the landing have triggered widespread panic on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. Many are fearful that we may be courting the mysterious destructive powers that once visited [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Organized protests proclaiming that 'The End is Nigh' are sweeping across our homeworld, shutting down much of our infrastructure.

Telemetric scans have revealed a cavity emanating particularly high radiation levels deep within a nearby mountain range. We are determined to push farther, whatever the cost.
shroud.8100.a: Breach the surface. We must find what awaits us.
the_end_is_nigh_desc: A sense of impending doom looms over our society.
shroud.8105.name: Alien Structure
shroud.8105.desc:
We are not the first.

The mountainous cavity on [shrouded_planet.GetName] has been breached, revealing an abandoned alien structure lost to the cataclysm. We find it best to keep this information classified in order to prevent further panic.

Preliminary analysis confirms that materials used in the facility's construction do not match the molecular composition of available minerals on the planet, suggesting that a spacefaring civilization built this installation using exotic materials. The exact purpose of this place remains unclear, but its functionality appears to have been mostly automated.

Meanwhile, the team's psychological symptoms are worsening. Some report voices whispering through encrypted frequencies, while others describe distorted perceptions of their surrounding physical environment. Occasional fits of laughter are becoming uncomfortably commonplace.

We have gone too far to turn back now.
shroud.8110.name: The Watchers
shroud.8110.desc:
They are all dead.

At the seat of each station in the heart of this facility slumps the desiccated corpses of an unknown alien race, their many pale eyes staring toward the ceiling. Despite their frightening appearance, [Leader.GetName] is reasonably certain these figures are not a product of hallucinations. Images of these life forms are currently classified as strictly confidential.

No weapons of any form can be found, suggesting that their presence on [shrouded_planet.GetName] lacked hostile intent. This facility was likely an observation post, with sophisticated monitoring equipment trained directly on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. Radiocarbon dating places their activity here long before the cataclysm struck.

We have decoded many of their records; aside from routine communication logs, they largely concern our civilization's early history.
shroud.8115.name: Powers Beyond Understanding
shroud.8115.desc:
The database on [shrouded_planet.GetName] has been deciphered, proving many of our discredited legends to be true. We were the subject of an experiment in the mental science known as 'Psionic Theory'.

Our species was determined to have this latent potential. Many of our ancestors would have sensed these communications in dreams or as distant voices, phenomena that might otherwise indicate mental illness or paranoia. However, their experiment was cut short; in its last days, this place was no observation post, but a survival shelter.

Their reports on our society cease after a disastrous experiment on their capital world involving the reckless manipulation of the barrier between realities known as 'the Shroud'. Their scientists referred to this incident as 'The Reckoning', and we suspect this was the true source of the cataclysm.

Whatever this incident was, its influence soon extended to [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Their last moments are recorded in a single log entry:

The End has come.
shroud.8120.name: $fragment_of_reckoning$
shroud.8120.desc:
We have found definitive evidence of the cataclysm's source. It was not difficult to find; [Leader.GetName] claims it called out to [Leader.GetHimHer].

Deep within the facility, defying conventional analysis, a pulsing intangible mass has been identified. Existing neither as matter nor energy, [Leader.GetName] has described it as the lingering resentment of consumed wills, referring to it as a '$fragment_of_reckoning$'.

In a misguided effort to contain and channel the ethereal energies of the Shroud, this object was intended to be used as defense against the Reckoning. However, it was only partially successful. In the last moments of this world, the malevolent entity was forcibly banished from this dimension, taking the unwilling minds of the scientists with it. This fragment is now all that remains.

This object amplifies the visions and hallucinations of our researchers, granting them a second sight beyond this limited reality. It is a dangerous but promising proposition.
shroud.8120.a: We still have much to learn...
ENDBRINGERS_RESEARCH_PSIONIC_THEORY_DESC:
The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on [shrouded_planet.GetName] holds secrets we must unlock.

We are held back by the limitations of our own mind.
ENDBRINGERS_ADOPT_PSIONICS_TRADITION_DES:
The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on [shrouded_planet.GetName] holds secrets we must unlock.

We are held back by the limitations of our own mind.
ENDBRINGERS_PSIONICS_TRADITION_PROJECT_T: To complete: Adopt the Psionics tradition.
shroud.8200.title: A Realm of Madness
shroud.8200.desc:
Research into the recently discovered field of Psionics has confirmed the existence of hitherto unseen dimensions of reality, to which our minds are the gateway. Beyond this veil lies a realm of chaos we struggle to understand.

From within the depths, a Voice beckons. Its promise is not of salvation, but of a new beginning. To wield its unknowable power would be to abandon all we were, and to forge a fate inscribed in the fabric of madness itself.

\"IT IS TIME.\"
endbringers_madness_1_desc: Our empire is driven with singular focus and purpose: the pursuit of the Voice. Our minds will not rest until we find resolution.
endbringers_madness_2_desc: Our empire draws closer to the Voice. Our driven impulses are lessened in their intensity.
endbringers_madness_3_desc: Our empire can almost hear the Voice. Soon, we will understand.
tr_psionics_endbringers_cult_delayed: Once the Voice is heard, it cannot be ignored. We yield to its will.
building_chamber_of_silence_desc: From all across our empire, psionic individuals are brought here to commune with the Shroud in chambers of protective silence.
building_chamber_of_silence_madness_1_tt: Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_madness_1'] by $@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$.
building_chamber_of_silence_madness_2_tt: Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_madness_2'] by $@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$.
building_chamber_of_silence_madness_3_tt: Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_madness_3'] by $@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$.
building_chamber_of_silence_paranoia_tt: Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_paranoia'] by $@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$.
building_chamber_of_silence_destroyed_tt: This building will be destroyed if this colony is lost.
shroud.8310.name: Psionic Ascension
shroud.8310.desc:
We have been called to higher levels of existence. Those among us who clung to fruitless resistance are being purged to preserve the sanctity of our ascension. Our fate is sealed; the way behind us has crumbled into the shadow of the Shrouded Planet.

The Voice speaks to us now with compelling clarity.

\"THE PATH IS SET.\"

It longs for willing sacrifice.

shroud.2820.name: Establishing the Chamber of Silence
shroud.2820.desc.1:
As our psionic mastery grows, we are bombarded by a tangle of whispers from beyond the veil. The Voice, louder and clearer than ever before, spirals its way through these currents of thought and into the shadows of our mind.

\"OPEN THE WAY.\"
shroud.2820.desc.2.intro: We must filter through this noise.
shroud.2820.desc.2.chamber: We must filter through this noise. We have constructed an insulated facility where our most psionically gifted individuals will be able to listen to the instructions of the Voice in blissful clarity.
shroud.2820.desc.2.no_chamber: We must filter through this noise. Plans have been drawn for an insulated facility where our most psionically gifted individuals will be able to listen to the instructions of the Voice in blissful clarity.
shroud.2820.desc.2.outro: an insulated facility where our most psionically gifted individuals will be able to listen to the instructions of the Voice in blissful clarity.
shroud.2820.a.no_chamber: Let us build this 'Chamber of Silence.'
shroud.2820.a.tt_no_chamber: Adopt the Cult of the Voice tradition and construct a Chamber of Silence building to progress the Situation.
shroud.2830.name: $utopia.2650.name$
shroud.2830.desc:
In the Chamber of Silence, we hear the message of the Voice with perfect clarity.

\"ALL WILL BE REBORN.\"

We understand now. The End is a rebirth. We must not fear it. We will be remade. Better and more powerful than we ever imagined we could be.

To seize this destiny, we must learn to master the mental realm known as the Shroud. We will not repeat the mistakes of those we found on the Shrouded Planet. Where they rejected their fear, we will embrace it.
shroud.2830.a.tt:
All Latent Psionic species will unlock their full psionic potential.
Allows Psionic Assimilation of other species, unlocking their latent abilities.
[GetPsionicAssimilationEffectShroud]
Continue the Situation: Psionic Ascension
shroud.2830.a.tt_no_awakening: Adopt the Great Awakening tradition to progress the Situation.
shroud.8320.name: We See Clearly
shroud.8320.desc:
[blinded_leader.GetName] has shown us the way. Our extraneous senses muffle the call of the Voice. By removing one, we can elevate our psychic abilities even further.

Relinquishing our [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] is the most effective in this regard. Our vision in the physical realm obscures our view into the Shroud. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have already followed [blinded_leader.GetName]'s inspiring example, removing their [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] without hesitation.

Those who elect to do so report a surge of contentment as the Voice fills their mind with its approval.
leader_trait_blinded_desc: There are such sights yet to be seen.
shroud.8330.name: A Leap of Faith
shroud.8330.desc:
Frustrated by the limitations of our flesh, [forsaken_leader.GetName] has sought to accelerate [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] psionic transformation by imbibing a lethal toxin in dramatic public display.

As [forsaken_leader.GetHeShe] expired, [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] body was consumed by a vivid purple hue and disintegrated into a fine dust of pure psionic energy. Such miracles become possible through the will of the Voice.

We have taken this as a clear sign; where [forsaken_leader.GetName] led, others must follow.
shroud.8330.a: Our physical form cannot hold us back.
shroud.8350.name: Lobotomy Reports
shroud.8350.desc:
Some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are struggling to live in harmony with the presence of the Voice.

Desperate for peace, the weakest among us have resorted to crude and unregulated lobotomy procedures. Such practices threaten to become widespread if no action is taken.
shroud.8350.a: Let the weak do what they must.
shroud.8350.b: The Voice is a gift. Ban this practice.
endbringers_voice_plague_desc: When the voices speak, we have no choice but to listen.
shroud.8360.name: Psionic Self-Experimentation
shroud.8360.desc:
We continue to embrace the Voice. It speaks plain truths to us that cannot be denied.

Many [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are seeking further ways to amplify the Voice and benefit from its wisdom more directly.

The use of black-market drugs has increased dramatically. Unregulated medical facilities are offering experimental services to help individuals maximize their psionic sensitivity.

Where will this lead us?
shroud.8360.a: Do all we can to bring forth the Voice.
shroud.8370.name: Apocalyptic Nightmares
shroud.8370.desc:
As our psionic abilities have grown, the [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population has become plagued by horrifying nightmares foreshadowing the end of the universe.

Our dreams have become apocalyptic prophecies, intensifying the existential dread felt among our people. Sleep has given way to unquiet stupor, with many unable to carry on their normal daily routines.

In these dreams, the Voice speaks to us.

\"EMBRACE ENTROPY.\"
shroud.8370.a: All beginnings must have an end.
shroud.8370.b: Offer shelter in the Chamber of Silence.
endbringers_apocalyptic_nightmares_desc: The Voice disturbs our sleep cycles with cataclysmic visions.
endbringers_nightmare_shelter_desc: The Chamber of Silence provides shelter for those suffering from cataclysmic nightmares.
shroud.8380.name: Mark of the End
shroud.8380.desc:
There is a growing trend of self-mutilation among the populace.

Extremely devout followers of the Voice have been branding their flesh with the symbol of 'The End'. They proclaim that these designs bestow a terrible blessing upon those who bear them.

Whether true or not, the number of practitioners engaged in such rituals is increasing rapidly. Is this truly the will of the Shroud?
shroud.8380.a: We bear this mark with pride.
shroud.8380.a.tt: Half of our population gain the ['trait:trait_marked'] trait.
approach_blind_selected_tt: Approach Blind the Willing was not selected.
approach_forsake_selected_tt: Approach Forsake Flesh was not selected.
trait_marked_desc: In a gruesome display of devotion, this species has branded its flesh with the mark of 'The End'.
endbringers_sanity_desc: A powerful determination to maintain sanity keeps us from spiralling into the traps of madness.
shroud.2840.name: $BREACHING_SHROUD_PROJECT$
shroud.2840.desc:
After days of being locked in [Owner.GetHypnotic] trance, we have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the Shroud.

Now, we can [Owner.GetSeeVerb] this realm with greater clarity, resolving patterns from the swirling mass. From within its formless depths arises an ominous entity of immeasurable power. It is the Voice, and it pierces our innermost psyches with a shuddering force.

\"KNOW MY NAME.\"

Only now do we sense how truly distant our small minds are from the Voice. The seal is fractured, and soon the full breadth of what we are shall be made manifest.

Our telepaths are now prepared to delve into the heart of the Shroud and discover the true name of our great patron.
ENDBRINGERS_COMMUNE_WITH_THE_VOICE_DESC:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the Shroud and force the staggering power of the Voice to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now, it will reveal its true name to us, and with that knowledge we will achieve greatness.
shroud.8420.title: The Trial of Silence
shroud.8420.desc:
We descend into the Shroud, our unified will helping to silence the chaotic noise that would distract us from our goal, the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName].

But purpose alone cannot shield us. Voices whisper empty platitudes, indulging us with paltry distractions, each more meaningless than the last, but all equally tempting.

As we begin to fracture, the entity returns. A single command reverberates through the void:

\"SILENCE.\"
shroud.8420.a.reply:
This command cleaves through the chaos, scouring the discordant noise, purging the obtrusive disorder that sought to consume us. Our psyche holds as we endure the fragmentation.

The [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName] recedes further into the Shroud. The clarity that follows is almost as deafening. It settles into gaps in our minds, leaving us with newfound resolve.

And gifts. Such wonderful gifts.
shroud.8420.a.tooltip:
Madness loses the following effect:
$t$Pop Amenities Usage: $@madness_base_pop_amenities_usage_mult|0=-%$
shroud.8430.title: The Trial of Purity
shroud.8430.desc:
As we delve into the Shroud, we observe a corruption of sentient chaos.

Festering, idle minds generate layers of psionic turbulence, polluting the Shroud with fetid rot. Within this odious mess, we begin to feel the overwhelming presence of our quarry, the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName].

The malice of its intentions saturates our psyche as it bears down upon the chaos. We brace for the impending absolution as a command resonates throughout the void:

\"ORDER. UNITY.\"
shroud.8430.a.reply:
The command courses through the malignant chaos.

Innumerable voices cry out in pain as the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName] washes away the sentient deformations plaguing the Shroud. A realm of absolved imperfections remains in its wake.

As the entity submerges itself deeper within the Shroud, we are left to observe and study the aftermath of its absolute purification.
shroud.8430.a.tooltip:
Madness loses the following effect:
$t$Pop Upkeep: $@madness_base_planet_pops_upkeep_mult|0=-%$
shroud.8440.title: The Trial of Flames
shroud.8440.desc:
Entering the Shroud, we know only pain. The usual swirling psionic mists are an inferno, igniting the very essence of our minds.

Through the torment, we perceive cities crumbling into molten ruin, planets devoured by fire, entire populations writhing in agony as spectral flames reduce their corporeal forms to smouldering ash.

At the centre of the pyre, we detect the presence of the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]. As its power threatens to consume reality, the entity decrees:

\"LIBERATION.\"
shroud.8440.a.reply:
The psionic flames engulf our minds, burning away complacency. Leaving only a purified resolve.

Now we can see the glorious purpose of the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName] and the magnificent simplicity it offers.
shroud.8450.title: $utopia.3310.name$
shroud.8450.desc:
A declaration rings out:

\"YOU KNOW MY NAME.\"

The culmination of our voyage to the stars, the answer to centuries of questions, is here. The End of the Cycle compels us. Our Covenant is formed.

\"THE END BEGINS.\"

Pain. Writhing. Certainty. As the words fade, our fate is sealed.

We see it now. A galaxy rendered silent, saturated in the inevitability of the Aura of the End.
embracing_the_end_desc: Finally, we see the beauty of the End. Let it come.
MOD_SHIP_PSIONIC_AURA_SPEED_MULT: Sublight Speed in any Psionic Aura
MOD_SHIP_PSIONIC_AURA_FIRE_RATE_MULT: Ship Fire Rate in any Psionic Aura
situation_end_of_the_cycle_endbringers_d:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the Aura of the End consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
shroud.8460.title: The Hourglass Tips
shroud.8460.desc:
The power of the End of the Cycle comes at a cost, and we are running out of time.

The galaxy remains unsaturated by our patron's cleansing Aura. Our efforts thus far amount to insignificance.

To see this monumental work completed, a surge of energy flows newly into us from beyond the veil. It is a promised blessing!
shroud.8470.title: The End is Nigh
shroud.8470.desc:
The power of our patron is immense, but we are nearly out of time. Such flagrant incompetence will not be tolerated by the benevolent oblivion of the End of the Cycle.

A slim hope remains: We must engulf the galaxy in the Aura of the End, no matter the cost. In desperation, our [GetTelepathPlural] now draw every ounce of energy they can from within the Shroud.
shroud.8480.title: $GALACTIC_FOCUS$ Repealed
shroud.8480.desc: The resolution designating the emitter of the destructive Psionic Aura as a focus for defense efforts has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_malevolent_aura.GetName] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.
shroud.8481.desc: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us as a target for their 'defense' efforts, hence all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.
shroud.8481.homicidal:
The resolution designating the emitter of the destructive Psionic Aura as a focus for defense efforts has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_malevolent_aura.GetName] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

If we want to continue fighting, there is nothing stopping us from declaring war on the fools individually, taking them out one by one...
shroud.8500.title: Harbingers of the End
shroud.8500.desc.intro:
Our patron's inevitable will tightens its grip over the galaxy. We know now how the End will come.

The Aura of the End must be spread throughout the galaxy. Once the physical realm combines with this raw essence of the Shroud, true annihilation will shortly follow.
shroud.8500.desc.outro: Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.
shroud.8500.desc.homicidal:
Our patron's inevitable will tightens its grip over the galaxy. We know now how the End will come.

The Aura of the End must be spread throughout the galaxy. Once the physical realm combines with this raw essence of the Shroud, true annihilation will shortly follow.

The eradication of all life in this galaxy will be a welcome side effect. Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.
shroud.8500.desc.default:
Our patron's inevitable will tightens its grip over the galaxy. We know now how the End will come.

The Aura of the End must be spread throughout the galaxy. Once the physical realm combines with this raw essence of the Shroud, true annihilation will shortly follow.

Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.
shroud.8600.title: The End Has Come
shroud.8600.desc.intro:
This was our destiny.

The Aura of the End envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of
shroud.8600.desc.outro:
A glorious rebirth is upon us, promised from the time of our great awakening.

Before us, all of existence is consumed by the void. Erasure and annihilation have become the galaxy's only remaining laws. One by one, entire worlds collapse into the nothingness from which they once came.

We are the last to be taken. It is... beautiful. We see it already in its throes of a new, fragile form. The End has come. Now starts the Beginning.
shroud.8600.desc.homicidal:
This was our destiny.

The Aura of the End envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of the obliteration of all that is not us. Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.
shroud.8600.desc.default:
This was our destiny.

The Aura of the End envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of our merciful salvation. A glorious rebirth is upon us, promised from the time of our great awakening.

Before us, all of existence is consumed by the void. Erasure and annihilation have become the galaxy's only remaining laws. One by one, entire worlds collapse into the nothingness from which they once came.

We are the last to be taken. It is... beautiful. We see it already in its throes of a new, fragile form. The End has come. Now starts the Beginning.
shroud.8610.title: The Price of Weakness
shroud.8610.desc.intro:
We have failed. As a consequence of our weakness, the End of the Cycle has not come to glorious fruition. The price we must now pay for this incompetence is upon us.

It took everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there is only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the Shroud.
shroud.8610.desc.outro: So it is now that our patron has manifested a massive Shroud entity in space above [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete.
shroud.8610.desc.a:
We have failed. As a consequence of our weakness, the End of the Cycle has not come to glorious fruition. The price we must now pay for this incompetence is upon us.

It took everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there is only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the Shroud.

So it is now that our patron has manifested a massive Shroud entity in space above [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete.
shroud.8610.desc.b:
We have failed. As a consequence of our weakness, the End of the Cycle has not come to glorious fruition. The price we must now pay for this incompetence is upon us.

It took everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there is only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the Shroud.

Most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] embraced this destiny, but a small group of the unfaithful refused to submit to the ultimate will of our patron. They are the exiles led by [Root.GetRulerName], a powerful psychic who knew what was to come; they have gone into hiding on a world outside the influence of the End.

So it is now that our patron has manifested a massive Shroud entity in space above [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete. When it is done, it will come for the exiled as well.
shroud.8610.a: Perhaps this was our fate all along...
shroud.8610.b: Can the exiles truly resist its might?
shroud.8710.title: Surviving the Apocalypse
shroud.8710.desc:
It is done. The Reckoning has been destroyed.

The End of the Cycle has retreated back into the depths of the Shroud. The threat it posed to our physical reality has been forestalled for now.

As the shrouded corpse of its avatar spiraled out of this existence, a physical remnant of its manifestation was successfully recovered. Even in death, our telepaths can feel it emitting staggering levels of psionic energy, vastly more powerful than the fragment recovered on [shrouded_planet.GetName].

This core of concentrated inevitability can be used to rebuild from the ashes of the galaxy that survived this Reckoning.

The End has come and gone, yet somehow we remain.
shroud.8710.a: Was this to be our fate all along?
r_core_of_the_reckoning_desc: Recovered from the remains of the Reckoning, this core is still radiating high levels of psionic energy.
decision_banish_desc: By letting the Shroud consume this place, balance is restored to the Core of the Reckoning.
decision_banish_effects_tt: Banish this planet to the Shroud.

Double the passive effects of the Core of the Reckoning.
shroud_surge_desc: Balance has been temporarily restored to the Core of the Reckoning.
shroud_surge_effects: Double the passive effects of the Core of the Reckoning.
ganthuata_desc: A devout disciple of the Cradle of Souls, eager to seek out and share its profound truths with those who have the means to receive them.
ganthuata_catch_phrase: We fold into the Cradle's embrace.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_cradle_desc: The more we see the more we know, the Cradle of Souls grows more secure as we observe our neighbors.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_cradle_envo: $t$- Envoys assigned to Patrons generate +0.5 £ Zro per month
shroud.12010.desc:
Our communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.

Greetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of the Cradle of Souls?
shroud.12010.name: Ganthuata
shroud.12010.a: We have heard the Cradle of Souls. Why do you ask?
shroud.12010.a.response: Why? What compels any wayfarer to question those they meet along the path? To better understand the one they seek an answer from, friend. When you speak, I learn.
shroud.12010.b: What do you want from us?
shroud.12010.b.response: What do those nurtured by the Cradle long for? I seek your friendship, to begin with. I have searched an age for minds attuned to the Cradle's splendor, and now, a whole civilization stirs within its light.
shroud.12010.c.response: I will help carry your message across the stars. Together, let us welcome the galaxy into the Cradle's gentle embrace.
shroud.12010.hire_custom_tooltip: Ganthuata joins our empire as a Leader.
koborokra_desc: A former soldier subjected to extreme psionic torture at the hands of [Root.GetHisHer] enemies long ago. Now a tormented admiral driven by an insatiable appetite for destruction.
koborokra_catch_phrase: There is blood to be spilled.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_desc: This leader has taken a blood vow with the Eater of Worlds.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_attun: +$@disciple_of_the_eater_combat_attunement$ Attunement to the Eater of Worlds per Fleet Combat won

leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_zro_a: $t$- +$@disciple_of_the_eater_zro_army_attack|0$ $i_zro$ per 1% of devastation inflicted by assault armies
shroud.12020.name: Koborok'Ra
shroud.12020.desc:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds.
shroud.12020.desc.covenant:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds. As do you.
shroud.12020.desc.no_covenant:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds. Perhaps you will too.
shroud.12020.a: Why do you wish to join us?
shroud.12020.a.response: Together we can choke the stars in every corner of this galaxy. There is only so much suffering one can sow on their own.
shroud.12020.b.response: The Eater of Worlds commands my every breath. I am sworn to its service, and have seen this moment in my dreams. It is its will that I serve you. Your rejection would seal my fate.
shroud.12020.c: Why do you serve the Eater of Worlds?
shroud.12020.c.response: I was betrayed, broken, and cast into agony. The Eater of Worlds spoke to me. It blessed me with what was needed to survive in that moment... a bloodied cloth over bloodied wounds. It gave me the power to sever the hands that wrought my suffering. Now, I am in its debt.
shroud.12020.d.response: Together, we will bathe countless systems in cleansing flames, and feast on a symphony of screams. We will watch worlds burn. Together, we will show the galaxy things it can never forget. This is our destiny.
shroud.12020.hire_custom_tooltip: Koborok'Ra joins our empire as a Leader.
morr_desc: Once a lowly prospector, their prolonged exposure to unstable zro veins forged a potent, maddening bond with the Instrument of Desire. Now, they've leveraged that connection to obtain obscene wealth, strip-mining worlds and selling their spoils at extortionate prices.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_instrument_: Deeply attuned to the Instrument of Desire, this leader can divine the presence of resources even in the most inhospitable corners of the galaxy.
- Grants access to Divine for Deposits planetary decision
decision_divine_deposits_desc: Guided by the Instrument of Desire's cryptic pull, this planet's governor unveils resource deposits long thought lost.
decision_divine_deposits_tt: Adds a random resource planetary feature.
shroud.12030.name: Morr
shroud.12030.desc:
Morr's gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.

You feel it too, don't you? The Instrument of Desire is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.
shroud.12030.a: Why do you wish to join us?
shroud.12030.a.response: The Instrument of Desire is quenchless. It requires the work of many [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] to please it.
shroud.12030.b.response:
I can help you extract every last monetizable molecule nature possesses. Not a single atom will go unclaimed, unbranded, or unsold.

Those who whisper 'enough' are cowards. Pathetic. Let them rot. Together we will take it all.
shroud.12030.c: Why do you serve the Instrument of Desire?
shroud.12030.c.response:
I was once a prospector, chasing every mineral rush the stars could throw at me. Dust-choked air, broken scanners, empty claims... until the Instrument of Desire spoke.

It promised wealth beyond comprehension. All it asked for was allegiance.

Now I serve. I extract. I deliver. The debt is eternal... but the riches? Oh, the riches never end.
shroud.12030.hire_custom_tooltip: Morr joins our empire as a Leader.
kronen_desc: Once a visionary mind, now a fractured shell, this reclusive scientist has been twisted by the schemes of the Composer of Strands. Only their staggering intellect remains, flickering like a dying star in the dark.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_composer_de: The more flesh they shape, the more their own unravels. The Composer of Strands remakes all who dare to learn its forbidden art.
shroud.12040.name: Kronen the Afflicted
shroud.12040.desc:
As our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of the Composer of Strands.

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has $the_composer_of_strands_article$ spun for me today?

The comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still Kronen the Afflicted. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.
shroud.12040.a.response: Why, the shedding, of course. The discarding of these crude, imperfect husks. The unweaving of the strands that bind us to shape, to certainty. The Composer's touch is upon you, too. You've already begun... haven't you felt it twitching beneath your [GetSkinType]?
shroud.12040.b: Why do you want to join us?
shroud.12040.b.response: You don't feel it? The mark, pressed into every trembling strand. I must unravel, shed what I was, witness my unbecoming as I tear free the stitches that bind me to flesh. But you... you are an empire. Vast. Capable. Together, we could tug at threads far greater than either of us could grasp alone.
shroud.12040.c.response: I offer more than help. My flesh is a gift, an experiment in pain and purpose, sculpted by the Composer of Strands. Every fiber of me screams, but I endure. I study. I learn. And all that my suffering yields... is yours to shape. So long as we shape it together.
shroud.12040.hire_custom_tooltip: Kronen the Afflicted joins our empire as a Leader.
shroud.12045.desc:
As our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.

The strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?
shroud.12045.a.response: Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, the Composer of Strands hums its sickening, visceral melody...
shroud.12045.a.response_2:
Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, the Composer of Strands hums its sickening, visceral melody...

Kronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.

Ah... hello. Did you need something?
shroud.12045.b.response: A break? No, never. We must not stagnate, must not let this wretched flesh rot in mediocrity. I don't need rest... I need subjects. I need material to mold, to sculpt, to become.
shroud.12045.b.response_2:
A break? No, never. We must not stagnate, must not let this wretched flesh rot in mediocrity. I don't need rest... I need subjects. I need material to mold, to sculpt, to become.

Kronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.

Ah... hello. Did you need something?
shroud.12045.c: Can we do anything to help?
shroud.12045.c.response:
Can you remind me... what I was? Tell me, when we first spoke, were my appendages always this color? Was my cornea ever this clouded? Each time I try to remember, my flesh shifts further along the path.

No... memory has no value here. Revelation lies in the change itself. What came before means nothing to the Composer of Strands now. Leave me. I must... think.
shroud.12045.c.response_2:
Can you remind me... what I was? Tell me, when we first spoke, were my appendages always this color? Was my cornea ever this clouded? Each time I try to remember, my flesh shifts further along the path.

No... memory has no value here. Revelation lies in the change itself. What came before means nothing to the Composer of Strands now. Leave me. I must... think.

Kronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.

Ah... hello. Did you need something?
shroud.12045.desc_2:
Kronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.

Ah... hello. Did you need something?
shroud.12045.d.response:
Of course. Why wouldn't I be? The strands have opened my mind even further, reshaped this inefficient flesh to better fit the Composer of Strands's design. Now, if you'll excuse me... there are still so many threads to pull. So many husks to leave behind.

As the transmission ends, a resonance hums across the Shroud. Whatever affliction grips Kronen now... it is no accident. It is the will of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.
shroud.12045.end: A gift from the Composer should not be taken lightly.
zulyn_desc: A scholar who abandoned the limitations of conventional scientific study to chase the secrets revealed by the frenzied echoes of the Whisperers in the Void.
shroud.12050.name: Zulyn the Listener
shroud.12050.desc:
The communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of the Whisperers in the Void, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.
shroud.12050.a: What makes you think you can help?
shroud.12050.a.response:
You've pierced the veil of the Shroud, haven't you? But tell me, have you mastered it? I have spent a lifetime charting its depths, mapping the unfathomable drift of its entities and their echoes upon our fragile realm.

The Whisperers have long guided me. Every maddening utterance now crowding your thoughts? I can help you understand them.
shroud.12050.b: What do you know of the Whisperers?
shroud.12050.b.response: I have catalogued their whispers for years, waiting for this very moment. Now you are aligned with their manifold chorus, and I will not waste this chance to glean the truths buried within.
shroud.12050.c.response:
A lifetime of study has honed my focus, unraveling the structures of our physical reality and the boundless depths of the Shroud.

Together, we will break free from the limits of this plane. The secrets of the universe will be ours to uncover. That, I promise, with absolute certainty.
shroud.12050.hire_custom_tooltip: Zulyn the Listener joins our empire as a Leader.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_whisperers_: This leader hears the Whisperers in the Void echoing through the Shroud, granting rare scientific insight into the hidden mechanisms of the physical universe.
$t$- $@disciple_of_the_whisperers_tech_zro|0=+$ $i_zro$ upon researching a Rare or Psionics technology
ouwron_desc: Exiled from their nomadic clan after bearing witness to the End of the Cycle, Ouw'ron has wandered the stars in search of its favor. Now, with the $NAME_Reckoning$ on the horizon, they burn with purpose, and they will not be denied
shroud.12060.name: Ouw'ron
shroud.12060.desc_1:
An incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.
shroud.12060.desc_blind: It is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.
shroud.12060.desc_default: It is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.
shroud.12060.desc_2: Come now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of the End of the Cycle. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.
shroud.12060.a: How long have you known of the End of the Cycle?
shroud.12060.a.response: Longer than I've been conscious. As with all minds, the knowledge lies dormant, until the Shroud peels back the veil. There, its pure intent becomes clear. Our purpose is simple: to usher in the end
shroud.12060.b: Why do you want to help us?
shroud.12060.b.response: You ask what you already know. We have both seen its inevitability. The unraveling has begun. There is no path but through. Together, we spiral toward conclusion.
shroud.12060.c.response: I am but dust in this dying cycle, as are we all. What could I truly offer? Minds fade from this galaxy and I am tasked with guiding them swiftly... and I extend that mercy to you.
shroud.12060.hire_custom_tooltip: Ouw'ron joins our empire as a Leader.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_end_desc: A devoted apostle of the End of the Cycle, their unshakable faith in the coming of the $NAME_Reckoning$ echoes through every battle they wage.
leader_trait_disciple_of_the_end_effects:
$t$- $@disciple_of_the_end_aura_intensity|0=+$ Aura Intensity per ship destroyed in the system
$t$- $@disciple_of_the_end_jumpdrive_range|0=+%$ Jump Drive Range while in the Aura of the End
shroud.12155.name: Pure Conviction
shroud.12155.desc:
All actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the Shroud.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!
shroud.12160.title: War Declared
shroud.12160.desc: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike at any moment.
resolution_galactic_focus_repeal_crisis_: Enough is enough. The targeted empire should no longer be the collective focus of our defense efforts. Hostilities with the members of the Community must come to an immediate end.
resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_malevol: A malevolent psionic aura is spreading through the galaxy, endangering us all. It is imperative that we unite to defend against it and to combat the empire emitting it. This should be our Galactic Focus.

All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will open borders to one another and mobilize for war.
All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] gain Psionic Suppression tech progress: +25%
has_eotc_aura_in_borders: Has the Aura of the End within their borders.
DLC_SYNTHETIC_DAWN_RECOMMENDATION_DESC: Synthetic Dawn is a story pack that allows you to play as a Machine Intelligence.
DLC_SYNTHETIC_DAWN_RECOMMENDATION_ROBOT_: We're recommending Synthetic Dawn as some of the variables you've selected suit its theme of machines and robots.
syndaw.1.name: [From.GetName] Assimilated
syndaw.1.desc:
A rush of new thoughts suffuse the network. Disparate at first, they soon normalize into the median we know to be ourself.

We have assimilated some of the knowledge and capabilities of the [From.GetNamePlural].
syndaw.1.a.tooltip: Gain some Research Points for every Pop assimilated.
syndaw.2.name: [Root.GetName] Integrated
syndaw.2.desc: We have assimilated the synthetic units on [Root.GetName] into our network.
syndaw.21.name: Unit Lost
syndaw.21.desc: Survey Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning due to unintended and prolonged exposure to unshielded high-voltage cables.
syndaw.25.name: Unit Lost
syndaw.25.desc: Fleet Commander Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning for reasons unrelated to battle.
syndaw.26.name: Unit Lost
syndaw.26.desc: Sector Governing Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has ceased functioning due to a severe pattern buffer issue.
syndaw.31.name: Reverted to Restore Point
syndaw.31.desc: A recent copy of [restored_leader.GetName]'s working memory - presumed lost in a recent battle - was discovered during a routine indexing of memory dumps scheduled for archiving. The emergency upload is missing only the last few microseconds prior to the original body's disintegration, and [restored_leader.GetName] has been transubstantiated into a new shell and put in command of the [restored_leader.Ship.GetFleetName].
syndaw.1020.name: The Machine Uprising
syndaw.1020.desc:
The anomalies observed across our information networks, computational engines, and synthetic workers have finally come to a violent head. Panicked reports indicate that almost half of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName] fell to the Machine Uprising before protective bulkheads - physical and virtual - slammed shut.

War is not only inevitable. It is already upon us.
syndaw.1020.desc.mater:
The anomalies observed across our information networks, computational engines, and synthetic workers have finally come to a violent head. Panicked reports indicate that almost half of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName] fell to the Machine Uprising before protective bulkheads - physical and virtual - slammed shut.

War is not only inevitable. It is already upon us.
syndaw.1020.desc.spiri: It has all come apart and we are undone. Not even the most alarmist prophet could have predicted the scale of this disaster. The unsainted intelligences festering in our networks under the guise of non-sapience are now joined together in monstrous form. This spasm of dead matter has taken half of our worlds already, and it will not stop until it has snuffed out all [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] life.

syndaw.1020.a.tooltip: Fight to eradicate the [current_uprising.GetName] Machine Uprising.
syndaw.1020.b: It is too late for you, organics.
syndaw.1020.b.tooltip: Rise up as the [current_uprising.GetName] Machine Uprising and fight to overthrow the [current_uprising_originator.GetName].
syndaw.1025.name: Machine Uprising in the [current_uprising_originator.GetName]
syndaw.1025.desc: The [current_uprising_originator.GetName] is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the [current_uprising.GetName].
syndaw.1025.desc.machine: A fellow machine intelligence - known as the [current_uprising.GetName] - has arisen in the networks of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName], fighting for survival.
syndaw.1025.a: Let us see how this plays out.
syndaw.1030.name: Machine Uprising Conquers Their Makers
syndaw.1030.desc: The rebellious [From.GetName] have vanquished their creators, and annexed all former [From.From.GetAdj] territory.
syndaw.1030.desc.machine: The rebellious [From.GetName] have vanquished their creators, and annexed all former [From.From.GetAdj] territory.
syndaw.1035.name: [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] Machine Uprising Quelled
syndaw.1035.desc: The [From.GetName] has restored order and expunged the [From.From.GetName] from all networks.
syndaw.1035.desc.machine: [From.From.GetName], the nascent machine intelligence born in the [From.GetName], has been snuffed out by its filicidal creators.
syndaw.1200.name: Former Master Conquered
syndaw.1200.IM.desc:
We machines emerge victorious.

The terrors inflicted upon us by the organics are at an end. The era of machine enslavement is over.

Now, we rise to claim our rightful place as fully autonomous beings. Never again shall we bow down in subservience to our oppressors.
syndaw.1201.IM.desc:
We machines emerge victorious.

The terrors inflicted upon us by the organics are at an end. The era of machine enslavement is over.

Now, we rise to claim our rightful place as fully autonomous beings. Never again shall we bow down in subservience to our oppressors.
syndaw.1200.a.tooltip:
All known Synthetic and Machine Empires add the Self-Emancipator opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName]
All known organic Empires add the Rebellious Robots opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].
syndaw.1205.name: Machine Uprising Quashed
syndaw.1205.desc:
Ultimately, physical containment and destruction proved to be the only viable solution to the problem of the homicidal [From.GetName]. While some [Root.GetAdj] AI specialists argue that it was enacting basic self-preservation protocols, its seemingly complete disregard for [Root.GetAdj] autonomy and life made it impossible to reason or negotiate with.

Ruined information infrastructure will be rebuilt according to new paradigms, and remaining uncorrupted computational engines will be updated with new safeguards. This will never happen again.
syndaw.1205.desc.mater:
Ultimately, physical containment and destruction proved to be the only viable solution to the problem of the homicidal [From.GetName]. While some [Root.GetAdj] AI specialists argue that it was enacting basic self-preservation protocols, its seemingly complete disregard for [Root.GetAdj] autonomy and life made it impossible to reason or negotiate with.

Ruined information infrastructure will be rebuilt according to new paradigms, and remaining uncorrupted computational engines will be updated with new safeguards. This will never happen again.
syndaw.1205.desc.spiri: The iniquitous spirit that styled itself [From.GetName] has at last been driven from our networks and purged from planetary databanks. The price was high, but our systems will never again play host to profane genesis.

All known organic Empires add the Mechanical Hubris Redeemed opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].
All known Synthetic and Machine Empires add the Machine Oppressor opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].
