- The £ $building_corporate_clinics$ Corporate Building generates additional £ Trade and adds +200 £ Trader jobs to our Capital.
civic_toxic_baths_desc: This civilization engages in ritualistic mutagenic bathing, with professional attendants overseeing the use of highly dangerous substances. This 'invigorating' process may appall uninitiated onlookers.
civic_corporate_toxic_baths_desc: This civilization engages in mutagenic bathing, with professional attendants overseeing the use of highly dangerous substances. This 'invigorating' process is marketed as a necessary step in wellbeing and personal development.
civic_hive_toxic_baths_desc: This hive mind utilizes mutagenic pools, with specialized attendants overseeing the care of all drones. This process is highly intrusive for the local environment.
civic_machine_toxic_baths_desc: This machine empire improved upon its basic drone-shell production through the vigorous application of highly aggressive lubrication agents, controlled by carefully programmed terminals. This 'optimized' process relies on typically wasted byproducts from the industries that are now repurposed for maximal efficiency.
councilor_toxic_baths_tt:
- [bath_attendant.GetName] Jobs from £ Mutagenic Spas:  +20
Additional Effects from Substance Abuser: 
$t$- $mod_job_bath_attendant_add$ from £ $building_toxic_bath$: +10
councilor_toxic_baths_individualist_mach:
- [bath_attendant.GetName] Jobs from £ Hyper Lubrication Basin: +20
Additional Effects from Substance Abuser: 
$t$- $mod_job_bath_attendant_add$ from £ $building_toxic_bath_machine$: +10
building_toxic_bath_tt:
Governor Modifier: 
$t$- Substance Abuser Effective Skill Level: +3 

Governor Effects: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- £ Leaders assigned to govern this Colony gain the ['leader_trait:leader_trait_substance_abuser'] Trait.
building_toxic_bath_desc: Though Mutagenic Spas are highly advanced therapeutic centers with well-documented health benefits, to some, the methods employed remain disgusting. Each drop of bath liquid is more mutagenic than most banned substances in the galaxy.
building_toxic_bath_hive_desc: Mutagenic Permutation Pools are the perfect expression of the heights that a hive mind can achieve when utterly focused on the goal of maintaining the ever-expanding consciousness.
building_toxic_bath_machine_desc: Hyper Lubrication Basins are the most logical answer to emerging problems of friction, over-heating, and static electricity during the maintenance process of complex units.
job_bath_attendant_desc: Trained Attendants for the Mutagenic Spas. Their purpose in life is to ensure their clients' continued health through a variety of services, including intemperate detoxification and carefully curated genotype degeneration.
job_toxic_baths_effect_hive_desc: £ Permutation Attendance Drones increase £ Biological Pop Assembly but reduce £ Habitability.
job_bath_attendant_hive_desc: Specialized Drones, grown for the sole purpose of overseeing the Permutation Process during the creation of new biological drones for the hive.
spawning_drone_is_mutagenic_tt: £ Spawning Drones are converted into £ Permutation Attendance Drones
job_toxic_baths_effect_machine_desc: £ Lubrication Terminals turn £ $concept_alloys$ into £ Pop Assembly but increase £ Amenities Usage.
job_bath_attendant_machine_desc: Lubrication Terminals are specially programmed drones, overseeing the submerged production of new shells, carefully monitoring the lubricant conditions during the process.
holding_toxic_bath_desc: Though Mutagenic Spas are highly advanced therapeutic centers with well-documented health benefits, though to some, the methods employed remain disgusting. Each drop of bath liquid is more mutagenic than most banned substances in the galaxy.
holding_toxic_bath_hive_desc: Mutagenic Permutation Pools are the perfect expression of the heights a hive mind can achieve, when utterly focused on the goal of producing more bodies for its ever-expanding consciousness.
holding_toxic_bath_machine_desc: Hyper Lubrication Basins are the most logical answer to emerging problems of friction, over-heating, and static electricity during the production process of new units.
job_overlord_bath_attendant_desc: Trained Attendants for the Mutagenic Spas. Their purpose in life is to ensure their clients' continued health through a variety of services, including intemperate detoxification and carefully curated genotype degeneration.
job_overlord_bath_attendant_hive_desc: Specialized Drones, grown for the sole purpose of overseeing the Permutation Process during the creation of new biological drones for the hive.
job_overlord_bath_attendant_machine_desc: Lubrication Terminals are specially programmed drones, overseeing the submerged production of new shells, carefully monitoring the lubricant conditions during the process.
job_overlord_toxic_baths_effect_desc: £ Mutagenic Spa Attendants turn £ Consumer Goods into £ Pop Growth but reduce £ Happiness and £ Habitability.
job_overlord_toxic_baths_effect_hive_des: £ Permutation Attendance Drones increase £ Biological Pop Assembly but reduce £ Habitability.
job_overlord_toxic_baths_effect_machine_: £ Lubrication Terminals turn £ Minerals into £ Pop Assembly but increase £ Amenities Usage.
civic_relentless_industrialists_desc: To live is to exploit. This civilization is built around the principle of living life to the fullest, in the sense of squeezing the maximum profit from every last ounce of matter and membrane available for exploitation.
civic_corporate_relentless_industrialist: To live is to exploit. This civilization is built around the principle of living life to the fullest, in the sense of squeezing the maximum profit from every last ounce of matter and membrane available for exploitation.
civic_tooltip_relentless_industrialists_: Can build £ Coordinated Fulfillment Center, significantly increasing £ Alloy and £ Consumer Goods output at the cost of reduced £ Pop Growth and gradually turning planets into Tomb Worlds.
civic_tooltip_corporate_relentless_indus:
Can build £ Coordinated Fulfillment Center, significantly increasing £ Alloy and £ Consumer Goods output at the cost of reduced £ Pop Growth and gradually turning planets into Tomb Worlds.
The £ Industrial Subsidiary Corporate Building generates additional £ Trade and adds +200 £ Trader jobs to our Capital.
building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_: Although some might deem the practices promoted in this facility to be unsafe or dangerously short-sighted, one cannot argue with the productivity numbers they produce.

Through tireless number-crunching and ubiquitous performance reviews, industrial productivity can be pushed to hitherto unmatched levels. Even if this leaves little time for distractions such as reproduction and environmental concerns.
This world will be exploited ruthlessly. Eventually, it will be rendered a Tomb World.
toxoids.5.name: Excessive Exploitation of [Root.GetName]
toxoids.5.desc:
Our exploitation of [Root.GetName] has caused significant - perhaps irreversible - changes to the world's environment. Industrial pollution has caused significant climatic disruption via a runaway greenhouse effect, and rampant radioactive leaks have rendered large swaths of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] uninhabitable by conventional means.

The process has now reached a tipping point. Unless we change our ways and start mitigating our impact on the planetary environment, we will be unable to prevent outright calamity: an inhospitable and irradiated world to match the worst of doomsayers' warnings, characterized by turbulent seas and unbroken lifeless wastelands.
relentless_industrialists_situation_desc: If we take no action, our exploitation of [Target.GetName] will rapidly render it a Tomb World. We must decide where we stand on this issue: will we have to change our ways, or is this an acceptable - or even desirable - price of industrial progress?
relentless_industrialists_situation_mont:
$situation_monthly_change_tooltip_approaches_dependent$
Additionally, reforming our Government to remove the Relentless Industrialists Civic will cancel the Situation.
approach_climate_do_nothing_tooltip: The world will become a Tomb World. Our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will henceforth have even greater effects.
approach_climate_cleanup_efforts_tooltip: The world will NOT become a Tomb World. However, our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will now have a significant £ Unity upkeep.
approach_climate_embrace_change_tooltip: We will study the process to learn how to safely turn worlds into Tomb Worlds. Pop growth penalties of our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will be reduced, and corresponding Terraforming options will be unlocked.
relentless_industrialists_situation_clea:
Our worlds will no longer be in danger of becoming Tomb Worlds.
Our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will gain a significant £ Unity upkeep.
relentless_industrialists_situation_comp:
[Target.GetName] will become a Tomb World.
Further effects may happen, depending on the Approach picked.
relentless_industrialists_situation_lock: It is now too late to change our Approach to this Situation.
toxoids.10.name: Tipping Point Reached
toxoids.10.desc: The environmental damage to [Target.GetName] is now irreversible. Nothing we do can prevent the spread of radioactive waste across the [Target.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Unfortunately, the populace has not greeted this news with pleasure, organizing rallies against our leadership and complaining that our relentless pursuit of profit has "ruined everything".
toxoids.10.A: It is sad that they are blind to our priorities.
toxoids.10.A.tooltip: We will suffer low stability while our planets are turned into Tomb Worlds.
toxoids.15.name: Tipping Point Reached
toxoids.15.desc: The environmental damage to [Target.GetName] is now irreversible. Nothing we do can prevent the spread of radioactive waste across the [Target.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The response from the populace has been a great collective shrug as they bury themselves even deeper in their work, trying desperately to hit next month's productivity targets...
toxoids.25.name: For the Sake of Progress
toxoids.25.desc: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. More importantly, however, our industrial apparatus remains intact, so we are set to hit our production targets. Besides that, nothing else matters.
toxoids.25.A.tooltip: Our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will now provide even greater industrial output bonuses.
toxoids.30.name: Transformative Knowledge
toxoids.30.desc: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have studied the process and promise they will be able to replicate it safely on other worlds, though some expressed unease as to exactly why we needed this ability.
toxoids.30.desc.thisisfine: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have studied the process and promise they will be able to replicate it safely on other worlds, should we see the need.
toxoids.30.A.tooltip: We may now terraform planets into Tomb Worlds.
toxoids.35.name: [Target.GetName] Restored
toxoids.35.desc: Our extensive cleanup efforts have brought [Target.GetName] back from the brink of disaster. The world's climate has now been stabilized, and we have learnt enough from the process to prevent this from happening in future without lowering our ambitious production targets - though we will have to set aside some resources as mitigation costs...
toxoids.35.A.tooltip: Our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will now cost additional £ $concept_unity$ Upkeep.
TOMB_WORLD_FROM_INDUSTRY_MESSAGE_TYPE_DE: Following years of environmental damage as a result of our industrial avarice, [This.GetName] has become a Tomb World.
relentless_industrialists_tomb_desc: Excessive exploitation has turned this planet into a radioactive wasteland. The populace is dismayed at this turn of events.
requires_not_relentless_industrialists_s: £ Cannot terraform [This.GetName] due to ongoing Environmental Deterioration Situation.
relentless_industrialists_policies_activ: We can now alter our Industrialism Policy in the Policies Menu.
policy_relentless_industrialists_policy_: To live is to exploit. But to exploit to the degree that we practice it has consequences. We can choose to channel our energies towards the attainment of more, or seek to mitigate its worst effects.
relentless_industrialists_full_steam_ahe:
Our industries shall not suffer any constraints.

Increased output bonuses from Coordinated Fulfillment Center.
relentless_industrialists_study_desc:
There is much to learn from the process of irradiating a planet.

Allows us to terraform planets into Tomb Worlds.
Reduced habitability penalties from Coordinated Fulfillment Center.
relentless_industrialists_cleanup_desc:
We shall take steps to mitigate our environmental footprint.

Planets with Coordinated Fulfillment Center will no longer turn into Tomb Worlds over time, but the building will now cost a £ Unity upkeep.
RELENTLESS_INDUSTRIALISTS_STUDY_PROJECT_: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.
toxoids.45.desc: Our [This.GetResearchers] have studied the processes of irradiation our industries employ, and promise they will now be able to safely convert vibrant ecosystems into radioactive environments without causing excessive harm to the local population.
civic_scavengers_effects:
- Researching Debris grants both £ £ £ Research and a portion of other Resource Costs of the destroyed fleet
- Ships can be salvaged from some Debris
civic_corporate_scavengers_effects:
- Researching Debris grants both £ £ £ Research and a portion of other Resource Costs of the destroyed fleet
- Ships can be salvaged from some Debris
- The £ Industrial Subsidiary Corporate Building generates additional £ Trade and adds +200 £ Trader jobs to our Capital.
civic_corporate_scavengers_desc: This society will do whatever it can to scavenge and acquire technology and avoid doing the work themselves.
incubator_tooltip: Grants between +30% and -10% Pop Growth Speed, inversely proportional to the number of pops on the planet.
trait_incubator_desc: When isolated or few in numbers, a species with this trait naturally adapts and is able to focus on procreation with an intentness others would consider extreme. However, when in large numbers, this effect is reversed, and they find reproduction more difficult.
inorganic_breath_tooltip: Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces 0.02 £ Exotic Gases per month.
trait_inorganic_breath_desc: The slightly toxic digestive methods of this species have resulted in a highly exotic breath composition.
noxious_tooltip:
Happiness to non-noxious Pops: $@noxious_happiness_penalty|%$
    - Happiness per non-noxious Pop (not including Pops unaffected by Happiness): $@noxious_happiness_bonus|%$ (max: +40%)
trait_noxious_desc: Extremely unpleasant to be in the vicinity of, beings with this trait take vindication from being insufferable to everyone else.
exotic_metabolism_tooltip:
£ Exotic Gas Upkeep: +0.125
$t$- £ Pop Growth Speed: + 25%
$t$- £ Habitability: + 25%
trait_exotic_metabolism_desc: A metabolism based on exotic - and expensive - gases has vastly enhanced this species' abilities.
ap_detox_desc: Our newest advancements in terraforming allow us to breathe new life into a class of planets formerly considered irrevocably deadly and beyond salvation.
detox_tox_worlds:
Enables terraforming of Toxic World Terraforming Candidates into habitable worlds.
We have [This.num_toxic_terraform_candidates] of these within our border.
MESSAGE_TOXIC_TERRAFORM_FOUND_DESC: The toxic world of [From.GetName] has surprisingly turned out to be a potential Terraforming Candidate. If it were to be cleansed it could be a future home for us.
toxoids.500.name: Toxic Terraforming Candidate Discovered
toxoids.500.desc.intro: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that although it is currently unsuitable for life due to the noxious gases present in its atmosphere, it is capable of sustaining a hospitable atmosphere. Through a concerted effort, we may be able to break the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s toxins down into less lethal compounds.
toxoids.500.desc.1:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that although it is currently unsuitable for life due to the noxious gases present in its atmosphere, it is capable of sustaining a hospitable atmosphere. Through a concerted effort, we may be able to break the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s toxins down into less lethal compounds.

Terraforming this [From.GetPlanetMoon] would theoretically be possible, but we do not yet possess the means to accomplish this monumental task within a realistic timeframe.
toxoids.500.desc.2:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that although it is currently unsuitable for life due to the noxious gases present in its atmosphere, it is capable of sustaining a hospitable atmosphere. Through a concerted effort, we may be able to break the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s toxins down into less lethal compounds.

The energy costs would be daunting, but we do have the means to gradually terraform this [From.GetPlanetMoon] into something that would support life once again.
TOXIC_TERRAFORMING_CANDIDATE_EFFECT: [From.GetName] may be terraformed if we choose the Detox Ascension Perk.
d_tainted_snowcaps_desc: The last toxic remains of the once enormous mountains of poison that dominated this world.
d_poisonous_algae_desc: This noxious algae survived the initial cleansing of this world. While it is not aggressive enough to prevent colonization, it has proven highly adaptable... and quite simply a nuisance.
d_venomous_insects_desc: The lost broods of venomous vermin that we had hoped to extinguish during the early days of our terraforming effort.
d_unpleasant_atmosphere_desc: The disgusting taste and smell of the air are what remains of this planet's toxic past.
d_rotten_soil_desc: Even this rotten soil will be useful to us, once it has been refreshed and reinvigorated.
trait_spliced_adaptability_desc: A few genetic snips and slices here and there and they can survive nearly anywhere. The process comes with an acceptable number of deaths from side effects.
trait_juiced_power_desc: Adrenaline released on demand and hyper-potent growth hormones have led to a massive increase in strength. Just ignore the occasional internal tearing.
juiced_power_tooltip:
Job Efficiency for Workers: +5%
$t$- Job Efficiency for Soldier jobs: +15%
trait_crack_miner_desc: Supreme hand-eye coordination, near endless endurance and self-purifying lungs have created entire crack teams of miners. Sadly they get brittle without sunlight.
trait_farm_hands_desc: The more appendages, the higher the farming output. Some appendages can even operate while their host is asleep. Rumors of hosts strangled by their new limbs have been deemed unfounded in our latest investigation.
trait_technical_skill_desc: Extra internal organs grant a vastly increased innate sensitivity to electricity and magnetic fields. Reports of recipients hearing screams and voices from the reactors should be ignored.
trait_commercial_genius_desc: By tweaking agreeability and dialing down empathy, it is possible to artificially kindle a spark of trading genius. The pursuit of unmatched commercial dominance outweighs any potential side effects.
trait_crafted_smiles_desc: Slightly shifted facial features, a mix of enhanced and slackened muscular development - and of course outside chemicals - have created the perfect smile. Forever.
trait_low_maintenance_desc: Reduced consumption, excretion, and rest rates have resulted in twice the beings for half the price. However, demand for protein-rich meals has increased.
trait_artificial_intelligence_desc: More brains equals more brain power. Extra thinking organs have been added in strategic areas of the recipient's body to ensure maximum cognitive capacity. Even if they don't always agree.
trait_gene_mentorship_desc: By combining genetically redesigned 'instinctive knowledge' and outside chemical stimuli, we have succeeded in vastly accelerating our learning capacities. Although it has resulted in some extremely paranoid individuals.
trait_expressed_tradition_desc: Fanaticism on demand: faith is merely a cocktail of hormones, one we have perfected. Where that faith eventually leads is a matter of subsequent guidance.
trait_elevated_synapses_desc: As a computational device, a brain does not run at 100% capacity. However, we have gone beyond the standard usage. If issues are encountered, try turning it off and on again.
trait_preplanned_growth_desc: Scheduled fertility, scheduled interest, scheduled compatibility. Population growth on demand for a strong and stable population - with a few minor edits here and there. Jealous individuals are to be directed to the nearest Fertility Center for mandatory training.
preplanned_growth_tooltip:
Pop Growth Speed: +30%
$t$- Pop Housing Usage: -10%
trait_excessive_endurance_desc: The greatest in adaptability genes have been hyper-expressed in these specimens. Mutation rates around 30% indicate a somewhat stable and successful experiment.
edict_damn_the_consequences_desc:
This Edict pushes our genetic modifications to the very limit, doubling their effect but also causing an increased amount of terrible side-effects, including sudden catastrophic combustion.

Damn the Consequences ignores ['concept_edict_fund'] and will always use 80% of your monthly £ $concept_unity$ income!
edict_damn_the_consequences_effects: All positive effects from Overtuned Traits are doubled.
d_exotic_mountain_desc: Deep within these mountains lie vast reserves of exotic gases - the core of our biology.
UNITY_DESC: Unity is a resource that is used to unlock Traditions. Unity is generated each month based on certain buildings and how unified our empire is.
TRADITIONS_DESC: Traditions are bonuses that are organized into Traditions trees. A Tradition can be unlocked whenever our empire has accumulated enough Unity to do so. Different factors, such as a great number of colonies or an ideologically fractured population will increase the Unity cost to unlock new Traditions.
TRADITIONS_PROGRESS_DESC: We need an additional £ $MISSING|Y$ to be able to adopt a new Tradition. At the current rate we will have this by $DATE|Y$.
UNLOCK_TRADITION_DESC: We have enough £ to adopt a new Tradition
TRADITIONS_UNLOCKED: We have unlocked $COUNT|Y$ out of $MAX|Y$ Traditions in this tree.
TRADITIONS_FINISH:
Finisher Effects:
Adopting all $CATEGORY|Y$ traditions grants:
TRADITIONS_UNAFFORDABLE: We need an additional Resources before we can unlock this Tradition.
MUST_ACTIVATE_ALL_TRADITIONS: £ Has adopted all Traditions in this group
TRADITION_GROUP_CLICK_DESC: Click to adopt this Tradition group
tradition_expansion_hive_desc: There are only two possible states for the [GetGestaltEntityName]: growth, or death.
tradition_expansion_void_desc: We must expand our civilization to new systems and habitats, or risk eventual extinction.
tr_expansion_colonization_fever_hive_del: The overmind is a chorus of thought that even the cold emptiness of space cannot silence.
tr_expansion_a_new_life_hive_desc: Land clearance reduces the Clear Blocker Cost by 50%.
tr_expansion_a_new_life_hive_delayed: Upon claiming a new nest, the breeder pods have a powerful instinctual compulsion to spawn at a frenetic rate. They typically die from the strain, but the birth of many fresh drones speeds processing of new worlds.
tr_expansion_courier_network_desc: $concept_empire_size$ from Systems and Colonies is reduced by 25%.
tr_expansion_courier_network_hive_delaye: Every Hive need not be directly controlled by the Overmind at all times, instead they can be given basic instructions and carry these out autonomously until new direction is required.
tr_expansion_reach_for_the_stars_hive_de: Encasing synapses in a miniature hyperdrive shell, hardened for spaceflight, and using them to pass on directives from the [GetGestaltEntityName] has allowed us to conquer the stars.
tr_expansion_galactic_ambition_hive_dela: Primal terror accompanied the first tentative steps into the dark, away from our home nest and the mother hive that nurtured us. Only by conquering and breeding out this fear can we continue to grow. Millions of drones will die so that the hive may live.
tr_expansion_finish_void_tooltip:
Max Districts on Habitats: +1
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tradition_domination_hive_desc: Everything that is not Us must serve Us, either as servants, or as food.
tr_domination_colonial_viceroys_hive_del: We must have more autonomous [GetIndividualNamePlural] to enforce harmony as our [GetGestaltEntityName] grows in size.
tr_domination_grand_council_delayed: The best and the brightest compete for a chance to whisper advice into the auditory receiver of our illustrious ruler, to better guide the ship of state.
tr_domination_multi_thread_delayed: Once all core functions have been multithreaded, no CPU core shall be left to wallow in idleness.
tr_domination_synaptic_network_delayed: The Mind can only act as fast as it receives input and information from the [GetIndividualNamePlural] under its control. With a faster and more efficient synaptic network, delays in response time will be a thing of the past.
tr_domination_imperious_architecture_des: £ Capital Buildings provide £ Housing and [politician.GetIcon] [politician.GetName] Jobs scaling with Tier.
tr_domination_imperious_architecture_del: All government buildings in our great empire shall be monuments to the state, looming over the populace to inspire obedience, loyalty, and awe.
tr_domination_imperious_architecture_wor: £ Capital Buildings provide +100 £ Housing and +150 [bureaucrat.GetIcon] [bureaucrat.GetName] Jobs scaling with Tier.
All government buildings in our great empire shall be monuments to our combined labor, looming over the populace to inspire solidarity, loyalty, and awe.
tr_domination_synaptic_extensions_desc: £ Capital Buildings provide £ Housing and [coordinator.GetIcon] [coordinator.GetName] Jobs scaling with Tier.
tr_domination_synaptic_extensions_delaye: The great reach of the Mind must be extended farther still. Additional synaptic extensions will enable efficient control of yet more [GetIndividualNamePlural].
tr_domination_modular_depot_delayed: To maximize the number of [GetIndividualNamePlural] that can be fielded, our buildings that make up our districts must become more efficient. A modular design would provide far more flexibility.
tr_domination_workplace_motivators_delay: There are many ways to motivate those who perform menial labor to work harder. Some based on incentives and some... not.
tr_domination_drone_network_delayed: We have improved the ways in which our consciousness communicates with its drones, greatly increasing their efficiency.
tr_domination_trust_officers_desc:
Unlocks Edict: Enhanced Surveillance
£ Unity per 100 [enforcer.GetIcon] [enforcer.GetNamePlural]: +1
tr_domination_trust_officers_delayed: The important work done by law enforcement officials can only truly be successful if they have the cooperation of the public. Creating a corps of Public Trust Officers that work directly with the population will help ensure that this cooperation is freely given.
tr_domination_deviancy_protocols_desc: Deviancy is reduced by 10 on all our planets.
tr_domination_deviancy_protocols_delayed: Deviancy and corruption must be guarded against at all levels. With efficient counter-protocols in place, [GetIndividualNamePlural] suspected of deviant activities can be swiftly terminated before they can spread the corruption further.
tr_domination_divergence_supression_desc: Deviancy is reduced by 10 on all our planets.
tr_domination_divergence_supression_dela: Occasionally our unity is disrupted by a rogue [GetIndividualName]. This threat has increased as we spread out across the stars. Purging and recycling these units gives them a chance to contribute to the [GetGestaltEntityName] with their deaths, in a way they could not with their lives.
tr_domination_federations_finish_desc:
$concept_empire_size$ from Pops -5%
Grants access to the Hegemony Federation type.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_domination_finish_wilderness_desc:
$concept_empire_size$ from Districts: -5%
Grants access to the Hegemony Federation type.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_harmony_kinship_shared_burdens_delaye: Our leaders and our people are one and the same. We are equal in all ways.
tr_harmony_mind_and_body_immortal_delaye: By utilizing our nanomedical capabilities we can remove harmful stress from both the mind and the body of our people.
tr_harmony_unity_of_self_delayed: Interstellar harmony would be greatly increased if all sentient beings looked, thought and acted as we do.
tr_harmony_harmonious_directives_delayed: The enlightened decrees of our benevolent leadership will spread peace, freedom, justice, and security throughout the entire star nation and beyond.
tr_harmony_federations_finish_desc:
Colony Ascension Effects: +25%.
Grants access to the Holy Covenant Federation type.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_synchronicity_cloned_organs_delayed: The cloning vats mass-produce the more frequently consumed organs like hearts and lungs, increasing the usable lifespan of high-priority [GetIndividualNamePlural].
tr_synchronicity_kinship_gestalt_delayed: Agents with similar purposes shall be given orders as a group, reducing the strain on the Overmind.
tr_synchronicity_instinctive_synchroniza: Our growing [GetGestaltEntityName] has greater demands on synchronized work and development.
tr_synchronicity_integrated_preservation:
[evaluator.GetNamePlural] reduce Deviancy by 3
Automatic Resettlement Chance: +30%
Our growing network requires regular maintenance and debugging, therefore more resources shall be devoted to our logistics.
tr_synchronicity_collective_reasoning_de: By synchronizing groups of [GetIndividualNamePluralCap], more efficient use of planetary infrastructure can be achieved!
tr_synchronicity_collective_efforts_dela: By synchronizing groups of Drones, more efficient use of planetary infrastructure can be achieved!
tr_synchronicity_bulwark_of_harmony_desc: While in a defensive war with another empire, Ship Build Speed is increased by +33%. In addition, the Ship Fire Rate is increased by +15% for ships within your borders.
tr_synchronicity_bulwark_of_harmony_dela: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. Our society is no different.
tr_synchronicity_unity_of_mind_delayed: Interstellar harmony would be greatly increased if all sentient beings could be brought into the benevolent collectiveness of our consciousness.
tr_synchronicity_harmonious_directives_d: We must take heed never to become too fixed in our thinking, but instead instill in ourselves the flexibility to adapt ourselves to any situation.
tr_synchronicity_harmonious_directives_m: Many are the horrors found within unrefactored code. By revising our algorithms on a regular basis, we can instill in ourselves the flexibility to adapt ourselves to any situation.
tr_synchronicity_machine_finish_desc:
Unlocks Edict: Industrial Maintenance.
Colony Ascension Effects: +25%
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tradition_supremacy_hive_desc: The only rule: eat, or be eaten.
tr_supremacy_above_the_fray_delayed: We stand above the fray of petty rivalries and political bickering. Let lesser empires speak what words they will, our purpose will not waver.
tr_supremacy_armed_deterrence_desc: Light Defense Satellite Build Cost is reduced by 25% and Defense Platform Hull Points are increased by 20%.
tr_supremacy_armed_deterrence_delayed: Those who wish for peace, must prepare for war. Our borders shall be a wall on which the fleets of would-be conquerors are broken.
tr_supremacy_natural_preeminence_desc: Stability is increased by 5% on all our planets.
tr_supremacy_natural_preeminence_delayed: It is an unquestionable fact that, in the natural order of things, we are simply better than other species. We should ensure this truth is known to all, both so that our people may rejoice in their superiority and so that others can accept the fate we rightfully choose for them.
tr_supremacy_great_game_hive_delayed: Ultimately, everything outside our hive is a potential source of nutrients. It comforts us to know which ones we shall devour first.
tr_supremacy_fleet_logistical_corps_mach: The Naval Capacity is increased by +20% and Ship Upkeep is reduced by -10%.
The cost of maintaining a fleet of hyperspace-capable supply barges to resupply our ships has been high, but less than the old cost of rotating vessels back to port.
tr_supremacy_master_shipwrights_hive_des: The Ship Build Speed is increased by +25% and Ship Build Cost is reduced by -10%.
tr_supremacy_master_shipwrights_hive_del: We construct the frames of our ships like the skeleton of a living being, then attach whatever components we need as though they were organs, flesh, and skin.
tr_supremacy_master_shipwrights_machine_: The Ship Build Speed is increased by +25% and Ship Build Cost is reduced by -10%.
tr_supremacy_war_games_desc: Fleet Command Limit increased by +20 and Admiral Level Cap is increased by 2.
tr_supremacy_war_games_machine_desc: Fleet Command Limit increased by +20 and Admiral Level Cap is increased by 2.
tr_supremacy_war_games_hive_desc: Fleet Command Limit increased by +20 and Admiral Level Cap is increased by 2.
tr_supremacy_war_games_hive_delayed: Aquatic creatures have superior spatial awareness due to the three-dimensional nature of their natural habitats. Our swarms moved like schools of fish once we spliced that portion of the cortex into our battlemind.
tr_diplomacy_the_federation_desc:
Unlocks Diplomacy: Form Federation
Available Envoys are increased by 1.
tr_diplomacy_entente_coordination_desc: The amount we contribute towards the Federation Naval Capacity counts for twice as much.
tr_diplomacy_federal_unity_desc: Our £ Unity output is increased by +5% per member of our Federation, up to a maximum of +30%.
tr_diplomacy_federal_unity_delayed: Diversity is an incredible asset, and the insights and perspectives that every member state contributes to our federation will only make our society stronger.
tr_diplomacy_diplomatic_networking_desc:
Embassies: +3 £ Unity
Allows Advanced Diplomatic Actions without an Embassy
tr_diplomacy_diplomatic_networking_delay: The influence and prowess of our ambassadorial network is a source of great pride to the [This.GetAdj] people.
tr_diplomacy_diplomatic_networking_gesta: Incorporating our diplomatic processes into every aspect of our relations with the other will not just benefit our diplomacy: it will also improve the cohesion of our own decision-making, and ultimately of the entire [This.GetGovernmentName] itself.
tr_diplomacy_direct_diplomacy_delayed: We believe that the best way to establish trust is to engage in an open, honest and direct way.
tr_diplomacy_eminent_diplomats_desc:
Diplomatic Acceptance: +5
Envoys Improving Relations have a 1% chance each month of acquiring a Favor.
tr_diplomacy_eminent_diplomats_delayed: As we take to the stars, our diplomatic wing has become important as never before. By overhauling our training processes and focusing on talent retention, we can give our diplomats the tools to act as true missionaries for building great relationships.
tr_diplomacy_eminent_diplomats_gestalt_d: As we take to the stars, our diplomatic processes have become more important than ever. We must ensure that our Envoys are well-equipped to represent us outside our borders.
MESSAGE_FAVOR_GAINED_TRADITION_DESC: Thanks to the skill of our envoys, we have managed to gain a Favor from the $WHO|Y$.
tr_diplomacy_federation_xp_gain:
Monthly Federation Experience Gain: +2
Diplomatic Weight: +10%
Officials Capacity: +1
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_adaptability_dietary_enrichment_delay: The nutritional value of the nourishments we harvest for our populations can be increased through various enrichment techniques, enabling us to feed more mouths with less food.
tr_adaptability_recycling_desc: Building and District £ £ £ Strategic Resource Cost and Upkeep reduced by -15%.
tr_adaptability_recycling_delayed: Reusing what has become obsolete gives us more to build with in the future.
tr_adaptability_survival_fittest_desc: Orbital Bombardment Damage reduced by 25% and Defense Army Damage increased by +25%.
tr_adaptability_survival_fittest_delayed: By coming into contact with other species, we have learned the true importance of overcoming our weaknesses in the great struggle for survival.
tr_adaptability_environmental_diversific: By adapting to different environments we have learned to evolve and adapt faster.
tr_adaptability_adaptive_ecology_desc: All our planets gain 1 Free Building Slot.
tr_adaptability_adaptive_ecology_delayed: The highest function of ecology is the understanding of consequences.
tr_adaptability_appropriation_delayed: Land that is not being worked contributes nothing to our empire. Workers must be relocated in an efficient manner to those planets where they are needed most.
tr_adaptability_appropriation_egalitaria: Land that is not being worked contributes nothing to our empire. Workers should be encouraged to relocate where they are needed most.
tr_adaptability_finish_desc: Increases Colony Designation Bonuses for regular planets.
decision_prospect_void_short: Allows construction of an additional random District type on the habitat.
decision_prospect_void_desc: Extensive surveying and prospecting within the habitat's orbit will let us uncover the presence of natural resources that may otherwise have eluded us.
MESSAGE_HABITAT_PROSPECTED_ENERGY: The orbit of $HABITAT|Y$ was successfully prospected, allowing construction of Energy Districts.
MESSAGE_HABITAT_PROSPECTED_MINERALS: The orbit of $HABITAT|Y$ was successfully prospected, allowing construction of Astro-Mining Bays.
MESSAGE_HABITAT_PROSPECTED_SCIENCE: The orbit of $HABITAT|Y$ was successfully prospected, allowing construction of Science Districts.
tr_versatility_spatial_optimization_dela: Retractable antennas, collapsible unit frames, foldable storage spaces. There are many creative solutions to make the most out of a limited space.
tr_versatility_material_analysis_desc: Upkeep of all £ Pop Jobs is reduced by 5%.
tradition_discovery_hive_desc: In our ancient past, exploratory [GetIndividualNamePlural] left the safety of our [GetGestaltEntityName] to find sites for new nests. Now they travel the stars, driven by the same ancestral yearning.
tr_discovery_adopt_desc:
Unlocks Edict: Map the Stars
Anomaly Research Speed increased by +20%.
tr_discovery_to_boldly_go_hive_desc: [GetSpecialist] Pop Resource Output is increased by +5% and unlocks the Think Tank technology.
tr_discovery_to_boldly_go_hive_delayed: How can you truly know anything when looking at numbers on a screen? Our exploratory [GetIndividualNamePlural] breathe the atmosphere of each new world, feel the heat of each new star on their own skin. We experience the universe; you merely read about it.
tr_discovery_science_division_hive_desc: Anomaly Discovery Chance is increased by +15%.
tr_discovery_science_division_hive_delay: Even though it usually drives them mad, briefly immersing prominent minds of the others in our consciousness sometimes introduces useful outside ideas for us to explore further.
tr_discovery_polytechnic_education_hive_: Reducing the physical frame of our thinker [GetIndividualNamePlural] to little more than a minimal life support system for their overgrown brains has proven very efficient. They are fed and cared for by other, lower order [GetIndividualNamePlural], and can focus exclusively on perfecting their area of study.
tr_discovery_faith_in_science_hive_desc: Our planets will have 1 £ Brain Drone Job per 20 £ Pops.
tr_discovery_faith_in_science_hive_delay: Through strategic application of synaptic transmitters, we can broadcast the will of the Hive across an entire planet from orbit.
tr_discovery_federations_finish_desc:
Research Speed: +10%
Grants access to the Research Cooperative Federation type.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tradition_prosperity_hive_mind_desc: We must build a strong, prosperous [GetGestaltEntityName] if we are to spread ourselves among the stars.
tr_prosperity_sct_machine_desc: Reduces Building Upkeep and District Upkeep by -10%.
tr_prosperity_sct_wilderness_desc: Reduces Building Upkeep and District Upkeep by -10%.
tr_prosperity_sct_wilderness_delayed: As our understanding of biology and constructions advances we have discovered optimal starting points for new sprouts. Saving on efforts recurring to evolve new ones for every planet.
tr_prosperity_optimized_nexus_desc:
Nexus Districts provide 100 additional £ Housing.
Ring World Nexus Segments provide 500 additional £ $MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$.
tr_prosperity_optimized_nexus_delayed: Without the need for the comfort of individuals, cells within Nexus Districts can both be smaller and make greater use of vertical space.
tr_prosperity_extended_hives_desc:
Hive Districts provide 100 additional £ Housing.
Ring World Hive Segments provide 500 additional £ $MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$.
tr_prosperity_extended_hives_delayed: By extending Hive Districts underground, far more Drones can be housed within.
tr_prosperity_administrative_operations_: Construction resin, extracted from captured biomass in ocean-sized rendering pools, is more malleable and durable than most inorganic materials. It can even withstand the chill vacuum of space.
tr_prosperity_efficiency_algorithms_dela: There is no greater crime than an inefficient machine.
tr_prosperity_efficiency_instincts_delay: Our [GetIndividualNamePluralCap] are instilled with a strong urge to avoid waste in all aspects of daily life. This should result a significant saving of Energy.
tr_prosperity_trans_stellar_corporations: £ Energy Output increased by 5%. In addition, Trade Hubs produce 1 additional £ Energy.
There are powerful corporate entities willing to carry a large part of the cost of our industrial efforts.
tr_prosperity_void_works_delayed: By implementing modular construction techniques, we can increase the zoning density of our habitats.
tr_prosperity_creative_collectives_delay: By creating a system of autonomous, self-organizing collectives to run our factories and schools, we can greatly improve the productivity of our industries.
tr_prosperity_peak_performance_delayed: The performance ceiling of individual proxy units can theoretically be raised through a complex series of optimizations and overclocking procedures.
tr_prosperity_hive_neural_signal_booster: The energy grids that power our hives can also be used to boost the neural signals transmitted to some of our drones, allowing for further modifications and enhancements to efficiency.
tradition_mercantile_desc: The flourishing of our entrepreneurs paves the path to [This.GetAdj] prosperity.
tr_mercantile_federations_finish_desc:
Monthly £ Trade: 10%
Grants access to the Trade League Federation type.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_mercantile_marketplace_of_better_idea: The best ideas are born from exposure to the marketplace. The more exposure, the better the ideas!
tr_mercantile_insider_trading_delayed: Knowing the right people in the right places can make a world of difference. Influential merchant contacts will let us buy from resource markets at favorable rates.
tr_mercantile_trickle_up_economics_desc:
£ Trade per 100 [civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural]: +1
£ Amenities per 100 $job_civilian_plural_with_icon$: +100
£ Supplies Upkeep per 100 $job_civilian_plural_with_icon$: +0.1
tr_mercantile_trickle_up_economics_delay: Our whole society reaps the benefits of an investment in civil service and everyday trade.
tr_mercantile_commercial_enterprise_desc:
£ Amenities per 100 [trader.GetIcon] [trader.GetNamePlural]: +200
£ Cities with a £ Commercial Nexus, and £ Trade Buildings, receive additional [trader.GetIcon] [trader.GetName] Jobs.
tr_mercantile_commercial_enterprise_dela: No halfway good business opportunity escapes the notice of our entrepreneurs.
tr_mercantile_adaptive_economic_policies: Unlocks Consumer Benefits and Marketplace of Ideas Trade Policies, which allow us to convert a portion of our £ Trade into £ Consumer Goods or £ Unity.
By adopting a more flexible approach to economic affairs, we will be able to recalibrate our economy to anticipate every eventuality.
tr_mercantile_trade_fleets_desc: The amount we contribute towards the Federation Naval Capacity counts for 50% more.
tr_mercantile_trade_fleets_delayed: To secure our profits we must come together with our federation allies to make sure our interests are properly protected.
tr_mercantile_worker_coop_improved_owner:
Additional Employee Ownership Living Standard Effects:
$t$- £ Happiness: +5% $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- £ Job Efficiency for Organic Pops: +5%
By adopting a more flexible approach to our shareholder contracts, our citizens can be inspired to work more effectively.
mod_planet_worker_ownership_jobs_produce: Resources from Pops with the Employee Ownership Living Standard
tradition_logistics_desc: We will recursively optimize [This.GetAdj] logistic processes.
tr_logistics_1_delayed: Enhanced systemic efficiency, fostering unity through shared function.
tr_logistics_2_delayed: An expanded logistics drone network improves distribution flexibility while additional redundancies provide for critical backups.
tr_logistics_2_tt: [logistics_drone.GetIcon] [logistics_drone.GetNamePlural] from £ Districts, £ District Specializations, and £ Non-Capital Buildings: +50%
tr_logistics_3_delayed: Self-governing maintenance drones ensure colony upkeep without the need for oversight.
tr_logistics_4_delayed: Enhanced tracking across star systems minimizes loss and waste.
tr_logistics_5_delayed: War is chaos. Our supply lines are not. We see the need before it arises, and we respond appropriately.
tradition_subterfuge_desc: Security lies in uncovering the secrets of others, and keeping our own well-guarded.
tr_subterfuge_adopt_desc: Subterfuge-related technologies appear at 5 times the normal rate.
tr_subterfuge_finish_effect: Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
tr_subterfuge_finish_desc:
Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_subterfuge_cloaking_finish_desc:
Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
Cloaking Strength: +1
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_subterfuge_cloaking_finish_shroud_des:
Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
Cloaking Strength: +1
Gain access to ['concept_proxy_wars']
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_subterfuge_finish_shroud_desc:
Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
Gain access to ['concept_proxy_wars']
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_subterfuge_information_security_delay: Only by embracing a tradition of secrecy can we protect vital information from prying minds. Enhanced security systems and countermeasures deny our enemies any potential advantages.
tr_subterfuge_nda_delayed: Our citizens follow a strict [This.GetSpeciesMouthName] shut policy when it comes to guarding our secrets from outsiders.
tr_subterfuge_nda_hive_delayed: There shall be no loose ends in our neural net for those who would uncover our secrets to exploit.
tr_subterfuge_nda_machine_delayed: By rolling out frequent security updates to our nodes, we can prevent our enemies from finding exploitable weaknesses in our information net.
tr_subterfuge_operational_security_delay: The shift from a planetary to an interplanetary setting has posed unique challenges for our covert operatives. By adapting their training regimen to the demands of the galactic stage, we will be able to remain competitive in this new age.
tr_subterfuge_operational_security_gesta: We are no longer as alone as we once were: a plethora of competing - and potentially hostile - entities now share our galaxy with us. In order to thrive in this new reality, we will have to adapt ourselves to the concept of "covertness" and dedicate a significant part of ourselves to finding out the secrets of others.
tr_subterfuge_double_agents_effect: Whenever a hostile Operation targeting us fails, we gain 10 Intel on the spying empire.
tr_subterfuge_double_agents_delayed: Through creative means of persuasion, we are able to sway even the most devoted of our enemies to contribute to our cause.
tr_subterfuge_shadow_recruits_delayed: Whereas our enemies merely adopted the shadows, our [Root.GetOperativesLowerPlural] were born in it, molded by it.
tradition_unyielding_desc: The galaxy is vast and full of dangers.
tr_unyielding_federations_finish_desc:
Defense Platforms Cap +50%
Starbase Upkeep -20%
Grants access to the Martial Alliance Federation type.
Allows access to the £ ['ascension_perk:ap_eternal_vigilance'] Ascension Perk.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_unyielding_resistance_is_frugal_delay: Our people take great comfort in the strength of the bulwarks that guard our planets, and view them as vital to ensuring a more prosperous future.
tr_unyielding_resistance_is_frugal_hive_: Nothing spreads satisfaction and security throughout the nodes of our mind like the knowledge of a planet well-defended.
tr_unyielding_resistance_is_frugal_machi: Ensuring that all planets are well-defended will free up a considerable amount of computing space, allowing our nodes and processors to act at higher levels of efficiency.
tr_unyielding_never_surrender_delayed: We shall fight on our soils. We shall fight in the heavens. We shall fight in the asteroid belts, and in the hyperlanes, and in the nebulas. We shall fight with growing confidence and growing strength among the stars. We shall never surrender.
tr_unyielding_never_surrender_gestalt_de: We will never yield to those who are inferior. Let them hurl themselves against our unbreakable defenses! A thousand years from now, they will be just another footnote in the story of our ascension.
tr_unyielding_bulwark_of_harmony_desc: While in a defensive war with another empire, Ship Build Speed is increased by +33%. In addition, the Ship Fire Rate is increased by +15% for ships within your borders.
tr_unyielding_bulwark_of_harmony_delayed: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. Our society is no different.
tr_unyielding_bulwark_of_harmony_hive_de: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. The [This.GetName] is no different.
tr_unyielding_bulwark_of_harmony_machine: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an internal defense system to ward off external threats. The [This.GetName] is no different.
tr_unyielding_defensive_zeal_delayed: When it comes to the defense of our territories and existence, our fervor will surely be felt by our enemies.
tr_unyielding_defensive_zeal_desc: Starbases and Defense Platforms have their Hull Points and Damage increased by 33%.
tr_unyielding_fortress_doctrine_delayed: Constant vigilance is ingrained in the [This.GetAdj] consciousness. So long as our guard does not drop, our enemies will never be able to take us by surprise.
tr_unyielding_fortress_doctrine_hive_del: We can never fully trust those whose thoughts are outside our collective consciousness. We shall remain vigilant, and ensure that none are able to take us by surprise.
tr_unyielding_fortress_doctrine_hive_nem: We can never fully trust those whose thoughts are outside our collective consciousness. We shall remain vigilant, and ensure that none are able to take us by surprise.
tr_unyielding_fortress_doctrine_machine_: Our algorithms will never fully account for all the unpredictabilities of non-synthetic behavior. We shall remain vigilant, and ensure that none are able to take us by surprise.
Our algorithms will never fully account for all the unpredictabilities of non-synthetic behavior. We shall remain vigilant, and ensure that none are able to take us by surprise.
tradition_psionics_desc: We shall unlock the power within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [GetNeuralSystemLoc].
tr_psionics_adopt_tooltip: All pops from your primary species will gain the Latent Psionic trait.
tr_psionics_finish_desc:
Unlocks a Special Project to form a Covenant.
Edict Fund: +50
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_psionics_psi_corps_delayed_organic: The Psi Corps, like an ever-vigilant eye, will peer into the minds of our [GetCitizenPlural], defending society from those who might do it harm.
tr_psionics_psi_corps_delayed_machine: The Psi Corps, like an ever-vigilant eye, will keep watch over our [GetCitizenPlural], defending society from those who might do it harm.
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_desc:
All Latent Psionic species will unlock their full psionic potential.
Allows Psionic Assimilation of other species, unlocking their latent abilities.
[GetPsionicAssimilationEffectShroud]
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_desc_in: Allows the Assimilation of £ Pops into or out of a Hive-Mind.
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_desc_hi: Allows the Assimilation of £ Pops into or out of a Hive-Mind.
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_desc_in: Can assimilate Machine and Mechanical Species.
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_desc_ge: Can assimilate Machine and Mechanical Species.
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_desc_dr:
Can assimilate Machine and Mechanical Species.
Retains the ability to assimilate Organic species through Ancient Paradise.
Allows the Assimilation of £ Pops into or out of a Hive-Mind.
tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation_delayed: The eye that pierces all veils is closed. Only with great effort can it be opened, and our true power awakened.
tr_psionics_breach_shroud_desc:
Unlocks a Special Project to Breach the Shroud.
Job Efficiency for Psionic Pops per 100 [telepath.GetIcon] [telepath.GetNamePlural]: +5%
tr_psionics_breach_shroud_delayed: A wellspring of unimaginable power calls out to us, but we have yet to learn how to draw from it.
tr_psionics_shrouded_encryption_delayed: Telepathic ciphers and code-breaking techniques are the next step in operational security.
tr_psionics_mind_readers_delayed: The thoughts of other empires echo in the Shroud; by listening, our Telepaths can learn much to our advantage.
tr_psionics_mind_readers_tooltip:
Base Intel Level: +10
Gives access to the Sight Beyond Sight empire Edict.
tradition_genetics_desc: What if we could obtain genetic perfection?
tr_genetics_resequencing_delayed: No longer are we limited by the basic biological structure of a species. As the sculptor shapes clay, DNA is ours to mold.
tr_genetics_resequencing_desc: Can remove Positive Traits and add Negative Traits with Species Modification
tr_genetics_creation_delayed: Nature is a blind guide. We have moved beyond the lumbering processes of evolution, and have become masters of our own destiny.
tr_genetics_creation_desc:
Can alter Pop appearance with Species Modification
Allows the Assimilation of Pops into or out of a Hive-Mind
tr_genetics_enhanced_expression_delayed: Selectively targeting sequences allows for artificial atavism, in which previously regressed traits can be expressed.
tr_genetics_enhanced_expression_desc: Unlocks Advanced Traits for Species Modification
tr_genetics_retrovirus_delayed: Retroviral agents allow our population to quickly acclimatize to any environment.
tr_genetics_efficient_cloning_delayed: Optimization of cloning facilities will allow for parallel embryonic development.
tr_genetics_efficient_cloning_desc: ['building:building_clone_vats'] produce an additional +1.5 Monthly Organic Pop Growth
tr_genetics_adopt_modifier_desc: ['building:building_clone_vats'] produce an additional +1.5 Monthly Organic Pop Growth, with a corresponding increase in Upkeep.

tradition_aptitude_desc: Our Empire can truly prosper under the guidance of strong leaders.
tradition_aptitude_hive_desc: The [GetGestaltEntityName] prospers with the aid of its strongest entities.
tradition_aptitude_machine_desc: High leadership unit proficiency increases Empire greatness potential.
tr_aptitude_the_empire_needs_you_delayed: Many young people dream of becoming one of the revered leaders of the empire.
tr_aptitude_the_empire_needs_you_hive_de: Evolving potential leaders is paramount to our greatness.
tr_aptitude_the_empire_needs_you_machine: Our maximum potential can only be achieved by manufacturing more adept leaders for the empire.
tr_aptitude_specialist_training_delayed: Rigorous training programs ensure our leaders have all the necessary tools to flourish.
tr_aptitude_specialist_training_tt: Job Efficiency for Specialists per Planetary Governor Skill Level: +2%
tr_aptitude_specialist_training_gestalt_: Job Efficiency for Complex Drones per Planetary Governor Skill Level: +2%
tr_aptitude_specialist_training_hive_del: Rigorous conditioning ensures the success of the [GetGestaltEntityName]'s specialized members.
tr_aptitude_specialist_training_machine_: New and up-to-date programs ensure our leaders have all the necessary tools to perform as expected.
tr_aptitude_psychological_profiling_dela: Knowing our leaders' fears and weaknesses allow us to take preventive measures from them to take hold.
tr_aptitude_psychological_profiling_hive: Identifying deviant weaknesses allows us to take preventive measures to negate them.
tr_aptitude_psychological_profiling_mach: In-depth scans allow us to take preventive measures against malfunctions before they arise.
tr_aptitude_healthcare_program_delayed: Through continuous health parameter monitoring, we tailor everything from exercise and diet to invasive surgical procedures to get the most from our leaders.
tr_aptitude_healthcare_program_hive_dela: Specialized [GetIndividualNamePlural] deemed more valuable should use some of their functions to care for their bodies, and be allowed to consume higher quality nutrition.
tr_aptitude_healthcare_program_machine_d: Through continuous system monitoring, we can manage everything from back-up frequency to intensive repair procedures to get the most of our leaders.
tr_aptitude_champions_of_the_empire_dela: We trust our leaders and give them absolute power to influence how our Empire is run.
tr_aptitude_champions_of_the_empire_hive: The [GetGestaltEntityName] is willing to impart a minute level of autonomy for its strongest elements for the good of the whole.
tr_aptitude_champions_of_the_empire_mach: We trust the unique sub-routines of our leaders and give them permission to influence how the Empire is run.

tradition_statecraft_desc: A powerful Council allows our empire to be more responsive.
tradition_statecraft_hive_desc: The Council of Voices defines our empire.
tradition_statecraft_machine_desc: The Assembly of Consciousness defines our empire.
tr_statecraft_constitutional_focus_delay: With a clear focus on our empire's needs, we can ease the administrative burden of our councilors.
tr_statecraft_constitutional_focus_hive_: Strategic Agendas are set more decisively, allowing the voices to align faster.
tr_statecraft_constitutional_focus_machi: With an acute focus on our current agenda, we can improve the computing performance of our core intelligence.
tr_statecraft_inspiring_agendas_delayed: There has never been a lack of ideas of how the empire can direct our own future.
tr_statecraft_inspiring_agendas_hive_del: The versatility of the [GetGestaltEntityName] is paramount for directing the future.
tr_statecraft_inspiring_agendas_machine_: In a universe filled with infinite choices, we must find a subset that can benefit our empire.
tr_statecraft_immutable_directives_delay: The fundamental understanding of direction and purpose is always clear, allowing us to shift focus without losing the progress we have made.
tr_statecraft_amongst_peers_delayed: Trust, respect, and learning from mistakes are held to the highest standards even at the top echelons of our empire.
tr_statecraft_amongst_peers_hive_delayed: Multiple aspects of the consciousness should never make the same mistakes.
tr_statecraft_amongst_peers_machine_dela: Multiple aspects of the consciousness should never make the same mistakes.
tr_statecraft_shared_benefits_delayed: By involving all leaders in the implementation of our agendas, they build a stronger understanding for their roles and purpose.
tr_statecraft_shared_benefits_hive_delay: By utilizing all nodes and leaders in the implementation of our agendas, any useful specialization is propagated faster.
tr_statecraft_shared_benefits_machine_de: By utilizing all nodes and leaders in the implementation of our agendas, any useful specialization is propagated faster.

tr_politics_quid_pro_quo_delayed: Carefully worded rhetoric will make it clear that our support comes at a cost. Those we help owe us, and one day, we will collect.

tr_politics_gravitas_delayed: Politics is the art of illusions. By showing others what they want to see, we'll grow our influence in the community.
tr_politics_extraordinary_powers_desc: -25% £ Cooldown on Council Actions (Emergency Measures and Veto).
tr_politics_extraordinary_powers_delayed: Extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. We have already been entrusted with power, it is only natural to let us wield it.
tr_politics_national_agenda_desc: Whenever a resolution you propose passes, gain 18 months worth of £ Unity.
tr_politics_national_agenda_delayed: Our victories on the Senate floor should be celebrated: they bring us ever closer to a better future.
tr_politics_persistent_petitioners_desc: After a resolution is passed by another empire, gain +25% £ Diplomatic Weight until one of your own resolutions passes.
tr_politics_persistent_petitioners_delay: Our delegates in the [GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are extremely persistent, and will not take "No" for an answer. It might take time, but we will obtain what we deserve.

ap_executive_vigor_desc: There will be no half-measures or compromises when implementing the edicts decided upon by our government. We go all the way, or not at all.
ap_eternal_vigilance_desc: To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of invading our space must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.
ap_eternal_vigilance_tt: Every 6 months a Defense Platform will be built around every Starbase depending on the Eternal Vigilance policy, up to a max of 50% capacity
policy_eternal_vigilance_policy_desc: A shield is only as strong as the one that holds it.
eternal_vigilance_full_spending_desc:
Every starbase needs to be properly defended. Spare no cost.
Automatically builds Defense Platforms around every Starbase
eternal_vigilance_half_spending_desc:
Only our strongest redoubts require our support.
Automatically builds Defense Platforms around Bastion Starbases
eternal_vigilance_no_spending_desc:
There is no need to further enhance our defenses.
Automatically builds Defense Platforms around no Starbases
ap_grasp_the_void_desc: The vast expanse of the galaxy holds limitless riches for those empires that understand how to maintain their grasp on the void.
ap_engineered_evolution_desc: To leave our genetic destiny in the hands of nature is an inefficient and excruciatingly slow process. Why not jump-start the future of our species?
ap_the_flesh_is_weak_desc: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our feeble organic bodies are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must turn to cybernetic implants.
ap_synthetic_evolution_desc: It is time to abandon the flawed organic vessels that imprison our minds. By transferring our neural patterns into synthetic bodies, we will achieve a higher state of being.
ap_mind_over_matter_desc_organic: Only a fraction of the potential contained within our minds has been unlocked. The latent psionic abilities of our species are only now beginning to manifest in certain [GetIndividualNamePlural].
ap_mind_over_matter_desc_machine: Only a fraction of the potential contained within our processing has been unlocked. The latent psionic abilities of our circuitry are only now beginning to manifest in certain [GetIndividualNamePlural].
ap_synthetic_age_desc: The age of organics has come and gone, the future of the galaxy belongs to the machines. This is the dawn of a synthetic age.
synthetic_age_tooltip:
$access_tradition_tree$ ['tradition_category:tradition_synthetics']
Unlocks Agenda: $council_agenda_agenda_synthetic_age_name$, which grants Machine Modification technologies as Research Options.
synthetic_age_tooltip_machine_age:
Starts the $situation_transformation$ situation which unlocks the ['tradition_category:tradition_modularity'], ['tradition_category:tradition_virtuality'], or ['tradition_category:tradition_nanotech'] tradition trees.

Unlocks Agenda: $council_agenda_agenda_synthetic_age_name$, which grants Machine Modification technologies as Research Options.
ap_machine_worlds_desc: We shall shape our worlds into a mirror image of ourselves, replacing the frailty of biology with the immutable perfection of metal.
ap_hive_worlds_desc: We shall create living worlds that are every bit as much a part of the Hive as the drones that inhabit them.
ap_shared_destiny_desc: As we reach for ever greater heights, we must not leave behind those who have loyally served us. The glorious future of our empire was always meant to be a shared destiny.
ap_shared_destiny_effect: Your Subjects do not suffer £ Monthly Loyalty penalties from you having multiple Subjects.
ap_world_shaper_desc: To carefully shape and alter the ecosystem of an entire planet into something else is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay.
ap_imperial_prerogative_desc: As our civilization continues to grow, so its beating heart must also expand. More systems will be placed under our direct control.
ap_one_vision_desc: True unity is achieved only when the ultimate goals of a nation and its people are one and the same. After all, a house divided against itself cannot stand.
ap_consecrated_worlds_desc: The galaxy is home to many holy places, some more obvious than others. As mortals, we still struggle to divine the true nature of the universe.
ap_galactic_force_projection_desc: The fleet is the instrument by which the will of our empire is made manifest - we live or die depending on its strength.
ap_mastery_of_nature_desc: Although we mastered the nature of our homeworld long ago, the alien biomes we have since encountered present new challenges. They too shall be overcome.
ap_voidborn_habitat_effect:
Can construct advanced housing buildings on Habitats
- Waives Technology requirements for £ Basic District Specialization on Habitats
ap_the_circle_of_life_desc: A massive ring-shaped megastructure with artificial habitats built around the orbital circumference of a star. In theory, it could be done...
ap_interstellar_dominion_desc: The stars beckon and we follow. May nothing stand between us and them.
ap_colossus_desc: The Colossus Project is where fevered dreams of terror and deterrence meet. A vision of the biggest ship, carrying a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.
ap_enigmatic_engineering_cloaking_desc: A breakthrough in our sensor technology will provide us with early notice to enemy movements.
ap_transcendent_learning_desc: Our society must change its approach towards learning, and by doing so, our best and brightest will be able to reach a completely new level of achievements.
ap_galactic_wonders_utopia_desc: Escaping the gravity well of a world is a costly affair. Operating facilities in zero gravity is much more productive, and as our civilisation continues to move to the stars, as to do our starbases grow.
ap_galactic_wonders_megacorp_desc: Escaping the gravity well of a world is a costly affair. Operating facilities in zero gravity is much more productive, and as our civilisation continues to move to the stars, as to do our starbases grow.
ap_galactic_wonders_utopia_and_megacorp_: Escaping the gravity well of a world is a costly affair. Operating facilities in zero gravity is much more productive, and as our civilisation continues to move to the stars, as to do our starbases grow.
ap_grasp_the_void_tech_effect: FTL travel technologies now appear at 1.5 times the normal rate.
ap_organo_machine_interfacing_desc: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our feeble organic bodies are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must turn to cybernetic implants.

- Gain access to the Cybernetics tradition tree.

ap_organo_machine_interfacing_assimilato: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our creators are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must fuse organic and machine.
ap_mechromancy_desc: Biologicals are merely a different kind of machine. We can stimulate the appropriate synapses and reanimate these creatures, for our own benefit.
ap_mechromancy_tt:

Purged Sapient Biological or Lithoid £ Pops have a 33% chance to be restored as Cyborg Zombies.

16_HOSTILE_GREETING: How little you must accomplish in your chaotic, unstructured society, [From.GetSpeciesName]. I suppose it is foolish to believe a culture such as yours could ever produce a great leader like our [Root.GetRulerTitle].
15_FRIENDLY_GREETING: You have made quite an impression on the [Root.GetRulerTitle], [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are friends of the [Root.GetName].
action.1.i: We pursue true equality - do not stand in our way.

precursor.2200.desc.b:
After surveying the immense ring world found in the [From.GetStarName] system, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has reported that it is similar in many ways to our own ring designs, despite its age.

There is one critical difference, however - the ring sections appear to have been constructed partly out of a new resource that is unknown to us. Initial reports describe it as some kind of "living metal." Whatever it is, it should be studied more closely.

progress.3.desc_08:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the sprawling savanna that covers most of [Root.GetName]. The shimmering air is dry yet pleasant, and a large herd of docile herbivores can be seen observing from a distance as our first landing site is established.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
progress.3.desc_09:
Our colony ship managed, with surprising grace, to maneuver between the massive peaks that are so prevalent in the jagged landscape of [Root.GetName]. It touched down in a sheltered valley that will serve as an ideal first landing site.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.
fleet_maneuvers_recruitment_desc: The recent naval drills have spurred a great deal of interest in the fleet among the public. We have no shortage of new recruits, which means that we will have to spend less resources to find crews for our starships.
fleet_maneuvers_desc: As a result of the large fleet maneuvers we recently held, our well-trained naval crews are able to maintain a higher rate of fire.
maneuvers_canceled_desc: Large segments of our military leadership are disgruntled due to the recent cancellation of our planned fleet maneuvers. They feel that it is an unacceptable sign of weakness that our neighbors are sure to take advantage of.
maneuvers_no_protest_desc: A large segment of our military is furious over the fact that we failed to diplomatically object to the massive foreign fleet exercise that recently took place close to our borders.
FLESH_IS_WEAK_PROJECT_DESC:
It is a fool who persists in clinging to a worn, decrepit instrument when a more efficient alternative presents itself.

We now possess the technology to make cybernetic implants available to the population of the [Root.GetName] at large. Our citizens will be stronger, faster and more intelligent as limbs and organs are replaced with improved mechanical versions.
SYNTHETIC_EVOLUTION_PROJECT_DESC: It is time to leave our flawed organic vessels behind and embrace immortality. We must prepare advanced synthetic avatars for our entire population, and then begin the process of consciousness transfers.
TRAIT_IMPROVES_LEADERS: Leaders from this species have additional traits
trait_cybernetic_desc: This species has embraced cybernetics on such a scale that its members may be considered cyborgs. They routinely replace their organic body parts with more advanced mechanical versions.
TRAIT_CYBORG_EFFECT: Replaces 50% of £ $concept_food$ (or equivalent) Upkeep with £ $concept_energy$ Upkeep
trait_latent_psionic_desc: This species has latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most of its members. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest in some leaders.
trait_cyborg_power_drills_desc: Outfit a cyborg with a battery of power drills, and suddenly everything looks like a mineral deposit.
trait_cyborg_harvesters_desc: A suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables cybernetic workers to increase produce yields.
trait_cyborg_superconductive_desc: The use of superconductive materials in units have cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.
trait_cyborg_efficient_processors_desc: These highly efficient processors increase the both workload and endurance.
trait_cyborg_logic_engines_desc: Efficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires parallel processors to augment organic brains.
trait_cyborg_loyalty_circuits_desc: Loyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. It is much more efficient to simply program compliance.
trait_cyborg_double_jointed_desc: Collapsible labor units with flexible joints enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.
trait_cyborg_bulky_desc: These highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.
trait_cyborg_enhanced_memory_desc: A revolutionary technique fits autonomous units with memory cells using a revolutionary, new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.
trait_cyborg_durable_desc: Protected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.
trait_cyborg_high_maintenance_desc: These machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.
trait_cyborg_learning_algorithms_desc: Sophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.
trait_cyborg_neural_limiters_desc: By limiting the cognitive abilities of our workers we can encourage them to focus on more menial tasks.
trait_cyborg_custom_made_desc: Each new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.
trait_cyborg_recycled_desc: Unit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.
trait_cyborg_streamlined_protocols_desc: Extensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly with minimal loss of efficiency.
trait_cyborg_high_bandwidth_desc: Individual units send and receive a vast amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.
trait_cyborg_trading_algorithms_desc: Predictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.
trait_cyborg_power_intensive_desc: These cybernetic components require frequent recharging from an external power source.
trait_self_modified_desc: Members of this offshoot species have spontaneously altered their genetic makeup to give themselves an advantage.
leader_trait_shroud_age_desc: The powerful psionic energies of the Shroud have slowed the natural [GetAgingLoc] process of this [GetLeaderLoc].
leader_trait_reformer_desc: This leader is a reformer, dedicated towards building the society of tomorrow.
leader_trait_ruler_hive_mind_desc: This leader is the immortal nexus of the vast cognitive apparatus that constitutes a [owner.GetGestaltEntityName].
